note: Machine translation of the website (tools/website/translate_site.py); fix a row's text to improve it.

0014a3bf18679290.source: The first time, Windows may ask whether to let DDM communicate on networks: allow it on private networks, or the phone can't reach DDM.
0014a3bf18679290.text: 首次使用时，Windows 可能会询问是否允许 DDM 在网络上通信：请允许其在专用网络上通信，否则手机无法连接 DDM。

0017931594681f79.source: <g1><g2>Portable mode</g2></g1> — run DDM from a folder or a USB stick without installing it.
0017931594681f79.text: <g1><g2>便携模式</g2></g1> — 无需安装即可从文件夹或 U 盘运行 DDM。

0022aa34a898269c.source: <g1>A YouTube playlist in Add URL</g1> (<g2>#338</g2>) opens the video window with its videos, instead of saving the page as a file named "playlist".
0022aa34a898269c.text: <g1>在“添加 URL”中添加 YouTube 播放列表</g1>（<g2>#338</g2>）会打开带有其视频的视频窗口，而不是将页面保存为名为“playlist”的文件。

0024cb13460f1e1f.source: DDM saves each download's progress as it goes, so a Windows crash, a power cut or closing DDM loses at most the last moments.
0024cb13460f1e1f.text: DDM 会在下载过程中保存每个下载的进度，因此 Windows 崩溃、断电或关闭 DDM 最多只会丢失最后时刻的进度。

002516ba76ac4fc3.source: Yes: export your list from IDM, then choose Tasks → Import → From IDM export file in DDM. <g1>More</g1>
002516ba76ac4fc3.text: 可以：先从 IDM 导出列表，然后在 DDM 中选择“任务”→“导入”→“从 IDM 导出文件”。<g1>更多</g1>

0025b509f2663050.source: Runs on most distributions: make it executable (<x1/>) and run it. It updates itself in place (<g2>Help → Check for updates</g2>).
0025b509f2663050.text: 可在大多数发行版上运行：使其可执行（<x1/>）并运行。它会原地更新（<g2>帮助 → 检查更新</g2>）。

003e18571307edf6.source: <g1>Under your speed limits</g1>: the <g2>Speed Limiter</g2>'s, the video's own (its progress window's <g3>Speed Limiter</g3> tab), and the limit for all downloads together. A change applies at once.
003e18571307edf6.text: <g1>在您的速度限制下</g1>：包括<g2>速度限制器</g2>的限制、视频本身的限制（其进度窗口的<g3>速度限制器</g3>选项卡），以及所有下载任务的总限制。任何更改都会立即生效。

0047e3c92be9288c.source: After a few months the list can hold hundreds of downloads. Here are four ways to get to the one you want.
0047e3c92be9288c.text: 几个月后，列表可能会包含数百个下载。这里有四种方法可以找到您想要的下载。

004ce569701a199b.source: On macOS only an administrator can schedule a wake, so the option is greyed. DDM doesn't ask for an administrator's password. An administrator can have the Mac wake every day a minute before the queue starts, for example at 10:59 PM for a queue that starts at 11:00 PM:
004ce569701a199b.text: 在 macOS 上，只有管理员才能安排唤醒，因此该选项是灰色的。DDM 不会要求管理员密码。管理员可以设置 Mac 在队列开始前一分钟每天唤醒，例如，对于晚上 11:00 开始的队列，在晚上 10:59 唤醒：

006bcd211ae86394.source: These pages explain each part of the program. The tutorials walk through the things people do most, one task each.
006bcd211ae86394.text: 这些页面介绍了程序的各个部分。教程会逐步讲解大家最常做的操作，每个教程介绍一项操作。

0098dc925a6174d6.source: Acts on downloads by id: <x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/> (file kept), <x4/> (file deleted too) or <x5/> (shows the file in its folder, as <g6>Open folder</g6> does). Answers <x7/>; a running download must be paused before it is removed or deleted. Only while the API is on.
0098dc925a6174d6.text: 按 ID 对下载执行操作：<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>（保留文件）、<x4/>（同时删除文件）或 <x5/>（在文件夹中显示文件，与<g6>打开文件夹</g6>相同）。返回 <x7/>；运行中的下载必须先暂停，才能被移除或删除。仅在 API 开启时有效。

00a7253abb008136.source: Report a problem with a translation →

00c0b83711a9aa44.source: On a Linux system without CA certificates (a minimal install without the <x1/> package), torrents still work: peers, the DHT and <x2/> trackers. An <x3/> tracker can't be checked there, so DDM skips it; install that package to use those too.
00c0b83711a9aa44.text: 在没有 CA 证书的 Linux 系统上（未安装 <x1/> 软件包的最小化安装），种子仍然可以工作：对等节点、DHT 和 <x2/> 跟踪器。无法在此类系统上检查 <x3/> 跟踪器，因此 DDM 会跳过它；安装该软件包即可使用这些功能。

00c4e6015cb2a0d5.source: In <g1>Link grabber</g1>, the volumes of one archive form one package. Each package has its folder, the archives' password, <g2>Extract when done</g2> (ticked by itself when the package holds an archive) and <g3>Delete archives after extracting</g3>. The password is kept in memory only, never written to disk.
00c4e6015cb2a0d5.text: 在<g1>链接抓取器</g1>中，一个压缩包的所有分卷会组成一个包。每个包都有自己的文件夹、压缩包密码、<g2>完成后提取</g2>（当包包含压缩包时会自动勾选）和<g3>提取后删除存档</g3>。密码仅保存在内存中，绝不会写入磁盘。

00deae29052686c9.source: The download list, text boxes and menus
00deae29052686c9.text: 下载列表、文本框和菜单

00dfff13e69e9ac7.text: 一个列表，管理所有下载

00ec64d3ac29c27c.source: Adding downloads — Dannex Download Manager help
00ec64d3ac29c27c.text: 添加下载 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

00ede073a341fb2a.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager stopped responding</g1>: its window didn't answer for 8 seconds. DDM is still running, frozen. <g2>End and restart DDM</g2> closes the frozen copy and starts a new one. If DDM answers again by itself, the window says so.
00ede073a341fb2a.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager 停止响应</g1>：窗口连续 8 秒没有响应。DDM 仍在运行，但已冻结。<g2>结束并重启 DDM</g2>会关闭已冻结的程序副本并启动一个新的副本。如果 DDM 自行恢复响应，窗口会显示这一情况。

0101e95bc6b6502c.source: Hold <g1>Ctrl+Alt</g1> while clicking a link to have DDM download it whatever its type, as <g2>Download with DDM</g2> in the right-click menu does: a page, a picture, a file type Options leave to the browser. Neither the page nor the browser does anything else with that click (no tab opens).
0101e95bc6b6502c.text: 点击链接时按住 <g1>Ctrl+Alt</g1>，可让 DDM 下载它，不论其类型，效果与右键菜单中的<g2>使用 DDM 下载</g2>相同：包括网页、图片，以及选项留给浏览器处理的文件类型。这次点击，页面和浏览器都不会再做别的事（不会打开标签页）。

0116b75ba3243932.source: <g1>Depth</g1>: how many links away from the start page it reads pages. 0 reads the start page only; 2 reads the pages it links to, and the pages those link to.
0116b75ba3243932.text: <g1>深度</g1>：从起始页面向外读取多少层链接内的页面。0 只读取起始页面；2 会读取它链接到的页面，以及那些页面所链接到的页面。

0144fefa5bfd7021.source: <g1>Direct3D 12, Vulkan and Metal support:</g1> DDM draws with Direct3D 12 on Windows; Vulkan on Linux and Metal on macOS are options.
0144fefa5bfd7021.text: <g1>支持 Direct3D 12、Vulkan 和 Metal：</g1> DDM 在 Windows 上使用 Direct3D 12 绘制；在 Linux 上可选择 Vulkan，在 macOS 上可选择 Metal。

0165595bf9c599c6.source: Options, General: Use advanced browser integration and the list of browsers DDM takes downloads from
0165595bf9c599c6.text: 选项，常规：使用高级浏览器集成和 DDM 从中获取下载的浏览器列表

017ae946397f5cac.source: DDM downloads BitTorrent files from magnet links and .torrent files. Torrents appear in the same list as other downloads, marked Torrent in the Source…
017ae946397f5cac.text: DDM 可通过磁力链接和 .torrent 文件下载 BitTorrent 文件。种子会与其他下载一起显示在同一列表中，并在“源”列中标记为“种子”…

017e6920369637f6.source: <g1>One look for every kind of control</g1>, in both themes: text boxes, read-only fields, check boxes, buttons, drop-downs, tabs, lists and their headers, popups and progress bars are each drawn one way everywhere (dark mode drew some windows' controls in an older style, with bright borders). A number and its arrows are one box now, as Windows 11's are; text is centred in controls of any height; one blue for selection and focus.
017e6920369637f6.text: <g1>两种主题下的所有控件外观统一</g1>：文本框、只读字段、复选框、按钮、下拉菜单、选项卡、列表及其标题、弹出窗口和进度条在各处的绘制方式都一致（以前深色模式下，某些窗口中的控件使用旧样式，边框较亮）。数字和箭头现在位于同一个框中，就像 Windows 11 中一样；不同高度的控件中文本都居中显示；选中项和焦点统一使用蓝色。

017ea75600814341.source: Open <g1>View → Theme</g1> and click a theme: the whole window changes at once, nothing to restart. <g2>View → Dark Mode support</g2> and <g3>View → Always dark</g3> then choose its light or dark side, as for the classic look (<g4>Dark mode</g4>).
017ea75600814341.text: 打开<g1>视图 → 主题</g1>，然后点击一个主题：整个窗口会立即改变，无需重启。然后，<g2>视图 → 深色模式支持</g2>和<g3>视图 → 始终为深色</g3>会选择其浅色或深色模式，就像经典外观一样（<g4>深色模式</g4>）。

0187f061227ec387.source: Version {v1} · free and open source · no ads, no spyware, nothing bundled. <g1>What's new</g1>
0187f061227ec387.text: 版本 {v1} · 免费开源 · 无广告、无间谍软件、无捆绑软件。<g1>更新内容</g1>

01a849d31d234662.source: Import your download list from IDM — Dannex Download Manager
01a849d31d234662.text: 从 IDM 导入下载列表 — Dannex Download Manager

01bcaeaab78b066e.source: A page address that points at one video inside a playlist or a mix (for example <x1/>) downloads that one video, never the whole list.
01bcaeaab78b066e.text: 如果页面地址指向播放列表或混音中的某个视频（例如 <x1/>），只会下载该视频，不会下载整个列表。

01bff8c60e4100a3.source: <g1>Torrent → Files…</g1>: the list of a torrent's files for any torrent, running, stopped or finished, with a box to choose each (also a Files… button in File Properties).
01bff8c60e4100a3.text: <g1>种子 → 文件…</g1>：显示任何种子（运行中、已停止或已完成）的文件列表，并提供复选框供选择（“文件属性”中也有“文件…”按钮）。

01c4c1faa63db5e5.source: Add it to the main download queue without starting it.
01c4c1faa63db5e5.text: 将其添加到主下载队列，但不开始下载。

01d01057d15da7cc.source: A server far by its round trip (over 150 ms)
01d01057d15da7cc.text: 往返时间较长（超过 150 毫秒）的服务器

01e8f0b4acca66a4.source: <g1>Start Download</g1> (or <g2>Enter</g2>) — download now. The progress window opens.
01e8f0b4acca66a4.text: <g1>开始下载</g1>（或<g2>Enter</g2>） — 立即下载。进度窗口打开。

02134070b2198d28.source: DDM's own window opens each browser's store page for you.
02134070b2198d28.text: DDM 自带的窗口会为您打开各浏览器的商店页面。

02134bd4a394a140.source: Torrents and magnet links, in the list you already use.
02134bd4a394a140.text: 种子和磁力链接，就在您已使用的列表中。

0215d585eb249436.source: On a queue's <g1>Schedule</g1> tab, tick <g2>Start download at</g2> and choose a time, <g3>Once at</g3> a date or <g4>Daily</g4> on the days you tick. <g5>Stop download at</g5> halts whatever is left, for example before work in the morning. A queue can also start whenever DDM starts.
0215d585eb249436.text: 在队列的<g1>计划</g1>选项卡上，勾选<g2>在以下时间开始下载</g2>并选择一个时间，<g3>一次在</g3>某个日期或<g4>每日</g4>在您勾选的日期。在<g5>在以下时间停止下载</g5>会暂停所有剩余任务，例如在早上工作前。队列也可以在 DDM 启动时开始。

0229b9ca87857c4c.source: A scheme changes colours only, on the classic look: every window, button and menu stays where it was. A dark scheme makes DDM dark and a light one light, whatever <g1>View → Always dark</g1> says. The scheme's colours go where they mean the same:
0229b9ca87857c4c.text: 方案只改变经典外观的颜色：所有窗口、按钮和菜单都保持原位。深色方案使 DDM 变暗，浅色方案使 DDM 变亮，无论 <g1>视图 → 始终为深色</g1> 的设置如何。方案的颜色会应用到其含义相同的位置：

02371ffa84de243f.source: Yes. Put downloads in a queue and let the Scheduler start it at a set time, stop it at another, and even shut down or put the computer to sleep when the queue is done. See <g1>Download overnight</g1>.
02371ffa84de243f.text: 可以。将下载任务放入队列，让计划程序在设定时间开始，在另一时间停止，甚至在队列完成后关闭或休眠计算机。请参阅<g1>通宵下载</g1>。

0251eaa65cf18141.source: With a debrid account, torrents and magnet links can go to the service instead of to peers, and DDM downloads the files from it over HTTP: see <g1>Torrents through the service</g1>.
0251eaa65cf18141.text: 通过网盘账户，种子和磁力链接可以发送到服务而不是对等节点，DDM 会通过 HTTP 从该服务下载文件：请参阅<g1>通过服务下载种子</g1>。

02575b1206e9ed9c.source: It's a theme already. A <g1>Base16 or Base24 scheme</g1> (<x2/>) or pywal's <x3/>, added the same way, changes DDM's colours and nothing else: the scheme's backgrounds behind the list and the windows, its text kept readable (4.5:1 or more), its blue on the focus, the selection and the progress bar. Once <x4/> has run, <g5>View → Theme</g5> lists <g6>pywal</g6>, read from <x7/> (
02575b1206e9ed9c.text: 它本身就是一个主题。<g1>Base16 或 Base24 配色方案</g1>（<x2/>）或 pywal 的 <x3/>，以相同方式添加，只改变 DDM 的颜色：列表和窗口的背景色、保持可读的文本颜色（4.5:1 或更高）、焦点、选择和进度条的蓝色。一旦 <x4/> 运行，<g5>视图 → 主题</g5> 会列出从 <x7/> 读取的 <g6>pywal</g6>（

026a1b767daa1fa2.source: <g1>File name or part of the name</g1> — on by default.
026a1b767daa1fa2.text: <g1>文件名或名称的一部分</g1> — 默认开启。

02a38777a650e8a4.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>Video from a page</g3> <g4>Paste a page's address and choose a quality, up to 4K, from YouTube, Vimeo and thousands of other sites.</g4>
02a38777a650e8a4.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>下载网页视频</g3> <g4>粘贴网页地址，即可从 YouTube、Vimeo 和数千个其他网站选择画质，最高可达 4K。</g4>

02a3ebd04f6ae293.source: Each release lists the <g1>SHA-256</g1> checksum of every file in <x2/>. Check your download against it: see <g3>Download</g3>.
02a3ebd04f6ae293.text: 每个版本都列出了 <x2/> 中每个文件的 <g1>SHA-256</g1> 校验和。请对照它检查您的下载：请参阅<g3>下载</g3>。

02b95a4f44948228.source: <g1>Download only what you have the right to.</g1> You are responsible for what you download and share.
02b95a4f44948228.text: <g1>只下载您有权下载的内容。</g1>您对您下载和分享的内容负责。

02c8eeacc4c57a33.source: <g1>Clients.</g1> IDM and DDM, both at default settings (8 connections), each given the download through the same documented command line: <x2/>. Both save to the drive that holds IDM's temporary folder, so neither pays a cross-drive copy.
02c8eeacc4c57a33.text: <g1>客户端。</g1> IDM 和 DDM，均采用默认设置（8 个连接），每个下载都通过相同的命令行进行：<x2/>。两者都保存到 IDM 临时文件夹所在的驱动器，因此都不会产生跨驱动器复制的开销。

02d3f7c49a396162.source: Videos protected with DRM, as most paid streaming services use, can't be downloaded, and DDM doesn't try. Downloading may be against some sites' terms: checking that is up to you.
02d3f7c49a396162.text: 大多数付费流媒体服务使用的 DRM 保护视频无法下载，DDM 也不会尝试。下载可能违反某些网站的服务条款：您需要自行检查。

02e598ee413c0595.source: A checked box's or radio's accent
02e598ee413c0595.text: 选中复选框或单选框的强调色

02ead06d261194ac.source: Point at a video and a small <g1>Download video</g1> button appears at its edge. It opens DDM's <g2>Download video from a page</g2> window with the qualities on offer (see <g3>video downloads</g3>). You can hide it on one video or one site, or turn it off in <g4>Options</g4>.
02ead06d261194ac.text: 指向视频时，其边缘会出现一个小的<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮。它会打开 DDM 的<g2>从页面下载视频</g2>窗口，其中显示了可用的画质（请参阅<g3>视频下载</g3>）。您可以在单个视频或单个网站上隐藏它，或在<g4>选项</g4>中将其关闭。

02f56de89605a75e.source: DDM asks each service well under its request limit: Real-Debrid at most 120 times a minute (it allows 250), AllDebrid 300 (it allows 600), Premiumize 60 (it publishes no limit), TorBox 120 (it allows 300 a minute, and 60 new web downloads an hour). When a service says it's asked too often, DDM waits.
02f56de89605a75e.text: DDM 对每个服务的请求次数远低于其限制：Real-Debrid 每分钟最多 120 次 (它允许 250 次)，AllDebrid 300 次 (它允许 600 次)，Premiumize 60 次 (它未公布限制)，TorBox 120 次 (它允许每分钟 300 次，每小时 60 次新网页下载)。当服务提示请求过于频繁时，DDM 会等待。

02f824962fd84248.source: This cap is shared by every download, however many run at once. It works on its own; you don't need to turn the Speed Limiter on.
02f824962fd84248.text: 无论同时运行多少个下载，此限制都由所有下载共享。它独立工作；您无需开启速度限制器。

031da5c20d1881e4.text: 计划程序能做的所有事情 →

03210e48a68f4f78.source: Firefox (from addons.mozilla.org), Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi (from the Chrome Web Store), through the DDM browser extension, and browsers built on them: Zen and LibreWolf, Helium. The extension hands downloads to DDM with their cookies and referrer, so files behind a sign-in still work, and it adds Download with DDM to the right-click menu and a Download video button over videos. See Browser integration.
03210e48a68f4f78.text: Firefox（来自 addons.mozilla.org）、Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi（来自 Chrome 网上应用店）可通过 DDM 浏览器扩展程序使用；Zen、LibreWolf 和 Helium 等基于这些浏览器构建的浏览器也支持。该扩展程序会将下载任务连同 Cookie 和来源页信息交给 DDM，因此需要登录才能访问的文件也可以下载。它还会在右键菜单中添加使用 DDM 下载，并在视频上方添加下载视频按钮。请参阅浏览器集成。

032d6a9d38dacb94.source: <g1>Zen, Helium and other browsers built on Firefox or Chromium</g1> (<g2>#41</g2>): the extension reaches DDM in them, also when one is the only browser on Linux or macOS (Zen reads Firefox's folder, which DDM now creates; Helium its own). <g3>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g3> lists them, Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp and Waterfox by their own names (Options too), and sends Firefox's family to the right page. On Windows DDM lists the browsers Windows itself lists, so Helium is no longer taken for Chrome. Flatpak browsers can't start DDM's helper, which the help page now says.
032d6a9d38dacb94.text: <g1>Zen、Helium 和其他基于 Firefox 或 Chromium 构建的浏览器</g1>（<g2>#41</g2>）：扩展可以在这些浏览器中连接到 DDM，即使其中一个浏览器是 Linux 或 macOS 上唯一的浏览器（Zen 读取 Firefox 的文件夹，DDM 现在会创建；Helium 读取其自己的文件夹）。<g3>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g3>会列出它们，Zen、LibreWolf、Floorp 和 Waterfox 会显示其自己的名称（“选项”中也是），并将 Firefox 系列浏览器发送到正确的页面。在 Windows 上，DDM 会列出 Windows 自身列出的浏览器，因此 Helium 不再被视为 Chrome。Flatpak 浏览器无法启动 DDM 的助手，帮助页面现在会说明这一点。

032f38898f839833.source: <g1>Move/Rename</g1> was greyed out with several downloads selected, for example a set just added to a queue. It now asks for a folder and moves them all there (<g2>#333</g2>).
032f38898f839833.text: 当选择多个下载任务时，例如一组刚添加到队列中的任务，<g1>移动/重命名</g1>会变灰。现在它会要求选择一个文件夹并将所有任务移动到那里（<g2>#333</g2>）。

03506d1b88dc282f.source: The area under a speed graph's line, at the line (it fades toward the bottom)
03506d1b88dc282f.text: 速度图线条下方的区域，靠近线条处（向底部渐隐）

03615f08519b4f49.source: <g1>Tasks → Link grabber...</g1> opens the same window empty: paste text with links in it (<g2>Ctrl+V</g2>). See <g3>Link grabber and archives</g3> for the packages, the archive password and extracting archives when they are downloaded.
03615f08519b4f49.text: <g1>任务 → 链接抓取器...</g1>会打开一个空白的同一窗口：粘贴包含链接的文本（<g2>Ctrl+V</g2>）。有关下载包、压缩包密码以及下载完成后解压压缩包的信息，请参阅<g3>链接抓取器和压缩包</g3>。

0364c0cf3df3d7e2.source: Select the download and click <g1>Resume</g1>. Many errors are a server or connection having a bad moment.
0364c0cf3df3d7e2.text: 选择下载任务并点击<g1>恢复</g1>。很多错误只是服务器或连接暂时出了问题。

036537e30c1d30cd.source: With <g1>Use proxy/socks from a browser's request</g1> (on by default), a download DDM takes from the browser goes through the proxy the browser used for it: a VPN or proxy extension's, the browser's own manual proxy, or its auto-config script. Content limited to the VPN's country keeps working. In Firefox, switch on <g2>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g2> in the extension's popup. Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi can't hand the proxy over yet: set the same proxy in DDM there. A proxy that needs the VPN extension's own login can't be shared, and the download says so rather than going without it.
036537e30c1d30cd.text: 启用<g1>使用浏览器请求中的代理/SOCKS</g1>（默认开启）后，DDM 从浏览器接管的下载将通过浏览器为其使用的代理进行：可以是 VPN 或代理扩展的代理、浏览器自己的手动代理，或其自动配置脚本。这样，受 VPN 国家/地区限制的内容也能正常工作。在 Firefox 中，请在扩展程序的弹出窗口中开启<g2>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g2>。Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 尚无法移交代理：请在 DDM 中设置相同的代理。需要 VPN 扩展自身登录凭据的代理无法共享，下载会显示相关信息，而不是在没有代理的情况下进行。

037c61a1fa3644c7.source: DDM remembers the columns, their widths and the sort order.
037c61a1fa3644c7.text: DDM 会记住列、列宽和排序顺序。

037e54db1d283569.source: No. DDM has no accounts, no analytics and no telemetry. It connects to the servers you download from and, each time it starts and once a day while it runs, asks GitHub whether a newer version exists (you can turn that off in Help → Check for updates). The browser extension talks only to DDM on your own computer. The details are in the <g1>privacy policy</g1>.
037e54db1d283569.text: 不。DDM 没有账户、分析和遥测功能。它连接到您下载的服务器，并在每次启动时和运行时每天一次向 GitHub 查询是否有新版本（您可以在“帮助”→“检查更新”中关闭此功能）。浏览器扩展程序只与您自己电脑上的 DDM 通信。详细信息请参阅<g1>隐私政策</g1>。

039a3bf8ea2e0dae.source: 10 built-in looks for Dannex Download Manager, each light and dark: Classic, Native, High contrast, Metro, Adwaita, Breeze, Luna, Aero, Aqua, Emerald. Or make your own in a text file.
039a3bf8ea2e0dae.text: Dannex Download Manager 提供了 10 种内置外观，每种都有亮色和暗色模式：经典、原生、高对比度、现代、Adwaita、Breeze、Luna、Aero、Aqua、翡翠。您也可以在文本文件中创建自己的主题。

03b1ad40625d83e8.source: Yes, completely. Dannex Download Manager (DDM) is free and open-source software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. There is no trial period…
03b1ad40625d83e8.text: 是的，完全免费。Dannex Download Manager (DDM) 是在 GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版下发布的免费开源软件。没有试用期…

03c0d4a7540da82c.source: A download's progress window can go there as well, with its Minimize, with <g1>Esc</g1>, or with its <g2>Hide to the notification area</g2> button: a short dash with an arrow down to the corner. The download goes on. (Its close box <g3>×</g3> stops the download instead, as <g4>Cancel</g4> does.)
03c0d4a7540da82c.text: 下载的进度窗口也可以放到那里，方法是使用其“最小化”、按 <g1>Esc</g1>，或使用其<g2>隐藏到通知区域</g2>按钮：一条短横线加一个指向角落的向下箭头。下载继续进行。（其关闭框 <g3>×</g3> 则会停止下载，与<g4>取消</g4>相同。）

03f6065d45b64f00.source: Windows: no more crash on a computer where Direct3D can't start, when a window opened during the switch to OpenGL (<g1>#337</g1>).
03f6065d45b64f00.text: Windows：在 Direct3D 无法启动的计算机上，当在切换到 OpenGL 期间打开窗口时，不再发生崩溃（<g1>#337</g1>）。

03fe2d590fecb966.source: Enter new address to download with the copied address filled in
03fe2d590fecb966.text: “输入要下载的新地址”已填入复制的地址

040a0a6a2988381d.source: If the site replaced the file with a new version, the parts DDM has don't fit any more. Right-click the download and choose <g1>Redownload</g1> to start again from the beginning. A finished file is only replaced when the new download completes.
040a0a6a2988381d.text: 如果网站用新版本替换了文件，DDM 已下载的部分就不再匹配。右键点击下载并选择<g1>重新下载</g1>以从头开始。只有当新下载完成时，已完成的文件才会被替换。

0410e8d07c304fbe.source: Can my AI assistant use DDM? — Dannex Download Manager
0410e8d07c304fbe.text: 我的 AI 助手可以使用 DDM 吗？— Dannex Download Manager

042975319f3eadfb.source: <g1>Torrents behind a proxy open no UDP socket toward the network</g1>: UDP trackers were already left out there; now their client stays on this computer too.
042975319f3eadfb.text: <g1>代理后的种子不会向网络打开 UDP 套接字</g1>：UDP 追踪器已经排除在外；现在它们的客户端也保留在此电脑上。

042f649662bebfc1.source: DDM opens where you left it: the window's place and size, the Categories pane, its open branches and the category or queue you were looking at.
042f649662bebfc1.text: DDM 会在上次关闭时的位置和大小打开窗口，并恢复类别窗格、展开的分支，以及您当时查看的类别或队列。

047d41a834df5979.source: Free and open source. The interface you already know, a faster engine underneath, torrents and video built in.
047d41a834df5979.text: 免费开源。采用您熟悉的界面，底层引擎更快，并内置种子下载和视频下载功能。

0483013fd35a5fd8.source: <g1>Options → General → Take downloads from web browsers</g1> is on, and your browser is ticked under <g2>Take downloads from these browsers</g2>.
0483013fd35a5fd8.text: <g1>选项 → 常规 → 接管浏览器的下载</g1>已开启，并且在<g2>接管这些浏览器的下载</g2>下已勾选您的浏览器。

04acb5c39615acc6.source: <g1>Site grabber:</g1> <g2>Tasks → Run site grabber</g2> explores a website and collects its files: all its images, audio, video or documents, a whole site to read offline, or your own choice of types. Choose how deep it follows links, whether it stays on the same host, domain or goes to any site, addresses to include or leave out, and the most pages and files; it follows the site's robots.txt and pauses between requests. The files it found are listed with their types and sizes, to download all or the ones you tick into a queue. Each grab is kept as a project under <g3>Grabber projects</g3>, to run again, edit or delete (<g4>help</g4>).
04acb5c39615acc6.text: <g1>站点抓取器：</g1><g2>任务 → 运行站点抓取器</g2>会探索网站并收集其文件：全部图像、音频、视频或文档，整个网站以便离线阅读，或您自选的类型。可选择跟随链接的深度、是否停留在同一主机、同一域或前往任意站点、要包含或排除的地址，以及最多页面数和文件数；它遵循站点的 robots.txt，并在请求之间暂停。找到的文件连同类型和大小一起列出，可全部下载，或把您勾选的放入队列下载。每次抓取都作为项目保存在<g3>抓取项目</g3>下，可再次运行、编辑或删除（<g4>帮助</g4>）。

04bb12464d3a29f6.source: Tick <g1>Wake the computer to run this queue</g1>, under the start time, and a computer that is asleep at the start time is woken for it. It needs <g2>Start download at</g2>.
04bb12464d3a29f6.text: 勾选开始时间下方的<g1>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g1>，电脑将在开始时间被唤醒。此功能需要<g2>在以下时间开始下载</g2>。

04c59d01af7e5661.source: <g1>Speed limiter</g1><g2>One cap for all of DDM, a limit per file, and full speed when you're away.</g2>
04c59d01af7e5661.text: <g1>速度限制器</g1><g2>为 DDM 设置一个总限速，或为每个文件设置限速，当您离开时可全速下载。</g2>

04ea3f289327532e.source: Tick <g1>Send torrents and magnet links to the first account instead of to peers</g1> in <g2>Options → Accounts</g2>. A magnet link (Add URL, the browser, the clipboard, a drop) or a <x3/> file (Add torrent's <g4>Download Now</g4> or <g5>Later</g5>) then goes to the first account in the list:
04ea3f289327532e.text: 在<g2>选项 → 帐户</g2>中勾选<g1>将种子和磁力链接发送到第一个帐户，而不是发送给对等方</g1>。之后，磁力链接（通过添加 URL、浏览器、剪贴板或拖放添加）或<x3/>文件（通过“添加种子”中的<g4>立即下载</g4>或<g5>稍后</g5>操作）都会发送到列表中的第一个帐户：

05088ac8334b7b90.source: Dannex Download Manager (DDM) is a free download manager for Windows and Linux (and, still experimental, macOS). It is laid out the way Internet Download Manager users expect: a toolbar, categories on the left, one list of downloads and a browser extension that hands downloads to it.
05088ac8334b7b90.text: Dannex Download Manager (DDM) 是一款适用于 Windows 和 Linux（macOS 版本仍在实验中）的免费下载管理器。它的布局与 Internet Download Manager 用户所熟悉的界面一致：一个工具栏、左侧的类别、一个下载列表以及一个将下载任务交给它的浏览器扩展。

050988a5d66f5eb1.source: A big fixes release: YouTube and video downloads, crashes and freezes, downloads on slow disks, the Mac helper, plus a Safari extension, far more file types and a few new columns and options.
050988a5d66f5eb1.text: 此版本主要修复了错误：包括 YouTube 和视频下载、崩溃和卡顿、慢速磁盘上的下载、Mac 辅助程序，以及 Safari 扩展、更多文件类型和一些新列与选项。

05105cdaa992861d.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager isn't installed</g1>, a <g2>Download Dannex Download Manager</g2> button for your system (Windows setup, macOS .dmg, Linux AppImage, .deb or .rpm) and three short steps
05105cdaa992861d.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager 未安装</g1>，一个适用于您系统的<g2>下载 Dannex Download Manager</g2>按钮（Windows 安装程序、macOS .dmg、Linux AppImage、.deb 或 .rpm）以及三个简短的步骤

052e65771dfdbc15.source: While the app is not notarized by Apple (the experimental builds are not), Safari lists the extension only with unsigned extensions allowed: <g1>Settings → Advanced</g1> → <g2>Show features for web developers</g2>, then <g3>Settings → Developer</g3> → <g4>Allow unsigned extensions</g4>. Safari forgets that setting each time it quits.
052e65771dfdbc15.text: 由于此应用程序未经 Apple 公证（实验版本未经公证），Safari 仅在允许未签名扩展程序时才列出此扩展程序：<g1>设置 → 高级</g1> → <g2>显示网页开发者功能</g2>，然后<g3>设置 → 开发者</g3> → <g4>允许未签名扩展程序</g4>。Safari 每次退出时都会忘记此设置。

053263e0b7c48cfa.text: 哪些内容会连接到您的计算机

0533acda9da6cbfb.source: <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> filled the form's System and Installed with only for a moment; they stay filled now.
0533acda9da6cbfb.text: 现在，<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>填写的表单中，“系统”和“已安装”信息不会再只显示片刻，而会一直保留。

053b48e80f60c390.source: <g1>Ignore file modification time changes when resuming a download</g1> — for servers that report a new date for the same file each time. Without it, such a server makes every resume start over.
053b48e80f60c390.text: <g1>恢复下载时忽略文件修改时间的变化</g1> — 适用于每次都为同一文件报告新日期的服务器。如果关闭此选项，此类服务器会导致每次恢复下载都从头开始。

053ee7266a83cbdf.source: <g1>One browser only:</g1> <g2>Options → General → Take downloads from these browsers</g2>. Untick the ones DDM should leave alone.
053ee7266a83cbdf.text: <g1>仅限一个浏览器：</g1><g2>选项 → 常规 → 接管这些浏览器的下载</g2>。取消勾选 DDM 应忽略的浏览器。

05486df7875394e2.source: Downloads stay with the browser although DDM is connected
05486df7875394e2.text: DDM 已连接，但下载仍由浏览器处理

0550900e29fb88f8.source: A server that allows two connections. DDM learns it and keeps to two; IDM opened 480.
0550900e29fb88f8.text: 一个允许两个连接的服务器。DDM 学习并保持两个连接；IDM 打开了 480 个。

05519de6cf4ebfd7.source: Downloads at full speed no longer stop and go on a slow disk: writing the resume state flushed the file to the disk so often that every connection waited for it, and were then replaced as slow (<g1>#361</g1>).
05519de6cf4ebfd7.text: 慢速磁盘上的全速下载不再停止和继续：写入恢复状态会频繁地将文件刷新到磁盘，导致每个连接都等待它，然后被替换为慢速连接（<g1>#361</g1>）。

05570b2fd86d1903.source: <g1>Your own devices, for the remote control.</g1> Off until you turn it on in <g2>Options → Remote</g2>: then DDM answers, over HTTPS on your local network, only the phones and computers you paired with its code.
05570b2fd86d1903.text: <g1>您的设备，用于远程控制。</g1> 在<g2>选项 → 远程</g2>中开启前，此功能默认关闭：开启后，DDM 仅通过本地网络上的 HTTPS 协议响应您已用其代码配对的手机和电脑。

055ae1fc7cba3fea.source: Use <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1> in DDM: it opens the bug report form on GitHub with your version, system and language filled in. Or <g2>open the form</g2> yourself. Security problems go privately through the <g3>security page</g3>.
055ae1fc7cba3fea.text: 在 DDM 中使用<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>：它会打开 GitHub 上的错误报告表，并已填写您的版本、系统和语言信息。或者您也可以<g2>自行打开该表单</g2>。安全问题请通过<g3>安全页面</g3>私下提交。

056973ea0bc40de4.source: Use GitHub's private <g1><g2>Report a vulnerability</g2></g1> form. Only the maintainers can read it. Say what you found, how to reproduce it, and which version you used (<g3>Help → About</g3> shows it). Please don't open a public issue for security problems.
056973ea0bc40de4.text: 请使用 GitHub 的私密<g1><g2>报告漏洞</g2></g1>表单。只有维护者可以查看。请说明您发现的问题、复现方法以及使用的版本（可在<g3>帮助 → 关于</g3>中查看）。请勿公开提交安全问题。

057a7f50e1cb0dc0.source: DDM runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11, and on 64-bit Linux: see <g1>On Linux</g1>. Builds for macOS are new and still experimental: see <g2>On a Mac</g2>.
057a7f50e1cb0dc0.text: DDM 运行于 64 位 Windows 10 和 Windows 11，以及 64 位 Linux：请参阅<g1>在 Linux 上</g1>。macOS 版本是新推出的，仍在实验阶段：请参阅<g2>在 Mac 上</g2>。

05846ba063cf2214.source: How many times faster DDM finished, from command to finished file. The whisker is the 95% interval of the ratio; the scale is logarithmic.
05846ba063cf2214.text: DDM 从命令发出到文件完成的速度是 IDM 的多少倍。须线表示比率的 95% 置信区间；刻度为对数。

0588c7c82fed2d21.source: Which browsers does it work with?

05a0e75094ba72e8.source: <g1>Firefox</g1> asks you once, at the switch, to allow the extension to read the browser's proxy; switching it off takes that permission back. DDM gets the proxy the browser's own request for the file took, including the ones a VPN extension picks for each request.
05a0e75094ba72e8.text: <g1>Firefox</g1>会在您切换时询问一次，以允许扩展读取浏览器的代理；关闭此选项会收回该权限。DDM 会获取浏览器自身请求文件时所用的代理，包括 VPN 扩展为每个请求选择的代理。

05ae27da0376b80e.source: <g1>.deb</g1> for Debian and Ubuntu, <g2>.rpm</g2> for Fedora
05ae27da0376b80e.text: 适用于 Debian 和 Ubuntu 的 <g1>.deb</g1>，适用于 Fedora 的 <g2>.rpm</g2>

05cb692655b00cd1.source: <g1>A Linux test machine, scripted</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): <x3/> sets up an Ubuntu 24.04 desktop in VirtualBox from a Windows host (<x4/>: hardware, headless start, linked clones; <x5/>: packages, Rust, Node, the browsers, UI automation, an unlocked keyring), builds any branch or pull request there with a quick test profile (<x6/>), and checks pull requests on it: windows shot and compared pixel by pixel (<x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>), HLS and DASH hand-overs from the Snap Firefox and Google Chrome (<x10/>, <x11/>), the extension's proxy switch (<x12/>), hand-overs and the Scheduler while minimized, torrents without a network, and DDM's start-up time (<x13/>). Every change is now checked on Linux as on Windows. The machine also has copies on KDE Plasma, Cinnamon and XFCE (<x14/>), which get a build copied over instead of making one (<x15/>); a window harness shoots many windows from one running DDM in any language, mode and theme, with real clicks and keys inside the machine (<x16/>, <x17/>); and a store package is checked before it ships (<x18/>, <x19/>).
05cb692655b00cd1.text: <g1>脚本化的 Linux 测试机</g1>（<g2>#164</g2> 的一部分）：<x3/> 在 VirtualBox 中从 Windows 主机设置 Ubuntu 24.04 桌面（<x4/>：硬件、无头启动、链接克隆；<x5/>：软件包、Rust、Node、浏览器、UI 自动化、已解锁的密钥环），使用快速测试配置文件（<x6/>）构建任何分支或拉取请求，并检查其上的拉取请求：窗口截图并逐像素比较（<x7/>、<x8/>、<x9/>），Snap Firefox 和 Google Chrome 的 HLS 和 DASH 切换（<x10/>、<x11/>），扩展程序的代理切换（<x12/>），最小化时的切换和计划程序，无网络时的种子下载，以及 DDM 的启动时间（<x13/>）。现在，每次更改都会像在 Windows 上一样在 Linux 上进行检查。该机器还在 KDE Plasma、Cinnamon 和 XFCE 上有副本（<x14/>），这些副本会复制构建而不是重新生成（<x15/>）；一个窗口工具可以在机器内部通过真实的点击和按键，以任何语言、模式和主题从一个运行中的 DDM 拍摄多个窗口（<x16/>、<x17/>）；并且在发布之前会检查商店软件包（<x18/>、<x19/>）。

05cdb0c8c9d33bd7.source: <g1>Get automatic updates</g1>, once, quietly (also in the right-click menu)
05cdb0c8c9d33bd7.text: <g1>获取自动更新</g1>，仅提示一次，不打扰（右键菜单中也有）

05e4107afbf16316.source: Open it with <g1>Scheduler</g1> on the toolbar or <g2>Downloads → Scheduler</g2>. Right-clicking a queue and choosing <g3>Schedule</g3> or <g4>Edit queue</g4> opens it on that queue.
05e4107afbf16316.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>计划程序</g1>或选择<g2>下载 → 计划程序</g2>即可打开窗口。右键点击某个队列，然后选择<g3>计划</g3>或<g4>编辑队列</g4>，即可打开该队列的设置。

05f8c699ee2684d7.source: The website is in 21 languages too, also machine-translated. Its texts are in <x1/>, one row per sentence: fix a row's <x2/> (keep tags like <x3/> and <x4/> as they are, they are the links and icons). <x5/> shows what each language still lacks, and the same tool with <x6/> translates only that.
05f8c699ee2684d7.text: 本网站也提供 21 种语言版本，同样由机器翻译生成。网站文本位于<x1/>中，每行一句：修正每行的<x2/>（保留<x3/>和<x4/>等标签，它们代表链接和图标）。<x5/>会显示各语言还缺少哪些内容；使用同一工具并指定<x6/>时，只会翻译这些内容。

05f8c91edd2041dd.source: Under <g1>Add to queue</g1>, pick <g2>Main download queue</g2>. Leave <g3>Start the queue now</g3> unticked. Click <g4>OK</g4>.
05f8c91edd2041dd.text: 在<g1>添加到队列</g1>下，选择<g2>主下载队列</g2>。不要勾选<g3>立即启动队列</g3>。点击<g4>确定</g4>。

060740273a407a0d.source: Options, Save to: a category's folder
060740273a407a0d.text: 选项 → 保存到：一个类别的文件夹

0660089fb2a14cce.source: DDM tells Windows it draws for each monitor's own scale, so Windows never stretches its windows into blur, and it draws Windows' fonts grid-fitted to whole pixels. If the text still looks blurred, tell us your screen's resolution and Windows' display scale when you <g1>report it</g1>.
0660089fb2a14cce.text: DDM 告诉 Windows 它会根据每个显示器的缩放比例进行绘制，因此 Windows 不会将其窗口拉伸导致模糊，并且它会以网格对齐到完整像素的方式绘制 Windows 字体。如果文字仍然模糊，请在<g1>报告问题</g1>时告知我们您的屏幕分辨率和 Windows 的显示缩放比例。

066088d5e05f695c.source: yt-dlp, gallery-dl and ffmpeg can't be held to an adapter themselves. While one is chosen, DDM gives them a proxy of its own on this computer, with a password only they get, and opens their connections through the adapter as it opens its own. Video formats that can't go through a proxy (RTMP, RTSP, MMS, FTP) are refused rather than sent around it.
066088d5e05f695c.text: yt-dlp、gallery-dl 和 ffmpeg 本身无法绑定到网卡。当选择网卡时，DDM 会在本地计算机上为它们提供一个自己的代理，并使用只有它们才能获得的密码，通过该网卡打开它们的连接，就像打开自己的连接一样。无法通过代理的视频格式（RTMP、RTSP、MMS、FTP）将被拒绝，而不是绕过代理发送。

0666f4bab00370a5.source: Every release, with its notes and files, is on <g1>GitHub Releases</g1>. The source code is at <g2>github.com/Riskraptor/dannexdownloadmanager</g2> under the GNU GPL, version 3.
0666f4bab00370a5.text: 所有发布版本及其说明和文件都在<g1>GitHub Releases</g1>上。源代码位于<g2>github.com/Riskraptor/dannexdownloadmanager</g2>，遵循 GNU GPL v3 许可。

0670e60516f1c2a5.source: <g1>Crash reports.</g1> If DDM closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a report window opens. It shows what happened and where in DDM's code, lets you read the whole report, and <g2>Send on GitHub</g2> opens a crash report form in your browser, filled in. Nothing is sent by itself. When the same problem was already reported, it takes you to that issue instead. A frozen DDM can be ended and restarted from there. Reports leave out your download addresses and file names. See <g3>Crash reports</g3>.
0670e60516f1c2a5.text: <g1>崩溃报告。</g1>如果 DDM 意外关闭或停止响应，会打开报告窗口，显示问题经过以及问题在 DDM 代码中的位置。您可以查看完整报告，也可以点击<g2>在 GitHub 上发送</g2>，在浏览器中打开已填写内容的崩溃报告表单。报告不会自动发送。如果相同问题已有人报告，窗口会带您前往对应的问题页面。您也可以从这里结束并重新启动已冻结的 DDM。报告中不包含您的下载地址和文件名。请参阅<g3>崩溃报告</g3>。

0679d081a8cd40ea.source: Turns the API on or off: <x1/>.

0684dfd4cd41d0be.source: Download limits for capped internet plans →
0684dfd4cd41d0be.text: 有流量限制的互联网套餐的下载限制 →

068929e04a8d8a6b.source: The progress window shows the download: its speed, the time left, and what each connection is doing.
068929e04a8d8a6b.text: 进度窗口显示下载情况：速度、剩余时间以及每个连接的状态。

0692cbfad04324c6.source: The progress window draws it as it happens: a bar of the whole file with each connection's start and progress, and a table with what every connection is doing right now.
0692cbfad04324c6.text: 进度窗口会实时显示下载情况：一个显示整个文件进度的条形图，其中包含每个连接的起始位置和进度，以及一个显示每个连接当前正在做什么的表格。

06963b667716f236.source: Control your downloads from an AI assistant (MCP server)
06963b667716f236.text: 通过 AI 助手（MCP 服务器）控制下载

06a005846d84ad31.source: Many features: video and MP3 through yt-dlp, torrents, a site grabber, AI models from Hugging Face
06a005846d84ad31.text: 功能丰富：通过 yt-dlp 下载视频和 MP3，支持种子下载，提供网站抓取工具和来自 Hugging Face 的 AI 模型

06b404cfc795c9e9.source: The downloads join the <g1>Main download queue</g1>, ready to start (<g2>Start</g2> starts it too). <g3>Tasks → Import → From an IDM list (.ef2)</g3> reads a list exported from IDM, with each download's referrer and cookies.
06b404cfc795c9e9.text: 这些下载会加入<g1>主下载队列</g1>，随时可以开始（<g2>开始</g2>也可以启动它）。<g3>任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 列表 (.ef2)</g3>会读取从 IDM 导出的列表，包括每个下载的引用页和 Cookie。

06b5ae2a1fefaa62.source: <g1>Crash reports</g1><g2>A crash or freeze opens a report you read first, then send on GitHub yourself if you want.</g2>
06b5ae2a1fefaa62.text: <g1>崩溃报告</g1><g2>崩溃或冻结时会打开一份报告，您可以先阅读，如果需要，再自行发送到 GitHub。</g2>

06c3086c2bfcb389.source: If you want Internet Download Manager's layout without its price, Dannex Download Manager: free and open source, laid out like IDM, and it imports your IDM list. If you need something else first, such as an Android app or a particular feature, the comparison above shows what each of the others is good at.
06c3086c2bfcb389.text: 如果您想要 Internet Download Manager 的布局但不想付费，请选择 Dannex Download Manager：免费开源，布局与 IDM 相似，并且可以导入您的 IDM 列表。如果您首先需要其他功能，例如安卓应用或特定功能，上面的比较显示了其他每个产品的优点。

06d93a023180f29b.source: <g1>Timing.</g1> End to end: from issuing the command to the finished file under its final name, polled every millisecond on a monotonic clock. DDM renames its finished file into place; IDM creates the final file early and fills it, so for IDM the moment it reaches full size counts. Transfer: the server's first request to its last byte, read on the same clock through a calibration request before each run.
06d93a023180f29b.text: <g1>计时。</g1> 端到端：从发出命令到文件以最终名称完成，在单调时钟上每毫秒轮询一次。DDM 将完成的文件重命名到位；IDM 提前创建最终文件并填充它，因此对于 IDM，达到完整大小的时刻即为完成。传输：服务器的第一个请求到最后一个字节，在每次运行前通过校准请求在同一时钟上读取。

06e245ea1e3d8bbb.source: Its permissions, and why: <g1>downloads</g1> to see and hand over downloads; <g2>cookies</g2> so signed-in downloads work in DDM; <g3>nativeMessaging</g3> to talk to DDM; <g4>contextMenus</g4> for the right-click items; <g5>storage</g5> for its settings; <g6>webRequest</g6> to see forms submitted and video streams loaded (it changes nothing); <g7>declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess</g7> (Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers) to have the files the browser would open (a PDF) downloaded instead, for the types DDM takes; in Firefox, <g8>webRequestBlocking</g8> does that; <g9>scripting</g9> to read a page's links when you ask, and to add the video button to pages already open when the extension is installed; <g10>proxy</g10> to read which proxy the browser uses, so downloads taken from a browser behind a VPN or proxy extension go through it too, only while you have that switched on in its options page (it never changes the browser's proxy; in Firefox it is optional, asked for when you switch it on; Chrome and the other Chromium browsers can't make it optional, and count it under the access to all sites); access to all sites because downloads and videos can come from any site.
06e245ea1e3d8bbb.text: 它的权限及原因：<g1>downloads</g1>用于查看并交出下载；<g2>cookies</g2>使已登录的下载在 DDM 中可用；<g3>nativeMessaging</g3>用于与 DDM 通信；<g4>contextMenus</g4>用于右键菜单项；<g5>storage</g5>用于保存其设置；<g6>webRequest</g6>用于查看提交的表单和加载的视频流（它不会更改任何内容）；<g7>declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess</g7>（Chrome、Edge 和其他 Chromium 浏览器）用于让浏览器本会打开的文件（如 PDF）改为下载，针对 DDM 接管的类型；在 Firefox 中由<g8>webRequestBlocking</g8>实现；<g9>scripting</g9>用于在您请求时读取页面的链接，并在安装扩展时将视频按钮添加到已打开的页面；<g10>proxy</g10>用于读取浏览器使用的代理，使通过 VPN 或代理扩展的浏览器接管的下载也能经过它，仅在您于其选项页中开启该开关时才会使用（它从不更改浏览器的代理；在 Firefox 中它是可选的，开启时才会请求；Chrome 和其他 Chromium 浏览器无法将其设为可选，会将其计入对所有站点的访问权限）；访问所有站点，因为下载和视频可能来自任何站点。

06f1e7a5c9a5fcfc.source: Help → About: the version you have.
06f1e7a5c9a5fcfc.text: 帮助 → 关于：您拥有的版本。

06f2b21b4750b749.source: How do I report a bug or ask for a feature?
06f2b21b4750b749.text: 如何报告错误或提出功能请求？

070c8fa6ee24507e.source: Download <g1>setup.exe</g1> above and run it. Windows may ask whether to allow it: the installer isn't code-signed yet, so choose <g2>More info → Run anyway</g2>.
070c8fa6ee24507e.text: 下载上方的<g1>setup.exe</g1>并运行。Windows 可能会询问是否允许运行：安装程序尚未进行代码签名，因此请选择<g2>更多信息 → 仍然运行</g2>。

0717a2923d7e72cc.source: <g1>Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi</g1>: one click from the Chrome Web Store, and the browser keeps it up to date. Edge first asks to allow extensions from other stores.
0717a2923d7e72cc.text: <g1>Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi</g1>：从 Chrome 网上应用店一键安装，浏览器会自动保持更新。Edge 浏览器首次安装时会要求允许来自其他商店的扩展。

07367459e6405a5a.source: <g1>Screen readers</g1> (Narrator, NVDA): every window, dialogs and menus included, now tells them what each control is, its name and its state; the download list reads each download.
07367459e6405a5a.text: <g1>屏幕阅读器</g1>（讲述人、NVDA）：现在每个窗口、对话框和菜单都包含在内，告知它们每个控件是什么、其名称和状态；下载列表会读取每个下载。

0748049168576df3.source: Options on its Downloads page: the start download dialog, Download complete and duplicate links
0748049168576df3.text: “选项”的“下载”页面：开始下载对话框、“下载完成”和重复链接。

074a8c8239dbb3b8.source: <g1>Picked before DDM is done.</g1> A quality picked from the page's list stays marked until DDM's list comes, then downloads by itself. If DDM doesn't offer that quality after all, the menu says so and shows what it does offer.
074a8c8239dbb3b8.text: <g1>在 DDM 完成之前选择。</g1>从页面列表中选择的画质会一直保持标记，直到 DDM 的列表出来，然后自动下载。如果 DDM 最终并不提供该画质，菜单会说明，并显示它提供的内容。

074e15c2678ecadd.source: Sounds: a sound for each event.
074e15c2678ecadd.text: 声音：为每种事件播放声音。

07587f5f9e42aa6f.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> appears. Make sure it is turned on.
07587f5f9e42aa6f.text: 列表中会出现<g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>。确保已启用它。

075b6e2400f539ab.source: Click a download link and <g1>Download File Info</g1> opens in DDM instead of the browser's own download bar. DDM gets the address together with the page it came from, your cookies for the site and the browser's User-Agent, so a download that needs you to be signed in still works. The browser's copy is cancelled and taken off its download list.
075b6e2400f539ab.text: 点击下载链接后，DDM 会打开<g1>下载文件信息</g1>窗口，而不是浏览器自带的下载栏。DDM 会获取下载地址、来源页面、您在该网站的 Cookie 以及浏览器的 User-Agent，因此需要登录才能下载的文件也能正常工作。浏览器本身的下载会被取消并从其下载列表中移除。

077f24ba3d4f74b0.source: Very likely: DDM speaks 86 languages, every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen on the first start or any time in <g1>View → Language</g1>. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur are laid out right to left. See <g2>all the languages</g2> and how to help improve yours.
077f24ba3d4f74b0.text: 很有可能：DDM 支持 86 种语言，涵盖 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，可在首次启动时或随时在<g1>视图 → 语言</g1>中选择。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语采用从右到左的布局。请参阅<g2>所有语言</g2>以及如何帮助改进您的语言。

07997cd4b03288ec.source: Options, Sites Logins: Cookies for video sites, From browser: Firefox
07997cd4b03288ec.text: 选项，站点登录：视频网站的 Cookie，来自浏览器：Firefox

0799a3169d80c8d3.source: Can I keep IDM installed too?
0799a3169d80c8d3.text: 我可以同时安装 IDM 吗？

07b884f85a5adcba.source: <g1>New</g1> — make your own category. <g2>Edit...</g2> changes the selected one: its name, file types and folder. The built-in categories (Compressed, Documents, Music, Programs, Video) can be renamed, given other file types and deleted like your own; a renamed one keeps its folder. General and Torrents change only their folder.
07b884f85a5adcba.text: <g1>新建</g1> — 创建您自己的类别。<g2>编辑...</g2> — 更改所选类别的名称、文件类型和文件夹。内置类别（压缩文件、文档、音乐、程序、视频）可以像您自己的类别一样重命名、更改文件类型和删除；重命名后的类别会保留其文件夹。常规和种子类别只能更改其文件夹。

07c06360dd3b3c3c.source: Yes. In IDM, export your list with Tasks → Export → To IDM export file. In DDM, choose Tasks → Import → From IDM export file and pick that .ef2 file: every…
07c06360dd3b3c3c.text: 可以。在 IDM 中，选择“任务 → 导出 → 导出到 IDM 文件”来导出列表。在 DDM 中，选择“任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 导出文件”，然后选择该 .ef2 文件：所有下载任务都会保留其地址、来源页和 Cookie。纯文本格式的链接文件也可以。请参阅“添加下载”。

07ed3d6396493231.source: Choose <g1>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Turn on</g1>. <g2>Turn off</g2> gives full speed again.
07ed3d6396493231.text: 选择<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 开启</g1>。选择<g2>关闭</g2>即可恢复全速下载。

07fb9066c15dba40.source: <g1>Network adapter:</g1> while one is chosen (<g2>Options → Proxy / Socks → <g3>Network adapter</g3></g2>), galleries go through it too, as video pages do: DDM's downloader opens its connections through the adapter as for any file, and DDM gives gallery-dl a proxy of its own on this computer, opens every connection through the adapter and looks the names up with the DNS you chose. When the adapter disconnects, the gallery stops with the other downloads; nothing goes out through your normal connection.
07fb9066c15dba40.text: <g1>网络适配器:</g1>选定适配器后（<g2>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → <g3>网络适配器</g3></g2>），图库也会通过它，视频页面同理：DDM 的下载器像下载任何文件一样通过该适配器建立连接，DDM 还会在这台计算机上给 gallery-dl 一个专用代理，所有连接都通过该适配器建立，并用您选择的 DNS 查找名称。适配器断开时，图库会与其他下载一起停止；不会有任何内容经由您的常规连接发出。

07fe2cd6bd8e6094.source: Tutorial: download a video from a page →

08084c2a5ca0a411.text: 右键点击一个类别可进行以下操作：

082e659b754ca03e.source: <g1>End the dial-up connection when done</g1> — for a dial-up connection, if you use one (Windows).
082e659b754ca03e.text: <g1>完成后结束拨号连接</g1> — 适用于拨号连接（如果您使用的话）（Windows）。

0830de009b68f05d.source: No, unless you want it to. While a torrent downloads it trades pieces with other people, as every torrent client does. When it finishes, it stops, like any…
0830de009b68f05d.text: 不会，除非您希望它这样做。在种子下载过程中，它会像所有种子客户端一样与其他用户交换数据块。下载完成后，它会停止，就像任何…

08498bd4c2b64852.source: Tick <g1>Don't show this again</g1> to stop seeing it. It can be turned back on in <g2>Options → Downloads → Show the Download complete window</g2>.
08498bd4c2b64852.text: 勾选<g1>不再显示此消息</g1>即可不再看到它。可在<g2>选项 → 下载 → 显示“下载完成”窗口</g2>中重新开启。

084f72ae121f3c2a.source: <g1>Delete</g1> takes the gallery off the list. Its folder and pictures stay, even if you tick the box to delete files: delete the folder yourself if you want it gone.
084f72ae121f3c2a.text: 点击<g1>删除</g1>会将图库从列表中移除。即使勾选了删除文件，图库文件夹和图片也会保留；如需删除，请自行删除该文件夹。

0869fe82a1a9be89.source: Or right-click a queue under <g1>Queues</g1> and choose <g2>Start now</g2> or <g3>Stop</g3>.
0869fe82a1a9be89.text: 或者右键点击<g1>队列</g1>下的一个队列，然后选择<g2>立即开始</g2>或<g3>停止</g3>。

088e2c35eed8fdfc.source: Download manager for Windows, with macOS and Linux builds — Dannex Download Manager
088e2c35eed8fdfc.text: 适用于 Windows 的下载管理器，也支持 macOS 和 Linux — Dannex Download Manager

089229fea40c86bb.source: A download's progress window has a <g1>Hide to the notification area</g1> button: a short dash with an arrow down to the corner. On Windows it sits in the title bar, left of Minimize, and in the title bar's menu (Alt+Space). On Linux and macOS it is at the end of the tab row. The download carries on.
089229fea40c86bb.text: 下载进度窗口有一个<g1>隐藏到通知区域</g1>按钮：一个短横线，带一个指向角落的箭头。在 Windows 上，它位于标题栏中，“最小化”按钮的左侧，以及标题栏菜单（Alt+Space）中。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它位于标签页行的末尾。下载将继续进行。

08927126dc5b4651.source: Retried about 250 times a second against the refusals. Finished in 15.9 s.
08927126dc5b4651.text: 面对拒绝请求，每秒重试约 250 次。15.9 秒后完成。

089b4494f3872319.source: Give a video's page address to <g1>Add URL</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>) and DDM sees that it is a video page: <g3>Download video from a page</g3> opens and looks it up. YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit and well over a thousand other sites work. With the <g4>browser extension</g4>, the button over a video opens the same window.

08d9abb3cbbc63f2.source: DDM downloads what you point it at, the way a web browser does, only faster and with more control. It's made for everyday downloads: software and updates, documents, your own files from cloud storage, videos and music you're allowed to save, Linux images and other torrents shared by their makers, and anything else you have the right to download.

08f894c4d36407be.source: <g1>The crash report window's status line stays inside the window</g1> (<g2>#164</g2>): the line above the check box ("The symbols couldn't be fetched: …", an issue's title, a translation) ran past the window's right edge, or its left edge in Persian. It is now cut with "…" at the margin and shown whole under the pointer. Its title ("Dannex Download Manager crash report") is now in DDM's language too; it was always in the system's. On Windows that also gives its title bar DDM's light or dark again in every language: outside English it kept Windows' own mode.
08f894c4d36407be.text: <g1>崩溃报告窗口的状态行保持在窗口内</g1> (<g2>#164</g2>)：复选框上方的行（“无法获取符号：…”、问题标题、翻译）会超出窗口右边缘，在波斯语中则超出左边缘。现在，它会在边缘处用“…”截断，并在指针悬停时完整显示。其标题（“Dannex Download Manager 崩溃报告”）现在也使用 DDM 的语言；之前它总是使用系统语言。在 Windows 上，这也能让其标题栏在所有语言中再次显示 DDM 的浅色或深色模式：在英语之外，它会保持 Windows 自己的模式。

08f904e3d0a7032e.source: <g1>Options → File types → Don't take files smaller than</g1> leaves small files (a receipt, an icon) to the browser. 0 takes any size.
08f904e3d0a7032e.text: <g1>选项 → 文件类型 → 不下载小于以下大小的文件</g1>会将小文件（如收据、图标）留给浏览器处理。设置为 0 表示任何大小的文件都可下载。

09076776465e4d35.source: <g1>Ubuntu's Firefox reaches DDM</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): the Snap Firefox never makes the folder DDM looked for, so browser integration wasn't set up for it and its extension couldn't find DDM. It is now, and the Snap goes through the desktop, which asks once (<g3>Allow</g3>); the help says how to be asked again after <g4>Don't allow</g4>. Chromium as a Snap ran DDM's helper inside its sandbox, away from DDM (it started a second, sandboxed DDM): DDM no longer offers it, and the help says why.
09076776465e4d35.text: <g1>Ubuntu 的 Firefox 连接到 DDM</g1>（<g2>#164</g2> 的一部分）：Snap 版 Firefox 从不创建 DDM 查找的文件夹，因此浏览器集成未为其设置，其扩展程序也无法找到 DDM。现在已解决此问题，Snap 版通过桌面进行，会请求一次 (<g3>允许</g3>)；帮助文档说明了在选择 <g4>不允许</g4> 后如何再次请求。Snap 版 Chromium 在其沙盒内运行 DDM 的辅助程序，与 DDM 隔离（它启动了第二个沙盒化的 DDM）：DDM 不再提供此选项，帮助文档说明了原因。

092d1dbe60812120.text: 每个主题都有亮色和深色模式：<g1>深色模式支持</g1> 和 <g2>始终为深色</g2> 像以前一样在它们之间进行选择。您放入主题文件夹（<g3>视图 → 主题 → 打开主题文件夹</g3>）的主题文件也会在此处列出，Base16 和 pywal 配色方案也是如此（<g4>视图 → 主题 → 添加主题文件…</g4>；<g5>pywal</g5> 运行时遵循 <x6/>）：<g7>主题</g7> 说明了该文件夹的位置、主题文件包含的内容（<x8/>、颜色、大小、控件形状、图标）、配色方案的颜色如何使用，以及如何制作和分享主题文件。

09bf1f8d90bf7ffd.source: A <g1>queue</g1> is a list of downloads that run in order, a few at a time. The <g2>Scheduler</g2> starts and stops queues by the clock, and decides what happens when a queue is done.
09bf1f8d90bf7ffd.text: <g1>队列</g1>是按顺序运行下载任务的列表，每次运行几个。<g2>计划程序</g2>会按计划启动和停止队列，并决定队列完成后要执行的操作。

09e0c03014821b00.source: gallery-dl is an optional helper, like yt-dlp for <g1>videos</g1>. On Windows and Linux, DDM installs it the first time you need it, from its releases on Codeberg, and only when the release is signed by its author's key. On macOS, install it with Homebrew or pip and choose it in <g2>Helpers...</g2>, which also takes your own copy on any system, such as the gallery-dl your Linux distribution ships (version 1.20 or later).
09e0c03014821b00.text: gallery-dl 是一个可选的辅助程序，就像用于<g1>视频</g1>的 yt-dlp 一样。在 Windows 和 Linux 上，DDM 会在您首次需要时从 Codeberg 的发布版本中安装它，并且仅当该发布版本由其作者的密钥签名时。在 macOS 上，请使用 Homebrew 或 pip 安装它，然后在<g2>帮助程序...</g2>中选择它，该选项也支持您在任何系统上使用自己的副本，例如您的 Linux 发行版附带的 gallery-dl（版本 1.20 或更高）。

Its version is small at the bottom, beside <g3>Help</g3> and <g4>Support DDM</g4> (the maintainer's GitHub Sponsors page).
0a44b80841e6fb99.text: <g1>帮助</g1>：状态页：<g2>Dannex Download Manager 已安装</g2>及其开关（与单击相同），或出了什么问题；以及其他值得了解的内容（浏览器限制了扩展的站点访问权限、隐私窗口、更新、浏览器保留的上一个下载及原因）。其版本号以小字显示在底部，位于<g3>帮助</g3>和<g4>支持 DDM</g4>（维护者的 GitHub Sponsors 页面）旁边。

0a5818695b2b21a8.source: <g1>Google Drive links</g1> (<g2>#34</g2>): paste a Drive file's link (<x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>) and DDM downloads the file itself, as it was uploaded, over several connections and resumable, with its real name and size in Download File Info. Large files get past Drive's "can't scan this file for viruses" page as <g6>Download anyway</g6> does. Google Docs, Sheets and Slides come as Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. A private file downloads with the sign-in the extension passes from the browser. When Drive won't give a file (too many downloads lately, sign-in needed, no access), DDM says so in your language instead of saving Drive's page. The video button over a Drive video downloads the original file. Folders aren't downloaded yet: DDM says the link is a folder. See <g7>Google Drive links</g7>.
0a5818695b2b21a8.text: <g1>Google Drive 链接</g1>（<g2>#34</g2>）：粘贴 Drive 文件的链接（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>），DDM 会下载文件本身，就像上传时一样，通过多个连接并可恢复，在“下载文件信息”中显示其真实名称和大小。大文件可以绕过 Drive 的“无法扫描此文件是否存在病毒”页面，就像<g6>仍然下载</g6>一样。Google 文档、表格和幻灯片以 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文件的形式出现。私人文件会通过扩展程序从浏览器传递的登录信息进行下载。当 Drive 不提供文件时（最近下载过多、需要登录、无访问权限），DDM 会用您的语言说明，而不是保存 Drive 的页面。Drive 视频上方的视频按钮会下载原始文件。文件夹尚未下载：DDM 会说明该链接是文件夹。请参阅<g7>Google Drive 链接</g7>。

0a66b90881d338cc.text: <g1>也支持 Linux 和 Mac。</g1> 如果您不只使用 Windows，每个版本都有相应的构建。从 {v1} 版本开始，Linux 不再是实验性版本：它已在 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 上进行过测试。

0a9f626e2ee9f591.text: 您需要 Windows 10 或 11，以及 Rust 稳定版 1.98 或更高版本（MSVC 工具链），以及 CMake、LLVM 和 NASM 用于 BoringSSL，引擎的浏览器式连接会从源代码构建这些组件 (<x1/>)。

0aa5af3e0b4d7cf2.source: Every request and answer is described field by field in a <g1>JSON Schema</g1>, made from the code the app answers with, so programs can check what they send or generate their types from it. AI assistants use the same API through DDM's <g2>MCP server</g2>.
0aa5af3e0b4d7cf2.text: 每个请求和答案都在<g1>JSON Schema</g1>中逐字段描述，该 Schema 由应用程序响应的代码生成，因此程序可以检查它们发送的内容或从中生成其类型。AI 助手通过 DDM 的<g2>MCP 服务器</g2>使用相同的 API。

0ac650f0cae0195d.source: Every file in its folder, without asking.
0ac650f0cae0195d.text: 文件自动归类，无需手动整理。

0ad6d5ee03f905eb.text: 一款历史悠久的全能型软件，配备完整的 BitTorrent 客户端，并为 4 种系统提供应用

0ae9161747d478ec.text: <g1>取消</g1>会停止下载并关闭窗口。下载仍保留在列表中，可以恢复。

Everything else stays with the browser.

0b1b52c201337090.source: Dannex Download Manager ("DDM") is free, open-source software made by its contributors. Because its whole source code is public at <g1>github.com/Riskraptor/dannexdownloadmanager</g1>, you don't have to take this page's word for it: every network connection described here can be checked in the code.
0b1b52c201337090.text: Dannex Download Manager（“DDM”）是由其贡献者开发的免费开源软件。由于其全部源代码都公开在 <g1>github.com/Riskraptor/dannexdownloadmanager</g1>，您不必只凭本页的说法相信它：这里描述的每一个网络连接都可以在代码中核实。

0b47686c6217ff71.source: <g1>A download or magnet link sent while the window is minimized opens at once</g1> (<g2>#162</g2>): with the main window minimized (not to the notification area), a download from the browser or a magnet link was accepted but its window waited until DDM was restored. Download File Info and Add torrent now open right away, as they do with the window open or in the notification area.
0b47686c6217ff71.text: <g1>当窗口最小化时发送的下载或磁力链接会立即打开</g1>（<g2>#162</g2>）：当主窗口最小化（未最小化到通知区域）时，来自浏览器或磁力链接的下载会被接受，但其窗口会等待 DDM 恢复。现在，“下载文件信息”和“添加种子”会立即打开，就像窗口打开或在通知区域时一样。

0b4b0e83da3b7d3b.source: Extracted files are marked as coming from the internet, as the archive is, so Windows still warns before running a program from it.
0b4b0e83da3b7d3b.text: 提取的文件会像存档一样标记为来自互联网，因此 Windows 在运行其中的程序前仍会发出警告。

0b5a2fe5d385702d.source: <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> — Minimize hides the main window, and a download's progress window, in the notification area; downloads go on. Off by default, as in IDM: Minimize leaves the window in the taskbar and only the close box hides it in the tray (lists from before 1.0, where it was on by default, have it off once; tick it again if you want it). On, only the window's own Minimize hides it; a click on its taskbar button still minimizes it to the taskbar, as Windows does. Where the tray has no icon, the main window minimizes to the taskbar instead. The close setting above is separate; when it is on, closing hides there too (or minimizes to the taskbar if there is no icon at all). Greyed where no tray shows DDM's icon (some Linux desktops); in a Wayland session the main window stays minimized in the dock, since Wayland can't hide a window.
0b5a2fe5d385702d.text: <g1>最小化到通知区域</g1> — 最小化会将主窗口以及下载的进度窗口隐藏到通知区域；下载继续进行。默认关闭，与 IDM 相同：最小化会将窗口留在任务栏中，只有关闭框才会将其隐藏到托盘（1.0 之前默认开启的列表会将其关闭一次；如需要请再次勾选）。开启时，只有窗口自己的“最小化”会将其隐藏；单击其任务栏按钮仍会将其最小化到任务栏，与 Windows 一样。在托盘没有图标的地方，主窗口会改为最小化到任务栏。上面的关闭设置是独立的；当它开启时，关闭窗口也会隐藏到那里（如果完全没有图标，则最小化到任务栏）。在没有托盘显示 DDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面）显示为灰色；在 Wayland 会话中，主窗口会保持最小化在程序坞中，因为 Wayland 无法隐藏窗口。

0b60549b3aaf5aea.source: A portable copy. The download list and settings stay in a <x1/> folder next to the program, and nothing is written to the registry. Browser integration needs the installer. See <g2>Portable mode</g2>.

0bc5fc7eb49e15cd.source: <g1>Streams served as plain text, from addresses without .m3u8 or .mpd</g1> (<g2>#171</g2>): some players load their stream from such an address, and the extension didn't know it as one. The button over the video, the right-click menu and <g3>Media on this page</g3> then sent the page alone, which yt-dlp answered "Unsupported URL". Now, when one of them is used and no stream is known, the extension reads the start of what the player fetched (a few kilobytes, never on sight) and recognises an HLS playlist or a DASH manifest.
0bc5fc7eb49e15cd.text: <g1>以纯文本形式提供的流，来自不带 .m3u8 或 .mpd 的地址</g1>（<g2>#171</g2>）：有些播放器会从此类地址加载其流，而扩展程序未将其识别为流。视频上方的按钮、右键菜单和<g3>此页面上的媒体</g3>随后只发送页面，yt-dlp 回复“不支持的 URL”。现在，当使用其中之一且未识别到流时，扩展程序会读取播放器获取内容的开头（几千字节，从不显示），并识别 HLS 播放列表或 DASH 清单。

0c04a7480c3b5e9c.source: The remote control is off until you turn it on. It answers only the devices you paired, each removable at once in Options, and listens only on the computer's private network addresses, never on one the internet can reach. Everything goes over HTTPS, and web pages can't use it.

0c736efae2d3f029.source: DDM's interface comes in 86 languages: every display language Windows 11 offers, from Afrikaans to Vietnamese, including both Chinese scripts, Spanish for Spain and Mexico, French for France and Canada, Portuguese for Portugal and Brazil, and Serbian in Cyrillic and Latin.

0c80ff02c1d12fdc.text: 检查<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>。较低的<g2>每个下载最多使用</g2>，或针对该服务器的例外，意味着连接更少。标有<g3>（自动）</g3>的行是拒绝更多连接的服务器；DDM 在那里无法做得更多。

Open it and drag Dannex Download Manager to Applications. macOS asks before its first start, because the app isn't notarized by Apple: right-click it and choose <g3>Open</g3> (on macOS 15 and later: <g4>System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway</g4>).
0c9992217989480e.text: 适用于配备 Apple 芯片（M1 或更高版本：<g1>苹果菜单 → 关于本机</g1> 显示 <g2>芯片</g2>）的 Mac。打开它，将 Dannex Download Manager 拖到“应用程序”文件夹。macOS 在首次启动前会询问，因为此应用未经 Apple 公证：右键点击它并选择<g3>打开</g3>（在 macOS 15 及更高版本上：<g4>系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开</g4>）。

0c9bfa704b26c7a2.source: <g1>Proxy auto-config scripts (PAC) run in QuickJS</g1>, a much smaller JavaScript engine, with limits on memory and running time: a script that loops or grows forever now fails, as a broken script does (the download goes on with the default proxy settings), instead of holding it.
0c9bfa704b26c7a2.text: <g1>代理自动配置脚本 (PAC) 在 QuickJS 中运行</g1>，这是一个小得多的 JavaScript 引擎，对内存和运行时间有限制：现在，一个无限循环或无限增长的脚本会失败，就像一个损坏的脚本一样（下载将使用默认代理设置继续），而不是卡住。

0f0d01c7bf52af00.source: <g1>Start Dannex Download Manager with the computer</g1> — start DDM when you sign in to Windows. It starts in the notification area, its window hidden, with its downloads, queues and Scheduler running; click its icon (or start DDM again) to show the window. On Linux and macOS it starts with your session the same way; where no notification area shows DDM's icon (some Linux desktops), it starts minimized, and the option's tooltip says so. DDM waits for the notification area up to 30 seconds after making its icon, its window hidden, as a desktop's can come up after DDM at sign-in. Off by default. Greyed in a <g2>portable copy</g2>, which writes nothing to the registry.
0f0d01c7bf52af00.text: <g1>随计算机启动 Dannex Download Manager</g1> — 在您登录 Windows 时启动 DDM。它在通知区域启动，窗口隐藏，下载、队列和计划程序照常运行；单击其图标（或再次启动 DDM）即可显示窗口。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它同样随您的会话启动；在没有通知区域显示 DDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面），它会以最小化方式启动，选项的提示中会对此说明。DDM 在创建图标并隐藏窗口后，最多等待通知区域 30 秒，因为桌面的通知区域可能在登录时比 DDM 更晚出现。默认关闭。在不向注册表写入任何内容的<g2>便携版</g2>中显示为灰色。

0f215f8302a86388.source: If neither can start, DDM draws with a software renderer (Microsoft's on Windows, Mesa's on Linux), so the window still opens (Remote Desktop, a virtual machine without a graphics driver). It works, but keeps the processor busier.
0f215f8302a86388.text: 如果两者都无法启动，DDM 会使用软件渲染器绘制（Windows 上使用 Microsoft 的软件渲染器，Linux 上使用 Mesa 的软件渲染器），这样窗口仍能打开（例如在远程桌面或没有图形驱动程序的虚拟机中）。这种方式可以正常工作，但会增加处理器负担。

Firefox installed as a Snap (Ubuntu's) reaches DDM once you allow it; other Snap and Flatpak browsers can't (see <g2>Flatpak and Snap browsers</g2>). The tray icon, following the system's dark mode and Launch on startup work on GNOME (Ubuntu's), KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon.

0f962bad8ad412ec.source: <g1>Paired devices only</g1>: every request but pairing needs the token the device got when it paired. A pairing code works once, for ten minutes, with five tries, and tries are slowed down. The settings keep a fingerprint of each token, not the token.
0f962bad8ad412ec.text: <g1>仅限已配对设备</g1>：除了配对之外的每个请求都需要设备在配对时获得的令牌。配对代码只能使用一次，有效期十分钟，有五次尝试机会，并且尝试速度会减慢。设置会保留每个令牌的指纹，而不是令牌本身。

0fd6f0d7a798d5e1.source: <g1>ffmpeg could fail to install</g1> with "the release has no an LGPL Windows build": BtbN, whose builds DDM installs, publishes a dated build each day and then remakes its <x2/> release, and meanwhile GitHub's "latest" is the dated one, whose files are named differently. DDM now reads BtbN's newest releases, either naming, and takes the newest complete build. Errors while installing yt-dlp or ffmpeg are also worded in the interface language now.
0fd6f0d7a798d5e1.text: <g1>ffmpeg 可能无法安装</g1>，显示“此版本没有 LGPL Windows 构建”：DDM 安装的 BtbN 构建每天发布一个带日期的构建，然后重制其 <x2/> 版本，同时 GitHub 的“最新”是带日期的版本，其文件命名不同。DDM 现在读取 BtbN 的最新版本，无论命名如何，并获取最新的完整构建。现在，安装 yt-dlp 或 ffmpeg 时的错误也会以界面语言显示。

0fd88936ec18ca21.source: <g1>Download File Info</g1> says which account a link goes through: <g2>Download through Real-Debrid (your account)</g2>, ticked. Untick it to download that one link directly, without the service. DDM looks the address up again the new way, so the name and size shown are the ones you will get. A download the browser had already started shows it unticked.
0fd88936ec18ca21.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>会显示链接将使用哪个帐户下载：<g2>通过 Real-Debrid 下载（您的帐户）</g2>，默认已勾选。取消勾选即可绕过服务，直接下载该链接。DDM 会按新的方式重新查询地址，因此显示的名称和大小与实际下载的文件相符。对于浏览器已经开始的下载，该选项默认未勾选。

10068bf8d08f9e51.source: A download's progress window can go there as well, with its Minimize or with its <g1>Hide to the notification area</g1> button: a short dash with an arrow down to the corner.
10068bf8d08f9e51.text: 下载进度窗口也可以通过其“最小化”按钮或“<g1>隐藏到通知区域</g1>”按钮（一个短横线，带一个指向角落的箭头）隐藏到那里。

100ad6083d713ab8.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>Options where you expect them</g3> <g4>Every setting where an IDM user looks first: connections, proxies, folders, sounds.</g4>
100ad6083d713ab8.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>选项就在熟悉的位置</g3> <g4>各项设置都在 IDM 用户首先会查找的位置：连接、代理、文件夹和声音。</g4>

100b36c152480e17.source: It has <g1>no remote code, no analytics and no ads</g1>, and sends nothing to us or anyone else. Its status page links to DDM's download page, and its pages' <g2>Support DDM</g2> to the maintainer's GitHub Sponsors page; the browser opens them only when you click.
100b36c152480e17.text: 它<g1>没有远程代码、没有数据分析、没有广告</g1>，也不会向我们或任何其他人发送任何内容。其状态页链接到 DDM 的下载页面，其页面上的<g2>支持 DDM</g2>链接到维护者的 GitHub Sponsors 页面；只有当您单击时，浏览器才会打开它们。

101d3ce9bd048a45.source: <g1>Check for updates</g1>: the release notes scroll (the wheel, a trackpad, their scroll bar, and the arrow, Page and Home/End keys); their lines no longer break mid-sentence, and links show as their text (issue #5).
101d3ce9bd048a45.text: <g1>检查更新</g1>：发布说明现在可以滚动（使用滚轮、触控板、滚动条以及箭头键、Page 键和 Home/End 键）；文字不再在句子中间换行，链接会显示为链接文本（问题 #5）。

105119676f5865c6.source: As links arrive, DDM asks each server about its file, a few at a time. Each link then shows its real name and size, and whether it is <g1>Online</g1>, <g2>Offline (404)</g2>, <g3>Needs a login</g3> or <g4>Busy, try later</g4>. Offline links come unticked, so you don't queue what isn't there. Links to web pages are hidden by default.
105119676f5865c6.text: 链接到达时，DDM 会一次性向每个服务器询问其文件信息。每个链接随后会显示其真实名称和大小，以及它是<g1>在线</g1>、<g2>离线 (404)</g2>、<g3>需要登录</g3>还是<g4>繁忙，请稍后重试</g4>。离线链接默认不勾选，这样您就不会将不存在的内容加入队列。指向网页的链接默认隐藏。

1066cbcb26bb8ead.source: <g1>Browser extension:</g1> with another DDM chosen in the popup, opening a page with a video no longer adds that page there as a file; in Firefox, a PDF or song that Options take is taken at the first click after the browser left the extension idle; in Chrome, Edge and Brave, Options' excluded addresses keep opening PDFs in the browser, and turning DDM off right after the browser starts no longer leaves them downloading; an Alt-click leaves only that download to the browser, even from a slow server.
1066cbcb26bb8ead.text: <g1>浏览器扩展：</g1>在弹出窗口中选择另一个 DDM 后，打开带视频的页面不再把该页面作为文件添加到那里；在 Firefox 中，选项接管的 PDF 或歌曲，会在浏览器让扩展空闲后的第一次点击时被接管；在 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 中，选项中的排除地址会继续在浏览器中打开 PDF，浏览器刚启动就关闭 DDM 也不再导致它们被下载；Alt+点击只把该次下载留给浏览器，即使服务器很慢也是如此。

106b31b5a3b2042f.source: Run Dannex Download Manager on a home server or a NAS (Docker, Unraid, any Linux machine) without a window, and send it downloads from your phone or your browser: the server downloads them into its own folders, such as a network share.
106b31b5a3b2042f.text: 在家庭服务器或 NAS（Docker、Unraid、任何 Linux 机器）上无窗口运行 Dannex Download Manager，并从您的手机或浏览器向其发送下载任务：服务器会将文件下载到其自己的文件夹中，例如网络共享。

1071689f20a203f7.source: <g1>Theme files</g1>: every colour and size DDM's controls are drawn with (corner radii, borders, font sizes, the list's row height, the icons' ink) comes from the theme, by role; the classic look is that theme, unchanged pixel for pixel. A theme file (TOML or JSON in the data folder's <x2/> folder) can change any role, choose each control's style (<x3/>) and an icon set, and a theme can be a folder that brings its own icons. An icon set can mix PNG pictures with SVG drawings, and one-colour icons (<x4/>, <x5/>, drawn in the theme's text colour) with coloured ones, and hold pictures at 32 and 48 pixels, used on a screen scaled to 150 % and more: the style themes' pictures stay sharp there.
1071689f20a203f7.text: <g1>主题文件</g1>：DDM 控件的所有颜色和尺寸（圆角半径、边框、字体大小、列表行高、图标墨迹）均按角色来自主题；经典外观即是该主题，像素级保持不变。主题文件（数据文件夹 <x2/> 文件夹中的 TOML 或 JSON 格式）可以更改任何角色，选择每个控件的样式（<x3/>）和图标集，主题也可以是一个包含自有图标的文件夹。图标集可以混合 PNG 图片和 SVG 绘图，以及单色图标（<x4/>、<x5/>，以主题的文本颜色绘制）和彩色图标，并包含 32 和 48 像素的图片，用于 150% 或更高缩放比例的屏幕：风格主题的图片在此保持清晰。

10825ce1e4e377bf.text: 任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 导出文件

109c6c08bce211ee.source: You don't need to start DDM first. When the browser hands over a download and DDM isn't running, the helper starts it and passes the download on.
109c6c08bce211ee.text: 您无需先启动 DDM。当浏览器移交下载而 DDM 未运行时，助手会启动它并传递下载。

10a570b26f9bc0a3.source: Yes. DDM accepts IDM's familiar command-line switches, comes with <x1/> for downloads from a terminal, and has a local, token-protected automation API that can list, pause, start and remove downloads. The API is off until you turn it on. See <g2>Command line and automation</g2>.
10a570b26f9bc0a3.text: 是。DDM 接受 IDM 熟悉的命令行开关，附带 <x1/> 用于从终端下载，并具有一个本地的、受令牌保护的自动化 API，可以列出、暂停、开始和删除下载。此 API 默认关闭，直到您将其打开。请参阅<g2>命令行和自动化</g2>。

10e2b446c7ba46e5.source: You can also paste a magnet link into <g1>Add URL</g1>, or drop a magnet link or a <x2/> file on the drop target (<g3>Tasks → Show drop target</g3>). If a torrent is already in the list, DDM says so instead of adding it twice.
10e2b446c7ba46e5.text: 您也可以将磁力链接粘贴到<g1>添加 URL</g1>中，或将磁力链接或 <x2/> 文件拖放到拖放目标上（<g3>任务 → 显示拖放目标</g3>）。如果种子已在列表中，DDM 会提示，而不是重复添加。

11037e9a1d07f9af.text: 必须允许扩展读取该网站。当您将扩展的访问权限限制为部分网站（或设置为<g1>点击时</g1>）时，它无法传递您的登录信息，因此会将这些网站上的下载留给浏览器处理。

1105c4be357dbf30.source: <g1>Properties</g1> keeps what the last run saw, so a finished download still shows where it came from.
1105c4be357dbf30.text: <g1>属性</g1>保留了上次运行所看到的信息，因此已完成的下载仍会显示其来源。

110d6b2bd87a92ac.text: 与您已有的工具配合使用

113095bd997336d5.text: 在这两种情况下，代理的登录信息都不会被读取：需要 VPN 扩展自身登录信息的代理无法共享，下载会因此显示错误，而不是在没有登录信息的情况下继续。

1151e5853122592c.text: RSS 源以及用于筛选下载内容的规则。

1170bfe4c3fcb630.source: Torrents: pausing a torrent just as one of its pieces was being checked no longer leaves it one piece short for good. That piece was neither counted as downloaded nor asked for again, so the torrent stopped just before the end, and pausing and starting it again didn't help, only restarting DDM did; a pause now puts that piece back to be downloaded again (<g1>#706</g1>).
1170bfe4c3fcb630.text: 种子：在其某个分片正在校验时暂停种子，不再让它永远差一个分片。该分片既没有被计为已下载，也没有再次被请求，所以种子停在快要结束的地方，暂停后再开始也无济于事，只有重启 DDM 才行；现在暂停会把该分片放回去重新下载（<g1>#706</g1>）。

1172931195565a11.source: No. DDM doesn't break copy protection (DRM), by design. Videos that are protected stay protected. See also what DDM is made for.
1172931195565a11.text: 不能。DDM 的设计宗旨是不破解版权保护 (DRM)。受保护的视频将保持受保护状态。另请参阅 DDM 的用途。

1173fd2e0a9c235b.source: The app has no accounts, telemetry or tracking
1173fd2e0a9c235b.text: 此应用不含账户、遥测或跟踪功能

11aeaa1e552ab59b.source: A video yt-dlp downloads by itself (<g1>How a video comes down</g1>) takes a limit only as it starts: when you turn the limiter on or off, change its settings or the video's own limit, DDM stops it and starts it again with the new limit, and it goes on from where it was (the log says "Stopped: the speed limit changed; starting again with it"). Under the limit for all downloads, such videos share it evenly: when another starts, the ones running with more than their share start again with it; when one ends, the others keep theirs. An image gallery's files that gallery-dl downloads itself (<g2>Image galleries</g2>) do the same, gallery-dl skipping the files already saved; those DDM downloads keep to a new limit at once. Other changes (torrents taking more or less of the limit for all downloads, <g3>Only while I'm using the computer</g3>) apply to the next one that starts.
11aeaa1e552ab59b.text: yt-dlp 自行下载的视频（<g1>视频如何下载</g1>）只在启动时采用限制：当您开启或关闭限速、更改其设置或该视频自己的限制时，DDM 会停止它，并用新的限制重新启动，从原来的位置继续（日志会写“已停止：速度限制已更改；正在以新限制重新开始”）。在所有下载的总限制之下，这类视频平均分享该限制：另一个开始时，占用超过其份额的视频会用新份额重新启动；一个结束时，其余的保持原份额。由 gallery-dl 自行下载的图库文件（<g2>图像图库</g2>）也是如此，gallery-dl 会跳过已保存的文件；由 DDM 下载的文件则立即遵守新限制。其他更改（种子占用所有下载限制的多少、<g3>仅在我使用计算机时</g3>）适用于下一个开始的下载。

1461eb79d70f666d.source: <g1>Resuming from a server that sends its ETag without quotes:</g1> DDM kept no validator at all for such a file. It now keeps the server's modification date, as the HTTP standard allows when there is no valid entity tag, and sends it as it resumes, so a server that honours it sends the file whole again if it changed; a weak ETag still means none. (Wikimedia's servers, which send such ETags, ignore both; there, as everywhere, DDM's check of the bytes where a resumed piece overlaps the saved ones catches a changed file.)
1461eb79d70f666d.text: <g1>服务器发送不带引号的 ETag 时的续传：</g1>对于这样的文件，DDM 以前完全不保存校验信息。现在，按 HTTP 标准在没有有效实体标签时的允许做法，DDM 会保存服务器给出的修改日期，并在续传时一并发送；这样，遵守该日期的服务器会在文件变化后重新发送完整文件。弱 ETag 仍视为没有校验信息。（发送此类 ETag 的 Wikimedia 服务器对两者都不理会；在那里，和其他地方一样，DDM 会比对续传片段与已保存部分重叠处的字节，从而发现文件已变化。）

151026c3e30438ac.source: <g1>A gallery's pictures named in another script:</g1> on Windows, gallery-dl wrote the names of the files it downloaded in the system's own code page, a question mark for each letter it couldn't write (a Cyrillic name on an English Windows), so DDM didn't recognise them: such a picture, saved, was reported as one that couldn't be downloaded, and one already there counted twice. gallery-dl now writes them in UTF-8 (from gallery-dl 1.25), and a file left to gallery-dl that its lines don't name is looked for on the disk before anything is said about it. A file whose saved progress can't be used says so in the log as it starts again.
151026c3e30438ac.text: <g1>用其他文字命名的图片库图片：</g1>在 Windows 上，gallery-dl 用系统自己的代码页写出所下载文件的名称，写不出的字母都变成问号（例如英文版 Windows 上的西里尔文名称），DDM 因而认不出它们：这样的图片即使已保存，也会被报告为无法下载，已有的图片还会被算两次。gallery-dl 现在用 UTF-8 写出名称（自 gallery-dl 1.25 起），对于留给 gallery-dl 下载、而它的输出行中没有提到的文件，DDM 会先在磁盘上查找，再作出提示。已保存的进度无法使用的文件，会在重新开始时于日志中说明。

157d0fc6b0ea2f75.source: No. DDM is an independent program written from scratch in Rust, with no connection to Tonec Inc., the makers of Internet Download Manager (IDM). It contains none of IDM's code or artwork. Its windows are laid out the way IDM users expect, so you can switch without learning anything new — and because DDM is free, there is nothing to crack. Please don't download "cracked" download managers: they are a common way to spread malware.
157d0fc6b0ea2f75.text: 不是。DDM 是一个完全独立的程序，使用 Rust 从头编写，与 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 的开发商 Tonec Inc. 没有任何关系。它不包含 IDM 的任何代码或美术作品。它的窗口布局符合 IDM 用户的习惯，因此您可以无需学习新知识即可切换使用——而且由于 DDM 是免费的，所以无需破解。请不要下载“破解版”下载管理器：它们是传播恶意软件的常见方式。

1587ea4b19460e14.source: Imported lists open in <g1>Link grabber</g1>: the links sorted into packages, each one checked online with its real name and size, and offline links unticked. A batch download of links from a file host goes through your <g2>debrid account</g2> when its service supports the host.
1587ea4b19460e14.text: 导入的列表会在<g1>链接抓取器</g1>中打开：链接被分类到不同的包中，每个链接都会在线检查其真实名称和大小，离线链接则会被取消勾选。当文件托管服务支持时，从文件托管服务批量下载的链接会通过您的<g2>去限制账户</g2>。

158fc48b9d19f7fd.source: The browser extension comes with the app and as <g1>its own download</g1>, to add by hand (<g2>how</g2>); its listings in the browsers' stores are on their way. Every file is built from the public source by GitHub Actions and listed with its SHA-256 checksum.
158fc48b9d19f7fd.text: 浏览器扩展随应用一起提供，也有<g1>单独的下载</g1>，可手动添加（<g2>方法</g2>）；其在各浏览器商店的页面即将上线。每个文件都由 GitHub Actions 从公开源代码构建，并附有其 SHA-256 校验和。

15cb3443184a8add.source: Most translations were written by machine and are waiting for a native speaker to check them, so some wording may sound wrong. A text not translated yet shows in English. If you speak a language well, you can fix it: each one is a plain text file in the repository, and the <g1>translation guide</g1> shows how to send changes, as a pull request or an issue.
15cb3443184a8add.text: 大多数翻译是由机器完成的，正在等待母语使用者进行校对，因此某些措辞可能听起来不自然。尚未翻译的文本会显示为英文。如果您精通某种语言，可以帮助修正：每种语言都是仓库中的一个纯文本文件，<g1>翻译指南</g1>会说明如何通过拉取请求或问题报告来提交更改。

15cbb55671681ebe.source: <g1><g2>Themes</g2></g1> — the built-in looks (Classic, Native, High contrast, Metro, Adwaita, Breeze, Luna, Aero, Aqua, Emerald), and how to make your own in a text file.
15cbb55671681ebe.text: <g1><g2>主题</g2></g1> — 内置外观（经典、原生、高对比度、现代、Adwaita、Breeze、Luna、Aero、Aqua、翡翠），以及如何在文本文件中制作您自己的主题。

15d7674516a26804.source: <g1>GitHub, to check for updates.</g1> Each time it starts, and once a day while it stays open, DDM asks GitHub's public API for the latest release of DDM (<x2/>). The request carries DDM's version in its User-Agent and nothing else. Turn the check off in <g3>Help → Check for updates</g3> (<g4>Check for updates at every start</g4>). If you choose <g5>Update now</g5>, DDM downloads the new version's file and its signed checksum list from the same GitHub release. GitHub's own privacy statement applies to these requests.
15d7674516a26804.text: <g1>GitHub，用于检查更新。</g1>每次启动时，以及在DDM保持打开状态下每天一次，DDM会向GitHub的公共API请求DDM的最新版本（<x2/>）。此请求在其User-Agent中携带DDM的版本信息，不包含其他任何内容。您可以在<g3>帮助 → 检查更新</g3>中关闭此检查（<g4>每次启动时检查更新</g4>）。如果您选择<g5>立即更新</g5>，DDM会从同一个GitHub发布中下载新版本的文件及其签名的校验和列表。GitHub自己的隐私声明适用于这些请求。

15d8f95e841f38a5.source: Installs DDM, connects your browsers, asks your language
15d8f95e841f38a5.text: 安装 DDM，连接您的浏览器，询问您的语言

15dc173670c614b5.source: <g1>Explore pages on</g1>: <g2>The same host</g2> (the default; <x3/> or not), <g4>The same domain and its subdomains</g4> (<x5/>, <x6/>), or <g7>Any site</g7>.
15dc173670c614b5.text: <g1>探索以下范围内的页面</g1>：<g2>同一主机</g2>（默认；带不带 <x3/> 都算）、<g4>同一域及其子域</g4>（<x5/>、<x6/>），或<g7>任意站点</g7>。

15e8a888aceb4b0e.source: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, is the main platform. Builds for Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) come with every release too; today's are marked experimental. Linux is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, in Wayland sessions too, and its packages in clean Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora systems. Still to come there: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet, and screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows yet. macOS stays experimental. See Windows, Mac and Linux and Download.
15e8a888aceb4b0e.text: Windows 10 和 11（64 位）是主要平台。每次发布也会提供 Linux（AppImage、.deb、.rpm 和 .tar.gz）和 macOS（.dmg）版本；目前这些版本标注为实验性。Linux 已在 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 上测试过，包括 Wayland 会话，其安装包也已在全新的 Ubuntu、Debian 和 Fedora 系统中测试过。尚待完成的有：Flatpak 版 Firefox 还未测试，屏幕阅读器 (Orca) 还不能朗读 DDM 的窗口。macOS 版仍为实验性。请参阅 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 和下载。

160d47fdb605f134.source: DDM closed with an internal error when a window opened while the main window was minimized or hidden in the notification area, for example Download File Info for a download from the browser, or Add torrent for a magnet link opened in the browser (<g1>#22</g1>, <g2>#145</g2>). The cause was in egui, the toolkit DDM is drawn with (<g3>emilk/egui#8470</g3>), and is fixed in DDM's copy of it.
160d47fdb605f134.text: 当主窗口最小化或隐藏在通知区域时，如果打开了一个窗口（例如浏览器下载的“下载文件信息”，或浏览器中打开磁力链接的“添加种子”），DDM 会因内部错误而关闭 (<g1>#22</g1>, <g2>#145</g2>)。原因是 DDM 绘制所用的 egui 工具包 (<g3>emilk/egui#8470</g3>)，此问题已在 DDM 的副本中修复。

1654b13da0558b05.source: DDM extracts ZIP (encrypted ones too), TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.XZ, GZ and XZ itself. 7z and RAR need 7-Zip, a free program: RAR's own extraction code can't be part of a free program like DDM. When 7-Zip isn't installed, a window says so, with a button to get it.
1654b13da0558b05.text: DDM 可以自行提取 ZIP（包括加密的）、TAR、TAR.GZ、TAR.XZ、GZ 和 XZ 格式。7z 和 RAR 格式需要 7-Zip，这是一个免费程序：RAR 自己的提取代码不能作为 DDM 这样免费程序的一部分。如果未安装 7-Zip，会弹出一个窗口提示，并提供一个获取按钮。

165bfc3d0addf229.source: The passwords (these, the proxy's and the debrid accounts') are kept in the system's keychain: Windows Credential Manager, the keyring on Linux (Secret Service: GNOME Keyring, KeePassXC and others) or the macOS keychain; DDM's settings keep only a reference. A locked keyring is never unlocked for DDM: without one, they stay in DDM's settings, sealed for your Windows account on Windows. <g1>Options → Accounts</g1> says where they are. A <g2>portable copy</g2> keeps them in its own folder.
165bfc3d0addf229.text: 密码（这些密码、代理密码和网盘账户密码）保存在系统的钥匙串中：Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环（Secret Service：GNOME Keyring、KeePassXC 及其他）或 macOS 钥匙串；DDM 的设置仅保留一个引用。锁定的密钥环绝不会为 DDM 解锁：如果没有密钥环，它们将保留在 DDM 的设置中，并在 Windows 上为您的 Windows 账户加密。<g1>选项 → 账户</g1>会说明它们的位置。<g2>便携版</g2>会将它们保存在自己的文件夹中。

165ea5e73977b362.source: In English, the <g1>Last Try Date</g1> and <g2>Added</g2> columns follow the system's 12- or 24-hour clock: <x3/> when Windows uses a 12-hour clock, and <g4>Added</g4> starts wide enough for it (<g5>#392</g5>).
165ea5e73977b362.text: 在英文版中，<g1>上次尝试日期</g1>和<g2>已添加</g2>列遵循系统的 12 小时或 24 小时制：<x3/> 当 Windows 使用 12 小时制时，<g4>已添加</g4>列的宽度足以显示它（<g5>#392</g5>）。

167e0568310b7eb2.text: 从页面下载视频：显示可选画质及文件大小，从 2160p 60fps 到更低画质。

16959ea3d24306e2.source: Untick the addresses you don't want (<g1>Select all</g1> and <g2>Select none</g2> help), then click <g3>Add to queue</g3>.
16959ea3d24306e2.text: 取消勾选不需要的地址（<g1>全选</g1>和<g2>不选</g2>会有帮助），然后单击<g3>添加到队列</g3>。
