16d498a3a477d64c.source: <g1>Dark mode has day mode's sizes and places</g1>: the menu bar, the toolbar, the panes, the list's lines and selection, buttons and the progress window's table measure the same in both modes. Only the colours change.
16d498a3a477d64c.text: <g1>深色模式的尺寸和位置已与浅色模式一致</g1>：两种模式下，菜单栏、工具栏、窗格、列表行和选中项、按钮以及进度窗口中的表格尺寸都相同。只有颜色不同。

16da6109033e7c1d.source: <g1>Copy a link, get the download window</g1>: copying a link to a file type on the <g2>File types</g2> list opens <g3>Download File Info</g3> with it, ready to start, also without the browser extension (<g4>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g4>, on by default).
16da6109033e7c1d.text: <g1>复制链接，打开下载窗口</g1>：复制文件类型列表<g2>文件类型</g2>上的链接会打开<g3>下载文件信息</g3>，并准备好开始下载，即使没有浏览器扩展程序也可以（<g4>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g4>，默认开启）。

17113f9f11b51665.source: DDM takes <x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/> and <x6/> addresses. Anything else gets <g7>Invalid address</g7>.
17113f9f11b51665.text: DDM 支持 <x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/> 和 <x6/> 地址。其他任何地址都会显示<g7>地址无效</g7>。

1718af0aab0b4996.source: DDM reads the torrent and shows its files as a folder tree. A <x1/> file is read at once. A magnet link first has to get the file list from other peers, usually within seconds. While it waits, <g2>Add torrent</g2> shows how many peers it found, from the trackers, the DHT or your local network, and how many answered. After 30 seconds without an answer, it says what may be in the way: a link with no trackers while the DHT is off, or a firewall, a VPN or a network that blocks BitTorrent.
1718af0aab0b4996.text: DDM 读取种子文件，并将其文件显示为文件夹树。一个 <x1/> 文件会立即读取。磁力链接需要先从其他对等点获取文件列表，通常在几秒钟内完成。在等待期间，<g2>添加种子</g2> 会显示它从跟踪器、DHT 或本地网络中找到的对等点数量，以及有多少对等点做出了响应。如果在 30 秒内没有响应，它会说明可能存在的问题：一个没有跟踪器且 DHT 已关闭的链接，或者防火墙、VPN 或阻止 BitTorrent 的网络。

172730c20b2fdcfc.text: 一个适配器用于所有连接

1745fe3e724c0846.source: <g1><g2>Link grabber and archives</g2></g1> — many links at once, in packages; zip, 7z and rar archives extracted when they are downloaded.
1745fe3e724c0846.text: <g1><g2>链接抓取器和压缩包</g2></g1> — 一次处理多个链接，以包的形式下载；下载完成后自动解压 zip、7z 和 rar 压缩包。

174c2671a756fca2.source: <g1>Scheduler and queues</g1><g2>Queues started and stopped by the clock, a few files at a time, the computer off at the end.</g2>
174c2671a756fca2.text: <g1>计划程序和队列</g1><g2>按时启动和停止队列，每次下载少量文件，完成后自动关闭电脑。</g2>

17526ad1287cb130.source: DDM itself still sends nothing anywhere: the server talks only to the DDM on this computer, over a token-protected local channel. But what the assistant reads, it passes on to its own AI service. When it lists your downloads, their file names, addresses and folders go to that service, under that service's privacy terms. Turn the API off with <x1/>, or remove the server from the assistant, when you don't want that.
17526ad1287cb130.text: DDM 本身不会向任何地方发送任何数据：服务器仅通过受令牌保护的本地通道与此计算机上的 DDM 通信。但助手读取的内容会传递给它自己的 AI 服务。当它列出您的下载任务时，其文件名、地址和文件夹会根据该服务的隐私条款发送到该服务。当您不希望发生这种情况时，请使用 <x1/> 关闭 API，或从助手中删除服务器。

178857076aff1609.source: Archives: extract when downloaded, and where the files go.
178857076aff1609.text: 存档：下载后提取，以及文件的存放位置。

17a6b9e12e193121.source: <g1>New:</g1> the server mode is new in this version. Please <g2>tell us how it goes</g2>.
17a6b9e12e193121.text: <g1>新增：</g1>服务器模式是此版本的新功能。请<g2>告诉我们您的使用体验</g2>。

17ad8acebdf474f3.source: A fix for {v1}, whose toolbar buttons did nothing (only their drop-down arrows worked), and for dark mode, which drew everything a little bigger and in other places than day mode.
17ad8acebdf474f3.text: 修复了 {v1} 版的问题：工具栏按钮点击后没有反应（只有下拉箭头有效）。还修复了深色模式下元素尺寸稍大、位置与浅色模式不同的问题。

17b0d178f671f810.source: It covers downloads and FTP, torrents (peers, trackers, the DHT and the listening port), video pages and image galleries, the DNS you chose, DDM's own downloads and its update check. The command line's <x1/>, <x2/> and <x3/> take <x4/>, with the adapter's name, such as <x5/> or <x6/>, or one of its addresses.
17b0d178f671f810.text: 它涵盖下载和 FTP、种子（对等点、追踪器、DHT 和监听端口）、视频页面和图片库、您选择的 DNS、DDM 自身的下载及其更新检查。命令行中的 <x1/>、<x2/> 和 <x3/> 接受 <x4/>，其中包含网卡名称，例如 <x5/> 或 <x6/>，或其某个地址。

182d183a89457359.source: Is DDM available in my language? — Dannex Download Manager
182d183a89457359.text: DDM 有我的语言版本吗？— Dannex Download Manager

1839e6e1134a946d.source: <g1>The video helpers are offered on the first start.</g1> A window explains what yt-dlp and ffmpeg do and downloads both on <g2>Yes, download them (recommended)</g2>; <g3>Not now</g3> leaves them for the video window. Upgrading? It asks once too, if one of them is missing.
1839e6e1134a946d.text: <g1>首次启动时会提供视频辅助工具。</g1>窗口会说明 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg 的用途，点击<g2>是，下载它们（推荐）</g2>即可下载这两个工具；点击<g3>暂不</g3>则可在视频窗口中再下载。升级时，如果缺少其中一个工具，也会询问一次。

183aba6f0c7e3efe.source: Point at the video in your browser and click the Download video button that appears over it, or paste the page's address into Tasks → Download video from a page. DDM lists every quality the site offers, with sizes; pick one and it downloads like any file. It uses yt-dlp, which supports thousands of sites. Download only videos you have the right to. See Download a video from a page.
183aba6f0c7e3efe.text: 将鼠标指向浏览器中的视频，然后点击视频上方出现的下载视频按钮，或者将页面地址粘贴到任务 → 从页面下载视频。DDM 会列出网站提供的所有画质及对应大小；选择所需画质，即可像下载普通文件一样下载。DDM 使用 yt-dlp，支持数千个网站。仅下载您有权下载的视频。请参阅从页面下载视频。

1882fb060e3b3168.source: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, is the main platform. Builds for Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) come with every release too; today's are marked experimental. From version {v1}, Linux isn't experimental any more: it is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, in Wayland sessions too, and its packages in clean Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora systems. 19377f473665c846.source: <g1>The help shows what it describes</g1> (<g2>#228</g2>): every guide and the main help pages now have pictures of the windows they explain, cropped to what matters, numbered where a step points at one control, and step strips for the usual flows (a download from the browser, a first download, a video, a torrent, a queue overnight). On the website they follow its light or dark theme, keep their place while they load, and open larger with a click; their descriptions and captions are translated with the page. The pictures are made by a script from one list (<x3/>), so they can all be taken again in one go.
19377f473665c846.text: <g1>帮助文档所见即所得</g1>（<g2>#228</g2>）：所有指南和主要帮助页面现在都配有其所解释窗口的图片，图片经过裁剪以突出重点，步骤指向某个控件时会进行编号，并为常见流程（从浏览器下载、首次下载、视频、种子、夜间队列）提供步骤条。在网站上，它们会根据网站的明暗主题显示，加载时保持原位，点击后可放大；图片描述和标题会随页面一起翻译。这些图片由脚本根据一个列表（<x3/>）生成，因此可以一次性全部重新拍摄。

196cd64b0e507e83.source: <g1>Working set</g1> (Details tab, add the column) adds memory shared with other programs. DDM draws its windows with the graphics card, so the graphics driver's memory counts here too, about 120 MB in all.

19751f457b4c7c29.source: <g1>Tasks → Import → From a text file</g1> reads a text file and picks out every web address in it. You can also drop a <x2/> or <x3/> list straight onto the download list. Untick what you don't want, and add the rest to the queue.
19751f457b4c7c29.text: <g1>任务 → 导入 → 从文本文件</g1>会读取文本文件，并找出其中的每个网址。您也可以直接将 <x2/> 或 <x3/> 列表拖放到下载列表上。取消勾选不需要的，其余的加入队列。

198e0f8020d53f36.source: <g1>Trackers</g1> — the torrent's trackers. With none, peers come from the DHT and other peers.

199473afdafb9dad.source: Windows: closing the window hides DDM in the notification area again, as it did before {v1}, instead of leaving it minimized in the taskbar with its icon right there, among the hidden icons behind ^ (where Windows puts a new icon). Before hiding the window, DDM asked Windows where the icon was, and Windows 10 and some Windows 11 versions give an icon behind ^ no place; DDM took that for no icon at all. It now also asks whether Windows has the icon, wherever it shows it, and keeps the window in the taskbar only when Windows says it has none (Explorer isn't running, or the icon was lost): when Windows doesn't answer, the window hides as usual, and starting DDM again always brings it back. The same goes for <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1>, and for a start with Windows, which no longer shows the window minimized after half a minute (<g2>#750</g2>, <g3>#718</g3>, <g4>#754</g4>, <g5>#545</g5>, <g6>#534</g6>, <g7>#527</g7>).
199473afdafb9dad.text: Windows：关闭窗口再次把 DDM 隐藏到通知区域，就像 {v1} 之前那样，而不是让它最小化留在任务栏里，而它的图标就在那里，在 ^ 后面的隐藏图标中（Windows 放置新图标的位置）。隐藏窗口之前，DDM 会向 Windows 询问图标在哪里，而 Windows 10 和某些 Windows 11 版本不给 ^ 后面的图标任何位置；DDM 曾把这当作根本没有图标。现在它还会询问 Windows 是否有这个图标，不管它显示在哪里，只有当 Windows 说没有时（资源管理器没有运行，或图标丢失），才让窗口留在任务栏里：当 Windows 没有应答时，窗口照常隐藏，再次启动 DDM 总能把它带回来。<g1>最小化到通知区域</g1>也是如此，随 Windows 启动时也一样，不再在半分钟后把窗口显示为最小化（<g2>#750</g2>、<g3>#718</g3>、<g4>#754</g4>、<g5>#545</g5>、<g6>#534</g6>、<g7>#527</g7>）。

199d6d5b06756e0f.source: DDM contains no adware, spyware, bundled offers or tracking. Its whole source code is public, so anyone can check what it does, and every release is built from that code by GitHub's servers, where the build can be inspected. The helper programs it can fetch for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. Download DDM only from <g1>this site</g1> or the project's GitHub releases.
199d6d5b06756e0f.text: DDM 不包含广告软件、间谍软件、捆绑优惠或跟踪。它的全部源代码都是公开的，因此任何人都可以检查它的功能，并且每个版本都是由 GitHub 的服务器从该代码构建的，构建过程可以被检查。它为视频获取的辅助程序在运行前会进行验证：yt-dlp 会对照其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会对照其发布的校验和进行验证。请仅从<g1>本网站</g1>或项目的 GitHub 发布页面下载 DDM。

19a3fe3b4ef2bca1.source: All Downloads, Unfinished, Finished and Queues, each by category.
19a3fe3b4ef2bca1.text: 所有下载、未完成、已完成和队列；每个分支都按类别显示。

19d15279ff89ebf1.source: <g1>YouTube's look-up failing with "Requested format is not available"</g1> (<g2>#352</g2>): signed-in cookies make yt-dlp use only YouTube's players that need a JavaScript runtime, and without one no video is left. The page is now looked up again without the cookies, and lists its qualities.
19d15279ff89ebf1.text: <g1>YouTube 查找失败并显示“请求的格式不可用”</g1>（<g2>#352</g2>）：登录的 Cookie 会使 yt-dlp 仅使用需要 JavaScript 运行时的 YouTube 播放器，如果没有运行时，则没有视频可用。现在会再次查找页面，但不带 Cookie，并列出其质量。

1a155732b76c7f3c.source: <g1>Limit each download to</g1> holds each download to the same speed. Set it first, since it starts at a very slow 10 KBytes/sec, then choose <g2>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Turn on</g2>. <g3>Turn off</g3> gives full speed back, and <g4>Turn the limiter on whenever Dannex Download Manager starts</g4> keeps it on from the start.
1a155732b76c7f3c.text: <g1>将每个下载限制为</g1>会让每个下载保持相同的速度。请先设置它，因为它起初是非常慢的 10 KB/s，然后选择<g2>下载 → 速度限制器 → 开启</g2>。<g3>关闭</g3>会恢复全速，<g4>每次 Dannex Download Manager 启动时开启限制器</g4>则让它从一开始就保持开启。

1a3adf48a31bc69c.source: Every text the UI shows goes through <x1/> (craft-i18n catalogs, <x2/>). <x3/> rebuilds <x4/> from the source, with a note for translators on each text (what it is, where it shows, its placeholders). <x5/> fills what the other catalogs lack (rows marked <x6/>), following each language's style guide (<x7/>) and the glossary; a row a person reviewed is never replaced, and CI (<x8/>) fails a change that drops one. The website has its own catalogs (<x9/>, <x10/>).
1a3adf48a31bc69c.text: UI 显示的每个文本都通过 <x1/>（craft-i18n 目录，<x2/>）。<x3/> 从源代码重建 <x4/>，并为每个文本附上翻译人员的注释（它是什么，在哪里显示，其占位符）。<x5/> 填充其他目录中缺少的内容（标记为 <x6/> 的行），遵循每种语言的样式指南（<x7/>）和词汇表；人工审核过的行永远不会被替换，CI（<x8/>）会使删除行的更改失败。网站有自己的目录（<x9/>，<x10/>）。

1a4513aa7b897fc8.source: <g1>Confirm before deleting downloads</g1> — ask before taking downloads off the list. On by default; <g2>Don't show this dialog again</g2> in that question turns it off, and ticking it here turns it back on.
1a4513aa7b897fc8.text: <g1>删除下载前确认</g1> — 在从列表中删除下载前进行询问。默认开启；该问题中的<g2>不再显示此对话框</g2>会将其关闭，而在此处勾选则会重新开启。

1a7ab1671a64da4c.source: <g1>At once from the page.</g1> On YouTube the player itself lists the video's formats, and on other sites the HLS or DASH stream the player loaded lists its qualities. The menu shows them straight away, the way DDM will list them: each resolution with its size, then the sound. A thin line moving along the menu's top edge means DDM is still checking. When DDM's own look-up comes, its list takes the place of the page's, row for row: sizes are corrected and any quality the page didn't name is added, while the row under the pointer stays where it is. If the page says nothing DDM can use (a live stream, a protected video, a site that names no qualities), the menu says <g2>Looking up the qualities...</g2> and shows DDM's list when it comes, as before.
1a7ab1671a64da4c.text: <g1>直接从页面获取。</g1>在 YouTube 上，播放器本身会列出视频的格式；在其他站点上，播放器加载的 HLS 或 DASH 流会列出其画质。菜单会立即显示它们，与 DDM 将来列出的方式相同：每个分辨率连同其大小，然后是声音。菜单顶部边缘有一条细线移动，表示 DDM 仍在检查。当 DDM 自己的查找结果出来后，其列表会逐行取代页面的列表：大小会被更正，页面没有列出的任何画质会被添加，而指针下方的那一行保持不动。如果页面没有给出 DDM 可用的内容（直播、受保护的视频、没有列出画质的站点），菜单会显示<g2>正在查找画质...</g2>，并在 DDM 的列表出来后显示它，与以前一样。

1afbd7e7716e0246.text: DDM 可以在 64 位 Linux 桌面会话中运行。它已在 Ubuntu 24.04、Debian 12 和 Fedora 上，使用 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 桌面环境，以及 X11 和 Wayland 会话中进行过测试。请选择以下文件之一（最高版本 {v1}，文件名以 <x1/> 结尾，例如 <x2/>）：

1b9bbdc7f554f0b8.source: In Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur the whole window is mirrored: the menus, toolbar and categories run from right to left, as Windows does for these languages. File names, addresses and folder paths keep their own direction inside translated sentences, so they stay readable.
1b9bbdc7f554f0b8.text: 使用阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语时，整个窗口会镜像显示：菜单、工具栏和分类会从右向左排列，就像 Windows 对这些语言的处理方式一样。文件名、地址和文件夹路径在翻译后的句子中仍保持原有的书写方向，以确保可读性。

1bad738cb3cea90f.source: Select or unselect the download with the dotted outline
1bad738cb3cea90f.text: 选择或取消选择带虚线轮廓的下载

1bc760bb0d073838.source: Click a column's title to sort by it; click it again for the other way.
1bc760bb0d073838.text: 单击列标题可按该列排序；再次单击则反向排序。

1bc816518d6f87cb.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: the folder its torrents go to; empty, the Torrents category's folder. <g2>Add them without starting them</g2> adds them as <g3>Download Later</g3> would.
1bc816518d6f87cb.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：种子文件的保存文件夹；留空则使用“种子”类别的文件夹。启用<g2>添加但不启动</g2>时，添加方式与<g3>稍后下载</g3>相同。

1bcf62be8def689c.source: Download File Info with Download Later ringed
1bcf62be8def689c.text: “下载文件信息”中圈出的“稍后下载”

1bdb78f184316d1c.source: <g1>Notification area</g1><g2>Starts with the computer in the notification area, and hides progress windows there while they run.</g2>
1bdb78f184316d1c.text: <g1>通知区域</g1><g2>随电脑启动并在通知区域运行，运行时将进度窗口隐藏在通知区域。</g2>

1be905c8f721541b.source: <g1>Browser integration needs the installer.</g1> The browser finds DDM's helper through the registry, so a portable copy can't take downloads from the browser. Use <g2>Add URL</g2>, the clipboard or the drop target instead (see <g3>Adding downloads</g3>).
1be905c8f721541b.text: <g1>浏览器集成需要安装程序。</g1>浏览器通过注册表查找 DDM 的辅助程序，因此便携版无法从浏览器接收下载。请改用<g2>添加 URL</g2>、剪贴板或拖放区域（请参阅<g3>添加下载</g3>）。

1be93bd020009908.source: <g1>The keyboard focus got lost</g1> when a button greyed itself or Escape closed a drop-down: Tab started over at the top of the window. It now moves on, or comes back, as in Windows.
1be93bd020009908.text: <g1>键盘焦点会丢失</g1>：按钮变灰或按 Escape 关闭下拉菜单时，按 Tab 会从窗口顶部重新开始。现在，焦点会像在 Windows 中一样继续移动或返回。

1c0101659f1e2203.source: <g1>Feeds</g1>: the feeds it watches; none ticked, all of them.
1c0101659f1e2203.text: <g1>源</g1>：规则适用的源；如果没有勾选任何源，则适用于所有源。

1c016fb7daded70e.source: Left click on the tray icon now toggles the main window: hidden or minimized shows it again, in front hides it to the tray, and behind other windows brings it forward (it only ever showed it, so clicking while the window was visible did nothing). On Windows it goes by what covers the window, so it works with the icon under the taskbar's ^ too.
1c016fb7daded70e.text: 左键点击托盘图标现在会切换主窗口：隐藏或最小化时再次显示，位于最前面时隐藏到托盘，被其他窗口遮住时调到前面（此前它只会显示，所以窗口可见时点击没有任何作用）。在 Windows 上，它根据什么遮住了窗口来判断，所以图标在任务栏的 ^ 之下时也能用。

1c20a2d248e2a80e.source: Run DDM on a home server, NAS, Docker or Unraid — Dannex Download Manager
1c20a2d248e2a80e.text: 在家庭服务器、NAS、Docker 或 Unraid 上运行 DDM — Dannex Download Manager

1c21f2a42d7d73f5.source: Some servers drop the connection when the speed is very low. Avoid a tight limit for servers that can't resume (<g1>Can resume: No</g1>).
1c21f2a42d7d73f5.text: 当速度很低时，有些服务器会断开连接。对于不支持断点续传的服务器（<g1>支持断点续传：否</g1>），请避免设置过严的限制。

1c4670fc540cb86b.source: <g1>Refresh</g1> fetches the selected feed now. <g2>Remove</g2> stops watching it. A feed that can't be read is shown in red, and its line at the bottom says why.
1c4670fc540cb86b.text: <g1>刷新</g1>会立即获取选定的源。<g2>删除</g2>会停止监视该源。无法读取的源会显示为红色，底部一行会说明原因。

1c4eee6300f12df4.source: Every file name now has its file-type icon, the one your system uses.
1c4eee6300f12df4.text: 现在每个文件名都带有其文件类型图标，即您的系统所使用的图标。

1c5f1bf427c1cf81.text: 它能续传中断的下载吗？

1c603722e0427f19.source: How do I download a video from YouTube or another site? — Dannex Download Manager
1c603722e0427f19.text: 如何从 YouTube 或其他网站下载视频？— Dannex Download Manager

1c7c99ef90478d88.text: Windows 10/11；macOS 和 Linux 版本可供试用

1c8712bdb568d397.source: Install DDM with the setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> ticked. This registers the helper. (The portable copy can't do this; see <g2>Portable mode</g2>.) On Linux and macOS DDM registers it itself, each time it starts, for the browsers installed then.
1c8712bdb568d397.text: 使用安装程序安装 DDM，并勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Firefox）</g1>。这会注册辅助程序。（便携版无法执行此操作；请参阅<g2>便携模式</g2>。）在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 每次启动时都会为当时安装的浏览器自行注册。

1c90a99a45e311c8.source: If the service can't get the torrent (no peers, too big, refused), the list says why.
1c90a99a45e311c8.text: 如果服务无法获取种子（没有对等方、文件过大或请求被拒绝），列表会说明原因。

1c9344ff1a57c0ff.source: Quit DDM with <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1> before you unplug the stick, so it saves the list.
1c9344ff1a57c0ff.text: 拔下 U 盘前，请通过<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>退出 DDM，以保存下载列表。

1ca5420546545830.source: <g1>Force processes to terminate</g1> closes programs that would otherwise hold Windows up.
1ca5420546545830.text: <g1>强制终止进程</g1>会关闭那些可能导致 Windows 无法正常关闭的程序。

1cab3257999e25f9.source: <g1>Update now</g1> in Help → Check for updates: DDM downloads the new version, checks it, puts it in place and restarts, on Windows (setup, portable and plain zip), Mac and Linux (AppImage, .tar.gz; a .deb or .rpm opens in the system's installer). It installs only files listed in a checksum list signed by DDM's release key, which every release now carries (<x2/>). The first update this way will be from {v1} to the next version.
1cab3257999e25f9.text: 在“帮助”→“检查更新”中选择<g1>立即更新</g1>：DDM 会在 Windows（安装版、便携版和普通 zip）、macOS 和 Linux（AppImage、.tar.gz；.deb 或 .rpm 会在系统安装程序中打开）上下载新版本、验证并安装，然后重新启动。它只会安装 DDM 发布密钥签名的校验和列表中列出的文件；现在每个版本都附带该列表（<x2/>）。首次使用此方式更新时，会从 {v1} 更新到下一个版本。

1cafb86bd2c2b2f4.source: <g1>Download File Info</g1> shows the file's name, its size and where it will be saved. The folder depends on the file's type: a ZIP goes to <x2/>, a video to <x3/>, and so on. Change the folder or the category if you like.
1cafb86bd2c2b2f4.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>显示文件名、大小以及保存位置。文件夹取决于文件类型：ZIP 文件到<x2/>，视频文件到<x3/>，依此类推。您可以更改文件夹或类别。

1cf59e936ec9e349.source: Whether <g1>7-Zip</g1> was found: 7z and RAR archives need it.
1cf59e936ec9e349.text: 是否找到 <g1>7-Zip</g1>：7z 和 RAR 存档需要使用它。

1cfe5aa7a4ff4b14.source: <g1>The engine tests no longer fail on a busy computer</g1> (<g2>#123</g2>, <g3>#136</g3>, <g4>#201</g4>):

1d26bf9aebfa246c.source: The main window in Arabic, laid out right to left.
1d26bf9aebfa246c.text: 阿拉伯语主窗口，采用从右到左的布局。

1d28151c4fc4f2b7.source: The download's log (hover over it in the list) says what happened: <g1>Extracted 12 files to …</g1>, or why not, for example <g2>Couldn't extract movie.7z.001: volume 3 of it is missing</g2>. An encrypted archive without its password opens the <g3>Archive password</g3> window. Type the password and click <g4>Extract</g4>, or <g5>Cancel</g5> to leave the archive as it is.
1d28151c4fc4f2b7.text: 下载日志（将鼠标悬停在列表中的下载上即可查看）会说明提取结果：<g1>已提取 12 个文件到…</g1>；如果提取失败，也会说明原因，例如 <g2>无法提取 movie.7z.001：缺少第 3 卷</g2>。如果加密存档没有密码，会打开“<g3>存档密码</g3>”窗口。输入密码并点击“<g4>提取</g4>”，或点击“<g5>取消</g5>”以保留存档。

1d3619526676820b.source: <g1>The servers you download from.</g1> To download a file, DDM connects to the server that holds it and sends what any browser would: the request, and the cookies, referrer and browser identification the extension passed along, so downloads that need you to be signed in keep working. Those servers see your IP address, as they would if your browser downloaded the file.
1d3619526676820b.text: <g1>您下载文件的服务器。</g1>为了下载文件，DDM 会连接到存储文件的服务器，并发送任何浏览器都会发送的内容：请求，以及扩展程序传递的 cookie、referrer 和浏览器标识，以便需要登录的下载能够继续工作。这些服务器会看到您的 IP 地址，就像您的浏览器下载文件时一样。

1d38afec30d09ec8.source: The copy of the extension from the Chrome Web Store showed no <g1>Download video</g1> button on YouTube before version 0.5.1. From {v1} it shows it. Your browser updates extensions by itself; to get it sooner, open its extensions page and update them there.
1d38afec30d09ec8.text: Chrome 网上应用店中的扩展程序副本在 {v1} 版本之前，YouTube 页面上不显示<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮。从 {v1} 版本开始，该按钮会显示。您的浏览器会自行更新扩展程序；要更快获取更新，请打开浏览器的扩展程序页面并在那里更新。

1d4ee2f96c724f0f.source: A torrent: what it sends to peers, while it runs.
1d4ee2f96c724f0f.text: 一个种子：运行时发送给对等点的数据。

1d6ccabe01271561.source: The progress window: speed, time left and each connection's share of the file
1d6ccabe01271561.text: 进度窗口：速度、剩余时间以及每个连接的文件份额

1d7e46d70dc708ef.source: <g1>Download video</g1> shows a plain file's size, from its server, instead of "size unknown" (<g2>#320</g2>).
1d7e46d70dc708ef.text: <g1>下载视频</g1>会显示普通文件从服务器获取的大小，而不是“大小未知”（<g2>#320</g2>）。

1d8e72be31ef720b.source: <g1>Adwaita</g1>: GNOME's look: round corners, flat grey buttons, a rounded focus ring, GNOME's check boxes, a header bar with the title in bold and round buttons (on Windows, where DDM draws it), and GNOME's Adwaita icons, in colour for files and categories, one colour in the toolbar.
1d8e72be31ef720b.text: <g1>Adwaita</g1>：GNOME 的外观：圆角、扁平的灰色按钮、圆形的焦点环、GNOME 的复选框、带有粗体标题和圆形按钮的标题栏（在 Windows 上，由 DDM 绘制），以及 GNOME 的 Adwaita 图标，文件和类别为彩色，工具栏为单色。

1da156143837aec9.source: Click <g1>Add Torrent</g1> on the toolbar to choose a <x2/> file. Or click the arrow next to it and choose <g3>Open torrent file...</g3> or <g4>Add magnet link...</g4> (also under <g5>Tasks</g5>).
1da156143837aec9.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 Torrent</g1>来选择一个 <x2/> 文件。或者点击旁边的箭头，选择<g3>打开 torrent 文件...</g3>或<g4>添加磁力链接...</g4>（也在<g5>任务</g5>下）。

1da9f06674c10f77.source: <g1>Videos come down through DDM's own downloader:</g1> yt-dlp now finds a video and its sound, and DDM downloads them the way it downloads any file: over as many connections as <g2>Options → Connection</g2> gives (8 by default; the progress window's connections table and segment map show them), under the speed limits (a change applies at once), paused and resumed like a file, also after quitting DDM, and with a fresh address asked of yt-dlp when one expires. yt-dlp then joins them and adds the subtitles as before. YouTube's qualities, its sound, most sites' MP4s and streams in pieces (HLS, DASH) come this way; live streams and RTMP, RTSP, MMS or FTP streams are still yt-dlp's to download, and the progress window says so (<g3>#769</g3>).
1da9f06674c10f77.text: <g1>视频通过 DDM 自己的下载器下载：</g1>yt-dlp 现在只负责找到视频及其声音，DDM 像下载任何文件一样下载它们：使用<g2>选项 → 连接</g2>给出的连接数（默认 8；进度窗口的连接表和分段图会显示它们），遵守速度限制（更改立即生效），像文件一样暂停和恢复（退出 DDM 后也一样），地址过期时会向 yt-dlp 请求新地址。随后 yt-dlp 把它们合并，并像以前一样添加字幕。YouTube 的各种画质及其声音、大多数站点的 MP4 和分片流（HLS、DASH）都走这条途径；直播以及 RTMP、RTSP、MMS 或 FTP 流仍由 yt-dlp 自己下载，进度窗口会说明这一点（<g3>#769</g3>）。

1daf9eb7819e64c4.source: Use Help → Report a problem in DDM: it opens the bug report form on GitHub with your version, system and language filled in. Or open the form yourself. Security problems go privately through the security page.
1daf9eb7819e64c4.text: 在 DDM 中选择“帮助”→“报告问题”，即可在 GitHub 上打开错误报告表单，其中已填入您的版本、系统和语言。您也可以自行打开表单。安全问题请通过安全页面私下报告。

1db710a3a79cb703.source: <g1>Show download complete dialog</g1> — show <g2>Download complete</g2> when a file finishes.
1db710a3a79cb703.text: <g1>显示下载完成对话框</g1> — 文件完成时显示<g2>下载完成</g2>。

1dc2c625a456ae3e.source: <g1>Look up each file's size</g1>: once exploring is done, DDM asks the server each file's size. Untick it for a faster list.
1dc2c625a456ae3e.text: <g1>查询每个文件的大小</g1>：探索结束后，DDM 会向服务器询问每个文件的大小。取消勾选可更快得到列表。

1dc7d4ba0d377867.text: 遵循浏览器的 VPN 扩展

1dea3a17c28944ca.text: 已选择另一个 DDM（<g1>将下载发送到</g1>）

1dfb7acf11d64257.source: 1 Follow the system's dark mode; 2 Always dark keeps DDM dark.
1dfb7acf11d64257.text: 1 跟随系统深色模式；2 始终为深色会让 DDM 保持深色。

1e137c87addef252.source: The torrent engine is written in Rust, which rules out many memory bugs, and DDM checks every piece against the torrent's fingerprint, so a peer can't slip in altered data. DDM keeps the engine up to date with the fixes its authors publish.
1e137c87addef252.text: 种子引擎使用 Rust 编写，可避免许多内存错误。DDM 还会根据种子的指纹检查每个数据块，因此对等方无法混入被篡改的数据。DDM 会及时更新种子引擎，以应用其作者发布的修复。

1e4608d466e2df9a.source: <g1>When done</g1> — shows where the file will be saved. Untick <g2>Show the Download complete window</g2> to skip the <g3>Download complete</g3> box for this file only.
1e4608d466e2df9a.text: <g1>完成后</g1> — 显示文件将保存的位置。取消勾选<g2>显示“下载完成”窗口</g2>，可仅对此文件跳过<g3>下载完成</g3>框。

1e4861cc4f32a384.source: <g1>Every text the user sees goes through <x2/></g1> (<x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>); after adding one, run <x7/>. Data inside a sentence (a file name, an address, a size) goes in through <x8/> or <x9/>, so it reads right in right-to-left languages.
1e4861cc4f32a384.text: <g1>用户看到的所有文本都必须通过<x2/></g1>（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/>）；添加文本后，运行<x7/>。句子中的数据（文件名、地址、大小）应通过<x8/>或<x9/>传入，以便在从右到左的语言中正确显示。

1e5f6407bbf006fa.source: Switching is easy. Bring your downloads with you.
1e5f6407bbf006fa.text: 轻松切换。带上您的下载。

1e85323c7843fa8c.source: Fill in <g1>Download no more than [N] MBytes every [H] hours</g1>. It starts at 200 MBytes every 5 hours.
1e85323c7843fa8c.text: 填写<g1>每 [H] 小时下载不超过 [N] MB</g1>。默认设置为每 5 小时 200 MB。

1e87214b3ee34be0.source: <g1>Support DDM</g1>: <g2>Help → Support DDM</g2> and a line in <g3>About</g3> open the creator's <g4>GitHub Sponsors</g4> page in the browser; the website, the README and the browser extension's popup link to it too. Only when asked: DDM stays free, with no reminders, and nothing changes or unlocks.
1e87214b3ee34be0.text: <g1>支持 DDM</g1>：<g2>帮助 → 支持 DDM</g2> 和<g3>关于</g3>中的一行文字会在浏览器中打开创建者的 <g4>GitHub Sponsors</g4> 页面；网站、README 和浏览器扩展的弹出窗口也链接到该页面。仅在被要求时显示：DDM 保持免费，没有提醒，也没有任何功能改变或解锁。

1e9513157826302d.source: Debrid service accounts — Dannex Download Manager help
1e9513157826302d.text: 网盘服务帐户 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

1edcb9d37be4f279.source: Options → General → Use advanced browser integration
1edcb9d37be4f279.text: 选项 → 常规 → 使用高级浏览器集成

1ef5c74257887c0c.source: A download manager can fill your whole connection. The Speed Limiter caps DDM so that browsing, video calls and games stay smooth, and can give it full speed again while you're away from the computer.
1ef5c74257887c0c.text: 下载管理器可能会占用您全部的网络连接。速度限制器可以限制 DDM 的速度，让您在浏览网页、视频通话和玩游戏时保持流畅。当您不在电脑旁时，它还可以让 DDM 恢复全速下载。

1f1e0325ab540d06.text: 服务器允许 2 个连接

1f695b083ba01e9b.source: Crash reports: a freeze whose window had recovered by the time its dump was taken is reported as a freeze, not as a crash in DDM's own watchdog (<g1>#420</g1>).
1f695b083ba01e9b.text: 崩溃报告：当窗口在转储生成时已恢复的卡顿，现在被报告为卡顿，而不是 DDM 自身看门狗中的崩溃（<g1>#420</g1>）。

1f696e508865eda4.source: <g1>Episodes</g1> reads <x2/> or <x3/> in a title. <x4/> is season 1, episode 2; <x5/> is episodes 5 to 8; <x6/> is everything from season 2 on. A rule takes each episode once: when a second release of an episode it already added turns up, it is skipped.
1f696e508865eda4.text: <g1>剧集</g1>会读取标题中的<x2/>或<x3/>。<x4/>是第 1 季第 2 集；<x5/>是第 5 到 8 集；<x6/>是第 2 季及之后的所有内容。一个规则每集只取一次：当它已经添加的剧集的第二个版本出现时，它会被跳过。

1f6d9db77baccf7e.source: Click <g1>Download Now</g1>, or <g2>Later</g2> to add it to the list without starting.
1f6d9db77baccf7e.text: 点击<g1>立即下载</g1>，或点击<g2>稍后</g2>将其添加到列表而不开始下载。

1f70af26cbe00250.source: : the user that owns those folders (DDM runs as no particular user).
1f70af26cbe00250.text: ：拥有这些文件夹的用户（DDM 不以特定用户身份运行）。

1f73edb3d8f37ba8.source: Some limits, plainly: the portable copy can't connect to a browser, since it writes nothing outside its folder.
1f73edb3d8f37ba8.text: 一些限制，请注意：便携版无法连接到浏览器，因为它不会在其文件夹之外写入任何内容。

1f97ee3107818c42.source: Speed Limiter and connections in detail →

1faf210450b3be53.source: Right-click a link, a video, a sound or a picture and choose <g1>Download with DDM</g1>. DDM downloads it whatever its type: you asked for it, so the file types list and the excluded sites don't apply here (they only decide which downloads DDM takes over by itself). A video that plays as a stream goes to the <g2>Download video</g2> window with the stream its player loaded (HLS or DASH), as the <g3>button over videos</g3> sends it, with your cookies for the stream's server and the page as the referrer.
1faf210450b3be53.text: 右键点击链接、视频、音频或图片，然后选择<g1>使用 DDM 下载</g1>。无论文件类型是什么，DDM 都会下载您指定的内容：由于这是您主动选择的操作，文件类型列表和排除网站设置在这里不适用（它们只决定 DDM 自动接管哪些下载）。如果视频以流媒体形式播放，就会连同播放器加载的流（HLS 或 DASH）一起发送到“<g2>下载视频</g2>”窗口，方式与点击<g3>视频上方的按钮</g3>相同，并会附带该流媒体服务器所需的 Cookie 和作为引荐来源的页面。

2075535ccce685a4.source: <g1>Options → Connection → DNS</g1> picks who turns names into addresses for downloads, FTP, DDM's own downloads and the update check: the system's (the default), Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, NextDNS with your configuration ID, or your own. It is asked over HTTPS (the default) or TLS, so nobody on the way sees or changes the names you look up, or plainly over TCP. <g2>Test</g2> shows how long it takes to answer.
2075535ccce685a4.text: <g1>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g1> 用于选择谁将下载、FTP、DDM 自身的下载和更新检查的名称解析为地址：系统默认、Cloudflare、Google、Quad9、AdGuard、带有您的配置 ID 的 NextDNS，或您自己的 DNS。解析请求通过 HTTPS（默认）或 TLS 发送，因此途中的任何人都无法看到或更改您查询的名称，也可以直接通过 TCP 发送。<g2>测试</g2> 显示响应所需的时间。

20802419a2c5daee.text: — 隐式 FTPS，默认使用端口 990，地址另有指定时除外。

20a97913c89bc8d2.source: The main window in the Metro theme

20b71eff9aa8883f.source: <g1>from YouTube Music and YouTube's mobile site</g1>: the button over a video on music.youtube.com or m.youtube.com passed the page's cookies for that host only, while yt-dlp asks www.youtube.com, so the sign-in didn't reach it. The extension now sends each cookie with the domain the browser keeps it for, and DDM gives yt-dlp each one for that domain: youtube.com's sign-in reaches every YouTube host, and a host's own cookie stays with that host. With an older extension, a YouTube page's cookies (or a site's mobile page's, m. and mobile.) go to the whole site.
20b71eff9aa8883f.text: <g1>来自 YouTube Music 和 YouTube 移动网站</g1>：music.youtube.com 或 m.youtube.com 上视频上方的按钮仅传递该主机的页面 Cookie，而 yt-dlp 请求的是 www.youtube.com，因此登录信息未到达。现在，扩展程序会为浏览器保存的每个域发送相应的 Cookie，DDM 会将每个 Cookie 提供给 yt-dlp 用于该域：youtube.com 的登录信息会到达所有 YouTube 主机，而主机的自有 Cookie 会保留在该主机上。对于较旧的扩展程序，YouTube 页面的 Cookie（或网站移动页面的 Cookie，m. 和 mobile.）会发送到整个网站。

20e287595c1be7dd.source: Pick a network adapter, usually your VPN's, and every connection DDM opens goes through it. If the VPN drops, nothing slips out through your normal connection: downloads stop, and start again when it's back.
20e287595c1be7dd.text: 选择一个网卡，通常是您的 VPN 网卡，DDM 的所有连接都将通过它。如果 VPN 断开，您的正常连接不会泄露任何信息：下载会停止，并在 VPN 恢复后重新开始。

20e8ae667f877f6c.text: 下载速度限制器 — Dannex Download Manager

214b90b13f41cfae.text: 您的网盘账户，DDM 的所有连接都可用。

214d94db10fe0954.source: <g1>Cookies for video sites</g1> (<g2>#229</g2>): <g3>Options → Sites Logins</g3> can let yt-dlp read a browser's cookies on this computer (Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Chromium, Whale; Safari on macOS), with a profile by name or folder, so a pasted link to a video that needs you signed in (YouTube's "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot") works. Off by default. When the browser's extension passes the page's own cookies, those are used instead. When the browser's cookies can't be read (Chrome, Edge and Brave lock them on Windows; a locked keyring on Linux), the Download video window says so in plain words.
214d94db10fe0954.text: <g1>视频网站的 Cookie</g1>（<g2>#229</g2>）：<g3>选项 → 站点登录</g3> 可以让 yt-dlp 读取此计算机上浏览器的 Cookie（Firefox、Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi、Chromium、Whale；macOS 上的 Safari），通过配置文件名或文件夹，这样粘贴需要登录才能观看的视频链接（YouTube 的“登录以确认您不是机器人”）就能正常工作。此功能默认关闭。当浏览器扩展程序传递页面自身的 Cookie 时，会优先使用这些 Cookie。如果无法读取浏览器的 Cookie（Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 在 Windows 上会锁定 Cookie；Linux 上密钥环被锁定），“下载视频”窗口会用清晰的文字说明。

214f865d28ca98ae.source: DDM's torrents don't use <g1>encryption</g1> (sometimes called "protocol encryption"). That kind of encryption only hides the traffic from simple filters. It never hides who you are, so DDM doesn't claim to offer it. Some peers that require it won't connect.
214f865d28ca98ae.text: DDM 的种子不使用<g1>加密</g1>（有时称为“协议加密”）。这种加密只能让简单的过滤器无法识别流量，但不会隐藏您的身份，因此 DDM 不会声称提供这种加密。部分要求使用这种加密的对等方将无法连接。

215c6b99b6fe2b74.source: DDM downloads videos from their web pages: YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, TikTok, X, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, SoundCloud and well over a thousand other sites. <g1>yt-dlp</g1>, an open-source program whose community keeps it working as sites change, finds the video on the page; DDM's own downloader then brings it in, the way it downloads any file.
215c6b99b6fe2b74.text: DDM 可以从 YouTube、Vimeo、Dailymotion、Twitch、TikTok、X、Instagram、Facebook、Reddit、SoundCloud 以及其他一千多个网站下载视频。开源程序 <g1>yt-dlp</g1> 的社区会持续更新，以适应网站的变化，它负责在网页上找到视频；然后 DDM 自带的下载器会像下载任何文件一样将其下载。

216167f68e5e8b95.source: A <x1/> file's web address works too: paste it into <g2>Add URL</g2> or <g3>Torrent</g3>, or let the browser hand the download over. DDM fetches the file, with the browser's cookies when the browser sent it, and <g4>Add torrent</g4> shows what it holds. The browser hands <x5/> downloads over because <x6/> is in <g7>Options → File types</g7>. It's there by default; a list you had before this version keeps what it had, so add <x8/> to it yourself. <g9>Download with DDM</g9> on a link always hands it over. A command line with <x10/> (silent) saves the <x11/> file itself, like any file. DDM fetches at most 10 MB: anything bigger isn't a <x12/> file.
216167f68e5e8b95.text: 一个 <x1/> 文件的网址也适用：将其粘贴到<g2>添加 URL</g2>或<g3>种子</g3>中，或者让浏览器将下载任务交给 DDM。DDM 会获取该文件，如果浏览器发送了它，则会带上浏览器的 cookie，<g4>添加种子</g4>会显示其中包含的内容。浏览器会将 <x5/> 下载任务交给 DDM，因为 <x6/> 位于<g7>选项 → 文件类型</g7>中。它默认就在那里；如果您在此版本之前有一个列表，它会保留原有的内容，因此请自行添加 <x8/>。<g9>使用 DDM 下载</g9>链接总是会将其交给 DDM。带有 <x10/>（静默）的命令行会像任何文件一样保存 <x11/> 文件本身。DDM 最多获取 10 MB：任何更大的文件都不是 <x12/> 文件。

216eae12c95fa610.source: Everyone who sent a pull request, opened an issue or commented on GitHub since version <x1/>.
216eae12c95fa610.text: 感谢自版本 <x1/> 以来在 GitHub 上提交拉取请求、提出问题或发表评论的所有人。

2171be975f40efe2.source: <g1>Moving from IDM</g1><g2>Your IDM list comes over in one file, each download with its address, referrer and cookies.</g2>
2171be975f40efe2.text: <g1>从 IDM 迁移</g1><g2>您的 IDM 列表可导入为一个文件，每个下载任务都包含其地址、引用页和 Cookie。</g2>

219b4865ef43eb2a.text: 不使用它来超载、攻击或绕过您不拥有的服务器的限制。

219cecd117bfcfa2.source: <g1>Network adapter:</g1> while one is chosen (<g2>Options → Proxy / Socks → <g3>Network adapter</g3></g2>), galleries go through it too, as video pages do: DDM gives gallery-dl a proxy of its own on this computer, opens every connection through the adapter and looks the names up with the DNS you chose. When the adapter disconnects, the gallery stops with the other downloads; nothing goes out through your normal connection.
219cecd117bfcfa2.text: <g1>网络适配器：</g1> 如果选择了某个适配器（<g2>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → <g3>网络适配器</g3></g2>），图库也会像视频页面一样通过它下载：DDM 会在您的电脑上为 gallery-dl 提供一个自己的代理，所有连接都通过该适配器打开，并使用您选择的 DNS 进行名称查找。当适配器断开连接时，图库会与其他下载一起停止；不会通过您的常规连接传输任何数据。

219d3a9eddb4a1de.source: It downloads like any other file, in its own row and window.
219d3a9eddb4a1de.text: 它会像其他文件一样下载，在列表中占据一行，并有自己的窗口。

21a175fe80775c21.source: <g1>Can resume</g1> — <g2>Yes</g2> if the server lets DDM continue the download later, <g3>No</g3> if it doesn't.
21a175fe80775c21.text: <g1>支持断点续传</g1> — 如果服务器允许 DDM 稍后继续下载，则为<g2>是</g2>，否则为<g3>否</g3>。

21aa032bde745310.source: A download's first request (<x1/>) follows redirects and the pages that lead on to a file by themselves (a waiting page's refresh). Sites whose links aren't the file's address have a module in <x2/> (Google Drive: <x3/>): it turns the link into the file's address, reads the site's own pages (a confirmation form, an error page) and names its refusals (<x4/>), with pure functions tested without a network. The lab server plays such a site on its real host names for the end-to-end tests (<x5/>).
21aa032bde745310.text: 下载的第一个请求 (<x1/>) 会跟踪重定向以及那些自行导向文件的页面（例如等待页面的刷新）。如果网站的链接不是文件地址，<x2/> 中会有一个模块（例如 Google Drive: <x3/>）：它将链接转换为文件地址，读取网站自己的页面（例如确认表单、错误页面），并指出其拒绝原因 (<x4/>)，所有这些都通过无需网络即可测试的纯函数实现。实验室服务器会在其真实主机名上模拟此类网站，以进行端到端测试 (<x5/>)。

21b4ad12f925276a.source: Delete the <x1/> folder (or make it read-only) and the same copy behaves like the plain zip: it keeps its data in <x2/>.
21b4ad12f925276a.text: 删除 <x1/> 文件夹（或将其设为只读）后，同一副本的运行方式就与普通 ZIP 文件相同：数据会保存在 <x2/> 中。

21b8eb663576850d.source: <g1>View → Customize URL List:</g1> tick the download list's columns and put them in order (Move up, Move down, Reset). <g2>View → Font</g2> makes the list's text Small, Normal, Large or Extra large, its rows growing with it, and can put file names in bold.
21b8eb663576850d.text: <g1>视图 → 自定义 URL 列表：</g1>勾选下载列表的列并排列顺序（上移、下移、重置）。<g2>视图 → 字体</g2>可把列表文字设为小、正常、大或特大，行高随之增长，还可以把文件名加粗。

21bbf14b3e328e23.source: <g1>Base16 and pywal colour schemes as themes</g1>: a Base16 or Base24 scheme (<x2/>, the classic layout and tinted-theming's <x3/> one) or pywal's <x4/> (wallust's pywal-shaped one too), added with <g5>View → Theme → Add a theme file…</g5> or put in the themes folder, is a theme on the classic look: only the colours change. base00 and base01 are the backgrounds, base05 and base04 the text, base0D the focus, the selection and the progress bar (pywal: its background and foreground, color4); text is kept at 4.5:1 or more against every background and the accent at 3:1, moved a little where a scheme falls short. Once <x6/> has run, <g7>View → Theme</g7> lists <g8>pywal</g8>, read from where pywal writes it (<x9/>, <x10/> on Windows), and DDM follows each new wallpaper's colours within two seconds. A theme file can <x11/> a scheme to change more than its colours.
21bbf14b3e328e23.text: <g1>Base16 和 pywal 配色方案作为主题</g1>：Base16 或 Base24 方案（<x2/>，经典布局和着色主题的 <x3/> 方案）或 pywal 的 <x4/>（wallust 的 pywal 格式方案），通过<g5>视图 → 主题 → 添加主题文件…</g5>添加或放入主题文件夹，是经典外观的主题：仅颜色发生变化。base00 和 base01 是背景色，base05 和 base04 是文本色，base0D 是焦点、选择和进度条的颜色（pywal：其背景色和前景色，color4）；文本与所有背景的对比度保持在 4.5:1 或更高，强调色对比度保持在 3:1，在方案不足时略作调整。一旦 <x6/> 运行，<g7>视图 → 主题</g7>会列出 <g8>pywal</g8>，从 pywal 写入的位置读取（<x9/>，Windows 上为 <x10/>），DDM 会在两秒内跟随每个新壁纸的颜色。主题文件可以 <x11/> 方案以更改更多颜色以外的设置。

21bc1db419022796.source: <g1>Statcounter</g1> counts visits so we know which pages people read and where they come from. Its script records the page you open, the page that linked to it, your browser, system and screen size, and your approximate location from your IP address, and sets a cookie to tell new visitors from returning ones. We see these as statistics in Statcounter's dashboard; we don't use them to identify you, and we don't sell or share them. See <g2>Statcounter's privacy policy</g2>. Blocking cookies or scripts for statcounter.com in your browser, or a content blocker, keeps you out of the count; the site works the same.
21bc1db419022796.text: <g1>Statcounter</g1> 统计访问量，以便我们了解人们阅读了哪些页面以及他们来自何处。其脚本会记录您打开的页面、链接到该页面的页面、您的浏览器、系统和屏幕尺寸，以及根据您的 IP 地址推断的大致位置，并设置一个 Cookie 来区分新访客和回访者。我们在 Statcounter 的控制面板中将这些信息视为统计数据；我们不会使用它们来识别您的身份，也不会出售或分享它们。请参阅 <g2>Statcounter 的隐私政策</g2>。在您的浏览器中阻止 statcounter.com 的 Cookie 或脚本，或使用内容拦截器，可以使您不被计入统计；网站功能保持不变。

21be45d12f9d2500.source: <g1>Numbers are written the interface language's way</g1> (<g2>#128</g2>): counts, sizes, speeds, percentages and the list's columns group and point their digits as the chosen language does (German <x3/> and <x4/>, French <x5/>, Hindi <x6/>), whatever the Windows region; a region in the same language keeps its own way (Swiss German <x7/>). English is unchanged.
21be45d12f9d2500.text: <g1>数字按界面语言的习惯书写</g1> (<g2>#128</g2>)：计数、大小、速度、百分比以及列表的列会根据所选语言的习惯对数字进行分组和分隔（德语 <x3/> 和 <x4/>，法语 <x5/>，印地语 <x6/>），无论 Windows 区域设置如何；同一语言的区域设置会保留其自己的习惯（瑞士德语 <x7/>）。英语保持不变。

21c4556a53e2815c.source: <g1>Default download directory for "…" category</g1> — the category's folder. Type a path or click <g2>Browse</g2>.
21c4556a53e2815c.text: <g1>“…”类别的默认下载目录</g1> — 该类别的文件夹。输入路径或点击<g2>浏览</g2>。

21e0a24c92fe95eb.source: Hover over the line for the server's address and how the time was measured.
21e0a24c92fe95eb.text: 将鼠标悬停在该行上，可查看服务器地址以及时间测量方式。

21e40310e3442a92.text: Linux 上的“添加 URL”窗口，带有其地址框

21ee3eebf468850e.text: 下拉框或微调框的箭头

2209afed6bfb7aed.source: <g1>Deferred Rename</g1> on a download's <g2>Download status</g2> tab: save a new name while a download runs (<g3>Confirm</g3>, <g4>Enter</g4>, or 3 seconds idle) to rename the finished file's stem (along with yt-dlp subtitle files) or an exclusive finished folder on completion, without touching the live stream or <x5/> state; shared/save or pre-existing folders, split-archive volumes, and single-file torrents keep their original names (<g6>#655</g6>).
2209afed6bfb7aed.text: <g1>延迟重命名</g1>位于下载的<g2>下载状态</g2>选项卡：在下载运行期间保存新名称（<g3>确认</g3>、<g4>Enter</g4>，或空闲 3 秒），完成时会重命名已完成文件的主文件名（连同 yt-dlp 字幕文件）或独占的已完成文件夹，而不影响实时流或 <x5/> 状态；共享/保存或原本已存在的文件夹、分卷压缩包的各卷以及单文件种子保留原来的名称（<g6>#655</g6>）。

225fcf1e3a947289.source: <g1>Your IP address.</g1> Everyone sharing the same torrent sees it, as do its trackers and the DHT (the network peers use to find each other). That's how BitTorrent works, and no setting in DDM changes it. To hide your address, use a VPN on your whole computer.
225fcf1e3a947289.text: <g1>您的 IP 地址。</g1>所有共享同一种子的人，以及该种子的跟踪器和 DHT（对等方用来相互查找的网络），都能看到您的 IP 地址。这就是 BitTorrent 的工作方式，DDM 中的任何设置都无法改变这一点。要隐藏您的地址，请在整台计算机上使用 VPN。

22b6f7c73ab799c1.source: The first time, the phone's browser warns about the certificate. That is expected: DDM made it on your computer, and no public authority knows it. <g1>Options → Remote</g1> shows its fingerprint to compare. Add the page to the phone's home screen to keep it one tap away.

22d061402938912f.source: Each download is then held to that speed. <g1>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Turn off</g1> gives full speed again. Tick <g2>Always turn on Speed Limiter on Dannex Download Manager startup</g2> to have it on every time.
22d061402938912f.text: 然后，每个下载都会被限制在该速度。选择<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 关闭</g1>会再次恢复全速。勾选<g2>Dannex Download Manager 启动时始终开启速度限制器</g2>，以便每次都开启它。

2319136e89725d94.source: <g1>How it asks:</g1> gallery-dl and DDM's downloader ask sites as DDM (with the User-Agent the browser handed over, if any), and name the gallery's site as the page the pictures come from, as a browser does. Wikimedia's servers refuse tools that ask without a name. What gallery-dl downloads itself, it downloads one file a second at most. It uses no configuration file of yours.
2319136e89725d94.text: <g1>请求方式：</g1>gallery-dl 和 DDM 的下载器以 DDM 的名义向站点发出请求（如果浏览器提供了 User-Agent，则使用它），并像浏览器一样，把图库所在的站点作为图片来源页面。Wikimedia 的服务器会拒绝不报名称的工具。gallery-dl 自己下载的内容，每秒最多一个文件。它不使用您的任何配置文件。

231de63d91e89c9f.source: When it finishes, <g1>Download complete</g1> appears. Click <g2>Open</g2> to open the file, or <g3>Open folder</g3> to see it in Explorer.

Install your distribution's Noto fonts if some scripts or symbols show as boxes.
23201f5f65d0831b.text: <g1>Linux，首次启动缓慢：</g1>DDM 在启动时会一次性查找系统所有脚本的字体（fontconfig）；在繁忙的电脑上首次启动可能需要多几秒钟。如果某些脚本或符号显示为方框，请安装您的发行版的 Noto 字体。

23f0c7a08a4e6d81.source: Torrents: the window no longer freezes while torrents run on a busy or slow disk (an antivirus scanning each write, a disk that is full of other work). The window read each torrent's numbers from the torrent engine on every frame, and the engine holds a torrent while it is paused, removed or added until its writes to the disk have ended, seconds on such a disk; the window waited that long ("freeze in mdm_torrent::Torrents::stats"). The numbers are now read beside the window, five times a second and at once after each change, and the list, the progress window's tabs, <g1>Files...</g1> and the right-click menu show the last ones without waiting (<g2>#693</g2>).
23f0c7a08a4e6d81.text: 种子：当种子在繁忙或缓慢的磁盘上运行（杀毒软件扫描每次写入、磁盘被其他工作占满）时，窗口不再冻结。窗口在每一帧都从种子引擎读取每个种子的数据，而引擎在种子被暂停、移除或添加时会一直占着它，直到写入磁盘结束，这在这样的磁盘上要几秒；窗口就等了那么久（“freeze in mdm_torrent::Torrents::stats”）。现在这些数据在窗口之外读取，每秒五次，每次更改后立即读取，列表、进度窗口的选项卡、<g1>文件...</g1>和右键菜单直接显示最近一次的数据而不再等待（<g2>#693</g2>）。

24b6fe3b0b54eee0.source: The windows are drawn with OpenGL (eframe's glow) or with the system's own graphics API through eframe's wgpu, with that one backend only: Direct3D 12 on Windows (the default there), Vulkan on Linux, Metal on macOS (choices there; OpenGL stays their default until real graphics cards have tried them, #206). View → Draw with picks one, from the next start. One code path does it on every system (<x1/>): when the chosen one can't start, the other one is tried, so the windows always open. A watched start with the system's API leaves a marker until its first frame is drawn: a start that ends before it (a crash inside the driver), one whose first frame doesn't come within 10 seconds (DDM then starts again with OpenGL), or a graphics card lost twice in 10 minutes is remembered with its reason, which the menu shows.
24b6fe3b0b54eee0.text: 窗口使用 OpenGL（eframe 的 glow）或通过 eframe 的 wgpu 使用系统自己的图形 API 绘制，仅使用该后端：Windows 上的 Direct3D 12（默认），Linux 上的 Vulkan，macOS 上的 Metal（这些是选项；OpenGL 仍是它们的默认，直到真正的显卡尝试过它们，#206）。“视图”→“绘制方式”选择一个，从下次启动开始生效。一个代码路径在每个系统上都这样做 (<x1/>)：当选择的无法启动时，会尝试另一个，因此窗口总是能打开。使用系统 API 的受监控启动会在绘制第一帧之前留下标记：如果启动在此之前结束（驱动程序内部崩溃），或者第一帧在 10 秒内未出现（DDM 随后会使用 OpenGL 重新启动），或者显卡在 10 分钟内丢失两次，则会记住其原因，并在菜单中显示。

2508774439912aac.source: No, unless you want it to. While a torrent downloads it trades pieces with other people, as every torrent client does. When it finishes, it stops, like any other download. Turn on Keep sharing torrents after they finish in Options if you'd like to give back.
2508774439912aac.text: 不，除非您希望它继续。在下载种子文件时，它会像所有种子客户端一样与其他用户交换数据块。下载完成后，它会像其他下载一样停止。如果您想回馈，请在“选项”中开启“下载完成后继续共享种子”。

251b2409fae5818c.source: When the browser can't hand a download to DDM, it keeps the download itself, so nothing is lost. The extension's toolbar button then turns grey with a red <g1>!</g1>. Click it: the extension's status page opens, says in a sentence or two what's wrong and the one thing to do, and turns into <g2>Dannex Download Manager is installed</g2> by itself once DDM answers (it asks again every two seconds while it is open). Its <g3>Help</g3> link brings you to the matching section below. You can open it any time: right-click the toolbar button → <g4>Help</g4>.
251b2409fae5818c.text: 当浏览器无法将下载交给 DDM 时，它会自己保留该下载，因此不会丢失任何内容。此时扩展的工具栏按钮会变为带红色<g1>!</g1>的灰色。单击它：扩展的状态页会打开，用一两句话说明出了什么问题以及该做的一件事，并在 DDM 响应后自动变为<g2>Dannex Download Manager 已安装</g2>（页面打开期间，它每两秒再询问一次）。其<g3>帮助</g3>链接会带您转到下方对应的部分。您可以随时打开它：右键单击工具栏按钮 → <g4>帮助</g4>。

252148200aacf78c.source: <g1>Download once</g1> or <g2>Keep finished files</g2> — the queue's kind, shown at the top: the Main download queue lets each finished download go, the Synchronization queue keeps them.
252148200aacf78c.text: <g1>下载一次</g1>或<g2>保留已完成的文件</g2> — 队列的类型，显示在顶部：主下载队列会让每个已完成的下载离开，同步队列则保留它们。

2563ef2a84378fd3.source: DDM goes through the proxy your network needs: the one set in Windows, one you type, a SOCKS proxy or the auto-config script your network gives. Choosing who looks up names comes with version 0.5.
2563ef2a84378fd3.text: DDM 遵循您的网络所需的代理：无论是 Windows 中设置的代理、您手动输入的代理、SOCKS 代理，还是您的网络提供的自动配置脚本。选择名称解析器功能将在 0.5 版本中提供。

258b3fe2653f7ccb.source: The top branches show how many downloads they hold. <g1>View → Hide categories</g1> gives the list the whole window.
258b3fe2653f7ccb.text: 顶部的分支会显示其中包含的下载数量。选择<g1>视图 → 隐藏类别</g1>可让列表占满整个窗口。

259b061fde6fe554.source: File Properties: the file's name, address, folder, size, status and description
259b061fde6fe554.text: 文件属性：文件的名称、地址、文件夹、大小、状态和描述

25bb9b042f030fcd.source: The dividers in the link grabber's and Add torrent's tables
25bb9b042f030fcd.text: 链接抓取器和“添加种子”表格中的分隔线

25c335aaf1d0db4c.text: 主题 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

25d65daee4cae982.source: Browser integration needs one more step in each browser: adding the extension. It comes with DDM, in its <x1/> folder, until the browsers' stores list it (on its way): in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, <g2>Load unpacked</g2> on the browser's extensions page; Firefox takes it as a file. <g3>Browser integration</g3> shows how.
25d65daee4cae982.text: 浏览器集成在每个浏览器中还需要一步：添加扩展。在各浏览器商店上架（即将进行）之前，它随 DDM 一起提供，位于 DDM 的 <x1/> 文件夹中：在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中，在浏览器的扩展页面选择<g2>加载已解压的扩展程序</g2>；Firefox 则以文件形式接收它。<g3>浏览器集成</g3>说明了具体做法。

25e1bb8bef8156e0.source: Every Dannex Download Manager release and what it changed, newest first: new features, fixes and downloads.
25e1bb8bef8156e0.text: Dannex Download Manager 的所有版本及其变更，最新版本在前：新功能、修复和下载。

25e1ffe092788c2a.source: <g1>Download File Info</g1>, the progress window and <g2>Properties</g2> show where a download's server is: its country's flag and name, then the time a round trip to it takes, such as <g3>about 24 ms (near)</g3>.
25e1ffe092788c2a.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>、进度窗口和<g2>属性</g2>会显示下载文件的服务器位置：服务器所在国家的旗帜和名称，然后是往返所需的时间，例如<g3>约 24 毫秒（近）</g3>。

25ee0c7f45fdaa15.source: <g1>The toolbar button</g1> says whether the browser reaches DDM, and <g2>How to fix it</g2> opens the help for the reason. When a setting leaves a download to the browser (its type isn't in <g3>File types</g3>, its site is excluded, it's under the minimum size), the button names the setting and the file, and DDM's log keeps a line for each.
25ee0c7f45fdaa15.text: <g1>工具栏按钮</g1>显示浏览器是否连接到 DDM，点击<g2>如何修复</g2>可查看原因的帮助。当某个设置将下载留给浏览器处理时（文件类型不在<g3>文件类型</g3>中、网站被排除、文件小于最小尺寸），按钮会显示该设置和文件名，DDM 的日志中也会记录每一项。

25fde82581ccbfaf.source: DDM is made by Ahmed Nefzaoui, an independent developer, and is open to contributions from anyone on <g1>GitHub</g1>. Bug reports, translations and code are all welcome.
25fde82581ccbfaf.text: DDM 由独立开发者 Ahmed Nefzaoui 制作，并欢迎<g1>GitHub</g1>上的任何人贡献。欢迎提交错误报告、翻译和代码。

260aedba82916fcb.source: <g1>Not available:</g1> sharing the browser's proxy or VPN, and a download from a form.
260aedba82916fcb.text: <g1>不可用：</g1>共享浏览器的代理或 VPN，以及表单下载。

260fcf826f71e07b.source: Sign in to the site in that browser first. DDM never logs or shows the cookies; the download's log names only the browser they came from.
260fcf826f71e07b.text: 请先在该浏览器中登录网站。DDM 绝不会记录或显示 Cookie；下载日志仅会显示 Cookie 的来源浏览器。

26375161de447b1e.source: Choose <g1>Repeat on</g1> and tick the days, or <g2>Once on</g2> and pick a date.
26375161de447b1e.text: 选择<g1>每周重复于</g1>并勾选日期，或选择<g2>单次于</g2>并选取日期。

2643eafb4fe7ba31.source: The server's country that <g1>Download File Info</g1> and the progress window show comes from a table inside DDM: no address is sent anywhere to look it up.
2643eafb4fe7ba31.text: <g1>下载文件信息</g1>和进度窗口显示的服务器国家/地区来自DDM内部的一个表格：不会向任何地方发送地址来查找它。

2661d3801e38313e.source: A part with no face of its own (an arrow, a column header) under the pointer
2661d3801e38313e.text: 鼠标指向的无独立外观部分（箭头、列标题）

267d1780c2b3aa22.source: The server, <x1/>, sits next to the app on Windows, macOS and Linux (on Linux use the <x2/>, <x3/> or <x4/>: the AppImage doesn't expose it). You turn on the automation API once with <x5/>, then tell your assistant where the server is. The assistant starts it by itself from then on. The <g6>set-up guide</g6> has the path for each kind of install and the exact entry for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code.
267d1780c2b3aa22.text: 服务器 <x1/> 在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上与应用程序并行运行（在 Linux 上使用 <x2/>、<x3/> 或 <x4/>：AppImage 不会暴露它）。您使用 <x5/> 一次性开启自动化 API，然后告诉您的助手服务器在哪里。此后，助手会自行启动它。<g6>设置指南</g6>包含每种安装类型的路径以及 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor 和 VS Code 的确切条目。

26ba7b194ff67f19.source: Some sites' bot checks (Cloudflare's challenge, Akamai's edge) let only a browser through, even after DDM asked once more the way your browser connects. DDM then says <g1>this site lets only browsers through</g1> and offers <g2>Download with the browser</g2>: a button in the download's progress window, and an item in its right-click menu in the list. It's still there after DDM restarts.
26ba7b194ff67f19.text: 有些站点的机器人检查（Cloudflare 的验证、Akamai 的边缘防护）只允许浏览器访问，即使 DDM 已按浏览器的连接方式再请求一次也是如此。此时 DDM 会提示<g1>此站点只允许浏览器访问</g1>，并提供<g2>使用浏览器下载</g2>：下载进度窗口中的一个按钮，以及列表中其右键菜单里的一项。DDM 重启后它仍然存在。

26bde9603b5c3b72.source: DDM downloads videos from their web pages: YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, TikTok, X, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit, SoundCloud and well over a thousand…
26bde9603b5c3b72.text: DDM 可以从网页下载视频，支持 YouTube、Vimeo、Dailymotion、Twitch、TikTok、X、Instagram、Facebook、Reddit、SoundCloud 以及一千多个其他网站…

26d5dca7b7c2e28b.source: <g1>An older DDM?</g1> Update DDM: a newer extension may have an ID an old helper doesn't know.
26d5dca7b7c2e28b.text: <g1>DDM 版本较旧？</g1>请更新 DDM：较新的扩展程序可能使用旧版辅助程序不认识的 ID。

26e4a94f404b8782.source: <g1>A video already in the list is no longer downloaded again without a word:</g1> picking the same quality of the same video, from the menu over a video or the Download video window, now follows Options → Downloads ("If a duplicate download link is added": ask, a numbered name, overwrite, or open / resume the one there). Another quality of the same video is not a duplicate.
26e4a94f404b8782.text: <g1>列表中已有的视频不再被悄悄地重复下载：</g1>从视频上方的菜单或下载视频窗口中再次选择同一视频的同一画质，现在会遵循选项 → 下载（“添加重复下载链接时”：询问、使用带编号的名称、覆盖，或打开 / 恢复已有的那个）。同一视频的另一种画质不算重复。

26e744828e520145.source: The main window in the Breeze theme

26ee23631d3f7d09.source: If an error message quotes something you typed, that text is in the report, so read it before sending.
26ee23631d3f7d09.text: 如果错误消息引用了您输入的内容，该内容也会包含在报告中，因此发送前请先阅读报告。

26f22a074bdc2a27.source: DDM also takes the file types the browser would show or play itself (a PDF, an MP3), when they're listed in <g1>Options → File types</g1> and <g2>Also take files the browser would open</g2> is ticked in <g3>Options → General → Keys...</g3>. This needs a Chromium browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi) version 128 or later, or Firefox. Sites in DDM's excluded sites keep opening them in the browser. Hold <g4>Alt</g4> while clicking a link to leave it to the browser: Firefox then opens it, while Chromium browsers download it themselves (Alt+click is their own "download link").
26f22a074bdc2a27.text: 如果文件类型已列在<g1>选项 → 文件类型</g1>中，并且已在<g2>选项 → 常规 → 按键...</g2>中勾选<g3>也接管浏览器会打开的文件</g3>，DDM 也会接管浏览器通常会显示或播放的文件（如 PDF、MP3）。此功能需要 Chromium 浏览器（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi）128 或更高版本，或 Firefox。DDM 排除的网站仍会在浏览器中打开这些文件。点击链接时按住<g4>Alt</g4>可让浏览器处理：Firefox 会打开文件，而 Chromium 浏览器会自行下载（Alt+点击是它们自带的“下载链接”功能）。

26fb7c72811e759a.source: A video yt-dlp downloads by itself (<g1>How a video comes down</g1>) takes a limit only as it starts: when you turn the limiter on or off, change its settings or the video's own limit, DDM stops it and starts it again with the new limit, and it goes on from where it was (the log says "Stopped: the speed limit changed; starting again with it"). Under the limit for all downloads, such videos share it evenly: when another starts, the ones running with more than their share start again with it; when one ends, the others keep theirs. Image galleries do the same with gallery-dl, which skips the files already saved. Other changes (torrents taking more or less of the limit for all downloads, <g2>Only while I'm using the computer</g2>) apply to the next one that starts.
26fb7c72811e759a.text: yt-dlp 自行下载的视频（<g1>视频下载方式</g1>）只在开始时接受限制：当您打开或关闭限制器、更改其设置或视频本身的限制时，DDM 会停止它并以新限制重新开始，它会从停止的地方继续（日志显示“已停止：速度限制已更改；正在以新限制重新开始”）。在所有下载的总限制下，此类视频会均匀共享：当另一个开始时，那些运行超过其份额的视频会重新开始；当一个结束时，其他视频会保持其份额。图片库使用 gallery-dl 执行相同的操作，它会跳过已保存的文件。其他更改（种子下载占用更多或更少的总下载限制，<g2>仅在我使用计算机时</g2>）适用于下一个开始的下载。

2703f69d017d87af.source: Close a menu or dialog (an open drop-down list first)
2703f69d017d87af.text: 关闭菜单或对话框（如果下拉列表已打开，则先关闭下拉列表）

2705b80bfe01cf3b.text: 点击<g1>应用</g1>，然后点击<g2>关闭</g2>。

2708ec161ff30359.source: the background a step toward the foreground

270e1cc792791539.source: If DDM can't be reached at all (it was uninstalled, or the helper isn't registered), the download stays with the browser, so nothing is lost, and the toolbar button turns grey with a red <g1>!</g1>: a click on it opens the extension's status page, which says what to do. See <g2>The browser and DDM aren't connected</g2>, or run <g3>Options → General → Test browser integration...</g3>.
270e1cc792791539.text: 如果完全无法连接 DDM（它已被卸载，或辅助程序未注册），下载会留在浏览器中，因此不会丢失任何内容，并且工具栏按钮会变为带红色<g1>!</g1>的灰色：单击它会打开扩展的状态页，其中说明该怎么做。请参阅<g2>浏览器与 DDM 未连接</g2>，或运行<g3>选项 → 常规 → 测试浏览器集成...</g3>。

2720f513417e25df.source: <g1>The gallery-dl of your Linux distribution:</g1> the one your distribution ships works too, from 1.20 (Ubuntu 22.04) on. Found on its own, it gets only the options every one of those versions knows; chosen in <g2>Helpers...</g2>, the ones its version knows. One older than that (Debian 11's 1.17) is refused when you choose it, saying which version DDM needs; found on its own, its galleries fail, and <g3>Use DDM's own copy</g3> is the way out.
2720f513417e25df.text: <g1>您的 Linux 发行版中的 gallery-dl：</g1> 您的发行版附带的版本也可以使用，从 1.20 (Ubuntu 22.04) 开始。如果自行找到，它只会获取这些版本都支持的选项；如果在<g2>帮助程序...</g2>中选择，则获取其版本支持的选项。如果版本过旧（Debian 11 的 1.17），当您选择它时会被拒绝，并提示 DDM 需要哪个版本；如果自行找到，其图库下载会失败，此时<g3>使用 DDM 自带的副本</g3>是解决方案。

2725cf19e6ced1be.source: Video pages and image galleries: yt-dlp, gallery-dl and the ffmpeg yt-dlp starts can't be held to an adapter themselves, so while one is chosen DDM gives them a proxy of its own on this computer (<x1/>, with a password only they get). DDM opens their connections through the adapter, as it opens its own, and looks the names up with the DNS you chose. When the adapter disconnects, their connections close and the downloads stop with the others. Video formats that can't go through a proxy (RTMP, RTSP, MMS, FTP) are refused rather than sent around it.
2725cf19e6ced1be.text: 视频页面和图片库：yt-dlp、gallery-dl 以及 yt-dlp 启动的 ffmpeg 本身无法绑定到适配器，因此选择适配器后，DDM 会在此计算机上为它们提供自己的代理（<x1/>，只有它们知道密码）。DDM 会像处理自己的连接一样，通过该适配器为它们建立连接，并使用您选择的 DNS 查询域名。适配器断开连接时，它们的连接会关闭，下载也会和其他下载一起停止。无法通过代理传输的视频格式（RTMP、RTSP、MMS、FTP）会被拒绝，而不会绕过代理发送。

27383ae31617d362.source: <g1>The extension lists the media a page has loaded</g1> (<g2>#38</g2>). The toolbar button's window has <g3>Media on this page</g3>: the HLS and DASH streams the page's players loaded (each once, with its qualities and length) and the video and sound files it played, with their size. <g4>Download</g4> sends a stream to the Download video window and a file to the list, with the page's cookies, the page as the referrer and the browser's User-Agent, so a stream a page won't give up can still be saved. Copy-protected (DRM) streams are listed as <g5>Protected</g5> and never sent. Nothing new to allow: the extension already watched the tab's responses.
27383ae31617d362.text: <g1>扩展会列出页面已加载的媒体</g1>（<g2>#38</g2>）。工具栏按钮的窗口中包含<g3>此页面上的媒体</g3>：页面播放器加载的 HLS 和 DASH 流（每个一次，包含其质量和长度）以及播放的视频和音频文件，并显示其大小。<g4>下载</g4>会将流发送到“下载视频”窗口，将文件发送到列表，并附带页面 Cookie、页面作为引用者和浏览器的 User-Agent，因此即使页面不愿放弃的流也可以保存。受版权保护 (DRM) 的流会列为<g5>受保护</g5>且永不发送。无需允许任何新内容：扩展已在监视选项卡的响应。

273f36b5b385ddc7.source: Linux won't be experimental any more: every change is now checked on a Linux desktop as well as on Windows. GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon were checked window by window: the tray icon and its menu, <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1>, Dark Mode support following the desktop, and the browsers handing downloads over (Ubuntu's Snap Firefox, Google Chrome and Brave). A Wayland session runs DDM through XWayland, so menus open under their titles, on tiling compositors such as sway too. The <x2/> and <x3/> were installed in clean Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora 45 systems and bring everything DDM needs; from the AppImage or the <x4/>, a missing library is named at start with the command that installs it. <g5>Update now</g5> asks the package manager which package DDM is.
273f36b5b385ddc7.text: Linux 版本将不再是实验性的：现在，每次更改都会在 Linux 桌面和 Windows 上进行检查。GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 桌面环境都已逐个窗口检查：包括托盘图标及其菜单、<g1>最小化到通知区域</g1>、跟随桌面主题的深色模式支持，以及浏览器移交下载任务（Ubuntu 的 Snap Firefox、Google Chrome 和 Brave）。Wayland 会话通过 XWayland 运行 DDM，因此菜单会显示在标题下方，即使在 sway 等平铺式合成器上也是如此。<x2/> 和 <x3/> 已安装在纯净的 Ubuntu 24.04、Debian 12 和 Fedora 45 系统中，并包含了 DDM 所需的一切；对于 AppImage 或 <x4/>，如果缺少库，启动时会显示其名称以及安装命令。<g5>立即更新</g5> 会询问包管理器 DDM 属于哪个软件包。

274fe9bbecdf489a.source: Firefox (from addons.mozilla.org), Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi (from the Chrome Web Store), through the DDM browser extension…
274fe9bbecdf489a.text: Firefox（来自 addons.mozilla.org）、Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi（来自 Chrome 网上应用店）可通过 DDM 浏览器扩展程序使用……

276d4f05431a73f3.source: <g1>The automation API's JSON Schema</g1>, <g2>automation-api.schema.json</g2>, made from the code the app answers with. Each download in its list now says why it failed (<x3/>), and the "it is off" answer carries <x4/> for programs to check.
276d4f05431a73f3.text: <g1>自动化 API 的 JSON Schema</g1>，<g2>automation-api.schema.json</g2>，由应用响应的代码生成。其列表中的每个下载现在都会说明失败原因（<x3/>），并且“已关闭”的响应会带有 <x4/> 供程序检查。

276fcec559dad0de.source: <g1>Use passive mode for FTP</g1> — on by default: for FTP downloads DDM opens the data connections itself (passive mode), which works through routers and firewalls. Turn it off only for a server that needs active mode (the server connects back to you). FTP never goes through the proxy above. See <g2>FTP and FTPS</g2>.
276fcec559dad0de.text: <g1>对 FTP 使用被动模式</g1> — 默认开启：对于 FTP 下载，DDM 会自己打开数据连接（被动模式），这样可以穿过路由器和防火墙。仅对需要主动模式的服务器（服务器反过来连接您）才将其关闭。FTP 从不经过上面的代理。请参阅 <g2>FTP 和 FTPS</g2>。

277bf1d7e01a41fc.source: DDM is made by Ahmed Nefzaoui, an independent developer, and is open to contributions from anyone on GitHub. Bug reports, translations and code are all welcome.
277bf1d7e01a41fc.text: DDM 由独立开发者 Ahmed Nefzaoui 制作，并欢迎 GitHub 上的任何人贡献。错误报告、翻译和代码都受到欢迎。

278efae7472c5c89.source: the rare streams in pieces of other kinds (Adobe's HDS, Microsoft's Smooth Streaming), and one whose key the site hands yt-dlp directly.
278efae7472c5c89.text: 其他类型（Adobe 的 HDS、Microsoft 的 Smooth Streaming）的稀有分块流，以及网站直接将密钥交给 yt-dlp 的流。

279fabf85cf86d75.source: Native speakers are very welcome to check and improve a language.
279fabf85cf86d75.text: 欢迎母语人士校对和改进各语言翻译。

27a7f563135e0a3b.source: Site grabber — Dannex Download Manager help
27a7f563135e0a3b.text: 站点抓取器 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

27b845a47422f57c.source: <g1>Launch Dannex Download Manager on startup</g1> — start DDM when you sign in to Windows. It starts in the notification area, its window hidden, with its downloads, queues and Scheduler running; click its icon (or start DDM again) to show the window. On Linux and macOS it starts with your session the same way; where no notification area shows DDM's icon (some Linux desktops), it starts minimized, and the option's tooltip says so. DDM waits for the notification area up to 30 seconds after making its icon, its window hidden, as a desktop's can come up after DDM at sign-in. Off by default. Greyed in a <g2>portable copy</g2>, which writes nothing to the registry.
27b845a47422f57c.text: <g1>启动时运行 Dannex Download Manager</g1> — 在您登录 Windows 时启动 DDM。它会在通知区域启动，窗口隐藏，下载、队列和计划程序都在运行；点击其图标（或再次启动 DDM）以显示窗口。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它以相同方式随会话启动；如果通知区域未显示 DDM 图标（某些 Linux 桌面），它会最小化启动，并且该选项的工具提示会说明这一点。DDM 在创建图标后会等待通知区域最多 30 秒，其窗口隐藏，因为桌面可能在登录时 DDM 之后才出现。默认关闭。在<g2>便携版</g2>中显示为灰色，因为它不会写入注册表。

27be9a365a65b5ef.source: Add links and manage your downloads and queues from your phone, on your own network: <g1>Options → Remote</g1>.
27be9a365a65b5ef.text: 在您自己的网络中，从手机添加链接并管理下载和队列：<g1>选项 → 远程</g1>。

27cc3e16602bb3b6.source: <g1>Source</g1>, <g2>Q</g2> and <g3>Status</g3> offer a few values to tick, such as only <g4>Error</g4> under <g5>Status</g5>, or only <g6>Not in a queue</g6> under <g7>Q</g7>.
27cc3e16602bb3b6.text: <g1>源</g1>、<g2>队列</g2>和<g3>状态</g3>可供选择一些值，例如只显示<g5>状态</g5>为<g4>错误</g4>的项目，或只显示<g7>队列</g7>为<g6>不在队列中</g6>的项目。

27d5718b27436ffe.source: <g1>Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR:</g1> open <x2/>, set <x3/> to <x4/>, then open <x5/>, click the gear, <g6>Install Add-on From File…</g6>, and choose <x7/> in DDM's folder.
27d5718b27436ffe.text: <g1>Firefox Developer Edition、Nightly 或 ESR：</g1>打开 <x2/>，把 <x3/> 设为 <x4/>，再打开 <x5/>，点击齿轮图标，选择<g6>从文件安装附加组件…</g6>，然后选择 DDM 文件夹中的 <x7/>。

281e2c871ace1c1d.source: Not affiliated with Tonec Inc.; Internet Download Manager and IDM are trademarks of their owner, named here only to compare.
281e2c871ace1c1d.text: 与 Tonec Inc. 无关联；Internet Download Manager 和 IDM 是其所有者的商标，此处仅用于比较。

28229ae295418c57.source: Each language has its own catalog in the repository: <x1/>, for example <x2/> for German or <x3/> for Portuguese (Brazil). The codes are listed in <x4/>. Each catalog is a text file with one row per text, in three columns separated by tabs:
28229ae295418c57.text: 存储库中每种语言都有自己的目录：<x1/>，例如德语目录<x2/>或巴西葡萄牙语目录<x3/>。代码列在<x4/>中。每个目录都是一个文本文件，每行对应一条文本，分为由制表符分隔的三列：

2825ed52113e5428.source: Up to 128 connections per file, re-split as they go
2825ed52113e5428.text: 每个文件最多 128 个连接，下载时可重新分配

2826420ef85a1bcf.source: Open <g1>View → Language...</g1>. The same window as on the first start opens: every language by its flag, its own name and its English name. Type in <g2>Search</g2> to narrow the list, then double-click a language or select it and click <g3>OK</g3>. The window switches at once; there is nothing to restart.
2826420ef85a1bcf.text: 打开<g1>视图 → 语言...</g1>。打开的窗口与首次启动时相同，其中每种语言都显示国旗、该语言的名称和英文名称。在<g2>搜索</g2>中输入内容以缩小列表范围，然后双击一种语言，或选择该语言并点击<g3>确定</g3>。界面会立即切换，无需重新启动。

282f9b6ea43027ed.source: Saved beside the video, they get its name and the language: <x1/>. Players such as VLC and MPV pick them up on their own. With ffmpeg they're always SRT; without it, the site's own format (often WebVTT, <x2/>).
282f9b6ea43027ed.text: 字幕文件会保存在视频旁边，文件名与视频相同，并带有语言信息：<x1/>。VLC 和 MPV 等播放器会自动识别字幕。使用 ffmpeg 时，字幕始终为 SRT 格式；不使用 ffmpeg 时，则采用网站提供的格式（通常是 WebVTT，<x2/>）。

28303c1fbe9c6009.source: Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, from their stores

28363ce0cfaf4e8e.source: The browser extension, from the browsers' own stores: the Chrome Web Store's is for Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi too. It also comes with the app and as <g1>its own download</g1>, to add by hand. Every file is built from the public source by GitHub Actions and listed with its SHA-256 checksum.
28363ce0cfaf4e8e.text: 浏览器扩展可从各浏览器自带的商店获取：Chrome 网上应用店中的版本也适用于 Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi。扩展也随应用一同提供，还可<g1>单独下载</g1>并手动添加。每个文件都由 GitHub Actions 根据公开的源代码构建，并附有 SHA-256 校验和。

2841cb0cf79d4ec8.source: Tick <g1>Only while I'm using the computer</g1> to apply it only while you use the mouse or keyboard. After a minute without input, DDM goes back to full speed.
2841cb0cf79d4ec8.text: 勾选<g1>仅在我使用计算机时</g1>，使其仅在您使用鼠标或键盘时生效。在一分钟没有输入后，DDM 会恢复全速。

285bca50f6f03a0a.source: Start Download: the progress window shows it coming in.
285bca50f6f03a0a.text: 开始下载：进度窗口显示文件正在下载。

286a2be607456e48.source: Set <g1>Maximum download speed</g1> in KBytes/sec. The new limit applies at once.
286a2be607456e48.text: 以千字节/秒为单位设置<g1>最大下载速度</g1>。新限制会立即生效。

286f78069efed389.source: <g1>Open with...</g1> (here and in <g2>Download complete</g2>) shows the system's own choice of apps: Windows' <g3>Open with</g3> window, whose <g4>Always</g4> (or <g5>Always use this app</g5>) makes that app the one <g6>Open</g6> uses from then on; on Linux the desktop's <g7>Open With</g7> chooser; on macOS the list of applications. <g8>Open folder</g8> opens the file's folder with the file selected.
286f78069efed389.text: <g1>打开方式...</g1>（此处以及<g2>下载完成</g2>中）会显示系统自己的应用选择：Windows 的<g3>打开方式</g3>窗口，其中的<g4>始终</g4>（或<g5>始终使用此应用</g5>）会让该应用此后成为<g6>打开</g6>所用的应用；在 Linux 上是桌面的<g7>打开方式</g7>选择器；在 macOS 上是应用程序列表。<g8>打开文件夹</g8>会打开文件所在的文件夹并选中该文件。

2879329fef4fb0e5.source: Add a download, with the Address box, Log in to the server and OK
2879329fef4fb0e5.text: 添加下载，含地址框、登录服务器和确定

28aaa598d16d2456.source: <g1>Downloads on a schedule</g1> Queues that start at 2 a.m., stop by 7 and turn the computer off when they're done.
28aaa598d16d2456.text: <g1>定时下载</g1> 设置队列在凌晨 2 点开始、早上 7 点前停止，并在下载完成后关闭电脑。

28b58f9af9a6fed9.source: In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera or Vivaldi
28b58f9af9a6fed9.text: 在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 或 Vivaldi 中

28c08ea95049b5c5.source: The remote control is <g1>off until you turn it on</g1>, it answers <g2>only phones and computers you paired</g2> with a code DDM shows, and it listens <g3>only on your local network</g3> (your Wi-Fi or your cable), never on an address the internet can reach.
28c08ea95049b5c5.text: 远程控制<g1>默认关闭，直到您将其开启</g1>，它<g2>只响应您使用 DDM 显示的代码配对的手机和电脑</g2>，并且<g3>只监听您的本地网络</g3>（您的 Wi-Fi 或有线网络），绝不会监听互联网可访问的地址。

28cacf4987268dd3.source: Run in the notification area: start hidden, hide progress windows — Dannex Download Manager
28cacf4987268dd3.text: 在通知区域运行：隐藏启动，隐藏进度窗口 — Dannex Download Manager

28e5f751e76d336c.text: 不允许在隐私窗口中使用

292621fe40d7beca.source: Every video starts ticked. Untick the ones you don't want, or use <g1>Select all</g1> and <g2>Select none</g2>. Private and deleted videos are greyed out and can't be ticked.
292621fe40d7beca.text: 每个视频默认都已勾选。取消勾选不需要的视频，或使用<g1>全选</g1>和<g2>不选</g2>。私人和已删除的视频会显示为灰色，无法勾选。

296bb6abbc747f28.source: If it gives up and shows <g1>Error</g1>:
296bb6abbc747f28.text: 如果重试失败并显示<g1>错误</g1>：

29746f1ff804cccd.source: <g1>AppImage tools support:</g1> the AppImage can update through them, downloading only what changed.
29746f1ff804cccd.text: <g1>支持 AppImage 工具：</g1> AppImage 可以通过它们进行更新，只下载更改的部分。

297e899a201c87a6.source: <g1>Server</g1> — where the server is: its country's flag and name, and how long a round trip to it takes. See <g2>Where the server is</g2>. It stays blank when the browser handed the download over with its name and size, since DDM didn't need to ask the server.
297e899a201c87a6.text: <g1>服务器</g1> — 服务器的位置：其国家/地区旗帜和名称，以及往返所需时间。请参阅<g2>服务器位置</g2>。当浏览器将下载文件及其名称和大小移交给DDM时，此项会留空，因为DDM无需询问服务器。

298bf4135e080b41.source: <g1>Upload speed for torrents</g1>, next to <g2>Transfer rate</g2> (part of <g3>#357</g3>): what a torrent sends to peers, in bytes per second, blank for anything but a torrent. A layout saved before it gets it between <g4>Transfer rate</g4> and <g5>Peers</g5>.
298bf4135e080b41.text: <g1>种子的上传速度</g1>，位于<g2>传输速率</g2>旁边（<g3>#357</g3> 的一部分）：种子发送给对等方的数据量，以字节/秒为单位，非种子任务为空。在此之前保存的布局将把它置于<g4>传输速率</g4>和<g5>对等方</g5>之间。

299c38ff8ddb0fef.source: File names whose stem is a Windows reserved device name followed by spaces before the dot (<x1/>, <x2/>) are now prefixed with <x3/> (<x4/>), as <x5/> already was (<g6>#655</g6>).
299c38ff8ddb0fef.text: 主文件名是 Windows 保留设备名、其后在点之前带有空格的文件名（<x1/>、<x2/>），现在会加上 <x3/> 前缀（<x4/>），就像 <x5/> 一直以来那样（<g6>#655</g6>）。

29bb3b24660ffc7c.source: DDM uses a lot of memory

29bcd05770e357d4.source: In colour, no badge; the tooltip: <g1>Dannex Download Manager is on. Click to turn it off.</g1>
29bcd05770e357d4.text: 彩色，无徽标；提示：<g1>Dannex Download Manager 已开启。点击以关闭。</g1>

29cc0459c192b39d.source: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, is the main platform. Builds for Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) come with every release too; today's are marked experimental. Linux is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, in Wayland sessions too, and its packages in clean Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora systems. Still to come there: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet, and screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows yet. macOS stays experimental. See <g1>Windows, Mac and Linux</g1> and <g2>Download</g2>.
29cc0459c192b39d.text: Windows 10 和 11（64 位）是主要平台。每次发布也会提供 Linux（AppImage、.deb、.rpm 和 .tar.gz）和 macOS（.dmg）版本；目前这些版本标注为实验性。Linux 已在 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon 上测试过，包括 Wayland 会话，其安装包也已在全新的 Ubuntu、Debian 和 Fedora 系统中测试过。尚待完成的有：Flatpak 版 Firefox 还未测试，屏幕阅读器 (Orca) 还不能朗读 DDM 的窗口。macOS 版仍为实验性。请参阅 <g1>Windows、Mac 和 Linux</g1>和<g2>下载</g2>。

29ce0d34d5fdcde0.source: <g1>Bug reports reach Dannex:</g1> the README, the user guide and the crash report form sent them to the original project's issues; Windows' <g2>Apps</g2> list linked there for support too. They now go to <g3>Dannex's issues</g3>.
29ce0d34d5fdcde0.text: <g1>错误报告会发给 Dannex：</g1>README、用户指南和崩溃报告表单过去把它们发到原项目的问题页；Windows 的<g2>应用</g2>列表也把支持链接指向那里。现在它们发往 <g3>Dannex 的问题页</g3>。

29defde0633295f7.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager vs IDM 6.42</g1><g2>Checked October 2026 · sources below</g2>
29defde0633295f7.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager 对比 IDM 6.42</g1><g2>2026 年 10 月核查 · 来源见下</g2>

29eb5ae7eede6a3d.source: <g1>Don't take downloads from this site</g1>: adds the current site to DDM's excluded sites. A green <g2>✓</g2> shows on the button for a moment.
29eb5ae7eede6a3d.text: <g1>不接管此站点的下载</g1>：将当前站点添加到 DDM 的排除站点。按钮上会短暂显示绿色的<g2>✓</g2>。

2a014824bb4f981c.source: Disabled text, the one grey of every greyed control and label
2a014824bb4f981c.text: 禁用文本，所有灰色控件和标签的灰色

2a367bb5be1ef2a5.source: <g1>Build it from source</g1><g2>cargo build, on Windows, macOS or Linux</g2>
2a367bb5be1ef2a5.text: <g1>从源代码构建</g1><g2>在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上运行 cargo build</g2>

2a4271d8484a5369.source: <g1>Your local network only</g1>: DDM listens on the computer's private addresses, one by one, never on every address at once.
2a4271d8484a5369.text: <g1>仅限本地网络</g1>：DDM 逐一监听计算机的私有地址，绝不会同时监听所有地址。

2a45fadaa534ed11.source: <g1>The volumes of one archive</g1> (<x2/>, <x3/>…, or <x4/>, <x5/>…) form one package named after the archive, as long as they come from the same site.
2a45fadaa534ed11.text: <g1>同一存档的分卷</g1>（<x2/>、<x3/>…，或<x4/>、<x5/>…）来自同一站点时，会组成一个以存档命名的分组。

2a61b9aafcc1f39b.source: The setup asks for its language first, with Windows' own already selected, and DDM starts in the one you pick. A zip copy shows the list on its first start instead: each language with its flag, its own name and its English name. The setup speaks the same languages, and the browser extension speaks your browser's.
2a61b9aafcc1f39b.text: 安装程序会首先询问语言，并已预选 Windows 自身的语言，DDM 将以您选择的语言启动。如果是 zip 压缩包版本，首次启动时会显示语言列表：每种语言都带有其国旗、本地名称和英文名称。安装程序也支持这些语言，浏览器扩展则使用您浏览器的语言。

2a737f9f3c493f67.source: Machine translations in all 85 languages were checked again against the English and corrected.
2a737f9f3c493f67.text: 所有 85 种语言的机器翻译都已根据英文原文重新检查并更正。

2a88270c5adb5b5c.source: When none of this helps, the browser keeps the download, so nothing is lost. The extension's toolbar button turns grey with a red <g1>!</g1>, and a click on it opens its status page, which says why it couldn't reach DDM and what to do; see <g2>The browser and DDM aren't connected</g2>.
2a88270c5adb5b5c.text: 如果以上都无济于事，浏览器会保留该下载，因此不会丢失任何内容。扩展的工具栏按钮会变为带红色<g1>!</g1>的灰色，单击它会打开其状态页，其中说明它为何无法连接 DDM 以及该怎么做；请参阅<g2>浏览器与 DDM 未连接</g2>。

2ab8acec08b25c9a.source: <g1>A server on your computer or your local network</g1> shows as such, with no flag.
2ab8acec08b25c9a.text: <g1>您计算机或本地网络上的服务器</g1>会显示为本地服务器，不带旗帜。

2ae83cc65522b8e0.source: <g1>Lists read as blank items</g1> (<g2>#95</g2>): the rows of Download video's qualities, Add torrent's files, the language picker, Options (browsers, sounds, the file-type and site lists), the Scheduler and Import now have their names (a format and its size, a file's name and size), their check boxes theirs, ticked or not, and their selected row; Download video's list is called Quality, Add torrent's Files and the sounds' Sounds. Choosing a row from a screen reader (UI Automation's Select) now shows the new choice at once: it used to wait for the next mouse move.
2ae83cc65522b8e0.text: <g1>列表项不再显示为空白</g1> (<g2>#95</g2>)：“下载视频”的质量列表、“添加种子”的文件列表、语言选择器、“选项”（浏览器、声音、文件类型和站点列表）、“计划程序”和“导入”的行现在都有其名称（格式和大小、文件名和大小）、其复选框（选中或未选中）以及其选定的行；“下载视频”的列表名为“质量”，“添加种子”的列表名为“文件”，声音列表名为“声音”。现在，从屏幕阅读器中选择一行（UI Automation 的 Select）会立即显示新选择：以前它会等待下一次鼠标移动。

2af84b403d951a41.source: <g1>Control styles.</g1> <x2/> names each control's shape (text boxes, check boxes, buttons, progress bars, scroll bars, the focus mark, the title bar); the style themes (Metro, Adwaita, Breeze, Luna, Aero, Aqua, Emerald) pick theirs, and on Windows DDM then draws the title bar itself (the <x3/> roles).
2af84b403d951a41.text: <g1>控件样式。</g1> <x2/> 命名每个控件的形状（文本框、复选框、按钮、进度条、滚动条、焦点标记、标题栏）；样式主题（现代、Adwaita、Breeze、Luna、Aero、Aqua、翡翠）选择各自的样式，在 Windows 上 DDM 会自行绘制标题栏（<x3/> 角色）。

2b022cf4d9a97412.source: An encrypted archive without its password opens the <g1>Archive password</g1> window. Hover over the download in the list to read what happened: how many files were extracted and where, or why not.
2b022cf4d9a97412.text: 没有密码的加密压缩包会打开<g1>压缩包密码</g1>窗口。将鼠标悬停在列表中的下载任务上，可以查看发生了什么：提取了多少文件、提取到哪里，或者为什么没有提取。

2b15744382efafb3.source: Answers about Dannex Download Manager: is it free, is it safe, how it compares with IDM, browsers, videos, torrents, speed, Mac and Linux, and more.
2b15744382efafb3.text: 关于 Dannex Download Manager 的解答：它是否免费、是否安全、与 IDM 的比较、浏览器、视频、种子、速度、Mac 和 Linux 等。

2b1b4f2777615ee9.source: <g1>Alt</g1> and <g2>F10</g2> open the menu bar while a button or the list has the keyboard focus, not only when nothing does (<g3>#328</g3>).
2b1b4f2777615ee9.text: 当按钮或列表具有键盘焦点时，<g1>Alt</g1> 和 <g2>F10</g2> 可以打开菜单栏，而不仅仅是在没有焦点时（<g3>#328</g3>）。

2b21e9bc73b92a40.source: macOS: <g1>Download video</g1> no longer stops with a Python error and a "Python.framework is damaged" alert on a copy of DDM downloaded by a browser (<g2>#330</g2>, <g3>#339</g3>). DDM now installs yt-dlp's folder build, which it unpacks once and checks against yt-dlp's signed list, instead of the single-program build that unpacks Python afresh at every start. The video window then offers to install it in place of a copy that came with an earlier version.
2b21e9bc73b92a40.text: macOS：通过浏览器下载的 DDM 副本，<g1>下载视频</g1>不再因 Python 错误和“Python.framework 已损坏”警报而停止（<g2>#330</g2>、<g3>#339</g3>）。DDM 现在安装 yt-dlp 的文件夹构建版本，该版本只需解压一次并根据 yt-dlp 的签名列表进行检查，而不是每次启动时都重新解压 Python 的单一程序构建版本。视频窗口随后会提供安装它以替换早期版本附带的副本。

2b3813b1923fc5e3.source: The list covers every display language of Windows 11, including both Chinese scripts, Spanish for Spain and Mexico, French for France and Canada, Portuguese for Portugal and Brazil, and Serbian in Cyrillic and Latin. The <g1>languages page</g1> lists them all.
2b3813b1923fc5e3.text: 此列表涵盖 Windows 11 的所有显示语言，包括两种中文脚本、西班牙语（西班牙和墨西哥）、法语（法国和加拿大）、葡萄牙语（葡萄牙和巴西），以及西里尔字母和拉丁字母的塞尔维亚语。<g1>语言页面</g1>列出了所有这些语言。
