3bca89c3d77cea30.text: 视频上方的按钮。将其拖到边缘；它会停留在您放置的位置。

3bee3aead6a42f28.source: gallery-dl then downloads those its usual way, one a second at most, and skips the pictures DDM has saved.
3bee3aead6a42f28.text: 然后 gallery-dl 按它通常的方式下载这些文件，每秒最多一个，并跳过 DDM 已保存的图片。

3c08b709c92257c2.source: <g1>Pause between requests</g1> and <g2>Requests at once</g2>: how gently it reads the site. The defaults (half a second, two at once) are polite to small sites.
3c08b709c92257c2.text: <g1>请求之间的暂停</g1>和<g2>同时请求数</g2>：读取站点的温和程度。默认值（半秒、同时两个）对小站点比较友好。

3c0c31138b27d1b4.source: A torrent stopped by one of these says so in its event log, and isn't shared again when DDM starts. Raise or turn off the limit to share it again. - <g1>Limit uploading for all torrents to</g1> — off by default. Caps what all your torrents together send to other peers, while they download and while they share. A torrent's own upload limit, in its progress window, applies on top of it. - <g2>Open magnet links and .torrent files with Dannex Download Manager</g2> — Windows then opens magnet links in your browser and <x3/> files in Explorer with DDM. This is for your Windows account only; a program you chose in Windows' <g4>Open with</g4> stays first. The setup can turn it on for you.
3c0c31138b27d1b4.text: 因上述任一原因停止共享的种子会在事件日志中注明，且 DDM 下次启动时不会再次共享。提高或关闭限制即可再次共享。 - <g1>将所有 torrent 的上传限制为</g1> — 默认关闭。限制所有 torrent 在下载和共享期间向其他节点上传的总速度。种子进度窗口中设置的单个种子上传限速也会生效。 - <g2>使用 Dannex Download Manager 打开磁力链接和 .torrent 文件</g2> — 设置后，Windows 会使用 DDM 在浏览器中打开磁力链接，并在资源管理器中打开 <x3/> 文件。此设置仅适用于您的 Windows 账户；您在 Windows 的<g4>打开方式</g4>中选择的程序仍优先使用。安装程序可以为您启用此功能。

3c1845d2fe82536b.source: <g1>Adwaita</g1>, after GNOME's look: round corners, flat grey buttons, a rounded focus ring, boxes that take a ring when focused, GNOME's check boxes and radio buttons, GNOME's Adwaita icons (LGPL-3.0), in colour for files and categories and one colour in the toolbar, and a header bar with the title in bold and round buttons.
3c1845d2fe82536b.text: <g1>Adwaita</g1>：仿照 GNOME 界面风格，采用圆角、扁平灰色按钮、圆形焦点环、获得焦点时带环的方框、GNOME 的复选框和单选按钮，以及 GNOME 的 Adwaita 图标（LGPL-3.0 许可），文件和类别图标为彩色，工具栏图标为单色，标题栏采用粗体标题和圆形按钮。

3c28e85016503a7e.text: 按住 <g1>Ctrl</g1> 并单击，可添加或取消选择一个下载。

3c333ba83ce0943b.source: <g1><g2>Torrents and your security</g2></g1> — what others can see, the network switches, blocklists, proxies.
3c333ba83ce0943b.text: <g1><g2>种子和安全</g2></g1> — 介绍他人可以看到的信息、网络开关、阻止列表和代理。

3c5d7df6746f0752.source: <g1>Download in order</g1> (<g2>#39</g2>): to watch a video while it downloads, tick <g3>Download in order</g3> in <g4>Add torrent</g4>, or choose <g5>Torrent → Download in order</g5> in the list's right-click menu, even while it runs. A file's start comes first, and with <g6>First and last pieces first</g6> (on by default) its end comes early too, which most video files need before they play. Slower peers take pieces a little further on, so the start isn't waiting for them. Other torrents now download the rarest pieces first, as BitTorrent programs usually do: on DDM's test swarms they finished just as fast, and they finished where a scarce piece's only holder left. Torrents already in the list carry on, with nothing checked again. DDM also honours a peer's request to cancel a piece it no longer needs, so its upload isn't spent on data nobody wants.
3c5d7df6746f0752.text: <g1>按顺序下载</g1> (<g2>#39</g2>)：要在视频下载时观看，请在<g3>添加种子</g3>中勾选<g4>按顺序下载</g4>，或者在列表的右键菜单中选择<g5>种子 → 按顺序下载</g5>，即使下载正在进行中也可以。文件开头部分会优先下载，并且勾选<g6>先下载首尾分块</g6>（默认开启）后，文件末尾部分也会提前下载，这是大多数视频文件播放前所必需的。速度较慢的对等点会下载稍远的分块，这样开头部分就不会等待它们。现在，其他种子会优先下载最稀有的分块，就像 BitTorrent 程序通常做的那样：在 DDM 的测试群中，它们完成速度一样快，并且在稀有分块的唯一持有者离开时也能完成。列表中已有的种子会继续下载，无需重新检查。DDM 还会响应对等点取消不再需要的分块的请求，这样上传就不会浪费在没人需要的数据上。

3c613c46735fd836.source: <g1>Category</g1>: the category the downloads are listed under, or <g2>Each by its file type</g2>.
3c613c46735fd836.text: <g1>类别</g1>：下载所列入的类别，或<g2>按文件类型分别归类</g2>。

3c6ad623b5f5dc77.source: DDM starts its torrent engine the first time a torrent needs it. With <g1>Stop the torrent engine when no torrent is running</g1> on (the default), it stops again a minute after no torrent is running or sharing. While it runs, other peers can connect to DDM, and DDM asks your router to forward its port (UPnP). Windows may ask whether to allow DDM through the firewall: allow it on private networks only.
3c6ad623b5f5dc77.text: 种子首次需要种子引擎时，DDM 会启动它。默认情况下，<g1>没有种子运行时停止种子引擎</g1>处于开启状态；没有种子运行或共享 1 分钟后，种子引擎就会停止。种子引擎运行时，其他对等方可以连接到 DDM，DDM 也会要求路由器转发其端口 (UPnP)。Windows 可能会询问是否允许 DDM 通过防火墙：仅允许其在专用网络上通过。

3c6b487078dbdaaa.source: <g1><x2/></g1> — single colour roles (such as <x3/>, <x4/> or <x5/>) on both sides; <g6><x7/></g6> and <g8><x9/></g8> on one side only. A colour is <x10/>, or <x11/> with transparency. The roles a file sets win over its seeds.
3c6b487078dbdaaa.text: <g1><x2/></g1> — 两侧的单一颜色角色（例如<x3/>、<x4/>或<x5/>）；<g6><x7/></g6>和<g8><x9/></g8>仅在一侧。颜色是<x10/>，或带有透明度的<x11/>。文件设置的角色优先于其种子。

3c83bf7ab2f93fb1.source: DDM checks its own downloads too
3c83bf7ab2f93fb1.text: DDM 也会检查自己的下载

3c9dd15fbbf36df8.source: <g1>Server.</g1> The lab server from this repository, on 127.0.0.1, serving generated content. It throttles, delays, refuses or cuts connections per scenario, and logs every request with millisecond start and end times.
3c9dd15fbbf36df8.text: <g1>服务器。</g1> 来自此仓库的实验室服务器，位于 127.0.0.1，提供生成内容。它根据场景限制、延迟、拒绝或中断连接，并记录每个请求的毫秒级开始和结束时间。

3ca810bb301a2ac2.source: <g1>Don't take files smaller than (KB, 0 = any size)</g1> — smaller downloads stay with the browser (a receipt, an icon). 0, the default, takes any size.
3ca810bb301a2ac2.text: <g1>不接管小于以下大小的文件 (KB，0 = 任意大小)</g1> — 较小的下载留给浏览器（收据、图标）。默认值 0 表示接管任意大小。

3cb8e519e26137e2.source: <g1>Help → Check for updates...</g1> tells you whether a newer version is out, and what is new in it. <g2>Check for updates at every start</g2> in that window lets DDM look by itself: a few seconds after it starts, and once a day while it stays open. When there's a new version, its window opens in front.
3cb8e519e26137e2.text: <g1>帮助 → 检查更新...</g1>会告知您是否有新版本，以及新版本有哪些变化。在该窗口中启用<g2>每次启动时检查更新</g2>后，DDM 会自动检查更新：启动几秒钟后检查一次，并在保持运行期间每天检查一次。有新版本时，更新窗口会显示在前台。

3cca55d1adeb4a1b.source: Once it is listed on addons.mozilla.org, <g1>Add to Firefox</g1> on its page installs it for good, and Firefox keeps it updated; Zen and LibreWolf install it from the same page.
3cca55d1adeb4a1b.text: 上架 addons.mozilla.org 之后，在其页面上点击<g1>添加到 Firefox</g1>即可永久安装，Firefox 会保持其更新；Zen 和 LibreWolf 也从同一页面安装。

3cddc2e8bdb0c7da.source: Take downloads off the running app's list: <x1/> keeps their files, <x2/> deletes them too. A running download is paused first (<x3/>).
3cddc2e8bdb0c7da.text: 将下载从运行中的应用列表中移除：<x1/> 保留文件，<x2/> 也删除文件。正在进行的下载会先暂停（<x3/>）。

3cea89afcf542c96.source: <g1>Smoother and quicker to drive:</g1> a list of 10,000 downloads scrolls at the screen's own rate (it managed 23 frames a second), the mouse wheel glides, and an idle window costs almost nothing. <g2>Enter</g2> does what <g3>On Double click</g3> says, <g4>F6</g4> moves between the list and the categories, the categories' arrows open, close and climb branches, and a menu's access key (<g5>Alt+D</g5>) no longer also runs that menu's command.
3cea89afcf542c96.text: <g1>更流畅，操作更快：</g1>含 10,000 个下载的列表按屏幕自身的刷新率滚动（此前只有每秒 23 帧），鼠标滚轮滚动平滑，空闲的窗口几乎不占资源。<g2>Enter</g2> 执行<g3>双击时</g3>所设的操作，<g4>F6</g4> 在列表和类别之间切换，类别的方向键可展开、收起分支并向上进入父级，菜单的访问键（<g5>Alt+D</g5>）也不再同时执行该菜单的命令。

3cff9bb93223a99f.source: The extension is called <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>.

3d4a4f2d1b19754e.source: Can I move my downloads over from IDM?
3d4a4f2d1b19754e.text: 我可以将 IDM 中的下载任务迁移过来吗？

3d67b0a7f32fc0e5.source: The free, open-source IDM alternative. Every connection at once, crash-safe resume, torrents and video in one list.
3d67b0a7f32fc0e5.text: 免费、开源的 IDM 替代品。多个连接同时下载，崩溃后可安全续传，还能在同一个列表中管理种子和视频。

3d686921b4a51711.source: One window for any video page
3d686921b4a51711.text: 一个窗口搞定所有视频页面

3d99fc9d6fbee4aa.source: Then run it, with a folder for its settings and one for the downloads. Make both folders first, as the user DDM will run as: a folder Docker makes for you belongs to <x1/>, and DDM can't use it.
3d99fc9d6fbee4aa.text: 然后运行它，并为其设置和下载分别指定一个文件夹。请先创建这两个文件夹，并确保它们属于 DDM 将运行的用户：Docker 为您创建的文件夹属于 <x1/>，DDM 无法使用它。

3da4888c751f6f68.source: Click <g1>Resume</g1> on the toolbar (or right-click → <g2>Resume Download</g2>).
3da4888c751f6f68.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>恢复</g1>（或右键点击 → <g2>恢复下载</g2>）。

3dae09c1521075dc.source: <g1>Every row of a list, not only those in view</g1> (<g2>#111</g2>): a list's rows out of view (the last qualities of Download video, a long playlist, the downloads) are there too, named, with their place ("12 of 40"), and can be scrolled into view or selected. A list of thousands offers 300 rows around the view, so it stays as fast.
3dae09c1521075dc.text: <g1>列表的每一行，而不仅仅是可见行</g1> (<g2>#111</g2>)：列表的不可见行（下载视频的最后几个质量选项、长播放列表、下载任务）现在也存在，有名称，并显示其位置（“40 个中的第 12 个”），可以滚动到视图中或选中。包含数千行的列表会提供视图周围的 300 行，因此速度保持不变。

3daf04b16daa1b92.source: Open <g1>View → Theme</g1> and click a theme: the whole window changes at once, nothing to restart. <g2>View → Follow the system's dark mode</g2> and <g3>View → Always dark</g3> then choose its light or dark side, as for the classic look (<g4>Dark mode</g4>).
3daf04b16daa1b92.text: 打开<g1>视图 → 主题</g1>并单击某个主题：整个窗口会立即更改，无需重启。<g2>视图 → 跟随系统深色模式</g2>和<g3>视图 → 始终为深色</g3>随后选择其浅色或深色面，与经典外观相同（<g4>深色模式</g4>）。

3db7d59b63e75c78.source: Here's what stays the same, what's better, and what IDM still does that DDM doesn't.
3db7d59b63e75c78.text: 以下是保持不变的、更好的，以及 IDM 仍有而 DDM 没有的功能。

3db8482f7cd4bff5.source: Download File Info and the progress window open in front of the browser.
3db8482f7cd4bff5.text: “下载文件信息”和进度窗口会在浏览器前面打开。

3dcd0da451b1205b.source: What DDM keeps in your home folder stays, as with any package: your list and settings (<x1/>), the AppImage's and the tar.gz's browser files, and those of the browsers that read them only there (Opera, Helium, Thorium, and Firefox's forks: Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp, Waterfox). A package can't remove those: it never touches home folders. Without DDM they lead nowhere, so the extension says it can't reach DDM. To remove them as well, run this as each user who used DDM, <g2>before</g2> uninstalling:
3dcd0da451b1205b.text: DDM 在您的主文件夹中保留的内容会像任何软件包一样保留：您的列表和设置（<x1/>）、AppImage 和 tar.gz 的浏览器文件，以及那些只从此处读取它们的浏览器（Opera、Helium、Thorium 和 Firefox 的分支：Zen、LibreWolf、Floorp、Waterfox）。软件包无法移除这些文件：它从不触及主文件夹。没有 DDM，它们将无处可去，因此扩展会显示无法连接 DDM。要一并移除它们，请在卸载<g2>之前</g2>，以每个使用过 DDM 的用户身份运行以下命令：

3de8df164b01526d.source: Open the add-on's page on addons.mozilla.org, <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>, and click <g2>Add to Firefox</g2>. Zen and LibreWolf use the same page.
3de8df164b01526d.text: 在 addons.mozilla.org 上打开附加组件页面，<g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>，然后点击<g2>添加到 Firefox</g2>。Zen 和 LibreWolf 使用相同的页面。

3dfb9f05f3fcd0b3.source: Windows: dragging a finished file out of <g1>Download complete</g1> (the grip at its bottom right) no longer holds up DDM's windows for as long as the drag lasts, or for as long as the program it is dropped on takes to answer: the drag now runs beside the window, as file dialogs already do (<g2>#561</g2>).
3dfb9f05f3fcd0b3.text: Windows：把已完成的文件从<g1>下载完成</g1>（其右下角的把手）拖出，不再在拖动持续期间、或在接收放下的程序应答期间卡住 DDM 的窗口：拖动现在在窗口之外运行，就像文件对话框已经做到的那样（<g2>#561</g2>）。

3dfd74b1990e5a43.source: The torrent engine is written in Rust, and every piece is checked against the torrent's fingerprint, so a peer can't slip in altered data.
3dfd74b1990e5a43.text: 种子引擎使用 Rust 编写，每个分块都会根据种子的指纹进行检查，因此对等点无法植入篡改过的数据。

3e093a790c11da8f.source: Type in <g1>Filter</g1> to show only the files whose name or address contains it. <g2>Select all</g2> and <g3>Select none</g3> tick or untick the files shown.
3e093a790c11da8f.text: 在<g1>筛选</g1>中输入内容，只显示名称或地址包含它的文件。<g2>全选</g2>和<g3>不选</g3>会勾选或取消勾选当前显示的文件。

3e4175d77459c06a.source: Click a column title to sort: <g1>Added</g1> for the newest, <g2>Size</g2> for the biggest, <g3>File Name</g3> for A to Z. Click again to reverse.
3e4175d77459c06a.text: 点击列标题进行排序：点击 <g1>添加时间</g1> 可按最新添加的任务排序，点击 <g2>大小</g2> 可按文件大小排序，点击 <g3>文件名</g3> 可按 A 到 Z 排序。再次点击可反向排序。

3e55e9b0929671e4.source: Yes. When a video has subtitles, the Subtitles list in the video window offers them: the uploader's languages and the site's automatic captions. They're saved beside the video as an .srt file, or put inside it with Put them into the video. See Subtitles.
3e55e9b0929671e4.text: 是。如果视频有字幕，视频窗口中的“字幕”列表会提供它们：上传者提供的语言和网站的自动字幕。它们会作为 .srt 文件保存在视频旁边，或者通过“将它们放入视频”选项嵌入视频中。请参阅“字幕”。

3e6e10c300b6b5ce.text: 限制所有下载的总速度

3e702f2065a82199.source: The download list — Dannex Download Manager help
3e702f2065a82199.text: 下载列表 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

3e9e6b7b10d78723.source: <g1>Start</g1> adds the ticked links to the <g2>Main download queue</g2> and starts the queue. It downloads as many files at once as the queue allows.
3e9e6b7b10d78723.text: <g1>开始</g1>会将勾选的链接添加到<g2>主下载队列</g2>并启动队列。队列会同时下载其允许数量的文件。

3ea1a57611279a61.source: Make sure the computer doesn't go to sleep before the start time.
3ea1a57611279a61.text: 确保计算机在开始时间之前不会进入睡眠状态。

3eb0ed57661bd9ce.source: In <g1>Save General files to</g1>, click <g2>Browse</g2> and choose a folder on the stick, for example <x3/>.
3eb0ed57661bd9ce.text: 在<g1>将常规文件保存到</g1>中，单击<g2>浏览</g2>并选择 U 盘上的文件夹，例如 <x3/>。

3eb3ecdcc3df0e7f.source: <g1>Customize DDM menu items in context menu of browsers → Edit...</g1> — which of DDM's five commands the browser's right-click menu shows (Download with DDM, selected links, all links, all images, all videos and audio). A browser changes its menu when you next switch to it.
3eb3ecdcc3df0e7f.text: <g1>自定义浏览器上下文菜单中的 DDM 菜单项 → 编辑...</g1> — 浏览器右键菜单显示 DDM 五条命令中的哪几条（使用 DDM 下载、选定链接、所有链接、所有图像、所有视频和音频）。下次切换到浏览器时，其菜单才会更改。

3eb7699d711521ad.source: <g1>Continue</g1> (when the last run stopped early) explores further, from where it stopped.
3eb7699d711521ad.text: <g1>继续</g1>（当上次运行提前停止时）会从停止处进一步探索。

3ec9646a8bee65e6.source: DDM doesn't do this alone, and doesn't pretend to. <g1>yt-dlp</g1> reads the page and downloads the video. <g2>ffmpeg</g2> joins the picture and the sound when a site keeps them apart, which most sites do for their higher qualities. DDM offers both on its first start and downloads them from their official releases, checked against what their publishers sign before it uses them. On Linux and macOS DDM uses the system's ffmpeg.
3ec9646a8bee65e6.text: DDM 并非独立完成此功能，也从未声称如此。<g1>yt-dlp</g1>负责读取页面并下载视频。<g2>ffmpeg</g2>负责将视频和音频合并，因为大多数网站为了提供更高画质，会将它们分开。DDM 在首次启动时会提供这两个程序，并从其官方发布渠道下载，在使用前会检查发布者签名。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 使用系统自带的 ffmpeg。

3ed855fe34869c20.source: <g1>PDFs, music and videos the browser would open itself are taken too</g1>, when their type is in <g2>Options → File types</g2> (<g3>Options → General → Keys...</g3> turns it off). Hold <g4>Alt</g4> while clicking a link to let the browser have it.
3ed855fe34869c20.text: <g1>浏览器会自行打开的 PDF、音乐和视频也会被接管</g1>，如果它们的类型在<g2>选项 → 文件类型</g2>中（<g3>选项 → 常规 → 按键...</g3>可以关闭此功能）。在点击链接时按住<g4>Alt</g4>键，让浏览器处理它。

3ee3f6088b3f3e5a.source: <g1>Breeze</g1>, after KDE Plasma's look: rounded corners, buttons and boxes whose edge takes the accent under the pointer or when focused, KDE's check boxes and radio buttons (the accent's edge, a tick in the text's colour), a focus frame, KDE's Breeze icons (LGPL-3.0-or-later) and a title bar in KDE's style: the title centred, round buttons that fill under the pointer (Close in red).
3ee3f6088b3f3e5a.text: <g1>Breeze</g1>：仿照 KDE Plasma 界面风格，采用圆角、指针悬停或获得焦点时边缘显示强调色的按钮和方框、KDE 的复选框和单选按钮（强调色边缘，文本颜色勾选）、焦点框、KDE 的 Breeze 图标（LGPL-3.0-or-later 许可），以及 KDE 风格的标题栏：标题居中，圆形按钮在指针悬停时填充（“关闭”按钮为红色）。

3eecfb0197709190.source: Download image galleries with gallery-dl — Dannex Download Manager
3eecfb0197709190.text: 使用 gallery-dl 下载图片库 — Dannex Download Manager

3ef37a86dccb8010.source: X (Twitter) videos sent from the browser's media list are named after the tab, not the random name of their file on X's video server (<g1>#493</g1>).
3ef37a86dccb8010.text: 从浏览器的媒体列表发送的 X (Twitter) 视频，现在以标签页命名，而不是用其在 X 视频服务器上的随机文件名（<g1>#493</g1>）。

3f2b96cbf359bd4a.source: The volumes of one split archive (<x1/>, <x2/> and so on) form one package, the other links of a page another, and the rest go into <g3>Various files</g3>. Tick a package to take all its links. Each package has its own folder, an archive password, and <g4>Extract when done</g4>.
3f2b96cbf359bd4a.text: 一个分卷压缩包（<x1/>、<x2/>等）形成一个包，页面上的其他链接形成另一个包，其余的则归入<g3>各种文件</g3>。勾选一个包即可选择其所有链接。每个包都有自己的文件夹、压缩包密码和<g4>完成后提取</g4>选项。

3f2c9d41aae4d8b5.source: Last updated {v1} · applies to the app, the browser extension and dannex.kavangi.co.ke
3f2c9d41aae4d8b5.text: 最后更新：{v1} · 适用于应用、浏览器扩展和 dannex.kavangi.co.ke

3f2e32c284681794.source: If Windows says <g1>Windows protected your PC</g1>, click <g2>More info</g2>, check that the file is <x3/> from the <g4>Releases</g4> page, then click <g5>Run anyway</g5>.
3f2e32c284681794.text: 如果 Windows 提示<g1>Windows 已保护你的电脑</g1>，请点击<g2>更多信息</g2>，确认文件<x3/>来自<g4>发布</g4>页面，然后点击<g5>仍要运行</g5>。

3f308b452e797bc8.source: Proxy settings in Dannex Download Manager: the system's proxy, a manual HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy, PAC scripts, and soon a DNS of your choice over HTTPS or TLS.
3f308b452e797bc8.text: Dannex Download Manager 中的代理设置：系统代理、手动 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 代理、PAC 脚本，以及即将推出的通过 HTTPS 或 TLS 的自定义 DNS。

3f42f44fd24912f6.source: Paste the address, get the pictures

3f4905b4bebc75fb.source: Selected text's ink in egui's boxes
3f4905b4bebc75fb.text: egui 框中选中文字的颜色

3f6b5f565fcff0f8.source: Put downloads in a queue and let the Scheduler start them when nobody needs the connection. When the queue is done, DDM can quit or turn the computer off.
3f6b5f565fcff0f8.text: 将下载任务放入队列，让计划程序在网络空闲时启动它们。队列完成后，DDM 可以退出或关闭计算机。

3f82daa5575a7af3.source: Type in <g1>Filter</g1> to show only the files whose name or address contains it, and choose a <g2>Type</g2> to show only the pictures, the documents, the pages and so on. <g3>Larger than</g3> and <g4>Smaller than</g4> (in KB) show only the files of those sizes, to leave out thumbnails say; a file whose size isn't known is always shown. <g5>Select all</g5> and <g6>Select none</g6> tick or untick the files shown.
3f82daa5575a7af3.text: 在<g1>筛选</g1>中输入内容，可仅显示名称或地址包含它的文件；选择<g2>类型</g2>可仅显示图片、文档、页面等。<g3>大于</g3>和<g4>小于</g4>（以 KB 为单位）仅显示这些大小的文件，例如用来排除缩略图；大小未知的文件始终显示。<g5>全选</g5>和<g6>不选</g6>会勾选或取消勾选所显示的文件。

3f86fde89f3656cf.source: Not held to the adapter yet, so they don't start while one is chosen: <x1/> (implicit TLS; <x2/> with TLS is fine).
3f86fde89f3656cf.text: 目前无法绑定到适配器，因此选择适配器后不会启动：<x1/>（隐式 TLS；带 TLS 的 <x2/> 可以正常使用）。

3f9ed7e1555038fc.source: DDM comes with an MCP server, dannexdownloadmanager-mcp, so an AI assistant that supports MCP (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and others) can…
3f9ed7e1555038fc.text: DDM 附带一个 MCP 服务器 dannexdownloadmanager-mcp，因此支持 MCP 的 AI 助手（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 及其他）可以…

3fa29fd2fc071d7b.source: A 256 KiB file. DDM is done in 30 ms; IDM is still starting.
3fa29fd2fc071d7b.text: 一个 256 KiB 的文件。DDM 在 30 毫秒内完成；IDM 仍在启动。

3fa6b840f06b8470.source: Options: Remote, with the address to open, the certificate's fingerprint and the paired devices
3fa6b840f06b8470.text: 选项：远程，包含要打开的地址、证书指纹和已配对设备

3fa8036373b9b833.source: The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn before the first start. Code signing will be added.
3fa8036373b9b833.text: Windows 安装程序尚未进行代码签名，因此首次启动前 Windows SmartScreen 可能会发出警告。之后会添加代码签名。

3fab3621d5ce1a78.text: 仅减慢一个下载的速度

3facb59aa77fa716.source: Dannex Download Manager's command line: IDM's /d /p /f /a /n /s switches, a terminal downloader with --json, and a local automation API.
3facb59aa77fa716.text: Dannex Download Manager 命令行：支持 IDM 的 /d /p /f /a /n /s 参数，带 --json 的终端下载器，以及本地自动化 API。

3fb5d477ceacf22f.source: DDM's support was built from each service's public documentation and is not yet confirmed with a real paid account. If something doesn't work with yours, please open an issue on GitHub, and never paste your token or key in it.
3fb5d477ceacf22f.text: DDM 的支持是根据每个服务的公开文档构建的，尚未通过真实的付费账户确认。如果您的账户出现问题，请在 GitHub 上提交问题，切勿在其中粘贴您的令牌或密钥。

3fc06084796b2204.source: <g1>If a duplicate download link is added</g1> — ask, add it with a numbered name, overwrite the old one, or open the finished one / resume the unfinished one.
3fc06084796b2204.text: <g1>添加重复的下载链接时</g1> — 询问要执行哪种操作：以带编号的名称添加、覆盖旧文件，或打开已完成的文件/恢复未完成的文件。

3fd2d9b9a2e2d4f7.source: Queue big files during the day and let DDM download them at night, when nobody needs the connection. It can turn the computer off when it is done.
3fd2d9b9a2e2d4f7.text: 白天将大文件加入队列，让 DDM 在晚上（没人需要网络连接时）下载。完成后，它还可以关闭计算机。

3fff690a552a2c10.source: Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser: each browser found, with a button to its store page
3fff690a552a2c10.text: 将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器：找到的每个浏览器，带有一个指向其商店页面的按钮

3fffdf3df5ac8800.source: To stop in the morning whatever is left, tick <g1>Stop at</g1> and set a time, for example 7:00:00 AM.
3fffdf3df5ac8800.text: 若要在早晨停止所有剩余的下载，请勾选<g1>停止于</g1>并设置时间，例如早上 7:00:00。

402a8a8f040cf6ec.source: In Chrome, Edge and Brave you can limit an extension to some sites (right-click its toolbar button → <g1>This can read and change site data</g1>). On a site it may not read, the extension can't pass your sign-in on, so it leaves the download to the browser. Choose <g2>On all sites</g2> to let DDM take downloads everywhere.
402a8a8f040cf6ec.text: 在 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 中，您可以限制扩展程序只能访问部分网站（右键点击工具栏上的扩展程序按钮 → <g1>此扩展程序可以读取和更改网站数据</g1>）。在扩展程序无法读取的网站上，它无法传递您的登录信息，因此会让浏览器处理下载。选择<g2>在所有网站上</g2>，即可让 DDM 接管所有网站的下载。

402fd2cf6aa900d5.source: An editable drop-down's arrow zone pressed or open
402fd2cf6aa900d5.text: 可编辑下拉框箭头区域被按下或打开时

40381e64ad055deb.source: <g1>from the button over them</g1>: the button's cookies reached the Download video window's look-up but not the download's own, which then failed with "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot";
40381e64ad055deb.text: <g1>通过视频上方的按钮</g1>：按钮的 Cookie 达到了“下载视频”窗口的查询，但未达到下载本身的查询，导致下载失败并显示“请登录以确认您不是机器人”；

403892baaaac323f.source: The progress window of a video whose size isn't known says no percentage (it read 0 % in the title and 0.00 % on the Downloaded line), and <g1>File size</g1> stays the file's size at the end (it read 0.1 % too high while yt-dlp finished).
403892baaaac323f.text: 大小未知的视频，其进度窗口不再显示百分比（标题中曾显示 0%，已下载一行曾显示 0.00%），并且<g1>文件大小</g1>在结束时保持为文件的实际大小（yt-dlp 收尾时曾偏高 0.1%）。

4043f232dfbdf98e.source: DDM checks the account and shows its name and whether it is premium. <g1>OK</g1> keeps it.
4043f232dfbdf98e.text: DDM 会检查帐户，并显示帐户名称及是否为高级帐户。点击<g1>确定</g1>即可保存。

40633c27b9a902b5.source: The main window in Arabic: the menus, toolbar and categories run from right to left.
40633c27b9a902b5.text: 阿拉伯语主窗口：菜单、工具栏和类别均从右到左排列。

406376ea6db241ce.source: Did you click <g1>Apply</g1> after setting the time?
406376ea6db241ce.text: 设置时间后，是否点击了<g1>应用</g1>？

4065d823f7a0f8c0.source: Every download and the total speed: <x1/>. <x2/> is <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/> or <x7/>; <x8/> is <x9/> while unknown; <x10/> (why it failed) is there only for a download in <x11/>; <x12/> is a category's <x13/>; <x14/> is the free space where downloads go (<x15/> when unknown). Only while the API is on.
4065d823f7a0f8c0.text: 每个下载和总速度：<x1/>。<x2/> 是 <x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/> 或 <x7/>；<x8/> 在未知时是 <x9/>；<x10/>（失败原因）仅在下载处于 <x11/> 状态时存在；<x12/> 是类别的 <x13/>；<x14/> 是下载存储的可用空间（未知时为 <x15/>）。仅在 API 开启时可用。

406b2e903a2cd3fd.source: <g1>The last download couldn't go to Dannex Download Manager</g1>, and <g2>Try again</g2>
406b2e903a2cd3fd.text: <g1>上次的下载无法发送到 Dannex Download Manager</g1>，以及<g2>重试</g2>

40823e925d252a27.source: Sites behind Akamai that let only browsers through (a 403 "Access Denied" page for DDM, the file for a browser, such as HPE's documentation PDFs) now download: DDM takes Akamai's refusal for the bot check it is and tries again the way a browser connects, as it does for Cloudflare's (<g1>#771</g1>).
40823e925d252a27.text: 位于 Akamai 之后、只允许浏览器访问的站点（DDM 得到 403“Access Denied”页面，浏览器却能得到文件，例如 HPE 的文档 PDF）现在可以下载：DDM 把 Akamai 的拒绝识别为机器人检查，并像对待 Cloudflare 的那样，按浏览器的连接方式重试（<g1>#771</g1>）。

4087eca64b1e9c7f.text: 更多内容请参阅<g1>连接和速度</g1>。

40a1f31ae2a6c453.source: Crash and freeze reports you read before you send — Dannex Download Manager
40a1f31ae2a6c453.text: 发送前可阅读的崩溃和冻结报告 — Dannex Download Manager

40a26ac3ae7dcbbc.source: If the link has expired (common for links from sites you sign in to, or links with a time limit in them), get a new one: right-click → <g1>Refresh download address</g1>. See <g2>Resume a broken download</g2>.
40a26ac3ae7dcbbc.text: 如果链接已过期（登录后才能访问的网站链接或带有时限的链接常会过期），请获取新链接：右键点击 → <g1>刷新下载地址</g1>。另请参阅<g2>恢复中断的下载</g2>。

40ae9f6f34dade5c.text: 选择<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 设置...</g1>。

40b300c66a605f82.source: In the Scheduler's time and date boxes, <g1>Up</g1> / <g2>Down</g2> and the number keys change the selected part, and <g3>Left</g3> / <g4>Right</g4> move between parts. In the calendar, the arrows move a day or a week, <g5>Page Up</g5> / <g6>Page Down</g6> a month, and <g7>Enter</g7> picks the day.
40b300c66a605f82.text: 在计划程序的日期和时间框中，<g1>向上</g1> / <g2>向下</g2>键和数字键可更改选定部分，<g3>向左</g3> / <g4>向右</g4>键可在各部分之间移动。在日历中，箭头键可移动一天或一周，<g5>Page Up</g5> / <g6>Page Down</g6>键可移动一个月，<g7>Enter</g7>键可选择日期。

40b46adc61bd2f95.source: Tick Also delete the file from disk only if you want the file gone too.
40b46adc61bd2f95.text: 仅当您也想删除文件时，才勾选同时从磁盘中删除文件。

40b67e7837545823.source: Download a gallery's pictures (a Wikimedia Commons category, a Flickr album, ...) into a folder named after it inside <x1/>: gallery-dl lists them, DDM's downloader brings them in, <x2/> at once (8 by default, as <x3/>'s connections); <x4/> takes at most that many, the first the site lists. Started again, it fetches only the new ones. <x5/> sends its connections, and gallery-dl's, through one network adapter, as for <x6/>.
40b67e7837545823.text: 把图库的图片（Wikimedia Commons 分类、Flickr 相册等）下载到 <x1/> 内以图库命名的文件夹中：gallery-dl 列出它们，DDM 的下载器把它们取回，同时下载 <x2/>（默认 8，与 <x3/> 的连接数相同）；<x4/> 最多取这么多，即站点列出的前几个。再次启动时，只获取新增的图片。<x5/> 通过同一个网络适配器发送它的连接和 gallery-dl 的连接，与 <x6/> 相同。

40c721d28a572fcf.source: The bar at the top shows the total speed and the free space where your downloads go.
40c721d28a572fcf.text: 顶部栏显示总速度和下载目标位置的可用空间。

40cf609cd66a0051.source: On Windows, DDM must be installed with the setup, with <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> ticked. It is ticked by default. If you're not sure, run the setup again. A portable copy can't do this. On Linux and macOS, start DDM once: it sets browser integration up itself.
40cf609cd66a0051.text: 在 Windows 上，DDM 必须通过安装程序安装，并勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Firefox）</g1>。此选项默认勾选。如果您不确定，请再次运行安装程序。便携版无法执行此操作。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，启动 DDM 一次即可：它会自动设置浏览器集成。

40d45b50d2257bd9.source: The command line runs in the app's own program, so the download engine ships once. Every command, <x1/>, Ctrl+C and exit code work as before.
40d45b50d2257bd9.text: 命令行在应用程序自己的程序中运行，因此下载引擎只需打包一次。所有命令、<x1/>、Ctrl+C 和退出代码都与以前一样。

40d582d636a59fc5.source: <g1>Start Dannex Download Manager with the computer</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> is greyed: starting with Windows needs the registry.
40d582d636a59fc5.text: <g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中的<g1>随计算机启动 Dannex Download Manager</g1>显示为灰色：随 Windows 启动需要注册表。

40dc8191b16ed145.source: Eight per download by default, and up to 32 if you choose in Options → Connection, or 128 after ticking Allow more than 32 connections there. DDM uses fewer…
40dc8191b16ed145.text: 默认情况下，每个下载使用八个连接。如果您在选项 → 连接中选择，最多可达32个；勾选允许超过32个连接后，可达128个。当服务器允许的连接数较少时，DDM会使用较少的连接…

40dfdd7492287dec.source: <g1>A cut file name's full text shows at the pointer</g1>, not under the list.
40dfdd7492287dec.text: <g1>将指针悬停在被截断的文件名上时，会显示完整名称</g1>，而不是在列表下方显示。

40fe836f1ec8f4d4.source: Eight per download by default, and up to 32 if you choose in Options → Connection, or 128 after ticking Allow more than 32 connections there. DDM uses fewer when a server allows fewer, and only one when a server can't send parts of a file at all.
40fe836f1ec8f4d4.text: 默认情况下，每个下载使用八个连接。如果您在选项 → 连接中选择，最多可达32个；勾选允许超过32个连接后，可达128个。当服务器允许的连接数较少时，DDM会使用较少的连接；当服务器完全无法发送文件分段时，DDM只使用一个连接。

410849c6c11c33d7.source: DDM is free and always will be. If it saves you time, you can support it.
410849c6c11c33d7.text: DDM 是免费的，并将一直免费。如果它为您节省了时间，您可以支持它。

412118ea0605f457.source: Many sites publish a checksum next to the download. Right-click the download, choose <g1>Verify checksum...</g1> and paste it. DDM reads MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and CRC32. A finished file is checked at once; an unfinished one is checked when its download ends. DDM then says <g2>The file matches</g2> or <g3>The file does NOT match</g3>.
412118ea0605f457.text: 许多网站会在下载链接旁提供校验和。右键单击下载，选择<g1>验证校验和...</g1>，然后粘贴校验和。DDM 支持 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 和 CRC32。已完成的文件会立即进行校验；未完成的文件会在下载结束后进行校验。随后，DDM 会显示<g2>文件匹配</g2>或<g3>文件不匹配</g3>。

412f3b0d34ccb320.source: Choose <g1>Tasks → Add batch download</g1> and write the address with one asterisk where the files differ: <x2/>. Under <g3>Fill the * with</g3>, choose <g4>Numbers</g4> or <g5>Letters</g5>, then <g6>From</g6> and <g7>To</g7>. For numbers, <g8>Digits</g8> sets the number of digits: with 3, the files are <x9/>, <x10/> and so on.
412f3b0d34ccb320.text: 选择<g1>任务 → 添加批量下载</g1>，并在文件不同的位置写一个星号：<x2/>。在<g3>* 替换为</g3>下，选择<g4>数字</g4>或<g5>字母</g5>，然后设置<g6>从</g6>和<g7>到</g7>。对于数字，<g8>位数</g8>用于设置数字的位数：设为 3 时，文件为 <x9/>、<x10/>，依此类推。

41333ec069d15e15.source: A magnet link takes a long time
41333ec069d15e15.text: 磁力链接需要很长时间

414b01109dbf5aca.source: Tick <g1>Remember Speed Limiter settings for this file on download stop/resume</g1> to keep this limit for the file: it applies again when you resume it later, even after restarting DDM.
414b01109dbf5aca.text: 勾选<g1>记住此文件的限速器设置</g1>，以便在停止或恢复下载时保留此文件的限速设置。之后恢复下载时，即使重启过 DDM，此限制也会再次生效。

41513dfc4f8ecfc6.source: <g1>Release builds:</g1> the macOS build runs again, and the IP-to-country table that shows where a server is is refreshed with each release again.
41513dfc4f8ecfc6.text: <g1>发布构建：</g1>macOS 版本可以再次运行，用于显示服务器所在国家或地区的 IP 到国家对照表，也再次随每个版本更新。

415f7ef389135eab.source: In Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur the whole window is mirrored, the way Windows does it for these languages. File names, addresses and folder paths keep their own direction inside translated sentences, so they stay readable. DDM uses the system's own fonts for every script.
415f7ef389135eab.text: 在阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语中，整个窗口会像 Windows 对这些语言的处理方式一样进行镜像显示。文件名、地址和文件夹路径在翻译后的句子中会保持其自身方向，以确保可读性。DDM 为每种文字都使用系统自带的字体。

4160d55635d3e362.source: Freeze reports that tell the kind of freeze
4160d55635d3e362.text: 显示冻结类型的冻结报告

4171c591cc5de164.source: A menu's and a popup's frame
4171c591cc5de164.text: 菜单和弹出窗口的边框

418a57e1f6e0ae58.source: Yes: ftp://, and FTP over TLS both ways (ftpes:// and ftps://), with several connections at once, resume, and logins from the address or from Sites Logins.…
418a57e1f6e0ae58.text: 是：ftp://，以及双向的 FTP over TLS（ftpes:// 和 ftps://），支持同时进行多个连接、续传，并可从地址或“站点登录”中获取登录信息。

41a4ff4df4d76364.source: Install DDM with the setup and keep Set up browser integration ticked. In Firefox, then open the add-on's page on addons.mozilla.org and click Add to…
41a4ff4df4d76364.text: 使用安装程序安装 DDM，并保持勾选“设置浏览器集成”。然后在 Firefox 中打开 addons.mozilla.org 上的附加组件页面，点击“添加到…”。

41b21e6f6cf70f57.source: <g1>Drag on blank space</g1> to draw a box around downloads.

41bfc577681596c9.source: Dannex Download Manager: the download manager you already know, rebuilt to be faster
41bfc577681596c9.text: Dannex Download Manager：您已熟悉的下载管理器，经过重新构建，速度更快

41d58fdb5c4f98df.source: A row with a <x1/> line above it was translated by machine. When you have checked it (and corrected it if needed), delete that <x2/> line. From then on the row is yours: machine translation never replaces it, and a check on every pull request makes sure no change drops it or marks it machine again.
41d58fdb5c4f98df.text: 上方有 <x1/> 线的行是由机器翻译的。当您检查并（如果需要）更正后，请删除该 <x2/> 线。从那时起，该行就属于您了：机器翻译绝不会替换它，并且每次拉取请求都会进行检查，以确保不会有任何更改将其删除或再次标记为机器翻译。

41e44a8bcf27e42b.source: In IDM, export your list as an <x1/> file (its <g2>Tasks → Export</g2> menu). In DDM, choose <g3>Tasks → Import → From an IDM list (.ef2)</g3> and pick that file. Each download comes over with its address, the page it came from (its referrer) and its cookies. The downloads join the <g4>Main download queue</g4>, ready to start.
41e44a8bcf27e42b.text: 在 IDM 中，将列表导出为 <x1/> 文件（其<g2>任务 → 导出</g2>菜单）。在 DDM 中，选择<g3>任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 列表 (.ef2)</g3>并选取该文件。每个下载都会连同其地址、来源页面（即引用页）和 Cookie 一起导入。这些下载会加入<g4>主下载队列</g4>，随时可以开始。

41eaa021513bb2bc.source: One cap for all of DDM

41f96a7bd5c225fc.source: <g1>A menu shut with Escape opens again at the first click on its title</g1>: a menu opened from the menu bar and shut with Escape, the pointer still on its title, was left marked open. On Linux the next click on that title only "shut" it, and a second click was needed; on Windows Escape seemed to do nothing (the menu came back at once). Escape, or DDM losing the focus, now shuts the menu whatever the pointer rests on; a press on a title still shuts its own menu or opens another.
41f96a7bd5c225fc.text: <g1>用 Esc 关闭的菜单在第一次点击其标题时会再次打开</g1>：从菜单栏打开并用 Esc 关闭的菜单，如果指针仍在其标题上，则会被标记为打开状态。在 Linux 上，下次点击该标题只会“关闭”它，需要第二次点击才能打开；在 Windows 上，Esc 似乎什么也没做（菜单立即返回）。现在，Esc 或 DDM 失去焦点都会关闭菜单，无论指针停留在何处；点击标题仍然会关闭其自身的菜单或打开另一个菜单。

420ddd33b4ea0c12.source: The extension is newer than DDM
420ddd33b4ea0c12.text: 扩展程序版本比 DDM 新

420fd4269607a080.source: Pick a quality, then Download Now.
420fd4269607a080.text: 选择画质，然后点击“立即下载”。

422aa11244ee2545.source: Torrents' trackers on this computer or the local network aren't contacted, and a <x1/> file over 10 MB isn't read (it isn't one). Peers see DDM's major version only.
422aa11244ee2545.text: 不会联系此计算机或本地网络上的洪流跟踪器，并且不会读取超过 10 MB 的<x1/>文件（它不是洪流文件）。对等方只能看到 DDM 的主版本号。

4231bc950a14bdeb.source: Before you click <g1>OK</g1>, the window shows the <g2>First file</g2>, <g3>Second file</g3> and <g4>Last file</g4>, so a typo shows up before anything downloads. If the server needs a login, tick <g5>Use authorization</g5>. Copied the address already? <g6>Tasks → Add batch download from clipboard</g6> fills it in.
4231bc950a14bdeb.text: 在点击<g1>确定</g1>之前，窗口会显示<g2>第一个文件</g2>、<g3>第二个文件</g3>和<g4>最后一个文件</g4>，这样在下载开始前就能发现输入错误。如果服务器需要登录，请勾选<g5>使用授权</g5>。已经复制了地址？<g6>任务 → 从剪贴板添加批处理下载</g6>会自动填写。

423221c9c3857d3c.text: 语言 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

424085db320c36a7.source: If Direct3D, Vulkan or Metal can't start on your computer (no driver for it, some virtual machines), or its first window doesn't show within 10 seconds of its own (the time DDM spends loading your list and its icons doesn't count, however slow the computer is just after it starts), DDM draws with OpenGL, and <g1>View → Draw with</g1> says so and why. Choosing it again tries it again at the next start.
424085db320c36a7.text: 如果您的电脑无法启动 Direct3D、Vulkan 或 Metal（缺少驱动程序，或在某些虚拟机中），或者 DDM 启动后 10 秒内（不计入 DDM 加载列表和图标的时间，即使电脑启动后运行缓慢）其首个窗口没有显示，DDM 将使用 OpenGL 绘制，并且<g1>视图 → 绘制方式</g1>会显示此信息及原因。再次选择它会在下次启动时再次尝试。

425dd08233bf3ff3.source: On Linux and macOS, DDM finds yt-dlp, ffmpeg and gallery-dl on your <x1/> and in the usual package-manager folders, including Homebrew's. A program you selected yourself takes priority, followed by DDM's own installed copy. The system copy is used when neither is present, and your package manager keeps it up to date: DDM never downloads over it on its own. If your distribution's yt-dlp is old, <g2>Use DDM's own copy</g2> in Helpers downloads DDM's, which keeps itself current and is used from then on.
425dd08233bf3ff3.text: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 会在您的 <x1/> 以及包括 Homebrew 在内的常用包管理器文件夹中查找 yt-dlp、ffmpeg 和 gallery-dl。您自己选择的程序优先，其次是 DDM 自己安装的副本。当两者都不存在时，将使用系统副本，并且您的包管理器会使其保持最新：DDM 绝不会自行覆盖它。如果您的发行版中的 yt-dlp 过旧，请在“帮助程序”中勾选<g2>使用 DDM 自带的副本</g2>，DDM 将下载并使用自己的副本，该副本会自行保持最新。

427cc05e98da7048.source: <g1>Extract when done</g1>: ticked by itself when the package holds an archive.
427cc05e98da7048.text: <g1>完成后提取</g1>：分组中包含存档时，此项会自动勾选。

429af5aabcba70df.source: 50 MiB, server allows 2 connections, 2 MB/s each
429af5aabcba70df.text: 50 MiB，服务器允许 2 个连接，每个 2 MB/秒

42b14e12bdf12e29.source: <g1>DDM asks to create a folder:</g1> the folder doesn't exist yet. Click <g2>Yes</g2>.
42b14e12bdf12e29.text: <g1>DDM 要求创建文件夹：</g1>该文件夹尚不存在。点击<g2>是</g2>。

42c7eeed9c7e6c6b.source: It stores its own settings (paused or not, DDM's file types and excluded sites, its connection status, the name and site of the last download it left to the browser so its status page can say why, where you dragged the video button on each of the last 200 sites; nothing from private windows) in the browser's extension storage, on your computer.
42c7eeed9c7e6c6b.text: 它会将自己的设置（是否暂停、DDM 的文件类型和排除的站点、其连接状态、它留给浏览器的上一个下载的名称和站点，以便其状态页说明原因、您在最近 200 个站点中每个站点上拖动视频按钮的位置；不包含来自隐私窗口的任何内容）存储在您计算机上浏览器的扩展存储中。

42c9af850b22a734.source: The other way works too: <g1>Tasks → Export → As a text file</g1> writes one address per line, and <g2>As an IDM list (.ef2)</g2> writes an <x3/> list.
42c9af850b22a734.text: 反过来也行：<g1>任务 → 导出 → 文本文件</g1>每行写入一个地址，<g2>IDM 列表 (.ef2)</g2>则写入 <x3/> 列表。

42d22490266e1c29.source: The pictures go into a folder of their own, named after the gallery. Want only a few? Type a number in <g1>Files at most</g1> to take the first ones the site lists, on most sites the newest.
42d22490266e1c29.text: 图片将保存到以图库命名的独立文件夹中。如果只想下载部分图片，可在<g1>最多文件数</g1>中输入数字，以下载网站列出的前几张图片（在大多数网站上为最新图片）。

42f13ba00e15c0ff.source: <g1>No proxy/socks</g1> connects directly; it is the default. <g2>Use system settings</g2> takes the proxy set in Windows. <g3>Manual proxy/socks configuration</g3> takes the proxy's address and <g4>Port</g4>, a <g5>UserName</g5> and <g6>Password</g6> if it needs them, and the protocols it is for. Write a SOCKS proxy as <x7/>. <g8>Get System</g8> fills the fields in from Windows' settings, to adjust from there.
42f13ba00e15c0ff.text: <g1>无代理/SOCKS</g1> 表示直接连接，这是默认设置。<g2>使用系统设置</g2> 采用 Windows 中设置的代理。<g3>手动代理/SOCKS 配置</g3> 允许您输入代理地址和<g4>端口</g4>，如果需要，还可以输入<g5>用户名</g5>和<g6>密码</g6>，以及适用的协议。SOCKS 代理的格式为 <x7/>。<g8>从系统获取</g8> 会从 Windows 设置中填充这些字段，以便您在此基础上进行调整。

42fcdc57b1d01537.source: A code works once, for ten minutes, and not after five wrong tries: click <g1>New code</g1> for another. To keep the page one tap away, add it to the phone's home screen (the browser's menu: <g2>Add to Home screen</g2>).
42fcdc57b1d01537.text: 一个代码只能使用一次，有效期十分钟，并且在五次错误尝试后失效：点击<g1>新代码</g1>获取另一个。要让页面触手可及，请将其添加到手机主屏幕（浏览器菜单：<g2>添加到主屏幕</g2>）。

42fd1c3a7225fa22.source: Each feature has a page of its own, with the real window, where to find it, and what it can't do yet.
42fd1c3a7225fa22.text: 每个功能都有专属页面，其中包含实际窗口截图、查找位置，以及尚未实现的功能。

42fd429771459bdb.source: A playlist: every video ticked, one quality for all.
42fd429771459bdb.text: 播放列表：所有视频均已勾选，画质统一。

430f6fceb63c7495.source: <g1>HLS and DASH videos from the browser, as their stream</g1> (<g2>#155</g2>): a video played as a stream (most sites' long videos) failed with yt-dlp's "Unsupported URL" when the extension sent the page instead of the stream. <g3>Download with Dannex Download Manager</g3> in the right-click menu on such a video now sends the stream its player loaded, as the button over videos and <g4>Media on this page</g4> do. In Firefox it did nothing at all. The cookies sent are those of the stream's own server, not the page's.
430f6fceb63c7495.text: <g1>来自浏览器的 HLS 和 DASH 视频，按其流处理</g1>（<g2>#155</g2>）：以流播放的视频（大多数站点的长视频），在扩展发送的是页面而不是流时，会因 yt-dlp 的“Unsupported URL”而失败。此类视频上右键菜单中的<g3>使用 Dannex Download Manager 下载</g3>现在会发送其播放器加载的流，视频上的按钮和<g4>此页面上的媒体</g4>也是如此。在 Firefox 中它此前完全没有反应。发送的 Cookie 是该流所在服务器自己的，而不是页面的。

4322a9c35e172e53.source: Its title and glyphs while the window isn't the active one, and a greyed button's
4322a9c35e172e53.text: 窗口非活动时，其标题和字形，以及置灰按钮的标题和字形

432cbb1ffee89925.source: <g1>Your downloads are yours to answer for.</g1> Respect copyright and the terms of the sites you download from. With torrents, remember that a torrent client also shares what it downloads.
432cbb1ffee89925.text: <g1>您的下载由您负责。</g1> 请尊重版权和您下载网站的条款。对于种子文件，请记住种子客户端也会分享它下载的内容。

4335a5e60824305f.source: <g1>DDM's own icons where Metro, Adwaita and Breeze had none</g1>: Metro's Hide to the notification area, Adwaita's PDF, torrent file and Hide to the notification area, and Breeze's PDF and Hide to the notification area, drawn for DDM in each one's style (the one-colour ones in the theme's text colour).
4335a5e60824305f.text: <g1>DDM 自有图标，用于 Metro、Adwaita 和 Breeze 风格中缺失的部分</g1>：Metro 风格的“隐藏到通知区域”图标，Adwaita 风格的 PDF、种子文件和“隐藏到通知区域”图标，以及 Breeze 风格的 PDF 和“隐藏到通知区域”图标，均按各自风格为 DDM 绘制（单色图标采用主题的文本颜色）。

433e0637cae84575.source: Links that work only once no longer fail with "403 Forbidden".
433e0637cae84575.text: 仅限一次的链接不再因“403 Forbidden”而失败。

434c8bef47698656.source: Download a file — Dannex Download Manager help
434c8bef47698656.text: 下载文件 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

436bac2c4f3d3f4c.source: <g1>Downloads → Start queue</g1> and <g2>Downloads → Stop queue</g2> list them too.
436bac2c4f3d3f4c.text: <g1>下载 → 启动队列</g1>和<g2>下载 → 停止队列</g2>也会列出所有队列。

439a601784d5071b.source: <g1>DDM says why the browser kept a download</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>): every download left to the browser by Options is a line in DDM's log naming the setting that decided (its type isn't in <g3>File types</g3>, its site or address is excluded, it's under the minimum size, the browser is unticked, browser integration is off, or the extension may not read the site), and the extension's button shows the last one, with the file's name. A download from a private window is logged without its name or site.
439a601784d5071b.text: <g1>DDM 会说明浏览器保留下载的原因</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）：“选项”中留给浏览器的每个下载都是 DDM 日志中的一行，其中会说明决定此操作的设置（其类型不在<g3>文件类型</g3>中、其站点或地址被排除、它小于最小大小、浏览器未勾选、浏览器集成已关闭，或扩展可能无法读取该站点），并且扩展按钮会显示最后一个原因以及文件名。来自隐私窗口的下载不会记录其名称或站点。

43a47efd749a00a7.source: dannex.kavangi.co.ke is a static site. Two companies take part in showing it to you:
43a47efd749a00a7.text: dannex.kavangi.co.ke 是静态网站。有两家公司参与向您展示本站：

43ad4ee2e95fdb1f.source: A page's own short sounds (a click, a voice-search chime) are no longer listed in <g1>Media on this page</g1>.
43ad4ee2e95fdb1f.text: 页面本身的短音（点击声、语音搜索提示音）不再列在<g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>中。

43b468d3bb0d57bb.source: Sites Logins: a user name and password per site.
43b468d3bb0d57bb.text: 站点登录：每个站点的用户名和密码。

43bb74214b2e4ee2.source: The first release: a free download manager for Windows, laid out the way Internet Download Manager users expect, with experimental builds for macOS and Linux.
43bb74214b2e4ee2.text: 首次发布：一款适用于 Windows 的免费下载管理器，布局与 Internet Download Manager 用户所期望的一致，并提供 macOS 和 Linux 的实验性版本。

43c49121239148be.source: <g1>List the downloads under All Downloads too</g1>: off by default, so that a grab of thousands of files doesn't bury your other downloads. The files show under the project in <g2>Grabber projects</g2>, and in the queue they join. Tick it to see them under All Downloads and its categories as well.
43c49121239148be.text: <g1>同时在“所有下载”下列出这些下载</g1>：默认关闭，这样抓取数千个文件时不会淹没您的其他下载。文件显示在<g2>抓取项目</g2>下的项目中，以及它们加入的队列中。勾选后，也可在“所有下载”及其类别下看到它们。

43cb42591f1e4934.source: <g1>No proxy/socks</g1> — connect directly. This is the default.
43cb42591f1e4934.text: <g1>无代理/SOCKS</g1> — 直接连接。这是默认设置。

43ccdecea2df6c27.source: The grabber finds links where a browser does: links, frames, pictures (<x1/> and pictures loaded late too), videos and their posters, sounds, style sheets and the pictures in them, icons. It doesn't run the pages' scripts, so files that only a script adds to a page aren't found. A link whose address doesn't show what it is (<x2/>) is asked once: a page is explored, a file is collected under the name the server gives it.
43ccdecea2df6c27.text: 抓取器查找链接的位置与浏览器相同：链接、框架、图片（<x1/> 以及延迟加载的图片）、视频及其封面、音频、样式表及其中的图片、图标。它不运行页面的脚本，因此只由脚本添加到页面上的文件找不到。对地址看不出是什么内容的链接（<x2/>），会询问一次：是页面就探索，是文件就按服务器给出的名称收集。

43dc4b87cceb0568.source: Links that come while the window is open join the ones already there. A link that is already in the window isn't added twice. A link that is already in your download list goes under <g1>Already in the list</g1>, unticked.
43dc4b87cceb0568.text: 窗口打开期间收到的链接会加入已有链接。窗口中已有的链接不会重复添加。已在下载列表中的链接会显示在<g1>已在列表中</g1>下方，且不会被勾选。

43ff6b9c3376c383.source: Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi

4409b6268f79d30a.source: <g1>Pasting.</g1> Choose <g2>Tasks → Link grabber...</g2> and press <g3>Ctrl+V</g3>: every web address in the copied text is added.
4409b6268f79d30a.text: <g1>粘贴。</g1>选择<g2>任务 → 链接抓取器…</g2>并按<g3>Ctrl+V</g3>：复制文本中的所有网址都会添加进来。

441af57745084076.text: 打开<g1>速度限制器</g1>选项卡。

44248ba62857c3f5.source: <g1>Ready for the Chrome Web Store:</g1> the browser extension is in Google's review. DDM already accepts the store's copy of it, so the day the store publishes it, installing it from there works at once with DDM. Until then DDM keeps offering the extension that comes with it.
44248ba62857c3f5.text: <g1>已为 Chrome Web Store 做好准备：</g1>浏览器扩展正在接受 Google 的审核。DDM 已经可以接受应用商店中的版本，因此商店一发布该扩展，从商店安装就能立即与 DDM 配合使用。在此之前，DDM 仍会提供随附的扩展。

4426f2fb1262af57.source: <g1>Download video</g1>: when a site's bot check (Cloudflare) turns yt-dlp away, the message says so and what to try, instead of yt-dlp's cut-off words (<g2>#317</g2>).
4426f2fb1262af57.text: <g1>下载视频</g1>：当站点的机器人检查（Cloudflare）挡住 yt-dlp 时，提示会如实说明并建议可尝试的做法，而不是 yt-dlp 被截断的话（<g2>#317</g2>）。

4447a34a8cbe1ae6.source: <g1>The Categories pane and the menus</g1> (<g2>#113</g2>): the pane reads as a tree (each category named with its count, open or shut, selected), the menu bar and every right-click menu as menus whose items can be run, and <g3>Shift+F10</g3> or the <g4>Menu</g4> key opens the selected category's menu. A menu opened from the keyboard no longer stays invisible until the mouse moves.
4447a34a8cbe1ae6.text: <g1>“类别”窗格和菜单</g1> (<g2>#113</g2>)：该窗格现在被读取为树状结构（每个类别都有名称、计数、展开或折叠状态、选中状态），菜单栏和每个右键菜单都被读取为可执行项目的菜单，<g3>Shift+F10</g3>或<g4>菜单</g4>键可以打开所选类别的菜单。通过键盘打开的菜单不再在鼠标移动之前保持不可见。

445cc2a9efa4121a.source: <g1>The button over the video</g1> sends the stream its player loaded (<g2>below</g2>).
445cc2a9efa4121a.text: <g1>视频上的按钮</g1>会发送其播放器加载的流（见<g2>下文</g2>）。

445e6378c12f1e16.source: <g1>Image gallery support:</g1> download whole galleries (Flickr, Imgur, DeviantArt and more) with gallery-dl.
445e6378c12f1e16.text: <g1>图像画廊支持：</g1> 使用 gallery-dl 下载整个画廊（Flickr、Imgur、DeviantArt 等）。

446b7f64f35263c2.source: The people who made Dannex Download Manager possible: everyone who sent a pull request, opened an issue or joined a conversation on GitHub.
446b7f64f35263c2.text: 感谢这些杰出人士让 Dannex Download Manager 成为可能：每一位在 GitHub 上提交拉取请求、提出问题或参与讨论的朋友。

44726c1758ab10cf.source: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi add their own <g1>Options</g1> item to that menu; in Firefox it's <g2>Manage Extension</g2> → <g3>Options</g3>. The extension's options page holds only <g4>Send downloads to Dannex Download Manager</g4> (the same switch as the click) and, under <g5>More</g5>, the two things only the extension can do: <g6>Download through this browser's VPN or proxy</g6> (see below) and <g7>Send downloads to</g7>: this computer, or Dannex Download Manager on another computer. When DDM can't be reached, it says so there, with <g8>See what to do</g8> for the status page.
44726c1758ab10cf.text: Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 会在该菜单中添加自己的<g1>选项</g1>项；在 Firefox 中则是<g2>管理扩展</g2> → <g3>选项</g3>。扩展的选项页只有<g4>将下载发送到 Dannex Download Manager</g4>（与单击相同的开关），以及在<g5>更多</g5>下的两项只有扩展才能做的事：<g6>通过此浏览器的 VPN 或代理下载</g6>（见下文）和<g7>将下载发送到</g7>：此计算机，或另一台计算机上的 Dannex Download Manager。当无法连接 DDM 时，会在那里说明，并提供<g8>查看处理方法</g8>以转到状态页。

447b0cdb28e67b18.source: <g1>Stop</g1> ends gallery-dl and everything it started. The pictures saved so far stay.
447b0cdb28e67b18.text: 点击<g1>停止</g1>会结束 gallery-dl 及其启动的所有进程。已保存的图片会保留。

44970b9b25afe28d.source: These are the checks CI runs; each works on a clean clone:
44970b9b25afe28d.text: 以下是 CI 执行的检查；每项检查都在干净的克隆版本上运行：

44aa99ba0ee91e15.source: It's a desktop app: open this page on your computer to download it.
44aa99ba0ee91e15.text: 这是一个桌面应用：请在您的电脑上打开此页面进行下载。

44ad450a0c786f11.source: <g1>Pause between requests</g1> and <g2>Requests at once</g2>: how gently it reads the site. The defaults (half a second, two at once) are polite to small sites. Each page is read once, however many pages link to it.
44ad450a0c786f11.text: <g1>请求间隔</g1>和<g2>同时请求数</g2>：读取站点的温和程度。默认值（半秒，同时两个）对小型站点比较友好。无论有多少页面链接到某个页面，每个页面只读取一次。

44be10554ef4d67f.source: Preliminary results from {date}. A full re-run is under way; these numbers will be replaced when it finishes.
44be10554ef4d67f.text: {date} 的初步结果。正在进行全面重新运行；完成后这些数字将被替换。

44c2ef53e14c6f1a.source: A save folder shown as <x1/> could be taken literally, asking to create it in the wrong place or failing with "Read-only file system" on macOS.
44c2ef53e14c6f1a.text: 保存文件夹显示为<x1/>时，可能会被字面理解，导致在错误位置创建文件夹或在 macOS 上因“只读文件系统”而失败。

44c881667b5a140f.source: The pane on the left has four branches. <g1>All Downloads</g1> holds everything, <g2>Unfinished</g2> what isn't complete yet and <g3>Finished</g3> what is, each by category. <g4>Queues</g4> lists each queue. The top branches show how many downloads they hold, and right-click → <g5>Browse</g5> opens a category's folder.
44c881667b5a140f.text: 左侧窗格有四个分支。<g1>所有下载</g1>包含所有文件，<g2>未完成</g2>显示尚未完成的文件，<g3>已完成</g3>显示已完成的文件，每个都按类别分类。<g4>队列</g4>列出每个下载队列。顶部显示的分支会显示其包含的下载数量，右键点击 → <g5>浏览</g5>可打开类别的文件夹。

44f50999ce094e3a.source: We may update these terms; the date at the top says when. Changes apply from then on and are recorded in the project's public history on GitHub.
44f50999ce094e3a.text: 我们可能会更新这些条款；顶部的日期注明了更新时间。变更自该日期起生效，并记录在项目 GitHub 公开历史中。

44fb69f9bb71352e.source: The site isn't in <g1>Leave downloads from these sites to the browser</g1>, nor the address in <g2>Leave these addresses to the browser</g2>.
44fb69f9bb71352e.text: 该站点不在<g1>将这些站点的下载留给浏览器</g1>中，该地址也不在<g2>将这些地址留给浏览器</g2>中。

450669a060390441.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager didn't start</g1>: start it yourself, then <g2>Try again</g2>
450669a060390441.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager 未启动</g1>：请自行启动它，然后<g2>重试</g2>

4507bfdd11d8c12b.source: DDM's interface comes in 86 languages: every display language Windows 11 offers, from Afrikaans to Vietnamese, including both Chinese scripts, Spanish for…
4507bfdd11d8c12b.text: DDM 界面支持 86 种语言：Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，从南非荷兰语到越南语，包括两种中文字体、西班牙语等…

4521ccf5390656f1.text: IDM 命令行参数，保持不变

4535a098db33e5bf.source: <g1>Stop</g1> pauses the gallery: the pictures saved so far stay, and a picture under way keeps what it had, for <g2>Resume</g2> to carry on from. gallery-dl ends with everything it started.
4535a098db33e5bf.text: <g1>停止</g1>会暂停图库：已保存的图片保留，正在下载的图片保留已有内容，供<g2>恢复</g2>继续。gallery-dl 会连同它启动的一切一并结束。

453c036948f0cacb.source: The technical policy, with the code each point refers to, is in <g1>SECURITY.md</g1>.
453c036948f0cacb.text: 技术政策以及各项政策对应的代码见 <g1>SECURITY.md</g1>。

45581f5e4b02308f.source: <g1>YouTube formats with Node.js or Bun installed</g1> (<g2>#360</g2>): yt-dlp needs a JavaScript runtime for them and looks for Deno alone, so DDM now tells it about Node.js (nvm's too) or Bun when there is no Deno.
45581f5e4b02308f.text: <g1>安装了 Node.js 或 Bun 的 YouTube 格式</g1>（<g2>#360</g2>）：yt-dlp 需要 JavaScript 运行时来处理这些格式，并且只查找 Deno，因此当没有 Deno 时，DDM 现在会告知它 Node.js（包括 nvm 的）或 Bun。

45634b08bf24e6aa.source: What's left: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet; screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows on Linux yet; and native Wayland windows can't place menus, so XWayland stays the default. macOS stays experimental: its builds are made and tested by GitHub Actions, not yet on a Mac of ours.
45634b08bf24e6aa.text: 待完成事项：Flatpak Firefox 尚未检查；屏幕阅读器 (Orca) 尚未在 Linux 上读取 DDM 窗口；原生 Wayland 窗口无法放置菜单，因此 XWayland 仍是默认选项。macOS 仍处于实验阶段：其构建由 GitHub Actions 完成和测试，我们尚未在 Mac 上进行测试。

4565fe0b1e5d6641.source: If DDM is running, the command goes to it; if not, DDM starts and carries it out. On macOS and Linux the program has the same name, without <x1/>.
4565fe0b1e5d6641.text: 如果 DDM 正在运行，命令将发送给它；如果未运行，DDM 将启动并执行命令。在 macOS 和 Linux 上，程序名称相同，不带 <x1/>。

4586afd483f44a6f.source: Don't open it to the internet through your router. To reach it while you're away, use a VPN to your home network, such as WireGuard or Tailscale; with Tailscale, choose its address under <g1>Listen on</g1>. The first time, Windows may ask whether DDM may use the network: allow it on private networks, or the phone can't reach DDM.
4586afd483f44a6f.text: 不要通过路由器将其暴露到互联网。要在您外出时访问它，请使用 VPN 连接到您的家庭网络，例如 WireGuard 或 Tailscale；使用 Tailscale 时，请在<g1>监听</g1>下选择其地址。首次使用时，Windows 可能会询问 DDM 是否可以使用网络：允许它在私有网络上使用，否则手机将无法访问 DDM。

459b25f877a94aab.source: A greyed label in the progress window
459b25f877a94aab.text: 进度窗口中置灰的标签

45c04c7e7d9311df.source: <g1>Files found...</g1>: the list of files its last run found, to download more of them.
45c04c7e7d9311df.text: <g1>找到的文件...</g1>：上次运行找到的文件列表，可从中下载更多。

45cc266ac890432b.source: If it says <g1>this site lets only browsers through</g1>, the site's bot check (Cloudflare's, for one) turned DDM away. DDM has already asked once more connecting the way your browser does, with your browser's cookies for that site, and the site still wants its check answered in a browser. Open the site in your browser (passing its check there can be enough: click the link again), or hold <g2>Alt</g2> as you click the link to leave that download to the browser. See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
45cc266ac890432b.text: 如果提示<g1>此网站只允许浏览器访问</g1>，则说明网站的机器人检测（例如 Cloudflare 的检测）拒绝了 DDM。DDM 已经尝试以您浏览器的方式再次连接，并使用了您浏览器在该网站的 Cookie，但网站仍然要求在浏览器中完成检测。请在浏览器中打开该网站（通过检测可能就足够了：再次点击链接），或者在点击链接时按住 <g2>Alt</g2> 键，将该下载任务交给浏览器处理。详见<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

45ce55f4ec4843d8.source: <g1>Start now</g1> and <g2>Stop</g2> run or halt the selected queue straight away.
45ce55f4ec4843d8.text: <g1>立即开始</g1>和<g2>停止</g2>会立即启动或停止所选队列。

45e8a3a166043112.source: <g1>Symbols.</g1> Release builds keep line tables (<x2/>), but no download includes the debug info. CI turns it into <x3/> (<x4/>, using Mozilla's <x5/>), published beside the release's other files. The report window fetches the zip for its own version when a stack shows bare addresses.
45e8a3a166043112.text: <g1>符号。</g1> 发布版本保留行号表（<x2/>），但下载文件不包含调试信息。CI 会将其转换为 <x3/>（<x4/>，使用 Mozilla 的 <x5/>），并与发布版本的其他文件一同发布。当堆栈中只有裸地址时，报告窗口会获取对应版本的 zip 文件。

460a4a4a7f6d305e.source: DDM keeps Internet Download Manager's compact sizes. On a large or high-resolution screen, choose <g1>View → Interface size</g1> (110 %, 115 %, 120 %, 125 %, 150 %, 175 % or 200 %), or press <g2>Ctrl +</g2> and <g3>Ctrl −</g3> in any DDM window, as in a browser; <g4>Ctrl 0</g4> goes back to 100 %. Every window follows at once, and DDM starts at that size next time. It comes on top of Windows' own display scale (<g5>Settings → System → Display → Scale</g5>).
460a4a4a7f6d305e.text: DDM 保持了 Internet Download Manager 的紧凑尺寸。在大屏幕或高分辨率屏幕上，选择<g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>（110%、115%、120%、125%、150%、175% 或 200%），或者在任何 DDM 窗口中按下 <g2>Ctrl +</g2> 和 <g3>Ctrl -</g3>，就像在浏览器中一样；<g4>Ctrl 0</g4> 可恢复到 100%。所有窗口会立即随之调整，DDM 下次启动时也会使用该尺寸。这会叠加在 Windows 自身的显示缩放（<g5>设置 → 系统 → 显示 → 缩放</g5>）之上。

460c28c064c58629.source: To remove it, open the same window and untick <g1>Limit all downloads together to</g1>.
460c28c064c58629.text: 要取消限制，请打开同一窗口并取消勾选<g1>将所有下载总计限制为</g1>。

46128337a14f5fa7.source: <g1>Something is blocking Dannex Download Manager</g1>: security software; or install it again, with the download
46128337a14f5fa7.text: <g1>有程序正在阻止 Dannex Download Manager</g1>：安全软件所致；或重新安装它，并附有下载

461ab20a8f7b69d5.source: More than 32, if you want them
461ab20a8f7b69d5.text: 如果需要，可超过 32 个连接

462b4ea88323a117.source: Bug reports, ideas, translation fixes and pull requests are all welcome. Everything happens in the open on <g1>GitHub</g1>.
462b4ea88323a117.text: 欢迎提交错误报告、想法、翻译修正和拉取请求。所有活动都在<g1>GitHub</g1>上公开进行。

4639868d375aceb6.source: GPL-3.0 · built in the open on <g1>GitHub</g1>

463b3165a5cdb89b.source: <g1>When Drive won't give a file.</g1> Drive limits how often a file can be downloaded: after many downloads in a day it answers "too many users have viewed or downloaded this file recently". DDM shows Drive's own words and writes nothing. Try again later (it can take up to a day), or sign in to Google in your browser and download from there, which often gets past the limit. DDM doesn't try to get around it. A file whose owner turned off downloading, or that your account can't open, gets <g2>no access</g2>.
463b3165a5cdb89b.text: <g1>当云端硬盘无法提供文件时。</g1>云端硬盘限制了文件的下载频率：一天内多次下载后，它会回复“最近有太多用户查看或下载此文件”。DDM 会显示云端硬盘自己的提示，不作任何修改。请稍后再试（可能需要一天时间），或者在浏览器中登录 Google 并从那里下载，这通常可以绕过限制。DDM 不会尝试绕过此限制。如果文件的所有者禁用了下载，或者您的帐户无法打开该文件，则会显示<g2>无权访问</g2>。

464095e5caa00e1c.source: Add the DDM extension to your browser (<g1>how</g1>) and turn IDM's off, so only one of them takes your downloads.
464095e5caa00e1c.text: 将 DDM 扩展程序添加到您的浏览器（<g1>如何操作</g1>），并关闭 IDM 的扩展程序，这样只有一个程序会接管您的下载。

4641f193de783971.source: Check four things: the extension is installed and turned on; <g1>Options → General → Use advanced browser integration</g1> is on and your browser is ticked; the file's type is in <g2>Options → File types</g2>; and the site isn't in the list of sites DDM leaves alone. Right-click a link and choose <g3>Download with DDM</g3> to send any file whatever its type. More in <g4>Troubleshooting</g4>.
4641f193de783971.text: 检查四件事：扩展程序已安装并开启；<g1>选项 → 常规 → 使用高级浏览器集成</g1>已开启且您的浏览器已勾选；文件类型在<g2>选项 → 文件类型</g2>中；并且该网站不在 DDM 忽略的网站列表中。右键单击链接并选择<g3>使用 DDM 下载</g3>以发送任何类型的文件。更多信息请参阅<g4>故障排除</g4>。

465d49f53d5a3c17.source: Tick <g1>Only while I'm using the computer</g1> and the cap applies only while you use the mouse or keyboard. After a minute without input, DDM goes back to full speed.
465d49f53d5a3c17.text: 勾选<g1>仅在我使用计算机时</g1>，此限制仅在您使用鼠标或键盘时生效。在一分钟没有输入后，DDM 将恢复全速下载。

466898c9b0e4598e.source: Add a download from your phone, or from another computer at home, and watch it run on the computer where DDM is: paste a link or a magnet link, send a <x1/> file, see the list with its progress, and pause, start or remove downloads. Your phone opens a small page that DDM itself serves; nothing is installed on the phone, and no outside service is involved.
466898c9b0e4598e.text: 从手机或家中另一台电脑添加下载，并在运行 DDM 的电脑上查看其运行情况：粘贴链接或磁力链接，发送 <x1/> 文件，查看包含进度、暂停、开始或删除下载的列表。您的手机会打开 DDM 自身提供的小页面；手机上无需安装任何东西，也不涉及任何外部服务。

467293b36a5c0bb8.source: A download that gets a web page where a file was expected (a server's "The requested URL was rejected", a sign-in page) now stops with "the server sent a web page instead of the file" instead of saving that page under the file's name and calling it complete. DDM knows a file was expected from the type the browser had for it, or from a file's name (.doc, .pdf, .zip, .mp4...); a page the browser saved as one, a <x1/> link, and a server's own name for what it sends are downloaded as before (part of <g2>#533</g2>).
467293b36a5c0bb8.text: 下载本应得到文件却得到网页（服务器的“The requested URL was rejected”、登录页面）时，现在会以“服务器发送的是网页而不是文件”停止，而不是把该页面按文件名保存并称其已完成。DDM 通过浏览器所给的类型，或文件名（.doc、.pdf、.zip、.mp4...）得知本应是文件；浏览器当作页面保存的页面、<x1/> 链接，以及服务器自己对其所发内容的命名，仍像以前一样下载（属于<g2>#533</g2>的一部分）。

4693601d27da4c66.source: <g1>DNS over HTTPS</g1> (the default) or <g2>DNS over TLS</g2>: encrypted, so nobody on the way sees or changes the names you look up.
4693601d27da4c66.text: <g1>基于 HTTPS 的 DNS</g1>（默认）或<g2>基于 TLS 的 DNS</g2>：查询经过加密，因此传输过程中无人能看到或更改您查询的名称。

4697f21cc891a01f.source: No. DDM is an independent program written from scratch in Rust, with no connection to Tonec Inc., the makers of Internet Download Manager (IDM). It contains…
4697f21cc891a01f.text: 不是。DDM 是一个完全独立的程序，使用 Rust 从头编写，与 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 的制造商 Tonec Inc. 没有任何关系。它包含…

46ac1f2e09bce7b0.source: When something breaks, you see why.
46ac1f2e09bce7b0.text: 问题发生时，您会知道原因。

46b00f4ec20af91a.source: <g1>Helium</g1> installs the extension from the same page in the Chrome Web Store: click <g2>Add to Chrome</g2>. Helium fetches extensions through its own services, so this works only while they're allowed. With those off, load the extension by hand instead, as above (<x9/> works in Helium too).

46dddc25fe1ef953.source: <g1>A download's progress file could be written again just after it stopped</g1> (<g2>#106</g2>), and <g3>a download could fail as it finished, with "part file still in use"</g3> (<g4>#116</g4>). DDM saves a download's progress every few seconds, in a file beside it. A download paused or finished during one of those saves could stop before the save was done; that save then wrote an old progress file a moment later, or, when the last bytes arrived during it, still held the file. A download now stops only once its save is done.
46dddc25fe1ef953.text: <g1>下载的进度文件可能会在停止后立即再次写入</g1>（<g2>#106</g2>），并且<g3>下载可能会在完成时失败，并显示“部分文件仍在使用中”</g3>（<g4>#116</g4>）。DDM 每隔几秒钟将下载进度保存到其旁边的一个文件中。在其中一次保存期间暂停或完成的下载可能会在保存完成之前停止；然后该保存会在片刻之后写入旧的进度文件，或者，当最后字节在此期间到达时，仍然持有该文件。现在，下载只有在保存完成后才会停止。

48d065620ca04dff.source: <g1>Fairness.</g1> The apps alternate, IDM first on even runs and DDM first on odd ones, so drift on the machine hits both. One warm-up run each is discarded. Failed runs are counted, not dropped. Before every run the harness waits until the loopback is quiet: against a server that refuses extra connections IDM retries about 250 times a second, leaving thousands of closed sockets for half a minute; without the wait, whichever app ran next was timed on that backlog.
48d065620ca04dff.text: <g1>公平性。</g1> 应用程序交替运行，IDM 在偶数次运行中优先，DDM 在奇数次运行中优先，因此机器上的漂移会同时影响两者。每次运行一次热身运行，结果被丢弃。失败的运行会被计数，而不是丢弃。在每次运行之前，测试工具会等待直到回环链路安静：对于拒绝额外连接的服务器，IDM 每秒重试约 250 次，留下数千个关闭的套接字半分钟；如果没有等待，接下来运行的应用程序将在该积压上计时。

4a72d3ef78d12a90.source: <g1>No freeze on a slow drive, the last cases:</g1> the main window waited for a drive slow to answer (a hard disk waking up, a USB drive, a network folder) when a link already in the list was added again (whether its finished file was still there, and the files <g2>Overwrite</g2> removes) and when a video from a page was added or started (its name looked for in its folder, and the folder made). They are now asked beside the window: the question, <g3>Download File Info</g3> or <g4>Download complete</g4> shows once the drive has answered, and with <g5>Overwrite</g5> the old row leaves at once and the new download follows once its files are gone. From the browser's quality menu, a finished duplicate being checked is answered as sent to DDM (follows <g6>#743</g6>).
4a72d3ef78d12a90.text: <g1>慢速磁盘不再造成卡顿，最后几种情况：</g1>当列表中已有的链接被再次添加时（检查其已完成的文件是否还在，以及<g2>覆盖</g2>要删除的文件），以及添加或启动页面中的视频时（在其文件夹中查找其名称并创建文件夹），主窗口会等待响应缓慢的磁盘（刚唤醒的硬盘、USB 驱动器、网络文件夹）。现在这些检查在窗口之外进行：磁盘响应后才显示提示、<g3>下载文件信息</g3>或<g4>下载完成</g4>；使用<g5>覆盖</g5>时，旧的行立即消失，待其文件删除后再开始新的下载。通过浏览器的画质菜单发送时，正在检查的已完成重复项会按已发送给 DDM 处理（承接 <g6>#743</g6>）。

4a9cb86df9739df6.source: <g1>Windows: DDM draws with Direct3D 12</g1> (<g2>#89</g2>). Its windows open faster (about a quarter of a second sooner on our test PC), and Direct3D may avoid the stalls some graphics drivers' OpenGL has (<g3>#82</g3>). <g4>View → Draw with</g4> goes back to OpenGL, as before, from the next start; a choice of OpenGL is kept. The window always opens: when Direct3D can't start, its first frame doesn't come within 10 seconds, or a start with it ends before its first frame, DDM draws with OpenGL until Direct3D is chosen again (the menu says so, and why); without a usable OpenGL either, it draws with Microsoft's software renderer (Remote Desktop, virtual machines without a graphics driver). When the graphics card is reset while DDM runs (a driver update), DDM starts again by itself. Freeze and crash reports say what was drawing. Linux and macOS keep OpenGL by default.
4a9cb86df9739df6.text: <g1>Windows：DDM 使用 Direct3D 12 绘制</g1>（<g2>#89</g2>）。其窗口打开速度更快（在我们的测试 PC 上大约快四分之一秒），Direct3D 可能会避免某些显卡驱动的 OpenGL 出现的卡顿（<g3>#82</g3>）。<g4>视图 → 绘制方式</g4>可选择回到 OpenGL，与之前一样，从下次启动生效；OpenGL 的选择会被保留。窗口始终会打开：当 Direct3D 无法启动、其第一帧在 10 秒内未出现，或使用它启动但在第一帧出现前结束时，DDM 会使用 OpenGL 绘制，直到再次选择 Direct3D（菜单会说明原因）；如果 OpenGL 也无法使用，它会使用 Microsoft 的软件渲染器绘制（远程桌面、没有显卡驱动的虚拟机）。当 DDM 运行时显卡重置（驱动更新）时，DDM 会自行重新启动。冻结和崩溃报告会说明正在使用的绘制方式。Linux 和 macOS 默认保持 OpenGL。

4aa0049fa9881235.source: <g1>macOS</g1>: in the login keychain (<g2>Keychain Access</g2>), service <x3/>. macOS may ask once whether DDM may use them, after an update.

4b8a2274de78ad9c.text: egui 的正文：工具提示、多行文本框

4bb4e8b6a2bae5ed.source: The browser warns that the connection's certificate isn't trusted. That is expected: DDM made its own certificate, on your computer, and no public authority knows it. To be sure the page is your DDM's, open the warning's details: the certificate's <g1>SHA-256 fingerprint</g1> is the one <g2>Options → Remote</g2> shows. Then continue to the page (<g3>Advanced → Proceed</g3> in Chrome, <g4>Show details → visit this website</g4> in Safari).
4bb4e8b6a2bae5ed.text: 浏览器会警告连接的证书不受信任。这是预期行为：DDM 在您的电脑上生成了自己的证书，任何公共机构都不知道它。为确保页面是您的 DDM 的，请打开警告详情：证书的<g1>SHA-256 指纹</g1>与<g2>选项 → 远程</g2>中显示的指纹一致。然后继续访问页面（Chrome 中为<g3>高级 → 继续</g3>，Safari 中为<g4>显示详情 → 访问此网站</g4>）。

4bb86feda5a10e9b.source: Tick <g1>Turn off computer when done</g1> and choose <g2>Shut down</g2>, <g3>Sleep</g3> or <g4>Hibernate</g4>. DDM shows a 30-second countdown first, so you can still cancel if you're at the computer.
4bb86feda5a10e9b.text: 勾选<g1>完成后关闭计算机</g1>并选择<g2>关机</g2>、<g3>睡眠</g3>或<g4>休眠</g4>。DDM 会先显示 30 秒倒计时，因此如果您在计算机旁，仍然可以取消。

4bd284ee80f6799e.source: <g1>Experimental:</g1> built from each service's public API documentation, not yet confirmed with a real paid account. AllDebrid's answers were also checked against its real API with the public demo key from its documentation, which answers with sample data, not a real file. If something doesn't work with your account, please <g2>open an issue</g2> (never paste your token or key in it).
4bd284ee80f6799e.text: <g1>实验性：</g1>根据各项服务的公开 API 文档构建，尚未使用真实的付费帐户进行验证。我们还使用文档中的公开演示密钥，通过 AllDebrid 的真实 API 检查了返回结果。该密钥返回的是示例数据，不是真实文件。如果帐户无法正常使用，请<g2>提交问题</g2>（切勿在问题中粘贴令牌或密钥）。

4bd53cf9b125f43b.source: On Windows that button is in the window's title bar, left of Minimize, and in the title bar's menu (Alt+Space). On Linux and macOS it's at the end of the tab row.
4bd53cf9b125f43b.text: 在 Windows 上，该按钮位于窗口标题栏的“最小化”按钮左侧，以及标题栏菜单 (Alt+Space) 中。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它位于标签行末尾。

4c0b75cb39374b7b.source: Download a file with up to 8 connections (<x1/>, 1 to 128), showing progress. <x2/> pauses it; <x3/> continues. <x4/> checks the finished file: hex MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 or CRC32, optionally named (<x5/>). <x6/> picks the DNS: <x7/> (the default); a service and how to ask it, <x8/>, <x9/>, <x10/>, <x11/>, <x12/>; DNS servers' addresses, <x13/>; or a DNS-over-HTTPS address. It never falls back to the system's DNS. <x14/> sends every connection through one network adapter, by its name (<x15/>, <x16/>) or one of its addresses; when it isn't connected, nothing is sent and the download fails. A link from a file host that one of your debrid accounts (<g17>Options → Accounts</g17>) supports goes through that account, as in the app, and <x18/> says <x19/>; <x20/> downloads the address itself (<g21>Debrid service accounts</g21>).
4c0b75cb39374b7b.text: 下载文件，最多使用 8 个连接（<x1/>，范围为 1 到 128），并显示进度。<x2/> 暂停下载；<x3/> 继续下载。<x4/> 检查已下载完成的文件：以十六进制格式显示 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 或 CRC32 校验和，也可以指定名称（<x5/>）。<x6/> 选择 DNS：<x7/>（默认）；选择服务及其查询方式，<x8/>、<x9/>、<x10/>、<x11/>、<x12/>；指定 DNS 服务器地址，<x13/>；或指定 DNS-over-HTTPS 地址。它不会回退到系统 DNS。<x14/> 通过一个网络适配器发送所有连接，可指定适配器名称（<x15/>、<x16/>）或其地址之一；如果适配器未连接，则不会发送任何内容，下载也会失败。文件托管网站的链接如果受网盘服务帐户（<g17>选项 → 帐户</g17>）支持，就会像在应用程序中一样通过该帐户处理；<x18/> 表示 <x19/>；<x20/> 则直接下载该网址（<g21>网盘服务帐户</g21>）。

4c225c234e3533a3.source: <g1>A download too big for the drive is refused on a busy computer too</g1> (<g2>#224</g2>): before a download starts, DDM checks the drive has room for it. It gave up checking after 5 seconds (a network drive that no longer answers can hang), counted from when it asked; on a very busy computer the check could wait longer than that just to start, and a download too big for its drive started anyway. The 5 seconds now count from when the check runs, and it asks only the folder's own drive instead of listing every drive, which takes well under a millisecond. A shared network folder (<x3/>) is checked too, which it wasn't before, and a folder that doesn't exist yet is checked on the drive it will be made on.
4c225c234e3533a3.text: <g1>对于驱动器空间不足的下载，在繁忙的电脑上也会被拒绝</g1>（<g2>#224</g2>）：在下载开始之前，DDM 会检查驱动器是否有足够的空间。它在 5 秒后放弃检查（无响应的网络驱动器可能会挂起），从它请求时开始计时；在非常繁忙的电脑上，检查可能需要等待更长时间才能开始，而对于驱动器来说太大的下载仍然会开始。现在，这 5 秒从检查运行时开始计时，并且它只询问文件夹自己的驱动器，而不是列出所有驱动器，这花费的时间远少于一毫秒。共享网络文件夹（<x3/>）也会被检查，而以前不会，并且尚未存在的文件夹会在它将要创建的驱动器上进行检查。

4c2b2b847989a4ba.source: The window no longer waits for Windows to look up the time zone: the queues' schedules asked for it at every moment, and once Windows took more than 8 seconds to answer, the window stopped answering meanwhile. The time zone is now looked up beside the window, again each minute, so a change of summer time still shows within a minute (<g1>#536</g1>).
4c2b2b847989a4ba.text: 窗口不再等待 Windows 查询时区：队列的计划在每个时刻都会询问它，一旦 Windows 应答超过 8 秒，窗口在此期间就会停止响应。现在时区在窗口之外查询，仍是每分钟一次，所以夏令时的变化仍会在一分钟内显示（<g1>#536</g1>）。

4c2d77a09ca56938.text: 无障碍下载管理器：屏幕阅读器和全键盘操作

4c313223884a2c9e.source: Windows: no more crash when a screen is unplugged, turned off or rearranged while DDM runs (<g1>#335</g1>).

4c66a42d4d367334.text: <g1>Windows 上平滑的文本和更精细的界面大小：</g1><g2>视图 → 文本 → 平滑</g2>以其自身大小绘制抗锯齿的字母，而不是在 1440p 屏幕上难以阅读的粗体、整像素字母；默认的<g3>经典</g3>保持 DDM 原有的外观。<g4>视图 → 界面大小</g4>现在在 100% 和 125% 之间提供 110%、115% 和 120% 的选项。

4c7653455d1907f8.source: <g1>Torrent commands</g1> in the right-click menu: <g2>Recheck files</g2>, <g3>Reannounce</g3>, <g4>Add trackers...</g4> and <g5>Copy magnet link</g5>. Files can be ticked and unticked while it runs.
4c7653455d1907f8.text: 右键菜单中的<g1>种子命令</g1>：<g2>重新检查文件</g2>、<g3>重新发布</g3>、<g4>添加跟踪器…</g4>和<g5>复制磁力链接</g5>。在运行时可以勾选和取消勾选文件。

4c7ae50eb25cbd28.source: <g1>Keys that leave a link to the browser, or give it to DDM → Keys...</g1> — the keys that, held while clicking a link, leave it to the browser (Alt) or have DDM download it whatever its type (Ctrl+Alt; Command+Option on a Mac). Each can be None, one key, or two or three together; the two must differ. Also <g2>Also take files the browser would open</g2>. See <g3>Keys to force or prevent capture</g3>.
4c7ae50eb25cbd28.text: <g1>将链接留给浏览器或交给 DDM 的按键 → 按键...</g1> — 按住它们单击链接时，会将链接留给浏览器 (Alt)，或让 DDM 下载它而不管其类型（Ctrl+Alt；Mac 上是 Command+Option）。每个都可以是无、一个键，或两三个键组合；两者必须不同。还有<g2>同时接管浏览器本会打开的文件</g2>。请参阅<g3>强制或阻止接管的按键</g3>。

4c8652ab742797b6.source: Some servers report a new date for the same file every time. Tick <g1>Options → Downloads → Resume even if the file's date on the server changed</g1>.

4ca1fb1c91dcdf4d.source: <g1>Resuming from a server that sends its ETag without quotes</g1> (Wikimedia's): DDM kept no validator at all for such a file, so a resumed download couldn't tell whether the file had changed on the server meanwhile. The server's modification date now guards it, as the HTTP standard allows when there is no valid entity tag; a weak ETag still means none.
4ca1fb1c91dcdf4d.text: <g1>从不带引号发送 ETag 的服务器（Wikimedia）恢复下载：</g1>DDM 以前对这类文件完全不保留校验值，因此恢复下载时无法判断文件在此期间是否已在服务器上更改。现在改用服务器的修改日期来保护，这是 HTTP 标准在没有有效实体标签时允许的做法；弱 ETag 仍视为没有。

4e2c245c44f6b6ff.source: The files go next to the archive, into a folder named after it when it holds several things (or always, or never: you choose in Options). A file that is already there is kept, and the new one is numbered: <x1/>.

4e4e27b130c200b5.source: <g1>Menus and the drop target without a black band across their top</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>): on a Windows 11 Insider build (22635), every menu and submenu showed a black band a title bar tall across its top and a thin one down its left side, its items moved down by as much and its last ones cut off; so did the drop target (Tasks → Show drop target), its icon moved down. Each of these windows had a title bar's style, hidden by DDM, and something on that build placed the window's picture where the title bar would have ended. Menus and the drop target are now plain pop-up windows, as Windows' own menus are, with nothing above their contents to take for a title bar; every window of DDM without a title bar is made one the same way.
4e4e27b130c200b5.text: <g1>菜单和拖放目标顶部不再有黑条</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）：在 Windows 11 Insider 版本 (22635) 上，每个菜单和子菜单顶部都显示一个标题栏高度的黑条，左侧有一条细线，其项目向下移动了相同的高度，最后几个项目被截断；拖放目标（任务 → 显示拖放目标）也一样，其图标向下移动。这些窗口都具有标题栏样式，被 DDM 隐藏了，并且在该版本上，某些东西将窗口的图片放置在标题栏结束的位置。现在，菜单和拖放目标是普通的弹出窗口，就像 Windows 自己的菜单一样，其内容上方没有任何东西可以作为标题栏；DDM 中所有没有标题栏的窗口都以相同的方式创建。

4e98649f7f674c0e.source: <g1>User-Agent for downloads you add yourself</g1> — how DDM names itself to servers for downloads you add yourself. With <g2>Automatic</g2> ticked (the default), DDM introduces itself as your default browser: the User-Agent that browser sends, at the version you have installed (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox or Safari). The box shows it, and pointing at it names the browser. When DDM doesn't recognise your default browser, it sends a current Chrome's. Untick <g3>Automatic</g3> to type your own; tick it again to go back. Downloads from the browser use that browser's own User-Agent. If a site turns a browser's User-Agent away, DDM asks once more with its own.
4e98649f7f674c0e.text: <g1>手动添加的下载所用的 User-Agent</g1> — DDM 在您自己添加的下载中向服务器表明身份的方式。勾选<g2>自动</g2>（默认）时，DDM 会将自己介绍为您的默认浏览器：该浏览器发送的 User-Agent，版本与您已安装的一致（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi、Firefox 或 Safari）。框中会显示它，将鼠标指向它会显示浏览器名称。当 DDM 无法识别您的默认浏览器时，它会发送当前 Chrome 的 User-Agent。取消勾选<g3>自动</g3>可输入您自己的；再次勾选即可返回。来自浏览器的下载使用该浏览器自己的 User-Agent。如果站点拒绝某个浏览器的 User-Agent，DDM 会用自己的再请求一次。

You tick the ones you want and DDM downloads them like any other download.
4e9a5c1abb0183af.text: <g1>站点抓取器</g1>从您指定的页面出发探索网站，向下跟随几层链接，并列出找到的文件：图库中的每张图片、文档站点的 PDF、播客页面上的录音，或整个网站以便离线阅读。您勾选想要的文件，DDM 会像其他下载一样下载它们。

4e9ff23471ef2f2a.text: DDM 的源代码中包含一个 <x1/> 和一个 Compose 文件。目前您需要自行构建镜像；已发布的镜像将在稍后提供。首次构建时间较长，在小型服务器上可能长达一小时，但镜像很小，大约 175 MB，不包含桌面库。

4f1d98c277461854.source: A download handed over by the browser whose link the site refuses to DDM before sending anything (FileHippo's links answered <g1>412 Precondition Failed</g1>; a one-time link the browser has already used, or one tied to its session, answers 403, 404 or 410) goes on from the address the browser's own download of it had reached, once; if that is refused too, the link's own answer is the error shown. Its cookies go there only when it is the same site (<g2>#630</g2>).
4f1d98c277461854.text: 浏览器交来的下载，如果站点在发送任何内容之前就拒绝了 DDM 对该链接的请求（FileHippo 的链接返回<g1>412 Precondition Failed</g1>；浏览器已用过的一次性链接或绑定其会话的链接返回 403、404 或 410），DDM 会从浏览器自己的下载所到达的地址继续一次；若那里也被拒绝，则显示链接自己的应答作为错误。只有在同一站点时，才会把它的 Cookie 带过去（<g2>#630</g2>）。

4f342424b8dab68f.source: Every display language Windows 11 offers, chosen by flag on the first start or any time in View → Language. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur are laid out right to left.
4f342424b8dab68f.text: 支持 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，首次启动时可通过旗帜选择，或随时在视图 → 语言中更改。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语采用从右到左的布局。

4f88a5680b4668a4.source: Linux: <g1>View → Dark Mode support</g1> turns dark on window managers such as Hyprland and sway when only GNOME's setting says so (<x2/>), as it did when a desktop portal answered (<g3>#324</g3>).
4f88a5680b4668a4.text: Linux：在 Hyprland 和 sway 这类窗口管理器上，当只有 GNOME 的设置这样说时（<x2/>），<g1>视图 → 深色模式支持</g1>会变成深色，就像桌面门户给出应答时那样（<g3>#324</g3>）。

4fa28fbd41a68f6d.source: A key DDM doesn't know, or a value it can't read, is skipped and written to DDM's log (the <x1/> folder beside the themes folder), so a file made for a newer DDM still loads. A file that isn't valid TOML or JSON doesn't load, and the log says why. A file named like a built-in theme (<x2/>) is passed over: give yours a name of its own.
4fa28fbd41a68f6d.text: DDM 不知道的键，或无法读取的值，将被跳过并写入 DDM 的日志（主题文件夹旁边的<x1/>文件夹），因此为较新 DDM 制作的文件仍然可以加载。无效的 TOML 或 JSON 文件无法加载，日志会说明原因。与内置主题同名的文件（<x2/>）将被跳过：请给您的文件一个自己的名称。

4fa6254f56afb416.source: Closing the main window doesn't quit DDM. It hides in the notification area, and downloads, queues and schedules carry on. To make closing quit (a portable copy's folder can then be deleted), untick <g1>Options → General → Keep running when closing the window</g1>. If there is no icon for DDM at all — not in the notification area, nor behind the ^ hidden icons — the window minimizes to the taskbar instead, so downloads continue and there is a way back. An icon behind ^ can be clicked to bring the window back, and starting DDM again always does.
4fa6254f56afb416.text: 关闭主窗口不会退出 DDM。它会隐藏在通知区域，下载、队列和计划会继续运行。要使关闭窗口即退出（之后便可删除便携版副本的文件夹），请取消勾选<g1>选项 → 常规 → 关闭窗口时保持运行</g1>。如果通知区域或“^ 隐藏图标”后面都没有 DDM 图标，则窗口会最小化到任务栏，这样下载仍会继续，并且可以找回窗口。点击“^”后面的图标可以恢复窗口，再次启动 DDM 也能恢复。

The extension comes with DDM until the browsers' stores list it: in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, open the browser's extensions page, turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked and pick the extension\chromium folder in DDM's folder. Firefox installs only add-ons Mozilla has signed, so until Dannex's is on addons.mozilla.org it takes the file extension\ddm-firefox.xpi in Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR, or until Firefox closes in any Firefox. The tutorial walks through each.
4fb365a77c2c6f9b.text: 用安装程序安装 DDM，并保持勾选设置浏览器集成。在各浏览器的商店上架之前，扩展随 DDM 一起提供：在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中，打开浏览器的扩展页面，开启开发者模式，选择加载已解压的扩展程序，然后选取 DDM 文件夹中的 extension\chromium 文件夹。Firefox 只安装 Mozilla 已签名的附加组件，因此在 Dannex 的附加组件登陆 addons.mozilla.org 之前，需要在 Firefox Developer Edition、Nightly 或 ESR 中使用文件 extension\ddm-firefox.xpi，或在任意 Firefox 中使用至 Firefox 关闭为止。教程介绍了各个浏览器的操作。
