500f97298bacea57.source: The same answer carries Options → General's keys (<x1/>: what page.js holds a click by, to leave a link to the browser or force it to the app) and the right-click items to show (<x2/>: background.js makes its menu anew when they change); the answer to whether the video button may show carries Download panels' settings (<x3/>: over videos or sound players, the least length, the first corner). Their names and defaults are <x4/>'s, read from the settings the app saves. The extension asks again when the browser's window gets the focus back (a few seconds after it last asked), when a page starts (15 s), and at a download (a minute).
500f97298bacea57.text: 同一次回答还带有选项 → 常规中的按键（<x1/>：page.js 据此判断是否拦截点击，把链接留给浏览器或强制交给应用）和要显示的右键菜单项（<x2/>：这些项更改时，background.js 会重新生成菜单）；是否可以显示视频按钮的回答则带有下载面板的设置（<x3/>：在视频或音频播放器上、最短时长、起始角落）。它们的名称和默认值来自 <x4/>，取自应用保存的设置。扩展会在浏览器窗口重新获得焦点时（距上次询问几秒后）、页面开始加载时（15 秒）以及下载时（一分钟）再次询问。

502a32945d3f28fd.source: Point at a column title and a funnel shows at its right: click it to filter the list by that column. From the keyboard, or on a narrow column, right-click the title and choose <g1>Filter "…"...</g1>.
502a32945d3f28fd.text: 将鼠标指向列标题，其右侧会显示一个漏斗：单击它即可按该列筛选列表。使用键盘，或在较窄的列上，请右键单击标题并选择<g1>筛选“…”...</g1>。

50344e9c00abc1e4.source: <g1>Add to queue</g1> adds the ticked links to the <g2>Main download queue</g2>, as the import always did, and <g3>Start</g3> starts the queue as well. An <x4/> file still brings each download's referrer and cookies. See <g5>Link grabber and archives</g5>.
50344e9c00abc1e4.text: <g1>添加到队列</g1>会将已勾选的链接添加到<g2>主下载队列</g2>，就像以前的导入功能一样，而<g3>开始</g3>也会同时启动队列。<x4/> 文件仍然会带上每个下载任务的来源和 Cookie。请参阅<g5>链接抓取器和压缩包</g5>。

505a599d74a09b57.source: The gallery gets one row in your download list. Its size grows as the pictures arrive, and its log says how many were saved.
505a599d74a09b57.text: 该图库将在您的下载列表中占据一行。其大小会随着图片的到来而增长，日志会显示已保存的图片数量。

5060a1dc2ceebb34.source: Windows: <g1>Open folder</g1> on a download opens the folder with the file manager set up to open folders (Directory Opus, for example), instead of always starting Windows Explorer. With Explorer it still selects the file (<g2>#446</g2>).
5060a1dc2ceebb34.text: Windows：下载上的<g1>打开文件夹</g1>会用设为打开文件夹的文件管理器（例如 Directory Opus）打开文件夹，而不是总是启动 Windows 资源管理器。使用资源管理器时，仍会选中该文件（<g2>#446</g2>）。

506410068bc3e290.source: DDM is installed and reached, but its own settings leave this download to the browser. The extension's status page (right-click its toolbar button → <g1>Help</g1>) names the file and which setting it was. Check, in DDM:
506410068bc3e290.text: DDM 已安装且可连接，但其自身设置将此下载留给了浏览器。扩展的状态页（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g1>帮助</g1>）会指出文件名以及是哪项设置。请在 DDM 中检查：

5069ed5778c3addc.source: <g1>Extract archives when their download completes</g1> (off by default) — every archive downloaded, as soon as it (or a split archive's last volume) is in. A Link grabber package has its own <g2>Extract when done</g2>.
5069ed5778c3addc.text: <g1>下载完成后提取存档</g1>（默认关闭）— 每个存档下载完成后立即提取；分卷存档则在最后一个卷下载完成后提取。链接抓取器的每个包都可以单独设置<g2>完成后提取</g2>。

50a8864f971c1689.source: Right-click → <g1>Add category</g1> makes one for what you collect, say <g2>Books</g2> for <x3/>: a name, the file types separated by spaces (<x4/> allowed) and a folder. Change it later with <g5>Properties</g5>, or remove it with <g6>Delete</g6>. The files stay where they are.
50a8864f971c1689.text: 右键点击 → <g1>添加类别</g1>可为您收集的文件创建类别，例如为<x3/>创建<g2>图书</g2>类别：输入名称、用空格分隔的文件类型（允许<x4/>）以及一个文件夹。之后可以使用<g5>属性</g5>更改，或使用<g6>删除</g6>移除。文件会保留在原位置。

50b1b826b2c5891a.source: Run DDM without a window on a home server or a NAS, and send it downloads from your phone or your browser. The files land in the server's own folders, such as a network share.
50b1b826b2c5891a.text: 在家庭服务器或 NAS 上无窗口运行 DDM，并通过手机或浏览器向其发送下载任务。文件将直接保存到服务器的文件夹中，例如网络共享。

50b8783da591113a.text: 选择<g1>任务 → 导入 → 从文本文件</g1>。

50bae93cf9cd9181.source: <g1>A video's sound as MP3, Opus or FLAC</g1> (<g2>#32</g2>, <g3>#70</g3>): <g4>Download video</g4> lists <g5>Audio only MP3</g5> at its best variable bitrate (VBR) and at 320, 256, 192 and 128 kbps, after the sound in the site's own format, now named <g6>Audio only, original</g6>. ffmpeg converts it (on Windows DDM offers to install it, as for the best video qualities; on Linux and macOS it uses the system's), and the browser's <g7>Download video</g7> button offers the same. Under the MP3 ones, <g8>Audio only OPUS</g8> (YouTube's Opus is only moved into an <x9/> file, not converted) and <g10>Audio only FLAC</g10> (lossless, with an honest note in the window: it can't add quality the site's lossy sound doesn't have, the file is only bigger). The command line takes <x11/> (<x12/> for VBR), <x13/> and <x14/>.
50bae93cf9cd9181.text: <g1>将视频音轨转换为 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC</g1> (<g2>#32</g2>, <g3>#70</g3>)：<g4>下载视频</g4>列出了<g5>仅音频 MP3</g5>的最佳可变比特率 (VBR) 以及 320、256、192 和 128 kbps 选项，排在网站自有格式的音轨之后，后者现在命名为<g6>仅音频，原始</g6>。ffmpeg 会进行转换（在 Windows 上，DDM 会像安装最佳视频质量所需组件一样，提供安装 ffmpeg 的选项；在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它使用系统自带的 ffmpeg），浏览器中的<g7>下载视频</g7>按钮也提供相同选项。在 MP3 选项下方，有<g8>仅音频 OPUS</g8>（YouTube 的 Opus 仅移入 <x9/> 文件，不进行转换）和<g10>仅音频 FLAC</g10>（无损，窗口中会诚实地注明：它无法增加网站有损音轨不具备的质量，文件只会更大）。命令行接受 <x11/>（<x12/> 用于 VBR）、<x13/> 和 <x14/>。

50cb386f15dff5dd.source: then signs out and in again. The setting stays after a restart. The computer has one wake alarm: if another program has set it, DDM leaves it alone and says so.
50cb386f15dff5dd.text: 然后注销并重新登录。重启后设置仍然有效。电脑只有一个唤醒闹钟：如果其他程序已设置，DDM 会保留它并提示。

50d069e3a40beb75.source: Download Dannex Download Manager {v1}, the free, open-source download manager: Windows installer and portable zip, macOS .dmg and Linux AppImage, .deb and .rpm, plus the browser extension. No ads, no bundled software.
50d069e3a40beb75.text: 下载 Dannex Download Manager {v1}，免费开源的下载管理器：Windows 安装程序和便携版 zip、macOS .dmg，以及 Linux AppImage、.deb 和 .rpm，另附浏览器扩展。无广告，无捆绑软件。

50ddf68448e9275b.source: <g1>Only pages under the start address's folder</g1>: part of a site. From <x2/>, only the pages in <x3/> and below it are explored, not the rest of the site. The pictures and files those pages use are collected wherever they are.
50ddf68448e9275b.text: <g1>仅限起始地址所在文件夹下的页面</g1>：网站的一部分。从 <x2/> 开始，仅探索 <x3/> 及其下的页面，而不探索网站的其余部分。这些页面使用的图片和文件无论在哪里都会被收集。

50e9066f0da554b8.source: The Speed Limiter keeps DDM from using all of your connection.
50e9066f0da554b8.text: 速度限制器可防止 DDM 占用全部网络带宽。

50ea8d40b4e8e738.source: No, unless you want it to. While a torrent downloads it trades pieces with other people, as every torrent client does. When it finishes, it stops, like any other download. Turn on <g1>Keep sharing torrents after they finish</g1> in Options if you'd like to give back.
50ea8d40b4e8e738.text: 不会，除非您希望它这样做。当种子下载时，它会像所有种子客户端一样与其他用户交换分片。下载完成后，它会像其他下载一样停止。如果您想继续分享，可以在“选项”中开启<g1>下载完成后继续共享种子</g1>。

50f84dc9b1b44c26.source: <g1>Options → Remote</g1> lists the paired devices, when each was paired and when it was last seen. Select one and click <g2>Remove</g2>: it is refused from its next request on, at once (no need for <g3>OK</g3>). On the phone, the page's <g4>⋮ → Forget this device</g4> does the same from that side.
50f84dc9b1b44c26.text: <g1>选项 → 远程</g1>列出了已配对的设备，以及每个设备的配对时间和上次看到的时间。选择一个并点击<g2>删除</g2>：它会立即被拒绝从下一次请求开始（无需点击<g3>确定</g3>）。在手机上，页面的<g4>⋮ → 忘记此设备</g4>会从该侧执行相同的操作。

5107132bc8835d92.text: 不带安装程序的程序文件

511729ecf9bdc1e4.source: Corner radius of a glossy push button (Luna, Aero; Aqua's are round at the ends)
511729ecf9bdc1e4.text: 光泽按钮的圆角半径 (Luna, Aero；Aqua 的两端是圆的)

512dc95b692cf4ac.source: Firefox 140 or later is needed. Install the add-on from its page on addons.mozilla.org, <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>: click <g2>Add to Firefox</g2>. Firefox keeps it updated. Zen and LibreWolf install it from the same page. (DDM's <g3>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g3> window opens that page for you.)
512dc95b692cf4ac.text: 需要 Firefox 140 或更高版本。从 addons.mozilla.org 上的 <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> 页面安装附加组件：点击<g2>添加到 Firefox</g2>。Firefox 会自动更新此扩展。Zen 和 LibreWolf 也从同一页面安装。（DDM 的<g3>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g3>窗口会为您打开该页面。）

512f824da85ef410.source: Point each category's folder at the stick.
512f824da85ef410.text: 将每个类别的文件夹指向U盘。

5137278f15d2d067.source: It does not hold your download addresses or file names, and your user name shows as <x1/> in folder paths. If an error message quotes something you typed, that text is in it, which is why you read it first.
5137278f15d2d067.text: 它不包含您的下载地址或文件名，并且您的用户名在文件夹路径中显示为<x1/>。如果错误消息引用了您输入的内容，则该文本会包含在内，这就是您需要先阅读它的原因。

513950a1b23ca382.source: This needs nothing more from you: the extension already sees what the browser downloads in order to hand downloads over. What it notes stays in the browser's memory and is forgotten when the browser closes.
513950a1b23ca382.text: 无需您进行其他操作：扩展程序为了接管下载，已经能查看浏览器下载的内容。它记录的信息只保存在浏览器内存中，关闭浏览器后就会清除。

5142bcccd6f76480.source: Crash reports name functions from the release's symbol files only, without the debug-info reader a build from source can add.
5142bcccd6f76480.text: 崩溃报告仅列出发布符号文件中的函数名称，不包含从源代码构建时可能添加的调试信息读取器。

5143892c1fb73010.source: explains the key terms (download, queue, category, connection, resume…). Translate each one the same way everywhere, the way Windows says it in your language. <x1/> is each language's style guide: how it writes commands, questions and labels, and the terms reviewers settled.
5143892c1fb73010.text: 解释了关键术语（下载、队列、类别、连接、恢复……）。请在所有地方都以相同的方式翻译每个术语，就像 Windows 在您的语言中表达它们一样。<x1/> 是每种语言的风格指南：它如何编写命令、问题和标签，以及审阅者确定的术语。

514cb54301cc574e.source: Several links, or a <x1/> or <x2/> list, dropped on the download list.
514cb54301cc574e.text: 将多个链接，或一个<x1/>或<x2/>链接列表，拖放到下载列表中。

515a83af9303e699.source: Everything that would be sent is in the window, under <g1>The report</g1>. You can add a few words under <g2>What were you doing when it happened?</g2>, such as "I opened Add URL".
515a83af9303e699.text: 所有将要发送的内容都在窗口中，位于<g1>报告</g1>下方。您可以在<g2>发生时您正在做什么？</g2>下方添加一些文字，例如“我打开了添加 URL”。

515b8682acc68acc.source: <g1>Toolbar buttons</g1> have as much room under their label as above their icon when the pointer is over them.
515b8682acc68acc.text: <g1>工具栏按钮</g1>在指针悬停时，标签下方的留白与图标上方的留白相同。

5163e8751025931b.source: Dannex Download Manager's main window in day mode: web and torrent downloads in one list, with categories, sizes, progress, speeds and dates.
5163e8751025931b.text: Dannex Download Manager 白天模式的主窗口：网页和种子下载显示在同一列表中，并列出类别、大小、进度、速度和日期。

516561d3a23e6ed6.source: <g1>Your system's copy:</g1> on Linux and macOS, DDM finds a gallery-dl on your <x2/> and in the usual package-manager folders, including Homebrew's, as it does yt-dlp. A program you chose yourself comes first, then DDM's own copy; the system's is used when neither is there, and your package manager keeps it up to date. If yours is too old for a site, <g3>Use DDM's own copy</g3> in <g4>Helpers...</g4> downloads DDM's (Windows and Linux x86-64), used from then on.
516561d3a23e6ed6.text: <g1>您系统的副本：</g1> 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 会在您的 <x2/> 以及包括 Homebrew 在内的常用包管理器文件夹中查找 gallery-dl，就像它查找 yt-dlp 一样。您自己选择的程序优先，然后是 DDM 自己的副本；当两者都不存在时，则使用系统的副本，并且您的包管理器会使其保持最新。如果您的版本对于某个网站来说太旧，可以在<g4>帮助程序...</g4>中选择<g3>使用 DDM 自带的副本</g3>来下载 DDM 的版本（Windows 和 Linux x86-64），此后将使用该版本。

516ac76d50ca3536.source: Set <g1>Run [N] downloads at once</g1>. Four is the default. Use 1 to download them one by one.
516ac76d50ca3536.text: 设置<g1>同时运行 [N] 个下载</g1>。默认是四个。设为 1 则逐个下载。

51737b403701b688.source: In the <g1>Categories</g1> tree, <g2>Up</g2> / <g3>Down</g3> choose a node, <g4>Left</g4> / <g5>Right</g5> close and open a branch, and <g6>Home</g6> / <g7>End</g7> go to the first / last node.
51737b403701b688.text: 在<g1>类别</g1>树中，<g2>向上</g2> / <g3>向下</g3>选择节点，<g4>向左</g4> / <g5>向右</g5>关闭和打开分支，<g6>Home</g6> / <g7>End</g7>转到第一个/最后一个节点。

517fce798c7b5d96.source: <g1>Shift+Delete's answer was remembered</g1>: after one Shift+Delete, a plain Delete with "Don't show again" erased files from disk. Shift+Delete now works on macOS and Linux too.
517fce798c7b5d96.text: <g1>Shift+Delete 的选择被记住了</g1>：按过一次 Shift+Delete 后，普通 Delete 会记住“不再显示”的选择，并从磁盘中删除文件。现在，macOS 和 Linux 也支持 Shift+Delete。

519a21a3a4e201d9.source: It comes with every download of DDM, next to the app (the installer puts it in DDM's folder). It works on its own: the app needn't run, except for <x1/> and <x2/>.
519a21a3a4e201d9.text: 每次下载 DDM 时都会附带此程序，放在应用程序旁边（安装程序会将它放在 DDM 文件夹中）。它可以独立运行：除了 <x1/> 和 <x2/> 外，无需运行应用程序。

51a9156ec9109466.source: IDM takes about three seconds to accept a download from its command line before it sends anything; downloads caught by its browser extension skip that step. That is why "Transfer" is the fair engine-to-engine view. "End to end" is here too.
51a9156ec9109466.text: IDM 从命令行接收下载任务后，约需 3 秒才开始发送数据；通过浏览器扩展捕获的下载则会跳过这一步。因此，“传输”更适合公平地比较两款软件的下载引擎。“端到端”的数据也列在这里。

52133c0660c19284.text: 下载加速与防崩溃续传 — Dannex Download Manager

521664f83beca8c4.source: Yes. DDM writes its progress as it goes, so after a lost connection, a crash or a restart it carries on where it stopped. Before resuming it checks that the…
521664f83beca8c4.text: 可以。DDM 会实时记录下载进度，因此在连接中断、程序崩溃或重启后，它会从停止的地方继续下载。在恢复下载之前，它会检查…

5219e2cf29deff54.source: <g1>Windows</g1>: in <g2>Windows Credential Manager</g2> (Control Panel → Credential Manager → Windows Credentials), as entries named <x3/>, for your Windows account. They roam with your profile, as DDM's settings folder does.
5219e2cf29deff54.text: <g1>Windows</g1>：在<g2>Windows 凭据管理器</g2>（控制面板 → 凭据管理器 → Windows 凭据）中，作为名为<x3/>的条目，用于您的 Windows 账户。它们会随您的配置文件漫游，就像 DDM 的设置文件夹一样。

521c77988a37435f.source: The main window's toolbar and categories in the Adwaita theme
521c77988a37435f.text: 主窗口的工具栏和类别采用 Adwaita 主题

52265d109183c603.source: DDM runs only once. Starting it again brings the running copy's window to the front. If nothing appears, look for DDM's icon in the notification area.
52265d109183c603.text: DDM 只会运行一个实例。再次启动时，会将已运行实例的窗口置于前台。如果没有窗口显示，请在通知区域查找 DDM 图标。

522cbce90def0bbb.source: <g1>File Properties</g1> shows a download's type, status, size and folder, its address, your description, the web page it came from, the <g2>Referer</g2> it is sent with, where it comes from (<g3>Server</g3>: its server's <g4>country and round trip</g4> as its last run saw them, a video's site and yt-dlp, or a torrent's peers; no line before it has run) and a login for the site. For an unfinished download, <g5>Last try</g5> and <g6>Result</g6> tell you how its last attempt went.
522cbce90def0bbb.text: <g1>文件属性</g1>显示下载的类型、状态、大小和文件夹、其地址、您的描述、其来源网页、随之发送的<g2>引用页</g2>、其来源（<g3>服务器</g3>：上次运行所见的服务器<g4>所在国家和往返时间</g4>、视频的站点和 yt-dlp，或种子的节点；运行之前没有这一行）以及站点的登录信息。对于未完成的下载，<g5>上次尝试</g5>和<g6>结果</g6>会告诉您上一次尝试的情况。

52434a6b584524ff.source: <g1>Windows 11's look in light mode</g1>: rounded text boxes and drop-downs (no more black corner dots), pressed states on every button (issue #7), focus rings only when you use the keyboard, tooltips with Windows 11's corners and padding, and dark mode in every window.

555ae1af216d6aa9.text: <g1>工具栏。</g1><g2>添加 URL</g2>、<g3>添加 Torrent</g3>、<g4>恢复</g4>、<g5>停止</g5>、<g6>停止所有</g6>、<g7>删除</g7>、<g8>删除已完成</g8>、<g9>选项</g9>、<g10>计划程序</g10>、<g11>启动队列</g11>、<g12>停止队列</g12>、<g13>站点抓取器</g13>（即<g14>站点抓取器</g14>）。<g15>添加 Torrent</g15>、<g16>启动队列</g16>和<g17>停止队列</g17>是拆分按钮：按钮执行常规操作，其右侧的箭头（将鼠标指向它时会单独亮起，并带有提示）会打开更多选择。相同的选择也在<g18>任务</g18>和<g19>下载</g19>中。

557accf0aacea5ac.source: Link grabber listing the links of a page in packages, with their names, sizes and whether they are online
557accf0aacea5ac.text: 链接抓取器列出页面中的链接包，包括它们的名称、大小以及是否在线

55941e6d91b9a45c.source: What a copy can't do: run what needs the site (searches, forms, logins), or show what a page's scripts would have fetched. Some browsers refuse scripts written as modules (<x1/>) from the disk.
55941e6d91b9a45c.text: 副本无法做到的事：运行需要网站的功能（搜索、表单、登录），或显示页面脚本本会获取的内容。有些浏览器会拒绝从磁盘加载以模块形式编写的脚本（<x1/>）。

559f1edb4136e9ae.source: End to end: command to finished file
559f1edb4136e9ae.text: 端到端：从发出命令到文件下载完成

55bb7652c732e417.source: The browser and DDM aren't connected
55bb7652c732e417.text: 浏览器和 DDM 未连接

55df82a395f7d69e.source: PDFs, music and videos the browser would open itself, and downloads from forms, go to DDM too. Hold <g1>Alt</g1> while clicking to let the browser have one.
55df82a395f7d69e.text: 浏览器会自行打开的 PDF、音乐和视频，以及来自表单的下载，也会发送到 DDM。在点击时按住<g1>Alt</g1>键，可让浏览器自行处理。

55ea9ba59e0259e8.source: <g1>No breaking of copy protection.</g1> DDM doesn't remove or get around DRM, and isn't meant to. Protected content stays protected.
55ea9ba59e0259e8.text: <g1>不破解版权保护。</g1> DDM 不会移除或绕过 DRM，也无意如此。受保护的内容仍然受保护。

55ecea9df3d3ed23.source: Paste the address of a playlist (<x1/>) or a channel's videos (<x2/>) and click <g3>Look up</g3>. Instead of one video's qualities, the window lists the list's videos, each with its length.
55ecea9df3d3ed23.text: 粘贴播放列表 (<x1/>) 或频道视频 (<x2/>) 的地址，然后点击 <g3>查找</g3>。窗口不会显示单个视频的画质选项，而会列出播放列表中的视频及其时长。

55ed1ee9aa561a5a.source: Made something others would like? Open a <g1>pull request on GitHub</g1> that adds it to <g2><x3/></g2>, with:
55ed1ee9aa561a5a.text: 制作了其他人可能会喜欢的主题？在 <g1>GitHub 上提交拉取请求</g1>，将其添加到 <g2><x3/></g2>，并附带：

55fc68b1cae6ed7f.source: <g1>pywal itself:</g1> once <x2/> has run, <g3>View → Theme</g3> lists <g4>pywal</g4>, read straight from where pywal writes its colours: <x5/> (on Windows <x6/>, where winwal and pywal write it; <x7/> or <x8/> when you set them). Pick it and DDM follows your wallpaper: each time <x9/> writes new colours, DDM takes them within two seconds. It looks only at the file's date and size, every two seconds, and only while pywal is the theme. A copy added with <g10>Add a theme file…</g10> keeps the colours it had.
55fc68b1cae6ed7f.text: <g1>pywal 本身：</g1> 一旦 <x2/> 运行，<g3>视图 → 主题</g3> 会列出 <g4>pywal</g4>，直接从 pywal 写入颜色的位置读取：<x5/>（在 Windows 上是 <x6/>，winwal 和 pywal 写入此处；如果您设置了 <x7/> 或 <x8/>，则为这些位置）。选择它，DDM 就会跟随您的壁纸：每次 <x9/> 写入新颜色时，DDM 都会在两秒内获取。它每两秒只查看文件日期和大小，并且仅在 pywal 是主题时。通过 <g10>添加主题文件…</g10> 添加的副本会保留其原有的颜色。

563e2c60c4e8248b.source: <g1>Torrents through your debrid account</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>): with <g3>Send torrents and magnet links to the first account instead of to peers</g3> ticked (<g4>Options → Accounts</g4>), a magnet link or a <x5/> file goes to the account. Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Premiumize download the torrent on their servers, and the list shows how far they are (<g6>45% at Real-Debrid</g6>). DDM then downloads its files over HTTP, with all its connections and resume, and removes the torrent from the account's list. Your computer never connects to the torrent's peers. Experimental, as the accounts are.
563e2c60c4e8248b.text: <g1>通过您的网盘账户下载种子</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>)：勾选<g3>将种子和磁力链接发送到第一个账户而不是对等点</g3>（<g4>选项 → 账户</g4>）后，磁力链接或 <x5/> 文件会发送到该账户。Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 和 Premiumize 会在其服务器上下载种子，列表会显示下载进度（<g6>Real-Debrid 上 45%</g6>）。DDM 随后通过 HTTP 下载其文件，支持所有连接和断点续传，并从账户列表中移除该种子。您的计算机永远不会连接到种子的对等点。此功能为实验性，与账户功能一样。

56417f54e14c905b.source: Have the links already, in a text file? <g1>Tasks → Import → From text file</g1> reads every web address in it, and you untick the ones you don't want. <g2>From IDM export file</g2> reads an <x3/> list, with each download's referrer and cookies, so a list exported from IDM comes over with what its downloads need. You can also drop a <x4/> or <x5/> list on the download list.
56417f54e14c905b.text: 已经有文本文件中的链接了？<g1>任务 → 导入 → 从文本文件</g1>会读取其中的每个网址，您可以取消勾选不想要的链接。<g2>从 IDM 导出文件</g2>会读取一个<x3/>列表，其中包含每个下载的引用页和 Cookie，因此从 IDM 导出的列表会随其下载所需的信息一同导入。您也可以将<x4/>或<x5/>列表拖放到下载列表中。

564813465e6f19c2.source: <g1>Right-click the page → Download all videos and audio with DDM</g1> opens, in Link grabber, the page's players and links to such files, and the files its players played without naming them.
564813465e6f19c2.text: <g1>右键单击页面 → 使用 DDM 下载所有视频和音频</g1>会在链接抓取器中打开页面上的播放器和指向此类文件的链接，以及其播放器未标明名称而播放过的文件。

5662a2d0e8ae7225.source: <g1>Dates and times</g1> in the list (<g2>Last Try Date</g2>, <g3>Added</g3>), the Scheduler and Statistics are written the way the interface language writes them, as numbers are: German <x4/> and <x5/>, Arabic <x6/> (Unicode CLDR's conventions). When your system's region is in that same language, its own formats win (on Windows <g7>Settings → Time & language → Language & region → Regional format</g7>). In English they follow the system's region, and the list keeps IDM's own date text (<x8/>), on the system's 12- or 24-hour clock (<x9/>). Your own date order, clock and first day of the week in <g10>Options → Regional</g10> win over both.
5662a2d0e8ae7225.text: 列表中的<g1>日期和时间</g1>（<g2>上次尝试日期</g2>、<g3>已添加</g3>）、计划程序和统计信息，按界面语言的写法书写，数字也一样：德语 <x4/> 和 <x5/>，阿拉伯语 <x6/>（Unicode CLDR 的约定）。当您系统的区域使用同一种语言时，以其自己的格式为准（在 Windows 上为<g7>设置 → 时间和语言 → 语言和区域 → 区域格式</g7>）。英语则遵循系统区域，列表保留 IDM 自己的日期文字（<x8/>），按系统的 12 或 24 小时制（<x9/>）。您在<g10>选项 → 区域</g10>中自己设置的日期顺序、时钟和每周第一天，优先于以上两者。

566b1720d3f6ccac.source: DDM isn't installed, or browser integration isn't set up
566b1720d3f6ccac.text: DDM 未安装，或浏览器集成未设置

5672aa47684fc0f8.source: Lines starting with <x1/> are notes for translators: where the text appears and what it means.
5672aa47684fc0f8.text: 以<x1/>开头的行是给译者的注释，说明文本出现的位置及其含义。

56779d1d50b86d0f.source: <g1>Linux</g1>: install the <g2>.deb</g2> with <x3/> (Debian, Ubuntu, Mint) or the <g4>.rpm</g4> with <x5/> (Fedora), and the packages bring what DDM needs. Or make the <g6>AppImage</g6> executable (<x7/>) and run it. DDM connects itself to your browsers at each start; then add the extension from your browser's store, above. <g8>More in the help</g8>.
56779d1d50b86d0f.text: <g1>Linux</g1>：使用 <x3/> 安装 <g2>.deb</g2>（Debian、Ubuntu、Mint）或使用 <x5/> 安装 <g4>.rpm</g4>（Fedora），这些软件包会带来 DDM 所需的依赖。或者将 <g6>AppImage</g6> 设置为可执行文件（<x7/>）并运行。DDM 每次启动时都会自动连接到您的浏览器；然后从上面您浏览器的商店添加扩展。 <g8>更多信息请查阅帮助</g8>。

567f61dda0920579.text: 灰色未选中复选框的边框

5680c010be7aa6b1.source: If your antivirus quarantined DDM, restore it and add an exception for its folder. If it flags something other than the setup or DDM's own programs, or a copy from anywhere else, don't run it, and please <g1>tell us</g1>.
5680c010be7aa6b1.text: 如果您的杀毒软件隔离了 DDM，请恢复它并为其文件夹添加例外。如果它标记了安装程序或 DDM 自身程序以外的内容，或者来自其他来源的副本，请不要运行它，并<g1>告知我们</g1>。

56a440bc7aa24cf3.source: Your language, from the first window.
56a440bc7aa24cf3.text: 从第一个窗口开始，就是您的语言。

56c991946fe8d471.source: To continue a stopped download, select it and click <g1>Resume</g1> on the toolbar (or <g2>File → Download Now</g2>).
56c991946fe8d471.text: 要继续已停止的下载，请选择该下载，然后点击工具栏上的<g1>恢复</g1>（或选择<g2>文件 → 立即下载</g2>）。

56cc0ee76be4673e.source: You can add your own queues in the Scheduler, or with <g1>Create new queue</g1> in a download's right-click menu.
56cc0ee76be4673e.text: 您可以在“计划程序”中添加自己的队列，或者通过下载右键菜单中的<g1>创建新队列</g1>来添加。

56d8787819039809.source: <g1>Ready before you click.</g1> When the pointer reaches the button, or rests for a moment over the video on that video's own page (a YouTube watch page, for example, never a feed or YouTube Shorts), DDM starts looking the video up already, so its list is often ready when the menu opens. One look-up at a time. It starts only while DDM isn't looking up another video, and stops when you leave the page. In a private window nothing is looked up before you click.
56d8787819039809.text: <g1>在您单击之前就绪。</g1>当指针移到按钮上，或在该视频自己的页面（例如 YouTube 观看页，绝不是动态消息或 YouTube Shorts）上的视频上停留片刻时，DDM 就会开始查找该视频，因此菜单打开时其列表通常已经就绪。一次只查找一个。它仅在 DDM 没有在查找另一个视频时才开始，并在您离开页面时停止。在隐私窗口中，在您单击之前不会查找任何内容。

56e24f6222e629f5.source: is the theme yours starts from: <x1/> (the default), <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>, or another theme file in the same folder.

56f407c985b086ad.source: Adds a download, as the command line's <x1/> do (<x2/> is <x3/>); <x4/>. <x5/> (a key from the list's <x6/>) puts it in that category's folder instead of the one its type picks; <x7/> (a queue's name) is the queue it waits in with <x8/>. Also with the API off, like the command line.
56f407c985b086ad.text: 添加下载，如同命令行中的 <x1/>（<x2/> 是 <x3/>）；<x4/>。<x5/>（列表中的 <x6/> 键）将其放入该类别的文件夹，而不是其类型选择的文件夹；<x7/>（队列名称）是它与 <x8/> 一起等待的队列。在 API 关闭时也可用，如同命令行。

5704b78ea54419dd.source: Click <g1>Add URL</g1> and paste the gallery's address, for example <x2/>.
5704b78ea54419dd.text: 点击<g1>添加 URL</g1> 并粘贴图库地址，例如 <x2/>。

571e5a5e3923ac85.source: When a download comes from a form you submitted, it passes <g1>the form's data</g1> too, so DDM can submit it again. It notes the data of forms you submit (in memory, used for two minutes at most, never stored) only for that.
571e5a5e3923ac85.text: 当下载来自您提交的表单时，它也会传递<g1>表单数据</g1>，以便 DDM 可以再次提交。它只为此目的记录您提交的表单数据（在内存中，最多使用两分钟，从不存储）。

5726cb36c6fd92b6.source: Benchmark: Dannex Download Manager vs IDM, timed to the millisecond
5726cb36c6fd92b6.text: 基准测试：Dannex Download Manager 对比 IDM，精确到毫秒

57271fd14fc7d6ce.source: The main window on Windows 11: the toolbar, the categories on the left and the download list on the right
57271fd14fc7d6ce.text: Windows 11 上的主窗口：工具栏、左侧的类别和右侧的下载列表

572eaa88b689dd90.source: Wait for the list. It shows each resolution with its size, best first, then the sound alone: - <g1>Audio only, original</g1>: the site's own file, not converted (M4A, or WebM with Opus inside, as the site serves it). The best sound there is, in the smallest file. - <g2>Audio only MP3</g2> at its best variable bitrate (VBR) and at 320, 256, 192 and 128 kbps, for players that only take MP3. - <g3>Audio only OPUS</g3>: an <x4/> file. When the site's sound is Opus already (YouTube's usually is), it's only moved into that file, not converted, so nothing is lost. - <g5>Audio only FLAC</g5>: a lossless <x6/> file, for a library or a program that wants FLAC. It can't add quality: the site's sound is already compressed with losses, and FLAC keeps it exactly as it came, in a file several times bigger. The window says so when you choose it.
572eaa88b689dd90.text: 等待列表加载。列表会按画质从高到低显示各分辨率和对应的文件大小，之后列出纯音频选项：- <g1>仅音频，原始</g1>：网站提供的原始文件，不经过转换（网站提供的是 M4A，或包含 Opus 音频的 WebM）。这是音质最好的选项，文件也最小。- <g2>仅音频 MP3</g2>：提供最佳可变比特率（VBR），以及 320、256、192 和 128 kbps，适用于只支持 MP3 的播放器。- <g3>仅音频 OPUS</g3>：一个 <x4/> 文件。如果网站提供的音频已经是 Opus（YouTube 通常如此），只需将它封装到该文件中，无需转换，因此不会损失音质。- <g5>仅音频 FLAC</g5>：无损 <x6/> 文件，适用于音乐库或需要 FLAC 的程序。它无法提升音质：网站提供的音频已经过有损压缩，FLAC 会原样保留音频，但文件会大几倍。选择此选项时，窗口会显示这一点。

5730437f2b40d7c8.source: You can also <g1>open the form yourself</g1>; it asks for the same details.
5730437f2b40d7c8.text: 你也可以<g1>自行打开表单</g1>；它会要求相同的详细信息。

5745722d36271493.source: The log records what DDM does, so a report can show what led to a problem. To log more detail, start DDM with the environment variable <x1/>.
5745722d36271493.text: 日志会记录 DDM 的操作，因此报告可以显示问题的起因。要记录更详细的信息，请使用环境变量<x1/>启动 DDM。

575ae202ce45ffc4.source: Files named photo001.jpg to photo150.jpg don't need 150 clicks. Write the address once with an asterisk where the number changes, and DDM queues every file. A list of links in a text file goes in just as easily.
575ae202ce45ffc4.text: 名为 photo001.jpg 到 photo150.jpg 的文件不需要点击 150 次。只需将地址中的数字变化部分用星号代替，DDM 就会将所有文件加入队列。文本文件中的链接列表也能同样轻松地导入。

57a2e56d39e0a778.source: <g1>Needs a login</g1>: the server wants a user name and password, or the page's cookies.
57a2e56d39e0a778.text: <g1>需要登录</g1>：服务器需要用户名和密码，或需要页面的 Cookie。

57df30288a29fe94.source: Made possible by these amazing humans
57df30288a29fe94.text: 由这些杰出人士倾力打造

57f7a41f3d7829f5.source: A video or a gallery takes a limit of its own the same way. For a torrent, the limit is that torrent's alone; the others keep theirs. A torrent can't be held under 16 KBytes/sec: a lower limit gives it 16.
57f7a41f3d7829f5.text: 视频或图片库同样有自己的限制。对于种子文件，限制仅适用于该种子文件；其他文件保持其各自的限制。种子文件的速度不能低于 16 千字节/秒：如果设置了更低的限制，它将自动调整为 16 千字节/秒。

5806d295f81ae413.text: IDM 的：工具栏、分类、列表

5807d89f8c08086c.source: <g1>Then move the archives to the Recycle Bin</g1> (off by default; the Trash on macOS and Linux) — after a successful extraction only. This is also the default of a new package's <g2>Delete archives after extracting</g2>.
5807d89f8c08086c.text: <g1>然后将存档移至回收站</g1>（默认关闭；在 macOS 和 Linux 上移至废纸篓）— 仅在成功提取后移动。这也是新建包的<g2>提取后删除存档</g2>选项的默认设置。

580e5e398c356ab0.source: DDM doesn't use a temporary folder: every connection writes straight into the final file's place, so there is nothing to put together at the end.
580e5e398c356ab0.text: DDM 不使用临时文件夹：每个连接都直接写入最终文件所在的位置，因此最后无需进行任何组合。

5825a9c27ba24869.source: <g1><g2>Keyboard shortcuts</g2></g1> — every key the main window answers, and screen readers.
5825a9c27ba24869.text: <g1><g2>键盘快捷方式</g2></g1> — 主窗口响应的每个按键，以及屏幕阅读器。

584697d876791ed0.source: <g1>Download video</g1> finds the video on pages whose player loads a <x2/> or <x3/> address that answers something else first, as SVT Play does (<g4>#377</g4>).
584697d876791ed0.text: 在 SVT Play 等网站上，<g1>下载视频</g1> 功能可以找到播放器加载 <x2/> 或 <x3/> 地址但首先响应其他内容的页面上的视频（<g4>#377</g4>）。

584cc45dc137daf3.text: 一个星号，一个完整系列

587c035cfef7393d.source: Download complete: Open the file, or Open folder.
587c035cfef7393d.text: 下载完成：打开文件，或打开文件夹。

588db309f4fc3eb6.source: <g1>Medium</g1> (amber): 60 to 150 ms, usually the same continent.
588db309f4fc3eb6.text: <g1>中</g1>（琥珀色）：60 到 150 毫秒，通常是同一大陆。

589ba88a30d884f3.source: Installed; <g1>It's turned off, so downloads stay in this browser.</g1>
589ba88a30d884f3.text: 已安装；<g1>已关闭，因此下载将保留在此浏览器中。</g1>

58aa7b36900be93c.source: DDM listens for the browser before its window is up, and the browser's helper waits 20 seconds for a slow first start instead of 5.
58aa7b36900be93c.text: DDM 在其窗口启动前监听浏览器，并且浏览器辅助程序会等待 20 秒以应对首次启动缓慢的情况，而不是 5 秒。

58bc1f5f43802ddb.source: Dannex Download Manager — the download manager you already know, rebuilt to be faster
58bc1f5f43802ddb.text: Dannex Download Manager — 您已熟悉的下载管理器，经重新构建，速度更快

58cb91129ec3a7fd.source: Free for everyone, forever. No sign-up, no ads, nothing bundled.
58cb91129ec3a7fd.text: 永久免费。无需注册，没有广告，也不捆绑其他软件。

58cda5d98d58da82.source: Windows: DDM no longer crashes ("crash in ntdll.dll", the heap corrupted) when the clipboard is read in two places at once, as when <g1>Add URL</g1> opened while the clipboard monitor was looking for a copied link. Windows lets the parts of one program open the clipboard together, and their reads spoiled each other's data; DDM's reads and writes of the clipboard, a paste or copy in a text box included, now go one at a time (<g2>#629</g2>).
58cda5d98d58da82.text: Windows：当剪贴板在两个地方同时被读取时，DDM 不再崩溃（“crash in ntdll.dll”，堆损坏），例如<g1>添加 URL</g1>在剪贴板监视器正在查找复制的链接时打开。Windows 允许同一程序的各部分一起打开剪贴板，它们的读取会弄坏彼此的数据；现在 DDM 对剪贴板的读取和写入，包括文本框中的粘贴或复制，都一个接一个地进行（<g2>#629</g2>）。

592f898c79b39c3a.source: A download falls into a category by its file type: <g1>General</g1>, <g2>Compressed</g2>, <g3>Documents</g3>, <g4>Music</g4>, <g5>Programs</g5> or <g6>Video</g6>, and torrents into <g7>Torrents</g7>. Each category has its own folder inside your Downloads folder, so a ZIP file lands in <x8/> and a film in <x9/> without you choosing.
592f898c79b39c3a.text: 下载文件会根据其文件类型归入相应类别：<g1>常规</g1>、<g2>压缩文件</g2>、<g3>文档</g3>、<g4>音乐</g4>、<g5>程序</g5> 或 <g6>视频</g6>，种子文件则归入<g7>种子</g7>。每个类别在您的“下载”文件夹中都有自己的子文件夹，因此 ZIP 文件会自动存入<x8/>，电影文件会自动存入<x9/>，无需您手动选择。

5931ce0e4ef63e2e.source: In Chrome, Edge and Brave you can limit an extension to some sites (right-click its toolbar button → <g1>This can read and change site data</g1>), and in Firefox take its access away in <g2>Add-ons and themes</g2> → the extension → <g3>Permissions</g3>. On a site it may not read, the extension can't pass your sign-in on, so it leaves the download to the browser. Choose <g4>On all sites</g4> to let DDM take downloads everywhere, or click <g5>Allow on all sites</g5> on the extension's status page (right-click its toolbar button → <g6>Help</g6>), which asks the browser for it.
5931ce0e4ef63e2e.text: 在 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 中，您可以将扩展限制在部分站点上（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g1>此扩展可读取和更改网站数据</g1>）；在 Firefox 中，可在<g2>附加组件和主题</g2> → 该扩展 → <g3>权限</g3>中收回其访问权限。在扩展无权读取的站点上，它无法传递您的登录状态，因此会将下载留给浏览器。选择<g4>在所有网站上</g4>可让 DDM 在所有位置接管下载，也可以单击扩展状态页（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g6>帮助</g6>）上的<g5>允许访问所有站点</g5>，由它向浏览器申请该权限。

5934223575270924.text: 在<g1>下载文件信息</g1>中：<g2>开始下载</g2>

59ac25a9efc19719.source: <g1>The browser extension's popup</g1> shows DDM's downloads as they run (progress, speed, time left) with <g2>Pause</g2>, <g3>Resume</g3> and <g4>Pause all</g4>, and opens a finished file's folder; an <g5>Add URL</g5> box sends a link to DDM; the toolbar button counts the downloads running; and the page's right-click menu adds <g6>Download all images</g6> and <g7>Download all videos and audio with DDM</g7>.

59d5983b5e65fbf4.text: 从 GitHub 的公共 API 读取谁发起了拉取请求和问题，以及谁发表了评论（维护者、Claude 和机器人除外），用于感谢他们的所有地方：网站主页、<x1/> 和新闻页面上的每个版本（<x2/>，在每个构建中），每个版本的发布说明（<x3/>，自上一个版本以来活跃的人员）以及 README（<x4/> 在每个版本准备时：其圆形照片提交在 <x5/> 中，因为 GitHub 无法在 README 中将图片设为圆形）。

5a064da37f8e1603.source: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, is the main platform. Builds for Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz) and macOS (.dmg) come with every release too; today's are marked experimental. From version {v1}, Linux isn't experimental any more: it is checked on GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce and Cinnamon, in Wayland sessions too, and its packages in clean Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora systems. Still to come there: the Flatpak Firefox isn't checked yet, and screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows yet. macOS stays experimental. See Windows, Mac and Linux and Download.
5a064da37f8e1603.text: Windows 10 和 11（64 位）是主要平台。每个版本也提供 Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm 和 .tar.gz) 和 macOS (.dmg) 版本；目前这些版本标记为实验性。从 {v1} 版本开始，Linux 不再是实验性：它已在 GNOME、KDE Plasma、Xfce 和 Cinnamon（包括 Wayland 会话）以及纯净的 Ubuntu、Debian 和 Fedora 系统上进行过检查。仍有待完成：Flatpak Firefox 尚未检查，屏幕阅读器 (Orca) 尚无法读取 DDM 的窗口。macOS 仍保持实验性。请参阅 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 以及下载。

5a12212d82e05e3f.source: All of this needs a notification area that shows DDM's icon. Windows and macOS have one, and so do most Linux desktops (KDE, GNOME with its AppIndicator extension, waybar's tray). On a desktop without one, DDM starts minimized instead, closing the window quits DDM, and <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> is greyed. In a Wayland session the main window stays minimized in the dock, because Wayland can't hide a window.
5a12212d82e05e3f.text: 所有这些功能都需要一个显示 DDM 图标的通知区域。Windows 和 macOS 都有，大多数 Linux 桌面（KDE、带有 AppIndicator 扩展的 GNOME、waybar 的托盘）也都有。在没有通知区域的桌面上，DDM 会改为最小化启动，关闭窗口会退出 DDM，并且<g1>最小化到通知区域</g1>会显示为灰色。在 Wayland 会话中，主窗口会保持最小化在 Dock 中，因为 Wayland 无法隐藏窗口。

A login typed there still goes first (<g4>#511</g4>).
5a134281facdcd3a.text: <g1>输入要下载的新地址</g1>：在<g2>选项 → 站点登录</g2>中有登录信息的地址，会在<g3>使用授权</g3>下显示该登录信息（已勾选，含用户名和密码），也就是下载所用的那一个；此前它被使用了，但框是空的。在那里输入的登录信息仍然优先（<g4>#511</g4>）。

5b73bbad81c22538.source: While the queue runs, the computer doesn't go to sleep. When the queue is done, the computer's own sleep settings apply again: a computer nobody is using goes back to sleep by itself. <g1>When done, turn off the computer → Sleep</g1> sends it back to sleep at once.

5be3281803390e1e.source: <g1>The window no longer freezes when the system's sleep or keychain service is slow</g1> (follows <g2>#222</g2>): a queue set to <g3>Wake the computer to run this queue</g3> asks the system to keep the computer awake while it runs. On Linux that is logind, which can be slow to answer just after the computer wakes, exactly when such a queue starts, and DDM waited for it on the window's own thread (asking again every 5 seconds while it refused). It is now asked in the background, on every system; the queue's downloads, retries and log lines are the same. A keyring that doesn't answer at start (a stopped GNOME Keyring) is now waited for once, at most 5 seconds, instead of once per saved password, and saving the list no longer asks it at all. On Linux the check for a tray to hide windows in, and in Download File Info the check that <g4>Save As</g4> isn't a folder (slow on a network share that doesn't answer), no longer run on the window's thread on every frame.
5be3281803390e1e.text: <g1>当系统睡眠或密钥链服务缓慢时，窗口不再冻结</g1>（继<g2>#222</g2>之后）：设置为<g3>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g3>的队列会请求系统在运行时保持电脑唤醒。在 Linux 上，这是 logind，它在电脑唤醒后（正是此类队列启动时）响应可能会很慢，而 DDM 会在窗口自己的线程上等待它（如果它拒绝，则每 5 秒再次询问）。现在它会在后台请求，在所有系统上都是如此；队列的下载、重试和日志行保持不变。对于启动时没有响应的密钥环（已停止的 GNOME Keyring），现在只会等待一次，最多 5 秒，而不是每个保存的密码等待一次，并且保存列表时根本不再询问它。在 Linux 上，检查是否有托盘可以隐藏窗口，以及在“下载文件信息”中检查<g4>另存为</g4>是否不是文件夹（在没有响应的网络共享上会很慢），不再在窗口的线程上每帧运行。

5bf587c2bc605e37.source: The Categories pane: All Downloads with a category per file type, Unfinished, Finished and Queues
5bf587c2bc605e37.text: 类别窗格：所有下载（按文件类型分类）、未完成、已完成和队列

5c2835f4bf5e979e.source: <g1>List rows sit inside their list</g1> (<g2>#102</g2>): they used to be listed beside it. A screen reader now says which row of how many ("4 of 12"), choosing from the list itself works (UI Automation's Selection), and a tree's check box belongs to its file's row. The language picker's list and the Options browser list and the Scheduler's two lists have names now too.
5c2835f4bf5e979e.text: <g1>列表行现在位于其列表内部</g1> (<g2>#102</g2>)：以前它们是并排显示的。现在屏幕阅读器会说出总行数中的哪一行（“12 中的 4”），从列表本身选择有效（UI Automation 的 Selection），并且树的复选框属于其文件的行。语言选择器列表、“选项”浏览器列表和“计划程序”的两个列表现在也有了名称。

5c32b466414eb19d.source: Limit seeding and upload, recheck files, reannounce, add trackers, and block IPs with a blocklist.
5c32b466414eb19d.text: 限制做种和上传，重新检查文件，重新发布，添加跟踪器，并使用黑名单阻止 IP。

5c4282dcd31a167d.text: IDM 用户为何转用 DDM

5c43697eaa789666.source: The rubber band that selects rows

5c55cd1c9eda4bdc.source: Paste a link from a file host your service supports, in <g1>Add URL</g1>, from the browser's <g2>Download with Dannex Download Manager</g2>, or in a batch download. DDM unlocks it through your account, then downloads it with all its connections, pause and resume. When the direct link expires, DDM asks the service for a new one.
5c55cd1c9eda4bdc.text: 在<g1>添加 URL</g1>中、在浏览器的<g2>使用 Dannex Download Manager 下载</g2>中，或在批量下载中，粘贴您的服务所支持的文件托管站点的链接。DDM 会通过您的账户解锁链接，然后用全部连接下载，并支持暂停和恢复。直链过期后，DDM 会向该服务请求新的链接。

5c57ede4ef1cce64.source: A paired phone handles downloads and queues, nothing more: it can't change settings, open windows on the computer or see your folders.
5c57ede4ef1cce64.text: 已配对的手机只能处理下载和队列，仅此而已：它无法更改设置、在电脑上打开窗口或查看您的文件夹。

5c61a8ce3792b918.source: <g1>Any Firefox, until it closes:</g1> open <x2/>, click <g3>Load Temporary Add-on…</g3> and choose the same file.
5c61a8ce3792b918.text: <g1>任意 Firefox，到关闭为止：</g1>打开 <x2/>，点击<g3>临时载入附加组件…</g3>，然后选择同一个文件。

5c652dc7ef553fde.source: Every window of DDM, its dialogs and menus included, tells a screen reader what each control is, its name and its state. The download list reads each download's name, status and size, so you know what is running and how far it has got without looking.
5c652dc7ef553fde.text: DDM 的每个窗口，包括其对话框和菜单，都会告知屏幕阅读器每个控件的类型、名称和状态。下载列表会朗读每个下载的名称、状态和大小，因此您无需查看即可了解正在运行的任务及其进度。

5c676fc93de738f4.source: <g1>Copy magnet link</g1> — copies a magnet link for the torrent, with its trackers.
5c676fc93de738f4.text: <g1>复制磁力链接</g1> — 复制种子的磁力链接，包括其跟踪器。

5c8c1d898b02be35.source: <g1>Start</g1> adds the ticked links to the <g2>Main download queue</g2> and starts it; <g3>Add to queue</g3> adds them without starting.
5c8c1d898b02be35.text: <g1>开始</g1>会将勾选的链接添加到<g2>主下载队列</g2>并开始下载；<g3>添加到队列</g3>则只添加链接而不开始下载。

5ca3f58d02dcbcb8.source: <g1>A freeze while DDM handles a command is reported again</g1> (<g2>#202</g2>): since the clock and what comes in from outside (a second launch, the browser, the automation API) run in every window state, a freeze there opened no crash report window and wrote no freeze report, minimized or not. The watchdog now times that part of each frame too.
5ca3f58d02dcbcb8.text: <g1>DDM 处理命令时冻结的问题再次报告</g1>（<g2>#202</g2>）：由于时钟和外部输入（第二次启动、浏览器、自动化 API）在所有窗口状态下运行，因此在此处冻结时不会打开崩溃报告窗口，也不会写入冻结报告，无论是否最小化。现在，看门狗也会对每个帧的这一部分进行计时。

5cb4c44654c9c90d.source: <g1>Pick an issue</g1><g2>See what's open and lend a hand.</g2>
5cb4c44654c9c90d.text: <g1>挑选问题</g1><g2>看看有哪些待处理的问题，并提供帮助。</g2>

5cc84b0198dcee09.source: Rules only look at articles that are new since the feed was last fetched, and a feed's first fetch only lists what is there. So adding a feed or a rule never downloads a whole backlog. <g1>Matches ... articles now</g1> shows which of the articles the feeds hold now the rule matches, to check it; download those by hand. A torrent the list already has isn't added again, and neither is one whose files are already in the folder: DDM never writes into files it didn't make without asking. The bottom line of the tab says what the rules did last, and a torrent a rule added says so in its event log.
5cc84b0198dcee09.text: 规则只检查自上次获取源以来新增的文章；首次获取源时只会列出当前已有的内容。因此，添加源或规则都不会下载之前积累的所有内容。<g1>现在匹配...篇文章</g1>会显示规则与源中当前文章的匹配情况，供您检查；匹配的文章需要手动下载。列表中已有的种子不会再次添加；如果种子文件已在文件夹中，也不会再次添加：未经询问，DDM 不会写入它未创建的文件。选项卡底部会说明规则上次执行的操作；规则添加的种子也会在其事件日志中注明。

5cf4f742d0a41f0e.source: downloads a gallery into a folder named after it. See <g1>Command line and automation</g1>.
5cf4f742d0a41f0e.text: 将图库下载到以图库命名的文件夹中。请参阅<g1>命令行和自动化</g1>。

5d0a5a5029ff8a77.source: Tick <g1>Start Dannex Download Manager with the computer</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> and DDM starts when you sign in, hidden, its icon in the notification area. Its downloads, queues, the <g3>Scheduler</g3> and downloads from the browser all run from there. Click the icon, or start DDM again, and the window opens as usual.
5d0a5a5029ff8a77.text: 勾选<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中的<g1>随计算机启动 Dannex Download Manager</g1>后，DDM 会在您登录时启动并隐藏，其图标位于通知区域。它的下载、队列、<g3>计划程序</g3>以及来自浏览器的下载都从那里运行。单击图标，或再次启动 DDM，窗口会照常打开。

5d0b5e3a94f7ce4c.source: The <x1/> copy has no installer, but you can register the helper yourself. Open a command prompt in DDM's folder and run:
5d0b5e3a94f7ce4c.text: 此 <x1/> 版本没有安装程序，但您可以自行注册辅助程序。在 DDM 文件夹中打开命令提示符并运行：

5d30dd2eebdacc64.source: <g1>Works as in the other browsers:</g1> the right-click items, the button over videos, the toolbar button, <g2>Alt</g2>-click, DDM starting by itself, and every rule in Options.
5d30dd2eebdacc64.text: <g1>与其他浏览器一样可用：</g1>右键菜单项、视频上的按钮、工具栏按钮、<g2>Alt</g2> 单击、DDM 自动启动，以及选项中的所有规则。

5d335ae1978e28c3.source: A video's progress window while yt-dlp brings it in
5d335ae1978e28c3.text: yt-dlp 下载视频时的视频进度窗口

5d339aba8fdcadaa.source: One click hides a download's window

5d506b0260fa3ae5.source: To find peers without trackers, DDM joins the DHT through four public routers (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/> and <x4/>); any one that answers is enough. It keeps the DHT nodes it found for the next start, so later starts don't depend on those routers.
5d506b0260fa3ae5.text: DDM 通过四个公共路由器（<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/> 和 <x4/>）加入 DHT，以查找没有跟踪器的对等点；只要其中一个响应即可。它会保存找到的 DHT 节点，供下次启动时使用，因此后续启动不依赖于这些路由器。

5d51fdbdd5365448.source: screenshots of the main window in its light and its dark side;
5d51fdbdd5365448.text: 主窗口浅色和深色模式的截图；

5d5232cb61c0d03f.source: Sites change often, and a newer yt-dlp usually fixes it. DDM doesn't update yt-dlp on its own yet. To get the newest one: quit DDM (<g1>Tasks → Exit</g1>), delete the <x2/> folder in DDM's data folder (<x3/>, or the <x4/> folder of a portable copy), start DDM, open the video window and click <g5>Install yt-dlp</g5>.
5d5232cb61c0d03f.text: 网站经常变化，更新 yt-dlp 通常可以解决问题。DDM 目前不会自动更新 yt-dlp。要获取最新版本：退出 DDM（<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>），删除 DDM 数据文件夹中的 <x2/> 文件夹（<x3/>，或便携版副本中的 <x4/> 文件夹），启动 DDM，打开视频窗口并点击<g5>安装 yt-dlp</g5>。

5d56098513a9a8da.source: To quit, choose <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1> or <g2>Exit</g2> in the tray menu.
5d56098513a9a8da.text: 要退出，请选择<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>或托盘菜单中的<g2>退出</g2>。

5d91effabe6559f7.source: <g1>The download progress window</g1> could be stretched on macOS and Linux without its contents following; it keeps its size, as on Windows.
5d91effabe6559f7.text: <g1>下载进度窗口</g1>在 macOS 和 Linux 上可以拉伸，但其内容不会随之变化；现在它会保持其大小，与 Windows 上一样。

5d9e401b06cf961f.source: Is it safe? Does it contain adware or spyware? — Dannex Download Manager
5d9e401b06cf961f.text: 安全吗？是否包含广告软件或间谍软件？— Dannex Download Manager

5db4d7af773861a3.source: Click to zoom · drag to move
5db4d7af773861a3.text: 点击放大 · 拖动移动

5db8bd4bd4cb23a0.source: YouTube serves each connection's long requests slowly, so DDM asks for the video in pieces of 10 MB at most, as yt-dlp does, and several at once.
5db8bd4bd4cb23a0.text: YouTube 对每个连接的长时间请求响应缓慢，因此 DDM 会像 yt-dlp 一样，以最大 10 MB 的分段请求视频，并且同时请求多个分段。

5de6dcb7cde10c5d.source: Yes: for one download from its progress window, or for everything with <g1>Downloads → Speed Limiter</g1>. See <g2>Keep some speed for everything else</g2>.
5de6dcb7cde10c5d.text: 可以：对于单个下载，可以在其进度窗口中设置；对于所有下载，可以使用<g1>下载 → 速度限制器</g1>。请参阅<g2>为其他任务保留一些速度</g2>。

5df7a79202ee3a2a.source: Or select downloads in the list, right-click and choose <g1>Add to queue</g1>, then the queue. A download that is already in a queue shows <g2>Move to queue</g2> instead.
5df7a79202ee3a2a.text: 也可以在列表中选择下载任务，右键点击并选择<g1>添加到队列</g1>，然后选择队列。已在队列中的下载任务会显示<g2>移动到队列</g2>。

5df8820ec8174223.text: 远程控制、服务器和脚本

5e27900a4025712f.source: Is the file's type in <g1>Options → File types</g1>? Only listed types are taken automatically. <g2>Download with DDM</g2> on the right-click menu takes any link.
5e27900a4025712f.text: 文件类型是否列在<g1>选项 → 文件类型</g1>中？只有列表中的文件类型才会被自动接管。右键菜单中的<g2>使用 DDM 下载</g2>可以下载任何链接。

5e2b0247cc6e98c7.source: The button follows the rest of the integration: it doesn't show when <g1>Take downloads from web browsers</g1> is off or the browser is unticked.
5e2b0247cc6e98c7.text: 该按钮与其余集成保持一致：当<g1>接管浏览器的下载</g1>关闭或未勾选该浏览器时，它不会显示。

5e2b599e5502fd7a.source: Release page and files on GitHub
5e2b599e5502fd7a.text: GitHub 上的发布页面和文件

5e2f043dafe51361.source: <g1>Loaded from DDM's folder:</g1> DDM's update replaced the files there, but the browser runs the copy it loaded until you reload it. <g2>Reload the extension</g2> on the status page does that (or the reload arrow on the browser's extensions page).
5e2f043dafe51361.text: <g1>从 DDM 文件夹加载：</g1>DDM 的更新替换了那里的文件，但浏览器在您重新加载之前仍运行它已加载的副本。状态页上的<g2>重新加载扩展</g2>可以做到这一点（或使用浏览器扩展页面上的重新加载箭头）。

5e491197856ec36d.source: To bring the window back, choose it in <g1>Downloads in progress</g1>, or right-click the download in the list and choose <g2>Show progress</g2>. A queue's downloads start with their windows there.
5e491197856ec36d.text: 若要调回窗口，请在<g1>正在进行的下载</g1>中选择它，或右键单击列表中的下载并选择<g2>显示进度</g2>。队列中的下载启动时，其窗口就在那里。

5e526dd27fbac753.source: TorBox first downloads the file to its own servers (at once when it has it already). DDM waits for it, up to an hour, and the list says how far it is, such as <g1>40% at TorBox</g1>. Once the download is done, or taken off DDM's list, it leaves your account's list of web downloads on TorBox; a paused one keeps its place there, to go on with.
5e526dd27fbac753.text: TorBox 首先将文件下载到其自己的服务器 (如果已有则立即下载)。DDM 会等待，最长一小时，列表中会显示进度，例如 <g1>TorBox 上 40%</g1>。一旦下载完成，或从 DDM 列表中移除，它就会从您 TorBox 账户的网页下载列表中消失；暂停的下载会保留其位置，以便继续。

5e5a9d4ef3efedf8.source: <g1>Icon sets.</g1> <x2/> draws a theme's icons (named by what they're for: <x3/>, <x4/>…, SVG or PNG at 16, 24, 32 and 48 px, <x5/> ones inked in the text colour) where the classic look draws its own; a need the set lacks keeps the classic icon.
5e5a9d4ef3efedf8.text: <g1>图标集。</g1> <x2/> 绘制主题的图标（按用途命名：<x3/>、<x4/>…，16、24、32 和 48 像素的 SVG 或 PNG，<x5/> 的图标以文本颜色着色），在经典外观绘制自己的图标的地方；如果图标集缺少所需图标，则保留经典图标。

5e815ae6f9d15fc5.source: <g1>Control DDM from your phone</g1> (<g2>#141</g2>): <g3>Options → Remote</g3>, off by default. A phone or another computer on the local network, paired with a code (or a QR code) DDM shows, opens a page DDM serves over HTTPS: it adds links, magnet links and <x4/> files, shows the list with its progress, pauses, starts and removes downloads, and starts and stops the queues, in the phone's language. Only paired devices are answered, each removable in Options, and only on the computer's private network addresses. <g5>Guide</g5>.
5e815ae6f9d15fc5.text: <g1>通过手机控制 DDM</g1>（<g2>#141</g2>）：<g3>选项 → 远程</g3>，默认关闭。本地网络上的手机或另一台计算机，通过 DDM 显示的代码（或二维码）配对后，会打开 DDM 通过 HTTPS 提供的页面：它会添加链接、磁力链接和<x4/>文件，显示带有进度的列表，暂停、开始和删除下载，以及启动和停止队列，并使用手机的语言。只响应已配对的设备，每个设备都可以在“选项”中移除，并且只在计算机的私有网络地址上。请参阅<g5>指南</g5>。

5e87cf3633bb51b9.source: Seven downloads, each run at least seven times by IDM 6.42 and Dannex Download Manager from the same test server: DDM was 5.4× faster on 1 GiB and 106× on small files. Charts, raw data and the method.
5e87cf3633bb51b9.text: IDM 6.42 和 Dannex Download Manager 分别从同一测试服务器下载 7 个文件，每个文件至少测试 7 次：DDM 下载 1 GiB 文件的速度快 5.4 倍，小文件快 106 倍。图表、原始数据和测试方法。

5e8a9e75e0c6408c.source: Leave DDM running. Closing the main window is fine: DDM keeps going in the tray. Don't use <g1>Tasks → Exit</g1>.
5e8a9e75e0c6408c.text: 让 DDM 保持运行。关闭主窗口没关系：DDM 会在系统托盘中继续运行。不要使用<g1>任务 → 退出</g1>。

5e9c16a3b68af2d9.source: <g1>One browser only:</g1> <g2>Options → General → Capture downloads from the following browsers</g2>. Untick the ones DDM should leave alone.
5e9c16a3b68af2d9.text: <g1>仅使用某个浏览器：</g1><g2>选项 → 常规 → 从以下浏览器捕获下载</g2>。取消勾选要由 DDM 忽略的浏览器。

5ea184bc04ad2f73.text: 请参阅<g1>视频无法下载时</g1>。

5ea31b9a4b8d8d46.source: Every release is built from the public source code by <g1>GitHub Actions</g1>, on GitHub's servers; the build logs are public.
5ea31b9a4b8d8d46.text: 每个版本都由 <g1>GitHub Actions</g1> 在 GitHub 的服务器上从公共源代码构建；构建日志是公开的。

5ea73c9f55e21a00.text: 5. 应用并让 DDM 保持运行

5eb434c1156d0e97.source: <g1>Options → General → DDM's commands in the browsers' right-click menu → Edit...</g1> chooses which of these five the browser's menu shows. A browser changes its menu when you next switch to it.
5eb434c1156d0e97.text: <g1>选项 → 常规 → DDM 在浏览器右键菜单中的命令 → 编辑...</g1>用于选择浏览器菜单显示这五项中的哪几项。浏览器会在您下次切换到它时更改其菜单。

5ee70a9dc19afc98.text: 开始使用 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

5f13dfbffc67eb56.text: 浏览器限制了扩展的站点访问权限

5f246a6b539a96be.text: 在 GitHub 上编辑此页面

5f2b7d4443e9a0fa.source: Click <g1>Grabber</g1> on the toolbar, or choose <g2>Tasks → Run site grabber...</g2>.
5f2b7d4443e9a0fa.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>站点抓取器</g1>，或选择<g2>任务 → 运行站点抓取器...</g2>。

5f31049fa5031c49.source: The remote control is on in this mode (<x1/> turns it off). It stops cleanly, saving its list, when the system stops it (<x2/>, systemd, Ctrl+C). It works on Windows and macOS too, the same way.
5f31049fa5031c49.text: 在此模式下，远程控制已开启（<x1/>将其关闭）。当系统停止它时（<x2/>、systemd、Ctrl+C），它会干净地停止并保存其列表。它在 Windows 和 macOS 上也以相同的方式工作。

5f3ac14112cdc19a.source: <g1>Resuming.</g1> DDM keeps the file's size and modification time. If either has changed when you resume, it says the file changed on the server instead of mixing two versions (<g2>Options → Downloads → Resume even if the file's date on the server changed</g2> skips the time check). The password is not written to the resume file next to the download: DDM gives it again when it resumes.
5f3ac14112cdc19a.text: <g1>续传。</g1>DDM 会记录文件的大小和修改时间。如果续传时其中任何一项已更改，DDM 会提示文件在服务器上已更改，而不是把两个版本混在一起（<g2>选项 → 下载 → 即使服务器上的文件日期已更改，也继续下载</g2>可跳过时间检查）。密码不会写入下载旁边的续传文件：续传时 DDM 会再次索要。

5f3f749cb54c5dfb.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>Downloads on a schedule</g3> <g4>Queues that start at 2 a.m., stop by 7 and turn the computer off when they're done.</g4>
5f3f749cb54c5dfb.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>定时下载</g3> <g4>设置下载队列在凌晨 2 点开始、早上 7 点前停止，并在下载完成后关闭电脑。</g4>

5f629de44812dd58.source: DDM never writes into a file that's already there without asking.
5f629de44812dd58.text: 未经询问，DDM 绝不会写入已存在的文件。

5f724f5f6e6beb8e.source: <g1>The main window</g1> you know: categories, the download list, the progress window with every connection's share, queues and the <g2>Scheduler</g2>, the speed limiter, Sites Logins, and <g3>Options</g3> where you expect them, every control working. Day and dark mode.
5f724f5f6e6beb8e.text: <g1>您熟悉的主窗口</g1>：类别、下载列表、显示每个连接份额的进度窗口、队列和<g2>计划程序</g2>、限速器、站点登录，以及您期望的<g3>选项</g3>，每个控件都正常工作。支持日间和夜间模式。

5fa6b314450ea41d.text: HTTPS 下载失败，显示“无证书”（Linux）

5fb35e9525fc0e0d.source: Bangla shows Bangladesh's flag instead of India's, in the language picker, on the website and in the README (<g1>#27</g1>).
5fb35e9525fc0e0d.text: 在语言选择器、网站和 README 中，孟加拉语显示孟加拉国国旗而非印度国旗 (<g1>#27</g1>)。

5fcf0291ca3b8d9c.source: Counts, sizes, speeds and percentages will be written the way the chosen language writes them (German <x1/> and <x2/>, French <x3/>), whatever the Windows region; a region in the same language keeps its own way. English stays as it is. Buttons will grow to fit their translated text in every window, so a longer German or Russian label is no longer cut short. Dates keep following your region, or your own choice in <g4>Options → Regional</g4>.
5fcf0291ca3b8d9c.text: 无论 Windows 区域设置如何，计数、大小、速度和百分比都将以所选语言的书写方式显示（德语 <x1/> 和 <x2/>，法语 <x3/>）；如果区域设置与语言相同，则保持其自身方式。英语则保持不变。所有窗口中的按钮都会根据翻译后的文本自动调整大小，因此较长的德语或俄语标签将不再被截断。日期仍会遵循您的区域设置，或您在<g4>选项 → 区域</g4>中的选择。

5fcf81378fa34b81.source: <g1>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Settings...</g1> — speed limits. See <g2>Connections and speed</g2>.
5fcf81378fa34b81.text: <g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 设置…</g1> — 速度限制。请参阅<g2>连接和速度</g2>。

5fd1f80d04f54496.source: Start with a few colours, then add more as you go:
5fd1f80d04f54496.text: 从几种颜色开始，然后逐步添加更多：

5fd4ad47d491ef87.source: Right-click a link, a picture, a video or a sound and choose <g1>Download with DDM</g1>: DDM downloads it whatever its type.
5fd4ad47d491ef87.text: 右键点击链接、图片、视频或音频，然后选择<g1>使用 DDM 下载</g1>：DDM 会下载它，无论其类型如何。

5ffb8afbcb21d52e.source: <g1>The app icon on macOS</g1>: the Dock showed a small, blurry icon while DDM ran; it keeps the app's own now. Elsewhere windows take their icon from a large size (sharp at any scaling).
5ffb8afbcb21d52e.text: <g1>macOS 上的应用图标</g1>：DDM 运行时，Dock 上显示一个小而模糊的图标；现在它会保留应用本身的图标。在其他地方，窗口图标取自大尺寸（在任何缩放比例下都清晰）。

6009e19453a98f85.source: YouTube refuses its automatic translations to download programs: an <g1>automatic translation</g1> comes with the captions it's made from, and when YouTube refuses the translation, those are saved instead (beside the video or inside it, as you chose), and the <g2>Download complete</g2> window says so.
6009e19453a98f85.text: YouTube 不允许下载程序获取其自动翻译：<g1>自动翻译</g1>附带它所依据的字幕，当 YouTube 拒绝提供翻译时，会改为保存这些字幕（按您的选择保存在视频旁边或视频内部），<g2>下载完成</g2>窗口会对此说明。

602a813939f74a37.source: A minimal Linux system (often with the AppImage, the tar.gz or a build from source) may have no CA certificates, which DDM needs to check a secure server. Plain <x1/> and <x2/> downloads still work; each <x3/> or <x4/> one stops at once saying the computer has no certificates to check the server with. Install the <x5/> package (<x6/>, <x7/>), then resume the download. The .deb and .rpm bring it.
602a813939f74a37.text: 最小化的 Linux 系统（通常使用 AppImage、tar.gz 或从源代码构建）可能没有 CA 证书，DDM 需要这些证书来检查安全服务器。普通的<x1/>和<x2/>下载仍然有效；每个<x3/>或<x4/>下载会立即停止，并提示电脑没有证书来检查服务器。安装<x5/>软件包（<x6/>、<x7/>），然后恢复下载。.deb 和 .rpm 包自带此功能。

6099a54f69f7df29.source: Torrents, videos and galleries have no single server of DDM's own (peers, or yt-dlp's and gallery-dl's), so their windows don't show one. <g1>Properties</g1> says where they come from instead: a video's or a gallery's site and the program that reads it (<g2>youtube.com, through yt-dlp</g2>), or <g3>BitTorrent peers</g3>.
6099a54f69f7df29.text: 种子、视频和图库没有 DDM 自己的单一服务器（而是节点，或 yt-dlp 和 gallery-dl 的服务器），因此它们的窗口不显示服务器。<g1>属性</g1>会改为说明它们的来源：视频或图库的站点以及读取它的程序（<g2>youtube.com，通过 yt-dlp</g2>），或<g3>BitTorrent 节点</g3>。

609ec75faaea91d6.source: Seven download scenarios against a local fault-injecting test server, each run at least seven times per app in alternating order; end-to-end and server-side transfer times, connections, requests, CPU and memory.
609ec75faaea91d6.text: 七种下载场景，针对本地故障注入测试服务器，每个应用交替运行至少七次；端到端和服务器端传输时间、连接、请求、CPU 和内存。

60be3b8e1d1dbc4a.text: 下载：显示哪些窗口，以及列表中已有的地址会如何处理。

60bfea57686a0f37.source: <g1>Video and sound files</g1> the page played (MP4, WebM, MP3 and the like), with their size and, for a video, its picture size.
60bfea57686a0f37.text: <g1>页面播放的视频和音频文件</g1>（MP4、WebM、MP3 等），显示文件大小；如果是视频，还会显示画面尺寸。

60d748739de6ad61.source: Run Dannex Download Manager without a window on a home server, NAS, Docker or Unraid, and send it downloads from your phone or your browser.

60e11cb01c866c39.source: <g1>Firefox</g1>: its add-on is on its way to addons.mozilla.org. Until then Firefox, which installs only add-ons Mozilla has signed, takes <g2>its file</g2> in Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR, or until it closes in any Firefox: <g3>the steps</g3>.
60e11cb01c866c39.text: <g1>Firefox</g1>：其附加组件即将登陆 addons.mozilla.org。在此之前，Firefox 只安装 Mozilla 已签名的附加组件，可在 Developer Edition、Nightly 或 ESR 中使用<g2>其文件</g2>，在任意 Firefox 中使用则只到关闭为止：<g3>操作步骤</g3>。

60e4ea08eb29abeb.source: <g1>Stop</g1> on a download in a running queue stays stopped, instead of the queue starting it again a moment later; <g2>Stop All</g2> too (<g3>#341</g3>).
60e4ea08eb29abeb.text: 队列中正在运行的下载任务，点击<g1>停止</g1>后会保持停止状态，而不是稍后又被队列重新启动；<g2>停止所有</g2>也一样（<g3>#341</g3>）。

60f3c58ee8c2af81.source: <g1>Options where you expect them</g1> Every setting where an IDM user looks first: connections, proxies, folders, sounds.
60f3c58ee8c2af81.text: <g1>选项都在熟悉的位置</g1> 各项设置都在 IDM 用户首先会查找的位置：连接、代理、文件夹和声音。

60f9139ba98eb162.source: <g1>Keep the site's folders</g1>: under the folder, each file goes where it is on the site: <x2/>. <g3>Put every file in this one folder</g3> puts them side by side instead. A name that is taken gets a number, as always.
60f9139ba98eb162.text: <g1>保留站点的文件夹结构</g1>：在该文件夹下，每个文件放在它在站点上所处的位置：<x2/>。<g3>将所有文件放入此文件夹</g3>则把它们并排放在一起。重名时会加上编号，一如既往。

6109962d969a7e9a.source: The Chrome Web Store lists the extension, and yours came from DDM's folder
6109962d969a7e9a.text: Chrome 应用商店已收录该扩展，而您的副本来自 DDM 文件夹

6111bd2651de0090.source: <g1>The download engine</g1>: up to 32 connections per file, re-splitting the slowest part until the last byte, and crash-safe resume after a restart or a dropped connection. HTTP, HTTPS, <g2>FTP and FTPS</g2> (<x3/>, <x4/> explicit TLS, <x5/> implicit TLS), proxies, SOCKS and <g6>proxy auto-config (PAC)</g6> scripts.
6111bd2651de0090.text: <g1>下载引擎</g1>：每个文件最多 32 个连接，重新分割最慢的部分直到最后一个字节，并在重启或连接中断后安全恢复。支持 HTTP、HTTPS、<g2>FTP 和 FTPS</g2>（<x3/>、<x4/> 显式 TLS、<x5/> 隐式 TLS）、代理、SOCKS 和<g6>代理自动配置 (PAC)</g6> 脚本。

61251da65a2d3e66.source: Links to a PDF or a video file, which the browser would open itself, go to DDM too when their type is listed. To leave one to the browser, hold <g1>Alt</g1> while clicking it (Firefox opens it; Chrome and Edge download it themselves). Any other link: right-click it and choose <g2>Download with DDM</g2>, which takes any type.
61251da65a2d3e66.text: 如果 PDF 或视频文件的类型已列出，即使浏览器原本会自行打开它们，链接也会交给 DDM 处理。要让浏览器处理某个链接，请在点击时按住 <g1>Alt</g1>（Firefox 会打开链接；Chrome 和 Edge 会自行下载文件）。对于其他链接，请右键点击并选择<g2>使用 DDM 下载</g2>；此选项适用于任何文件类型。

6126a3542358d39b.source: Tick <g1>Don't show this dialog again</g1> to stop seeing it. It can be turned back on in <g2>Options → Downloads → Show download complete dialog</g2>.
6126a3542358d39b.text: 勾选<g1>不再显示此对话框</g1>以停止显示它。可以在<g2>选项 → 下载 → 显示下载完成对话框</g2>中重新开启。

6127f93b44cff252.source: <g1>Resume capability</g1> — <g2>Yes</g2> if the server lets DDM continue the download later, <g3>No</g3> if it doesn't.
6127f93b44cff252.text: <g1>恢复功能</g1> — 如果服务器允许 DDM 稍后继续下载，则为<g2>是</g2>；如果不允许，则为<g3>否</g3>。

61298c24065d8bad.source: A filtered column's funnel turns blue. Right-click a column title and choose <g1>Clear all filters</g1> to see everything again.
61298c24065d8bad.text: 已筛选列的漏斗图标会变为蓝色。右键点击列标题，然后选择<g1>清除所有筛选器</g1>，即可再次查看所有内容。

612c083423df5e68.source: Hover over the download's <g1>Status</g1> in the list to see them.
612c083423df5e68.text: 将鼠标悬停在列表中的下载<g1>状态</g1>上即可查看这些信息。

612c8ee2fd9cf5ad.source: <g1>One click turns it off or on.</g1> While it takes downloads, its toolbar button shows DDM's icon in colour; turned off, it's grey with an X, and every download stays with the browser until you click it again. If DDM isn't installed or can't be reached, the click opens a page that says what to do, and that page turns green by itself once DDM is ready.
612c8ee2fd9cf5ad.text: <g1>单击一下即可关闭或开启。</g1>在接管下载时，其工具栏按钮会以彩色显示 DDM 图标；关闭后则变为带 X 的灰色，所有下载都留在浏览器中，直到您再次单击。如果 DDM 未安装或无法连接，单击会打开一个页面，说明该怎么做，而一旦 DDM 就绪，该页面会自动变为绿色。

6164b6f6b618527e.source: <g1>Ghost windows while a menu is open</g1> (issue #4): faded copies of the main window titled "egui window" opened and closed with every redraw of an open menu, and the toolbar's hover flickered under them. On a Mac in full screen they opened a space of their own and froze DDM (issue #5). They came with {v1}'s menu keyboard support, which asked about a submenu's window that wasn't open, and that made one.
6164b6f6b618527e.text: <g1>菜单打开时出现的幽灵窗口</g1>（问题 #4）：每次打开的菜单重绘时，标题为“egui window”的主窗口褪色副本都会打开又关闭，工具栏的悬停效果也在这些副本下方闪烁。在 Mac 全屏模式下，这些窗口会占用自己的空间并导致 DDM 卡死（问题 #5）。这些窗口是在 {v1} 添加菜单键盘支持时出现的：该功能会查询一个未打开的子菜单窗口，结果导致窗口被创建。

61d179601f69a50c.text: Windows 11 Insider 版本中，菜单和窗口不再出现黑色条带。

6210b4ed9dfcfd49.source: <g1>The window couldn't be closed</g1> on desktops without a tray, such as MangoWC (<g2>#59</g2>): closing hid it to a tray that wasn't there. Closing now hides to the tray only when a tray shows DDM's icon, and quits otherwise. (The menus and dark mode there: see #50 and #60.)
6210b4ed9dfcfd49.text: <g1>在没有系统托盘的桌面上，窗口无法关闭</g1>，例如 MangoWC (<g2>#59</g2>)：关闭会将其隐藏到不存在的托盘中。现在，只有当系统托盘显示 DDM 图标时，关闭才会隐藏到托盘中，否则会退出。（那里的菜单和深色模式：请参阅 #50 和 #60。）

6216638d7aa4db3f.source: Check <g1>Save to</g1> (the General category's folder by default). The pictures go into a folder of their own there, named after the gallery.
6216638d7aa4db3f.text: 确认<g1>保存到</g1>（默认为“常规”类别的文件夹）。图片会保存到该文件夹下一个以图库命名的独立文件夹中。

621c5a4f8acb706b.source: In dialogs, <g1>Tab</g1> moves between controls, the arrows go through radio groups and tab strips, <g2>Ctrl+Tab</g2> changes tabs, and typing a name jumps to it in any list or drop-down. <g3>Add URL</g3>'s address and <g4>Save As</g4> keep a history you can walk with <g5>Up</g5> and <g6>Down</g6>, and the Scheduler's calendar works from the keyboard. On a Mac, <g7>⌘</g7> takes the place of <g8>Ctrl</g8>.
621c5a4f8acb706b.text: 在对话框中，<g1>Tab</g1> 在控件之间移动，方向键遍历单选组和选项卡条，<g2>Ctrl+Tab</g2> 切换选项卡，输入名称可在任何列表或下拉菜单中跳转到该项。<g3>添加 URL</g3> 的地址和<g4>另存为</g4>保留了历史记录，您可以使用<g5>向上</g5>和<g6>向下</g6>键浏览，计划程序的日历也可以通过键盘操作。在 Mac 上，<g7>⌘</g7> 键代替 <g8>Ctrl</g8> 键。

624b98af1c3e9963.text: 转到已打开菜单中的第一个/最后一个项目

6252af3e97f3ba17.text: 类别属性：其名称、文件类型和文件夹

62b391cabe3b0674.text: 将浏览器中的链接拖到它上面：当有它可处理的内容在其上方时，它会亮起琥珀色边框。松开后，DDM 会像使用<g1>添加 URL</g1>一样添加该链接。

62e049f954021405.source: Control it from your phone or your browser
62e049f954021405.text: 通过手机或浏览器控制它

62e21c60c16790f3.source: Inside a container, the address DDM finds is the container's own: give it the one you open, the <g1>server's</g1> address with the port you published, as <x2/>, and the log and the QR code show that one. Then pair as <g3>Control DDM from your phone</g3> says. For another code, at any time:
62e21c60c16790f3.text: 在容器内部，DDM 找到的地址是容器自身的地址：请提供您打开的地址，即带有您发布的端口的<g1>服务器</g1>地址，如<x2/>所示，日志和二维码将显示该地址。然后按照<g3>从手机控制 DDM</g3>所述进行配对。如需获取另一个代码，随时可以：

62ebed48ebb1093d.text: 是否已启用<g1>选项 → 常规 → 使用高级浏览器集成</g1>，并在<g2>从以下浏览器捕获下载</g2>下勾选了您的浏览器？

62ed752cff5dacea.source: <g1>Ask for the queue on Download Later</g1> — ask which queue; off puts it in the <g2>Main download queue</g2>.
62ed752cff5dacea.text: <g1>稍后下载时询问加入哪个队列</g1> — 询问加入哪个队列；关闭则放入<g2>主下载队列</g2>。

631b9914f6507aef.source: <g1>Testing it.</g1> <x2/> runs a real freeze, panic and crash (<x3/>) and checks each report's signature. To try it in the app, start DDM with <x4/>, then run <x5/> (a deadlock; or <x6/>, 12 s of a busy window thread, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>). <x10/> does that in a copy of the app off the screens, its window visible and minimized.
631b9914f6507aef.text: <g1>测试。</g1> <x2/> 会触发实际的冻结、panic 和崩溃（<x3/>），并检查每份报告的签名。要在应用中测试，请使用 <x4/> 启动 DDM，然后运行 <x5/>（死锁；或者运行 <x6/>，让窗口线程忙碌 12 s；还可以运行 <x7/>、<x8/>、<x9/>）。<x10/> 会在屏幕外的应用副本中执行这些操作，窗口保持可见并处于最小化状态。

633080a934d3fe43.source: DDM's setup registers the helper where Helium looks for it, on Windows, Linux and macOS. Once the store lists it, on Linux and macOS DDM also offers the extension to Helium, through Helium's own services, so with them allowed it arrives by itself at Helium's next start (on macOS Helium asks first: <g1>New extension added</g1> in its menu, where you turn it on). The Linux packages (.deb, .rpm) leave that to the window below, writing nothing in your home folder. On Windows Helium can't be offered the extension this way: DDM's <g2>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g2> window opens the store's page in Helium when Helium was installed with its setup; Helium from its zip isn't found there, so open the store's page in it yourself. Helium presents itself as Google Chrome, on purpose, so in <g3>Options → General → Capture downloads from the following browsers</g3> it is <g4>Google Chrome</g4>.
633080a934d3fe43.text: DDM 的安装程序会在 Helium 查找的位置注册辅助程序，适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。商店上架后，在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 还会通过 Helium 自己的服务向 Helium 提供该扩展，因此在服务被允许的情况下，它会在 Helium 下次启动时自动出现（在 macOS 上 Helium 会先询问：菜单中的<g1>已添加新扩展</g1>，在其中开启它）。Linux 软件包（.deb、.rpm）把这件事留给下面的窗口，不会在您的主目录中写入任何内容。在 Windows 上无法用这种方式向 Helium 提供扩展：如果 Helium 是用其安装程序安装的，DDM 的<g2>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口会在 Helium 中打开商店页面；用 zip 安装的 Helium 在那里找不到，请自行在其中打开商店页面。Helium 有意把自己标识为 Google Chrome，因此在<g3>选项 → 常规 → 捕获来自以下浏览器的下载</g3>中，它显示为<g4>Google Chrome</g4>。

6331bddead43e1a6.source: User names and passwords for sites that ask for them. <g1>New</g1> adds a row: the site (with a path if the login is only for part of it), the user name and the password. <g2>Edit</g2> and <g3>Remove</g3> change or delete the selected row. DDM uses the login for every download from that site. A login typed in <g4>Add URL</g4> (<g5>Use authorization</g5>) takes priority for that one download.
6331bddead43e1a6.text: 需要用户名和密码的站点的登录信息。<g1>新建</g1>会添加一行，填写站点（如果登录信息仅适用于站点的部分路径，则填写路径）、用户名和密码。<g2>编辑</g2>和<g3>删除</g3>可修改或删除选中的行。DDM 会将此登录信息用于从该站点进行的所有下载。在<g4>添加 URL</g4>（<g5>使用授权</g5>）中输入的登录信息仅对该次下载优先使用。

635f40f1db7e086a.source: Pause running downloads, or start (resume) stopped, queued or failed ones, in the running app.
635f40f1db7e086a.text: 暂停正在运行的下载，或在运行中的应用里开始（恢复）已停止、已排队或失败的下载。

63864f0ddcaa9a14.source: to download only files you have the right to download, and to respect copyright and the terms of the sites you download from;
63864f0ddcaa9a14.text: 仅下载您有权下载的文件，并尊重版权和您下载网站的条款；

639b04fd92deea56.source: <g1>Cancel</g1> closes the window and adds nothing.
639b04fd92deea56.text: <g1>取消</g1>关闭窗口，不添加任何内容。

639dcdb14649149e.source: <g1>A copy from elsewhere?</g1> Remove it and add the extension as DDM's <g2>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g2> window shows (see <g3>Browser integration</g3>).
639dcdb14649149e.text: <g1>副本来自其他地方？</g1>删除该副本，然后按照 DDM 的<g2>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口中的说明添加扩展程序（请参阅<g3>浏览器集成</g3>）。

639e97e78af63aae.source: <g1>Google Docs, Sheets and Slides</g1> come as Word (<x2/>), Excel (<x3/>) and PowerPoint (<x4/>) files, and Drawings as <x5/>. These files are made when they are asked for, so their size is unknown until they arrive and they can't be resumed: a cut-off download starts again.
639e97e78af63aae.text: <g1>Google Docs、Sheets 和 Slides</g1>会以 Word（<x2/>）、Excel（<x3/>）和 PowerPoint（<x4/>）文件的形式下载，Drawings 则会以 <x5/> 格式下载。这些文件会在请求时生成，因此下载完成前无法知道文件大小，也无法恢复下载：下载中断后会从头开始。

63b82090a9141698.source: A queue is a list of downloads that run in order, a few at a time. Click <g1>Download Later</g1> in <g2>Download File Info</g2>, or right-click downloads in the list and choose <g3>Add to queue</g3>. The <g4>Q</g4> column marks them, and <g5>Queues</g5> in the categories pane shows each queue on its own.
63b82090a9141698.text: 队列是按顺序运行的下载列表，每次运行少量任务。在<g2>下载文件信息</g2>中点击<g1>稍后下载</g1>，或右键点击列表中的下载任务并选择<g3>添加到队列</g3>。<g4>Q</g4>列会标记它们，类别窗格中的<g5>队列</g5>会单独显示每个队列。

63dc8a0242c6302b.source: <g1>New queue</g1> asks for a name and adds a queue. <g2>Delete</g2> removes one of your own queues; the two built-in queues can't be deleted. A deleted queue's downloads stay in the list.
63dc8a0242c6302b.text: <g1>新建队列</g1>会提示您输入名称，然后添加队列。<g2>删除</g2>会移除您创建的队列；两个内置队列无法删除。删除队列后，其中的下载任务仍会保留在列表中。

63e081b54c563868.text: <g1>状态</g1> — <g2>正在连接...</g2>、<g3>正在接收数据...</g3>、<g4>已暂停</g4>、<g5>完成</g5>或错误信息。

63f1d2c78982729f.source: downloads a gallery into a folder named after it, <x1/> files at once (8 by default). See <g2>Command line and automation</g2>.
63f1d2c78982729f.text: 把图库下载到以其命名的文件夹中，同时下载 <x1/> 个文件（默认 8 个）。参见<g2>命令行和自动化</g2>。

640ceca3e229adc2.source: Make every window larger, up to 200 %: <g1>View → Interface size</g1>, or Ctrl + and Ctrl −.
640ceca3e229adc2.text: 将所有窗口放大至 200%：<g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>，或按 Ctrl + 和 Ctrl −。

640f7ad89c389c38.source: <g1>Take downloads from web browsers</g1> — let the browser extension hand downloads to DDM. Turn it off to keep every download in the browser.
640f7ad89c389c38.text: <g1>接管浏览器的下载</g1> — 让浏览器扩展将下载交给 DDM。关闭它可让所有下载都留在浏览器中。

64127a76a775643b.source: <g1>Options on completion</g1> — shows where the file will be saved. Untick <g2>Show download complete dialog</g2> to skip the <g3>Download complete</g3> box for this file only.
64127a76a775643b.text: <g1>完成时选项</g1> — 显示文件将保存的位置。取消勾选<g2>显示下载完成对话框</g2>可跳过此文件的<g3>下载完成</g3>框。

6418ff5742ef4770.source: The free download managers people reach for instead of IDM, checked on their own websites and code in November 2026. Each is good at something. We make the first one, so judge the rest by their own links.
6418ff5742ef4770.text: 人们用来替代 IDM 的免费下载管理器，于 2026 年 11 月在其各自官网和代码库上进行核查。每款都有其优点。我们开发了第一款，因此请通过它们自己的链接来判断其余的。

64254df81bae2d98.text: <g1>安装帮助</g1><g2>从 IDM 导入</g2><g3>基准测试</g3>

64411e8900502fb0.source: Windows 8's flat look: square corners, flat buttons and one-colour icons.
64411e8900502fb0.text: Windows 8 的扁平外观：方形边角、扁平按钮和单色图标。

64537e877bb3abb4.source: A selection's fill: rows, a chosen day, selected text
64537e877bb3abb4.text: 选区填充：行、选定日期、选定文本

6453a141bfc3ae57.source: By default DDM starts downloading while this window is open, so no time is lost while you decide. The download joins the list only when you choose <g1>Start Download</g1> or <g2>Download Later</g2>; <g3>Cancel</g3> drops what it fetched and leaves nothing behind. You can turn this off in <g4>Options → Downloads → Start fetching while Download File Info is open</g4>.
6453a141bfc3ae57.text: 默认情况下，DDM 在此窗口打开时就开始下载，因此在您决定的同时不会浪费时间。只有当您选择<g1>开始下载</g1>或<g2>稍后下载</g2>时，下载才会加入列表；<g3>取消</g3>会丢弃已获取的内容，不留任何痕迹。您可以在<g4>选项 → 下载 → “下载文件信息”打开时开始获取</g4>中关闭此行为。

64654f809c621efe.source: <g1>Download limits</g1> — download no more than a set amount every few hours. The same setting is in the Scheduler; see <g2>Queues and the Scheduler</g2>.
64654f809c621efe.text: <g1>下载限制</g1> — 每隔几小时，限制下载量不超过设定值。计划程序中也有相同设置；请参阅<g2>队列和计划程序</g2>。

647a6ba9cf8c0dae.source: the <x1/> file, and its folder of icons if it has one;
647a6ba9cf8c0dae.text: 该 <x1/> 文件，以及其图标文件夹（如果有）；

648b3c118f4bb30b.source: <g1>The project on GitHub</g1><g2>Code, issues and every release</g2>
648b3c118f4bb30b.text: <g1>GitHub 上的项目</g1><g2>代码、问题和所有发布版本</g2>

648edea923936f72.source: DDM offers the same choice again for the next video when it has that language.
648edea923936f72.text: 下一个视频有相同语言的字幕时，DDM 会再次提供相同的选择。

64b0bbf6e3e92f4b.source: On the same PC and the same test server, DDM fetched a 1 GiB file in 1.0 s against IDM 6.42's 5.5 s, and a 256 KiB file in 0.03 s against 3.1 s: the medians of alternating runs. The <g1>benchmark page</g1> has every run, the method and the raw data.
64b0bbf6e3e92f4b.text: 在同一台电脑和同一测试服务器上，DDM 下载 1 GiB 文件耗时 1.0 秒，而 IDM 6.42 耗时 5.5 秒；下载 256 KiB 文件耗时 0.03 秒，而 IDM 耗时 3.1 秒：这些都是交替运行的中位数。<g1>基准测试页面</g1>包含每次运行、测试方法和原始数据。

64c38b8a1d0fe249.source: Yes. Copy a link to a file and DDM offers to download it at once (<g1>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g1>, on by default). You can also paste links into <g2>Add URL</g2>, drag them onto the drop target, add a whole batch, or use the command line. See <g3>Adding downloads</g3>.
64c38b8a1d0fe249.text: 是的。复制文件链接后，DDM 会立即提供下载（<g1>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g1>，默认开启）。您也可以将链接粘贴到<g2>添加 URL</g2>中，将其拖放到目标区域，添加一整批，或使用命令行。请参阅<g3>添加下载</g3>。

64da2708de9b0827.source: <g1>Logging in.</g1> Write the login in the address (<x2/>), tick <g3>Use authorization</g3>, or save it in <g4>Options → Sites Logins</g4>. Without one, DDM logs in as <x5/>. The path is relative to the folder the login starts in; to start from the server's root, write <x6/> after the server (<x7/>).
64da2708de9b0827.text: <g1>登录。</g1>可将登录信息写入地址（<x2/>）、勾选<g3>使用授权</g3>，或将其保存到<g4>选项 → 站点登录</g4>。如果没有登录信息，DDM 会以 <x5/> 身份登录。路径相对于登录后所在的文件夹；要从服务器根目录开始，请在服务器地址后写入<x6/>（<x7/>）。

64f61d6ae94023a6.source: Menus and the main window's text (Segoe UI)
64f61d6ae94023a6.text: 菜单和主窗口文本 (Segoe UI)

6501a7e45e25931c.source: <g1>Torrents</g1> go through it on Windows too (<g2>#143</g2>): every torrent connection goes out from the adapter's address, with the same kill switch as downloads: peers, trackers, the DHT and the listening port. When the adapter disconnects, torrents stop, nothing goes out another way, and they start again when it is back.
6501a7e45e25931c.text: <g1>种子</g1>在 Windows 上也通过它进行（<g2>#143</g2>）：每个种子连接都从适配器的地址发出，与下载具有相同的断网开关：对等点、跟踪器、DHT 和监听端口。当适配器断开连接时，种子停止，不会有其他方式发出，并在适配器恢复时重新开始。

6506f17b28e02b13.source: Choose <g1>Help → Report a problem</g1>. It opens the bug report form on GitHub with your DDM version, your system and its version, how DDM was installed and its interface language already filled in. Describe what happened, what you expected and the steps that make it happen. For a download, include the address if you can share it, and the reason shown under <g2>Status</g2>.
6506f17b28e02b13.text: 选择<g1>帮助 → 报告问题</g1>。系统会在 GitHub 上打开错误报告表单，并预先填入您的 DDM 版本、系统及其版本、DDM 的安装方式和界面语言。请描述发生了什么、预期结果以及重现问题的步骤。如果问题与下载有关，请尽可能提供下载地址，以及<g2>状态</g2>下显示的原因。

650f31994e698c98.source: Free for Windows, with macOS and Linux to try. Installer, portable zip and the browser extension.
650f31994e698c98.text: Windows 版免费，macOS 和 Linux 版可试用。包含安装程序、便携式压缩包和浏览器扩展。

65105eaefb5fc4a5.source: a text it writes itself (a post's caption, for example);
65105eaefb5fc4a5.text: 它自己写出的文本（例如帖子的说明文字）；

6529f89a5f8b2eee.source: Tasks → Add new download, with a gallery's address
6529f89a5f8b2eee.text: 任务 → 添加新下载，输入图库地址

65405b254c9c07bd.source: The portable copy runs straight from a USB stick and keeps its list and settings there. With a few settings, it saves your downloads to the stick too.
65405b254c9c07bd.text: 便携版可直接从 U 盘运行，并将下载列表和设置保存在 U 盘上。调整几项设置后，下载文件也会保存到 U 盘上。

6542349c43e32bc7.source: The main window: the Categories pane on the left with All Downloads, Unfinished, Finished and Queues, and the download list on the right
6542349c43e32bc7.text: 主窗口：左侧是类别窗格，包含所有下载、未完成、已完成和队列；右侧是下载列表

6543d7e635d11ea1.source: The download list, settings, helpers for video and galleries (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, gallery-dl), torrent data, your <g1>theme files</g1> (<x2/>) and the logs are kept in <x3/>, not in your Windows profile.
6543d7e635d11ea1.text: 下载列表、设置、视频和图库辅助工具（yt-dlp、ffmpeg、gallery-dl）、种子数据、您的<g1>主题文件</g1>（<x2/>）和日志都保存在<x3/>中，而不是您的 Windows 配置文件中。

6564aaf64b6741a4.source: DDM runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11, and on 64-bit Linux: see On Linux. Builds for macOS are new and still experimental: see On a Mac.
6564aaf64b6741a4.text: DDM 运行在 64 位 Windows 10 和 Windows 11，以及 64 位 Linux 上：请参阅“在 Linux 上”。macOS 版本是新推出的，仍处于实验阶段：请参阅“在 Mac 上”。

65a49e0cab20233d.source: Control your downloads from an AI assistant (MCP server) — Dannex Download Manager
65a49e0cab20233d.text: 通过 AI 助手（MCP 服务器）控制下载 — Dannex Download Manager

65b71efc22b4ce41.text: Linux，其他包管理器（pacman 等）的包

65cb5200a6c6b9ad.source: The video download button moves to a free corner instead of covering a control of the page, such as a thumbnail's watch-later button (<g1>#421</g1>). Dragging it still puts it where you want it.
65cb5200a6c6b9ad.text: 视频下载按钮会移动到空闲角落，而不是覆盖页面上的控件，例如缩略图的稍后观看按钮（<g1>#421</g1>）。拖动它仍然可以将其放置在您想要的位置。

65da44cc551abd0f.source: <g1>Download complete</g1> shows the file's size, its address and where it was saved. Choose <g2>Open</g2>, <g3>Open with...</g3>, <g4>Open folder</g4> or <g5>Close</g5>. On Windows you can also drag the small box at the bottom right into Explorer, an email or a chat to drop the file there. The window shows above your other programs until you click it, without taking the keyboard from the one you're typing in.
65da44cc551abd0f.text: <g1>下载完成</g1>窗口显示文件大小、地址和保存位置。您可以选择<g2>打开</g2>、<g3>打开方式...</g3>、<g4>打开文件夹</g4>或<g5>关闭</g5>。在 Windows 上，您还可以将右下角的小框拖到资源管理器、电子邮件或聊天中以放置文件。此窗口会显示在其他程序上方，直到您点击它，但不会抢占您正在输入的程序的键盘焦点。

65fa7d8610e857e4.source: Show the finished file, or resume the unfinished one
65fa7d8610e857e4.text: 显示已完成的文件，或恢复未完成的下载

661637e7fcacdc09.source: <g1>Follow the site's robots.txt</g1> (on by default): pages the site asks robots not to visit are not explored, and a <x2/> it asks for is kept (up to 10 seconds). The window counts the addresses it left out for it.
661637e7fcacdc09.text: <g1>遵循站点的 robots.txt</g1>（默认开启）：站点要求机器人不要访问的页面不会被探索，它要求的 <x2/> 会被遵守（最多 10 秒）。窗口会统计因此被排除的地址数。

662e8cdda4078826.source: 32 MiB, one connection in three crawls at 128 KB/s

66c8f7ac84eb3e9e.source: <g1>Waterfox (and Firefox set to ask what to do with each file): the download stayed in the browser</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>). Firefox's family hands an extension the download only after its <g3>What should … do with this file?</g3> dialog, by which time it has already downloaded the file behind the dialog. DDM now takes the download as the server's answer arrives, before the dialog: for a file DDM takes, the dialog never shows and the browser downloads nothing. Other files open the dialog as before.
66c8f7ac84eb3e9e.text: <g1>Waterfox（以及 Firefox 设置为询问每个文件如何处理时）：下载停留在浏览器中</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）。Firefox 家族只有在其<g3>此文件应如何处理？</g3>对话框之后才会将下载交给扩展程序，而此时它已经在此对话框背后下载了文件。DDM 现在会在服务器响应到达时（在对话框之前）接管下载：对于 DDM 接管的文件，对话框永远不会显示，浏览器也不会下载任何内容。其他文件则像以前一样打开对话框。

66c91a7104a192e0.source: Each grab is kept as a project, listed under <g1>Grabber projects</g1> in the Categories pane and, the latest first, under <g2>Tasks → Grabber projects</g2>. Click a project to see the downloads it added; while it has none, the list offers <g3>Open the project</g3>. Right-click it for:
66c91a7104a192e0.text: 每次抓取都保存为一个项目，列在“类别”窗格的<g1>抓取项目</g1>下，以及<g2>任务 → 抓取项目</g2>下（最新的在前）。单击项目可查看它添加的下载；当它还没有任何下载时，列表会提供<g3>打开项目</g3>。右键单击它可使用：

66d5121e5c0e0523.source: DDM downloads BitTorrent files from magnet links and <x1/> files. Torrents appear in the same list as other downloads, marked <g2>Torrent</g2> in the <g3>Source</g3> column, and can be queued and scheduled like them.
66d5121e5c0e0523.text: DDM 可以从磁力链接和 <x1/> 文件下载 BitTorrent 文件。种子会出现在与其他下载相同的列表中，在<g3>源</g3>列中标记为<g2>种子</g2>，并且可以像其他下载一样进行排队和计划。

66e61fa9b0888d8e.source: <g1>Must not contain</g1>: words that make the rule skip an article.
66e61fa9b0888d8e.text: <g1>不得包含</g1>：使规则跳过文章的词语。

66f0a3d1e574e041.source: DDM extracts safely. A name that would lead outside the folder is left out, and so is a link to somewhere else on the disk. An archive that would write far more than its size, or more than the disk has room for, stops before it fills it. When something goes wrong, nothing but the archive is left behind.
66f0a3d1e574e041.text: DDM 会安全地提取文件。可能导致文件被写入文件夹之外的路径会被忽略，指向磁盘其他位置的链接也会被忽略。如果存档会写入远超自身大小的数据，或超出磁盘可用空间，提取会在磁盘写满前停止。如果提取出错，除了存档外不会留下任何文件。

66f7530c7179f562.source: <g1>The Download video button over the video</g1> passes that page's cookies, from the window and profile you're in (a private window, a Firefox container), for the look-up and the download. Nothing to set up. Each cookie goes with the domain the browser keeps it for, so a sign-in on YouTube Music (music.youtube.com) or YouTube's mobile site reaches www.youtube.com too.
66f7530c7179f562.text: <g1>视频上方的下载视频按钮</g1>会传递您当前窗口和配置文件（私人窗口、Firefox 容器）中的页面 Cookie，用于查找和下载。无需设置。每个 Cookie 都与其浏览器保存的域一起使用，因此在 YouTube Music (music.youtube.com) 或 YouTube 移动网站上的登录也会到达 www.youtube.com。

67300cd45bbe6ef2.source: Borders and the hover and pressed shades are mixed from these, as for a theme file's <x1/>. Text stays readable: text and secondary text at 4.5:1 or more against every background they sit on (WCAG AA), the accent at 3:1. A scheme short of that has those colours moved a little darker (lighter on a dark scheme) until they pass; DDM's log says which.
67300cd45bbe6ef2.text: 边框以及悬停和按下时的阴影是根据主题文件的 <x1/> 从这些颜色混合而成的。文本保持可读性：文本和次要文本与其所在的所有背景的对比度至少为 4.5:1 (WCAG AA)，强调色为 3:1。如果方案不符合此要求，这些颜色会稍微变暗（深色方案则变亮），直到通过为止；DDM 的日志会说明具体情况。
