755549897c2cdec4.source: Windows: fewer freezes ("The window stopped responding") on a system held up by its disk or its memory. Every 2 seconds, and in each frame of an open dialog, DDM asked Windows about its windows' title bar colours, and the window waited with Windows' answer; it now sets a title bar's light or dark once, when the window opens or the theme changes. Looking for its own windows no longer waits on another busy part of DDM either (<g1>#633</g1>, <g2>#583</g2>).
755549897c2cdec4.text: Windows：在被磁盘或内存拖慢的系统上，冻结（“窗口已停止响应”）减少了。每 2 秒，以及打开的对话框的每一帧，DDM 都会向 Windows 询问其窗口标题栏的颜色，窗口要等 Windows 的应答；现在它在窗口打开或主题更改时，只设置一次标题栏的浅色或深色。查找自己的窗口也不再等待 DDM 中另一个繁忙的部分（<g1>#633</g1>、<g2>#583</g2>）。

7558ab642481a394.source: The browser extension's toolbar button lists DDM's downloads with the same <x1/>, and pauses, resumes and opens their folders with the same actions, whatever the API's switch: its helper marks what it asks with <x2/>. It asks nothing else that way.
7558ab642481a394.text: 浏览器扩展的工具栏按钮用同样的 <x1/> 列出 DDM 的下载，并用同样的操作暂停、恢复和打开其文件夹，不受 API 开关影响：其辅助程序用 <x2/> 标明它的请求。它不会以这种方式请求其他任何内容。

755c9430c92ad5b4.source: Save it in this folder (else the category's folder from <g1>Options → Save to</g1>).
755c9430c92ad5b4.text: 将其保存到此文件夹（否则保存到<g1>选项 → 保存到</g1>中对应类别的文件夹）。

756eb85314856d65.source: A download resumes where it stopped: after you stop it, after the connection drops, or after Windows or DDM crashes. DDM saves how far each part has got as it goes.
756eb85314856d65.text: 下载会从停止的位置继续：无论是手动停止、连接中断，还是 Windows 或 DDM 崩溃。DDM 会在下载过程中保存每个部分的进度。

7575c799ddabcc55.source: In Safari the toolbar button's click works the same way, but Safari gives an extension's button no right-click menu: open <g1>Safari → Settings → Extensions → DDM Integration Module → Settings</g1> for the options page.
7575c799ddabcc55.text: 在 Safari 中，工具栏按钮的单击作用相同，但 Safari 不给扩展的按钮提供右键菜单：请打开<g1>Safari → 设置 → 扩展 → DDM Integration Module → 设置</g1>进入选项页。

7599425ea536d1d0.source: Options on its Archives page: Extract archives when their download completes, Then move the archives to the Recycle Bin, where an archive's files go, the 7-Zip found, and Link grabber's look-ups
7599425ea536d1d0.text: 其“压缩包”页面上的选项包括：下载完成后提取存档、然后将存档移至回收站、压缩包文件的存放位置、已找到的 7-Zip，以及链接抓取器的查找功能

75a80bd6b1eeb9c6.source: Install DDM with the setup from <g1>the download page</g1>, and keep <g2>Set up browser integration</g2> ticked.
75a80bd6b1eeb9c6.text: 使用<g1>下载页面</g1>中的安装程序安装 DDM，并确保勾选<g2>设置浏览器集成</g2>。

75a8d67e8ef43ede.source: End-to-end medians with interquartile ranges, the ratio with its 95% interval, and the Mann–Whitney test, as <x1/> writes them.
75a8d67e8ef43ede.text: 端到端时间的中位数和四分位距、比率及其 95% 区间，以及 Mann–Whitney 检验结果，均按 <x1/> 的格式列出。

75bf519c9d8327cd.source: The web page is the one your browser had open (or where a site grabber project found the link); for a video, its own page. A link you added by hand says <g1>Unknown</g1>. The page and the <g2>Referer</g2> are kept with the list, so they are still there after DDM restarts.
75bf519c9d8327cd.text: 网页是指您的浏览器当时打开的页面（或站点抓取项目找到该链接的位置）；对于视频，则是其自己的页面。手动添加的链接显示为<g1>未知</g1>。该页面和<g2>引用页</g2>会与列表一起保存，因此 DDM 重启后它们仍然存在。

75c5e88776534271.source: Adding a link again after its finished file was moved or deleted starts a new download, instead of asking about a duplicate that isn't there (<g1>#342</g1>).
75c5e88776534271.text: 在已完成的文件被移动或删除后再次添加链接，会开始新的下载，而不是询问不存在的重复文件（<g1>#342</g1>）。

76183f0e11216add.source: Does it run on Windows 7 or 8? — Dannex Download Manager
76183f0e11216add.text: 能在 Windows 7 或 8 上运行吗？— Dannex Download Manager

76215a248670b754.source: <g1><g2>Troubleshooting</g2></g1> — what to check when a download fails, the browser doesn't hand over a download, or a schedule doesn't start.
76215a248670b754.text: <g1><g2>故障排除</g2></g1> — 下载失败、浏览器未移交下载任务或计划未启动时，需要检查哪些内容。

7626e75c2b62c9da.text: Xfce 上的 DDM 主窗口

7656183623a80fa6.source: The main window in the Aqua theme

76569424bfaa0f84.source: <g1>Synchronization queue</g1> — finished downloads stay in it instead of leaving. It is the only queue that takes finished downloads.
76569424bfaa0f84.text: <g1>同步队列</g1> — 已完成的下载会保留在此队列中，不会移除。这是唯一一个会接收已完成下载的队列。

7686693c810faee2.source: <g1>View → Always dark</g1> (<g2>#60</g2>): DDM stays dark whatever the system says, for a desktop that reports no light or dark preference (DDM also reads it on Linux now, see Fixed).
7686693c810faee2.text: <g1>视图 → 始终为深色</g1>（<g2>#60</g2>）：无论系统设置如何，DDM 始终保持深色模式，适用于未报告浅色或深色偏好的桌面（DDM 现在也能在 Linux 上读取此设置，详见“已修复”）。

76aa885d2d428ace.source: <g1>Luna, Aero and Aqua</g1>, after Windows XP, Windows 7 and Mac OS X (Leopard), each with a light and a dark side and icons drawn for DDM in its era's manner. <g2>Luna</g2>: buttons shaded from white with a dark blue edge and an orange glow under the pointer, green ticks, square text boxes, progress in green blocks and a deep blue title bar with the title in bold and square buttons (Close red). <g3>Aero</g3>: glossy buttons in two halves that turn light blue under the pointer, quiet check boxes, a glossy green progress bar and a glassy title bar, the title on a soft glow, its buttons hung from the top (Close wider and red). <g4>Aqua</g4>: gel buttons round at the ends (the default one blue), glossy check boxes, a blue focus ring, a blue gel progress bar and a grey title bar with the title centred and small round graphite buttons whose glyphs show under the pointer. Every glyph and shade is DDM's own drawing; none of Microsoft's or Apple's pictures or fonts are used.
76aa885d2d428ace.text: <g1>Luna、Aero 和 Aqua</g1>：分别仿照 Windows XP、Windows 7 和 Mac OS X (Leopard) 界面风格，每种风格都有浅色和深色模式，图标按其时代风格为 DDM 绘制。<g2>Luna</g2>：按钮从白色渐变，深蓝色边缘，指针悬停时有橙色光晕，绿色勾选，方形文本框，绿色块状进度条，深蓝色标题栏，标题粗体，方形按钮（“关闭”按钮为红色）。<g3>Aero</g3>：光泽按钮分为两半，指针悬停时变为浅蓝色，简洁的复选框，光泽绿色进度条，玻璃质感标题栏，标题带有柔和光晕，按钮悬挂在顶部（“关闭”按钮更宽，为红色）。<g4>Aqua</g4>：两端圆润的凝胶按钮（默认按钮为蓝色），光泽复选框，蓝色焦点环，蓝色凝胶进度条，灰色标题栏，标题居中，小型圆形石墨按钮，其字形在指针悬停时显示。所有字形和阴影均为 DDM 自行绘制；未使用任何 Microsoft 或 Apple 的图片或字体。

76bbb49f8701559e.source: <g1>Off</g1> (the default) — yt-dlp gets cookies only from the browser's extension, when you use the button over a video.
76bbb49f8701559e.text: <g1>关</g1>（默认）— yt-dlp 仅在您使用视频上方的按钮时，从浏览器扩展程序获取 Cookie。

76ce76c1e1586496.source: The window freezes or draws wrongly

76e8fe34285e22ca.source: Turn the look-ups off in <g1>Options → Archives → Look links up when they arrive</g1>. Some file hosts count a look-up as a download.
76e8fe34285e22ca.text: 在<g1>选项 → 存档 → 链接到达时查询</g1>中关闭查询功能。有些文件托管网站会将查询计为一次下载。

7704f35f9d60deac.source: Our benchmark, replayed: the same PC, the same test server, the median of alternating runs.
7704f35f9d60deac.text: 重现我们的基准测试：使用同一台电脑和同一台测试服务器，交替运行并取中位数。

771d962d77eeb085.source: <g1><g2>Control DDM from your phone</g2></g1> — add links, magnets and torrents from a phone or another computer at home, and watch and control the list.
771d962d77eeb085.text: <g1><g2>用手机控制 DDM</g2></g1> — 在家时，从手机或另一台电脑添加链接、磁力链接和种子，并查看和控制下载列表。

7726c41ccf589277.source: It stores its own settings (paused or not, DDM's file types and excluded sites, its connection status, where you dragged the video button on each of the last 200 sites; nothing from private windows) in the browser's extension storage, on your computer.
7726c41ccf589277.text: 它会将自己的设置（是否暂停、DDM 的文件类型和排除的网站、连接状态，以及您在最近 200 个网站上拖动视频按钮的位置；不包含私密窗口中的任何内容）存储在您计算机上的浏览器扩展程序存储空间中。

773cad2b0e40c996.source: Choose <g1>Daily</g1> and tick the days, or <g2>Once at</g2> and pick a date.
773cad2b0e40c996.text: 选择<g1>每日</g1>并勾选日期，或选择<g2>一次在</g2>并选择一个日期。

774d3300ac9f2e73.source: To skip that question and always use the <g1>Main download queue</g1>, turn off <g2>Options → Downloads → Ask for the queue on Download Later</g2>.
774d3300ac9f2e73.text: 若要跳过该提问并始终使用<g1>主下载队列</g1>，请关闭<g2>选项 → 下载 → 稍后下载时询问加入哪个队列</g2>。

775acb9f997b4090.source: A browser fetches a file over one connection. DDM asks the server for several parts of the file at once, up to 32 connections (128 if you allow it), and keeps re-splitting: when a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the biggest part still left, so no slow connection holds up the end. It also remembers servers that refuse extra connections and stops asking them. See Connections and speed.
775acb9f997b4090.text: 浏览器通过一个连接获取文件。DDM 会同时向服务器请求文件的多个部分，最多 32 个连接（如果允许，可达 128 个），并持续重新拆分：当一个连接完成其部分后，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，这样就不会有慢速连接拖延整个下载。它还会记住拒绝额外连接的服务器，并停止向它们请求。请参阅连接和速度。

77600c3c5161113f.source: Android; Windows, macOS, Linux in beta
77600c3c5161113f.text: Android；Windows, macOS, Linux 处于测试阶段

7795e2b94936333b.source: your user name, which shows as <x1/> in folder paths.
7795e2b94936333b.text: 用户名（在文件夹路径中显示为<x1/>）。

77990b32e22a429d.source: Browsers built on Firefox or Chromium, such as Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp, Waterfox and Helium, reach DDM. Flatpak browsers on Linux can't start DDM's helper.
77990b32e22a429d.text: 基于 Firefox 或 Chromium 构建的浏览器，例如 Zen、LibreWolf、Floorp、Waterfox 和 Helium，都可以连接到 DDM。Linux 上的 Flatpak 浏览器无法启动 DDM 的助手。

779b7a8636b6d838.source: <g1>Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR:</g1> open <x2/>, set <x3/> to <x4/>, then open <x5/>, click the gear, <g6>Install Add-on From File…</g6>, and choose the file.
779b7a8636b6d838.text: <g1>Firefox Developer Edition、Nightly 或 ESR：</g1>打开 <x2/>，把 <x3/> 设为 <x4/>，再打开 <x5/>，点击齿轮图标，选择<g6>从文件安装附加组件…</g6>，然后选择该文件。

779d3d89172c13c6.source: The browser asks to confirm: click <g1>Add extension</g1>. It keeps the extension up to date.
779d3d89172c13c6.text: 浏览器会要求确认：点击<g1>添加扩展</g1>。浏览器会自动更新此扩展。

77a524c1d8c2a24b.source: <g1>Firefox</g1> (and Zen, LibreWolf): one click from its add-ons store, and Firefox keeps it up to date.
77a524c1d8c2a24b.text: <g1>Firefox</g1>（以及 Zen、LibreWolf）：从其附加组件商店一键安装，Firefox 会保持其最新状态。

77a978c0273a44bd.source: <g1>Two smaller macOS downloads</g1> (<g2>#25</g2>): a .dmg for Apple Silicon (<x3/>, about 14 MB) and one for Intel (<x4/>, about 16 MB) instead of one universal .dmg of 80 MB. From {v1} or older, update once by hand: <g5>Download</g5> in Check for updates opens the release; pick your Mac's .dmg. <g6>Update now</g6> works again after that.
77a978c0273a44bd.text: <g1>macOS 下载文件分为两个更小的版本</g1>（<g2>#25</g2>）：一个适用于 Apple Silicon 的 .dmg（<x3/>，约 14 MB）和一个适用于 Intel 的 .dmg（<x4/>，约 16 MB），取代了之前 80 MB 的通用 .dmg。从 {v1} 或更早版本更新时，需要手动更新一次：<g5>下载</g5>在“检查更新”中打开发布页面；选择适用于您 Mac 的 .dmg。之后<g6>立即更新</g6>将再次可用。

77d82afba3bb8011.source: <g1>The toolbar's buttons work again</g1>: Add URL, Add Torrent, Delete Completed, Options, Scheduler, Start Queue and the others did nothing when clicked in {v1}; their drop-down arrows did.
77d82afba3bb8011.text: <g1>工具栏按钮已恢复正常</g1>：在 {v1} 版中，点击“添加 URL”“添加 Torrent”“删除已完成”“选项”“计划程序”“启动队列”等按钮都没有反应，只有下拉箭头有效。

77e3a7999ea3e995.source: The tree's chevrons, where the variant draws them
77e3a7999ea3e995.text: 树的V形箭头，由变体绘制

77efacf2c131fb24.source: Closed to the notification area, DDM gives its memory back to Windows: <g1>Memory</g1> drops to under 10 MB within seconds and stays low while it waits. Downloads, queues and the scheduler go on as before. The list of every language (<g2>View → Language</g2>) loads fonts for every script while it's open; DDM lets them go when it closes.
77efacf2c131fb24.text: 关闭到通知区域后，DDM 会将占用的内存还给 Windows：几秒钟内，<g1>内存</g1>会降至 10 MB 以下，并在等待期间保持较低水平。下载、队列和计划任务照常运行。打开每种语言的列表（<g2>视图 → 语言</g2>）时，会加载所有文字系统所需的字体；关闭列表后，DDM 会释放这些字体。

7813c4b8661ca90d.source: <g1>Image galleries</g1><g2>Paste a gallery's address and DDM saves all its pictures into a folder of their own.</g2>
7813c4b8661ca90d.text: <g1>图片画廊</g1><g2>粘贴画廊地址，DDM 会将所有图片保存到单独的文件夹中。</g2>

78227832e7b70201.source: DDM splits a file into parts and downloads them side by side, then keeps every connection busy until the last byte. If the line drops or the computer restarts, the download carries on from where it was.
78227832e7b70201.text: DDM 将文件分成多个部分并同时下载，然后保持每个连接忙碌，直到下载完最后一个字节。如果网络中断或计算机重启，下载会从中断处继续。

7827c6282f85b6d5.source: Dannex Download Manager's main window on Ubuntu's GNOME desktop, in night mode.
7827c6282f85b6d5.text: Dannex Download Manager 在 Ubuntu GNOME 桌面上的主窗口，夜间模式。

782ff1221a908792.source: DDM doesn't accept this copy (DDM older than it)
782ff1221a908792.text: DDM 不接受此副本（DDM 比它旧）

784cf3bd0d0adfdb.source: By default the list shows the columns IDM users know: <g1>File Name</g1>, <g2>Q</g2>, <g3>Size</g3>, <g4>Status</g4>, <g5>Time left</g5>, <g6>Transfer rate</g6>, <g7>Last Try Date</g7> and <g8>Description</g8>. The torrent columns (<g9>Upload speed</g9>, <g10>Peers</g10>, <g11>Share ratio</g11>) show in the <g12>Torrents</g12> category, where they mean something, until you show or hide one yourself. <g13>Source</g13> and <g14>Added</g14> are there to tick when you want them.
784cf3bd0d0adfdb.text: 默认情况下，列表显示 IDM 用户熟悉的列：<g1>文件名</g1>、<g2>Q</g2>、<g3>大小</g3>、<g4>状态</g4>、<g5>剩余时间</g5>、<g6>传输速率</g6>、<g7>上次尝试日期</g7>和<g8>描述</g8>。种子相关的列（<g9>上传速度</g9>、<g10>节点</g10>、<g11>共享率</g11>）会在<g12>种子</g12>类别中显示，因为在那里它们才有意义，直到您自己显示或隐藏某一列。<g13>来源</g13>和<g14>添加时间</g14>可在需要时勾选。

786383d16d2f2d90.source: Before it continues, DDM checks that the file on the server is still the same one, so a changed file never gets stitched onto an old half. When a server can't send a file in parts, the progress window says <g1>Resume capability: No</g1> before you rely on it.
786383d16d2f2d90.text: 在继续下载之前，DDM 会检查服务器上的文件是否仍然是同一个文件，因此更改过的文件绝不会与旧的半成品拼接在一起。当服务器无法分段发送文件时，进度窗口会在您依赖它之前显示<g1>恢复功能：否</g1>。

78735d70990230cd.source: Videos keep to the <g1>Speed Limiter</g1>: the limit for one file, a video's own limit (the <g2>Speed Limiter</g2> tab of its progress window), and the limit for all downloads together, which they share with every other download. DDM's own downloader brings them in, so a change applies at once, as for a file.
78735d70990230cd.text: 视频会遵守<g1>速度限制器</g1>：单个文件的限制、视频本身的限制（其进度窗口的<g2>速度限制器</g2>选项卡），以及所有下载任务的总限制，它们与其他所有下载任务共享此限制。DDM 自己的下载器会下载它们，因此更改会立即生效，就像对文件一样。

789ceb2a0c6594a0.source: Height of a row in the download list

789f61f29abda046.source: <g1>A server without ranges no longer sends the file twice</g1> (<g2>#136</g2>): when the extra connections' answers came late (a busy computer), the download could finish and then start over on one connection, fetching the whole file again. DDM now stops its other connections once every byte is in, and a server that never said it takes ranges is known for one at its first full answer (a CDN that says it does and misses a range now and then still gets several connections).
789f61f29abda046.text: <g1>服务器不再重复发送不带范围的文件</g1>（<g2>#136</g2>）：当额外连接的响应延迟（计算机繁忙）时，下载可能完成，然后在一个连接上重新开始，再次获取整个文件。DDM 现在会在所有字节都到位后停止其他连接，并且对于从未声明支持范围的服务器，DDM 会在其第一次完整响应时将其识别为支持范围的服务器（而对于那些声明支持但偶尔丢失范围的 CDN，DDM 仍会使用多个连接）。

78b941511ecd4414.source: The browser extension's <g1>Download video</g1> button over a video opens the same qualities in a menu over the page (<g2>Browser integration</g2>). yt-dlp takes a few seconds to look a video up, so the menu doesn't wait for it when the page already says what it holds:
78b941511ecd4414.text: 浏览器扩展在视频上的<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮会在页面上方的菜单中打开相同的画质列表（<g2>浏览器集成</g2>）。yt-dlp 需要几秒钟来查找视频，因此当页面已经说明其内容时，菜单不会等待它：

78c318b1f146d438.source: <g1>Derived palettes.</g1> <x2/> makes a whole palette from a few seeds (background, surface, text, accent…), mixing every other role in OKLab and keeping WCAG contrast (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for edges); High contrast strengthens every edge on top. <x3/> seeds the Native theme from the system's accent and contrast (Windows' settings, the freedesktop portal on Linux, macOS's accent).
78c318b1f146d438.text: <g1>派生调色板。</g1> <x2/> 从几个种子（背景、表面、文本、强调色…）生成完整的调色板，在 OKLab 中混合所有其他角色并保持 WCAG 对比度（文本 4.5:1，边缘 3:1）；高对比度会加强所有边缘。 <x3/> 根据系统的强调色和对比度（Windows 设置、Linux 上的 freedesktop 门户、macOS 的强调色）为“原生”主题提供种子。

78d1901f870994d6.source: Every window, from the keyboard. Read aloud.
78d1901f870994d6.text: 所有窗口，均可通过键盘操作。可朗读。

78d6a8631b6a39e7.source: A chart's background: the speed graphs, Statistics' charts
78d6a8631b6a39e7.text: 图表的背景：速度图、统计信息的图表

78e579434cd145d4.source: <g1>Keep running when closing the window</g1> — closing the main window hides it in the notification area instead of quitting, and downloads, queues and schedules go on. On by default; unticked, closing quits DDM (so a <g2>portable copy</g2>'s folder can then be deleted). If there is no icon for DDM at all — not even behind the ^ hidden icons — the window minimizes to the taskbar instead, so downloads continue and the window stays reachable; an icon behind ^ can be clicked to bring it back, or start DDM again. Greyed where no tray shows DDM's icon (some Linux desktops): closing quits there.
78e579434cd145d4.text: <g1>关闭窗口时保持运行</g1> — 关闭主窗口时，它会隐藏到通知区域而不是退出，下载、队列和计划会继续进行。默认开启；如果取消勾选，关闭窗口会退出 DDM（这样<g2>便携版</g2>的文件夹就可以被删除）。如果完全没有 DDM 的图标 — 甚至在 ^ 隐藏图标后面也没有 — 窗口会最小化到任务栏，这样下载会继续，窗口也保持可访问；可以点击 ^ 后面的图标将其恢复，或再次启动 DDM。在没有托盘显示 DDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面）会变灰：关闭时会退出。

790e0458e3fc7df1.source: <g1>docker/unraid.xml</g1> is a template: copy it to <x2/> on the flash drive, then <g3>Docker → Add Container</g3> and pick <g4>dannexdownloadmanager</g4>. It maps <x5/> to <x6/>, <x7/> to a share, the port 8463, and runs as <x8/> (99:100), as Unraid's shares expect. The image must be built first (above), on the server or pushed to a registry you use. If the container's log says a folder belongs to another user, give it to <x9/> once: <x10/>.
790e0458e3fc7df1.text: <g1>docker/unraid.xml</g1> 是一个模板：将其复制到闪存驱动器上的 <x2/>，然后选择 <g3>Docker → 添加容器</g3> 并选择 <g4>dannexdownloadmanager</g4>。它将 <x5/> 映射到 <x6/>，将 <x7/> 映射到一个共享，端口为 8463，并以 <x8/> (99:100) 身份运行，正如 Unraid 的共享所期望的那样。镜像必须先在服务器上构建（如上所述），或者推送到您使用的注册表。如果容器日志显示某个文件夹属于其他用户，请将其一次性授予 <x9/>：<x10/>。

792486c20eef0fae.source: DDM sends the service only the links you download through it, and your account's token or key. Nothing else.
792486c20eef0fae.text: DDM 只会将您通过它下载的链接以及您账户的令牌或密钥发送给服务，不会发送其他信息。

7924d76a6c3632e9.source: Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser: each browser found, with a button to add the extension to it
7924d76a6c3632e9.text: 将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器：列出找到的每个浏览器，以及为其添加扩展的按钮

793dc38942ce9ab9.source: A control is greyed only while it can't apply: a box under a choice that is off, a button with nothing selected.
793dc38942ce9ab9.text: 控件仅在无法应用时才显示为灰色：处于关闭状态的选项下方的框，或未选中任何内容时的按钮。

79639c98d5418ae1.source: Sign-in secrets (debrid accounts, Sites Logins' and the proxy's passwords) live in the system's keychain (<x1/>, #44): Windows Credential Manager (<x2/>), the Secret Service on Linux or the macOS keychain (<x3/>). The settings keep a <x4/> reference in their place, written only once the keychain has confirmed the secret; without a keychain (or with a locked one, never unlocked for DDM) the secret stays in the settings as before.
79639c98d5418ae1.text: 登录凭据（debrid 账户、“站点登录”和代理的密码）存储在系统的密钥链中 (<x1/>, #44)：Windows 凭据管理器 (<x2/>)，Linux 上的 Secret Service 或 macOS 密钥链 (<x3/>)。设置中保留一个 <x4/> 引用，仅在密钥链确认凭据后写入；如果没有密钥链（或密钥链已锁定，且从未为 DDM 解锁），凭据仍像以前一样保存在设置中。

796b5a121f210921.source: The downloads go to a queue. As with Download Later, DDM asks which queue unless you turn off <g1>Options → Downloads → Ask for the queue after a batch download</g1>.
796b5a121f210921.text: 这些下载会进入一个队列。与“稍后下载”一样，DDM 会询问加入哪个队列，除非您关闭<g1>选项 → 下载 → 批量下载后询问加入哪个队列</g1>。

7985eb68e0350f85.source: <g1><g2>Report a problem</g2></g1> — or use <g3>Help → Report a problem</g3> in DDM, which fills in your version, system and how DDM was installed for you.
7985eb68e0350f85.text: <g1><g2>报告问题</g2></g1> — 或者在 DDM 中使用<g3>帮助 → 报告问题</g3>，它会自动填写您的版本、系统以及 DDM 的安装方式。

798a534b6b549e15.source: <g1>Things that fail say why</g1>: opening a file that was moved, a file that can't be deleted or moved, the list that can't be saved, a computer that won't shut down, a check closed early.
798a534b6b549e15.text: <g1>操作失败时会说明原因</g1>：打开已移动的文件、删除或移动文件失败、保存列表失败、计算机无法关机，以及检查提前关闭。

799b0b15db05f399.source: If the server needs a login, tick <g1>Use authorization</g1>.
799b0b15db05f399.text: 如果服务器需要登录，请勾选<g1>使用授权</g1>。

799d83a8ce1f6faf.source: Once you switch on <g1>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g1> in its popup (Firefox asks you first), when the browser uses a proxy for a download (set by a VPN or proxy extension, or in its settings), the extension passes <g2>the proxy's address</g2>, or its <g3>proxy auto-config script</g3>, so DDM downloads through the same proxy. It never reads or passes the proxy's login. It notes only that a proxy asked for one, so DDM can tell you it can't use that proxy. Switched off (as installed), it reads nothing of the browser's proxy.
799d83a8ce1f6faf.text: 一旦您在其弹出窗口中开启<g1>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g1>（Firefox 会先询问您），当浏览器通过代理进行下载时（由 VPN 或代理扩展设置，或在其设置中设置），该扩展会传递<g2>代理地址</g2>或其<g3>代理自动配置脚本</g3>，以便 DDM 通过相同的代理下载。它绝不会读取或传递代理的登录信息。它只记录代理请求过一次，因此 DDM 可以告诉您它无法使用该代理。关闭时（默认安装状态），它不读取浏览器的代理信息。

79a0cbc1cf868d3a.source: A theme in a folder of its own (<x1/>) can bring its icons in <x2/> and <x3/> (and, for PNG pictures, <x4/> and <x5/>, used on a screen scaled to 150 % and more), each named for what it shows (<x6/>, <x7/>…). SVG and PNG files keep their colours; <x8/> and <x9/> ones, as GNOME and KDE name them, take the theme's text colour. An icon the set lacks is drawn as the classic look draws it. The full list of names is in <g10>themeicons.rs</g10> (<x11/>).
79a0cbc1cf868d3a.text: 位于独立文件夹中的主题（<x1/>）可以在<x2/>和<x3/>中（对于 PNG 图片，还有<x4/>和<x5/>，用于 150% 及以上缩放的屏幕）引入其图标，每个图标都以其显示的内容命名（<x6/>、<x7/>…）。SVG 和 PNG 文件保留其颜色；<x8/>和<x9/>文件，如 GNOME 和 KDE 所命名，采用主题的文本颜色。缺少图标的集合将以经典外观绘制。名称的完整列表在<g10>themeicons.rs</g10>（<x11/>）中。

79a5c315d6e44215.source: <g1>A Safari extension, inside the Mac app:</g1> a click on a link to a file type DDM takes goes to DDM, and so do the right-click items, the button over videos and <g2>Media on this page</g2>, as in the other browsers. Safari gives extensions no access to its downloads, so a download a page starts by itself stays with Safari, and the browser's proxy is not shared. See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
79a5c315d6e44215.text: <g1>Mac 应用内嵌 Safari 扩展：</g1>点击 DDM 支持的文件类型链接会跳转到 DDM，右键菜单项、视频上方的按钮和<g2>此页面上的媒体</g2>也同样如此，与其他浏览器一致。Safari 不允许扩展访问其下载，因此页面自身启动的下载仍由 Safari 处理，且浏览器代理不共享。请参阅<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

79a674edc4b6045b.source: <g1>Resume a broken download</g1> covers expired links too.
79a674edc4b6045b.text: <g1>恢复中断的下载</g1>也适用于过期链接。

79d14e9946a23846.source: The assistant can't change DDM's options, see your browser, or turn the automation API on by itself.
79d14e9946a23846.text: 助手无法更改 DDM 的选项、查看您的浏览器，也无法自行开启自动化 API。

79f1921905dfa0ca.source: A chart's grid lines, a share bar's track
79f1921905dfa0ca.text: 图表的网格线，占比条的轨道

79f8119259b62349.source: The extension no longer asks you to update DDM when only a bug-fix version separates them, which it did even when there was no update to get.
79f8119259b62349.text: 当 DDM 仅有一个错误修复版本更新时，扩展程序不再要求您更新 DDM，即使当时没有可用的更新。

7a013b94d0d00807.source: <g1><x2/></g1> — strengthens every edge and text colour on top of the rest.
7a013b94d0d00807.text: <g1><x2/></g1> — 在其他颜色之上，加强每个边缘和文本颜色。

7a10ae909a8694f8.source: For your own DNS: the servers' IP addresses, the name their certificate shows (TLS), or the <x1/> address (HTTPS, with its IP addresses if you know them). NextDNS takes your configuration ID.
7a10ae909a8694f8.text: 自定义 DNS：输入服务器的 IP 地址、证书中显示的名称（TLS），或 <x1/> 地址（HTTPS；如果知道其 IP 地址，也可以填写）。NextDNS 则需要填写配置 ID。

7a2c84c39d465281.source: Firefox, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, through the DDM browser extension (it comes with DDM; its listings on addons.mozilla.org and in the Chrome Web Store are on their way), and browsers built on them: Zen and LibreWolf, Helium. The extension hands downloads to DDM with their cookies and referrer, so files behind a sign-in still work, and it adds Download with DDM to the right-click menu and a Download video button over videos. See Browser integration.
7a2c84c39d465281.text: 通过 DDM 浏览器扩展支持 Firefox、Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi（扩展随 DDM 提供；其在 addons.mozilla.org 和 Chrome Web Store 的页面即将上线），以及基于它们的浏览器：Zen、LibreWolf 和 Helium。扩展会把下载连同 Cookie 和来源页面一起交给 DDM，因此需要登录才能访问的文件也能正常下载；它还会在右键菜单中加入使用 DDM 下载，并在视频上方显示下载视频按钮。参见浏览器集成。

7a431c024b9ed18e.source: Choose <g1>Subtitles</g1> if you want them (see below).
7a431c024b9ed18e.text: 需要字幕时，选择<g1>字幕</g1>（见下文）。

7a4733c4250308a8.source: Yes. DDM accepts IDM's familiar command-line switches, comes with dannexdownloadmanager-cli for downloads from a terminal, and has a local, token-protected…
7a4733c4250308a8.text: 是。DDM 接受 IDM 熟悉的命令行开关，附带 dannexdownloadmanager-cli 用于从终端下载，并具有一个本地的、受令牌保护的…

7a4ee35b0d941e48.source: RSS feeds for torrents, with download rules — Dannex Download Manager
7a4ee35b0d941e48.text: 带下载规则的种子 RSS 源 — Dannex Download Manager

7a5b7ab31d5f22cb.source: Click <g1>Add Torrent</g1> on the toolbar to open a <x2/> file, or use the arrow next to it for <g3>Add magnet link...</g3>. A magnet link pasted into <g4>Add URL</g4> works too. Torrents land in the same list as your other downloads, marked <g5>Torrent</g5> in the <g6>Source</g6> column, and go into queues and the Scheduler like them.
7a5b7ab31d5f22cb.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 Torrent</g1>以打开 <x2/> 文件，或使用旁边的箭头选择<g3>添加磁力链接…</g3>。粘贴到<g4>添加 URL</g4>中的磁力链接也同样有效。种子会出现在您其他下载任务的同一列表中，在<g6>来源</g6>列中标记为<g5>种子</g5>，并像其他任务一样进入队列和计划程序。

7a6ff9503edd25ad.source: Is the site in <g1>Don't start downloading automatically from the following sites</g1>?
7a6ff9503edd25ad.text: 该网站是否在<g1>不要从以下网站自动开始下载</g1>中？

7a77ad085222bc5b.source: <g1><x2/></g1> <g3><g4>Make your own theme</g4><g5>A text file of colours and sizes, tried in seconds. Three steps.</g5></g3>
7a77ad085222bc5b.text: <g1><x2/></g1> <g3><g4>创建您自己的主题</g4><g5>一个包含颜色和尺寸的文本文件，几秒钟即可试用。只需三步。</g5></g3>

7a7f1a80d67e4b64.source: In a Wayland session (GNOME, KDE Plasma and others), DDM's windows run through XWayland when it is there: Wayland doesn't let a program place its own windows, so DDM's menus and drop-down lists would open in the middle of the screen. To run on Wayland itself anyway, start it with <x1/>. If the system lacks a library X11 windows need (such as libxkbcommon-x11, which the .deb and .rpm bring but the AppImage and the tar.gz can't), DDM opens on Wayland instead; with no window system it can use, it names what's missing and the command that installs it.
7a7f1a80d67e4b64.text: 在 Wayland 会话（GNOME、KDE Plasma 及其他）中，如果存在 XWayland，DDM 的窗口会通过 XWayland 运行：Wayland 不允许程序自行放置窗口，因此 DDM 的菜单和下拉列表会打开在屏幕中央。若要在 Wayland 本身运行，请使用<x1/>启动。如果系统缺少 X11 窗口所需的库（例如 libxkbcommon-x11，.deb 和 .rpm 包会提供，但 AppImage 和 tar.gz 包无法提供），DDM 会转而在 Wayland 上打开；如果没有可用的窗口系统，它会列出缺失的组件和安装命令。

7aad71c792353898.source: <g1>Open folder</g1> works on a torrent that is still downloading (<g2>#354</g2>).
7aad71c792353898.text: 对于仍在下载的种子，<g1>打开文件夹</g1>功能现在可以正常使用（<g2>#354</g2>）。

7ab13cf63ca91547.source: Every release lists the SHA-256 checksum of each file in <g1>SHA256SUMS.txt</g1>. On Windows, compare it with <x2/>; on macOS and Linux with <x3/>. All files are built from the public source by GitHub Actions; the build logs are on <g4>GitHub</g4>.
7ab13cf63ca91547.text: 每个发布版本都在<g1>SHA256SUMS.txt</g1>中列出了每个文件的 SHA-256 校验和。在 Windows 上，请与<x2/>进行比较；在 macOS 和 Linux 上，请与<x3/>进行比较。所有文件均由 GitHub Actions 从公共源代码构建；构建日志可在<g4>GitHub</g4>上查看。

7ab229d7e32f43f1.source: The system's DNS asks the names in its own way, and Windows may ask over every adapter. To keep the names inside the adapter too, choose a DNS under <g1>Connection</g1> → <g2>DNS</g2>: DDM then asks it through the adapter.
7ab229d7e32f43f1.text: 系统的 DNS 会以自己的方式查询域名，而 Windows 可能会通过所有适配器进行查询。若要让域名查询也通过该适配器进行，请在<g1>连接</g1> → <g2>DNS</g2>下选择一个 DNS：DDM 随后会通过该适配器向其查询。

7ab41681b98e7a8c.source: AllDebrid sometimes needs a while to prepare a link. DDM waits for it, up to 10 minutes, and the list says so.
7ab41681b98e7a8c.text: AllDebrid 有时需要一段时间才能准备好链接。DDM 最多会等待 10 分钟，列表会显示等待状态。

7abae1f3c6a9aed0.source: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi

7acc73393492b437.source: Tick <g1>Limit all downloads together to</g1> and type a speed in KBytes/sec. A good start is about two thirds of your connection's speed. (1 MByte/sec is about 1000 KBytes/sec.)
7acc73393492b437.text: 勾选<g1>将所有下载总计限制为</g1>，并输入速度（单位为千字节/秒）。一个好的开始是您连接速度的大约三分之二。（1 兆字节/秒大约是 1000 千字节/秒。）

7ad4d2325131e1f8.source: <g1>Linux: uninstalling the .deb or .rpm leaves no browser files behind</g1> (<g2>#266</g2>): DDM wrote the files that tell each browser where its helper is in every user's home folder, and <x3/> or <x4/> left them there, naming a program that was gone. The packages now install them for everyone, in each browser's own folder (Chrome and Brave, Chromium and Vivaldi, Edge, Firefox, the Snap Firefox included), and remove them with the package; DDM writes none in the home folder for those browsers, and takes away the ones an earlier version wrote. The AppImage and the tar.gz, and Opera, Helium, Thorium and Firefox's forks (which read them only in the home folder), still get them there.
7ad4d2325131e1f8.text: <g1>Linux：卸载 .deb 或 .rpm 后不会留下浏览器文件</g1>（<g2>#266</g2>）：DDM 会在每个用户的主文件夹中写入文件，告诉每个浏览器其助手的位置，而 <x3/> 或 <x4/> 会将它们留在那里，指向一个已不存在的程序。现在软件包会为所有人将它们安装到每个浏览器自己的文件夹中（Chrome 和 Brave、Chromium 和 Vivaldi、Edge、Firefox，包括 Snap Firefox），并在卸载软件包时将其删除；DDM 不会在主文件夹中为这些浏览器写入任何文件，并删除早期版本写入的文件。AppImage 和 tar.gz，以及 Opera、Helium、Thorium 和 Firefox 的分支（它们只在主文件夹中读取这些文件），仍然会在那里获取它们。

7ad7c17f54ce45b0.source: Add torrent with a torrent's files as a folder tree, the folder they go to, and Download Now
7ad7c17f54ce45b0.text: 添加种子窗口，显示种子中的文件树、保存位置文件夹和“立即下载”按钮

7ae5e52dfd6438e1.source: Yes: every release has builds for Linux and macOS. Today's are marked experimental; from version {v1}, Linux isn't, after checks on four desktops, and macOS stays experimental. Windows 10 and 11 are the main platform. <g1>More</g1>
7ae5e52dfd6438e1.text: 是的：每个版本都有 Linux 和 macOS 的构建。目前这些版本标记为实验性；从 {v1} 版本开始，Linux 在经过四种桌面环境的测试后不再是实验性版本，而 macOS 仍保持实验性。Windows 10 和 11 是主要平台。<g1>更多</g1>

7af4218058f9b63f.source: A download carries its site's cookies (and a form's data) to DDM. A few sites set so many that together they exceed what DDM accepts from the browser (1 MB). The browser kept this one. Signing out and back in to the site usually trims them.
7af4218058f9b63f.text: 下载会将网站的 Cookie（和表单数据）一并发送给 DDM。有些网站设置的 Cookie 太多，合计超过了 DDM 接受浏览器传送数据的上限（1 MB）。浏览器保留了此下载。退出网站后重新登录通常可以减少 Cookie。

7b0fa7fbdf8802b0.source: Out of the way. Still downloading.

7b0fd2a3655650fc.text: 您的登录信息保持私密

7b27fbbb52af0819.source: Downloads still work. DDM came with a newer extension, and the status page says how to get it:
7b27fbbb52af0819.text: 下载仍可正常进行。DDM 附带了较新的扩展，状态页会说明如何获取：

7b3a4b79acf13381.source: Options on its Proxy / Socks page, with Network adapter near the bottom set to Any (the system chooses)
7b3a4b79acf13381.text: 在其“代理/SOCKS”页面上的选项，其中“网卡”设置为“任何（系统选择）”

7b4ed1d902bdc163.source: <g1>The AppImage on Linux:</g1> the AppImage's files are gone once it quits, so DDM keeps a copy of its helper program in its data folder (<x2/>) and points the browsers there. Start DDM once after moving or renaming the AppImage, or after an AppImage manager (Gear Lever, AppImageLauncher and the like) moved it, so the helper knows where to start it from.
7b4ed1d902bdc163.text: <g1>Linux 上的 AppImage：</g1> AppImage 的文件在退出后会消失，因此 DDM 会在其数据文件夹 (<x2/>) 中保留其帮助程序的一个副本，并让浏览器指向那里。在移动或重命名 AppImage 后，或在 AppImage 管理器（如 Gear Lever、AppImageLauncher 等）移动它之后，请启动 DDM 一次，以便帮助程序知道从何处启动它。

7b53412eaabdca4d.source: The right-click menu has everything you can do with a download: <g1>Open</g1>, <g2>Open with...</g2>, <g3>Open folder</g3>, <g4>Move/Rename</g4>, <g5>Redownload</g5>, <g6>Resume Download</g6>, <g7>Stop Download</g7>, <g8>Show progress</g8>, <g9>Refresh download address</g9>, <g10>Verify checksum...</g10>, <g11>Remove</g11>, <g12>Add to queue</g12> and <g13>Properties</g13>. A download a site's bot check turned away also has <g14>Download with the browser</g14> (<g15>Browser integration</g15>).
7b53412eaabdca4d.text: 右键菜单包含您可对下载执行的所有操作：<g1>打开</g1>、<g2>打开方式...</g2>、<g3>打开文件夹</g3>、<g4>移动/重命名</g4>、<g5>重新下载</g5>、<g6>恢复下载</g6>、<g7>停止下载</g7>、<g8>显示进度</g8>、<g9>刷新下载地址</g9>、<g10>验证校验和...</g10>、<g11>删除</g11>、<g12>添加到队列</g12>和<g13>属性</g13>。被站点的机器人检查拒绝的下载还有<g14>使用浏览器下载</g14>（<g15>浏览器集成</g15>）。

7b655c3076cd7d8b.source: <g1>Tasks → Import → From text file</g1> and <g2>From IDM export file</g2>. An <x3/> file brings each download's referrer and cookies.
7b655c3076cd7d8b.text: <g1>任务 → 导入 → 从文本文件</g1>和<g2>从 IDM 导出文件</g2>。<x3/>文件会包含每个下载的引用页和 Cookie。

7b67b877992fe095.source: Both are kept in a <x1/> folder in DDM's data folder.
7b67b877992fe095.text: 两者都保存在 DDM 数据文件夹中的 <x1/> 文件夹里。

7b75149d61c4c0ff.source: A download that is running isn't deleted. Stop it first.
7b75149d61c4c0ff.text: 正在下载的任务不会被删除。请先停止下载。

7b8e1b3734be9e87.source: The extension does almost nothing you can see: everything else is set in DDM's own <g1>Options</g1>. A click on its button turns taking downloads off, and another click turns it back on. It is one switch for the whole browser: every tab, and the tabs you open later, go by it.
7b8e1b3734be9e87.text: 此扩展几乎没有任何可见的操作：其他一切都在 DDM 自己的<g1>选项</g1>中设置。单击其按钮可关闭下载接管，再次单击则重新开启。这是整个浏览器的一个开关：每个标签页以及您之后打开的标签页都遵从它。

7b937f9a31424bb6.source: How to report a security problem in Dannex Download Manager privately, how releases are built and verified, and what the project does to keep you safe.
7b937f9a31424bb6.text: 如何私下报告 Dannex Download Manager 中的安全问题、如何构建和验证发行版本，以及项目为保护您所采取的措施。

7bbbe7e2df6058d3.source: Its permissions, and why: <g1>downloads</g1> to see and hand over downloads; <g2>cookies</g2> so signed-in downloads work in DDM; <g3>nativeMessaging</g3> to talk to DDM; <g4>contextMenus</g4> for the right-click items; <g5>storage</g5> for its settings; <g6>webRequest</g6> to see forms submitted and video streams loaded (it changes nothing); <g7>declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess</g7> (Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers) to have the files the browser would open (a PDF) downloaded instead, for the types DDM takes; in Firefox, <g8>webRequestBlocking</g8> does that; <g9>scripting</g9> to read a page's links when you ask, and to add the video button to pages already open when the extension is installed; <g10>proxy</g10> to read which proxy the browser uses, so downloads taken from a browser behind a VPN or proxy extension go through it too, only while you have that switched on in the popup (it never changes the browser's proxy; in Firefox it is optional, asked for when you switch it on; Chrome and the other Chromium browsers can't make it optional, and count it under the access to all sites); access to all sites because downloads and videos can come from any site.
7bbbe7e2df6058d3.text: 其权限及原因：<g1>下载</g1>用于查看和移交下载；<g2>Cookie</g2>用于使已登录的下载在 DDM 中工作；<g3>原生消息</g3>用于与 DDM 通信；<g4>上下文菜单</g4>用于右键菜单项；<g5>存储</g5>用于其设置；<g6>网络请求</g6>用于查看提交的表单和加载的视频流（它不改变任何内容）；<g7>声明式网络请求与主机访问</g7>（Chrome、Edge 和其他 Chromium 浏览器）用于将浏览器会打开的文件（PDF）改为下载，适用于 DDM 支持的类型；在 Firefox 中，<g8>网络请求阻止</g8>实现此功能；<g9>脚本</g9>用于在您请求时读取页面链接，并在安装扩展后将视频按钮添加到已打开的页面；<g10>代理</g10>用于读取浏览器使用的代理，以便从 VPN 或代理扩展后面的浏览器获取的下载也通过它进行，仅当您在弹出窗口中开启此功能时（它从不改变浏览器的代理；在 Firefox 中是可选的，在您开启时会询问；Chrome 和其他 Chromium 浏览器无法使其可选，并将其计入对所有站点的访问权限）；访问所有站点是因为下载和视频可以来自任何站点。

7bbfd6a588b5c2c4.text: 工具提示文本换行位置

7bda8095d8381906.source: Other programs can ask the running app for its downloads, as JSON, and pause, start, remove or delete them. They connect to a port on this computer only, with a secret token that changes at every start and that only your own programs can read. The API is off until you turn it on with <x1/>, and <x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/> and <x6/> use it from the command line.
7bda8095d8381906.text: 其他程序可以向正在运行的应用程序请求其下载任务（以 JSON 格式），并暂停、开始、移除或删除它们。它们仅连接到此计算机上的一个端口，使用每次启动时都会更改的秘密令牌，并且只有您自己的程序才能读取。API 默认关闭，直到您使用 <x1/> 开启它，并且 <x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/> 和 <x6/> 从命令行使用它。

7beb76c0e99ab62c.source: <g1>Videos that need you signed in</g1>: <g2>Options → Sites Logins → Cookies for video sites</g2> lets yt-dlp read a browser's cookies, for pasted links. Chrome, Edge and Brave lock theirs on Windows, and the window says so; Firefox works, and so does the button over the video.
7beb76c0e99ab62c.text: <g1>需要登录才能观看的视频</g1>：<g2>选项 → 站点登录 → 视频网站的 Cookie</g2>允许 yt-dlp 读取浏览器的 Cookie，用于粘贴的链接。Chrome、Edge 和 Brave 在 Windows 上会锁定其 Cookie，窗口会提示；Firefox 可以正常工作，视频上方的按钮也可以。

7bf07491298eaae4.source: <g1>Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi</g1> can't ask for that permission at the switch, so the extension has it from the install (Chrome counts it under the access to every site the extension already asks for, so it adds no line to the install prompt and the update asks for nothing new). The switch asks nothing. DDM gets the browser's effective proxy, whoever set it (a VPN or proxy extension, a policy, the command line): a fixed server for the download's scheme (<x2/>, <x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>), unless the address is on its bypass list, or its proxy auto-config script (by its address or inline). With no proxy, or the system's, nothing is sent and DDM goes by its own Options. A QUIC proxy can't be shared.
7bf07491298eaae4.text: <g1>Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi</g1>无法在切换时请求该权限，因此扩展在安装时就已获得（Chrome 将其计入扩展已请求的对每个站点的访问权限中，因此不会在安装提示中添加新行，更新时也不会请求新内容）。此切换不请求任何权限。DDM 会获取浏览器有效的代理，无论是由谁设置的（VPN 或代理扩展、策略、命令行）：对于下载方案（<x2/>、<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>），它是一个固定的服务器，除非地址在其绕过列表中，或者其代理自动配置脚本（通过其地址或内联）。如果没有代理，或者使用系统代理，则不会发送任何内容，DDM 将遵循其自己的选项。QUIC 代理无法共享。

7c13b99aeb6bd7c5.source: A playlist is listed whole, as its videos come in: the line above the list says how far it is ("Listing the videos: 1,200 of 6,000"). <g1>Stop listing</g1> keeps the ones listed so far, and <g2>List the rest</g2> carries on from there. If the site stops answering part-way (YouTube may, when it's asked too often), the window says after how many videos and why, and <g3>List the rest</g3> tries again from there.
7c13b99aeb6bd7c5.text: 播放列表会逐步列出其中的视频：列表上方会显示进度（“正在列出视频：6,000 个中的 1,200 个”）。<g1>停止列出</g1>会保留已列出的视频，<g2>列出其余部分</g2>会从那里继续。如果网站中途停止响应（YouTube 在请求过于频繁时可能会这样），窗口会显示已列出多少个视频以及原因，然后<g3>列出其余部分</g3>会从那里继续尝试。

7c395edd6333d2b1.source: Everything DDM doesn't take stays with the browser.
7c395edd6333d2b1.text: DDM 不捕获的内容仍由浏览器处理。

7c3fdd61c8808264.source: <g1>Resuming after a waiting page</g1>: when a download's address had to be asked again (an expired link), DDM now goes through the same waiting pages and redirects as the first time, instead of giving up on them.
7c3fdd61c8808264.text: <g1>等待页面后恢复</g1>：当下载地址需要再次请求（链接过期）时，DDM 现在会像第一次一样通过相同的等待页面和重定向，而不是放弃它们。

7c5ee42e360cb052.source: A torrent names the trackers DDM asks for peers. DDM doesn't contact a tracker on your own computer or your local network (<x1/>, <x2/>, <x3/> and the like), so a torrent can't make DDM send requests into the network it sits in. <g4>Add trackers...</g4> follows the same rule: it refuses such an address and tells you why, rather than keeping one that would never be asked.
7c5ee42e360cb052.text: 种子会列出 DDM 用来请求对等方的跟踪器。DDM 不会联系您自己的计算机或本地网络上的跟踪器（<x1/>、<x2/>、<x3/> 等），因此种子无法让 DDM 向其所在的网络发送请求。<g4>添加跟踪器...</g4>也遵循同样的规则：遇到这类地址时会拒绝添加并说明原因，而不是保留一个永远不会被联系的地址。

7c61c4f7eb5732af.source: A filtered column's title is tinted and keeps its funnel, in blue, and the strip under the list says <g1>(filtered)</g1>. To remove every filter, click <g2>Clear filters</g2> there, or right-click a column title and choose <g3>Clear all filters</g3>. Filters last until you close DDM.
7c61c4f7eb5732af.text: 被筛选的列标题会着色并保留蓝色的漏斗，列表下方的状态栏会显示<g1>（已筛选）</g1>。要移除所有筛选器，请单击那里的<g2>清除筛选器</g2>，或右键单击列标题并选择<g3>清除所有筛选器</g3>。筛选器会保留到您关闭 DDM 为止。

7c937c28782fee15.source: The list keeps the host's link. The direct link is never shown or copied: the services forbid sharing it. It lives only in the download's resume data, and when it expires DDM asks the service for a new one.
7c937c28782fee15.text: 列表中保留文件托管网站的链接。直接链接不会显示或复制，因为服务禁止分享该链接。直接链接只保存在下载的续传数据中；链接过期后，DDM 会向服务请求新的链接。

7c9ac4a167131000.source: Browser integration is set up by DDM itself at each start (the browsers installed then are found); add the extension as in <g1>Browser integration</g1>.
7c9ac4a167131000.text: 浏览器集成由 DDM 每次启动时自行设置（会找到当时安装的浏览器）；按照<g1>浏览器集成</g1>中的说明添加扩展。

7ca06640051a11fc.source: The tray menu also has <g1>Add new download</g1>, <g2>Add batch download</g2>, the <g3>Speed Limiter</g3>, the <g4>Scheduler</g4>, the main download queue and <g5>Options</g5>.
7ca06640051a11fc.text: 托盘菜单还包括<g1>添加新下载</g1>、<g2>添加批量下载</g2>、<g3>速度限制器</g3>、<g4>计划程序</g4>、主下载队列和<g5>选项</g5>。

7ca97bd5e93217a8.source: Its progress window: each file and how much of it is here.
7ca97bd5e93217a8.text: 其进度窗口：显示每个文件及其已下载的百分比。

7cab5b043dd16bd1.source: The app and the extension <g1>send nothing about you to us</g1>. We don't run servers that could receive it.
7cab5b043dd16bd1.text: 应用和扩展程序<g1>不会向我们发送您的任何信息</g1>。我们没有运行可以接收这些信息的服务器。

7caee0cc5ae2399b.source: In Torrent settings you can turn off <g1>Accept incoming connections</g1> and <g2>Map the port on the router (UPnP)</g2>, or the DHT. Downloads still work, sometimes more slowly. With the <g3>Port</g3> box empty, DDM picks a port the first time and keeps it (another one if a program has taken it since), so firewall and router rules keep working; a port typed there is always the one used. These changes apply the next time the engine starts, so when no torrent is running.
7caee0cc5ae2399b.text: 在“种子设置”中，您可以关闭<g1>接受传入连接</g1>和<g2>在路由器上映射端口 (UPnP)</g2>，或关闭 DHT。下载仍可进行，但有时速度会变慢。如果<g3>端口</g3>框为空，DDM 首次运行时会选择一个端口并保持使用（如果此后有程序占用，则会选择另一个），这样防火墙和路由器规则就能持续生效；如果在此处输入端口，则始终使用该端口。这些更改将在引擎下次启动时生效，即在没有种子运行时生效。

7ce987620338a702.source: To take a download out of its queue, right-click it and choose <g1>Delete from queue</g1>. The download stays in the list.
7ce987620338a702.text: 要将下载任务从队列中移除，请右键点击该任务并选择<g1>从队列中删除</g1>。下载任务仍会保留在列表中。

7ceb91dc2c47dc1c.source: <g1>The first window opens seconds sooner, and no longer freezes on a busy computer</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): DDM asked fontconfig for its fonts one at a time (one program for each of some thirty scripts, more each time the language list opened) while the window waited, 2 s on an idle computer and long enough on a busy one for a freeze report on the very first start. It now asks once, all together, while the rest of DDM starts.
7ceb91dc2c47dc1c.text: <g1>第一个窗口打开速度加快数秒，并且在繁忙的计算机上不再冻结</g1>（<g2>#164</g2> 的一部分）：DDM 之前会一次一个地向 fontconfig 请求字体（大约三十个脚本中的每个脚本一个程序，每次打开语言列表时更多），而窗口则等待，在空闲计算机上等待 2 秒，在繁忙计算机上等待足够长的时间以至于在首次启动时出现冻结报告。现在它会一次性请求所有字体，而 DDM 的其余部分则同时启动。

7cefc273f40903c0.text: 触发高亮显示的（默认）按钮；如果焦点位于按钮上，则按下该按钮

7d32e887febf85b0.text: 右键点击下载并选择<g1>刷新下载地址</g1>。

7d3af2ef0e680bca.text: 通过多个连接下载文件时的进度窗口

7d5309abd8725ba7.source: <g1>Start download on Dannex Download Manager startup</g1> — start the queue whenever DDM starts.
7d5309abd8725ba7.text: <g1>在 Dannex Download Manager 启动时开始下载</g1> — 每次启动 DDM 时都启动此队列。

7d58c596e2060806.source: <g1>TorBox</g1> debrid accounts (experimental), in <g2>Options → Accounts</g2>, signed in in the browser or with your API key: file-host links, torrents and magnet links through your account (<g3>#391</g3>).
7d58c596e2060806.text: <g1>TorBox</g1> Debrid 账户（实验性），位于<g2>选项 → 账户</g2>，可在浏览器中登录或用您的 API 密钥登录：通过您的账户处理文件托管站点链接、种子和磁力链接（<g3>#391</g3>）。

7d7c56f97fe554b4.text: Firefox 只安装 Mozilla 签名的附加组件，而 Dannex 的附加组件尚未列在 addons.mozilla.org 上。在此之前：

7db6ec1b50e019c9.source: <g1>As the language and the system's region write them</g1> (the default) — the way DDM's language writes them (German <x2/>, <x3/>), or Windows' region settings (Settings → Time & language → Region) when your region is in that same language. In English, the system region's date order and clock, and the list keeps IDM's own date text.
7db6ec1b50e019c9.text: <g1>按语言和系统区域设置</g1>（默认）— 按 DDM 语言的写法（德语 <x2/>、<x3/>），或在您的区域使用同一种语言时，按 Windows 的区域设置（设置 → 时间和语言 → 区域）。英语则采用系统区域的日期顺序和时钟，列表保留 IDM 自己的日期文字。

7db9ed501785d447.source: <g1>Quality</g1> applies to every video: <g2>Best quality</g2>, <g3>Up to</g3> a height (each video at that height, or the nearest below it), <g4>Audio only, original</g4>, <g5>Audio only MP3</g5>, <g6>Audio only OPUS</g6> or <g7>Audio only FLAC</g7>. Without ffmpeg, only the qualities that come with their sound are offered, and no MP3, Opus or FLAC.
7db9ed501785d447.text: <g1>画质</g1>适用于所有视频：<g2>最佳质量</g2>、<g3>最高</g3>高度（每个视频下载该高度或最接近的较低高度）、<g4>仅音频，原始</g4>、<g5>仅音频 MP3</g5>、<g6>仅音频 OPUS</g6>或<g7>仅音频 FLAC</g7>。没有 ffmpeg 时，只提供带有音频的视频画质选项，不提供 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC。

7e003eeb98d38711.source: Is it really free, or a trial?
7e003eeb98d38711.text: 它是真的免费，还是试用版？

7e0f0fb8c60306bf.source: <g1>Default max. conn. number</g1> — how many connections each download may use, from 1 to 32 (8 by default). Type the number or use the arrows.
7e0f0fb8c60306bf.text: <g1>默认最大连接数</g1> — 每个下载可使用的连接数为 1 到 32（默认为 8）。输入数字或使用箭头调整。

7e318a27b34c246a.source: There are several ways to give DDM something to download. Most of them end in the same window, Download File Info, where you choose where the file goes.
7e318a27b34c246a.text: 有几种方法可以给 DDM 添加下载任务。大多数方法都会打开同一个窗口，即“下载文件信息”，您可以在其中选择文件的保存位置。

7e3326f31ea1a679.source: A debrid service downloads files from file hosts on its own servers and hands back a plain link, without the host's waits, speed caps and captchas. With your account in DDM, that link is downloaded like any file.
7e3326f31ea1a679.text: 网盘服务会从文件主机下载文件到其自己的服务器，然后返回一个普通链接，没有主机等待、速度限制和验证码。在 DDM 中使用您的账户，该链接会像任何文件一样被下载。

7e65341170033bf2.source: The user guide and tutorials, this file, the benchmark data; the website makes the guide its help pages, which Help opens
7e65341170033bf2.text: 用户指南和教程，此文件，基准数据；网站将此指南作为其帮助页面，点击“帮助”即可打开

7e92ca3591a44f50.source: Helium installs it from the same page, as long as Helium may download extensions: see <g1>Helium</g1>.
7e92ca3591a44f50.text: 只要 Helium 允许下载扩展，它就会从同一页面安装：请参阅<g1>Helium</g1>。

7eb01362a68bd828.source: A freeze when the disk was slow: DDM looked on the disk for a portable data folder on every tick of the window; it now works the data folder out once (<g1>#565</g1>).
7eb01362a68bd828.text: 磁盘缓慢时的冻结：DDM 曾在窗口的每个周期都去磁盘上查找便携数据文件夹；现在它只确定一次数据文件夹（<g1>#565</g1>）。

7eb542d3a6bc3fb8.source: The file's size, when the server told it.
7eb542d3a6bc3fb8.text: 服务器提供文件大小时显示该大小。

7eb97ed779cd3652.source: Ask your assistant. DDM does the downloading.

7ebe922b703038bb.source: Select part of a page and right-click it for <g1>Download selected links with DDM</g1>, or right-click the page for <g2>Download all links with DDM</g2>: the links open in <g3><g4>Link grabber</g4></g3>, sorted into packages, where you tick the ones you want. Right-click the page for <g5>Download all images with DDM</g5> (each picture at the largest size the page offers) or <g6>Download all videos and audio with DDM</g6> (the page's players and links to such files, and the files its players played): they open in Link grabber the same way.
7ebe922b703038bb.text: 选中页面的一部分并右键点击，选择<g1>使用 DDM 下载选定链接</g1>；或右键点击页面，选择<g2>使用 DDM 下载所有链接</g2>：这些链接会在<g3><g4>链接抓取器</g4></g3>中打开，并分成若干包，您可勾选需要的链接。右键点击页面，选择<g5>使用 DDM 下载所有图像</g5>（每张图片取页面提供的最大尺寸）或<g6>使用 DDM 下载所有视频和音频</g6>（页面中的播放器和指向此类文件的链接，以及播放器播放过的文件）：它们同样在链接抓取器中打开。

7ed1a150972c9f29.source: DDM itself extracts zip archives (AES-encrypted and Deflate64 ones too), tar, tar.gz and tar.xz archives, and single <x1/> and <x2/> files.
7ed1a150972c9f29.text: DDM 可以直接提取 zip 存档（也支持 AES 加密和 Deflate64 格式）、tar、tar.gz 和 tar.xz 存档，以及单个 <x1/> 和 <x2/> 文件。

7ef4bcd5b2cb6b88.source: <g1>DDM's commands in the browsers' right-click menu → Edit...</g1> — which of DDM's five commands the browser's right-click menu shows (Download with DDM, selected links, all links, all images, all videos and audio). A browser changes its menu when you next switch to it.
7ef4bcd5b2cb6b88.text: <g1>DDM 在浏览器右键菜单中的命令 → 编辑...</g1> — 浏览器的右键菜单显示 DDM 五个命令中的哪几个（使用 DDM 下载、所选链接、所有链接、所有图片、所有视频和音频）。浏览器会在您下次切换到它时更改其菜单。

7f0cbe382b22bf78.text: 很有可能：DDM 支持 86 种语言，涵盖 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，您可以在首次启动时选择，或随时通过“视图”→“语言”进行更改。阿拉伯语、希伯来语……

7f1e7ebaff978239.source: <g1>DDM 0.2.x with the extension from the Chrome Web Store?</g1> The store's copy needs a newer DDM: 0.2.x knows only the copy in its own folder. Update DDM with <g2>Help → Check for updates...</g2>. Until then, remove the store's copy and load the one in DDM's folder instead (<x3/>, see <g4>Browser integration</g4>).
7f1e7ebaff978239.text: <g1>DDM 0.2.x 与来自 Chrome 网上应用店的扩展程序？</g1> 网上应用店的版本需要更新的 DDM：0.2.x 仅识别其自身文件夹中的版本。请通过<g2>帮助 → 检查更新...</g2>更新 DDM。在此之前，请移除网上应用店的版本，并加载 DDM 文件夹中的版本（<x3/>，请参阅<g4>浏览器集成</g4>）。

7f2837a2015479db.source: The system's DNS looks names up its own way, and Windows may ask over every adapter. To keep the names inside the VPN as well, choose a DNS in <g1>Options → Connection → DNS</g1>: DDM then asks it through the adapter. See <g2>DNS and proxies</g2>.
7f2837a2015479db.text: 系统的 DNS 以自己的方式查找名称，Windows 可能会通过每个网卡进行查询。为了也将名称保留在 VPN 内部，请在<g1>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g1>中选择一个 DNS：DDM 然后会通过该网卡进行查询。请参阅<g2>DNS 和代理</g2>。

7f2b3156563a771b.source: Stopped, or after a restart, the download continues where it was: the service isn't sent the torrent again, and files already downloaded aren't downloaded again.
7f2b3156563a771b.text: 停止下载或重启后，下载会从中断处继续。DDM 不会再次将种子发送给服务，也不会重新下载已下载的文件。

7f6ce25a3c642090.source: If Dannex Download Manager closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a crash report window opens. It shows what happened, lets you read the whole report, and…
7f6ce25a3c642090.text: 如果 Dannex Download Manager 意外关闭或停止响应，会打开崩溃报告窗口。窗口会显示发生了什么，让您阅读完整报告，并且……

7f6e9b487e59c00f.source: The list shows the queue's downloads in the order they will run. The arrow buttons under it move the selected download down or up; the cross takes it out of the queue.
7f6e9b487e59c00f.text: 此列表按下载运行的顺序显示队列中的下载。列表下方的箭头按钮可将选定的下载向上或向下移动；叉号按钮可将其从队列中移除。

7f700a3fe6bddc4a.source: The browser's <g1>video button</g1> over a video in a feed (a site's home page, a timeline, search results) sends that video's own address instead of the page's, which yt-dlp read as no video at all ("No video found on this page"). It finds the post the video sits in, as you would: on LinkedIn its <x2/> (or <x3/>) address, read from the post in LinkedIn's 2026 feed too, on Facebook the reel's, the video's or the post's own link, on X the post's (<x4/>), on Instagram <x5/> or <x6/>, on Reddit the post's comments page, on TikTok <x7/>, on Vimeo and Dailymotion the clip's page, and elsewhere a post's own link, such as its timestamp. Only a post that names that one video counts. When nothing does, the video's own file goes (when it plays one, not pieces), and otherwise nothing goes and the button says to open the post and use the button there (<g8>#689</g8>, <g9>#643</g9>).
7f700a3fe6bddc4a.text: 浏览器在信息流（站点首页、时间线、搜索结果）中的视频上的<g1>视频按钮</g1>，现在发送该视频自己的地址，而不是页面的地址（yt-dlp 曾因此认为没有任何视频：“No video found on this page”）。它会像您那样找到视频所在的帖子：在 LinkedIn 上是其 <x2/>（或 <x3/>）地址，在 LinkedIn 2026 年的信息流中同样能从帖子中读取；在 Facebook 上是 Reels、视频或帖子自己的链接；在 X 上是帖子的链接（<x4/>）；在 Instagram 上是 <x5/> 或 <x6/>；在 Reddit 上是帖子的评论页；在 TikTok 上是 <x7/>；在 Vimeo 和 Dailymotion 上是该片段的页面；其他地方则是帖子自己的链接，例如它的时间戳。只有点名该视频的帖子才算数。如果没有任何帖子符合，就发送视频自己的文件（当它播放的是文件而不是分片时），否则什么都不发送，按钮会提示打开该帖子并使用那里的按钮（<g8>#689</g8>、<g9>#643</g9>）。

7f72357724e5c329.source: Linux and macOS: a gallery-dl installed by the system (a package manager, Homebrew, pip) is found and used when DDM has none of its own, as yt-dlp is; <g1>Helpers</g1> can switch to DDM's own copy where DDM has one (Windows and Linux x86-64) (<g2>#571</g2>).
7f72357724e5c329.text: Linux 和 macOS：当 DDM 自己没有 gallery-dl 时，会找到并使用系统安装的 gallery-dl（包管理器、Homebrew、pip），与 yt-dlp 相同；<g1>帮助程序</g1>可以切换到 DDM 自带的副本（在 DDM 有副本的地方：Windows 和 Linux x86-64）（<g2>#571</g2>）。

7f766e56cac844dc.source: The accent: focus lines, open and default controls, filters, links' focus
7f766e56cac844dc.text: 强调色：焦点线、打开和默认控件、过滤器、链接焦点

7f770ae470480a05.source: To skip that question and always use the <g1>Main download queue</g1>, turn off <g2>Options → Downloads → Show queue selection panel on pressing "Download Later" button</g2>.
7f770ae470480a05.text: 要跳过此问题并始终使用<g1>主下载队列</g1>，请关闭<g2>选项 → 下载 → 按“稍后下载”按钮时显示队列选择面板</g2>。

7f79702d18f48f44.source: <g1>Limits</g1>: stop sharing at a share ratio or after some minutes, and cap what torrents send, all together or one by one.
7f79702d18f48f44.text: <g1>限制</g1>：达到共享率或经过一定时间后停止共享，并限制种子发送的总量，可以全部一起限制，也可以逐个限制。

7f7bfe78bf5b687c.source: The window no longer freezes while watching the clipboard when the program holding it hangs, or while a cancelled download's files are removed from a slow disk (<g1>#418</g1>, <g2>#423</g2>).
7f7bfe78bf5b687c.text: 当持有剪贴板的程序挂起时，窗口不再在监视剪贴板时卡顿；当取消的下载文件从慢速磁盘中移除时，窗口也不再卡顿（<g1>#418</g1>、<g2>#423</g2>）。

7fa6f9417a745711.source: <g1>Buttons fit their text in every language, in every window</g1> (<g2>#192</g2>): many windows gave their buttons a width made for English, so a longer translation was cut with "..." (German <g3>Später herunterla...</g3> in Download File Info, <g4>Hilfsprogramme...</g4> in Download a gallery, Russian <g5>Открыть с помощью...</g5> in Download complete, French <g6>Nouvelle file d’attente</g6> in the Scheduler). Each button is now as wide as its translated text, and the buttons beside it move along with the same gaps, the row keeping its end; a box or caption beside a widened button ends before it. Where a window has no room left, the buttons wider than their text give some back first. English is unchanged, and in Arabic and the other right-to-left languages the buttons widen the mirrored way.

However many files are downloading, together they stay under it. It works on its own: there is nothing else to turn on. About two thirds of your connection's speed is a good start.
82d6ded95ec8b5ce.text: 在<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 设置...</g1>中，勾选<g2>将所有下载总计限制为</g2>，并输入一个以千字节/秒为单位的速度。无论有多少文件正在下载，它们的总速度都会保持在此限制之下。它会自动生效，无需额外开启。建议将速度设置为您网络连接速度的大约三分之二。

The report now keeps its own lines in every language, and in Arabic and Persian it reads left to right, from the box's left edge, as the English data it is (the window around it stays right to left). The release notes in <g3>Check for updates</g3> keep their lines the same way. <g4>End and restart DDM</g4> showed cut in German, French, Russian and Arabic: the buttons are now as wide as their text, the others giving back room they don't need.

83031e191bb2522b.text: <g1>Linux，来自 AppImage 或 tar.gz：</g1>如果系统缺少 DDM 窗口所需的库（例如<x2/>），DDM 会在终端和消息框中显示其名称，以及安装它的命令（<x3/>，或您的发行版）。.deb 和 .rpm 包自带这些库。在 Wayland 会话中，DDM 会在 Wayland 上打开其窗口。

83121edb08ac0d5e.text: DDM 在手机上的页面：带有类别和何时选项的地址框，带有开始按钮的队列，以及显示进度的下载任务

83317aa6b5969dc8.source: <g1>Don't show this dialog again</g1> — DDM stops asking and does what you answered this time. To be asked again, tick <g2>Options → General → Confirm before deleting downloads</g2>.

85e66d381c28e0c4.source: It works as a kill switch. When the adapter disconnects, running torrents stop with "… is not connected; it goes on when it is back", and they start again through the adapter when it is. Until DDM notices (within a second), the engine's sockets are still bound to an address that is gone, so nothing can leave another way. A torrent added while the adapter isn't connected doesn't start, and says why. Tracker names are still looked up by the system's DNS.
85e66d381c28e0c4.text: 这相当于一个网络断开保护开关。适配器断开连接时，正在运行的种子会停止，并显示“……未连接；重新连接后将继续”。适配器重新连接后，种子会通过该适配器重新启动。在 DDM 检测到断开之前（最多 1 秒），种子引擎的套接字仍绑定到已失效的地址，因此无法通过其他途径发送数据。适配器未连接时添加的种子不会启动，并会说明原因。跟踪器名称仍由系统的 DNS 查询。

86a38072f9109584.text: 在通知区域启动，窗口保持隐藏：这就是您登录时<g1>随计算机启动 Dannex Download Manager</g1>启动 DDM 的方式。在没有通知区域显示 DDM 图标的地方（某些 Linux 桌面），DDM 会以最小化方式启动。已在运行的 DDM 保持原样。

86a9adb405639b90.source: Its main installer has optional offers; an offers-free one is on its site
86a9adb405639b90.text: 主安装程序会提供可选的捆绑软件；其网站上有不含这些捆绑软件的版本

86e0b935f62e5988.source: <g1>More file types taken from the browser by default</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>): today's installers and packages (DMG and PKG for macOS, DEB, RPM and APPIMAGE for Linux, MSIX, APPX, APPXBUNDLE and CAB for Windows, JAR), archives (XZ, ZST, TGZ, TXZ) and WEBM, FLAC and OPUS join <g3>Options → File types</g3>. A list never edited gains them on the next start; one you edited stays as it is. <g4>Options → File types → Don't take files smaller than</g4> leaves small files (a receipt, an icon) to the browser, and <g5>Edit list ...</g5> for the addresses left to the browser works.
86e0b935f62e5988.text: <g1>默认情况下从浏览器接管更多文件类型</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）：今天的安装程序和软件包（macOS 的 DMG 和 PKG，Linux 的 DEB、RPM 和 APPIMAGE，Windows 的 MSIX、APPX、APPXBUNDLE 和 CAB）、存档文件（XZ、ZST、TGZ、TXZ）以及 WEBM、FLAC 和 OPUS 加入<g3>选项 → 文件类型</g3>。从未编辑过的列表会在下次启动时获得它们；您编辑过的列表保持不变。<g4>选项 → 文件类型 → 不下载小于此大小的文件</g4>会将小文件（收据、图标）留给浏览器处理，并且用于留给浏览器的地址的<g5>编辑列表...</g5>功能有效。

86e5c2477f430964.source: Tutorial: catch downloads from your browser →
86e5c2477f430964.text: 教程：从浏览器捕获下载 →

86e5d8f5e4d67d3f.source: A <g1>gofile</g1> share link (<x2/>) now says it is a web page to open in your browser, instead of saving that page as if it were the file (<g3>#346</g3>).
86e5d8f5e4d67d3f.text: <g1>gofile</g1> 分享链接（<x2/>）现在会说明它是一个要在浏览器中打开的网页，而不是把该页面当作文件保存（<g3>#346</g3>）。

874309c1d3f0920b.source: <g1>Downloads still go to the computer's Downloads folder</g1> unless you change it. To keep them with DDM, set each category's folder in <g2>Options → Save to</g2>. <g3>Carry DDM on a USB stick</g3> shows how.
874309c1d3f0920b.text: 除非更改设置，否则<g1>下载仍会保存到计算机的“下载”文件夹</g1>。要将下载文件保存在 DDM 所在位置，请在<g2>选项 → 保存到</g2>中设置各类别的文件夹。<g3>在 U 盘上携带 DDM</g3>介绍了具体操作方法。

875a0aa9fd4c9ada.source: <g1>A finished download no longer fails with "part file still in use" on a busy computer</g1> (<g2>#201</g2>): when the last bytes came in, the connections still running were cut off. One cut off while it read or wrote the part file (checking the bytes before a reconnect, for example) left that read or write to finish on its own, with the file still open, and renaming the finished file failed. The connections are now told to stop and waited for, when a download completes and when it is stopped or fails, so none of them outlives it. A stopped download's last writes are also in its saved progress now.
875a0aa9fd4c9ada.text: <g1>在繁忙的电脑上，已完成的下载不再因“部分文件仍在使用中”而失败</g1>（<g2>#201</g2>）：当最后字节传入时，仍在运行的连接被切断。一个在读取或写入部分文件时被切断的连接（例如，在重新连接之前检查字节）会使其读取或写入自行完成，文件仍处于打开状态，并且重命名已完成的文件失败。现在，当下载完成、停止或失败时，会通知连接停止并等待它们，因此没有连接会比下载本身更长寿。停止下载的最后写入现在也包含在其保存的进度中。

8766bd96baf967c5.source: <g1>Codeberg, for gallery-dl.</g1> If you download an image gallery, DDM installs gallery-dl from its official releases on Codeberg and checks its author's signature; gallery-dl then talks to the site you asked for.
8766bd96baf967c5.text: <g1>Codeberg，用于gallery-dl。</g1>如果您下载图片库，DDM会从Codeberg的官方发布中安装gallery-dl并检查其作者签名；然后gallery-dl会与您请求的网站通信。

87762c1628d1de13.source: On a queue's <g1>Schedule</g1> tab, tick <g2>Start at</g2> and choose a time, <g3>Once on</g3> a date or <g4>Repeat on</g4> the days you tick. <g5>Stop at</g5> halts whatever is left, for example before work in the morning. A queue can also start whenever DDM starts.
87762c1628d1de13.text: 在队列的<g1>计划</g1>选项卡上，勾选<g2>开始于</g2>并选择一个时间，可选<g3>单次于</g3>某个日期，或<g4>每周重复于</g4>您勾选的日子。<g5>停止于</g5>会停止所有剩余的下载，例如在早上上班前。队列也可以在 DDM 每次启动时开始。

877fc06837396c8e.source: <g1>Save As</g1> — the folder and file name. You can type another, pick one of the last 20 folders you saved to from the arrow at its end, or choose a folder with <g2>...</g2>.
877fc06837396c8e.text: <g1>另存为</g1> — 文件夹和文件名。您可以输入另一个，从箭头末尾选择您最近保存的 20 个文件夹之一，或使用<g2>...</g2>选择一个文件夹。

87c345548c074b2f.source: <g1>Look up each file's size</g1>: once exploring is done, DDM asks the server each file's size. Untick it for a faster list. <g2>Whole site for offline reading</g2> leaves it off: the downloads say each size anyway.
87c345548c074b2f.text: <g1>查询每个文件的大小</g1>：探索完成后，DDM 会向服务器询问每个文件的大小。取消勾选可使列表更快。<g2>整个站点（供离线阅读）</g2>会将其保持关闭：下载本来就会显示各个大小。

87c55712ad4306ba.source: 7z and RAR archives need 7-Zip, a free program. DDM uses it when it is installed, for split and encrypted archives too. <g1>Options → Archives</g1> says whether it was found; when it wasn't, the <g2>7-Zip needed</g2> window says so, with a <g3>Get 7-Zip</g3> button. RAR's own extraction code can't be part of a free program like DDM, which is why it asks 7-Zip.
87c55712ad4306ba.text: 7z 和 RAR 压缩包需要 7-Zip，这是一个免费程序。DDM 在安装 7-Zip 后会使用它，也支持分卷和加密压缩包。<g1>选项 → 压缩包</g1>会显示是否已找到 7-Zip；如果未找到，<g2>需要 7-Zip</g2>窗口会提示，并提供<g3>获取 7-Zip</g3>按钮。RAR 自身的解压代码不能作为 DDM 这种免费程序的一部分，因此需要 7-Zip。

87e568e2c01ad2e1.source: Check a download against its published MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 or CRC32 checksum in Dannex Download Manager, from the list or the command line.
87e568e2c01ad2e1.text: 在 Dannex Download Manager 中，通过下载列表或命令行，对照已发布的 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 或 CRC32 校验和来检查下载文件。

87fde7a900305ff8.source: <g1>Right-click a page</g1> for <g2>Download all links</g2>, <g3>Download selected links</g3>, <g4>Download all images</g4> and <g5>Download all videos and audio</g5>: what the page holds goes to <g6>Link grabber</g6>, the files its players played included.
87fde7a900305ff8.text: <g1>右键单击页面</g1>可使用<g2>下载所有链接</g2>、<g3>下载所选链接</g3>、<g4>下载所有图片</g4>和<g5>使用 DDM 下载所有视频和音频</g5>：页面上的内容会进入<g6>链接抓取器</g6>，其中包括播放器播放过的文件。

87ff7e81ac4516d8.source: What keeps the remote control safe, in short:
87ff7e81ac4516d8.text: 简而言之，远程控制的安全保障：

880dcd6570293c2e.source: Downloading may be against some sites' terms. Checking that is up to you.
880dcd6570293c2e.text: 下载可能违反某些网站的服务条款。是否违反条款由您自行确认。

88125ffc76ce682b.source: Download a video; <x1/> takes a quality's selector from <x2/> (<x3/> = the best single file; <x4/> = the sound alone as the site has it, not converted; <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/> or <x8/> = the sound as an MP3 at that bitrate, <x9/> at its best variable one; <x10/> = as Opus; <x11/> = as FLAC, lossless but no better than the site's sound; conversions need ffmpeg). <x12/>: DDM's own downloader brings each stream yt-dlp finds over this many connections (8 by default, 1 to 128), a stream in pieces (HLS, DASH) this many pieces at once. <x13/> saves subtitles beside it: language codes from <x14/> (<x15/>), or <x16/> for every one the uploader gave; <x17/> takes the site's automatic captions instead; <x18/> puts them into the video (needs ffmpeg, MP4 or MKV). <x19/> sends the downloads' connections, and yt-dlp's (and ffmpeg's), through one network adapter, as for <x20/>; when it isn't connected, nothing starts.
88125ffc76ce682b.text: 下载视频；<x1/> 从 <x2/> 获取画质选择器（<x3/> = 最佳单一文件；<x4/> = 网站提供的纯音频，不转换；<x5/>、<x6/>、<x7/> 或 <x8/> = 该比特率的 MP3 音频，<x9/> 为最佳可变比特率；<x10/> = Opus 格式；<x11/> = FLAC 格式，无损但音质不优于网站源；转换需要 ffmpeg）。<x12/>：DDM 自己的下载器通过这么多连接（默认 8 个，1 到 128 个）下载 yt-dlp 找到的每个流，HLS、DASH 等分段流则同时下载这么多片段。<x13/> 将字幕保存到旁边：语言代码来自 <x14/>（<x15/>），或 <x16/> 表示上传者提供的所有字幕；<x17/> 改为获取网站的自动字幕；<x18/> 将字幕嵌入视频中（需要 ffmpeg，MP4 或 MKV 格式）。<x19/> 通过一个网络适配器发送下载连接以及 yt-dlp（和 ffmpeg）的连接，如 <x20/>；如果未连接，则不开始任何操作。

881997dfad27782d.source: <g1>Add trackers...</g1> — adds trackers, one address a line (<x2/>, <x3/> or <x4/>). They are kept with the torrent, after the ones it has, and the <g5>Trackers</g5> tab shows them. A tracker on your computer or your local network is refused: DDM never contacts those (<g6>why</g6>).
881997dfad27782d.text: <g1>添加跟踪器...</g1> — 添加跟踪器，每行一个地址（<x2/>、<x3/>或<x4/>）。它们与种子一起保存，在其已有的跟踪器之后，<g5>跟踪器</g5>选项卡会显示它们。您计算机或本地网络上的跟踪器会被拒绝：DDM 绝不会联系这些跟踪器（<g6>原因</g6>）。

882620b07afdcfef.source: On any Linux machine with DDM installed (the <x1/>, <x2/>, AppImage or <x3/>):
882620b07afdcfef.text: 在任何安装了 DDM 的 Linux 机器上（<x1/>、<x2/>、AppImage 或<x3/>）：

8854151459f022ea.source: The Scheduler: the queues on the left with Download limits, the selected queue's Schedule tab on the right
8854151459f022ea.text: 计划程序：左侧是队列和下载限制，右侧是所选队列的“计划”选项卡

88553921bc94a7a6.source: If it says <g1>the file changed on the server</g1>, the file isn't the one DDM started with. Right-click → <g2>Redownload</g2> to start again from the beginning.
88553921bc94a7a6.text: 如果显示<g1>服务器上的文件已更改</g1>，则当前文件与 DDM 开始下载时的文件不同。右键点击 → <g2>重新下载</g2>，从头开始下载。

885f65c1e800b21f.source: A VPN or proxy extension is a proxy for the browser only. Switch on <g1>Download through this browser's VPN or proxy</g1> in the extension's options page, under <g2>More</g2> (right-click its toolbar button → <g3>Options</g3>; it's off as installed), and DDM downloads what it takes from the browser through the same proxy (with <g4>Options → Proxy / Socks → Use the browser's proxy for the downloads it hands over</g4>, on by default; see <g5>Options</g5>). Switched off, the extension reads nothing of the browser's proxy.
885f65c1e800b21f.text: VPN 或代理扩展只是浏览器自己的代理。请在扩展的选项页的<g2>更多</g2>下开启<g1>通过此浏览器的 VPN 或代理下载</g1>（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g3>选项</g3>；安装后默认关闭），DDM 就会通过相同的代理下载它从浏览器接管的内容（并配合默认开启的<g4>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 对浏览器交给 DDM 的下载使用浏览器的代理</g4>；参见<g5>选项</g5>）。关闭后，扩展不会读取浏览器的任何代理信息。

8876ca36591ce4ae.source: <g1>Allow more than 32 connections</g1> — raises the most to 128, for the number above and for the exceptions. Most servers allow far fewer from one address; DDM notices and asks those for fewer. Turned off again, any higher number comes back to 32.
8876ca36591ce4ae.text: <g1>允许超过 32 个连接</g1> — 将上方设置和例外中的最大连接数提高到 128。大多数服务器允许来自同一地址的连接数远少于此值；DDM 会检测到这一点，并向这些服务器请求较少的连接数。再次关闭此选项后，任何超过 32 的数字都会恢复为 32。

8877fd41005c6e50.text: Dannex Download Manager（“DDM”，“本软件”）和网站 dannex.kavangi.co.ke（“本站”）由 Dannex Download Manager 贡献者（“我们”）制作。使用本软件或本站，即表示您接受这些条款。如果您不接受，请不要使用。

88797b59ad63a6d7.source: <g1>DDM as an IDM alternative</g1><g2>Spot something wrong? Tell us</g2>
88797b59ad63a6d7.text: <g1>DDM 作为 IDM 的替代品</g1><g2>发现错误？告诉我们</g2>

8899ec1c903c0f82.source: The browser extension can't send downloads to a portable copy, because that needs the installer.
8899ec1c903c0f82.text: 浏览器扩展无法将下载发送到便携版，因为这需要安装程序。

889bc8b63c0c7171.source: <g1>Linux: menus appear at once, as menus, on compositors that animate windows</g1> (Hyprland, picom with fading, <g2>#277</g2>). Before the fix above, Hyprland gave DDM's menus a window's border and slid each one down from the top of the screen. And moving from title to title along the menu bar closed one menu window and opened another, so such a compositor faded each menu out and the next one in at every switch. The menu bar's menus now share one window that moves from title to title, as a submenu's window already did from item to item, and each menu window says which menu it is (a drop-down menu, a right-click menu, a drop-down list), as GTK's and Qt's do.
889bc8b63c0c7171.text: <g1>Linux：在动画窗口的合成器上，菜单会立即以菜单形式出现</g1>（Hyprland，带淡入淡出的 picom，<g2>#277</g2>）。在上述修复之前，Hyprland 会给 DDM 的菜单一个窗口边框，并将其从屏幕顶部滑下。并且沿着菜单栏从一个标题移动到另一个标题会关闭一个菜单窗口并打开另一个，因此这样的合成器会在每次切换时淡出每个菜单并淡入下一个。现在菜单栏的菜单共享一个从标题移动到标题的窗口，就像子菜单的窗口已经从项目移动到项目一样，并且每个菜单窗口都说明它是哪个菜单（下拉菜单、右键菜单、下拉列表），就像 GTK 和 Qt 的菜单一样。

88a598304bb1b085.source: Files DDM downloads from the browser are marked as coming from the internet, as the browser marks its own: Windows checks a program with SmartScreen before it runs and Office opens a document in Protected View.
88a598304bb1b085.text: DDM 从浏览器下载的文件会被标记为来自互联网，就像浏览器标记自己的文件一样：Windows 会在程序运行前使用 SmartScreen 检查它，Office 会在受保护视图中打开文档。

88a644198668dd78.source: Options, File types: the file types DDM takes from the browser, and the sites it leaves alone
88a644198668dd78.text: 选项 → 文件类型：DDM 从浏览器接管的文件类型，以及它不处理的网站

88b16f0adf785619.source: <g1>Pieces</g1> — a map of the torrent's pieces: there, partly there, or missing.
88b16f0adf785619.text: <g1>分块</g1> — 种子分块的映射：已存在、部分存在或缺失。

88be3e3a59d8a661.source: Looking for a free alternative to Internet Download Manager (IDM)? Dannex Download Manager is free and open source, laid out like IDM, and imports your IDM list. Compare it with Free Download Manager, AB Download Manager, Motrix, Neat, JDownloader and more.
88be3e3a59d8a661.text: 正在寻找 Internet Download Manager (IDM) 的免费替代品？Dannex Download Manager 是一款免费、开源的下载管理器，界面布局与 IDM 相似，并可导入您的 IDM 列表。将其与 Free Download Manager、AB Download Manager、Motrix、Neat、JDownloader 等进行比较。

88d9fe1439bf5cb4.source: Linux and macOS: a yt-dlp installed by the system (a package manager, Homebrew) is found and used when DDM has none of its own; <g1>Helpers</g1> can still switch to DDM's own copy, kept up to date (<g2>#452</g2>).
88d9fe1439bf5cb4.text: Linux 和 macOS：当 DDM 自己没有 yt-dlp 时，会找到并使用系统安装的 yt-dlp（包管理器、Homebrew）；<g1>帮助程序</g1>仍可切换到 DDM 自带且保持更新的副本（<g2>#452</g2>）。

88de80972ae62a7a.source: Add URL, the clipboard, the browser's <g1>Download with DDM</g1> link menu, and batch downloads go through the account when its service supports the link's host.
88de80972ae62a7a.text: 如果帐户对应的服务支持链接所在的文件托管网站，通过添加 URL、剪贴板、浏览器中的<g1>使用 DDM 下载</g1>链接菜单或批量下载添加的链接，都会使用该帐户下载。

88e200b39a205261.source: Keep <x1/> slots, such as <x2/> or <x3/>, exactly as they are. You can move them within the sentence.
88e200b39a205261.text: 保留<x1/>占位符（例如<x2/>或<x3/>），不要做任何更改。可以在句子中移动它们。

8902f86068dcc6a0.source: <g1>Sleep when done hibernated</g1> the computer on Windows.
8902f86068dcc6a0.text: <g1>“完成后睡眠”会使 Windows 计算机进入休眠状态</g1>。

8949ac9217869457.source: <g1>Its settings</g1>: <g2>Options → General → Customize DDM Download panels in browsers → Edit...</g2>: turn it off; show it <g3>Over videos</g3>, <g4>Over sound players</g4>, or both; leave it off media shorter than so many seconds (the browser knows a video's length once its player has loaded it, and shows the button until then); choose <g5>Where it shows first</g5> (top right unless you choose another corner; dragged elsewhere on a site, it stays there on that site); and see or edit the sites it never shows on. <g6>Never on</g6> in the button's menu adds to that list, and a site added there while Options is open is kept when you click OK.

8a588b9978a09377.source: <g1>Catching problems.</g1> When DDM crashes (a Windows exception, a signal on Linux, a Mach exception on macOS), panics, or freezes, it asks the monitor for a dump. A freeze is a frame of the window running more than 8 s, seen by a watchdog thread that ignores time spent asleep. It times both parts of a frame: what DDM handles (the commands that come in, the clock of downloads, queues and the Scheduler), which runs minimized too, and the drawing; never the wait between frames. The watchdog also measures how much processor time the window thread got meanwhile, and the report says what that means: it ran all along (a loop), it waited in a lock or on I/O (a deadlock), or it hardly ran in ordinary code, which is a computer too busy to run DDM or slow to load it from disk, most likely not DDM's bug (those share one signature, <x2/>). When the window thread is already back in the event loop by the time the dump is written, the freeze was over before the snapshot, so its stack can't explain it; those reports say so and share the signature <x3/>. macOS doesn't measure it yet. The monitor then writes a <g4>minidump</g4> of every thread from outside, through <x5/> and <x6/>. A crashed process never writes its own dump, which is how Firefox, Crashpad and Sentry do it too.
8a588b9978a09377.text: <g1>捕获问题。</g1> 当 DDM 崩溃（Windows 异常、Linux 信号、macOS Mach 异常）、程序异常终止或冻结时，它会向监视器请求一个转储。冻结是指窗口运行超过 8 秒的帧，由一个忽略休眠时间的看门狗线程检测。它会测量帧的两个部分：DDM 处理的部分（接收到的命令、下载时钟、队列和计划程序），这部分在最小化时也会运行，以及绘图部分；但不测量帧之间的等待时间。看门狗还会测量在此期间窗口线程获得了多少处理器时间，报告会说明这意味着什么：它一直在运行（一个循环），它在锁或 I/O 上等待（死锁），或者它几乎没有在普通代码中运行，这表示计算机太忙而无法运行 DDM 或从磁盘加载 DDM 太慢，这很可能不是 DDM 的错误（这些情况共享一个签名，<x2/>）。如果转储写入时窗口线程已经回到事件循环中，则冻结在快照之前已经结束，因此其堆栈无法解释冻结；这些报告会说明这一点并共享签名 <x3/>。macOS 尚未测量此项。然后，监视器通过 <x5/> 和 <x6/> 从外部写入每个线程的<g4>小型转储</g4>。崩溃的进程从不写入自己的转储，Firefox、Crashpad 和 Sentry 也是如此。
