DDM now reads the chosen gallery-dl's version and passes only what that release accepts, from 1.20 (Ubuntu 22.04) to today's; checked against every release from 1.17 to 1.32. An older one (Debian 11's 1.17) is refused when chosen, saying it is too old and which version DDM needs, and one chosen before is passed over for DDM's own copy, which Helpers says. gallery-dl {v2}, whose version starts with an empty line, is no longer taken for another program.
8d24a3891d556f6d.text: <g1>图库可与 Linux 发行版自带的 gallery-dl 配合使用</g1>（<g2>#236</g2>）：在“帮助程序”中选择 Ubuntu 24.04 的 gallery-dl {v1} 后，所有图库都立即失败（“无法识别的参数：--no-input”）：DDM 传递了只有较新版本才知道的选项。DDM 现在读取所选 gallery-dl 的版本，并仅传递该版本接受的选项，从 1.20（Ubuntu 22.04）到最新版本；已针对从 1.17 到 1.32 的所有版本进行检查。如果选择旧版本（Debian 11 的 1.17），则会拒绝，并提示它太旧以及 DDM 需要哪个版本，并且之前选择的版本会被 DDM 自己的副本取代，这在“帮助程序”中有所说明。版本以空行开头的 gallery-dl {v2} 不再被误认为是其他程序。

8d36554a4f22d1a6.source: Until a store has it, or if you can't use one: it comes with the app, in its <x1/> folder, and <g2>as its own download</g2> for Chromium browsers (<x3/>: unzip, then <g4>Load unpacked</g4> on the browser's extensions page with Developer mode on). The <g5>step-by-step guide</g5> shows each browser.
8d36554a4f22d1a6.text: 在商店上架之前，或者您无法使用商店时：扩展随应用一起提供，位于其 <x1/> 文件夹中，也可<g2>单独下载</g2>，用于 Chromium 浏览器（<x3/>：先解压，再在浏览器的扩展页面打开开发者模式后点击<g4>加载已解压的扩展程序</g4>）。<g5>分步指南</g5>介绍了各个浏览器。

8d5482092a09013b.source: Some pages play a video without a link to it, and some players hide it from the download button too. The toolbar button lists what the page has loaded, so you can still save it:
8d5482092a09013b.text: 有些页面播放的视频没有链接，有些播放器也会隐藏视频，不让下载按钮检测到。工具栏按钮会列出页面已加载的内容，因此您仍然可以保存这些内容：

8d8e052bd62085d8.source: <g1>Statistics.</g1> Medians with interquartile ranges, bootstrap 95% intervals (10,000 resamples) for each median and for the ratio of medians, and a two-sided Mann–Whitney U test.
8d8e052bd62085d8.text: <g1>统计。</g1> 中位数及四分位距，每个中位数和中位数比率的自举 95% 置信区间（10,000 次重采样），以及双侧 Mann–Whitney U 检验。

8d9101ebbab57c1f.source: DDM is free and always will be. If it saves you time, you can support its creator on GitHub Sponsors.
8d9101ebbab57c1f.text: DDM 是免费的，并将永远免费。如果它为您节省了时间，您可以在 GitHub Sponsors 上支持其创建者。

8db0cfbcd4c4f5eb.source: Mac fixes from the first round of real use, found on every system and fixed there too; the menus and text boxes work as in any desktop program; and DDM works with AI assistants.
8db0cfbcd4c4f5eb.text: 修复了首轮实际使用中发现的 Mac 问题，这些问题也在其他系统上发现并修复；菜单和文本框现在的操作方式与其他桌面程序一致；DDM 现在可与 AI 助手配合使用。

8dbeeeabcf1f6918.source: <g1>86 interface languages</g1>, every language Windows 11 offers, chosen by flag on the first start or in <g2>View → Language...</g2>; right to left for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur; fonts for every script from the system itself. The installer speaks the same languages, and the browser extension speaks your browser's (50 languages).
8dbeeeabcf1f6918.text: <g1>86 种界面语言</g1>，Windows 11 提供的所有语言，首次启动时通过旗帜选择或在<g2>视图 → 语言...</g2>中选择；阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语、乌尔都语和维吾尔语从右到左显示；所有脚本的字体均来自系统本身。安装程序支持相同的语言，浏览器扩展程序支持您的浏览器语言（50 种语言）。

8dbf6ff24d2ed734.source: Can't use a store? It comes with the app, in its <x1/> folder, and <g2>as its own download</g2> for Chromium browsers (<x3/>: unzip, then <g4>Load unpacked</g4> on the browser's extensions page with Developer mode on). The <g5>step-by-step guide</g5> shows each browser.
8dbf6ff24d2ed734.text: 无法使用商店？它随应用程序一起提供，位于其 <x1/> 文件夹中，<g2>也可作为单独的下载</g2>用于 Chromium 浏览器（<x3/>：解压后，在浏览器扩展页面上开启开发者模式，然后点击<g4>加载已解压的扩展程序</g4>）。<g5>分步指南</g5>会展示每个浏览器的操作步骤。

8dc29fd0c1aa70c1.source: <g1>Over several connections</g1>: as many as <g2>Options → Connection</g2> gives a file. The progress window's connections table shows each one, and the segment map shows the video and then its sound.
8dc29fd0c1aa70c1.text: <g1>通过多个连接</g1>：与<g2>选项 → 连接</g2>中为文件设置的连接数相同。进度窗口的连接表会显示每个连接，分段图会显示视频及其音频。

8dfb095805a146c6.source: <g1>Also delete the file from disk</g1> — tick it to delete the files too. For an unfinished download, this deletes the part downloaded so far. Leave it unticked to take the downloads off the list and keep the files.
8dfb095805a146c6.text: <g1>同时从磁盘中删除文件</g1> — 勾选后也会删除文件。对于尚未完成的下载，会删除已下载的部分。不勾选则会将下载从列表中移除，但保留文件。

8e0392a5361b8cc7.source: <g1>Torrents</g1><g2>Magnet links and .torrent files beside your other downloads, queued and scheduled like any of them.</g2>
8e0392a5361b8cc7.text: <g1>种子</g1><g2>磁力链接和 .torrent 文件可与其他下载任务一起，像普通任务一样排队和计划。</g2>

8e0cfd466871abcf.source: <g1>View → Interface size</g1> (<g2>#262</g2>): every window larger, 100 % to 200 %, on top of the system's display scale; <g3>Ctrl +</g3>, <g4>Ctrl −</g4> and <g5>Ctrl 0</g5> in any DDM window, as in a browser. Every open window follows at once (dialogs, menus, the drop target) and DDM starts at that size, the crash report window too. A window larger than the screen opens as large as the screen allows and scrolls the rest, its title bar on the screen.
8e0cfd466871abcf.text: <g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>（<g2>#262</g2>）：所有窗口放大，从 100% 到 200%，在系统显示缩放之上；在任何 DDM 窗口中，像浏览器一样使用 <g3>Ctrl +</g3>、<g4>Ctrl −</g4> 和 <g5>Ctrl 0</g5>。所有打开的窗口（对话框、菜单、拖放目标）会立即跟随调整，DDM 也会以该大小启动，崩溃报告窗口也一样。窗口大于屏幕时，会以屏幕允许的最大尺寸打开，其余部分可滚动，标题栏保持在屏幕上。

8e12c185ccf34fa4.source: <g1>Controls that didn't react to the mouse</g1>: the ▾ of Address and Save As (Add URL, Download File Info), the drop-down lists, check boxes, radio buttons, the Categories pane's ×, the Scheduler's date button and calendar, scroll bars and the list's column headers now show when the pointer is over them and when they're pressed, as Windows' own controls do; an arrow stays pressed while its list is open.
8e12c185ccf34fa4.text: <g1>之前无法响应鼠标操作的控件</g1>：地址和另存为字段中的 ▾（“添加 URL”、“下载文件信息”）、下拉列表、复选框、单选按钮、“类别”窗格中的 ×、“计划程序”中的日期按钮和日历、滚动条以及列表的列标题，现在都会像 Windows 自带控件一样，在指针悬停和按下时显示相应状态；列表打开时，箭头会保持按下状态。

8e1d692dfb4deabe.source: A second browser download arriving while Download File Info was open replaced the first, which was lost (the browser had already given it up). They now wait their turn, and those still waiting when DDM quits are kept in the main queue (Download Later).
8e1d692dfb4deabe.text: 当“下载文件信息”窗口打开时，第二个浏览器下载任务到达会替换第一个，导致第一个任务丢失（浏览器已经放弃了它）。现在它们会按顺序等待，并且当 DDM 退出时仍在等待的任务会保留在主队列中（稍后下载）。

8e4c4a984da7391d.source: Check that the Speed Limiter is off: <g1>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Turn off</g1>. Also look at <g2>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Settings... → Limit all downloads together to</g2>, which applies even with the limiter off.
8e4c4a984da7391d.text: 检查速度限制器是否已关闭：<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 关闭</g1>。还要查看<g2>下载 → 速度限制器 → 设置... → 将所有下载总计限制为</g2>；即使关闭速度限制器，此设置仍然生效。

8e690ec7342ce75f.source: Already installed? Open DDM, then <g1>Options → General → Test browser integration</g1>, and click <g2>Set it up</g2> if it offers to.
8e690ec7342ce75f.text: 已经安装？打开 DDM，然后依次打开<g1>选项 → 常规 → 测试浏览器集成</g1>；如果系统提供设置选项，请点击<g2>设置</g2>。

8e6d5328fa5fa2f0.source: If the server needs a user name and password, tick <g1>Log in to the server</g1> and type them.
8e6d5328fa5fa2f0.text: 如果服务器需要用户名和密码，请勾选<g1>登录服务器</g1>并输入。

8e777a315376e404.source: The assistant can list your downloads with their status, size, progress and speed, and filter them by status or by name. It can add an http, https, ftp or ftps address and start it or only queue it, in the folder and under the name you say. A magnet link opens <g1>Add torrent</g1> in DDM, for you to choose the files. It can pause, resume and remove downloads, deleting the files only when asked, and start the main download queue.
8e777a315376e404.text: 助手可以列出您的下载任务，包括它们的状态、大小、进度和速度，并按状态或名称进行筛选。它可以添加 http、https、ftp 或 ftps 地址，并立即开始下载或仅将其排队，下载到您指定的文件夹和名称。磁力链接会在 DDM 中打开<g1>添加种子</g1>，供您选择文件。它可以暂停、恢复和删除下载，仅在请求时删除文件，并启动主下载队列。

8e977f7240fd471e.source: Your download list, settings, logins you save in <g1>Sites Logins</g1>, the history of each download and the files you download are stored only on your computer: in <x2/> on Windows (or the <x3/> folder of the portable copy), and in the usual application-data folder on macOS and Linux. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Uninstalling offers to delete them. From version {v1}, the passwords of Sites Logins, the proxy and debrid accounts go into the system's keychain instead (Windows Credential Manager, the keyring on Linux, the macOS keychain), still on your computer, when one is there and unlocked.
8e977f7240fd471e.text: 您的下载列表、设置、您在<g1>站点登录</g1>中保存的登录信息、每个下载的历史记录以及您下载的文件仅存储在您的计算机上：Windows 上的 <x2/>（或便携版中的 <x3/> 文件夹），以及 macOS 和 Linux 上常用的应用程序数据文件夹中。没有任何内容会被上传到任何地方。卸载时会提示删除这些内容。从 {v1} 版本开始，如果系统存在并已解锁，站点登录、代理和网盘账户的密码将存储在系统密钥链中（Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环、macOS 密钥链），仍然在您的计算机上。

8ebacedce5c28ec5.source: Add URL sends these to the gallery window: - Wikimedia Commons categories; - Flickr photographers and albums; - DeviantArt and ArtStation galleries; - Imgur albums; - Pixiv artists and works; - Pinterest boards and pins; - Danbooru and Gelbooru searches; - Tumblr blogs; - Bluesky profiles.
8ebacedce5c28ec5.text: 添加 URL 会将以下内容发送到图库窗口：- 维基共享资源分类；- Flickr 摄影师和相册；- DeviantArt 和 ArtStation 图库；- Imgur 相册；- Pixiv 艺术家和作品；- Pinterest 画板和图钉；- Danbooru 和 Gelbooru 搜索；- Tumblr 博客；- Bluesky 个人资料。

8f085588eab5dbf1.source: <g1>RSS feeds</g1><g2>Follow torrent feeds, and let rules add the new episodes you want, each one only once.</g2>
8f085588eab5dbf1.text: <g1>RSS 源</g1><g2>关注种子 RSS 源，设置规则自动添加您想要的新剧集，每集只添加一次。</g2>

8f11311d78b1263e.source: <g1>Media on this page says why it's empty</g1>: on a player that streams in pieces there's no file to list, and it says to use the button over the video instead of asking you to play it again.
8f11311d78b1263e.text: <g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>会说明其为空的原因：对于分段流式传输的播放器，没有文件可供列出，它会提示您使用视频上方的按钮，而不是要求您再次播放。

8f332d210170d0cf.source: <g1>Download selected</g1> adds the ticked files to the download list; <g2>Download all</g2> adds every file found. They are added as one batch: no window opens for any of them, as it is added or as it finishes. Each download carries the page it was found on as its referrer, as the browser would.
8f332d210170d0cf.text: <g1>下载所选项</g1>会将已勾选的文件添加到下载列表；<g2>全部下载</g2>会添加找到的每个文件。它们作为一批添加：无论是添加时还是完成时，都不会为其中任何一个打开窗口。每个下载都会带着找到它的页面作为其引用页，就像浏览器那样。

8f5bc00256713559.source: Nothing: the window says so, and your system's updates bring the new version.
8f5bc00256713559.text: 无：窗口会显示，并且您的系统更新会带来新版本。

8f70d98ab55b1e55.source: Hidden in the notification area, DDM hands the memory it isn't using back to the system. Task Manager's <g1>Memory</g1> for DDM drops from about 50 MB to under 10 MB there, and DDM gives memory back again every 10 minutes while it stays hidden. On Linux it does the same with its free memory.
8f70d98ab55b1e55.text: 隐藏在通知区域时，DDM 会将其未使用的内存交还给系统。任务管理器的 DDM <g1>内存</g1>会从大约 50 MB 下降到 10 MB 以下，并且 DDM 在保持隐藏状态时每 10 分钟会再次释放内存。在 Linux 上，它也会以同样的方式处理其空闲内存。

8f81187a957c46df.source: <g1><g2>Download overnight</g2></g1> — queue files and let the Scheduler start them at night.
8f81187a957c46df.text: <g1><g2>通宵下载</g2></g1> — 将文件加入队列，让计划程序在夜间启动下载。

8f815841ec6b033f.source: <g1>Test browser integration...</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> checks DDM's side.
8f815841ec6b033f.text: <g1>测试浏览器集成...</g1>在<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中检查 DDM 端。

8fb3d70faa4b2bac.text: 勾选<g1>限制此下载的速度</g1>。

8fb7daff1c4ae24d.source: <g1>Add a download</g1> opens. If the clipboard holds a web address, it is already filled in. The arrow at the end of <g2>Address</g2> lists the last 20 addresses you entered; pick one to use it again. Right-click the box for <g3>Cut</g3>, <g4>Copy</g4>, <g5>Paste</g5>, <g6>Delete</g6> and <g7>Select all</g7>.
8fb7daff1c4ae24d.text: <g1>添加下载</g1>窗口随即打开。如果剪贴板中有网址，会自动填入。<g2>地址</g2>末尾的箭头会列出您最近输入的 20 个地址；选择一个即可再次使用。右键单击该框可使用<g3>剪切</g3>、<g4>复制</g4>、<g5>粘贴</g5>、<g6>删除</g6>和<g7>全选</g7>。

8fba73f35f3415f8.source: Decide exactly how DDM reaches the internet, and see where your files come from.
8fba73f35f3415f8.text: 精确控制 DDM 如何连接互联网，并查看文件来源。

8fd5190974156ab1.source: <g1>Reading the dump.</g1> The monitor reads the dump with Mozilla's <x2/>. It uses the release's Breakpad symbols when they are found. A build from source can also read the native debug info beside it (its <x3/>, DWARF) when built with <x4/>; the shipped app goes without that reader, several MB. The report's <g5>Signature</g5> (for example <x6/>) stays the same across reports of one problem, and the window searches existing issues for it.
8fd5190974156ab1.text: <g1>读取转储文件。</g1> 监视器使用 Mozilla 的 <x2/> 读取转储文件。如果找到发布版本的 Breakpad 符号，就会使用这些符号。使用 <x4/> 构建的源码版本也可以读取旁边的原生调试信息（其 <x3/>，DWARF）；随附的应用不包含该读取器，因为它会占用几 MB。报告的<g5>签名</g5>（例如 <x6/>）在同一问题的多份报告中保持不变，窗口会据此搜索现有问题。

8fe7cc9878663c27.source: To watch a video while it downloads, tick <g1>Download in order</g1> (see <g2>Download in order</g2>).
8fe7cc9878663c27.text: 要边下载边观看视频，请勾选<g1>按顺序下载</g1>（参见<g2>按顺序下载</g2>）。

8ff85631a55ead59.source: With the server set up, you can ask your assistant things like "What is DDM downloading right now, and how long is left?", "Download this ISO to my ISOs folder tonight, don't start it yet", or "Remove the finished downloads from the list but keep the files". The assistant turns that into requests to DDM and tells you what happened.
8ff85631a55ead59.text: 设置好服务器后，您可以向助手提问，例如“DDM 现在正在下载什么，还剩多长时间？”，“今晚将此 ISO 下载到我的 ISO 文件夹，但暂时不要开始”，或者“从列表中删除已完成的下载，但保留文件”。助手会将这些问题转换为对 DDM 的请求，并告诉您结果。

9001d9a9ddba3f85.source: <g1>Metro</g1>: Windows 8's flat look: square corners, flat buttons and boxes, a coloured title bar with the title centred (on Windows, where DDM draws it), and one-colour icons (Microsoft's Fluent UI System Icons).
9001d9a9ddba3f85.text: <g1>现代</g1>：Windows 8 的扁平外观：方形边角，扁平按钮和方框，带有居中标题的彩色标题栏（在 Windows 上，由 DDM 绘制），以及单色图标（Microsoft 的 Fluent UI System Icons）。

9019ff06c86e5c17.source: A download manager can fill your whole connection. These steps cap DDM so that browsing, video calls and games stay smooth.
9019ff06c86e5c17.text: 下载管理器可能会占满整个网络带宽。按以下步骤限制 DDM 的速度，让网页浏览、视频通话和游戏保持流畅。

902881a3e9d2e863.source: How do I uninstall it? — Dannex Download Manager
902881a3e9d2e863.text: 如何卸载？— Dannex Download Manager

9043acfd376ea96d.source: Corner radius of egui's own widgets
9043acfd376ea96d.text: egui 自身小部件的圆角半径

904b52f5167d900b.source: Each grab is kept as a project, listed under <g1>Grabber projects</g1> in the Categories pane. Click a project to see the downloads it added. Right-click it for:
904b52f5167d900b.text: 每次抓取都会保存为一个项目，列在类别窗格的<g1>抓取项目</g1>下。点击项目可查看它添加的下载。右键点击它可以：

906061a133fd191c.source: DDM saves how far each part has got as it goes. A download picks up where it stopped after you pause it, after the connection drops, or after Windows or DDM itself crashes. A connection that fails is retried on its own, and the table shows <g1>Retrying</g1> with the reason.
906061a133fd191c.text: DDM 会在下载过程中保存每个部分的进度。在您暂停下载、连接中断或 Windows 或 DDM 本身崩溃后，下载会从中断处继续。失败的连接会自行重试，表格会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>及原因。

908e0cc6bcc8957d.text: Dannex Download Manager 的 GitHub 页面

90a08a02d6179492.source: No. DDM doesn't break copy protection (DRM), by design. Videos that are protected stay protected. See also <g1>what DDM is made for</g1>.
90a08a02d6179492.text: 不能。DDM 的设计宗旨是不破解版权保护 (DRM)。受保护的视频将保持受保护状态。另请参阅<g1>DDM 的用途</g1>。

90e1029ca6c017f8.source: Right-click it for <g1>Add new download</g1>, <g2>Add batch download</g2>, <g3>Downloads in progress</g3>, <g4>Speed Limiter</g4>, <g5>Scheduler</g5>, the main download queue, <g6>Options</g6> and <g7>Exit</g7>.
90e1029ca6c017f8.text: 右键单击它可选择<g1>添加新下载</g1>、<g2>添加批量下载</g2>、<g3>正在进行的下载</g3>、<g4>速度限制器</g4>、<g5>计划程序</g5>、主下载队列、<g6>选项</g6>和<g7>退出</g7>。

90e8aa747b236f64.source: Can I download without the browser extension? — Dannex Download Manager
90e8aa747b236f64.text: 没有浏览器扩展，我能下载吗？— Dannex Download Manager

90f5fe16b9f31f12.source: Batch download numbered files and lists of links
90f5fe16b9f31f12.text: 批量下载编号文件和链接列表

90f994f09c15f5fa.source: With <x1/>, every command prints JSON, one object per line: a progress line every half second while a file downloads, then the path, size and time when it's done. Sizes are in bytes, speeds in bytes per second, and a failure prints an error object, so a script or an AI agent reads the result without parsing text. The <g2>formats</g2> are listed command by command.
90f994f09c15f5fa.text: 使用 <x1/>，每个命令都会打印 JSON，每行一个对象：文件下载时每半秒打印一行进度，然后是完成时的路径、大小和时间。大小以字节为单位，速度以字节每秒为单位，失败时打印错误对象，因此脚本或 AI 代理无需解析文本即可读取结果。<g2>格式</g2>按命令列出。

911baa1a13bfe282.source: The queues are on the left, with <g1>Download limits</g1> below them. The right side shows the selected queue on two tabs, <g2>Schedule</g2> and <g3>Files in the queue</g3>.
911baa1a13bfe282.text: 队列位于左侧，<g1>下载限制</g1>位于其下方。右侧通过两个选项卡显示所选队列的内容：<g2>计划</g2>和<g3>队列中的文件</g3>。

9121e1b489370681.source: <g1>Speed Limiter</g1> — a limit for this download only. See below.
9121e1b489370681.text: <g1>速度限制器</g1> — 仅用于此下载的限制。请参见下文。

91349c94fea24e71.source: It notes where page loads' redirects started and ended (in memory, for two minutes), so DDM gets the address you clicked, not only where it led.
91349c94fea24e71.text: 它会记录页面加载重定向的起点和终点（在内存中保存两分钟），这样 DDM 获取的就是您点击的地址，而不只是重定向后的地址。

91413c8d067f6992.source: <g1>All Downloads</g1> — everything, with a node per category below it.
91413c8d067f6992.text: <g1>所有下载</g1> — 显示所有下载，下方按类别列出各个节点。

9146f6e2b5b7667d.source: Some sites, YouTube among them, send each viewer to a nearby video server, sometimes one inside the internet provider's own network. If that server can't be reached from your connection, a browser quietly switches to another one, but yt-dlp on its own would give up. Before each video download DDM checks the servers in the video's links and, if one doesn't answer, switches to the next one the site lists. The download's log says when this happens.
9146f6e2b5b7667d.text: 一些网站（包括 YouTube）会将每位观看者连接到附近的视频服务器，有时是互联网服务提供商自己网络中的服务器。如果您的网络无法连接到该服务器，浏览器会自动切换到另一个服务器，但单独使用 yt-dlp 则会放弃。每次下载视频前，DDM 都会检查视频链接中的服务器；如果某个服务器没有响应，就会切换到网站列出的下一个服务器。下载日志会记录这种情况。

917d7eacd7afdb1b.source: <g1>View</g1> — show or hide the categories, sort the list (<g2>Arrange files</g2>), <g3>Dark Mode support</g3>, <g4>Always dark</g4>, <g5>Theme</g5>, <g6>Interface size</g6> (every window larger, 100 % to 200 %; <g7>Ctrl +</g7>, <g8>Ctrl −</g8> and <g9>Ctrl 0</g9> too), <g10>Text</g10> (Windows: smooth or classic letters), <g11>Draw with</g11> (OpenGL, or Direct3D on Windows, Vulkan on Linux, Metal on macOS) and <g12>Language</g12>.
917d7eacd7afdb1b.text: <g1>视图</g1> — 显示或隐藏类别，排序列表（<g2>整理文件</g2>），<g3>深色模式支持</g3>，<g4>始终为深色</g4>，<g5>主题</g5>，<g6>界面大小</g6>（所有窗口放大，100% 到 200%；也可用 <g7>Ctrl +</g7>、<g8>Ctrl −</g8> 和 <g9>Ctrl 0</g9>），<g10>文本</g10>（Windows：平滑或经典字体），<g11>绘制方式</g11>（Windows 上为 OpenGL 或 Direct3D，Linux 上为 Vulkan，macOS 上为 Metal）和 <g12>语言</g12>。

9189b83bf9497166.source: On <g1>Status</g1>, tick only <g2>Error</g2> to see the downloads that failed.
9189b83bf9497166.text: 在 <g1>状态</g1> 列中，只勾选 <g2>错误</g2>，即可查看下载失败的任务。

91cefe80b7f00fac.source: <g1><g2>Download a file</g2></g1> — copy a link, add it, open the file.
91cefe80b7f00fac.text: <g1><g2>下载文件</g2></g1> — 复制链接、添加链接，然后打开文件。

91d9821e91c26313.text: Dannex Download Manager 是谁开发的？

91f7b61e72ddf0bc.source: <g1>Acceleration and resume</g1><g2>A file split over up to 32 connections, re-split until the last byte, and resumed after any crash.</g2>
91f7b61e72ddf0bc.text: <g1>加速与续传</g1><g2>文件可拆分为最多 32 个连接，重新拆分直到最后一个字节，并在任何崩溃后恢复下载。</g2>

92055d4da1d101c5.source: <x1/> people who sent a pull request, reported a problem or joined a conversation on GitHub. <g2>Meet them all</g2>
92055d4da1d101c5.text: <x1/> 在 GitHub 上提交拉取请求、报告问题或参与讨论的人们。 <g2>认识他们</g2>

9234aa60d4155968.text: <g1>不收集遥测数据</g1>：请参阅<g2>隐私政策</g2>。

9235535325c5d83c.source: In <g1>Find file</g1>, tick what to search:
9235535325c5d83c.text: 在 <g1>查找文件</g1> 中，勾选要搜索的内容：

92383cf306536af4.source: The toolbar's right-click menu is gone: it offered button sizes and styles that don't exist.
92383cf306536af4.text: 工具栏的右键菜单已移除：其中提供的按钮大小和样式实际上并不存在。

924459f1594756a8.source: Pick another folder in <g1>Download File Info</g1> and, by default, it becomes the category's folder from then on. <g2>Options → Save to</g2> shows each category's file types and folder in one place.
924459f1594756a8.text: 在<g1>下载文件信息</g1>中选择其他文件夹后，该文件夹将默认成为该类别此后的保存位置。<g2>选项 → 保存到</g2>可在一个地方查看每个类别的文件类型和文件夹。

927f1c13042cb4ea.source: <g1>Start downloading immediately while displaying "Download File Info" dialog</g1> — on by default, so the download is already under way while you choose a folder.
927f1c13042cb4ea.text: <g1>显示“下载文件信息”对话框时立即开始下载</g1> — 默认开启，因此在您选择文件夹时下载已在进行中。

9285f3bab6a553d1.source: Torrents, videos and galleries have no single server of DDM's own (peers, or yt-dlp's and gallery-dl's), so their windows don't show one.
9285f3bab6a553d1.text: 种子、视频和图库没有 DDM 自己的单一服务器（对等点，或 yt-dlp 和 gallery-dl 的），因此它们的窗口不显示服务器。

92a4e4872087c6ab.source: The Chrome Web Store's: as above. The one from DDM's folder: grey, amber <g1>!</g1>
92a4e4872087c6ab.text: Chrome 应用商店的副本：如上所述。来自 DDM 文件夹的副本：灰色，琥珀色<g1>!</g1>

92abe6de5cd6999e.source: <g1>Hide tab</g1> takes a tab off this download's window and goes back to <g2>Download status</g2>. To bring the tabs back, right-click the tab row and choose <g3>Show hidden tabs</g3>; closing the window and opening it again brings them back too.
92abe6de5cd6999e.text: <g1>隐藏选项卡</g1>会将当前选项卡从下载窗口中移除，并返回到<g2>下载状态</g2>。要恢复选项卡，请右键点击选项卡行并选择<g3>显示隐藏的选项卡</g3>；关闭窗口再重新打开也能恢复。

92c40823018cb745.source: Yes. DDM comes with an MCP server, dannexdownloadmanager-mcp: add it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or another assistant that supports MCP, and you can ask it in your own words to list, add, pause, resume or remove downloads. It works with the DDM on your computer only, and needs the automation API on. See AI assistants.
92c40823018cb745.text: 可以。DDM 自带 MCP 服务器，dannexdownloadmanager-mcp：将其添加到 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code 或其他支持 MCP 的助手中，即可用自己的话要求它列出、添加、暂停、恢复或删除下载。它只能连接您电脑上的 DDM，并且需要启用自动化 API。请参阅 AI 助手。

92f23ad4b35d3d62.source: The setup or DDM won't start
92f23ad4b35d3d62.text: 安装程序或 DDM 无法启动

9315d662b51c5629.source: <g1><g2>Catch downloads from your browser</g2></g1> — set up the extension so clicked downloads go to DDM.
9315d662b51c5629.text: <g1><g2>从浏览器捕获下载</g2></g1> — 设置扩展程序，让点击下载的文件通过 DDM 下载。

931872eeef27a13d.source: <g1><g2>Your first download</g2></g1> — a two-minute walk-through from copied link to opened file.
931872eeef27a13d.text: <g1><g2>首次下载</g2></g1> — 从复制链接到打开文件，只需两分钟。

932220e95efec82c.source: <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> appears in the list. Leave it turned on. Pin its button to the toolbar to see at a glance whether the browser reaches DDM.
932220e95efec82c.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> 会出现在列表中。保持其开启状态。将其按钮固定到工具栏，即可一目了然地查看浏览器是否已连接到 DDM。

932bdecbc746c3d4.source: <g1>Port</g1>: <x2/> unless another program uses it; then pick another (1024 to 65535).
932bdecbc746c3d4.text: <g1>端口</g1>：<x2/>，除非其他程序正在使用它；然后选择另一个（1024 到 65535）。

93306d927621de67.source: Yes. They don't share settings or files. Turn off one browser extension so each download goes to one program.
93306d927621de67.text: 可以。它们不共享设置或文件。关闭其中一个浏览器扩展程序，以确保每个下载都由一个程序处理。

9335063c349851e4.source: <g1>Fix causes, not cases</g1>, and keep producers and consumers of shared data (the download list, the browser extension's messages, the catalogs) in step.
9335063c349851e4.text: <g1>解决根本原因，而非个别问题</g1>，并确保共享数据（下载列表、浏览器扩展的消息、目录）的生成方和使用方保持同步。

9389247375fa372f.source: How do I report a bug or ask for a feature? — Dannex Download Manager
9389247375fa372f.text: 如何报告错误或提出功能请求？— Dannex Download Manager

939004d1ba9ff1d9.source: fluent, square, adwaita, breeze, luna, aero, aqua

939d0090c9a67cd3.source: The window no longer waits for the disk to write DDM's log or to save the RSS feeds: while Windows held every write on the disk to make a snapshot of it (a restore point or a backup), the window could stop answering until the writes were let go. Both are now written beside the window, as the download list already was (part of <g1>#513</g1>).
939d0090c9a67cd3.text: 窗口不再等待磁盘写入 DDM 的日志或保存 RSS 源：当 Windows 为了生成快照（还原点或备份）而挂起磁盘上的所有写入时，窗口可能停止响应，直到写入被放开。现在二者都在窗口之外写入，就像下载列表早已如此（属于<g1>#513</g1>的一部分）。

93b2dc8abe21954b.source: DDM no longer contacts torrent trackers on this computer or the local network.
93b2dc8abe21954b.text: DDM 不再联系此计算机或本地网络上的 torrent 跟踪器。

93e5e70937b50101.source: The app's answer, which is JSON already (see below).
93e5e70937b50101.text: 应用的回答，已经是 JSON 格式（见下文）。

93f24e6ba5efc95d.source: Pick a <g1>Template</g1>: <g2>All images</g2>, <g3>All audio</g3>, <g4>All video</g4>, <g5>All documents</g5>, <g6>Whole site for offline reading</g6>, or <g7>Custom</g7>. A template sets which files are collected and how deep the grabber goes; you can change both later.
93f24e6ba5efc95d.text: 选择一个<g1>模板</g1>：<g2>所有图像</g2>、<g3>所有音频</g3>、<g4>所有视频</g4>、<g5>所有文档</g5>、<g6>整个站点（供离线阅读）</g6>或<g7>自定义</g7>。模板决定收集哪些文件以及抓取器深入多少层；您之后可以更改这两项。

93f335b0185aba7d.source: Keep some speed for everything else →
93f335b0185aba7d.text: 为其他一切保留一些速度 →

93fe047e6ce08047.source: Without the API, the assistant can still add downloads, as DDM's <g1>command line</g1> can.
93fe047e6ce08047.text: 即使没有 API，助手仍然可以添加下载，就像 DDM 的<g1>命令行</g1>一样。

940b9b61593ef30c.source: <g1><x2/></g1> — the shape of text boxes, check boxes, buttons, progress bars, scroll bars, the focus mark and the title bar.
940b9b61593ef30c.text: <g1><x2/></g1> — 文本框、复选框、按钮、进度条、滚动条、焦点标记和标题栏的形状。

941ec1f268db80f9.source: <g1>More than 32 connections per download, if you want them</g1> (<g2>#12</g2>): <g3>Options → Connection</g3> now takes any number from 1 to 32, typed or set with the arrows, and <g4>Allow more than 32 connections</g4> raises that to 128, for server exceptions too. Servers that allow fewer are still noticed and asked for fewer. The command line's <x5/> takes 1 to 128.
941ec1f268db80f9.text: <g1>每个下载超过 32 个连接，如果您需要</g1>（<g2>#12</g2>）：<g3>选项 → 连接</g3>现在接受 1 到 32 之间的任何数字，可以输入或使用箭头设置，并且<g4>允许超过 32 个连接</g4>将其提高到 128，也适用于服务器异常。允许较少连接的服务器仍然会被注意到并请求较少连接。<x5/> 命令行接受 1 到 128。

94280a68d863d482.source: Windows, dialogs, the toolbar, the menu bar and column headers
94280a68d863d482.text: Windows、对话框、工具栏、菜单栏和列标题

9439b503963faae1.source: <g1>Regular expressions</g1>: the two boxes hold regular expressions instead.
9439b503963faae1.text: <g1>正则表达式</g1>：这两个输入框改为填写正则表达式。

945dd1a4f985ec9a.source: <g1>Description</g1> — a note of your own. It shows in the list's <g2>Description</g2> column and Find can search it.
945dd1a4f985ec9a.text: <g1>描述</g1> — 您自己的备注。它会显示在列表的<g2>描述</g2>列中，并且“查找”可以搜索它。

9464b1100a111c0c.source: DDM on Ubuntu's GNOME desktop, with the desktop's own file icons.
9464b1100a111c0c.text: DDM 在 Ubuntu 的 GNOME 桌面上运行，使用桌面自带的文件图标。

946ded9a6fbbdbd0.source: Crash reports: no report any more when one of the download engine's background tasks panics while DDM is already closing (<g1>#422</g1>).
946ded9a6fbbdbd0.text: 崩溃报告：当下载引擎的某个后台任务在 DDM 正在关闭时发生恐慌，不再生成报告（<g1>#422</g1>）。

94725d8e323fe39f.source: If the site asks for a user name and password, type them under <g1>Login</g1>. They are sent to the start address's site only, never to another site its pages link to. A login saved in <g2>Options → Sites Logins</g2> for that site is used too.
94725d8e323fe39f.text: 如果站点要求用户名和密码，请在<g1>登录</g1>下输入。它们只发送到起始地址所在的站点，绝不会发送到其页面链接到的其他站点。在<g2>选项 → 站点登录</g2>中为该站点保存的登录信息也会被使用。

949b30501b1deb8b.text: 用手机控制下载 — Dannex Download Manager

949e7c1956120262.source: Options → Connection: the DNS list at the bottom.
949e7c1956120262.text: 选项 → 连接：底部的 DNS 列表。

94a7f71ab168f4df.text: 网盘账户 (#44)：这些服务的官方 API（Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize、TorBox）将文件托管链接转换为下载引擎可直接下载的链接。

94fc845655fe4463.source: <g1>No proxy</g1> — connect directly. This is the default.
94fc845655fe4463.text: <g1>无代理</g1> — 直接连接。这是默认设置。

950c43d71bd73d95.source: You can change it at any time in <g1>View → Language</g1>. More in <g2>Languages</g2>.
950c43d71bd73d95.text: 您可以随时在<g1>视图 → 语言</g1>中更改语言。更多信息请参阅<g2>语言</g2>。

9520db8ce6669bde.source: Windows 10/11; macOS and Linux to try
9520db8ce6669bde.text: Windows 10/11；macOS 和 Linux 可试用

9525905f481b0709.source: A white canvas, one near-black ink, emerald fills with near-black text, 6-point corners.
9525905f481b0709.text: 白色画布，近乎黑色的墨水，翡翠色填充搭配近乎黑色的文本，6 点圆角。

953a64f3542b5742.source: Correct the translation in the third column and delete the row's <x1/> line.
953a64f3542b5742.text: 更正第三列中的翻译，并删除该行的 <x1/>。

954e6d3b4b30d19d.source: A theme changes how DDM looks and keeps everything where it was: the same windows, menus and buttons in the same places, drawn in other colours, shapes and icons. Each theme has a light and a dark side.
954e6d3b4b30d19d.text: 主题会改变 DDM 的外观，但所有元素的位置保持不变：相同的窗口、菜单和按钮，以不同的颜色、形状和图标呈现。每个主题都有浅色和深色两种模式。

958547a6449be61a.source: Tick <g1>Keep this limit when the download is stopped and resumed</g1> to keep this limit for the file: it applies again when you resume it later, even after restarting DDM.
958547a6449be61a.text: 勾选<g1>下载停止并恢复后仍保留此限制</g1>可为该文件保留此限制：以后恢复该文件时，即使重启 DDM，限制也会再次生效。

958664bb01cc22af.source: A torrent comes from other people's computers, not from one website. That changes what you can trust and what others can see. This page says plainly what…
958664bb01cc22af.text: 种子来自其他人的计算机，而不是来自一个网站。这改变了您可以信任的内容以及其他人可以看到的内容。本页面明确说明了...

95bc2de8eff5bcf8.source: Some pages play a video without a link to it, and some players hide it from the download button too. The extension notes what the tab's players load (HLS and DASH streams, the way most sites play long videos, and video and sound files), so you can still save it:
95bc2de8eff5bcf8.text: 有些页面播放视频时没有指向它的链接，有些播放器也会对下载按钮隐藏它。扩展会记录该标签页中播放器加载的内容（HLS 和 DASH 流，这是大多数网站播放长视频的方式，以及视频和音频文件），因此您仍然可以保存它：

95c10421608930fc.text: 代理密码会移动到系统的密钥链中：Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环或 macOS 密钥链。

95cd68fe730a5e09.source: And on the other desktops it was checked on:
95cd68fe730a5e09.text: 在其他已测试的桌面上：

95d9ea7a266a569b.text: 下载页面：选择适合您系统的文件

95dadfcaa8f08124.source: The browser and DDM aren't connected — Dannex Download Manager help
95dadfcaa8f08124.text: 浏览器与 DDM 未连接 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

95e0579f795bdd56.source: <g1>Description or part of the description</g1> — your notes.
95e0579f795bdd56.text: <g1>描述或描述的一部分</g1> — 您的备注。

95ff4e3f1e52b773.source: portable.zip — runs from a folder or USB stick
95ff4e3f1e52b773.text: portable.zip — 可从文件夹或 U 盘运行

961eaa849deedf28.source: Download File Info for a ZIP file: its address, the Compressed category, the folder it goes to, its size, and the Download Later, Start Download and Cancel buttons
961eaa849deedf28.text: ZIP文件的下载文件信息：其地址、压缩文件类别、保存文件夹、大小，以及稍后下载、开始下载和取消按钮

962661aca0a7d432.source: Each running download has its own progress window. It opens when you start or resume the download. To open it again, right-click the download and choose…
962661aca0a7d432.text: 每个正在运行的下载都有自己的进度窗口。它在您开始或恢复下载时打开。要再次打开它，请右键单击下载并选择…

96305159e842a657.source: Every colour and size a control is drawn with comes from the active theme (#45). A theme is a light and a dark palette, metrics, control styles and an icon style (<x1/>):
96305159e842a657.text: 控件绘制的每种颜色和大小都来自活动主题 (#45)。一个主题包含一个亮色和暗色调色板、度量、控件样式和图标样式 (<x1/>)：

9641498adf0c3309.source: <g1>A Base16 scheme</g1>, the <x2/> file the <g3>Base16 and Base24 schemes</g3> come in: both the classic layout (<x4/> and <x5/> to <x6/> at the top) and the newer one (<x7/> and a <x8/> block). A Base24 scheme reads as its first 16 colours.
9641498adf0c3309.text: <g1>Base16 方案</g1>，即 <x2/> 文件，<g3>Base16 和 Base24 方案</g3> 均采用此格式：包括经典布局（顶部 <x4/> 和 <x5/> 到 <x6/>）和新布局（<x7/> 和 <x8/> 块）。Base24 方案读取其前 16 种颜色。

964f931287002369.source: Every release and what it changed, newest first. Follow along with the <g1>news feed</g1> or watch the project on GitHub.
964f931287002369.text: 每次发布及其变更，最新版本在前。请关注<g1>新闻源</g1>或在 GitHub 上关注项目。

96640d6850d00a78.source: Browsers built on them work too: Chromium and Helium take the extension as Chrome does, Brave Origin as Brave does, Zen and LibreWolf as Firefox does. On Windows, Zen has a bug of its own (see <g1>The browser and DDM aren't connected</g1>).
96640d6850d00a78.text: 基于这些浏览器构建的其他浏览器也同样适用：Chromium 和 Helium 像 Chrome 一样安装扩展，Brave Origin 像 Brave 一样，Zen 和 LibreWolf 像 Firefox 一样。在 Windows 上，Zen 自身存在一个错误（请参阅<g1>浏览器与 DDM 未连接</g1>）。

966968c5d27758d7.source: Select one or more downloads and press <g1>Delete</g1>, click <g2>Delete</g2> on the toolbar, or choose <g3>File → Remove</g3>. DDM asks first:
966968c5d27758d7.text: 选择一个或多个下载，然后按 <g1>Delete</g1>、单击工具栏上的<g2>删除</g2>，或选择<g3>文件 → 删除</g3>。DDM 会先询问：

9675f888cdb836b1.text: 选择第一个/最后一个下载

96762962430d58e1.source: The tabs stay once the torrent has finished, for as long as it is shared.
96762962430d58e1.text: 只要 torrent 仍在共享，其选项卡就会在下载完成后保留。

9682bbc6499d98d3.source: <g1>All files and install steps</g1><g2>Every release on GitHub</g2>
9682bbc6499d98d3.text: <g1>所有文件和安装步骤</g1><g2>GitHub 上的所有发布</g2>

968dc8a4c8405655.source: <g1><g2>Browser integration</g2></g1> — the extension for Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Helium (it comes with DDM), which downloads it takes, and what happens when DDM isn't running.
968dc8a4c8405655.text: <g1><g2>浏览器集成</g2></g1> — 适用于 Firefox、Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Helium 的扩展（随 DDM 附带）、它接管哪些下载，以及 DDM 未运行时会发生什么。

969edadbc09f210d.source: <g1>ffmpeg</g1> (about 80 MB) joins a video and its sound when a site keeps them apart, which most sites do for the higher qualities, and turns the sound into an MP3, Opus or FLAC file. Click <g2>Install ffmpeg</g2> when DDM offers it. DDM checks it against the checksums its release publishes.
969edadbc09f210d.text: <g1>ffmpeg</g1>（约 80 MB）会在网站将视频和音频分开时将它们合并。大多数网站都会为较高画质这样处理。ffmpeg 还可以将音频转换为 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC 文件。DDM 提示时，点击<g2>安装 ffmpeg</g2>。DDM 会根据其发布版本提供的校验和进行验证。

96bcd95deee789b9.source: <g1>Emerald</g1> among the built-in looks in <g2>View → Theme</g2>: a white canvas with one near-black ink and a ladder of neutral greys for structure, emerald fills that carry near-black text rather than white, 6-point corners and Metro's one-colour icons. Its theme file names a few seeds per side and derives every other colour, so a role added later arrives in this look instead of the classic one (<g3>#45</g3>).
96bcd95deee789b9.text: <g1>Emerald</g1>加入<g2>视图 → 主题</g2>中的内置外观：白色画布，一种近黑色的墨色，以及用于结构的一组中性灰，带近黑色文字（而不是白色）的翡翠绿填充，6 点圆角，以及现代主题的单色图标。其主题文件为每一侧只列出几个种子色，并推导出其他所有颜色，因此以后新增的角色会出现在这个外观中，而不是经典外观中（<g3>#45</g3>）。

96cec022ce66b5c4.source: Unzip the file to a folder you can write to (not straight into <x1/>).
96cec022ce66b5c4.text: 将文件解压到您有写入权限的文件夹中（不要直接解压到 <x1/>）。

96d73217192641fd.source: DDM reads MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and CRC32 checksums. Paste the code as the site shows it: there is no list to pick the kind from, as DDM tells them apart by their length.
96d73217192641fd.text: DDM 可读取 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 和 CRC32 校验和。请按网站显示的方式粘贴代码：无需从列表中选择类型，DDM 会根据其长度进行区分。

96e3a6d626144c98.source: <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks → Network adapter</g1> holds DDM's connections to one adapter, usually a VPN's (<g2>Options</g2>). The torrent engine binds every socket to it: peers (TCP, and through a SOCKS proxy), HTTP and UDP trackers, the DHT and the listening port. On Linux and macOS it binds the adapter itself. On Windows it binds the adapter's address (its IPv4 one when it has one), and Windows sends a packet only through the adapter that has its source address. UPnP and local peer discovery are turned off then, because they talk to the local network rather than through the adapter.
96e3a6d626144c98.text: <g1>选项 → 代理/Socks → 网络适配器</g1>可将 DDM 的连接绑定到一个适配器，通常是 VPN 适配器（<g2>选项</g2>）。种子引擎会将每个套接字绑定到该适配器：包括对等方连接（TCP，以及通过 SOCKS 代理的连接）、HTTP 和 UDP 跟踪器、DHT，以及监听端口。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，它会绑定适配器本身。在 Windows 上，它会绑定适配器的地址（如果有 IPv4 地址，则绑定该地址）；Windows 只会通过拥有该源地址的适配器发送数据包。此时会关闭 UPnP 和本地对等方发现，因为它们通过本地网络通信，而不是通过该适配器通信。

970641facab3170c.source: <g1>Move/Rename</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+M</g2>) moves or renames the file of a finished download, or of one that hasn't started yet. With several downloads selected it asks for a folder and moves them all there, each under its own name.
970641facab3170c.text: <g1>移动/重命名</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+M</g2>) 用于移动或重命名已完成下载的文件，或尚未开始下载的文件。如果选中了多个下载任务，它会要求选择一个文件夹，然后将所有文件移动到该文件夹，每个文件保留其原有名称。

97383cda956e06f9.source: <g1>The installer</g1> (<x2/>), the one to pick unless you have a reason not to. It installs for you alone without administrator rights, or for everyone, and can set up browser integration and open <x3/> files and magnet links with DDM.
97383cda956e06f9.text: <g1>安装程序</g1> (<x2/>)，除非您有特殊原因，否则请选择此项。它无需管理员权限即可为您个人或所有用户安装，并可设置浏览器集成，以及使用 DDM 打开 <x3/> 文件和磁力链接。

97408a3a460ac468.source: Untick what you don't want, then Download Now.
97408a3a460ac468.text: 取消勾选不想要的文件，然后点击“立即下载”。

974263b60b93881e.source: Free IDM alternative: Dannex Download Manager, and 9 others compared
974263b60b93881e.text: 免费的 IDM 替代品：Dannex Download Manager 及其他 9 款下载管理器对比

97500b52b4a33a3e.source: Many sites publish their new torrents as an RSS or Atom feed. DDM watches the feeds you follow, lists what they hold, and its rules add the new torrents you want by themselves.
97500b52b4a33a3e.text: 许多网站以 RSS 或 Atom 源的形式发布新种子。DDM 会监控您关注的订阅源，列出其中的内容，并根据其规则自动添加您想要的新种子。

9757a8b628979f6a.source: The list shows each quality with its size, best first, and the sound alone at the end. Check <g1>Save to</g1> and <g2>File name</g2>, then click <g3>Download Now</g3>, or <g4>Later</g4> to put it in the list for later. The video gets its own row and progress window, like any other download.
9757a8b628979f6a.text: 列表会显示各种画质及其大小，最佳画质排在最前面，纯音频排在最后。检查<g1>保存到</g1>和<g2>文件名</g2>，然后点击<g3>立即下载</g3>，或点击<g4>稍后</g4>将其添加到稍后下载列表。视频会像其他下载一样，拥有独立的行和进度窗口。

976e1bc04dee0c02.source: Both the address you clicked and the one its redirects led to are checked, so a site you excluded stays excluded even when it sends you to another server. Everything else stays with the browser. Changes in Options reach the browser within a minute; you don't need to restart it.
976e1bc04dee0c02.text: 系统会检查您点击的地址以及重定向后的地址，因此即使被排除的网站将您重定向到另一台服务器，该网站仍会被排除。其他所有下载仍由浏览器处理。选项中的更改会在一分钟内同步到浏览器，无需重启浏览器。

9772287c22790a58.source: Unzip it onto the stick, for example to <x1/>.
9772287c22790a58.text: 将其解压到 U 盘上，例如解压到<x1/>。

9776a28342c940e4.source: Bigger when you need it, faster to open, and closer to your system.
9776a28342c940e4.text: 需要时更大，打开更快，更贴近您的系统。

97b923935fd6ed95.text: DDM 会收集我的数据吗？

97c670ad821220a9.source: Unzip it where you want DDM to live, for example <x1/> on a USB stick.
97c670ad821220a9.text: 将其解压到您希望 DDM 存放的位置，例如 U 盘上的 <x1/>。

97de26efb1e196ce.source: The <g1>Q</g1> column now shows a queue icon for each of them.
97de26efb1e196ce.text: <g1>Q</g1>列现在会为每个下载显示一个队列图标。

97df160b348bfb2f.source: Select the downloads in the box

9803050e064b2a71.source: <g1>Toolbar icon styles.</g1> View → Toolbar → Line style (the outlines, inked as the theme says) or 3D style: DDM's own glossy pictures (<x2/>, drawn by <x3/> at 16 to 64 px, the one for the size on screen; greyed by <x4/> when disabled). They apply where the theme has no icon of its own for a button and inks its icons in their own colours; a theme with an icon set, or one inking icons in one colour (High contrast), keeps its own.
9803050e064b2a71.text: <g1>工具栏图标样式。</g1>视图 → 工具栏 → 线条样式（轮廓线，按主题的设定着色）或 3D 样式：DDM 自己的光泽图片（<x2/>，由 <x3/> 以 16 到 64 px 绘制，取与屏幕上大小相符的一张；禁用时由 <x4/> 置灰）。它们用于主题没有为某个按钮提供图标、且按图标自身颜色着色的场合；带有自己图标集的主题，或把图标涂成单一颜色的主题（高对比度），则保留自己的图标。

980436929d94cbf9.source: A download that stopped halfway doesn't have to start over. DDM keeps what it has and continues from there.
980436929d94cbf9.text: 中途停止的下载不必重新开始。DDM 会保留已下载的部分，并从那里继续。

981faeae41148137.source: Check the folder, then Start Download.
981faeae41148137.text: 检查文件夹，然后点击“开始下载”。

982812ef66b913d5.source: <g1>Status</g1> — what it is doing, the address to open on the phone, and the certificate's fingerprint.
982812ef66b913d5.text: <g1>状态</g1> — 当前正在做什么、手机上要打开的地址以及证书的指纹。

98471ddc759bbcb3.source: On the web page, start the download again, or copy the new download link (right-click → <g1>Copy link</g1>). If the browser hands the new download to DDM, cancel it there: you only need the address.
98471ddc759bbcb3.text: 在网页上，再次开始下载，或复制新的下载链接（右键点击 → <g1>复制链接</g1>）。如果浏览器将新下载交给 DDM，请在那里取消它：您只需要地址。

9884d340beffa35b.source: <g1>Texts that were always in English</g1> are translated in every language: the empty list's message, buttons of the crash report window, and why OK or Verify is greyed in some windows.
9884d340beffa35b.text: <g1>原本始终显示为英文的文本</g1>现已翻译成所有语言，包括空列表提示、崩溃报告窗口中的按钮，以及某些窗口中“确定”或“验证”按钮变灰的原因。

989684c83eea8b0b.source: <g1>Aero</g1>: Windows 7's look: glossy buttons that turn light blue under the pointer, quiet check boxes, a glossy green progress bar, a glassy title bar with the title on a soft glow (on Windows), and glossy icons drawn for DDM in that manner.
989684c83eea8b0b.text: <g1>Aero</g1>：Windows 7 的外观：光泽按钮，指针悬停时变为浅蓝色，低调的复选框，光泽绿色进度条，玻璃质感标题栏，标题带有柔和光晕（在 Windows 上），以及为 DDM 绘制的光泽图标。

989d0a3e3e184d6f.source: On the phone, on the same Wi-Fi: scan the QR code with the camera (or type the address).
989d0a3e3e184d6f.text: 在手机上，连接同一 Wi-Fi：用相机扫描二维码（或输入地址）。

989f471f8d0c0cca.source: The website's <g1>Themes page</g1> has a prompt you can give an AI assistant, with the format, every key and the rules, to write a theme for you from a description.
989f471f8d0c0cca.text: 网站的<g1>主题页面</g1>提供了一个您可以提供给 AI 助手的提示，其中包含格式、所有键和规则，以便根据描述为您编写主题。

98b77f378859b820.source: It notes the addresses of video streams (HLS and DASH playlists) and of video and sound files a page's players load, in memory for that tab, so the <g1>Download video</g1> button and the right-click menu can pass them on. Its button reads the page only to find video and sound players and place itself, and, for its menu, the qualities the player or its stream lists (on YouTube, what the player says it plays and its formats). Clicking it passes the page's address, the video's address, the page's title, the site's cookies, the page that embeds the player and your browser's User-Agent to DDM. So that the qualities are ready when you click, it passes the same when the pointer reaches the button, or rests over the video on that video's own page; never from a private window.
98b77f378859b820.text: 它会在内存中为该标签页记录页面播放器加载的视频流（HLS 和 DASH 播放列表）以及视频和音频文件的地址，以便<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮和右键菜单可以将其传递出去。其按钮读取页面只是为了找到视频和音频播放器并放置自己，以及（对于其菜单）读取播放器或其流所列出的画质（在 YouTube 上，是播放器所说的可播放内容及其格式）。单击它会将页面的地址、视频的地址、页面的标题、站点的 Cookie、嵌入播放器的页面以及您浏览器的 User-Agent 传递给 DDM。为了让画质在您单击时已准备好，当指针移到按钮上，或在该视频自己的页面上的视频上停留时，它也会传递同样的内容；绝不会来自隐私窗口。

98ba5822f64ea0d2.source: Mac OS X's feel: gel buttons round at the ends, a blue focus ring and a blue gel progress bar.
98ba5822f64ea0d2.text: Mac OS X 的感觉：两端圆润的凝胶按钮、蓝色焦点环和蓝色凝胶进度条。

98c2bdc7d9ac8445.source: <g1>Show queue selection panel on pressing "Download Later" button</g1> — ask which queue; off puts it in the <g2>Main download queue</g2>.
98c2bdc7d9ac8445.text: <g1>按下“稍后下载”按钮时显示队列选择面板</g1> — 询问要使用哪个队列；关闭此选项后，下载会放入<g2>主下载队列</g2>。

98cabd18b288ca1d.source: Yes, built in: open a .torrent file or paste a magnet link, tick the files you want in the folder tree, and the torrent downloads in the same list as everything else, with its peers, trackers and pieces one tab away. See Torrents.
98cabd18b288ca1d.text: 是，内置支持：打开 .torrent 文件或粘贴磁力链接，在文件夹树中勾选所需文件，种子下载会与其他下载显示在同一列表中，其对等节点、跟踪器和分块信息只需切换一个选项卡即可查看。请参阅“种子”页面。

98d5e27c784a055e.source: When the queue is done: open a file, quit DDM, or turn the computer off.
98d5e27c784a055e.text: 队列完成后：打开文件、退出 DDM 或关闭计算机。

98e94f4629f01678.source: See why a download stayed in the browser, and which setting to change.
98e94f4629f01678.text: 查看下载停留在浏览器的原因，以及需要更改的设置。

98ee44f0be07d8d6.text: 选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 网卡

98f4c63ffc4e2e0d.source: Removing the last feed in the RSS feeds window no longer crashes the app (<g1>#321</g1>).
98f4c63ffc4e2e0d.text: 在 RSS 源窗口中删除最后一个源不再导致应用程序崩溃（<g1>#321</g1>）。

98f8f3a8ba59b632.source: comes with every download of DDM and works without the app running. <x1/> downloads a file over several connections with a progress line, <g2>Ctrl+C</g2> pauses it and <x3/> carries on later. <x4/> downloads a video, and <x5/> a torrent or only some of its files. <x6/> and <x7/> say what there is to choose before you download. <x8/> lists every option, and a command that fails exits with code 1.
98f8f3a8ba59b632.text: 随 DDM 的每次下载附带，无需应用程序运行即可工作。<x1/> 通过多个连接下载文件，并显示进度条，<g2>Ctrl+C</g2> 暂停，<x3/> 稍后继续。<x4/> 下载视频，<x5/> 下载种子或仅下载其部分文件。<x6/> 和 <x7/> 说明下载前有哪些选项可供选择。<x8/> 列出所有选项，失败的命令将以代码 1 退出。

98fb5e5b449dc77b.source: Each column title has a faint funnel. Click it to filter the list by that column:
98fb5e5b449dc77b.text: 每个列标题旁都有一个浅色的漏斗图标。点击图标可按该列筛选列表：

990ac76c42b765ec.source: Give the video's page address to <g1>Add URL</g1> (<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>). DDM recognises video pages and opens the video window, already looking the page up.
990ac76c42b765ec.text: 将视频页面地址输入<g1>添加 URL</g1>（<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>）。DDM 会识别视频页面并打开视频窗口，同时开始查找该页面。

990b1cc3d0547f94.source: Dannex Download Manager ("DDM", "the software") and the website dannexdownloadmanager.com ("the site") are made by the Dannex Download Manager contributors ("we"), on the code of Mister Download Manager by Ahmed Nefzaoui. By using the software or the site you accept these terms. If you don't, please don't use them.
990b1cc3d0547f94.text: Dannex Download Manager（“DDM”“本软件”）和网站 dannexdownloadmanager.com（“本站”）由 Dannex Download Manager 贡献者（“我们”）开发，基于 Ahmed Nefzaoui 的 Mister Download Manager 的代码。使用本软件或本站，即表示您接受这些条款。如果不接受，请不要使用。

990d8b16ea032009.source: <g1>Image galleries</g1> (<g2>#58</g2>): a gallery's address in Add URL (a Wikimedia Commons category, a Flickr album, a DeviantArt or Imgur gallery and more) opens <g3>Download a gallery</g3>, which downloads its pictures with gallery-dl into a folder of their own, all of them or the first N. Started again, a gallery fetches only its new pictures. gallery-dl is an optional helper like yt-dlp: installed from its releases only when signed by its author's key, or your own copy (Helpers). On the command line: <x4/> and <x5/>.
990d8b16ea032009.text: <g1>图片图库</g1>（<g2>#58</g2>）：在“添加 URL”中输入图库地址（Wikimedia Commons 类别、Flickr 相册、DeviantArt 或 Imgur 图库等）会打开<g3>下载图库</g3>，它会使用 gallery-dl 将图片下载到自己的文件夹中，全部下载或下载前 N 张。再次启动时，图库只会获取新图片。gallery-dl 是一个可选的帮助程序，类似于 yt-dlp：仅当由其作者的密钥签名时才从其发布版本安装，或者使用您自己的副本（帮助程序）。在命令行上：<x4/> 和 <x5/>。

990eebff0153d94b.source: How dates and times are written in the list of downloads, the Scheduler and Statistics.
990eebff0153d94b.text: 下载列表、计划程序和统计信息中日期和时间的写法。

995f8de8c1aac52c.source: <g1>Delete</g1> — remove a category, your own or a built-in one (not General or Torrents). DDM asks what happens to its downloads: <g2>Move its downloads to General</g2>, or <g3>Remove its downloads from the list</g3> (a download that is running moves to General instead). Their files stay where they are either way. From then on, files of its types go to another category that has them, or to General.
995f8de8c1aac52c.text: <g1>删除</g1> — 删除自定义类别或内置类别（常规和种子类别除外）。DDM 会询问如何处理该类别中的下载：<g2>将其下载移动到“常规”</g2>，或<g3>从列表中删除其下载</g3>（正在进行的下载会改为移至“常规”）。无论选择哪种方式，文件都会保留在原处。之后，该类别所含文件类型的文件会归入其他包含这些类型的类别，或归入“常规”。

99605902518653e2.source: The same programs without an installer. It keeps its data in <x1/>, like an installed copy.
99605902518653e2.text: 不带安装程序的程序。它将数据保存在 <x1/> 中，就像已安装的版本一样。

9980d7b09f417fc4.source: DDM's icon in the top bar of Ubuntu's GNOME, its menu open: Open DDM, Add new download, Add batch download, Downloads in progress, Speed Limiter, Scheduler, the main queue, Options and Exit
9980d7b09f417fc4.text: Ubuntu GNOME 顶部栏中的 DDM 图标，其菜单已打开：打开 DDM、添加新下载、添加批量下载、正在进行的下载、速度限制器、计划程序、主队列、选项和退出

999042cdd3edbcf1.source: Who the app talks to, and why
999042cdd3edbcf1.text: 应用与谁通信，以及原因

9996301ba94de649.source: The Download panels settings: the button on or off, and the sites it never shows on
9996301ba94de649.text: 下载面板设置：按钮的开启或关闭，以及它从不显示的网站

9996e70b2743bdbf.source: The free DDM extension hands each download you click over to DDM, with the page it came from and your sign-in for the site. A button over videos sends them to DDM too.
9996e70b2743bdbf.text: 免费的 DDM 扩展会将您点击的每个下载任务交给 DDM，同时附带来源页面和您在该网站的登录信息。视频上方的按钮也会将视频发送到 DDM。

99b7a47a174252a2.source: DDM's setup registers the helper where Helium looks for it, on Windows, Linux and macOS. Once the store lists it, on Linux and macOS DDM also offers the extension to Helium, through Helium's own services, so with them allowed it arrives by itself at Helium's next start (on macOS Helium asks first: <g1>New extension added</g1> in its menu, where you turn it on). The Linux packages (.deb, .rpm) leave that to the window below, writing nothing in your home folder. On Windows Helium can't be offered the extension this way: DDM's <g2>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g2> window opens the store's page in Helium when Helium was installed with its setup; Helium from its zip isn't found there, so open the store's page in it yourself. Helium presents itself as Google Chrome, on purpose, so in <g3>Options → General → Take downloads from these browsers</g3> it is <g4>Google Chrome</g4>.
99b7a47a174252a2.text: DDM 的安装程序会在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上，将辅助程序注册到 Helium 查找它的位置。待应用商店收录后，在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 还会通过 Helium 自己的服务向 Helium 提供该扩展，因此允许这些服务后，它会在 Helium 下次启动时自动出现（在 macOS 上 Helium 会先询问：其菜单中的<g1>已添加新扩展</g1>，在那里开启它）。Linux 软件包（.deb、.rpm）把这一步留给下方的窗口，不会在您的主文件夹中写入任何内容。在 Windows 上，无法以这种方式向 Helium 提供扩展：如果 Helium 是用其安装程序安装的，DDM 的<g2>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口会在 Helium 中打开应用商店页面；用 zip 包安装的 Helium 在那里找不到，所以请自行在其中打开应用商店页面。Helium 有意将自己标识为 Google Chrome，因此在<g3>选项 → 常规 → 接管这些浏览器的下载</g3>中，它显示为<g4>Google Chrome</g4>。

99b89deb8ad08cda.source: Later, the program is built for size (<g1>#158</g1>), which takes the installer from 16.1 to 13.6 MB and the zips from 19.3 to 15.6 MB, with the same features and the same download speed.
99b89deb8ad08cda.text: 稍后，程序将针对大小进行构建（<g1>#158</g1>），这将使安装程序从 16.1 MB 变为 13.6 MB，zip 文件从 19.3 MB 变为 15.6 MB，同时保持相同的功能和下载速度。

99c3f60a725ee399.source: <g1><g2>Video downloads</g2></g1> — download a video from its page (YouTube, Vimeo and many more) with yt-dlp.
99c3f60a725ee399.text: <g1><g2>视频下载</g2></g1> — 使用 yt-dlp 从视频页面（YouTube、Vimeo 等）下载视频。

99e97ad515986dce.source: Options on its Sites Logins page: a list of sites with their user names
99e97ad515986dce.text: “选项”的“站点登录”页面：带有用户名的网站列表。

9a26fd6f740cf884.source: <g1>Show details >></g1> (open by default) adds the connection view:
9a26fd6f740cf884.text: <g1>显示详情 >></g1>（默认打开）会添加连接视图：

9a2a2296a8ebb424.text: 导入您的 IDM 导出文件

9a37e805240604f2.source: Set <g1>Limit each download to</g1> in KBytes/sec. It starts at 10, so set it before you turn the limiter on.
9a37e805240604f2.text: 以 KB/s 为单位设置<g1>将每个下载限制为</g1>。它起初为 10，因此请在开启限制器之前设置它。

9a7aa1f60dbf9dbd.source: Keep <x1/> and the one <x2/> (the keyboard shortcut letter) as they are.
9a7aa1f60dbf9dbd.text: 保留<x1/>和唯一的<x2/>（键盘快捷键字母），不要更改。

9a946958fe91d2d6.source: Right-click and choose <g1>Add to queue → Main download queue</g1>.
9a946958fe91d2d6.text: 右键点击并选择<g1>添加到队列 → 主下载队列</g1>。

9aaff800d23a7c48.source: A link the service can't give says why in the list: sign in again, premium needed, the host is down (DDM tries again later), the file is gone, and so on.
9aaff800d23a7c48.text: 如果服务无法提供链接，列表会说明原因，例如需要重新登录、需要高级帐户、文件托管网站不可用（DDM 会稍后重试）或文件已不存在。

9ab2283e83608818.source: Before you click <g1>OK</g1>, the window shows the <g2>First file</g2>, <g3>Second file</g3> and <g4>Last file</g4>, so a typo shows up before anything downloads. If the server needs a login, tick <g5>Log in to the server</g5>. Copied the address already? <g6>Tasks → Add batch download from clipboard</g6> fills it in.
9ab2283e83608818.text: 在单击<g1>确定</g1>之前，窗口会显示<g2>第一个文件</g2>、<g3>第二个文件</g3>和<g4>最后一个文件</g4>，因此在下载任何内容之前就能发现输入错误。如果服务器需要登录，请勾选<g5>登录服务器</g5>。已经复制了地址？<g6>任务 → 从剪贴板添加批处理下载</g6>会自动填入。

9ab56ef757d644f4.source: <g1>DDM's own downloads use its own downloader</g1>: yt-dlp, ffmpeg, DDM's updates and a crash report's symbols now come down with several connections, resume after a cut connection and go through your proxy settings. Each file is still checked against its publisher's signed checksums before use.
9ab56ef757d644f4.text: <g1>DDM 自身的下载使用自己的下载器</g1>：现在，yt-dlp、ffmpeg、DDM 更新和崩溃报告符号文件都会通过多个连接下载，网络中断后可以续传，并会使用代理设置。每个文件在使用前仍会根据发布者的签名校验和进行验证。

9ac831e3083f5953.source: Options on its Proxy / Socks page: No proxy, Use system settings, Use a configuration script and Use this proxy server
9ac831e3083f5953.text: 其“代理/SOCKS”页面上的选项：无代理、使用系统设置、使用配置脚本和使用此代理服务器

9b13534b69e87859.text: <g1>种子</g1>是点对点的：洪流群中的其他人会看到您的 IP 地址，所有洪流客户端都是如此。

9b3077cadf5c65e0.text: 启动 DDM，然后重试下载。

9b364ec1f04b6971.text: 对于这些视频，新的速度限制会从停止的地方重新开始下载（<g1>速度限制</g1>）。

9b3dde1851a80204.source: <g1>Match case</g1> tells capitals apart. <g2>Match whole string only</g2> finds only an exact, complete match.
9b3dde1851a80204.text: <g1>区分大小写</g1> 会区分大小写字母。<g2>只匹配整个字符串</g2> 只查找精确、完整的匹配项。

9b47af5a9641c752.source: To check DDM's side, open <g1>Options → General</g1> in DDM and click <g2>Test browser integration...</g2>. It checks that browser integration is on, that this is the installed copy, that the browsers can find DDM, and which browsers' extension has connected (and which copy: the Chrome Web Store's, or the one loaded from DDM's folder); <g3>How to fix it</g3> opens the section for the first that fails.
9b47af5a9641c752.text: 要检查 DDM 一侧，请在 DDM 中打开<g1>选项 → 常规</g1>并单击<g2>测试浏览器集成...</g2>。它会检查浏览器集成是否开启、这是否为已安装的副本、浏览器能否找到 DDM，以及哪些浏览器的扩展已连接（以及是哪个副本：Chrome 应用商店的，还是从 DDM 文件夹加载的）；<g3>如何修复</g3>会打开第一个失败项对应的部分。

9b6e0916bcbf22ba.source: A connection that fails is retried on its own. The progress window's table shows <g1>Retrying</g1> and the reason.
9b6e0916bcbf22ba.text: 连接失败时会自动重试。进度窗口的表格会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>和重试原因。

9b6f6bc5bd8eb1a4.source: <g1>Use advanced browser integration</g1> — let the browser extension hand downloads to DDM. Turn it off to keep every download in the browser.
9b6f6bc5bd8eb1a4.text: <g1>使用高级浏览器集成</g1> — 让浏览器扩展将下载任务交给 DDM。关闭此选项可将所有下载保留在浏览器中。

9b9f71ce7672692d.source: <g1>A status strip</g1> under the list: how many downloads it shows and how many are selected, how many are running and how fast in all. The tray icon's tip says the same.
9b9f71ce7672692d.text: 列表下方新增<g1>状态栏</g1>：显示下载总数、选中数、正在运行的数量和总速度。托盘图标的提示也会显示相同信息。

9bb035da4696ddfc.source: A <x1/> file is sent as its magnet link (its hash, its name and its trackers). Every file of the torrent is downloaded; the service fetches the whole torrent.
9bb035da4696ddfc.text: <x1/>文件会以磁力链接的形式发送，其中包含哈希值、名称和跟踪器。种子中的所有文件都会下载；服务会获取整个种子。

9bb3d17ebf50acad.source: Install or update the helpers videos need: yt-dlp (checked against its signing key) and ffmpeg (Windows; on macOS and Linux DDM uses the system's).
9bb3d17ebf50acad.text: 安装或更新下载视频所需的辅助工具：yt-dlp（使用其签名密钥验证）和 ffmpeg（适用于 Windows；在 macOS 和 Linux 上，DDM 使用系统自带的 ffmpeg）。

9bb97350926cc022.source: Open <g1>Tasks → RSS feeds...</g1>, type a feed's address into <g2>Feed address</g2> and click <g3>Add feed</g3>. DDM fetches it at once, then every 30 minutes, or as often as you set, down to every 5. Pick a feed to see its articles: one with a torrent shows a torrent icon, and its size when the feed gives it. Double-click an article to open <g4>Add torrent</g4> with it, as for any <g5>torrent</g5>.
9bb97350926cc022.text: 打开<g1>任务 → RSS 源...</g1>，在<g2>订阅源地址</g2>中输入订阅源地址，然后点击<g3>添加订阅源</g3>。DDM 会立即获取它，然后每 30 分钟获取一次，或者按照您设置的频率（最短 5 分钟）获取。选择一个订阅源以查看其文章：带有种子图标的文章会显示种子图标，并在订阅源提供时显示其大小。双击文章以使用它打开<g4>添加种子</g4>，就像任何<g5>种子</g5>一样。

9c1cda1d769c9ac5.source: The keys are the ones Windows users already know. <g1>Ctrl+N</g1> adds a download, <g2>Ctrl+F</g2> finds one, <g3>Enter</g3> opens it and <g4>Alt+Enter</g4> shows its <g5>Properties</g5>. <g6>F10</g6> or <g7>Alt</g7> opens the menus, and the underlined letters run their items. <g8>Shift+F10</g8> or the <g9>Menu</g9> key opens the selected download's menu. <g10>Tab</g10> moves between the <g11>Categories</g11> tree and the list, and the tree answers the arrow keys.
9c1cda1d769c9ac5.text: 按键是 Windows 用户已经熟悉的。<g1>Ctrl+N</g1> 添加下载，<g2>Ctrl+F</g2> 查找下载，<g3>Enter</g3> 打开下载，<g4>Alt+Enter</g4> 显示其<g5>属性</g5>。<g6>F10</g6> 或 <g7>Alt</g7> 打开菜单，带下划线的字母执行其项目。<g8>Shift+F10</g8> 或 <g9>菜单</g9> 键打开所选下载的菜单。<g10>Tab</g10> 在<g11>类别</g11>树和列表之间移动，树形视图响应方向键。

9c229c6b356c1396.source: <g1>The host connection limit test tells a reconnect from a connection too many</g1> (<g2>#224</g2>). A server sees that a client dropped an answer only when it next writes to it, so on a busy computer a connection that reconnects can be refused once while the server still counts its old answer. The lab server now logs, with each refusal, how far the answers holding the client's slots had been sent; the test fails only for a refusal none of them explains.
9c229c6b356c1396.text: <g1>主机连接限制测试区分重新连接和过多连接</g1>（<g2>#224</g2>）。服务器只有在下次写入客户端时才会发现客户端丢弃了响应，因此在繁忙的计算机上，重新连接的连接可能会被拒绝一次，而服务器仍在计算其旧响应。实验室服务器现在会记录每次拒绝时，持有客户端槽的响应已发送的进度；测试仅在没有任何解释的拒绝时失败。

9c2a25b113f100c0.source: Dannex Download Manager's crash and freeze reports: readable, free of your addresses and file names, and sent only by you, through your browser and GitHub.
9c2a25b113f100c0.text: Dannex Download Manager 的崩溃和冻结报告：可读，不含您的地址和文件名，并且仅由您通过浏览器和 GitHub 发送。

9c4861e08c9b1cf2.source: Download manager command line and automation API
9c4861e08c9b1cf2.text: 下载管理器命令行和自动化 API

9c5c6fbd0cb66ec8.source: <g1>Turn the limiter on whenever Dannex Download Manager starts</g1> turns it on each time DDM starts.
9c5c6fbd0cb66ec8.text: <g1>每次 Dannex Download Manager 启动时开启限制器</g1>会在每次 DDM 启动时将其开启。

9c75cab2cd0dd243.source: The download button over videos passes the page's referrer, cookies and the browser's User-Agent to yt-dlp, so videos that need a sign-in or play only where they're embedded work.
9c75cab2cd0dd243.text: 视频上方的下载按钮会将页面的 referrer、cookie 和浏览器的 User-Agent 传递给 yt-dlp，因此需要登录或只能在嵌入位置播放的视频也能正常工作。

9c7d71c30eb26593.source: <g1>View → DDM tray icon</g1> has the icon's own choices. <g2>3D style</g2> (the default) shows DDM's icon in full colour; <g3>Flat style</g3> shows its mark flat, in one colour that suits the taskbar (white on a dark taskbar, dark on a light one, following Windows' setting as it changes; the menu bar's own colour on a Mac). While downloads run, a slim bar along the icon's foot fills as they progress. <g4>Don't show</g4> leaves no icon at all: closing the main window then minimizes it to the taskbar (the Dock on macOS) when <g5>Keep running when closing the window</g5> is on, and Minimize leaves it there too (on Linux, with no icon, closing quits DDM). <g6>Show download speed in the tray tooltip</g6> adds how many downloads run and how fast to the icon's tip. On Windows, <g7>Show progress on the taskbar button</g7> shows every running download's progress as one bar on DDM's taskbar button.
9c7d71c30eb26593.text: <g1>视图 → DDM 托盘图标</g1>有图标自己的选项。<g2>3D 样式</g2>（默认）以全彩显示 DDM 的图标；<g3>扁平样式</g3>以单一颜色平面显示其标志，颜色与任务栏相配（深色任务栏上为白色，浅色任务栏上为深色，随 Windows 的设置变化；在 Mac 上为菜单栏自己的颜色）。下载运行时，图标底部的细进度条会随进度填充。<g4>不显示</g4>则完全不留图标：此时，若开启了<g5>关闭窗口时保持运行</g5>，关闭主窗口会把它最小化到任务栏（macOS 上是程序坞），最小化也会让它留在那里（在 Linux 上没有图标时，关闭窗口会退出 DDM）。<g6>在通知区域图标提示中显示下载速度</g6>会在图标提示中加入正在运行的下载数量和速度。在 Windows 上，<g7>在任务栏按钮上显示进度</g7>会把所有运行中下载的进度显示为 DDM 任务栏按钮上的一条进度条。

9c9751edd8659026.source: Close the dialog (an open drop-down list first)
9c9751edd8659026.text: 关闭对话框（如果下拉列表已打开，则先关闭下拉列表）

9cd6c290fcd2830b.source: <g1>When an address stops working</g1>: a video's addresses are signed and expire after a few hours (YouTube's after six). DDM asks yt-dlp for a fresh one for the same quality and carries on from where it stopped.
9cd6c290fcd2830b.text: <g1>当地址失效时</g1>：视频地址经过签名，并在几小时后过期（YouTube 的地址在六小时后过期）。DDM 会向 yt-dlp 请求相同质量的新地址，并从停止的地方继续。

9cde19e93226436f.source: The same list is in DDM under <g1>Help → Keyboard shortcuts</g1>, and the menus show each command's keys beside it. On a Mac, <g2>⌘</g2> (Command) takes the place of <g3>Ctrl</g3>: <g4>⌘N</g4> adds a download.
9cde19e93226436f.text: DDM 中也有同样的列表，位于<g1>帮助 → 键盘快捷方式</g1>下；菜单中会在每个命令旁显示对应的快捷键。在 Mac 上，<g2>⌘</g2> (Command) 代替 <g3>Ctrl</g3>：<g4>⌘N</g4> 可添加下载。

9ce016493c61d1f9.source: <g1>Linux: Vulkan, and macOS: Metal, in View → Draw with</g1> (<g2>#206</g2>). Linux can draw its windows with Vulkan (on Wayland and X11), and macOS with Metal, the way Windows draws with Direct3D. OpenGL stays the default there until reports from real graphics cards are in: try it and tell us how it went. The same safety net as on Windows: when Vulkan or Metal can't start (no driver for it), its first frame doesn't come within 10 seconds, or a start with it ends before its first frame, DDM draws with OpenGL until it is chosen again, and the menu says why. A graphics card reset while DDM runs starts DDM again.
9ce016493c61d1f9.text: <g1>Linux：Vulkan，macOS：Metal，在视图 → 绘制方式中</g1>（<g2>#206</g2>）。Linux 可以在 Wayland 和 X11 上使用 Vulkan 绘制窗口，macOS 可以使用 Metal，就像 Windows 使用 Direct3D 绘制一样。OpenGL 仍是默认设置，直到收到真实显卡的报告：请尝试并告诉我们效果如何。与 Windows 相同的安全网：当 Vulkan 或 Metal 无法启动（没有驱动）、其第一帧在 10 秒内未出现，或使用它启动但在第一帧出现前结束时，DDM 会使用 OpenGL 绘制，直到再次选择它，菜单会说明原因。DDM 运行时显卡重置会重新启动 DDM。

9ce84c07ab18260e.source: The new address has to point at the same file. If it doesn't, DDM stops with <g1>the file changed on the server</g1>.
9ce84c07ab18260e.text: 新地址必须指向同一个文件。如果不是，DDM 会停止并显示<g1>服务器上的文件已更改</g1>。

9d1326816ebdec07.source: Firefox forgets the extension after a restart
9d1326816ebdec07.text: Firefox 重启后会忘记扩展程序

9d148e6408c5dc4e.source: : each report (<x1/>) and its crash data (<x2/>);
9d148e6408c5dc4e.text: ：每个报告 (<x1/>) 及其崩溃数据 (<x2/>)；

9d17cb869478b3ac.source: <g1>As the system's region writes them</g1> (the default) — Windows' region settings (Settings → Time & language → Region); on macOS and Linux, your language's usual way. In English the list keeps IDM's own date text.
9d17cb869478b3ac.text: <g1>按系统区域设置写入</g1>（默认）— 使用 Windows 的区域设置（设置 → 时间和语言 → 区域）；在 macOS 和 Linux 上，使用相应语言的常用格式。使用英语时，列表会保留 IDM 自己的日期文本。

9d218a03ea7f9cde.source: <g1>Resize a column:</g1> drag the line between two titles; double-click it to fit the column to its contents. A column can't be made narrower than its title's start and "...": it stops there.
9d218a03ea7f9cde.text: <g1>调整列宽：</g1>拖动两个标题之间的线；双击它可使列宽适应其内容。列不能比其标题的开头和“...”更窄：到那里就停止了。

9d354175893ac831.source: Add the extension to each browser you use, as below. Dannex's extension isn't in the browsers' stores yet (its listings are on their way), so it comes with DDM, in the <x1/> folder where DDM is installed, and as its own download with every release. Until a browser's extension has reached DDM, DDM's <g2>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g2> window opens at each start: it lists the browsers it found, and <g3>Show me how</g3> opens these steps (once a store lists it, <g4>Add the extension</g4> opens its page there instead). <g5>Don't ask again</g5> stops the window.
9d354175893ac831.text: 按下文所述，把扩展添加到您使用的每个浏览器。Dannex 的扩展尚未登陆各浏览器的商店（上架即将进行），因此它随 DDM 一起提供，位于 DDM 安装位置的 <x1/> 文件夹中，每个版本也提供单独下载。在某个浏览器的扩展连上 DDM 之前，每次启动时都会打开 DDM 的<g2>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g2>窗口：它列出找到的浏览器，点击<g3>向我展示如何操作</g3>会打开这些步骤（商店上架后，<g4>添加扩展</g4>会改为打开商店中的页面）。<g5>不再询问</g5>可停止弹出该窗口。

9d84f106d2cfbe3e.source: Is the extension loaded and turned on? Look for <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> on the browser's extensions page. In Firefox, a temporary add-on is gone after a restart: <g2>Browser integration</g2> says how to keep it. See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
9d84f106d2cfbe3e.text: 扩展是否已加载并开启？请在浏览器的扩展页面上查找 <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>。在 Firefox 中，临时附加组件在重启后就会消失：<g2>浏览器集成</g2>说明了如何保留它。请参阅<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

9d949d786d522be7.source: <g1>Link grabber, and archives extracted when they are downloaded</g1> (<g2>#37</g2>). The window that took the browser's "Download all links", Tasks → Import and dropped lists grew into Link grabber (also Tasks → Link grabber..., where pasted links go). Links come in packages: a split archive's volumes together, the other links of a page together, the rest in "Various files". Each link is looked up for its name, size and whether the server has it (Offline links come unticked), and each package has its folder, an archive password, "Extract when done" and "Delete archives after extracting". <g3>Start</g3> or <g4>Add to queue</g4> (IDM's import, unchanged: an <x5/> file still brings each download's referrer and cookies). DDM extracts ZIP (AES and Deflate64 too), TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.XZ, GZ and XZ itself; 7z and RAR need 7-Zip (split <x6/> and <x7/> too), and a window says so when it isn't installed. It extracts when a package says so, for any download with <g8>Options → Archives → Extract archives when their download completes</g8> (off by default), or with right-click → <g9>Extract</g9>. A split archive is extracted once its last volume is in. Extracted files are marked as downloaded from the internet, as the archive is; names that would leave the folder, links, and archives that would fill the disk are refused; an existing file is never overwritten. The archive goes to the Recycle Bin (the Trash) only when you ask. Options has a new <g10>Archives</g10> page.
9d949d786d522be7.text: <g1>链接抓取器，以及下载后提取的存档</g1>（<g2>#37</g2>）。接收浏览器“下载所有链接”、任务 → 导入和拖放列表的窗口已发展为链接抓取器（也可通过任务 → 链接抓取器…，粘贴的链接会进入此处）。链接以包的形式出现：拆分的存档卷在一起，页面上的其他链接在一起，其余的在“各种文件”中。每个链接都会查找其名称、大小以及服务器是否拥有它（离线链接未勾选），每个包都有其文件夹、存档密码、“完成后提取”和“提取后删除存档”。<g3>开始</g3>或<g4>添加到队列</g4>（IDM 的导入，未更改：<x5/> 文件仍然会带来每个下载的引用者和 cookie）。DDM 自己提取 ZIP（也包括 AES 和 Deflate64）、TAR、TAR.GZ、TAR.XZ、GZ 和 XZ；7z 和 RAR 需要 7-Zip（也包括拆分的 <x6/> 和 <x7/>），如果未安装，会弹出一个窗口说明。当包说明时，它会提取，对于任何下载，如果<g8>选项 → 压缩包 → 下载完成后提取存档</g8>（默认关闭）或右键点击 → <g9>提取</g9>。拆分的存档会在其最后一个卷进入后提取。提取的文件被标记为从互联网下载，就像存档一样；会离开文件夹的名称、链接以及会填满磁盘的存档会被拒绝；现有文件绝不会被覆盖。存档只有在您要求时才会进入回收站（垃圾箱）。选项中新增了<g10>压缩包</g10>页面。

9d9b6d291dfca165.source: <g1>Each download uses up to</g1> — how many connections each download may use, from 1 to 32 (8 by default). Type the number or use the arrows.
9d9b6d291dfca165.text: <g1>每个下载最多使用</g1> — 每个下载可使用多少个连接，范围为 1 到 32（默认 8）。输入数字或使用箭头。

9d9eb270f47daa62.source: Check <g1>Download limits</g1> in the Scheduler. When the limit is reached, downloads wait with <g2>Waiting: the download limit is reached (Scheduler)</g2>.
9d9eb270f47daa62.text: 检查计划程序中的<g1>下载限制</g1>。达到限制后，下载任务会显示<g2>等待: 已达到下载限制（计划程序）</g2>。

9da027e1258a39d3.source: Other programs can ask the running app what it is downloading, and pause, start, remove or delete downloads. The API is <g1>off by default</g1>; turn it on with <x2/> (and off with <x3/>).
9da027e1258a39d3.text: 其他程序可以询问正在运行的应用正在下载什么，并暂停、开始、移除或删除下载。API <g1>默认关闭</g1>；使用 <x2/> 开启（使用 <x3/> 关闭）。

9dc027cf03b45afb.source: Downloads added from the phone behave like any other: they go to the category's folder and follow the queues, the Scheduler and the speed limits. The page speaks your phone's language when DDM has it, and follows its light or dark mode.
9dc027cf03b45afb.text: 从手机添加的下载与任何其他下载一样：它们会进入所属类别的文件夹，并遵循队列、计划程序和速度限制。当 DDM 支持时，该页面会使用您手机的语言，并遵循其浅色或深色模式。

9dcb3eb62d6f2e46.source: A theme is one small text file, in <g1>TOML</g1> (or JSON). It names only what it changes; everything else comes from the theme it builds on. You don't need to build DDM or know how to program.
9dcb3eb62d6f2e46.text: 主题是一个小的 <g1>TOML</g1>（或 JSON）文本文件。它只命名它所更改的内容；其他所有内容都来自它所基于的主题。您无需构建 DDM 或了解如何编程。

9dd2cffc726c6f48.source: Headless downloads with progress (<x1/>, <x2/>), videos, torrents and the automation API's commands: a library the app's program runs (<x3/>), and <x4/>, a small launcher that starts it with the same arguments, terminal and exit code
9dd2cffc726c6f48.text: 无界面下载，带进度（<x1/>、<x2/>）、视频、种子和自动化API命令：应用程序运行的库（<x3/>），以及<x4/>，一个小型启动器，以相同的参数、终端和退出代码启动它

9dde0d9d0fb50ff4.source: <g1>Remember the last folder chosen for …</g1> — when you pick another folder in <g2>Download File Info</g2>, it becomes the category's folder from then on. On by default. (It sets the first state of <g3>Always save … files to this folder</g3> in that window.)
9dde0d9d0fb50ff4.text: <g1>记住上次为……选择的文件夹</g1> — 当您在<g2>下载文件信息</g2>中选择另一个文件夹时，它此后会成为该类别的文件夹。默认开启。（它决定该窗口中<g3>始终将……文件保存到此文件夹</g3>的初始状态。）

9df4b353c5463d72.source: Get your file's SHA-256. On Windows, run <x1/>; on Linux, <x2/> and the file's name.
9df4b353c5463d72.text: 获取您文件的 SHA-256 值。在 Windows 上，运行 <x1/>；在 Linux 上，运行 <x2/> 并加上文件名。

9e0019721ea3837e.source: Install it from the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons.
9e0019721ea3837e.text: 从 Chrome 网上应用店或 Firefox 附加组件安装。

9e23a915fdb4dd6c.source: <g1>Memory</g1> (on the Processes tab) is what DDM holds for itself alone, its <g2>private working set</g2>. With the window open and nothing downloading, that is about 70 MB.
9e23a915fdb4dd6c.text: <g1>内存</g1>（在“进程”选项卡中）是 DDM 独立占用的内存，即其<g2>专用工作集</g2>。在窗口打开且没有下载任务时，大约是 70 MB。

9e2414e7eb93b062.source: Windows 7's feel: glossy buttons, a glassy title bar and a glossy green progress bar.
9e2414e7eb93b062.text: Windows 7 的感觉：光泽按钮、玻璃质感标题栏和光泽绿色进度条。

9e343096f9189eb2.source: Seven downloads, each run at least seven times by both apps. The bar is the middle half of the runs, the line the median.
9e343096f9189eb2.text: 两款应用都至少运行了七次下载，每次下载七个文件。条形图表示运行时间中间一半的范围，线表示中位数。

9e59f4400e4a724b.source: <g1>The .deb and .rpm bring what DDM's window needs</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): on a system without libxkbcommon-x11 (a minimal install, a container), DDM installed from them stopped at start under X11 and XWayland, and without the CA certificates (Debian's minimal install) no download started. They now require both, and EGL for Wayland windows. They also require the glibc the programs were built against, read from the programs themselves, instead of a fixed version: a package built on a newer system no longer installs on an older one where it can't start.
9e59f4400e4a724b.text: <g1>.deb 和 .rpm 包会带来 DDM 窗口所需的一切</g1>（<g2>#164</g2>的一部分）：在没有 libxkbcommon-x11 的系统（最小安装、容器）上，从这些包安装的 DDM 在 X11 和 XWayland 下启动时会停止，并且如果没有 CA 证书（Debian 的最小安装），则无法开始下载。它们现在需要两者，以及 Wayland 窗口的 EGL。它们还需要程序构建时所依赖的 glibc，从程序本身读取，而不是固定版本：在较新系统上构建的包不再安装在无法启动的旧系统上。

9e66a9ddcc79eac6.source: <g1>Where a download's server is</g1> (<g2>#140</g2>): <g3>Download File Info</g3>, the progress window and <g4>Properties</g4> show the server's country, with its flag, and its round trip, such as <g5>about 24 ms (near)</g5>, in green, amber or red. The country comes from a table that ships with DDM (<g6>IP to Country Lite by DB-IP</g6>, CC BY 4.0, refreshed with each release), looked up on the computer: no address is sent anywhere. The time is measured from the download's own connections, with nothing extra sent. Through a proxy DDM says so instead of guessing, and a CDN's server (Cloudflare, CloudFront, Fastly, Akamai and others) is said to be the CDN's, not the site owner's. Properties keeps what the last run saw. DDM is about 770 KB larger (the table 674 KB, the flags 95 KB).
9e66a9ddcc79eac6.text: <g1>下载服务器所在地</g1>（<g2>#140</g2>）：<g3>下载文件信息</g3>、进度窗口和<g4>属性</g4>显示服务器的国家/地区及其国旗，以及其往返时间，例如<g5>约 24 毫秒（附近）</g5>，以绿色、琥珀色或红色显示。国家/地区来自 DDM 附带的表格（<g6>DB-IP 的 IP to Country Lite</g6>，CC BY 4.0，每次发布都会刷新），在计算机上查找：不会将任何地址发送到任何地方。时间是从下载自己的连接中测量的，没有额外发送任何内容。通过代理，DDM 会说明而不是猜测，CDN 的服务器（Cloudflare、CloudFront、Fastly、Akamai 等）被认为是 CDN 的，而不是网站所有者的。属性保留上次运行看到的内容。DDM 大约增加了 770 KB（表格 674 KB，国旗 95 KB）。

9e723581d21aba3f.source: <g1>Another browser built on Chromium</g1> (Helium, Thorium, ungoogled-chromium...): choose <g2>Chromium</g2> and that browser's profile folder (its <x3/> folder, or <x4/>...; under <x5/> on Linux, <x6/> on Windows). yt-dlp reads the folder, but a browser that keeps its key under its own name in the keyring, or locks its cookies as Chrome does, can't be read this way: use its extension's button.
9e723581d21aba3f.text: <g1>其他基于 Chromium 的浏览器</g1>（Helium、Thorium、ungoogled-chromium...）：选择<g2>Chromium</g2>和该浏览器的配置文件文件夹（其<x3/>文件夹，或<x4/>...；在 Linux 上位于<x5/>下，在 Windows 上位于<x6/>下）。yt-dlp 会读取该文件夹，但如果浏览器将其密钥以自己的名称保存在密钥环中，或像 Chrome 一样锁定其 Cookie，则无法通过此方式读取：请使用其扩展程序的按钮。

9e7934216466c9ae.source: <g1>The Download video button took the wrong video on YouTube</g1> (<g2>#311</g2>, thanks to <g3>@mayankmohan1992</g3>): YouTube moves from one video to the next without loading a new page, and the browser kept naming the page it first loaded, so DDM got the video watched before. On the home page, a search or a channel it got that whole page instead, and offered about 50 videos. The button now sends the video playing in the player it's on, and a Short as the Short it is.
9e7934216466c9ae.text: <g1>YouTube 上的下载视频按钮选择了错误的视频</g1>（<g2>#311</g2>，感谢 <g3>@mayankmohan1992</g3>）：YouTube 会在不加载新页面的情况下从一个视频切换到下一个视频，而浏览器会一直命名它最初加载的页面，因此 DDM 获取的是之前观看的视频。在主页、搜索或频道页面上，它会获取整个页面，并提供大约 50 个视频。现在，该按钮会发送正在播放器中播放的视频，并将短视频作为其本身。

9ebe47af30bc7593.source: Click your language above: it opens its file on GitHub, one text per row.
9ebe47af30bc7593.text: 点击上面的语言：它会在 GitHub 上打开其文件，每行一个文本。

9ec565319560694c.source: <g1>Its menu</g1> (the arrow next to it): <g2>Hide on this video</g2>, <g3>Never on</g3> the site (DDM remembers the site, without its <x4/>, so its other addresses such as <x5/> are covered too), and <g6>Button settings...</g6>, which opens DDM's Options (when DDM can't be reached, the button says so).
9ec565319560694c.text: <g1>它的菜单</g1>（旁边的箭头）：<g2>仅在此视频上隐藏</g2>；<g3>永不在此站点显示</g3>（DDM 会记住该站点，不含其 <x4/>，因此它的其他地址，如 <x5/>，也在范围内）；以及<g6>按钮设置...</g6>，会打开 DDM 的选项（无法连上 DDM 时，按钮会说明）。

9edc1024df0fd5a4.source: DDM now goes well beyond single videos: whole playlists, subtitles, sound on its own, and picture galleries.
9edc1024df0fd5a4.text: DDM 现在远不止支持单个视频：它支持整个播放列表、字幕、单独的音频和图片库。

9ee01014043d0097.source: Yes. It's open source under the GNU GPL, version 3. No trial, no paid edition, no registration key, no nag screen, no ads. <g1>More</g1>

9f19a579ecf2f645.source: If you want Internet Download Manager's layout without its price, Dannex Download Manager: it is free and open source, laid out like IDM, imports your IDM list, and also downloads torrents and videos. Free Download Manager, AB Download Manager, Motrix, Neat Download Manager, Prism, JDownloader 2, Xtreme Download Manager and Gopeed are free too, each with its own strengths.
9f19a579ecf2f645.text: 如果您想要 Internet Download Manager 的布局但又不想付费，Dannex Download Manager 是一个不错的选择：它免费且开源，界面布局与 IDM 相似，可导入您的 IDM 列表，还能下载种子和视频。Free Download Manager、AB Download Manager、Motrix、Neat Download Manager、Prism、JDownloader 2、Xtreme Download Manager 和 Gopeed 也都是免费的，各有其独特优势。

9f3336a9d7c74216.source: The grabber finds links where a browser does: links, frames, pictures (<x1/>, <x2/> and pictures loaded late from <x3/> too), videos and their posters, sounds, style sheets and the pictures and fonts in them, scripts, icons. Relative addresses, addresses from the site's root, <x4/> addresses, a <x5/>, addresses with letters beyond ASCII and redirects are followed as a browser follows them. It doesn't run the pages' scripts, so files that only a script adds to a page aren't found. A link whose address doesn't show what it is (<x6/>) is asked once: a page is explored, a file is collected under the name the server gives it. A page that doesn't answer is counted under <g7>Could not be read</g7>; <g8>Continue</g8> asks it again. Cookies the site sets while it is explored (a session, a consent) are sent back to it for the rest of the grab, and with the downloads of its files.
9f3336a9d7c74216.text: 抓取器会在浏览器查找链接的位置查找链接：链接、框架、图片（<x1/>、<x2/>，以及稍后从 <x3/> 加载的图片）、视频及其封面、声音、样式表及其中的图片和字体、脚本、图标。相对地址、从站点根目录开始的地址、<x4/> 地址、<x5/>、含有 ASCII 以外字母的地址以及重定向，都会像浏览器一样被跟随。它不会运行页面的脚本，因此仅由脚本添加到页面的文件不会被找到。对于地址无法显示其类型的链接（<x6/>），会询问一次：是页面则探索，是文件则以服务器给出的名称收集。没有响应的页面会计入<g7>无法读取</g7>；<g8>继续</g8>会再次请求它。站点在探索期间设置的 Cookie（会话、同意）会在抓取的其余过程中，以及在其文件的下载中被发回给它。

Rows marked <g5>(auto)</g5> are limits DDM learned by itself from servers that refused more connections. They can't be edited and fade away by themselves.
9f5a29570362ec91.text: <g1>例外</g1> — 为某些服务器设置不同的连接数。<g2>新建</g2>可添加一项（服务器名称和连接数）；<g3>编辑</g3>和<g4>删除</g4>可修改或移除选中的项目。标有<g5>(auto)</g5>的行表示 DDM 根据拒绝更多连接的服务器自动记录的限制。这些项目无法编辑，并会自动消失。

9f93bf61864af099.source: Plainly: everyone sharing the same torrent sees your IP address. That is how BitTorrent works, and no setting changes it. To hide it, use a VPN for the whole computer. <g1>Torrents and your security</g1> says what others can see.
9f93bf61864af099.text: 简单来说：所有共享同一种子的人都能看到您的 IP 地址。BitTorrent 的工作方式就是如此，任何设置都无法改变。要隐藏它，请为整台计算机使用 VPN。<g1>种子和您的安全</g1>说明了其他人可以看到什么。

9f9a54fc20703dc6.source: The built-in themes are <g1>Classic</g1> (DDM's own look, the default), <g2>Native</g2> (your system's accent colour and contrast), <g3>High contrast</g3>, and the style themes <g4>Metro</g4>, <g5>Adwaita</g5>, <g6>Breeze</g6>, <g7>Luna</g7>, <g8>Aero</g8>, <g9>Aqua</g9> and <g10>Emerald</g10>, each with its own control shapes and icons, and on Windows its own title bar. <g11>Getting started</g11> describes each one; the website's <g12>Themes page</g12> shows them all, light and dark.
9f9a54fc20703dc6.text: DDM 内置主题包括：<g1>经典</g1>（DDM 默认外观）、<g2>原生</g2>（使用系统强调色和对比度）、<g3>高对比度</g3>，以及样式主题 <g4>现代</g4>、<g5>Adwaita</g5>、<g6>Breeze</g6>、<g7>Luna</g7>、<g8>Aero</g8>、<g9>Aqua</g9> 和 <g10>翡翠</g10>。每个主题都有独特的控件形状、图标，在 Windows 上还有专属标题栏。<g11>入门指南</g11> 详细介绍了每个主题；网站的<g12>主题页面</g12> 展示了所有主题的亮色和暗色模式。

9fdf9558274838d9.source: Yes, built in: open a <x1/> file or paste a magnet link, tick the files you want in the folder tree, and the torrent downloads in the same list as everything else, with its peers, trackers and pieces one tab away. See <g2>Torrents</g2>.
9fdf9558274838d9.text: 可以，内置支持：打开<x1/>文件或粘贴磁力链接，在文件夹树中勾选所需文件，种子就会在与其他下载相同的列表中下载，其对等点、跟踪器和分片信息都在一个选项卡中。请参阅<g2>种子</g2>。

9ff6e4c8afc7a630.source: With <g1>Send downloads to → Dannex Download Manager on another computer</g1> in its options page (under <g2>More</g2>; off until you pair one with the code that DDM shows), the extension sends the address of each download it takes to that DDM of yours, over HTTPS, with the pairing's token; nothing else, and never to anyone else.
9ff6e4c8afc7a630.text: 在其选项页中使用<g1>将下载发送到 → 另一台计算机上的 Dannex Download Manager</g1>时（在<g2>更多</g2>下；在您用 DDM 显示的代码配对之前保持关闭），扩展会通过 HTTPS 将其接管的每个下载的地址，连同配对的令牌，发送到您自己的那个 DDM；除此之外不发送任何内容，也绝不会发送给其他任何人。

a005349660165dea.source: <g1>Palette roles.</g1> <x2/> declares each role with a stable key (<x3/>, <x4/>, <x5/>…), a description and the classic look's light and dark values, written out (the classic look isn't derived). The shared painters (<x6/>, <x7/>, <x8/>, <x9/>) read them through <x10/> and <x11/> and decide each control's states from them; no painting code holds a colour of its own.
a005349660165dea.text: <g1>调色板角色。</g1> <x2/> 声明每个角色都有一个稳定的键（<x3/>、<x4/>、<x5/>…）、一个描述以及经典外观的亮色和暗色值，明确写出（经典外观并非派生）。共享的绘图器（<x6/>、<x7/>、<x8/>、<x9/>）通过 <x10/> 和 <x11/> 读取它们，并根据它们决定每个控件的状态；没有绘图代码拥有自己的颜色。

a00eb12a0c517c21.source: <g1>Download Now</g1> adds each video as its own download and starts the main queue, which runs as many at once as you set in the <g2>Scheduler</g2> (<g3>Run N downloads at once</g3>). <g4>Later</g4> adds them without starting. Adding more than 500 at once asks first.
a00eb12a0c517c21.text: <g1>立即下载</g1>会将每个视频添加为单独的下载并启动主队列，主队列会按您在<g2>计划程序</g2>中设置的数量同时运行（<g3>同时运行 N 个下载</g3>）。<g4>稍后</g4>会添加它们但不启动。一次添加超过 500 个时会先询问。

a04886db62535b92.source: A translation longer than the English ends in <g1>...</g1> where it doesn't fit; point at it to read it whole.

a056eac99f8c7b94.source: <g1>Live speed graphs and Statistics:</g1> each progress window draws its download's speed over the last two minutes (current, average and peak), the status bar the last minute of all downloads together, and <g2>Downloads → Statistics...</g2> shows what came down today, this week, this month and in all, the last 30 days day by day, and the top sites and file types.
a056eac99f8c7b94.text: <g1>实时速度图和统计信息：</g1>每个进度窗口会绘制其下载在最近两分钟内的速度（当前、平均和峰值），状态栏绘制所有下载合计在最近一分钟内的速度，<g2>下载 → 统计信息...</g2>显示今天、本周、本月和全部时间的下载量、最近 30 天的逐日数据，以及排名靠前的站点和文件类型。

a05a0538e9ea2498.source: <g1>File Properties</g1> shows a download's type, status, size and folder, its address, your description, the page it came from (<g2>Referer</g2>), where its server is (<g3>country and round trip</g3>, as its last run saw them) and a login for the site. <g4>Last try</g4> and <g5>Result</g5> tell you how its last attempt went.
a05a0538e9ea2498.text: <g1>文件属性</g1>显示下载的类型、状态、大小和文件夹、下载地址、描述、来源页面（<g2>引用页</g2>）、服务器所在位置（<g3>国家和往返时间</g3>，根据上次运行时的信息），以及网站登录信息。<g4>上次尝试</g4>和<g5>结果</g5>会显示上次尝试的情况。
