a09cf46e49e64bbb.text: 全面检查了所有窗口，修复那些影响程序完善度的小问题：控件外观及其对鼠标和键盘操作的响应、各处的深色模式、屏幕阅读器支持，以及全面检查后发现的大量问题（问题 #7 等）。

a138862f6607942e.source: addresses (implicit TLS) don't start while an adapter is chosen; <x1/> with TLS is fine. a1c361bba9771d69.source: <g1>Downloads from a browser behind a VPN or proxy extension go through it too</g1> (<g2>#42</g2>): the browser extension passes the proxy the browser uses for a download (an extension's, or its settings' manual proxy or auto-config script) with it. DDM downloads through the same proxy while <g3>Options → Proxy / Socks → Use proxy/socks from a browser's request</g3> is on, which is the default. A proxy that needs the VPN extension's own login can't be shared: the download says so rather than going without it. It is an opt-in, off as installed: <g4>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g4> in the extension's popup. In Firefox the switch asks for the browser's <g5>proxy</g5> permission (to read the browser's proxy, never to change it). Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi can't make that permission optional, so their extension has it from the install; Chrome counts it under the access to every site the extension already has, so the update asks for nothing new. There the extension reads the browser's proxy settings: the server for the download's scheme (honouring their bypass list), or their auto-config script. Addresses on this computer (localhost, 127.0.0.1) go straight to it, as the browser sends them.
a1c361bba9771d69.text: <g1>通过 VPN 或代理扩展的浏览器下载也会通过它</g1>（<g2>#42</g2>）：浏览器扩展会将浏览器用于下载的代理（扩展的，或其设置中的手动代理或自动配置脚本）一并传递。当<g3>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 使用浏览器请求中的代理/SOCKS</g3>开启时（默认设置），DDM 会通过相同的代理下载。需要 VPN 扩展自身登录的代理无法共享：下载会提示此情况，而不是在没有代理的情况下进行。这是一个选择性加入功能，默认安装时关闭：在扩展的弹出窗口中选择<g4>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g4>。在 Firefox 中，此开关会请求浏览器的<g5>代理</g5>权限（读取浏览器的代理，绝不更改）。Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 无法使该权限成为可选，因此其扩展在安装时就拥有此权限；Chrome 将其计入扩展已拥有的对每个站点的访问权限中，因此更新不会请求任何新内容。在此，扩展会读取浏览器的代理设置：下载方案的服务器（遵守其绕过列表），或其自动配置脚本。此计算机上的地址（localhost、127.0.0.1）会直接发送，就像浏览器发送它们一样。

a21920e1fa173649.source: DDM opens 8 connections by default, and you can set anything from 1 to 32 in <g1>Options → Connection</g1>. When a connection finishes its part, it takes over half of the largest part still left, so the work is shared out again and again until the file is done. A connection that falls far behind the others is dropped and opened again.
a21920e1fa173649.text: DDM 默认开启 8 个连接，您可以在<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>中设置 1 到 32 个。当一个连接完成其部分后，它会接管剩余最大部分的一半，因此工作会不断重新分配，直到文件下载完成。如果一个连接远远落后于其他连接，它将被断开并重新连接。

If <g7>Draw with</g7> says Direct3D didn't start there, the line under it says why.
a3d9722ac9cf4e47.text: 如果冻结报告显示窗口线程在图形驱动程序内部，正在显示帧（Intel 为<x1/>或<x2/>，NVIDIA 为<x3/>，AMD 为<x4/>，在<x5/>下），则表明是驱动程序的 OpenGL 卡住，而非 DDM：在 Windows 上，选择<g6>视图 → 绘制方式 → Direct3D</g6>（默认）并重启 DDM，然后更新图形驱动程序。如果<g7>绘制方式</g7>显示 Direct3D 未在此处启动，其下方会显示原因。

a4106dfebeee68bc.source: <g1>The last languages</g1> (after #247): Options → Proxy's title takes two lines where one leaves Get System too little room (Bulgarian, Armenian, Tamil), and where it ran over the page's icon or past the window's left edge (Greek, Finnish, Catalan, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Malayalam, Serbian, Afrikaans). In Greek and Malayalam, the Scheduler's "Turn off computer when done" and its choices have shorter machine translations, so the drop-down fits beside the caption; in Belarusian, Welsh, French, Russian, Tamil and Ukrainian, the longer ones the translation review brought (such as Russian's Hibernate) are back to their earlier, shorter wording.
a4106dfebeee68bc.text: <g1>最后的语言调整</g1>（继 #247 之后）：在某些语言（保加利亚语、亚美尼亚语、泰米尔语）中，“选项”→“代理”的标题需要两行，否则“从系统获取”的空间不足；在另一些语言（希腊语、芬兰语、加泰罗尼亚语、爱沙尼亚语、拉脱维亚语、立陶宛语、马拉雅拉姆语、塞尔维亚语、南非荷兰语）中，标题会超出页面图标或窗口左边缘。在希腊语和马拉雅拉姆语中，“计划程序”的“完成后关闭计算机”及其选项的机器翻译较短，因此下拉菜单可以与标题并排显示；在白俄罗斯语、威尔士语、法语、俄语、泰米尔语和乌克兰语中，翻译审阅后较长的措辞（如俄语的“休眠”）已恢复到之前较短的措辞。

a42e12be6c4ea980.source: <g1>Windows: Download File Info and the progress window open in front of the browser</g1> (<g2>#208</g2>): a download handed over by the browser could open its window behind the browser, and stay there. Windows lets a program in the background take the foreground only with the browser's say-so, which the user's next click or key ends, and a window refused it opens under the program in front. Every dialog and progress window of DDM that opens without the foreground now goes above the other programs' windows, without taking the keyboard from the one being typed in: a click on it does, as with Download complete.
a42e12be6c4ea980.text: <g1>Windows：“下载文件信息”和进度窗口在浏览器前面打开</g1>（<g2>#208</g2>）：浏览器移交的下载任务可能会在浏览器后面打开其窗口，并停留在那里。Windows 允许后台程序在浏览器同意的情况下才能切换到前台，这会在用户下次点击或按键时结束，并且被拒绝的窗口会在前面的程序下方打开。现在，DDM 中所有在没有前台的情况下打开的对话框和进度窗口都会显示在其他程序的窗口上方，而不会从正在输入的程序中抢夺键盘焦点：点击它会抢夺焦点，就像“下载完成”一样。

a4d3460eeaa0a1e4.text: Linux：Flatpak 和 Snap 浏览器

a4d974a7cf63b1e0.source: Speed Limiter settings: Maximum download speed for one file, Always turn on Speed Limiter on startup, and Limit all downloads together to, with Only while I'm using the computer
a4d974a7cf63b1e0.text: 速度限制器设置：单个文件的最大下载速度、始终在启动时开启速度限制器，以及将所有下载总计限制为（包含仅在我使用计算机时）

a4de909b3035fa29.source: The crash data file (<x1/>) helps the developers most, but it can hold pieces of what DDM had in memory, such as addresses, cookies and saved passwords. It is attached only when you tick <g2>Also attach the crash data</g2>.
a4de909b3035fa29.text: 崩溃数据文件 (<x1/>) 对开发者帮助最大，但它可能包含 DDM 内存中的部分内容，例如地址、Cookie 和保存的密码。仅当您勾选<g2>同时附加崩溃数据</g2>时才会附加它。

a4e3bffdb438e82d.source: DDM wakes the computer a minute before the start time, so the network is back when the queue starts.
a4e3bffdb438e82d.text: DDM 会在开始时间前一分钟唤醒电脑，以便队列开始时网络已恢复。

a4ec7f409ec80484.source: The download list and settings are saved atomically to the data folder (<x1/>): <x2/> on Windows, <x3/> on Linux, <x4/> on macOS, a <x5/> folder beside a portable copy, or <x6/> (<x7/>). The browser host reads the same file for the capture rules, so a change in Options applies to the next captured download.
a4ec7f409ec80484.text: 下载列表和设置以原子方式保存到数据文件夹 (<x1/>)：Windows 上的 <x2/>，Linux 上的 <x3/>，macOS 上的 <x4/>，便携式副本旁边的 <x5/> 文件夹，或 <x6/> (<x7/>)。浏览器主机读取相同的文件以获取捕获规则，因此“选项”中的更改适用于下一个捕获的下载。

a517ce8507a2ecd5.source: <g1>Paste</g1> from other programs into any text box (Ctrl+V, ⌘V): DDM kept a clipboard of its own.
a517ce8507a2ecd5.text: 从其他程序<g1>粘贴</g1>到任何文本框（Ctrl+V，⌘V）：DDM 曾有自己的剪贴板。

a51abe62ab38892c.source: <g1>Options → File types → Take these file types from the browsers</g1> must list the file's type. The list starts with the usual ones: ZIP, RAR, 7Z, EXE, MSI, ISO, DMG, DEB, RPM, APPIMAGE, MP3, MP4, MKV, WEBM, PDF, AI models such as GGUF and SAFETENSORS, 3D files such as GLB and STL, and many more. Anything else can be added to the list.
a51abe62ab38892c.text: <g1>选项 → 文件类型 → 接管浏览器中的这些文件类型</g1>必须列出该文件的类型。列表一开始包含常见类型：ZIP、RAR、7Z、EXE、MSI、ISO、DMG、DEB、RPM、APPIMAGE、MP3、MP4、MKV、WEBM、PDF、GGUF 和 SAFETENSORS 等 AI 模型、GLB 和 STL 等 3D 文件，以及更多。其他任何类型都可以添加到列表中。

a51b37558abe6a60.source: The app talks to <g1>the servers you download from</g1>, to <g2>GitHub</g2> to check for updates when it starts (you can turn that off), and to GitHub again for <g3>yt-dlp and ffmpeg</g3> if you download videos.
a51b37558abe6a60.text: 此应用会与<g1>您下载文件的服务器</g1>通信；启动时会与<g2>GitHub</g2>通信以检查更新（您可以关闭此功能）；如果您下载视频，还会再次与GitHub通信以获取<g3>yt-dlp和ffmpeg</g3>。

a53a29b5626df6ca.source: DDM's <g1>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g1> window, which opens at each start until a browser's extension has reached DDM, walks you through the steps below. The extension comes with DDM: it is in DDM's folder, so nothing is downloaded from a store.
a53a29b5626df6ca.text: DDM 的<g1>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g1>窗口会在每次启动时打开，直到某个浏览器的扩展连上 DDM，它会带您完成下面的步骤。扩展随 DDM 一起提供：就在 DDM 的文件夹中，所以不用从商店下载任何东西。

a53baf5e058e53a2.source: Add downloads with <g1>Add URL</g1>, the clipboard (<g2>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g2>) or the drop target (<g3>Tasks → Show drop target</g3>).
a53baf5e058e53a2.text: 使用<g1>添加 URL</g1>、剪贴板（<g2>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g2>）或拖放目标（<g3>任务 → 显示拖放目标</g3>）添加下载。

a55681383fa2e5a4.source: Under <g1>Replace asterisk to</g1>, choose <g2>Numbers</g2> or <g3>Letters</g3>, then <g4>From</g4> and <g5>To</g5>.
a55681383fa2e5a4.text: 在<g1>将星号替换为</g1>下，选择<g2>数字</g2>或<g3>字母</g3>，然后选择<g4>从</g4>和<g5>到</g5>。

a55c59b0ebf8abf9.source: <g1>Set file creation date as provided by the server</g1> — give finished files the date the server reports, not the date you downloaded them.
a55c59b0ebf8abf9.text: <g1>将文件创建日期设置为服务器提供日期</g1> — 将完成文件的日期设置为服务器报告的日期，而不是您下载它们的日期。

a56cf65be39b1d95.source: <g1>Add to queue</g1> adds them to the <g2>Main download queue</g2> without starting them, as IDM's import does.
a56cf65be39b1d95.text: <g1>添加到队列</g1>会将这些链接添加到<g2>主下载队列</g2>，但不会开始下载，类似 IDM 的导入功能。

a5cb66e2ebdfd80c.source: Right-click, or the button over a video
a5cb66e2ebdfd80c.text: 右键点击，或使用视频上方的按钮

a5d84d26b1b8e85b.source: Continue a paused or broken download from the <x1/> file next to it. Through a debrid account, as <x2/>: the service gives a new link when the old one expired; <x3/> continues from the address itself.
a5d84d26b1b8e85b.text: 从同一文件夹中的 <x1/> 文件继续已暂停或中断的下载。通过网盘服务帐户继续下载时，使用 <x2/>：旧链接过期后，服务会提供新链接；<x3/> 则从原网址继续下载。

a5e6456893fd36d2.source: A crash or a freeze doesn't go unnoticed
a5e6456893fd36d2.text: 崩溃或冻结不会被忽视

a5e98fe2194f5d86.source: A calendar's day or arrow under the pointer, a drop target
a5e98fe2194f5d86.text: 鼠标指向的日历日期或箭头，拖放目标

a5fc5eedb2f59c7a.text: DDM 与 IDM 有何不同？— Dannex Download Manager

a60dbde973718833.source: The same care goes into what DDM fetches for itself. The helpers it can install for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. DDM's own updates install only files listed in a checksum list signed with DDM's release key, which every release carries.
a60dbde973718833.text: DDM 对自身获取的文件也同样谨慎。它可为视频安装的辅助工具在运行前都会经过验证：yt-dlp 会对照其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会对照其发布的校验和进行验证。DDM 自身的更新只会安装列在校验和列表中的文件，该列表由 DDM 的发布密钥签名，每个版本都包含此密钥。

a6126fa5772b9188.source: <g1>Capture downloads from the following browsers</g1> — untick a browser to leave its downloads alone.
a6126fa5772b9188.text: <g1>从以下浏览器捕获下载</g1> — 取消勾选某个浏览器，即可让其下载由浏览器自行处理。

a6155db02abd4623.source: Start DDM. The download is in the list under <g1>Unfinished</g1>.
a6155db02abd4623.text: 启动 DDM。该下载在<g1>未完成</g1>下的列表中。

a61e5239d9e7d560.source: Control Dannex Download Manager from your phone on your home network: add links and torrents, pause and start downloads, run queues. Paired devices only.
a61e5239d9e7d560.text: 在您的家庭网络上通过手机控制 Dannex Download Manager：添加链接和种子，暂停和开始下载，运行队列。仅限已配对设备。

a62887b4090e09bf.source: <g1>Downloads from forms</g1> (a button that posts and gets a file back) are posted again by DDM, with the form's data, instead of being lost. A form that sends a file (multipart) stays with the browser.
a62887b4090e09bf.text: <g1>来自表单的下载</g1>（一个提交并返回文件的按钮）会由 DDM 再次提交，并附带表单数据，而不是丢失。发送文件（multipart）的表单会留在浏览器中处理。

a62b9466b9c83c86.source: <g1>An older DDM says nothing of the store's listing</g1>: nothing is offered.
a62b9466b9c83c86.text: <g1>较旧的 DDM 不知道应用商店的收录情况</g1>：不提供任何内容。

a656f8bb2618d9d8.source: <g1>Choose columns:</g1> right-click any column title and tick the ones you want. <g2>Reset columns</g2> in the same menu puts them back as they first were.
a656f8bb2618d9d8.text: <g1>选择列：</g1>右键点击任意列标题，勾选所需的列。在同一菜单中选择<g2>重置列</g2>可恢复初始设置。

a65e3187925f9f37.source: 256 KiB file over a fast local link
a65e3187925f9f37.text: 通过快速本地链接下载 256 KiB 文件

a6ab6bd8d0321dcf.source: Once the Chrome Web Store lists the extension, DDM tells the copy loaded from its folder, which never updates itself: its right-click menu gains <g1>Get automatic updates from the Chrome Web Store...</g1> and its status and options pages say so once, with no badge and nothing opening by itself. Add the extension from the store, and this copy stands aside and offers to be removed.
a6ab6bd8d0321dcf.text: 一旦 Chrome 应用商店收录了该扩展，DDM 就会通知从其文件夹加载的副本（它自己不会更新）：其右键菜单会新增<g1>从 Chrome 应用商店获取自动更新...</g1>，其状态页和选项页会提示一次，不显示徽标，也不会自动打开任何内容。从应用商店添加该扩展后，这个副本会让路，并提示将其移除。

a6b1b297c526386b.source: <g1>That you use DDM.</g1> Peers see the name "DannexDownloadManager" and its major version, not the exact build.
a6b1b297c526386b.text: <g1>您正在使用 DDM。</g1>对等方会看到“DannexDownloadManager”这个名称及其主版本号，但看不到具体的构建版本。

a6d086a0326cc3b7.source: "Dannex Download Manager", "DDM" and the DDM logo identify this project. You may use them to refer to the project, and to name unmodified copies you distribute. If you distribute a changed version, please give it a different name and logo so people aren't confused about who made it; the GPL still applies to the code.
a6d086a0326cc3b7.text: “Dannex Download Manager”、“DDM”和 DDM 徽标标识本项目。您可以使用它们来指代本项目，并命名您分发的未修改副本。如果您分发更改版本，请为其提供不同的名称和徽标，以免人们对制作者产生混淆；GPL 仍然适用于代码。

a6f23421ac35c205.source: Look at <g1>Can resume</g1> in the progress window. <g2>No</g2> means the server can't send a file in parts, so DDM can't continue it later.
a6f23421ac35c205.text: 查看进度窗口中的<g1>支持断点续传</g1>。<g2>否</g2>表示服务器无法分块发送文件，因此 DDM 无法稍后继续它。

a716131dd46b73f4.source: Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Premiumize accounts — Dannex Download Manager
a716131dd46b73f4.text: Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 和 Premiumize 账户 — Dannex Download Manager

a7431b39fec4f131.source: How it holds: Windows binds the adapter's own address. Windows then sends those packets only through that adapter (its strong host model). Linux binds the device itself (Linux 5.7 or newer), and macOS binds the interface. An address of a kind the adapter doesn't have (IPv6 on an IPv4-only VPN) is refused, not sent around it.
a7431b39fec4f131.text: 它如何保持：Windows 绑定适配器自己的地址。然后 Windows 只通过该适配器发送这些数据包（其强主机模型）。Linux 绑定设备本身（Linux 5.7 或更高版本），macOS 绑定接口。适配器不具备的地址类型（例如仅支持 IPv4 的 VPN 上的 IPv6）将被拒绝，而不会绕过它发送。

a75047bc29174d21.source: Then click a download link, for example a ZIP or an EXE: DDM opens <g1>Download File Info</g1>. Click <g2>Start Download</g2>.
a75047bc29174d21.text: 然后点击一个下载链接，例如 ZIP 或 EXE：DDM 会打开<g1>下载文件信息</g1>。点击<g2>开始下载</g2>。

a76dca28c6aae7b3.source: Many sites publish a checksum next to a download. Paste it into DDM and it tells you in plain words whether the file you got is the one they meant.
a76dca28c6aae7b3.text: 许多网站会在下载链接旁发布校验和。将其粘贴到 DDM 中，DDM 会用简洁的语言告诉您下载的文件是否与发布者提供的文件一致。

a796d15297b81a60.source: <g1>High contrast</g1>: black and white, a bright accent, every edge drawn, text at 7:1 or more.
a796d15297b81a60.text: <g1>高对比度</g1>：黑白配色、鲜明的强调色、所有边缘均清晰显示，文本对比度至少为 7:1。

a7a3f7c6b7a38022.source: <g1>The download list's file icons</g1> were drawn over the Categories pane when the list was scrolled sideways (the Categories tree and the Scheduler had the same fault).
a7a3f7c6b7a38022.text: <g1>下载列表的文件图标</g1>在列表横向滚动时会绘制在“类别”窗格上方（“类别”树和“计划程序”也有同样的问题）。

a7a7c03fa5bb9b0f.source: <g1>Batch downloads</g1><g2>One address with an asterisk fetches a numbered series; a text file of links adds them all.</g2>
a7a7c03fa5bb9b0f.text: <g1>批量下载</g1><g2>一个带星号的地址可抓取一系列编号文件；一个包含链接的文本文件可添加所有链接。</g2>

a7c07115ddb8e577.source: One asterisk in the address, then numbers or letters from–to.
a7c07115ddb8e577.text: 地址中一个星号，然后是数字或字母的范围。

a7dc55fb9245b4ab.source: Browser downloads are no longer taken when the extension may not read the site (its access set to <g1>On click</g1>): without the site's cookies they would fail.
a7dc55fb9245b4ab.text: 当扩展程序可能无法读取网站时（其访问权限设置为<g1>点击时</g1>），不再接管浏览器下载：没有网站的 Cookie 它们会失败。

a7ea2a3f9b907213.source: The browser started DDM's helper, but it stopped before answering. Security software is the usual cause.
a7ea2a3f9b907213.text: 浏览器启动了 DDM 的辅助程序，但辅助程序在响应之前就停止了。常见原因是安全软件。

a7ff2198d4ac5a4a.source: <g1>Menus open where they belong</g1>: in a Wayland session they opened in the middle of the screen (<g2>#50</g2>), as Wayland lets no program place its windows, and DDM's menus and drop-down lists are windows it places; DDM now runs through XWayland when it is there (<x3/> keeps Wayland). Under tiling compositors such as sway (<g4>#267</g4>), through XWayland, the menu bar's menus, their submenus, the right-click menus and the drop-down lists still opened in the middle of the screen, as the compositor placed them like windows. They are now menu windows no window manager places, as X11 menus are, so they open where DDM puts them, on every window manager.
a7ff2198d4ac5a4a.text: <g1>菜单在其应有的位置打开</g1>：在 Wayland 会话中，它们会在屏幕中央打开 (<g2>#50</g2>)，因为 Wayland 不允许程序放置其窗口，而 DDM 的菜单和下拉列表是它放置的窗口；DDM 现在在存在 XWayland 时通过 XWayland 运行 (<x3/> 保持 Wayland)。在平铺合成器（如 sway (<g4>#267</g4>)）下，通过 XWayland，菜单栏的菜单、其子菜单、右键菜单和下拉列表仍然在屏幕中央打开，因为合成器将它们视为窗口。现在它们是窗口管理器不放置的菜单窗口，就像 X11 菜单一样，因此它们会在 DDM 放置它们的位置打开，在所有窗口管理器上都是如此。

a80cb83be49f9624.source: A small script in every page notes only the links you click while holding <g1>Alt</g1>, so those downloads stay with the browser; the addresses are kept in memory for a few seconds.
a80cb83be49f9624.text: 每个页面中的小脚本只记录您按住 <g1>Alt</g1> 键时点击的链接，这样这些下载就会留在浏览器中；地址会在内存中保存几秒钟。

a821d1fc5827d57f.source: Grid lines between a list's rows in dialogs
a821d1fc5827d57f.text: 对话框中列表行之间的网格线

a82e6c5273111ce9.source: <g1>Download limits</g1> — at most a set amount in any few hours. The same setting is in the Scheduler; see <g2>Queues and the Scheduler</g2>.
a82e6c5273111ce9.text: <g1>下载限制</g1> — 在任意若干小时内最多下载设定的量。计划程序中也有相同的设置；请参阅<g2>队列和计划程序</g2>。

a83900c5aca20461.source: Download File Info in DDM for a file clicked in the browser
a83900c5aca20461.text: 在浏览器中点击文件后，DDM 中的“下载文件信息”

a839d0f1595e9f40.source: <g1>Resume</g1>, <g2>Stop</g2>, <g3>Remove</g3> and the queue commands then act on all the selected downloads. The other commands need one download. The full list of keys is in <g4>Keyboard shortcuts</g4>.
a839d0f1595e9f40.text: <g1>恢复</g1>、<g2>停止</g2>、<g3>删除</g3>和队列命令会对所有选中的下载执行。其他命令只能对单个下载执行。完整的按键列表请参阅<g4>键盘快捷方式</g4>。

a83f4efc25f8e42e.text: DDM 由其贡献者在 GitHub 上开发，基于 Ahmed Nefzaoui 的 Mister Download Manager 代码，欢迎任何人参与贡献。欢迎提交问题报告…

a84e33bb5d1bc55c.text: <g1>命令行指南</g1>列出了<x2/>接受的所有参数。

a856aa8d56dfc9ae.source: <g1>Dark mode: grey notes and error texts are easier to read</g1> (<g2>#45</g2>): they now have the contrast WCAG asks for (4.5:1) on every dark surface, Options' failed checks no longer use light mode's dark red on the dark dialog, and an editable drop-down's arrow is tinted dark under the pointer.
a856aa8d56dfc9ae.text: <g1>深色模式：灰色注释和错误文本更易阅读</g1>（<g2>#45</g2>）：它们现在在所有深色背景上都具有 WCAG 要求的对比度（4.5:1），“选项”中失败的检查不再在深色对话框上使用浅色模式的深红色，并且可编辑下拉菜单的箭头在指针悬停时会显示深色。

a8737cae2a471da9.source: <g1>Dark Mode support follows the desktop, on every desktop</g1> (<g2>#156</g2>): <g3>View → Dark Mode support</g3> did nothing on Linux: DDM asked the window system for the desktop's light or dark setting, and X11 never says. It now asks the desktop itself (the freedesktop portal, which KDE, GNOME, Cinnamon and most others answer) and follows it as it changes. Where the portal doesn't answer, as on XFCE and MATE, DDM stayed light under a dark theme: it now reads the theme the desktop gives its programs (a name such as Adwaita-dark, Mint-Y-Dark or Greybird-dark is dark), GNOME's own dark style setting when there is no portal, and GTK's settings with no desktop at all, and follows changes as they happen. The portal still comes first. A change now shows at once too: the window waited for its next theme check, up to 20 s on a busy machine, on every desktop.
a8737cae2a471da9.text: <g1>深色模式支持在所有桌面上都遵循桌面设置</g1> (<g2>#156</g2>)：<g3>视图 → 深色模式支持</g3> 在 Linux 上不起作用：DDM 向窗口系统查询桌面的浅色或深色设置，而 X11 从不提供。现在它会向桌面本身查询（freedesktop 门户，KDE、GNOME、Cinnamon 和大多数其他桌面都会响应）并随其变化。在门户不响应的情况下，例如在 XFCE 和 MATE 上，DDM 在深色主题下仍保持浅色：现在它会读取桌面为其程序提供的主题（例如 Adwaita-dark、Mint-Y-Dark 或 Greybird-dark 等名称表示深色），在没有门户时读取 GNOME 自己的深色样式设置，以及在完全没有桌面时读取 GTK 的设置，并随变化而变化。门户仍然优先。现在变化也会立即显示：之前窗口会等待下一次主题检查，在繁忙的机器上可能长达 20 秒，在所有桌面上都是如此。

a87ed045cf6b81cd.source: <g1>The time</g1> is measured from the download's own connections, as each one opens: DDM sends nothing extra to the server. It is an estimate (the time to open a connection, divided by its round trips: one for http, two for https), so it says <g2>about</g2>. The quickest connection counts.
a87ed045cf6b81cd.text: <g1>时间</g1>是从下载自身的连接中测量的，每个连接打开时都会测量：DDM 不会向服务器发送任何额外数据。这是一个估算值（打开连接所需的时间，除以其往返次数：HTTP 为一次，HTTPS 为两次），因此显示<g2>约</g2>。最快的连接会被计算在内。

a88c571fc7066917.source: With the DDM extension, clicking a download link in your browser hands the download to DDM. DDM gets the address together with the page it came from (the referrer), your cookies for the site and the browser's User-Agent, so downloads that need you to be signed in still work. It also gets the address the browser's own download had reached: when a site refuses DDM the link itself (a one-time link the browser has already used, or a site that lets only browsers ask for its links), DDM goes on from there once, without your cookies if it is another site. When a site's bot check (Cloudflare's, for one) or its refusal of programs (FileHippo's <g1>412 Precondition Failed</g1>) turns DDM's own connection away, DDM asks once more connecting the way your browser does (the same handshake, settings and order of headers), with your browser's User-Agent and its cookies for that site only, and downloads on that one connection; your proxy, network adapter and speed limits apply as usual. It solves no challenge: a site that still wants one answered refuses again, and DDM says <g2>this site lets only browsers through</g2>; Alt+click the link to leave the download to the browser.
a88c571fc7066917.text: 安装 DDM 扩展后，在浏览器中点击下载链接即可将下载任务交给 DDM。DDM 会获取下载地址、来源页面（referrer）、您在该网站的 cookie 和浏览器的 User-Agent，因此需要登录才能下载的任务也能正常工作。它还会获取浏览器自身下载已达到的地址：当网站拒绝 DDM 直接获取链接时（浏览器已使用过的一次性链接，或只允许浏览器请求其链接的网站），DDM 会在此基础上继续一次，如果目标是另一个网站则不带您的 cookie。当网站的机器人检查（例如 Cloudflare）或其拒绝程序（FileHippo 的 <g1>412 Precondition Failed</g1>）拒绝 DDM 自己的连接时，DDM 会再次尝试以浏览器的方式连接（相同的握手、设置和请求头顺序），并仅使用您浏览器的 User-Agent 和该网站的 cookie，在此连接上进行下载；您的代理、网络适配器和速度限制照常适用。它无法解决挑战：如果网站仍要求回答挑战，它会再次拒绝，DDM 会提示<g2>此网站只允许浏览器通过</g2>；此时请 Alt+点击链接，将下载任务留给浏览器处理。

aebbc00d2c0bae9e.source: If <g1>Resume capability</g1> is <g2>No</g2>, the server can't send a file in parts. DDM then downloads it over one connection, and a download that stops has to start over.

aebece9c4f2b1a7f.source: DDM itself still sends nothing anywhere: the server talks only to the DDM on this computer, over the token-protected local channel. But what the assistant reads, it passes to its own AI service: when it lists your downloads, their file names, addresses and folders go to that service, under that service's privacy terms. Turn the automation API off, or remove the server from the assistant, when you don't want that.
aebece9c4f2b1a7f.text: DDM 本身仍不会向任何地方发送数据：服务器仅通过受令牌保护的本地通道与此计算机上的 DDM 通信。但助手读取的数据会传递给其自身的 AI 服务：列出下载内容时，下载的文件名、地址和文件夹会发送给该服务，并受该服务隐私条款的约束。如果不希望这样，请关闭自动化 API，或从助手中移除服务器。

aee59a6a5bc87cf9.source: <g1>A stream sent in many small pieces</g1> (HLS, DASH, as most sites other than YouTube send theirs) comes down that many pieces at once, each kept on disk as it arrives, then joined in order into one file, as yt-dlp joins them. Pieces encrypted with AES-128 are decrypted with the key the stream's playlist names. When their addresses expire, DDM asks yt-dlp for the stream's new list and carries on with the pieces still missing.
aee59a6a5bc87cf9.text: <g1>以许多小分块发送的流</g1>（HLS、DASH，大多数网站（YouTube 除外）都采用这种方式）会同时下载许多分块，每个分块在到达时都保存在磁盘上，然后按顺序合并成一个文件，就像 yt-dlp 合并它们一样。用 AES-128 加密的分块会用流播放列表指定的密钥解密。当它们的地址过期时，DDM 会向 yt-dlp 请求流的新列表，并继续下载仍缺失的分块。

aeea31ff4889dbde.source: <g1>Address</g1> (Add URL) and <g2>Save As</g2> (Download File Info) list the last 20 addresses and folders from their arrows; <g3>...</g3> beside Save As chooses a folder, <g4>+</g4> beside Category makes one.
aeea31ff4889dbde.text: <g1>地址</g1>（添加 URL）和<g2>另存为</g2>（下载文件信息）通过箭头列出最近 20 个地址和文件夹；“另存为”旁边的<g3>...</g3>用于选择文件夹，“类别”旁边的<g4>+</g4>用于创建文件夹。

aeebdabfd4045b05.source: <g1>Emerald</g1>: a white canvas with one near-black ink and a ladder of neutral greys for structure, emerald fills that always carry near-black text rather than white, 6-point corners on every control, and Metro's one-colour icons.
aeebdabfd4045b05.text: <g1>翡翠</g1>：白色画布，搭配近乎黑色的墨水和一系列中性灰色调以构建结构，翡翠色填充总是承载近乎黑色的文本而非白色，所有控件均采用 6 点圆角，以及现代风格的单色图标。

af120dadcfcb2b46.source: The extension now reaches DDM from Ubuntu's Snap Firefox and from Brave Origin.
af120dadcfcb2b46.text: 现在，扩展程序可以从 Ubuntu 的 Snap Firefox 和 Brave Origin 浏览器中连接到 DDM。

af13220c8027da8d.source: <g1>Paired devices</g1> — <g2>Pair a device...</g2> shows a QR code and a code; <g3>Remove</g3> unpairs the device selected, at once.
af13220c8027da8d.text: <g1>已配对设备</g1> — <g2>配对设备...</g2>显示一个二维码和一个代码；<g3>删除</g3>立即取消配对所选设备。

af31ce31cba24f64.source: In the browser extension's menu, <g1>Send downloads to → Another Dannex Download Manager (a server)</g1>: type the server's address, open it once in that browser to accept its certificate, then enter a pairing code (<x2/> above). Downloads the extension catches, and <g3>Download with DDM</g3> on a link, then go to the server instead of this computer. The browser's cookies are not sent to the server: a download that needs you to be signed in to a site stays with this computer.
af31ce31cba24f64.text: 在浏览器扩展程序的菜单中，选择<g1>将下载发送到 → 另一个 Dannex Download Manager（服务器）</g1>：输入服务器地址，在该浏览器中打开一次以接受其证书，然后输入配对码（如<x2/>所示）。扩展程序捕获的下载，以及链接上的<g3>使用 DDM 下载</g3>，将发送到服务器而不是此电脑。浏览器的 Cookie 不会发送到服务器：需要您登录网站的下载仍将在此电脑上进行。

af5a7a426e59a8df.source: <g1>Never take downloads from</g1> the current site: adds it to DDM's excluded sites.
af5a7a426e59a8df.text: <g1>从不接管来自</g1> 当前网站的下载：将其添加到 DDM 的排除网站列表。

af7c7d57134afbc1.source: DDM ships no list of hosts or links; the service says which hosts it supports.
af7c7d57134afbc1.text: DDM 不附带主机或链接列表；服务会说明它支持哪些主机。

af83c70c1ca46aae.source: Options on its Connection page, on Linux
af83c70c1ca46aae.text: Linux 上“选项”的“连接”页面

af8c653066cc3fda.source: Queue it today. Download it tonight.
af8c653066cc3fda.text: 今天加入队列，今晚下载。

afaa46159bead1bd.source: Some servers drop the connection when the speed is very low. Don't set a tight limit for a server that can't resume (<g1>Can resume: No</g1> in the progress window).
afaa46159bead1bd.text: 当速度很低时，有些服务器会断开连接。对于不支持断点续传的服务器（进度窗口中为<g1>支持断点续传：否</g1>），请不要设置过严的限制。

afd30b395bede669.source: Dannex Download Manager downloads torrents and magnet links: choose the files, see peers, trackers and pieces, and queue them with your other downloads.
afd30b395bede669.text: Dannex Download Manager 下载种子和磁力链接：选择文件，查看对等点、跟踪器和分块，并将其与其他下载任务一起排队。

afe68f77f7c77895.source: On a finished download, double-click (or <g1>Enter</g1>) shows its <g2>Properties</g2>. To open the file instead, right-click any download and choose <g3>On Double click → Open</g3>.
afe68f77f7c77895.text: 在已完成的下载上，双击（或按 <g1>Enter</g1>）会显示其<g2>属性</g2>。若想改为打开文件，请右键点击任意下载并选择<g3>双击时 → 打开</g3>。

b0312b0d92b43a05.source: <g1>Leave these addresses to the browser → Edit list...</g1> — addresses whose downloads stay in the browser, one per line; <x2/> stands for any text (<x3/>).
b0312b0d92b43a05.text: <g1>将这些地址留给浏览器 → 编辑列表...</g1> — 其下载留在浏览器中的地址，每行一个；<x2/> 代表任意文本（<x3/>）。

b0442a90b7202b80.source: Yes. Copy a link to a file and DDM offers to download it at once (Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard, on by default). You can also paste links into Add URL, drag them onto the drop target, add a whole batch, or use the command line. See Adding downloads.
b0442a90b7202b80.text: 可以。复制文件链接后，DDM 会立即询问是否下载（选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接，默认开启）。您也可以将链接粘贴到“添加 URL”中，拖到投放区域，批量添加，或使用命令行。请参阅“添加下载”。

b04ebaded7d53aa1.source: <g1>Your proxy</g1>, if you set one in <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks</g2>, and your network's proxy auto-config script, if you point DDM at one.
b04ebaded7d53aa1.text: <g1>您的代理</g1>，如果您在<g2>选项 → 代理/Socks</g2>中设置了代理，以及您网络的代理自动配置脚本，如果您将 DDM 指向其中一个。

b05472801cf663cd.source: <g1>Run [N] downloads at once</g1> — how many of the queue's downloads run together. The rest wait their turn.
b05472801cf663cd.text: <g1>同时运行 [N] 个下载</g1> — 队列中同时运行多少个下载。其余的按顺序等待。

b05f1388075b4b26.source: The Scheduler's choices for when the queue is done, Turn off computer when done among them
b05f1388075b4b26.text: “计划程序”中队列完成后的选项，其中包括“完成后关闭计算机”

b0661d044f93a1d2.source: <g1>Ask for the queue after a batch download</g1> — the same for batch downloads.
b0661d044f93a1d2.text: <g1>批量下载后询问加入哪个队列</g1> — 对批量下载同样如此。

b0b1def70a245732.source: With no tray icon to come back from, closing or minimizing the main window now leaves it in the taskbar, with downloads still going, instead of hiding it with no way back. <g1>Options → General → Keep running when closing the window</g1> (on by default) makes closing quit DDM when unticked (<g2>#457</g2>).
b0b1def70a245732.text: 现在，关闭或最小化主窗口时，它会留在任务栏中，下载仍在进行，而不是隐藏起来无法返回，因为不再有托盘图标可供恢复。<g1>选项 → 常规 → 关闭窗口时保持运行</g1>（默认开启）在取消勾选时会使关闭操作退出 DDM（<g2>#457</g2>）。

b0b228d70e708747.source: Install DDM with its setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration</g1> ticked. Then add the extension: Firefox 140 or later takes it from addons.mozilla.org, and Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi from the Chrome Web Store. The browser keeps it updated.
b0b228d70e708747.text: 安装 DDM 时，请勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成</g1>。然后添加扩展程序：Firefox 140 或更高版本从 addons.mozilla.org 获取，Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 从 Chrome 网上应用店获取。浏览器会保持其更新。

b0c0ef4ee0008226.source: — FTP secured with TLS from the start of the session (explicit FTPS, <x1/>, usually port 21). Use it when the server says it supports TLS.
b0c0ef4ee0008226.text: — 在会话开始时使用 TLS 加密的 FTP（显式 FTPS，<x1/>，通常使用端口 21）。服务器表示支持 TLS 时，请使用此方式。

b0c69399ed328758.source: <g1>Claude Desktop</g1>: <g2>Settings → Developer → Edit Config</g2> opens <x3/>. Add the server, then restart Claude Desktop:
b0c69399ed328758.text: <g1>Claude Desktop</g1>：<g2>设置 → 开发者 → 编辑配置</g2>会打开<x3/>。添加服务器，然后重启 Claude Desktop：

b0d3cd22152eff0f.source: Installed or the plain zip: <x1/>. The list and settings are in <x2/>.
b0d3cd22152eff0f.text: 已安装版或普通 zip 版：<x1/>。列表和设置位于<x2/>中。

b0e15d7e6fb068ef.source: The right-click menu has everything you can do with a download: <g1>Open</g1>, <g2>Open with...</g2>, <g3>Open folder</g3>, <g4>Move/Rename</g4>, <g5>Redownload</g5>, <g6>Resume Download</g6>, <g7>Stop Download</g7>, <g8>Refresh download address</g8>, <g9>Verify checksum...</g9>, <g10>Remove</g10>, <g11>Add to queue</g11> and <g12>Properties</g12>. A download a site's bot check turned away also has <g13>Download with the browser</g13> (<g14>Browser integration</g14>).
b0e15d7e6fb068ef.text: 右键菜单包含您可对下载执行的全部操作：<g1>打开</g1>、<g2>打开方式...</g2>、<g3>打开文件夹</g3>、<g4>移动/重命名</g4>、<g5>重新下载</g5>、<g6>恢复下载</g6>、<g7>停止下载</g7>、<g8>刷新下载地址</g8>、<g9>验证校验和...</g9>、<g10>删除</g10>、<g11>添加到队列</g11>和<g12>属性</g12>。被站点机器人检查拒绝的下载还有<g13>使用浏览器下载</g13>（<g14>浏览器集成</g14>）。

b0ee9b152e4c0ce7.source: marks the keyboard letter of a menu item or button. Keep one <x1/> before a letter of your translation.
b0ee9b152e4c0ce7.text: 表示菜单项或按钮的键盘快捷键字母。在译文的一个字母前保留一个<x1/>。

b0f4072ded4a18b1.source: Move from Internet Download Manager to Dannex Download Manager: import an IDM export file (.ef2) or a text list of links, with referrers and cookies.
b0f4072ded4a18b1.text: 从 Internet Download Manager 切换到 Dannex Download Manager：导入 IDM 导出文件 (.ef2) 或包含来源和 Cookie 的文本链接列表。

b119279300fe5cc6.source: <g1>DNS</g1> — which DNS turns the servers' names into addresses for DDM's downloads, its own downloads (helpers, updates) and FTP. <g2>The system's DNS</g2> is the default (on Windows 11 it can already be encrypted, in Windows' own network settings). Or pick <g3>Cloudflare</g3>, <g4>Google</g4>, <g5>Quad9</g5>, <g6>AdGuard</g6> or <g7>NextDNS</g7>, or <g8>Another DNS...</g8> to type your own; <g9>Settings...</g9> chooses how it's asked:
b119279300fe5cc6.text: <g1>DNS</g1> — 选择用于将服务器名称转换为地址的 DNS，适用于 DDM 的下载、DDM 自身的下载（辅助程序、更新）和 FTP。默认使用<g2>系统的 DNS</g2>（在 Windows 11 中，系统 DNS 可能已在 Windows 自带的网络设置中加密）。也可以选择 <g3>Cloudflare</g3>、<g4>Google</g4>、<g5>Quad9</g5>、<g6>AdGuard</g6> 或 <g7>NextDNS</g7>，也可以选择<g8>其他 DNS...</g8>并输入自己的 DNS；<g9>设置...</g9>可选择查询方式：

b1286285f8338dd7.source: Make a <x1/> of a file or folder (peers find it through the DHT).
b1286285f8338dd7.text: 为文件或文件夹创建 <x1/>（对等方通过 DHT 找到它）。

b132b005cfa29649.source: Can I limit the download speed?
b132b005cfa29649.text: 我可以限制下载速度吗？

b14b4a114ab58052.source: The line under the menu bar

b156c3515d1ed58b.source: Up to 32, re-split as they go
b156c3515d1ed58b.text: 最多 32 个，下载过程中会重新分配

b1618ed2436f6ef8.source: Don't make DDM reachable from the internet (a router's port forwarding): the remote control is made for your home network. To reach it while away, use a VPN to your home network instead (WireGuard, Tailscale): with Tailscale, choose its address in <g1>Listen on</g1>.
b1618ed2436f6ef8.text: 不要让 DDM 可以从互联网访问（路由器的端口转发）：远程控制是为您的家庭网络设计的。要在外出时访问它，请使用 VPN 连接到您的家庭网络（WireGuard、Tailscale）：使用 Tailscale 时，请在<g1>监听</g1>中选择其地址。

b1627f2f79cc28d7.source: The View menu open, with Dark Mode support and Always dark
b1627f2f79cc28d7.text: “视图”菜单已打开，带有“深色模式支持”和“始终为深色”选项

b169aed28375c4bf.source: Website: a page for every feature, a Themes gallery, and a hall of fame.
b169aed28375c4bf.text: 网站：每个功能都有一个页面，一个主题画廊，以及一个名人堂。

b178f01dccda074e.source: What Dannex Download Manager, its browser extension and this website do with your data: the app and extension collect nothing; the website counts visits with Statcounter.
b178f01dccda074e.text: Dannex Download Manager、其浏览器扩展程序和本网站如何处理您的数据：应用和扩展程序不收集任何数据；网站使用 Statcounter 统计访问量。

b17ac026b2d6bb9c.source: DDM follows your system: when Windows (or your desktop's light/dark preference on Linux and macOS) is set to dark mode, so is DDM. To keep DDM light whatever the system does, turn off <g1>View → Dark Mode support</g1>. To keep it dark whatever the system does, for example on a desktop that reports no preference, turn on <g2>View → Always dark</g2>.
b17ac026b2d6bb9c.text: DDM 会跟随系统设置：当 Windows（或 Linux 和 macOS 上桌面环境的浅色/深色偏好设置）设为深色模式时，DDM 也会使用深色模式。要让 DDM 不受系统设置影响，始终保持浅色，请关闭<g1>视图 → 深色模式支持</g1>。要让 DDM 不受系统设置影响，始终保持深色（例如，桌面环境未报告偏好设置时），请开启<g2>视图 → 始终为深色</g2>。

b18e946821cdb2ff.source: Put the file in DDM's themes folder. <g1>View → Theme → Open themes folder</g1> opens it, and makes it the first time. It is in DDM's data folder:
b18e946821cdb2ff.text: 将文件放入 DDM 的主题文件夹。<g1>视图 → 主题 → 打开主题文件夹</g1> 可打开该文件夹，并首次创建它。它位于 DDM 的数据文件夹中：

b198592bcc534043.source: When an address is already in the list, DDM asks what to do, or follows the answer you chose in <g1>Options → Downloads → When an address is already in the list</g1>.
b198592bcc534043.text: 当地址已在列表中时，DDM 会询问如何处理，或按您在<g1>选项 → 下载 → 当地址已在列表中时</g1>中选择的方式处理。

b1b2249661e1c4a9.source: Keep changes focused and match the code around them. A few rules hold everywhere:
b1b2249661e1c4a9.text: 更改应聚焦于具体问题，并与周围的代码风格保持一致。以下规则适用于所有地方：

b1cfb9dac9c38d80.source: Then yt-dlp does what it does after a download: it joins the video and its sound with ffmpeg into one MP4, saves or embeds the subtitles, and converts the sound for an MP3, Opus or FLAC choice.
b1cfb9dac9c38d80.text: 然后 yt-dlp 会在下载完成后执行其操作：它会使用 ffmpeg 将视频和音频合并为一个 MP4 文件，保存或嵌入字幕，并为 MP3、Opus 或 FLAC 选项转换音频。

b1d90b3e9d2a1cd5.source: runs unit tests and end-to-end downloads against <x1/> with injected faults (slow, dropped and refused connections, servers without ranges, changing files). <x2/> runs the published speed comparison; its raw data is in <x3/>.
b1d90b3e9d2a1cd5.text: 针对注入故障（慢速、丢弃和拒绝连接、无范围服务器、文件更改）的 <x1/> 运行单元测试和端到端下载。<x2/> 运行已发布的速度比较；其原始数据在 <x3/> 中。

b1eff07328e8e48f.source: Pieces of a stream (its segments) are never listed. A copy-protected stream (DRM: Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay, as most paid streaming services use) is listed as <g1>Protected</g1>, with no <g2>Download</g2> button: no tool may break that protection, and DDM doesn't try.
b1eff07328e8e48f.text: 流媒体的分块（片段）不会列出。受版权保护的流媒体（DRM：Widevine、PlayReady、FairPlay；大多数付费流媒体服务都使用这些技术）会标记为<g1>受保护</g1>，且不提供<g2>下载</g2>按钮：任何工具都不能绕过这种保护，DDM 也不会尝试。

b1f35176aca676c5.source: While the queue runs, the computer doesn't go to sleep. When the queue is done, the computer's own sleep settings apply again: a computer nobody is using goes back to sleep by itself. <g1>Turn off computer when done → Sleep</g1> sends it back to sleep at once.
b1f35176aca676c5.text: 队列运行时，电脑不会进入睡眠状态。队列完成后，电脑自身的睡眠设置将再次生效：无人使用的电脑会自行进入睡眠状态。<g1>完成后关闭计算机 → 睡眠</g1>会立即让电脑进入睡眠状态。

b208caa24e13c211.source: <g1>Shift+Up / Shift+Down</g1> makes the selection longer or shorter.
b208caa24e13c211.text: 按 <g1>Shift+Up / Shift+Down</g1> 可扩大或缩小选择范围。

b2181eccf65e86be.source: This <g1>website</g1> counts visits with <g2>Statcounter</g2>, which sets a cookie and sees your IP address; it runs only on the website, never in the app.
b2181eccf65e86be.text: 本<g1>网站</g1>使用<g2>Statcounter</g2>统计访问量，它会设置一个 cookie 并查看您的 IP 地址；它只在网站上运行，绝不会在应用中运行。

b21d10b675161104.source: DDM makes the folder when the first file goes there; it never asks about it.
b21d10b675161104.text: DDM 会在第一个文件保存到那里时创建文件夹；从不就此询问。

b23e4d23398b2d6f.source: Made possible by these amazing humans: everyone who sent a pull request, opened an issue or joined a conversation on GitHub. Thank you, every one of you.
b23e4d23398b2d6f.text: 感谢这些杰出人士的贡献：每一位在 GitHub 上提交拉取请求、提出问题或参与讨论的朋友。衷心感谢你们每一个人。

b23e9f6d4d6a6718.source: Browser integration needs one more step in each browser: adding the extension. In Firefox, click <g1>Add to Firefox</g1> on <g2>its page on addons.mozilla.org</g2>; in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, <g3>Add to Chrome</g3> on <g4>its page in the Chrome Web Store</g4>. <g5>Browser integration</g5> shows how.
b23e9f6d4d6a6718.text: 浏览器集成在每个浏览器中都需要多一步：添加扩展。在 Firefox 中，点击 <g2>addons.mozilla.org 上的页面</g2>中的<g1>添加到 Firefox</g1>；在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中，点击 <g4>Chrome 网上应用店中的页面</g4>中的<g3>添加到 Chrome</g3>。<g5>浏览器集成</g5>会展示具体操作。

b252636433b25eae.source: <g1>Numbers</g1> (counts, sizes, speeds, percentages and the list's columns) are written the way the interface language writes them, whatever the Windows region: German <x2/> and <x3/>, French <x4/>, Hindi <x5/>. When your system's region is in that same language, its own way wins (Swiss German <x6/>, or a separator you set in Windows). In English, DDM writes plain digits, as IDM does (<x7/>, <x8/>).
b252636433b25eae.text: <g1>数字</g1>（计数、大小、速度、百分比和列表列）的显示方式与界面语言的写法一致，无论 Windows 区域设置如何：德语 <x2/> 和 <x3/>，法语 <x4/>，印地语 <x5/>。当您的系统区域设置与该语言相同时，系统自己的方式优先（瑞士德语 <x6/>，或您在 Windows 中设置的分隔符）。在英语中，DDM 使用纯数字，与 IDM 相同（<x7/>，<x8/>）。

b258d94cbafaa2d0.source: <g1>Use a configuration script</g1> — the proxy auto-config (PAC) script your network gives: type its address (<x2/>, or a file). DDM fetches it and asks it which proxy each download goes through (<x3/>, <x4/> or <x5/>), as browsers do. Until it has been fetched, or if it can't be, DDM uses the system's settings.
b258d94cbafaa2d0.text: <g1>使用配置脚本</g1> — 您的网络提供的代理自动配置 (PAC) 脚本：输入其地址（<x2/>，或文件）。DDM 会获取它，并像浏览器一样询问每个下载该走哪个代理（<x3/>、<x4/> 或 <x5/>）。在获取完成之前，或获取失败时，DDM 会使用系统设置。

b3b2d01c08877810.source: Both are set in <g1>Options → General → Keys...</g1>: each can be <g2>None</g2>, Alt, Ctrl, Shift, or two or three of them together, and the two must differ. They count exactly as held: with Alt chosen, an Alt+Shift click is an ordinary one. Ctrl+Alt is the default for forcing because nobody makes that click for anything else: a browser opens a tab for Ctrl, a window for Shift and downloads for Alt, and on Windows Alt+Shift switches the keyboard layout. A key chosen to leave links to the browser keeps the browser's own meaning (Shift still opens a new window, which downloads the link); a key chosen to force a link replaces it. On a Mac, Ctrl in Options is the Command key (⌘), since a Control-click opens the right-click menu there: Command+Option forces a link. A change applies once the browser has asked DDM again, which it does when you switch back to it. The <g3>Keys...</g3> window also holds <g4>Also take files the browser would open</g4>.
b3b2d01c08877810.text: 两者都在<g1>选项 → 常规 → 按键...</g1>中设置：每个都可以是<g2>无</g2>、Alt、Ctrl、Shift，或其中两个或三个组合，且两者必须不同。它们按实际按住的键精确计算：选择 Alt 时，Alt+Shift 单击就是普通单击。默认用 Ctrl+Alt 来强制，因为没有人会为别的用途做这个单击：浏览器用 Ctrl 打开标签页，用 Shift 打开窗口，用 Alt 下载，而在 Windows 上 Alt+Shift 会切换键盘布局。选择用来将链接留给浏览器的按键保留浏览器自己的含义（Shift 仍会打开新窗口，从而下载该链接）；选择用来强制处理链接的按键则会替换其含义。在 Mac 上，选项中的 Ctrl 是 Command 键 (⌘)，因为 Control 单击会打开右键菜单：Command+Option 可强制处理链接。更改在浏览器再次询问 DDM 后生效，切换回浏览器时就会这样做。<g3>按键...</g3>窗口中还有<g4>同时接管浏览器本会打开的文件</g4>。

b4559949c9cdafe0.source: Each connection writes directly into the file's place on disk, in a part file next to the final one. There is no temporary folder and no joining step at the end: when the last part arrives, DDM checks the size and renames the file.
b4559949c9cdafe0.text: 每个连接直接写入磁盘上文件所在的位置，写入最终文件旁边的部分文件。没有临时文件夹，也没有最后的合并步骤：当最后一个部分到达时，DDM 会检查大小并重命名文件。

b45cf41d19dc2fdc.source: The AppImage can also be updated by AppImage tools (AppImageLauncher, Gear Lever, AppImageUpdate): it carries the address of its updates, and each release has its <x1/> file, so those tools download only the parts that changed. This starts with the AppImage of the version after 0.2.4.

b46f093f1aea3d25.source: <g1>Download video offering only the sound, with no reason given</g1> (<g2>#351</g2>): when a page's better videos need ffmpeg and it isn't installed, the window now says so.

b4ac60c82f87352c.source: DDM reads the torrent and shows its files as a folder tree. A <x1/> file is read at once. A magnet link first has to get the file list from other peers, usually within seconds. While it waits, <g2>Add torrent</g2> shows how many peers it found, from the trackers, the DHT or your local network, and how many answered. After 30 seconds without the file list, it says what may be in the way: a link with no trackers while the DHT is off, a firewall, a VPN or a network that blocks BitTorrent, or peers that answer but don't have the file list themselves. After 3 minutes it stops and keeps showing what it found, with what to try; <g3>Look up</g3> asks again.
b4ac60c82f87352c.text: DDM 会读取种子并以文件夹树的形式显示其文件。<x1/> 文件会立即读取。磁力链接则首先要从其他节点获取文件列表，通常在几秒内完成。等待期间，<g2>添加种子</g2>会显示它从跟踪器、DHT 或您的本地网络找到了多少个节点，以及有多少个已响应。在 30 秒内仍未获得文件列表时，它会说明可能的阻碍：在 DHT 关闭时链接没有跟踪器、防火墙、阻止 BitTorrent 的 VPN 或网络，或者节点虽然响应但自己没有文件列表。3 分钟后它会停止，并继续显示已找到的内容以及可以尝试的办法；<g3>查找</g3>会再次询问。

b4b8dfaf3531b2c6.text: 通宵下载 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

b4c6b4d600e8fca1.source: The code that draws the windows is optimised for size (the engine stays optimised for speed), and the programs are optimised as a whole.
b4c6b4d600e8fca1.text: 绘制窗口的代码已针对大小进行优化（引擎仍针对速度进行优化），并且程序作为一个整体进行了优化。

b4c711557b443b7e.source: <g1>Torrent peers and trackers.</g1> When you download a torrent, DDM connects to the trackers listed in the torrent, to the BitTorrent DHT network and to other peers, who see your IP address and which pieces you have. To accept connections it may ask your router to open a port (UPnP). This is how BitTorrent works; it ends when the torrent stops.
b4c711557b443b7e.text: <g1>种子对等点和追踪器。</g1>当您下载种子时，DDM 会连接到种子中列出的追踪器、BitTorrent DHT 网络和其他对等点，这些对等点会看到您的 IP 地址和您拥有的片段。为了接受连接，它可能会要求您的路由器打开一个端口（UPnP）。这就是 BitTorrent 的工作方式；当种子停止时，它就结束了。

b4e383c17ad547ef.source: Learns the limit from the server's answer, keeps to it, and remembers it for next time. Finished in 12.6 s.
b4e383c17ad547ef.text: 从服务器的响应中学习限制，并遵守该限制，下次还会记住。在 12.6 秒内完成。

b4ed890c26512496.source: <g1>Freeze reports say what kind of freeze it was</g1> (<g2>#57</g2>): DDM measures how much processor time the window got while it didn't answer. The report then says whether it ran all along (a loop), waited (a deadlock, or the disk or the network), or hardly ran at all, which means a computer too busy to run DDM or slow to load it from disk, most likely not a bug in DDM. Those last ones share one signature, so they find one issue instead of many.
b4ed890c26512496.text: <g1>冻结报告说明了冻结的类型</g1>（<g2>#57</g2>）：DDM 会测量窗口在无响应时获得了多少处理器时间。报告会说明它是始终运行（循环）、等待（死锁，或磁盘或网络），还是几乎没有运行，这意味着电脑太忙无法运行 DDM 或从磁盘加载速度慢，很可能不是 DDM 的错误。最后一种情况共享一个签名，因此它们会找到一个问题而不是多个问题。

b88a67e39c494a61.source: The server runs on the app's Tokio runtime, one listener per local network address. Each request is checked (<x1/>, <x2/>, token), turned into an <x3/> marked <x4/> (a field no request line can set) and handed to the app through the same channel as the command line's; the app answers it on its next frame, as it answers the automation API. Its page is built in (<x5/>) and its texts come from the app's catalogs (<x6/>).
b88a67e39c494a61.text: 服务器在应用的 Tokio 运行时上运行，每个本地网络地址一个监听器。每个请求都经过检查（<x1/>、<x2/>、令牌），转换为标记为 <x3/> 的 <x4/>（请求行无法设置的字段），并通过与命令行相同的通道传递给应用；应用在下一帧响应它，就像响应自动化 API 一样。其页面内置于 <x5/> 中，其文本来自应用的目录 (<x6/>)。

b88bda5a82ad2252.source: Each command's outcome goes into the torrent's event log; hover its <g1>Status</g1> cell in the list to read it.

b8b97aa49bef24ec.source: three end-to-end tests depended on timing: a refused connection coming back, the learned connection limit, and a dead address (a server without ranges was fixed earlier). Each now waits for the state it checks. The lab server can hold a connection slot for a test (<x1/>), and <x2/> now also means every slot is free (#136);
b8b97aa49bef24ec.text: 三个端到端测试依赖于时间：被拒绝的连接返回、学习到的连接限制和死地址（没有范围的服务器已在早些时候修复）。现在每个测试都会等待其检查的状态。实验室服务器可以为测试保留一个连接槽（<x1/>），并且 <x2/> 现在也意味着每个槽都已空闲（#136）；

b9027340f4925afb.source: <g1>A video download could fail in DDM while yt-dlp went on and finished it</g1> (<g2>#79</g2>). A line yt-dlp printed in the system's code page rather than UTF-8 (a title in Turkish or Russian on some Windows) ended DDM's reading there, and the finished file was then "not said". yt-dlp now always writes UTF-8, every line is read to the end, and the saved file is also found by its name. Whenever DDM gives a video download up, it ends yt-dlp and everything yt-dlp started, so nothing goes on downloading unseen.
b9027340f4925afb.text: <g1>视频下载可能在 DDM 中失败，而 yt-dlp 继续并完成了下载</g1>（<g2>#79</g2>）。yt-dlp 以系统代码页而不是 UTF-8 打印的一行（在某些 Windows 上以土耳其语或俄语显示的标题）结束了 DDM 的读取，然后完成的文件被“未告知”。yt-dlp 现在总是写入 UTF-8，每一行都被读取到最后，并且保存的文件也可以通过其名称找到。每当 DDM 放弃视频下载时，它都会结束 yt-dlp 和 yt-dlp 启动的所有内容，因此不会有任何内容在后台继续下载。

ba32838f82589bef.source: The download windows no longer freeze while a drive is slow to answer (a hard disk waking up, a USB drive, a network or mapped folder). <g1>Download File Info</g1> asked the disk whether its file's name was taken (to number it <x2/>) on the window's own thread, and so did <g3>Show in folder</g3>, <g4>Open folder</g4>, <g5>Open</g5> and the drag handle in <g6>Download complete</g6>, the question to create a missing folder, the look for files a torrent would write into, and the progress window's check of a folder for <g7>Rename</g7>; the window waited for the disk, 8 seconds and more in the reports. They now ask beside the window. Meanwhile Save As shows the name as it is, without <x8/>, and takes the numbered one when the answer comes; a download started before then is numbered as it starts, so nothing is overwritten (<g9>#743</g9>, <g10>#751</g10>).

bc4702bcb75fda66.source: Yes. DDM writes its progress as it goes, so after a lost connection, a crash or a restart it carries on where it stopped. Before resuming it checks that the file on the server hasn't changed. When a download address has expired, Refresh download address lets you give it a fresh one and keep the data. See Resume a broken download.
bc4702bcb75fda66.text: 是。DDM 会实时记录下载进度，因此在连接中断、程序崩溃或重启后，它会从停止的地方继续下载。恢复下载前，它会检查服务器上的文件是否发生变化。当下载地址过期时，刷新下载地址 功能可让您提供新的地址并保留现有数据。请参阅恢复中断的下载。

bc4dcd5d0ee98446.source: nine more tests checked a time, a speed or a byte count that a starved CPU or a busy CI runner can't keep. Each now checks the state itself, or times from the event it is about: a slow request's own duration, a stop measured from Stop against a wait of minutes, the first bytes before a pause, a speed limit against a download the server paces at the same time (and every byte paid for once), parts asked again instead of a deadline, links that expire after a number of requests instead of milliseconds, range attempts a server without ranges answers slowly enough not to fill the sockets, and the bytes a sparse file takes on the drive. The slow-connection test now fails without shedding (it passed without it before). The lab server can hand out such links (<x1/>) and pace answers to range requests on their own (<x2/>) (#201).
bc4dcd5d0ee98446.text: 另外九项测试检查了在 CPU 资源不足或 CI 运行器繁忙时无法保持的时间、速度或字节计数。现在，每项测试都检查状态本身，或从相关事件开始计时：慢速请求自身的持续时间，从“停止”开始测量停止时间而不是等待几分钟，暂停前的第一个字节，针对服务器同时限制下载速度的下载任务的速度限制（并且每个字节只支付一次），重新请求部分而不是截止日期，在请求次数而不是毫秒数后过期的链接，服务器在没有范围请求时响应缓慢以至于不会填满套接字的范围尝试，以及稀疏文件在驱动器上占用的字节数。慢速连接测试现在在不丢弃数据的情况下会失败（之前在不丢弃数据的情况下会通过）。实验室服务器可以提供此类链接（<x1/>）并单独调整范围请求的响应速度（<x2/>）（#201）。

bc5aa34a7c73058d.source: Options on its File types page: the file types the browser hands to DDM and the sites it leaves alone
bc5aa34a7c73058d.text: “选项”的“文件类型”页面：浏览器移交给 DDM 的文件类型以及不受 DDM 处理的网站。

bc606bb991071128.source: The next tab of a focused tab strip; the next choice of a radio group
bc606bb991071128.text: 在当前聚焦的选项卡栏中切换到下一个选项卡；在单选按钮组中选择下一个选项

bc713e862e9b84d3.source: Each download falls into a category by its file type: <g1>General</g1>, <g2>Compressed</g2>, <g3>Documents</g3>, <g4>Music</g4>, <g5>Programs</g5> or <g6>Video</g6>. Torrents have their own <g7>Torrents</g7> category. Each category has its own folder, by default inside your Downloads folder (<x8/>, <x9/> and so on; General uses <x10/> itself).
bc713e862e9b84d3.text: 每个下载都会根据文件类型归入一个类别：<g1>常规</g1>、<g2>压缩文件</g2>、<g3>文档</g3>、<g4>音乐</g4>、<g5>程序</g5>或<g6>视频</g6>。种子文件有自己的<g7>种子</g7>类别。每个类别都有自己的文件夹，默认位于“下载”文件夹中（<x8/>、<x9/>等；常规类别直接使用<x10/>）。

bc79a66e4eaeb5b9.source: Point at a video on a web page and a small <g1>Download video</g1> button appears at its edge. Click it and a menu opens over the video: DDM looks up the qualities it can download and lists them with their sizes. Pick one and it downloads at once, with only its progress window; DDM's main window stays where it is (with <g2>Do not start downloading, only add files to the queue</g2> on in Options, it goes in the queue instead). <g3>Open in DDM...</g3> at the bottom of the menu opens the <g4>Download video from a page</g4> window instead. DDM must be running for the menu: when it isn't, or for another DDM you send downloads to, a click opens that window directly. It takes the video you clicked: its own file when it plays one, or the stream the player loaded (HLS or DASH), else the page. When the button can't tell which one you mean, the toolbar button's <g5>Media on this page</g5> lists them all. Embedded players work too, and your sign-in for the site, the page that embeds the player and your browser's User-Agent go with it, so videos for members, or that play only on the site that embeds them, can be downloaded. Sound players get the button too.
bc79a66e4eaeb5b9.text: 将鼠标指向网页上的视频时，视频边缘会出现一个小的<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮。点击它，视频上方会打开一个菜单：DDM 会查找它可以下载的视频质量，并列出它们及其大小。选择一个即可立即下载，只显示其进度窗口；DDM 主窗口保持不变（如果在“选项”中开启了<g2>不开始下载，只将文件添加到队列</g2>，则会进入队列）。菜单底部的<g3>在 Dannex Download Manager 中打开...</g3>会打开<g4>从页面下载视频</g4>窗口。DDM 必须运行才能显示菜单：如果未运行，或者您将下载发送到另一个 DDM，点击后会直接打开该窗口。它会获取您点击的视频：如果播放的是文件，则获取其文件本身；如果是播放器加载的流（HLS 或 DASH），则获取流；否则获取页面。当按钮无法判断您指的是哪个视频时，工具栏按钮的<g5>此页面上的媒体</g5>会列出所有视频。嵌入式播放器也适用，并且您在该网站的登录信息、嵌入播放器的页面以及您浏览器的 User-Agent 都会随之发送，因此会员视频或仅在嵌入它们的网站上播放的视频也可以下载。音频播放器也会显示该按钮。

bc83548866edf95a.source: For numbers, set <g1>Wildcard size</g1> to the number of digits. With 3, the files are <x2/>, <x3/> and so on.
bc83548866edf95a.text: 对于数字，将<g1>通配符大小</g1>设置为位数。如果设置为 3，文件将是<x2/>、<x3/>等等。

bc8f37612213a486.source: DDM refuses a torrent with file names your system can't write safely, says which name, and writes nothing. What others can see, the network switches in <g1>Torrent settings</g1>, blocklists and proxies: <g2>Torrents and your security</g2>.
bc8f37612213a486.text: DDM 会拒绝文件名无法安全写入您系统的种子，并会说明是哪个文件名，且不写入任何内容。其他人可以看到的内容、<g1>种子设置</g1> 中的网络开关、黑名单和代理：<g2>种子与您的安全</g2>。

bcb9a067330c23b6.text: 在亮色和暗色之间切换

bcbfeb0968ed1426.source: A torrent says <g1>Checking 42%</g1> while its files are read and checked, and a Recheck no longer stops partway and stays there.
bcbfeb0968ed1426.text: 种子在读取和检查文件时会显示<g1>正在检查 42%</g1>，并且重新检查不再中途停止并停滞不前。

bd3527667ef96098.source: The Mac app carries the Safari extension: there is nothing to download. Safari 17 or later and macOS 14 or later are needed.
bd3527667ef96098.text: Mac 应用程序自带 Safari 扩展程序：无需下载。需要 Safari 17 或更高版本以及 macOS 14 或更高版本。

bd405bf51bf8471b.source: The translations (85 languages besides English) are packed, 12 MB of text in under 1 MB without the translators' notes, and unpacked once at start.
bd405bf51bf8471b.text: 翻译（除英语外 85 种语言）已打包，12 MB 的文本在不到 1 MB 的空间中（不含译者注释），并在启动时一次性解包。

bd56dadacbd8aea1.source: <g1>Leaving a submenu no longer closes the whole menu</g1> (<g2>#250</g2>): with a submenu open (Tasks → Import, Downloads → Speed Limiter), moving the pointer back onto its menu, to another item, closed the menu itself as well. Some window managers (KWin, sway) give a submenu's window the focus; when the submenu closed, its window handed the focus on, and for a moment no window of DDM had it, which counted as DDM losing the focus. A menu now closes for that only when the focus stays away (a click in another program). A submenu also closes when the pointer rests on another item without moving, instead of waiting for the next move.
bd56dadacbd8aea1.text: <g1>离开子菜单不再关闭整个菜单</g1> (<g2>#250</g2>)：当子菜单打开时（任务 → 导入，下载 → 速度限制器），将指针移回其菜单，移到另一个项目时，菜单本身也会关闭。一些窗口管理器（KWin，sway）会给子菜单窗口焦点；当子菜单关闭时，其窗口会移交焦点，并且DDM的窗口在片刻内没有焦点，这被视为DDM失去焦点。现在，菜单只有在焦点持续离开时才会因此关闭（在另一个程序中点击）。子菜单也会在指针停留在另一个项目上而不移动时关闭，而不是等待下一次移动。

bd5edb756199ab1a.source: <g1>View → Language...</g1> opens the same list. Type in <g2>Search</g2> to narrow it, then double-click a language. The window switches at once. <g3>Windows' language</g3>, at the top, follows Windows' display language, and falls back to English when DDM doesn't have it.
bd5edb756199ab1a.text: <g1>视图 → 语言...</g1>会打开相同的列表。在<g2>搜索</g2>框中输入内容以缩小范围，然后双击选择一种语言。窗口会立即切换。<g3>Windows 语言</g3>（位于顶部）会跟随 Windows 的显示语言，如果 DDM 不支持该语言，则会回退到英语。

bd8c99635b6d3edc.source: More of the browser, in version {v1}

bd8e50643c3c4ebf.source: Going the other way is just as easy: <g1>Tasks → Export → To text file</g1> saves one address per line, and <g2>To IDM export file</g2> writes an <x3/> file.
bd8e50643c3c4ebf.text: 反向操作也同样简单：<g1>任务 → 导出 → 导出到文本文件</g1>会每行保存一个地址，而<g2>导出到 IDM 文件</g2>会写入一个 <x3/> 文件。

bd90223c231b70eb.source: on Windows), and DDM follows each new wallpaper's colours within two seconds. <g1>The guide</g1> shows which colour goes where.
bd90223c231b70eb.text: 在 Windows 上），DDM 会在两秒内跟随每个新壁纸的颜色。<g1>指南</g1>会显示每种颜色对应的位置。

bd979e348643fd6c.source: DDM's <g1>Add Dannex Download Manager to your browser</g1> window, which opens at each start until a browser's extension has reached DDM, does the steps below for you: <g2>Add the extension</g2> opens the store's page in that browser.
bd979e348643fd6c.text: DDM 的<g1>将 Dannex Download Manager 添加到您的浏览器</g1>窗口会在每次启动时打开，直到浏览器的扩展程序连接到 DDM。它会为您执行以下步骤：<g2>添加扩展</g2>会在该浏览器中打开商店页面。

bda9a2b644afc6f5.source: Control DDM from your phone or another computer on the local network: see <g1>Control DDM from your phone</g1>.
bda9a2b644afc6f5.text: 通过手机或本地网络上的其他电脑控制 DDM：请参阅<g1>通过手机控制 DDM</g1>。

bdba91b07ade3b78.source: runs DDM with its list, categories, queues, Scheduler, speed limits and torrents, but no window. Its folders and port come from flags or the environment. It stops cleanly, saving its list, when the system stops it. It runs on any Linux machine with DDM installed, and on Windows and macOS the same way.
bdba91b07ade3b78.text: 运行 DDM 时，它会保留下载列表、分类、队列、计划程序、速度限制和种子功能，但不会显示窗口。其文件夹和端口由标志或环境变量决定。当系统停止它时，它会干净地停止并保存其列表。它可以在任何安装了 DDM 的 Linux 机器上运行，在 Windows 和 macOS 上也以同样的方式运行。

bdc9de810562c363.source: The MCP server (<x1/>): AI assistants list, add and control the running app's downloads through the automation API
bdc9de810562c363.text: MCP 服务器（<x1/>）：AI 助手通过自动化 API 列出、添加和控制正在运行的应用的下载

bdecf0a581b9c832.source: By default DDM starts downloading while this window is open, so no time is lost while you decide. <g1>Cancel</g1> drops what it fetched. You can turn this off in <g2>Options → Downloads → Start downloading immediately while displaying "Download File Info" dialog</g2>.
bdecf0a581b9c832.text: 默认情况下，DDM 会在此窗口打开时开始下载，因此您在决定时不会浪费时间。<g1>取消</g1>会丢弃已获取的内容。您可以在<g2>选项 → 下载 → 显示“下载文件信息”对话框时立即开始下载</g2>中关闭此功能。

bdf67df1d931eced.source: A site that lets only browsers through
bdf67df1d931eced.text: 只允许浏览器访问的站点

be0ffe38b6cd621b.source: <g1>Options → Proxy / Socks → Network adapter</g1> holds every connection DDM opens to one network adapter, usually your VPN's: downloads, FTP, torrents, video pages and galleries, DDM's own downloads and the update check. It works as a kill switch: when the adapter disconnects, or the VPN is switched off, nothing goes out through your normal connection. Running downloads stop with <g2>… is not connected</g2>, and start again by themselves when the adapter is back. The line under the list shows the adapter's address, or that it isn't connected. Details in <g3>Options → Proxy / Socks</g3> and, for torrents, in <g4>Torrents and your security</g4>.
be0ffe38b6cd621b.text: <g1>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 网络适配器</g1>将 DDM 打开的所有连接（下载、FTP、种子、视频页面和图库、DDM 自身的下载以及更新检查）都绑定到一个网络适配器，通常是您的 VPN 适配器。它充当终止开关：当适配器断开连接或 VPN 关闭时，任何数据都不会通过您的常规连接传出。正在进行的下载会因<g2>…未连接</g2>而停止，并在适配器恢复后自行重新开始。列表下方的行显示适配器的地址，或显示其未连接。详情请参阅<g3>选项 → 代理/SOCKS</g3>，以及种子相关的<g4>种子与您的安全</g4>。

be2d15619e0e5dee.source: If your network gives a proxy auto-config (PAC) script, type its address, or pick the file, under <g1>Use a configuration script</g1>. DDM fetches it and asks it which way each download goes (<x2/>, <x3/> or <x4/>), as browsers do. Until it has been fetched, or if it can't be, DDM uses the system's settings.
be2d15619e0e5dee.text: 如果您的网络提供代理自动配置 (PAC) 脚本，请在<g1>使用配置脚本</g1>下输入其地址，或选取该文件。DDM 会获取它，并像浏览器一样询问每个下载该走哪条路径（<x2/>、<x3/> 或 <x4/>）。在获取完成之前，或获取失败时，DDM 会使用系统设置。

be3dff402d9bec75.source: Check that there is a <x1/> folder next to <x2/>. That folder is what makes DDM portable. Don't delete it.
be3dff402d9bec75.text: 检查<x2/>旁边是否有<x1/>文件夹。这个文件夹使 DDM 成为便携版。请勿删除它。

be46fd68856b871f.source: It opens the download's address in the browser the download came from, or in your default browser when DDM doesn't know which one it was (a link you added in DDM yourself) or doesn't find it (on Linux, a Flatpak or Snap browser). Answer the site's check there if it asks for one. When the browser starts the download, its extension offers it to DDM as usual, and DDM leaves it to the browser: the browser keeps it, and the toolbar button's popup says why. DDM does this once for that address (or the one its redirects led to), within 10 minutes of your click; after that, the link's downloads come to DDM again. DDM's log notes each one.
be46fd68856b871f.text: 它会在该下载来源的浏览器中打开下载地址；如果 DDM 不知道来源是哪个浏览器（您在 DDM 中自己添加的链接），或找不到它（在 Linux 上是 Flatpak 或 Snap 浏览器），则在默认浏览器中打开。如果站点要求验证，请在那里完成。浏览器开始下载后，其扩展会照常把它提供给 DDM，DDM 则把它留给浏览器：由浏览器保存，工具栏按钮的弹出窗口会说明原因。DDM 对该地址（或其重定向到达的地址）只这样做一次，且在您点击后的 10 分钟内；之后，该链接的下载会再次交给 DDM。DDM 的日志会记录每一次。

be551b1a5450099a.source: Double-click a torrent for its progress window. Its tabs show each file, the peers you get it from, the trackers, a map of the pieces, and the share ratio.
be551b1a5450099a.text: 双击一个种子可打开其进度窗口。其选项卡会显示每个文件、提供文件的对等点、跟踪器、分块图以及共享率。

be5f68c00b2c6c59.source: Big batches of links, extracting archives by itself, and plugins to extend it
be5f68c00b2c6c59.text: 可批量处理大量链接、自动解压归档文件，还能通过插件扩展功能

be67148bff767184.source: Hold <g1>Alt</g1> while clicking a link to let the browser download it instead of DDM. In Firefox, Alt+click saves a link only when its <x2/> setting is on (in <x3/>); otherwise right-click the link and choose <g4>Save Link As...</g4>, which the browser keeps.
be67148bff767184.text: 点击链接时按住 <g1>Alt</g1>，可让浏览器而不是 DDM 下载它。在 Firefox 中，只有其 <x2/> 设置（位于 <x3/>）开启时，Alt+点击才会保存链接；否则请右键点击链接并选择<g4>将链接另存为...</g4>，这样由浏览器保存。

be8936bd5aa080c5.source: <g1>Linux</g1>: in the system keyring through the Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KeePassXC, KDE's wallet with its Secret Service on), its default collection, as items labelled <x2/>. DDM never unlocks a locked keyring and never asks for its password: when the keyring is locked (some desktops that log in on their own leave it locked) or there is none (many tiling window managers), the sign-ins stay in DDM's settings, in a data folder only you may read (0700), as before.
be8936bd5aa080c5.text: <g1>Linux</g1>：通过 Secret Service（GNOME Keyring、KeePassXC、KDE 钱包及其 Secret Service 已开启）保存在系统密钥环中，作为其默认集合中标记为<x2/>的项。DDM 从不解锁锁定的密钥环，也从不要求其密码：当密钥环被锁定（一些自动登录的桌面会将其锁定）或没有密钥环（许多平铺式窗口管理器）时，登录信息会像以前一样保存在 DDM 的设置中，位于只有您可以读取（0700）的数据文件夹中。

be93583a49a09b2f.source: A <x1/> file fetched from a web address goes through the same checks as one opened from disk, and DDM reads at most 10 MB of it.
be93583a49a09b2f.text: 从网址获取的 <x1/> 文件会经过与从磁盘打开的文件相同的检查，DDM 最多读取 10 MB 的内容。

bea727d285f2a159.source: <g1>Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Premiumize</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>): <g3>Options → Accounts</g3> keeps your debrid service accounts. Real-Debrid signs in by code in the browser, or with your API token; AllDebrid by a PIN in the browser or with an API key, and DDM waits while it prepares a slow link; Premiumize with its API key. A link from a file host your service supports is unlocked through your account, then downloaded with all of DDM's connections, pause and resume, from Add URL, the browser's link menu and batch downloads. When the direct link expires, DDM asks the service for a new one. The direct link is never shown or copied, and the sign-in is kept like your other passwords (the system's keychain, below). Each service is asked well under its request limit. See <g4>Debrid service accounts</g4>. Experimental: built from the services' public API documentation, not yet confirmed with a real paid account.
bea727d285f2a159.text: <g1>Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 和 Premiumize</g1>（<g2>#44</g2>）：<g3>选项 → 账户</g3> 用于保存您的网盘服务账户。Real-Debrid 通过浏览器中的代码或您的 API 令牌登录；AllDebrid 通过浏览器中的 PIN 码或 API 密钥登录，DDM 会等待它准备慢速链接；Premiumize 使用其 API 密钥。您的服务支持的文件托管链接会通过您的账户解锁，然后通过“添加 URL”、浏览器链接菜单和批量下载，使用 DDM 的所有连接、暂停和恢复功能进行下载。当直链过期时，DDM 会向服务请求新的链接。直链永远不会显示或复制，并且登录信息会像您的其他密码一样保存（系统密钥链，见下文）。每个服务的请求频率都远低于其请求限制。请参阅<g4>网盘服务帐户</g4>。实验性功能：根据服务的公共 API 文档构建，尚未通过真实的付费账户确认。

beb2e83ff9bbe8a0.source: <g1><x2/> opens the menu bar's menu even with downloads in the list</g1>; it opened the first download's right-click menu instead.
beb2e83ff9bbe8a0.text: <g1>即使列表中有下载任务，<x2/> 也会打开菜单栏的菜单</g1>；之前它会打开第一个下载任务的右键菜单。

bebf1a7c82ae2be4.source: A torrent in order isn't faster to finish, and it helps the swarm less: use it for what you want to watch now.
bebf1a7c82ae2be4.text: 按顺序下载不会让种子更快完成，对群的贡献也较小：仅在需要立即观看内容时使用此功能。

bee758a9aad9268c.source: <g1>The extension's popup: Open Dannex Download Manager shows whole</g1> (<g2>#164</g2>): on Linux, whose fonts are wider, and in longer languages, the button was cut to "Open Dannex Do…". Each button is now as wide as its text, and Options moves below it when both don't fit on one line.

A new help page, <g3>Torrents and your security</g3>, says what others can see and what each switch does.
befc877eb2e581be.text: <g1>种子设置：网络由您选择</g1>（<g2>#40</g2>）：可以选择是否接受传入连接，是否使用 UPnP 映射端口，固定端口，DHT，在本地网络上查找对等点，来自“代理/SOCKS”的 SOCKS5 代理（这会关闭绕过代理的连接），IP 黑名单（P2P 或 eMule 格式，每 7 天重新获取一次），以及在没有种子运行时停止种子引擎。新的帮助页面 <g3>种子与您的安全</g3> 解释了其他人可以看到什么以及每个开关的作用。

bf1775587c0862fc.source: On 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, DDM is the stable, recommended build. The <g1>download page</g1> offers three files:
bf1775587c0862fc.text: 在 64 位 Windows 10 和 11 上，DDM 是稳定且推荐的构建版本。<g1>下载页面</g1>提供三种文件：

bf579d4260973f2c.source: A VPN or proxy extension is a proxy for the browser only. Switch on <g1>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g1> in the extension's toolbar popup (it's off as installed), and DDM downloads what it takes from the browser through the same proxy (with <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks → Use proxy/socks from a browser's request</g2>, on by default; see <g3>Options</g3>). Switched off, the extension reads nothing of the browser's proxy.
bf579d4260973f2c.text: VPN 或代理扩展仅是浏览器的代理。在扩展的工具栏弹出窗口中打开“<g1>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g1>”（默认安装时为关闭），DDM 就会通过相同的代理下载它从浏览器接管的任务（默认情况下，<g2>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 使用浏览器请求中的代理/SOCKS</g2>已开启；详见<g3>选项</g3>）。如果关闭此选项，扩展将不会读取浏览器的任何代理信息。

bf6005b554acc40d.source: Click <g1>Add URL</g1> and paste a gallery's address. Instead of saving the page as a file, DDM opens <g2>Download a gallery</g2>. When its line reads <g3>gallery-dl can download this gallery's files</g3>, check <g4>Save to</g4> and click <g5>Download Now</g5>, or <g6>Later</g6> to add it without starting.
bf6005b554acc40d.text: 点击<g1>添加 URL</g1>并粘贴图库地址。DDM 不会将页面保存为文件，而是打开<g2>下载图库</g2>。当其显示“<g3>gallery-dl 可以下载此图库的文件</g3>”时，勾选<g4>保存到</g4>并点击<g5>立即下载</g5>，或点击<g6>稍后</g6>将其添加到列表而不立即开始下载。

bf627fe501394733.source: <g1>View → Theme → Add a theme file…</g1> does it for you: pick the file anywhere, and DDM copies it into the themes folder and uses it at once.
bf627fe501394733.text: 通过<g1>视图 → 主题 → 添加主题文件…</g1>即可完成：在任意位置选择文件，DDM 会将其复制到主题文件夹并立即应用。

bf8eed08aa80a086.text: <g1>支持 86 种语言和从右到左的排版</g1> 界面语言与电脑的语言一致。阿拉伯语、希伯来语、波斯语和乌尔都语均采用从右到左的排版。

bf904532bdc645af.source: A torrent counts as one file here: each torrent gets the limit of its own. So do a video and an image gallery (<g1>Videos</g1>). A download with a limit of its own (see <g2>For one download</g2>) keeps that one.

bf94455af6da7fc7.source: A plain list of links works too

bfa0513a6871b8e0.source: <g1>The Scheduler wakes the computer to run a queue</g1> (<g2>#142</g2>): tick <g3>Wake the computer to run this queue</g3> under the start time, and a sleeping computer is woken a minute before the queue starts and kept awake while it runs; the line under it says when. On Windows it needs <g4>Allow wake timers</g4> in the power plan: when that is off the Scheduler says so, with a link to the setting. On Linux an administrator has to allow it once (the guide shows how); on macOS only an administrator can schedule a wake, so the option says why it's greyed. DDM never asks for an administrator's password. The Scheduler is 40 pixels taller for it.
bfa0513a6871b8e0.text: <g1>计划程序唤醒电脑以运行队列</g1>（<g2>#142</g2>）：在开始时间下方勾选<g3>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g3>，电脑将在队列开始前一分钟被唤醒，并在运行期间保持唤醒状态；下方一行文字会显示具体时间。在 Windows 上，这需要电源计划中<g4>允许唤醒定时器</g4>开启：如果关闭，计划程序会提示，并提供设置链接。在 Linux 上，管理员需要一次性允许（指南中说明了操作方法）；在 macOS 上，只有管理员才能安排唤醒，因此该选项会说明为何显示为灰色。DDM 绝不会要求管理员密码。计划程序因此增加了 40 像素的高度。

bfb5be5f11fb070f.source: Your browsers hand it their downloads, and proven open-source tools do the specialist work. <g1>Set up the extension</g1>.
bfb5be5f11fb070f.text: 浏览器会将下载任务交给 DDM，专业工作则由成熟的开源工具完成。<g1>设置扩展</g1>。

bfccf2cc495dc164.source: One egui window painted to fixed pixel coordinates, plus one immediate viewport per dialog. <x1/> holds the state (downloads, queues, settings, the list's selection) and turns menu, toolbar, key and IPC commands into actions. Each dialog is its own module and returns an <x2/> (open, closed, done with a value). Windows-only calls are confined to <x3/> and their Linux and macOS counterparts to <x4/> (starting with the session, the browsers' host, sounds, show in folder, the crash handler); every other file is safe, portable Rust. Fonts come from the system: Windows' Fonts folder, macOS's system fonts, fontconfig on Linux (<x5/>). On Windows, Latin, Greek and Cyrillic text is drawn by DirectWrite (<x6/>, through egui's glyph rasterizer hook): View → Text → Smooth in its natural mode, anti-aliased at the size asked for and placed at quarter pixels with the font's own advances; Classic (the default) in GDI-classic mode, so each letter's hinted shape and whole-pixel width come together. Other scripts are shaped and drawn by egui.
bfccf2cc495dc164.text: 一个 egui 窗口绘制到固定的像素坐标，每个对话框一个即时视口。<x1/> 负责维护状态（下载、队列、设置、列表选择），并将菜单、工具栏、按键和 IPC 命令转换为操作。每个对话框都是独立的模块，并返回一个 <x2/>（打开、关闭、完成并带有一个值）。仅限 Windows 的调用被限制在 <x3/> 中，而其 Linux 和 macOS 对应部分则在 <x4/> 中（从会话开始、浏览器主机、声音、在文件夹中显示、崩溃处理程序）；其他所有文件都是安全、可移植的 Rust 代码。字体来自系统：Windows 的 Fonts 文件夹、macOS 的系统字体、Linux 上的 fontconfig (<x5/>)。在 Windows 上，拉丁语、希腊语和西里尔语文本由 DirectWrite 绘制 (<x6/>，通过 egui 的字形光栅化器钩子)：在自然模式下，视图 → 文本 → 平滑，按请求的大小进行抗锯齿处理，并以四分之一像素放置，使用字体自身的字距；经典（默认）模式下，使用 GDI 经典模式，因此每个字母的提示形状和整像素宽度结合在一起。其他脚本由 egui 进行塑形和绘制。

bfdcb4c0c0e4bf80.text: <g1>站点名称/下载链接/父网页/引用页</g1> — 地址、站点名称和下载来源页面。勾选此项可查找来自同一站点的所有内容。

c0861674b153043b.source: <g1>Started with the computer, DDM waits in the notification area</g1> (<g2>#226</g2>): with <g3>Options → General → Launch Dannex Download Manager on startup</g3>, DDM no longer opens its window in front at every sign-in. It starts hidden, its icon in the notification area, with its downloads, queues, Scheduler and browser hand-overs running; its icon, or starting DDM again, shows the window as before. The same on Linux and macOS; where no notification area shows DDM's icon (some Linux desktops), it starts minimized, and the option's tooltip says so (it waits for one up to 30 seconds after its icon is made, its window hidden: a desktop's can come up after DDM at sign-in). The startup entry now passes <x4/> (new on the <g5>command line</g5>); an entry written by an earlier version or its installer is written again at the next start, and the installer writes the new one.
c0861674b153043b.text: <g1>随电脑启动，DDM 在通知区域等待</g1>（<g2>#226</g2>）：通过<g3>选项 → 常规 → 启动时运行 Dannex Download Manager</g3>，DDM 不再在每次登录时都将窗口置于前台。它会隐藏启动，图标显示在通知区域，同时其下载、队列、计划程序和浏览器交接功能都在运行；点击其图标或再次启动 DDM，窗口会像以前一样显示。在 Linux 和 macOS 上也是如此；如果通知区域不显示 DDM 的图标（某些 Linux 桌面），它会最小化启动，并且该选项的工具提示会说明这一点（它会在图标创建后等待最多 30 秒，窗口隐藏：桌面可能在登录时 DDM 之后出现）。启动项现在传递 <x4/>（<g5>命令行</g5>上的新功能）；由早期版本或其安装程序写入的启动项会在下次启动时重新写入，安装程序会写入新的启动项。

The arrow at the end of <g2>Address</g2> lists the last 20 addresses you entered; pick one to use it again. Right-click the box for <g3>Cut</g3>, <g4>Copy</g4>, <g5>Paste</g5>, <g6>Delete</g6> and <g7>Select all</g7>.

c15122fb110bbe8e.source: <g1>System keychain support:</g1> passwords and account sign-ins are now kept in your system's keychain, not in DDM's settings.
c15122fb110bbe8e.text: <g1>支持系统钥匙串：</g1> 密码和账户登录信息现在保存在您系统的钥匙串中，而不是 DDM 的设置里。

c189ef9e90d38d62.source: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi can have the extension twice: the one from the Chrome Web Store and the one loaded from DDM's folder (<g1>Load unpacked</g1>). Both would take each download, so they ask each other: the Chrome Web Store's acts (it updates itself), and the other stands aside. It takes nothing, shows no right-click items and no <g2>Download video</g2> button, and its toolbar button is grey with an amber <g3>!</g3>: click it and <g4>Remove this copy</g4> removes it (the browser asks first). Or remove it on the browser's extensions page.
c189ef9e90d38d62.text: Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中可能会同时有两个该扩展：一个来自 Chrome 应用商店，一个从 DDM 文件夹加载（<g1>加载已解压的扩展程序</g1>）。两者都会接管每个下载，因此它们会互相询问：由 Chrome 应用商店的那个执行（它会自行更新），另一个让路。让路的副本不接管任何内容，不显示右键菜单项，也没有<g2>下载视频</g2>按钮，其工具栏按钮是带琥珀色<g3>!</g3>的灰色：单击它，<g4>移除此副本</g4>会将其移除（浏览器会先询问）。也可以在浏览器的扩展页面中将其移除。

c1904181c8dd01d4.source: <g1>Use proxy/socks from a browser's request…</g1> — on by default. A download DDM takes from the browser goes through the proxy the browser used for it. That's the one a VPN or proxy extension set, the browser's own manual proxy, or its proxy auto-config script. Without it, the download would leave from your own address, and content limited to the VPN's country, or to its address, would fail. The browser extension reads that proxy and hands it to DDM with each download, once you switch on <g2>Send downloads through this browser's proxy or VPN extension</g2> in the extension's toolbar popup (Firefox asks you once; Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi ask nothing more: see <g3>A VPN or proxy extension</g3>).
c1904181c8dd01d4.text: <g1>使用浏览器请求中的代理/SOCKS…</g1> — 默认开启。DDM 从浏览器接管的下载会通过浏览器用于该下载的代理。这包括 VPN 或代理扩展设置的代理、浏览器自己的手动代理，或其代理自动配置脚本。如果没有此设置，下载将从您自己的地址发出，并且受限于 VPN 国家或其地址的内容将无法下载。一旦您在扩展程序的工具栏弹窗中开启<g2>通过此浏览器的代理或 VPN 扩展发送下载</g2>（Firefox 会询问一次；Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 不会再询问：请参阅<g3>VPN 或代理扩展</g3>），浏览器扩展就会读取该代理并将其随每次下载传递给 DDM。

c1d36b87b24557b5.source: It stays out of the way: it shows only while you point at a video (or the player has the keyboard's focus; <g1>Tab</g1> then moves to the button), fades when the pointer rests, and leaves out small videos and short muted loops (animated pictures, backgrounds). In fullscreen it follows the video when the player allows it. On a copy-protected video (DRM) it says that the video can't be saved.
c1d36b87b24557b5.text: 它不会碍事：它只在您指向视频时显示（或播放器具有键盘焦点；<g1>Tab</g1> 键会移动到按钮），当指针静止时会淡出，并排除小视频和短的静音循环（动画图片、背景）。在全屏模式下，如果播放器允许，它会跟随视频。对于受版权保护的视频 (DRM)，它会显示视频无法保存。

c2c8754abcc79249.source: This is the only part of DDM that waits for connections from outside. Downloads, DDM's DNS choice (Options → Connection → DNS), its updates and its helpers only connect out, so they never need a firewall exception; the browser extension and the automation API reach DDM on this computer only (127.0.0.1).
c2c8754abcc79249.text: 这是 DDM 唯一会等待外部连接的部分。下载、DDM 的 DNS 选择（选项 → 连接 → DNS）、更新和辅助程序都只发起外连，因此不需要防火墙例外；浏览器扩展和自动化 API 只会在这台计算机上连接 DDM（127.0.0.1）。

c2e8e85fbcb5f098.source: It has <g1>no remote code, no analytics and no ads</g1>, and sends nothing to us or anyone else.
c2e8e85fbcb5f098.text: 它<g1>没有远程代码、没有分析和没有广告</g1>，并且不向我们或任何其他人发送任何内容。

c2ef218c38582097.source: It uses <g1>8 connections</g1> by default. You can set 1 to 32 in <g2>Options → Connection → Default max. conn. number</g2>, or up to 128 after ticking <g3>Allow more than 32 connections</g3> there. More connections help only when the server sends each one at a limited speed and allows that many from one address; most servers allow far fewer.
c2ef218c38582097.text: DDM 默认使用 <g1>8 个连接</g1>。您可以在<g2>选项 → 连接 → 默认最大连接数</g2>中设置 1 到 32 个连接，或者勾选<g3>允许超过 32 个连接</g3>后最多设置 128 个。只有当服务器以有限的速度发送每个连接并允许来自一个地址的多个连接时，更多的连接才会有帮助；大多数服务器允许的连接数要少得多。

c31622b1a542c888.text: 适用于 Intel Mac 的 <g1>.dmg</g1>

c3e94db31bd7ff31.source: Download a video; <x1/> takes a quality's selector from <x2/> (<x3/> = the best single file; <x4/> = the sound alone as the site has it, not converted; <x5/>, <x6/>, <x7/> or <x8/> = the sound as an MP3 at that bitrate, <x9/> at its best variable one; <x10/> = as Opus; <x11/> = as FLAC, lossless but no better than the site's sound; conversions need ffmpeg). <x12/>: a video the site sends in pieces (HLS, DASH) comes down this many pieces at once (8 by default, 1 to 128); a video in one file is one connection whatever it says. <x13/> saves subtitles beside it: language codes from <x14/> (<x15/>), or <x16/> for every one the uploader gave; <x17/> takes the site's automatic captions instead; <x18/> puts them into the video (needs ffmpeg, MP4 or MKV). <x19/> sends yt-dlp's connections (and ffmpeg's) through one network adapter, as for <x20/>; when it isn't connected, nothing starts.
c3e94db31bd7ff31.text: 下载视频；<x1/> 从 <x2/> 中选择画质（<x3/> = 最佳单一文件；<x4/> = 网站提供的纯音频，不转换；<x5/>、<x6/>、<x7/> 或 <x8/> = 该比特率的 MP3 音频，<x9/> 为最佳可变比特率；<x10/> = Opus 格式；<x11/> = FLAC 格式，无损但音质不优于网站源；转换需要 ffmpeg）。<x12/>：网站分段发送的视频（HLS、DASH）将同时下载这么多片段（默认为 8 个，范围 1 到 128）；单个文件的视频无论设置如何都只使用一个连接。<x13/> 将字幕保存到视频旁边：语言代码来自 <x14/>（<x15/>），或 <x16/> 表示下载上传者提供的所有字幕；<x17/> 则下载网站的自动生成字幕；<x18/> 将字幕嵌入视频中（需要 ffmpeg，MP4 或 MKV 格式）。<x19/> 将 yt-dlp 的连接（和 ffmpeg 的）通过一个网络适配器发送，与 <x20/> 的用法相同；如果未连接，则不开始下载。

c41cf3697bdcc8d7.source: The extension asks the host which file types to take, checks each download against them, and cancels the browser's download only after the app has accepted it; otherwise the browser keeps it, and the extension says why.
c41cf3697bdcc8d7.text: 扩展程序会询问主机要获取哪些文件类型，对照这些类型检查每个下载，并且仅在应用程序接受后才取消浏览器的下载；否则浏览器会保留它，扩展程序会说明原因。

c43a066c9b68a599.source: If Dannex Download Manager closes unexpectedly or stops responding, a <g1>crash report</g1> window opens. It shows what happened, lets you read the whole report, and can send it to the developers on GitHub. Each report helps fix the problem for everyone.
c43a066c9b68a599.text: 如果 Dannex Download Manager 意外关闭或停止响应，会打开一个<g1>崩溃报告</g1>窗口。窗口会显示发生了什么，您可以阅读完整报告，也可以将报告发送给 GitHub 上的开发者。每份报告都有助于解决问题，让所有人受益。

c467885946dc6e66.source: Your download list, settings, logins you save in <g1>Sites Logins</g1>, the history of each download and the files you download are stored only on your computer: in <x2/> on Windows (or the <x3/> folder of the portable copy), and in the usual application-data folder on macOS and Linux. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Uninstalling offers to delete them. The passwords of Sites Logins, the proxy and debrid accounts go into the system's keychain instead (Windows Credential Manager, the keyring on Linux, the macOS keychain), still on your computer, when one is there and unlocked.
c467885946dc6e66.text: 您的下载列表、设置、您在<g1>站点登录</g1>中保存的登录信息、每个下载的历史记录以及您下载的文件，仅存储在您的计算机上：在 Windows 上位于 <x2/>（或便携版的 <x3/> 文件夹），在 macOS 和 Linux 上位于常见的应用程序数据文件夹。不会上传到任何地方。卸载时可选择将其删除。站点登录、代理和 debrid 帐户的密码则会改存入系统的钥匙串（Windows 凭据管理器、Linux 上的密钥环、macOS 钥匙串），仍在您的计算机上，前提是存在钥匙串且已解锁。

c49b538c60630963.source: Already have yt-dlp or ffmpeg for another program? Use those instead of a second copy: in <g1>Download video from a page</g1>, click <g2>Helpers...</g2>, then <g3>Use another program...</g3> beside yt-dlp or ffmpeg, and choose the program. DDM runs it once to check that it is that program, and uses it from then on, the command line too. DDM doesn't update a program you chose: keep it up to date yourself (yt-dlp: <x4/>, or your package manager). <g5>Use DDM's own copy</g5> goes back to the one DDM downloads and checks.
c49b538c60630963.text: 已经为其他程序准备了 yt-dlp 或 ffmpeg？可以使用现有版本，无需再下载一份：在<g1>从页面下载视频</g1>窗口中，点击<g2>帮助程序...</g2>，然后点击 yt-dlp 或 ffmpeg 旁边的<g3>使用其他程序...</g3>，并选择程序。DDM 会运行一次以确认它是相应程序，之后就会一直使用它，包括通过命令行使用。DDM 不会更新您选择的程序，请自行保持其为最新版本（yt-dlp：<x4/>，或使用您的包管理器）。点击<g5>使用 DDM 自己的副本</g5>，即可切换回 DDM 下载并验证的版本。
