d9b76e3e6afd2fa9.source: <g1><g2>Download a video from a page</g2></g1> — pick a quality and save a video.
d9b76e3e6afd2fa9.text: <g1><g2>从页面下载视频</g2></g1> — 选择质量并保存视频。

d9c09dd097c849db.source: On Linux and macOS, DDM sets browser integration up itself each time it starts: start DDM once. <g1>Test browser integration</g1> says what went wrong if it couldn't, such as <g2>The helper program the browsers start is missing</g2>: <g3>Set it up</g3> puts it back.
d9c09dd097c849db.text: 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 每次启动时都会自行设置浏览器集成：只需启动 DDM 一次。<g1>测试浏览器集成</g1> 会说明如果设置失败，例如出现 <g2>浏览器启动的帮助程序缺失</g2>，是哪里出了问题：点击 <g3>设置</g3> 即可修复。

d9dde89e1b709127.source: Add URL: the copied address is already there. Click OK.
d9dde89e1b709127.text: 添加 URL：复制的地址已在其中。点击“确定”。

d9f725fa45412644.source: <g1><g2>Site grabber</g2></g1> — explore a web site a few links deep and download its pictures, documents or media, or the whole site to read offline.
d9f725fa45412644.text: <g1><g2>站点抓取器</g2></g1> — 从网站向下探索几层链接，下载其图片、文档或媒体，或下载整个网站以便离线阅读。

da12a252ee14babe.source: To stop in the morning whatever is left, tick <g1>Stop download at</g1> and set a time, for example 7:00:00 AM.
da12a252ee14babe.text: 要在早上停止所有剩余的下载，请勾选<g1>在以下时间停止下载</g1>并设置一个时间，例如早上 7:00:00。

da1944611f1b4a60.source: <g1>Off by default</g1>, and nothing listens while it is off.
da1944611f1b4a60.text: <g1>默认关闭</g1>，关闭时没有任何监听。

da19625cfdf84664.source: IDM itself is closed source. Dannex Download Manager is open source (GPL-3.0) and laid out the way IDM users expect, but it's a separate program written from scratch. Anyone can read its code on <g1>GitHub</g1>.
da19625cfdf84664.text: IDM 本身是闭源的。Dannex Download Manager 是开源的 (GPL-3.0)，布局符合 IDM 用户的期望，但它是一个从头开始编写的独立程序。任何人都可以到 <g1>GitHub</g1> 阅读其代码。

da1c1be39d578250.source: <g1>When done, turn off the computer</g1> — choose <g2>Shut down</g2>, <g3>Sleep</g3> or <g4>Hibernate</g4>.
da1c1be39d578250.text: <g1>完成后关闭计算机</g1> — 选择<g2>关机</g2>、<g3>睡眠</g3>或<g4>休眠</g4>。

da2e1f2b68c87f18.source: Let the home server do the downloading.

da35426aeb049210.source: <g1>Stop All</g1> on the toolbar (or <g2>Downloads → Stop All</g2>, <g3>Pause All</g3>) stops every running queue along with the downloads, so no queue starts its next file. Started again, a queue goes on where it stopped.
da35426aeb049210.text: 工具栏上的<g1>停止所有</g1>（或<g2>下载 → 停止所有</g2>、<g3>暂停所有</g3>）会连同下载一起停止所有正在运行的队列，因此没有队列会开始下一个文件。再次启动后，队列会从停止处继续。

da373eda9cbcb8a7.source: It asks sites for one picture a second at most, and names itself as DDM, because some servers, Wikimedia's among them, refuse tools that ask faster or without a name. It uses no configuration file of yours.
da373eda9cbcb8a7.text: 它最多每秒向网站请求一张图片，并自称为 DDM，因为某些服务器（包括维基媒体的服务器）会拒绝请求过快或未命名的工具。它不使用您的任何配置文件。

da42e0ecc146e6f3.source: DDM can unpack an archive as soon as its download completes, or when you ask. A split archive waits for its last part, and nothing already on your disk is overwritten.
da42e0ecc146e6f3.text: DDM 可以在压缩包下载完成后立即解压，或在您需要时解压。分卷压缩包会等待所有部分下载完毕，并且不会覆盖您磁盘上已有的文件。

da51f77fc03674c8.source: <g1>From the Chrome Web Store:</g1> the browser updates it by itself within a few hours. <g2>Check for updates</g2> on the status page asks now.
da51f77fc03674c8.text: <g1>来自 Chrome 应用商店：</g1>浏览器会在几小时内自动更新它。状态页上的<g2>检查更新</g2>会立即询问。

da5804cb7ae48112.source: Some servers report a new date for the same file every time. Tick <g1>Options → Downloads → Ignore file modification time changes when resuming a download</g1>.
da5804cb7ae48112.text: 有些服务器每次都会为同一个文件报告新的日期。勾选<g1>选项 → 下载 → 恢复下载时忽略文件修改时间更改</g1>。

da6586417d8dd463.source: Done: Open the file, or Open folder.
da6586417d8dd463.text: 完成：打开文件，或打开文件夹。

da6d241acb08d37e.source: Links you add by hand go with the User-Agent of your default browser, at the version you have installed (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox or Safari, on Windows, Linux and macOS), instead of the Internet Explorer 11 one DDM sent until now, which some sites no longer let through. DDM looks the browser up once as it starts. <g1>Options → Downloads</g1> shows it with <g2>Automatic</g2> ticked; untick it to type your own, and a User-Agent you had set stays yours. When DDM doesn't recognise your default browser, it sends a current Chrome's; when a site turns a browser's User-Agent away, it asks once more with its former one, as for downloads from the browser (part of <g3>#668</g3>).
da6d241acb08d37e.text: 您手动添加的链接，现在会带上您的默认浏览器的 User-Agent，版本为您已安装的版本（Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上的 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi、Firefox 或 Safari），而不再是 DDM 此前发送的 Internet Explorer 11 的 User-Agent，一些站点已不再放行它。DDM 在启动时查找一次浏览器。<g1>选项 → 下载</g1>会在勾选<g2>自动</g2>时显示它；取消勾选即可输入您自己的，您此前设置的 User-Agent 仍然有效。DDM 不认识您的默认浏览器时，会发送当前 Chrome 的；站点拒绝某个浏览器的 User-Agent 时，会改用其先前的 User-Agent 再请求一次，与来自浏览器的下载相同（属于<g3>#668</g3>的一部分）。

da6edd8a7cee18e1.source: where it listens: every local network address unless given
da6edd8a7cee18e1.text: 监听地址：除非指定，否则为所有本地网络地址

da732a1798c9def9.source: Pick the service, then either: - <g1>Sign in in the browser</g1> (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and TorBox): DDM shows a code and opens the service's page (TorBox's is also at <x2/>). Type the code there (AllDebrid's page already has it) and allow DDM. The dialog notices on its own. - or paste your <g3>API token</g3> (<g4>Find my token</g4> opens the service's page that shows it), then <g5>Use the token</g5>. Premiumize signs in this way only: paste the API key from its Account page.
da732a1798c9def9.text: 选择服务，然后： - <g1>在浏览器中登录</g1> (Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 和 TorBox)：DDM 会显示一个代码并打开服务页面 (TorBox 的页面也在 <x2/>)。在那里输入代码 (AllDebrid 的页面已包含该代码) 并授权 DDM。对话框会自动检测到。 - 或粘贴您的 <g3>API 令牌</g3> (<g4>查找我的令牌</g4> 会打开显示该令牌的服务页面)，然后<g5>使用令牌</g5>。Premiumize 仅通过此方式登录：从其“账户”页面粘贴 API 密钥。

da77eb1016522f8a.source: <g1>Your own copy:</g1> <g2>Helpers...</g2> (in the gallery window or the video window) lists yt-dlp, ffmpeg and gallery-dl, and <g3>Use another program...</g3> takes your own copy of each instead of DDM's.
da77eb1016522f8a.text: <g1>您自己的副本：</g1><g2>帮助程序...</g2>（在图库窗口或视频窗口中）会列出 yt-dlp、ffmpeg 和 gallery-dl；点击<g3>使用其他程序...</g3>即可使用您自己的相应程序，而不是 DDM 提供的程序。

da7c7d693bc54d47.source: The <g1>Download video</g1> window remembers the folder you save into, per <g2>Options → Save to</g2>'s "Change folder for this category on last selected", as <g3>Download File Info</g3> does: it no longer goes back to the Video category's folder each time (<g4>#475</g4>).
da7c7d693bc54d47.text: <g1>下载视频</g1>窗口会记住您保存到的文件夹，遵循<g2>选项 → 保存到</g2>的“在上次选择时更改此类别的文件夹”，与<g3>下载文件信息</g3>相同：它不再每次都回到视频类别的文件夹（<g4>#475</g4>）。

da9c23c3457966df.source: The <g1>user guide</g1> covers every window, with step-by-step tutorials. Something broken? <g2>Open an issue on GitHub</g2>, or use Help → Report a problem in the app.
da9c23c3457966df.text: <g1>用户指南</g1>涵盖了每个窗口，并提供分步教程。遇到问题？<g2>在 GitHub 上提交问题</g2>，或在应用中使用“帮助”→“报告问题”。

daa2aa4f40324179.source: From the Download video button in your browser
daa2aa4f40324179.text: 通过浏览器中的“下载视频”按钮

dabaf2be6d185ffc.source: Questions about these terms: open an <g1>issue on GitHub</g1>.
dabaf2be6d185ffc.text: 有关这些条款的问题：请在<g1>GitHub 上提交问题</g1>。

dabb49ca1929585a.source: Dannex Download Manager ("DDM", "the software") and the website dannex.kavangi.co.ke ("the site") are made by the Dannex Download Manager contributors ("we"), on the code of Mister Download Manager by Ahmed Nefzaoui. By using the software or the site you accept these terms. If you don't, please don't use them.
dabb49ca1929585a.text: Dannex Download Manager（“DDM”“本软件”）和网站 dannex.kavangi.co.ke（“本站”）由 Dannex Download Manager 贡献者（“我们”）开发，基于 Ahmed Nefzaoui 的 Mister Download Manager 的代码。使用本软件或本站，即表示您接受这些条款。如果不接受，请不要使用。

dad5de5d134be8d3.source: Pick what the setup should do: - <g1>Set up browser integration (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> - <g2>Open .torrent files and magnet links with Dannex Download Manager</g2> - <g3>Start Dannex Download Manager when Windows starts</g3> - <g4>Create a desktop shortcut</g4> (off unless you tick it)
dad5de5d134be8d3.text: 选择安装程序应执行的操作：- <g1>设置浏览器集成 (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)</g1> - <g2>使用 Dannex Download Manager 打开 .torrent 文件和磁力链接</g2> - <g3>Windows 启动时启动 Dannex Download Manager</g3> - <g4>创建桌面快捷方式</g4>（默认关闭，除非您勾选）

daf0900c44e24071.source: Removes downloads from the list and keeps their files, or deletes the files too when asked. A running download must be paused first.
daf0900c44e24071.text: 从列表中删除下载并保留其文件，或者在要求时也删除文件。正在运行的下载必须先暂停。

db2ddcfc7e327586.source: Remote Control and Headless Mode Support
db2ddcfc7e327586.text: 远程控制和无界面模式支持

db3865d429f20bf4.source: DDM keeps the choice with the download, after a restart too.
db3865d429f20bf4.text: DDM 会将此选择与下载一起保存，即使重启后也是如此。

db3d951916b6ce25.source: <g1>Firefox as a Snap</g1> (Ubuntu's own Firefox) reaches DDM through the desktop, which reads the browser files in your home folder and those the .deb or .rpm installs for everyone. The first time the extension calls DDM, the desktop asks <g2>Allow Firefox to start WebExtension backend?</g2> for Dannex Download Manager: choose <g3>Allow</g3>. After <g4>Don't allow</g4>, the extension says the connection failed and the desktop doesn't ask again; to be asked again, run this in a terminal, then use the extension again:
db3d951916b6ce25.text: <g1>Snap 版 Firefox</g1>（Ubuntu 自带的 Firefox）通过桌面环境连接 DDM，桌面环境会读取您主文件夹中的浏览器文件以及 .deb 或 .rpm 为所有用户安装的文件。扩展程序首次调用 DDM 时，桌面环境会询问“<g2>允许 Firefox 启动 WebExtension 后端吗？</g2>”以连接 Dannex Download Manager：请选择<g3>允许</g3>。选择<g4>不允许</g4>后，扩展程序会提示连接失败，并且桌面环境不会再次询问；要再次被询问，请在终端中运行以下命令，然后再次使用扩展程序：

db3fcf8fdc9287f7.source: For Ubuntu, Debian, Mint and Pop!_OS: <x1/>. It brings the libraries DDM needs.
db3fcf8fdc9287f7.text: 适用于 Ubuntu、Debian、Mint 和 Pop!_OS：<x1/>。它包含了 DDM 所需的库。

db45ba1da15b395c.source: <g1>Temporary folder</g1> — empty (the default), each download writes straight into a part file next to its file, so nothing is copied at the end. Type a folder or click <g2>Browse</g2> to keep the part files there until their downloads complete; on another drive than a download's folder, its file is then copied over. A download paused before you changed it moves its part file there when it goes on. Video pages, galleries and torrents keep their own files where they always do.
db45ba1da15b395c.text: <g1>临时文件夹</g1> — 留空（默认）时，每个下载直接写入其文件旁边的分块文件，因此最后无需复制。输入文件夹或单击<g2>浏览</g2>，可将分块文件保留在那里，直到下载完成；如果与下载文件夹不在同一驱动器上，完成后文件会被复制过去。在您更改之前已暂停的下载，在继续时会将其分块文件移到那里。视频页面、图库和种子仍将自己的文件保存在原来的位置。

db5e343720753d5c.source: A split button's divider at rest: its shadow
db5e343720753d5c.text: 分割按钮静止时的分隔线：其阴影

db5fc874733ab939.source: Select part of a page and right-click it for <g1>Download selected links with DDM</g1>, or right-click the page for <g2>Download all links with DDM</g2>: the links open in <g3><g4>Link grabber</g4></g3>, sorted into packages, where you tick the ones you want.
db5fc874733ab939.text: 选中页面的一部分，然后右键点击并选择<g1>使用 DDM 下载选定链接</g1>；或者右键点击页面并选择<g2>使用 DDM 下载所有链接</g2>：这些链接会在<g3><g4>链接抓取器</g4></g3>中打开，并按包分类，您可以勾选想要的链接。

db74b9137912e0a2.source: A proxy that asks for a login the VPN extension gives itself can't be shared: no other program has that login. The download then stops and says so, rather than going without the proxy. Use the VPN's own app, or choose its adapter under <g1>Network adapter</g1>.
db74b9137912e0a2.text: 如果代理需要 VPN 扩展自行提供的登录信息，就无法共享：其他程序无法获取这些登录信息。此时下载会停止并说明原因，而不会绕过代理继续下载。请使用 VPN 自带的应用，或在<g1>网络适配器</g1>中选择 VPN 的适配器。

db94ba5f97a1f9e2.source: The extension shows almost nothing of its own, as users of other download managers expect: a click on its toolbar button turns taking downloads off and on, its right-click menu has "Don't take downloads from this site" and Help (<x1/>, the status page: installed, or what is wrong and the one thing to do), and its options page (<x2/>) has only that switch, the browser's proxy (#42) and another DDM (#157). It never asks the app for its downloads (extensions up to {v1} did, for a window of their own: the host refuses that question now, and the app answers the automation API's <x3/> and actions only while the API is on).
db94ba5f97a1f9e2.text: 此扩展自身几乎不显示任何内容，正如其他下载管理器的用户所期望的：单击其工具栏按钮即可关闭和开启下载接管，其右键菜单有“不接管此站点的下载”和“帮助”（<x1/>，状态页：已安装，或出了什么问题以及该做的一件事），其选项页（<x2/>）只有该开关、浏览器的代理 (#42) 和另一个 DDM (#157)。它从不向应用索取其下载（{v1} 及更早版本的扩展会这样做，以便显示自己的窗口：宿主现在会拒绝该请求，而应用仅在自动化 API 开启时才回应该 API 的 <x3/> 和操作）。

dba089f6ed3c76a8.source: Black and white, a bright accent, every edge drawn, text at 7:1 or more.
dba089f6ed3c76a8.text: 黑白分明，明亮的强调色，每条边缘都清晰可见，文本对比度达到 7:1 或更高。

dbab4b9a74908e08.source: Your system's accent colour and contrast setting, followed as you change them, on Windows, Linux and macOS.
dbab4b9a74908e08.text: 在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 会跟随您更改系统强调色和对比度设置。

dbb4681b9d950b8f.source: DDM installs an update only when the release's list of checksums is signed by DDM's release key and the file matches it; anything else is refused, and <g1>Download</g1> opens the <g2>Releases</g2> page instead. Dannex updates itself this way from version 0.6.2 on: 0.6.0 and 0.6.1 carry the original project's key, so they open the Releases page; install 0.6.2 (or newer) from there once, and the updates after it come by themselves.
dbb4681b9d950b8f.text: 只有当版本的校验和列表经 DDM 的发布密钥签名且文件与之相符时，DDM 才会安装更新；其他情况一律拒绝，<g1>下载</g1>会改为打开<g2>Releases</g2> 页面。Dannex 从 0.6.2 版起以这种方式自行更新：0.6.0 和 0.6.1 带的是原始项目的密钥，所以它们会打开 Releases 页面；请从那里安装一次 0.6.2（或更新版本），之后的更新就会自动进行。

dbd76771e65e9757.source: <g1>Where it comes from:</g1> DDM downloads gallery-dl from its releases on Codeberg. It accepts it only when the release's checksum list is signed by gallery-dl's author's key, pinned in DDM, and the program matches that list. It keeps the previous version and never goes back to an older one. On Windows and on Linux (x86-64) DDM installs it; on macOS, install it with Homebrew (<x2/>) or pip.
dbd76771e65e9757.text: <g1>来源：</g1> DDM 从 Codeberg 上的发布下载 gallery-dl。只有当发布版本的校验和列表由 DDM 中固定的 gallery-dl 作者密钥签名，并且程序与该列表匹配时，DDM 才接受它。它会保留上一个版本，并且绝不会回滚到旧版本。在 Windows 和 Linux (x86-64) 上，DDM 会安装它；在 macOS 上，请使用 Homebrew (<x2/>) 或 pip 安装。

dbd790f226f0403e.source: Capped by data, not by speed
dbd790f226f0403e.text: 按数据量而非速度限制

dbf30e7142611530.source: "What is DDM downloading right now, and how long is left?"
dbf30e7142611530.text: “DDM 现在正在下载什么，还剩多长时间？”

dc1a2189e80bed74.source: <g1>Downloads in progress</g1> lists the running downloads. Choose one to see its progress window.
dc1a2189e80bed74.text: <g1>正在进行的下载</g1>列出正在运行的下载。选择一个可查看其进度窗口。

dc54ff9291da2b52.source: Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi through the extension, from <g1>Firefox's add-ons store</g1> and <g2>the Chrome Web Store</g2>. Without the extension, copy a link and DDM opens the download window. <g3>More</g3>
dc54ff9291da2b52.text: 通过扩展程序支持 Firefox、Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi，可从<g1>Firefox 附加组件商店</g1>和<g2>Chrome 网上应用店</g2>获取。如果没有扩展程序，复制链接后 DDM 会打开下载窗口。<g3>更多</g3>

dc75431952fc8673.source: Today's files marked <x1/> are for macOS 11 and later, on Apple Silicon or Intel, and for Linux on x86-64: an AppImage for most distributions, a <x2/> for Ubuntu, Debian, Mint and Pop!_OS, an <x3/> for Fedora, openSUSE and RHEL, and a <x4/> of the plain programs. Please <g5>tell us how it went</g5>, good or bad.
dc75431952fc8673.text: 目前标有 <x1/> 的文件适用于 macOS 11 及更高版本（Apple Silicon 或 Intel 芯片），以及 x86-64 架构的 Linux：包括适用于大多数发行版的 AppImage、适用于 Ubuntu、Debian、Mint 和 Pop!_OS 的 <x2/>、适用于 Fedora、openSUSE 和 RHEL 的 <x3/>，以及普通程序的 <x4/>。请<g5>告诉我们您的使用体验</g5>，无论好坏。

dc868ceecfac36d1.source: Open <g1>Downloads → Options</g1> and the <g2>Save to</g2> tab.
dc868ceecfac36d1.text: 打开<g1>下载 → 选项</g1>，然后选择<g2>保存到</g2>选项卡。

dc8b1df162854afe.source: If your network gives a proxy auto-config (PAC) script, type its address, or pick the file, under <g1>Use automatic configuration script</g1>. DDM fetches it and asks it which way each download goes (<x2/>, <x3/> or <x4/>), as browsers do. Until it has been fetched, or if it can't be, DDM uses the system's settings.
dc8b1df162854afe.text: 如果您的网络提供代理自动配置 (PAC) 脚本，请在<g1>使用自动配置脚本</g1>下输入其地址或选择文件。DDM 会像浏览器一样获取该脚本，并询问每个下载应通过哪种方式进行（<x2/>、<x3/> 或 <x4/>）。在脚本被获取之前，或者如果无法获取，DDM 将使用系统设置。

dc8bb7ad3da606ac.source: A page named after the project, at the top of the folder (<x1/>), opens the copy's start page. You can also right-click the project and choose <g2>Open offline copy</g2> once its start page is downloaded.
dc8bb7ad3da606ac.text: 项目文件夹顶部有一个以项目命名的页面（<x1/>），用于打开副本的起始页。起始页下载完成后，您也可以右键单击项目并选择<g2>打开离线副本</g2>。

dce175995531cf3a.source: <g1>Don't start downloading automatically from the following sites</g1> — sites whose downloads stay in the browser, separated by spaces. <x2/> covers every part of a site. <g3>Default</g3> puts the original list back.
dce175995531cf3a.text: <g1>不自动从以下网站下载</g1> — 下载保留在浏览器中的网站，用空格分隔。<x2/>涵盖网站的每个部分。<g3>默认</g3>会恢复原始列表。

dce1986baae3793b.source: Use your own copies of yt-dlp and ffmpeg instead of DDM's.
dce1986baae3793b.text: 使用您自己的 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg 副本，而不是 DDM 内置的。

dce1d04a23573e65.source: <g1>Where a download's server is says "this computer" or "the local network"</g1>, each with its own icon in the flag's place, instead of "this computer or the local network" with nothing; the dot between the place and the time is round, where the font's thin "·" read as an apostrophe.
dce1d04a23573e65.text: <g1>下载服务器位置显示“此计算机”或“本地网络”</g1>，每个都有自己的图标代替旗帜，而不是“此计算机或本地网络”且无图标；位置和时间之间的点是圆形的，而字体细长的“·”之前被误读为撇号。

dce3ae8513f15cf7.source: An import opens <g1>Link grabber</g1>, which sorts the links into packages: the volumes of one archive together, the links of one page together, the rest in <g2>Various files</g2>. Each link is looked up for its real name, its size and whether the server still has it, and the ones that are gone come unticked. A link already in your list goes under <g3>Already in the list</g3>, unticked.
dce3ae8513f15cf7.text: 导入会打开<g1>链接抓取器</g1>，它将链接分类打包：一个压缩包的多个分卷放在一起，一个页面的链接放在一起，其余的放在<g2>各种文件</g2>中。每个链接都会被查找其真实名称、大小以及服务器是否仍有该文件，已失效的链接会被取消勾选。列表中已有的链接会显示在<g3>已在列表中</g3>下，并被取消勾选。

dcf1dce1ec4a4d01.source: Crash and freeze reports keep the log lines that explain them: 25 of the file-type icons carried no-op styles (<x1/>, <x2/> and the like) that DDM's SVG reader warned about each time they were drawn, 1,385 lines for one look at them all, and those warnings filled the end of the log a report includes (<g3>#767</g3>). The icons look the same.
dcf1dce1ec4a4d01.text: 崩溃和冻结报告会保留解释它们的日志行：25 个文件类型图标带有无作用的样式（<x1/>、<x2/> 等），DDM 的 SVG 读取器每次绘制它们都会发出警告，一次查看全部图标就产生 1,385 行，这些警告填满了报告所含日志的末尾（<g3>#767</g3>）。图标外观不变。

dcf7c57bec3d49ba.source: A debrid service, such as Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize or TorBox, is a paid account that downloads files from file hosts on its own servers. It hands back a plain direct link, without the host's waits, speed caps and captchas. With your account in DDM, a link from a host your service supports is unlocked through the service, then downloaded by DDM like any file: all its connections, pause and resume.
dcf7c57bec3d49ba.text: Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize 或 TorBox 等网盘离线下载服务是一种付费账户，它将文件从文件托管服务下载到自己的服务器上。它会返回一个直接链接，没有文件托管服务的等待、速度限制和验证码。在 DDM 中设置您的账户后，您的服务支持的文件托管服务链接将通过该服务解锁，然后由 DDM 像下载任何文件一样下载：包括所有连接、暂停和恢复功能。

dcf9fbdd7aa08cb0.source: <g1>Add browser...</g1> — a browser the list doesn't name (Vivaldi, Thorium, Yandex, Arc…): choose its program (its <x2/> on Windows, its app on macOS), give it a name, and it joins the list with its own box. DDM knows it by the program that starts DDM's helper, whatever browser its User-Agent claims to be. Select one you added and the button becomes <g3>Remove browser</g3> (or press <g4>Delete</g4>).
dcf9fbdd7aa08cb0.text: <g1>添加浏览器...</g1> — 列表中没有的浏览器（Vivaldi、Thorium、Yandex、Arc…）：选择其程序（Windows 上是其 <x2/>，macOS 上是其应用），为其命名，它就会带着自己的复选框加入列表。DDM 通过启动 DDM 辅助程序的那个程序来识别它，无论其 User-Agent 自称是哪个浏览器。选中您添加的一个后，按钮会变为<g3>移除浏览器</g3>（或按 <g4>Delete</g4>）。

dd033f338a148106.source: <g1>On</g1>: the button is in colour, with no badge, as any button. Its tooltip says <g2>Dannex Download Manager is on. Click to turn it off.</g2>
dd033f338a148106.text: <g1>开启</g1>：按钮为彩色，没有徽标，与任何按钮一样。其提示显示<g2>Dannex Download Manager 已开启。点击以关闭。</g2>

dd08837a9e712b0e.source: Set up the extension once, and every download link you click in Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Helium goes to DDM.
dd08837a9e712b0e.text: 只需设置一次扩展，您在 Firefox、Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 或 Helium 中点击的每个下载链接都将发送到 DDM。

dd1e9dabc733f0d8.source: <g1>Options → General → Test browser integration</g1> checks DDM's side in order (integration on, the installed copy, the browsers can find DDM, which browsers' extension connected) and offers <g2>Set it up</g2> when the browsers can't find DDM.
dd1e9dabc733f0d8.text: <g1>选项 → 常规 → 测试浏览器集成</g1>会按顺序检查 DDM 端（集成是否开启、已安装的版本、浏览器是否能找到 DDM、哪些浏览器扩展已连接），并在浏览器无法找到 DDM 时提供<g2>设置</g2>。

dd2ca97400217502.source: If DDM never opens, see <g1>The setup or DDM won't start</g1>.
dd2ca97400217502.text: 如果 DDM 始终无法打开，请参阅<g1>安装程序或 DDM 无法启动</g1>。

dd51eccae63b71c0.source: <g1>Categories</g1><g2>Downloads sorted by type into folders of their own, with Finished and Unfinished one click away.</g2>
dd51eccae63b71c0.text: <g1>类别</g1><g2>下载文件按类型分类到各自的文件夹中，一键查看“已完成”和“未完成”任务。</g2>

dd626c4273adae29.source: Runs nearly everywhere, with HTTP, BitTorrent, magnet and ed2k, and a REST API
dd626c4273adae29.text: 几乎可在所有地方运行，支持 HTTP、BitTorrent、磁力链接和 ed2k，并提供 REST API

dd9e9f3ba79eac09.source: In DDM, click <g1>Add URL</g1> (or press <g2>Ctrl+N</g2>) and click <g3>OK</g3>. DDM sees that the address is a video's page and opens <g4>Download video from a page</g4>. (You can also open it with <g5>Tasks → Download video from a page...</g5>, paste the address and click <g6>Look up</g6>.)
dd9e9f3ba79eac09.text: 在 DDM 中，点击<g1>添加 URL</g1>（或按<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>），然后点击<g3>确定</g3>。DDM 会识别出这是视频页面，并打开<g4>从页面下载视频</g4>。（也可以通过<g5>任务 → 从页面下载视频…</g5>打开该窗口，粘贴地址并点击<g6>查找</g6>。）

dda58342e5dff4d8.source: Chrome, Edge, Brave and the other Chromium browsers: a download the extension leaves to the browser keeps the name and folder another extension gives it (Save In's folders, or any extension's own download into a folder). The extension's answer for it counted as a name of its own, an empty one, and when the extension was the newest installed it won: the file landed in the Downloads folder, and the browser could warn of a conflict between the two extensions (<g1>#578</g1>).
dda58342e5dff4d8.text: Chrome、Edge、Brave 和其他 Chromium 浏览器：扩展留给浏览器的下载，会保留另一个扩展给它的名称和文件夹（Save In 的文件夹，或任何扩展自己下载到某个文件夹）。扩展对它的应答被算作它自己的名称，而且是空的，当该扩展是最新安装的时，它就胜出：文件落在了下载文件夹中，浏览器还可能提示两个扩展冲突（<g1>#578</g1>）。

ddb9f1b963c5c27d.source: In a Wayland session the windows go through XWayland (below). Not there yet on Linux: screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows; browsers installed as a Flatpak can't reach DDM (Firefox from Flathub may, through the desktop as the Snap does, but that isn't checked yet); and <g1>View → Draw with → Vulkan</g1> is a choice, OpenGL stays the default.
ddb9f1b963c5c27d.text: 在 Wayland 会话中，窗口通过 XWayland 运行（如下）。Linux 上尚未实现的功能：屏幕阅读器（Orca）无法读取 DDM 的窗口；作为 Flatpak 安装的浏览器无法连接 DDM（来自 Flathub 的 Firefox 可能会通过桌面连接，就像 Snap 那样，但这尚未验证）；<g1>视图 → 绘制方式 → Vulkan</g1>是一个选项，OpenGL 仍是默认设置。

ddbd4f59d06ac571.source: Download DDM only from <g1>the website</g1> or <g2>GitHub Releases</g2>.
ddbd4f59d06ac571.text: 仅从<g1>官网</g1>或 <g2>GitHub Releases</g2> 下载 DDM。

ddbfd426bc410b06.source: DDM can be driven without its window in three ways:
ddbfd426bc410b06.text: DDM 可通过以下 3 种方式在不显示窗口的情况下运行：

dddc4b4555b211bf.source: the pause-and-resume and event-log tests no longer depend on how fast the machine is: the lab server can hold a byte back until a test lets it go (<x1/>), and a test can wait until every request it made is in the server's log (#123);
dddc4b4555b211bf.text: 暂停-恢复和事件日志测试不再依赖于机器速度：实验室服务器可以保留一个字节，直到测试允许其释放（<x1/>），并且测试可以等待直到其发出的每个请求都记录在服务器日志中（#123）；

de1268129133c5e9.source: With <g1>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g1> ticked (it is, unless you turned it off), when you copy a link to a file type in <g2>Options → File types</g2> (ZIP, EXE, MP4, PDF and many more), <g3>Download File Info</g3> opens with it filled in, ready for <g4>Start Download</g4>. Links to other pages are left alone. With <g5>Options → Downloads → Show start download dialog</g5> off, the download starts at once instead. Only links copied while DDM runs are taken, never one that was already there.
de1268129133c5e9.text: 勾选<g1>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g1>（除非您已关闭，否则默认勾选），当您复制<g2>选项 → 文件类型</g2>中列出的文件类型（ZIP、EXE、MP4、PDF 等）的链接时，<g3>下载文件信息</g3>将打开并已填入该链接，可供<g4>开始下载</g4>。指向其他页面的链接将不作处理。如果<g5>选项 → 下载 → 显示开始下载对话框</g5>关闭，下载将立即开始。DDM 只会处理在 DDM 运行时复制的链接，不会处理之前已有的链接。

de5eff3673bc7d55.text: 免费 IDM 替代品对比

de7042ead2b68920.source: <g1>Delete archives after extracting</g1>: once extracted, the archives go to the Recycle Bin (the Trash on macOS and Linux).
de7042ead2b68920.text: <g1>提取后删除存档</g1>：提取完成后，存档会移入回收站（macOS 和 Linux 上的废纸篓）。

de8b7a679086918a.source: <g1>Virus checking → Edit...</g1> — tick <g2>Check downloaded files for viruses</g2>, choose the antivirus program and its arguments (<x3/> stands for the downloaded file), and the <g4>File types</g4> to check (programs, installers, archives, disk images and documents that can carry macros by default). Each finished file of those types goes to the program; its answer is its exit code: 0 found nothing, anything else is a problem it reports. The result goes in the download's log, and a problem in its <g5>Download complete</g5> window (or in a message when that window is off). <g6>Use Microsoft Defender</g6> (Windows) fills in Defender's own scanner (<x7/>: it reports and leaves the file where it is); <g8>Use ClamAV</g8> does the same with <x9/> on Linux and macOS. Each shows only when it is installed.
de8b7a679086918a.text: <g1>病毒检查 → 编辑...</g1> — 勾选<g2>检查已下载的文件是否有病毒</g2>，选择杀毒程序及其参数（<x3/> 代表已下载的文件），以及要检查的<g4>文件类型</g4>（默认是程序、安装包、压缩包、磁盘映像和可能带有宏的文档）。这些类型的每个已完成文件都会交给该程序；其回答是它的退出代码：0 表示未发现任何问题，其他任何值都表示它报告了问题。结果会记入下载的日志，问题则显示在其<g5>下载完成</g5>窗口中（该窗口关闭时则以消息显示）。<g6>使用 Microsoft Defender</g6>（Windows）会填入 Defender 自己的扫描程序（<x7/>：它只报告，并将文件留在原处）；<g8>使用 ClamAV</g8>在 Linux 和 macOS 上用 <x9/> 实现同样的功能。每项仅在已安装时才显示。

de9a68a9aac2994b.source: <g1>User-Agent for manually added downloads</g1> — how DDM names itself to servers for downloads you add yourself. With <g2>Automatic</g2> ticked (the default), DDM introduces itself as your default browser: the User-Agent that browser sends, at the version you have installed (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox or Safari). The box shows it, and pointing at it names the browser. When DDM doesn't recognise your default browser, it sends a current Chrome's. Untick <g3>Automatic</g3> to type your own; tick it again to go back. Downloads from the browser use that browser's own User-Agent. If a site turns a browser's User-Agent away, DDM asks once more with its own.
de9a68a9aac2994b.text: <g1>手动添加下载的用户代理</g1> — DDM 在您手动添加下载时向服务器表明身份的方式。勾选“<g2>自动</g2>”（默认）后，DDM 会将自己标识为您的默认浏览器：发送该浏览器当前安装版本（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi、Firefox 或 Safari）的用户代理。框中会显示该信息，鼠标指向时会显示浏览器名称。如果 DDM 无法识别您的默认浏览器，它会发送当前 Chrome 的用户代理。取消勾选“<g3>自动</g3>”可自行输入；再次勾选可恢复。通过浏览器发起的下载会使用该浏览器自己的用户代理。如果某个网站拒绝了浏览器的用户代理，DDM 会再次尝试使用自己的用户代理。

dea26376a5dda6e5.source: Play a sound for <g1>Download complete</g1>, <g2>Download failed</g2>, <g3>A queue starts</g3> and <g4>A queue stops or is done</g4>. Tick an event, select it, click <g5>Browse...</g5> to choose a <x6/> file, and <g7>Play</g7> to hear it. The <g8>Delete</g8> key clears the selected event's sound.
dea26376a5dda6e5.text: 为<g1>下载完成</g1>、<g2>下载失败</g2>、<g3>队列启动时</g3>和<g4>队列停止或完成时</g4>播放声音。勾选一个事件，选中它，单击<g5>浏览...</g5>选择 <x6/> 文件，单击<g7>播放</g7>试听。<g8>Delete</g8> 键会清除所选事件的声音。

debac78242ebe5d9.source: Minimize hides the main window there too, while <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> is on in <g2>Options → General</g2>. It is on by default; where the tray has no icon, Minimize sends the window to the taskbar instead.
debac78242ebe5d9.text: 当<g1>选项 → 常规</g1>中的<g2>最小化到通知区域</g2>开启时，“最小化”也会将主窗口隐藏到通知区域。此选项默认开启；如果通知区域没有图标，“最小化”会将窗口发送到任务栏。

dec24cb67001cd4a.source: DDM downloads the pictures of a gallery (a Wikimedia Commons category, a Flickr album, a DeviantArt gallery, an Imgur album and many more) with the help of <g1>gallery-dl</g1>, a free program that reads several hundred sites: it finds the gallery's pictures, and DDM downloads them. Like yt-dlp for videos, it's an optional helper: DDM installs it the first time you need it, or uses your own copy.
dec24cb67001cd4a.text: DDM 借助 <g1>gallery-dl</g1> 下载图库（Wikimedia Commons 分类、Flickr 相册、DeviantArt 图库、Imgur 相册等）中的图片。gallery-dl 是一个免费程序，可读取数百个站点：它找出图库中的图片，由 DDM 下载。和用于视频的 yt-dlp 一样，它是可选的帮助程序：DDM 会在您第一次需要时安装它，也可使用您自己的副本。

decdfffe86a6a5b9.source: The layout is familiar on purpose: the toolbar, the categories, the download list, the progress window with every connection, queues and the scheduler. The differences: DDM is free and open source, downloads BitTorrent and magnet links in the same list, finished faster in our benchmark, speaks 86 languages and has builds for Linux and macOS. IDM is the more mature product, refined over many years. See the full comparison.
decdfffe86a6a5b9.text: 布局刻意保持熟悉：工具栏、类别、下载列表、显示每个连接的进度窗口、队列和计划任务。不同之处在于：DDM 是免费开源的，可以在同一列表中下载 BitTorrent 和磁力链接，在我们的基准测试中完成速度更快，支持 86 种语言，并提供 Linux 和 macOS 版本。IDM 是更成熟的产品，经过多年完善。查看完整比较。

ded2d9ada89753dc.source: About Dannex Download Manager: its version, licence and links
ded2d9ada89753dc.text: 关于 Dannex Download Manager：版本、许可证和链接

ded6b8d1bb0da886.source: A site may also refuse subtitles when it's asked too often. The video is saved all the same. DDM asks for the subtitles once more after 20 seconds, and if they still don't come, the <g1>Download complete</g1> window and the download's log say which ones are missing and why. Try them again later. When subtitles meant to go inside the video only come on that second try, they're saved beside it instead.
ded6b8d1bb0da886.text: 站点也可能在被请求过于频繁时拒绝提供字幕。视频仍会照常保存。DDM 会在 20 秒后再次请求字幕，如果仍然没有，<g1>下载完成</g1>窗口和下载的日志会说明缺少哪些以及原因。请稍后再试。当本应放入视频内部的字幕只在第二次尝试时才获取到时，它们会改为保存在视频旁边。

dee4ab42b514acda.source: The language list on first start: every language with its flag, its own name and its English name
dee4ab42b514acda.text: 首次启动时的语言列表：每种语言都带有其旗帜、其本国名称和英文名称

dee52466980c445e.source: <g1>Sites to leave alone:</g1> <g2>Options → File types → Don't start downloading automatically from the following sites</g2>. Add the site's name, for example <x3/> or <x4/>.
dee52466980c445e.text: <g1>要忽略的站点：</g1><g2>选项 → 文件类型 → 不自动从以下站点开始下载</g2>。添加站点名称，例如<x3/>或<x4/>。

def0430c0d444bdb.source: Yes. In IDM, export your list as an .ef2 file (its Tasks → Export menu). In DDM, choose Tasks → Import → From an IDM list (.ef2) and pick that file: every…
def0430c0d444bdb.text: 可以。在 IDM 中，将列表导出为 .ef2 文件（其任务 → 导出菜单）。在 DDM 中，选择任务 → 导入 → 从 IDM 列表 (.ef2)并选取该文件：每个…

df08fbc15558c215.source: <g1>Show progress</g1> in the right-click menu always opens a download's progress window, or brings it back from the notification area.
df08fbc15558c215.text: 右键菜单中的<g1>显示进度</g1>始终会打开下载的进度窗口，或将其从通知区域调回。

df1f4287bd6b01b1.source: The download's row stays in DDM's list as it was, and <g1>Resume</g1> tries again from DDM. Where DDM shows no such button (a link the Link grabber or <g2>Download File Info</g2> looked at before adding it), hold <g3>Alt</g3> as you click the link to leave that download to the browser (<g4>Keys to force or prevent capture</g4>).
df1f4287bd6b01b1.text: 该下载的行仍保留在 DDM 的列表中，<g1>恢复</g1>会从 DDM 重新尝试。在 DDM 没有这个按钮的地方（链接抓取器或<g2>下载文件信息</g2>在添加前查看过的链接），点击链接时按住 <g3>Alt</g3>，可把该下载留给浏览器（<g4>强制或阻止捕获的按键</g4>）。

df260daf719b26b8.text: 通过高速链接下载 1 GiB 文件

df2cf479419d70fe.source: More connections help only where a server sends each one at a limited speed. Most servers allow a few connections per address, and DDM notices when one says no: it stops asking that server for more and lists what it learned under <g1>Exceptions</g1> in <g2>Options → Connection</g2>. You can set a number for a server yourself there too.
df2cf479419d70fe.text: 当服务器限制每个连接的速度时，增加连接数才会有帮助。大多数服务器允许每个地址有几个连接，DDM 会在服务器拒绝时注意到：它会停止向该服务器请求更多连接，并在<g2>选项 → 连接</g2>下的<g1>例外</g1>中列出它学到的信息。您也可以在那里为服务器自行设置连接数。

df4be9726ccb94fb.source: <g1>Pause</g1> stops the download and keeps what it has; <g2>Resume</g2> continues it.
df4be9726ccb94fb.text: <g1>暂停</g1>会停止下载并保留已下载的部分；<g2>恢复</g2>会继续下载。

df622d2f46b86c8c.source: Add it again, with a numbered file name

df75204089bb69a0.source: Minimize leaves the window in the taskbar, as any window's does; double-clicking the title bar maximizes or restores it. To have Minimize hide it in the notification area too, tick <g1>Minimize to the notification area</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> (off by default); where the tray has no icon, Minimize sends the window to the taskbar instead.
df75204089bb69a0.text: 最小化会像任何窗口一样将窗口留在任务栏中；双击标题栏可最大化或还原窗口。若要让“最小化”也将其隐藏到通知区域，请勾选<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中的<g1>最小化到通知区域</g1>（默认关闭）；在托盘没有图标的地方，“最小化”会改为将窗口发送到任务栏。

df81c342c23099f4.text: 如何安装浏览器扩展？— Dannex Download Manager

dfc3b08caea203d1.source: Videos a site sends in pieces (HLS and DASH streams, as many sites other than YouTube do) download several pieces at once, as many as <g1>Options → Connection</g1> gives a file (8 by default), through DDM's own downloader: against a test server that slows each connection, 4 at once took under a third of the time, 8 under a fifth. They keep to the speed limits, a change applying at once; pieces encrypted with AES-128 are decrypted with their playlist's key, and pieces whose addresses expire are asked of yt-dlp again. The command line's <x2/> and <x3/> take <x4/> for it (<g5>#531</g5>, <g6>#769</g6>).
dfc3b08caea203d1.text: 站点分片发送的视频（HLS 和 DASH 流，除 YouTube 外许多站点都这样）会同时下载多个分片，数量与<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>给每个文件的连接数相同（默认 8），通过 DDM 自己的下载器完成：对一台让每条连接变慢的测试服务器，同时 4 个只用了不到三分之一的时间，8 个只用了不到五分之一。它们遵守速度限制，更改立即生效；用 AES-128 加密的分片用其播放列表的密钥解密，地址会过期的分片则再次向 yt-dlp 询问。命令行的 <x2/> 和 <x3/> 用 <x4/> 来设置它（<g5>#531</g5>、<g6>#769</g6>）。

dfda3e65e02aaf76.source: DDM splits a file into parts and downloads them over several connections at once:
dfda3e65e02aaf76.text: DDM 将文件分成多个部分，并通过多个连接同时下载：

dffdbe7958a45c24.source: Eight per download by default, and up to 32 if you choose in <g1>Options → Connection</g1>, or 128 after ticking <g2>Allow more than 32 connections</g2> there. DDM uses fewer when a server allows fewer, and only one when a server can't send parts of a file at all.
dffdbe7958a45c24.text: 默认情况下，每个下载使用八个连接。如果您在<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>中选择，最多可达32个；勾选<g2>允许超过32个连接</g2>后，可达128个。当服务器允许的连接数较少时，DDM会使用较少的连接；当服务器完全无法发送文件分段时，DDM只使用一个连接。

e00a7fba0e2de1d3.source: <g1>Under gallery-dl's names</g1>: each picture goes where gallery-dl would have saved it, so a gallery downloaded before by gallery-dl alone, or by DDM, finds its pictures and skips them.
e00a7fba0e2de1d3.text: <g1>沿用 gallery-dl 的命名</g1>：每张图片都保存在 gallery-dl 本会保存的位置，因此之前仅由 gallery-dl 或由 DDM 下载过的图库，能找到自己的图片并跳过它们。

e04c43357e5af3cf.source: A magnet link has to get the torrent's file list from other peers first. That can take a minute or two, and longer for torrents with few peers. If nobody answers in about three minutes, DDM gives up; try again later, or use the <x1/> file if the site offers one.
e04c43357e5af3cf.text: 磁力链接必须首先从其他对等点获取种子的文件列表。这可能需要一两分钟，对于对等点较少的种子则需要更长时间。如果大约三分钟内没有响应，DDM 会放弃；请稍后再试，或者如果网站提供<x1/>文件，请使用该文件。

e04f69d547a21d71.source: <g1>Native</g1>: your system's colours. Windows' accent colour (Settings → Personalization → Colors) and, when it is on, its contrast theme; the desktop's accent colour and its higher contrast setting on Linux (GNOME 47 and later, KDE Plasma); the accent colour on macOS. It follows them when you change them.
e04f69d547a21d71.text: <g1>本机</g1>：使用系统颜色。Windows 的强调色（设置 → 个性化 → 颜色），以及开启时的高对比度主题；Linux 桌面环境的强调色和高对比度设置（GNOME 47 及更高版本、KDE Plasma）；macOS 的强调色。更改这些设置时，DDM 也会随之更新。

e06604b0b93dfd79.source: There, DDM connects itself to your browsers at each start, has its tray icon, follows the system's light or dark look and uses the system's fonts and ffmpeg. The Mac app isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS asks before its first start: right-click it and choose <g1>Open</g1> (on macOS 15 and later, <g2>System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway</g2>). A <x3/> or <x4/> update opens in the system's installer. A few parts work only on Windows, and the help says so where it matters.
e06604b0b93dfd79.text: 在此，DDM 每次启动时都会自动连接到您的浏览器，拥有托盘图标，遵循系统的浅色或深色外观，并使用系统的字体和 ffmpeg。Mac 应用程序尚未获得 Apple 认证，因此 macOS 在首次启动前会询问：右键点击它并选择<g1>打开</g1>（在 macOS 15 及更高版本上，选择<g2>系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开</g2>）。<x3/> 或 <x4/> 更新会在系统的安装程序中打开。少数功能仅在 Windows 上可用，帮助文档会在相关位置说明。

e068510ba77259cf.source: The extension's button shows whether the browser reaches DDM. A red <g1>!</g1> means it doesn't; click the button to see why, and <g2>How to fix it</g2> opens the matching section of <g3>The browser and DDM aren't connected</g3>. While DDM downloads, the button shows how many downloads are running. The button also:
e068510ba77259cf.text: 扩展的按钮会显示浏览器能否连上 DDM。红色的<g1>!</g1>表示连不上；点击按钮可查看原因，<g2>如何修复</g2>会打开<g3>浏览器与 DDM 未连接</g3>中对应的部分。DDM 下载时，按钮会显示正在运行的下载数。按钮还提供：

e0ad26c06dcee181.source: 1 the start time, 2 once or on some days, 3 a stop time if you want one.
e0ad26c06dcee181.text: 1 开始时间，2 单次或某几天，3 如需要则设置停止时间。

e0d986e8a1aca326.source: <g1>Themes: View → Theme</g1> (<g2>#45</g2>). <g3>Classic</g3> is DDM's look, unchanged and still the default. <g4>Native</g4> takes your system's colours: Windows' accent colour and, when it is on, its contrast theme; the desktop's accent colour and higher-contrast setting on Linux (GNOME 47 and later, KDE Plasma); the accent colour on macOS; it follows them when they change. <g5>High contrast</g5> is black and white with a bright accent, every edge drawn and text at 7:1 or more. A theme applies at once, light and dark alike, and theme files in the themes folder (<g6>View → Theme → Open themes folder</g6>) are listed too; High contrast is itself such a file, in the same format. Six style themes keep the layout and bring their own control shapes, icons and, on Windows, a title bar DDM draws (resizing, Snap Layouts on Maximize, double-click and Alt+Space work as with the system's):
e0d986e8a1aca326.text: <g1>主题：视图 → 主题</g1>（<g2>#45</g2>）。<g3>经典</g3>是 DDM 的默认外观，保持不变。<g4>原生</g4>会采用您的系统颜色：Windows 的强调色，以及在启用时的高对比度主题；Linux（GNOME 47 及更高版本，KDE Plasma）的桌面强调色和高对比度设置；macOS 的强调色；当它们改变时，DDM 也会随之改变。<g5>高对比度</g5>是黑白配色，带有明亮的强调色，所有边缘都已绘制，文本对比度达到 7:1 或更高。主题会立即应用，无论亮色还是深色模式，主题文件夹（<g6>视图 → 主题 → 打开主题文件夹</g6>）中的主题文件也会被列出；“高对比度”本身就是这样一个文件，格式相同。六种样式主题保留了布局，并带来了它们自己的控件形状、图标，以及在 Windows 上由 DDM 绘制的标题栏（调整大小、“最大化”时的 Snap Layouts、双击和 Alt+Space 键功能与系统一致）：

e0ee3a5c79eaf814.source: Is the extension loaded and turned on? Look for <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> on the browser's extensions page. In Firefox, install it from addons.mozilla.org: a temporary add-on is gone after a restart. See <g2>Browser integration</g2>.
e0ee3a5c79eaf814.text: 扩展程序是否已加载并启用？在浏览器的扩展程序页面中查找<g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1>。在 Firefox 中，请从 addons.mozilla.org 安装扩展程序；临时附加组件会在重启后消失。另请参阅<g2>浏览器集成</g2>。

e0f4ab5df9c8188d.source: A running queue starts its downloads in list order, a few at a time (four by default). When one fails, it moves to the end of the queue and is tried again 30 seconds later. The queue stops when nothing is left to download.
e0f4ab5df9c8188d.text: 队列运行时，会按列表顺序启动下载任务，每次启动几个（默认 4 个）。下载失败后会移到队列末尾，并在 30 秒后重试。没有剩余下载任务时，队列会停止。

e0fd074a942a4d50.source: <g1>Delete</g1>: forget the project. Its downloads stay in the list (under All Downloads again) and its files on the disk.
e0fd074a942a4d50.text: <g1>删除</g1>：忘记该项目。其下载仍保留在列表中（再次位于“所有下载”下），其文件也保留在磁盘上。

e0fed74de34d9a29.source: <g1>Whole site for offline reading</g1> (or <g2>Make the pages work offline</g2> on any project) saves a site so that it opens and works from the disk, without a connection:
e0fed74de34d9a29.text: <g1>整个站点（供离线阅读）</g1>（或任何项目上的<g2>让页面可离线使用</g2>）会保存网站，使其可以从磁盘打开并运行，无需连接：

e12b9c165be3a951.source: DDM comes with an MCP server, so an AI assistant that supports MCP can work with the downloads in your running DDM. You ask in your own words, and it lists, adds, pauses or resumes them.
e12b9c165be3a951.text: DDM 附带一个 MCP 服务器，因此支持 MCP 的 AI 助手可以与您正在运行的 DDM 中的下载任务协同工作。您可以用自己的话提问，它会列出、添加、暂停或恢复下载。

e12c33d490b22dd0.text: 应用和主机共享的单实例通道（受令牌保护的本地套接字）、数据文件夹和捕获规则

e1484c9d0efe2cad.text: 移动或重命名所选下载

e149765f8bc9c999.source: <g1>Network adapter</g1> — <g2>Any (the system chooses)</g2> is the default. Pick an adapter, usually your VPN's, and every connection DDM opens goes out through it, or not at all. That covers downloads, FTP, torrents, video pages and image galleries, the DNS you chose, DDM's own downloads and the update check. It works as a kill switch: when the adapter disconnects, or the VPN is switched off, nothing goes out through your normal connection. Running downloads stop with "… is not connected" and start again when the adapter is back. The line under the list shows the adapter's address, or that it isn't connected.
e149765f8bc9c999.text: <g1>网络适配器</g1> — <g2>任何（系统选择）</g2>是默认设置。选择一个适配器，通常是 VPN 使用的适配器，DDM 打开的所有连接都会通过它发出，否则就不会发出。这包括下载、FTP、种子下载、视频页面和图片库、您选择的 DNS、DDM 自己的下载以及更新检查。它可用作终止开关：适配器断开连接或 VPN 关闭时，所有流量都不会通过您的常规连接发出。正在进行的下载会因“……未连接”而停止，并在适配器恢复连接后重新开始。列表下方会显示适配器的地址，或显示其未连接。

e14b9440fb335a93.source: The main window no longer freezes while a drive is slow to answer (a hard disk waking up, a USB drive, a network or mapped folder) as a download starts or resumes (<g1>Redownload</g1> too), as a finished download takes the name typed in its progress window, or as links are added without <g2>Download File Info</g2>: a copied link, a command line, <g3>Add batch download</g3>, <g4>Link grabber</g4>, the site grabber, a paired phone or computer and the torrents it sends. Each of these asked the disk on the window's own thread (is there something to resume, is the name taken, does the folder hold other files, the rename itself); they now ask beside the window, and the download shows as started at once. A link added this way shows its name numbered <x5/> once its folder has answered, and one that starts before then is numbered as it starts, so nothing is overwritten (follows <g6>#743</g6>).
e14b9440fb335a93.text: 当驱动器响应缓慢时（硬盘正在唤醒、USB 驱动器、网络或映射文件夹），主窗口不再冻结，这发生在：下载开始或恢复时（<g1>重新下载</g1>也一样）、已完成的下载采用其进度窗口中输入的名称时，或在不使用<g2>下载文件信息</g2>的情况下添加链接时：复制的链接、命令行、<g3>添加批量下载</g3>、<g4>链接抓取器</g4>、站点抓取器、已配对的手机或计算机以及它发来的种子。以上每种情况都曾在窗口自己的线程上询问磁盘（有没有可恢复的内容、名称是否已被占用、文件夹里是否有其他文件、重命名本身）；现在改为在窗口之外询问，下载会立即显示为已开始。以这种方式添加的链接，在其文件夹作出回答后，会显示带编号 <x5/> 的名称；在此之前就开始的，则在开始时编号，因此不会覆盖任何内容（接续 <g6>#743</g6>）。

e155a9e9fed089dd.source: The automation API is off by default. When you turn it on, it listens only on <x1/> (your own computer) and answers only programs that present the secret token from DDM's data folder.
e155a9e9fed089dd.text: 自动化 API 默认关闭。当您打开它时，它只监听<x1/>（您自己的电脑），并且只响应呈现 DDM 数据文件夹中秘密令牌的程序。

e15d599e6927add3.source: Options on its Save to page: a category, its file types and its folder
e15d599e6927add3.text: “选项”的“保存到”页面：一个类别、其文件类型和其文件夹。

e160eb1af05eac08.source: <g1>Use this proxy server</g1> — type the proxy's address, <g2>Port</g2>, and a <g3>User name</g3> and <g4>Password</g4> if it needs them, and keep ticked the protocols it is for (<g5>http</g5>, <g6>https</g6>). Choosing it ticks both when neither is: a proxy for neither would carry no download, and every download would go straight to its server. <g7>Advanced / Socks...</g7> chooses the proxy's kind: an <g8>HTTP proxy</g8> (the default), an <g9>HTTPS proxy</g9> (reached over TLS), <g10>SOCKS 4</g10> or <g11>SOCKS 5</g11>, and for SOCKS whether the proxy looks the servers' names up itself (<g12>DNS through the proxy</g12>, so your computer asks no DNS for them), with the address, port and login. The address then shows its kind (<x13/>); you can also type it that way.
e160eb1af05eac08.text: <g1>使用此代理服务器</g1> — 输入代理的地址、<g2>端口</g2>，如需要则输入<g3>用户名</g3>和<g4>密码</g4>，并保持勾选它适用的协议（<g5>http</g5>、<g6>https</g6>）。选择它时，若两者都未勾选，会同时勾选两者：两者都不适用的代理不会承载任何下载，所有下载都会直接连到其服务器。<g7>高级/Socks...</g7>用于选择代理的类型：<g8>HTTP 代理</g8>（默认）、<g9>HTTPS 代理</g9>（通过 TLS 连接）、<g10>SOCKS 4</g10> 或 <g11>SOCKS 5</g11>，对于 SOCKS，还可选择代理是否自己查找服务器名称（<g12>通过代理进行 DNS 解析</g12>，这样您的计算机不会为它们发出任何 DNS 请求），以及地址、端口和登录信息。此时地址会显示其类型（<x13/>）；您也可以这样输入。

e1713d442d1eea6d.source: Yes. Put downloads in a queue and let the Scheduler start it at a set time, stop it at another, and even shut down or put the computer to sleep when the…
e1713d442d1eea6d.text: 是。将下载任务放入队列，让计划程序在设定的时间开始下载，在另一个时间停止下载，甚至在队列完成后关闭计算机或使其进入睡眠状态。

e184a8bf2e5e8059.source: <g1>The progress window's Speed Limiter</g1> took a speed set with a screen reader or UI Automation only after the focus moved on, and its "Remember Speed Limiter settings for this file" check box had no name. A speed set that way applies at once, and the box is named.
e184a8bf2e5e8059.text: <g1>进度窗口的“速度限制器”</g1>在焦点移动后才应用通过屏幕阅读器或 UI 自动化设置的速度，并且其“记住此文件的限速器设置”复选框没有名称。现在，以这种方式设置的速度会立即应用，并且该复选框已命名。

e1ab431f14758e3d.text: 无障碍下载管理器：屏幕阅读器和全键盘操作 — Dannex Download Manager

e1bd121dfc6ea3a8.source: The copy from DDM's folder stands aside only while the store's copy reaches DDM. It stays the one that acts when the store's copy is turned off on the browser's extensions page, or can't reach DDM (when DDM is too old to accept the store's copy, <g1>update DDM</g1>). Removed or turned off there, the store's copy gives the work back at the next download, and turned on again it takes it back the same way: never both at once. Switched OFF with its toolbar button, the store's copy keeps the other copy off too: OFF means OFF in that browser.
e1bd121dfc6ea3a8.text: 来自 DDM 文件夹的副本只在应用商店的副本能连接 DDM 时才让路。当应用商店的副本在浏览器的扩展页面中被关闭，或无法连接 DDM 时（当 DDM 太旧而不接受应用商店的副本时，请<g1>更新 DDM</g1>），它仍是执行工作的那个。应用商店的副本在那里被移除或关闭后，会在下次下载时把工作交还；重新开启后，同样在下次下载时接回工作：绝不会两者同时工作。若用其工具栏按钮将应用商店的副本切换为“关”，另一个副本也会保持关闭：在该浏览器中，“关”就是“关”。

e1c58f7c0679af79.source: A bar of the whole file, showing where each connection started and how far it has got (<g1>Each connection's part of the file</g1>).
e1c58f7c0679af79.text: 整个文件的条形图，显示每个连接从哪里开始以及已进行到哪里（<g1>每个连接负责的文件部分</g1>）。

e1c931588a9c48dc.source: <g1>A magnet link could wait minutes for its file list</g1> (<g2>#92</g2>): in {v1} on Windows, the DHT (how DDM finds peers without trackers) could stop for the rest of the session once a computer it asked was gone, so a magnet its trackers didn't serve never got its file list. The updated torrent library keeps going, and a test keeps it that way. <g3>Add torrent</g3> now shows the wait: the peers found, from the trackers, the DHT or the local network, and how many answered. After 30 seconds without an answer, it says what may be in the way.
e1c931588a9c48dc.text: <g1>磁力链接可能需要数分钟才能获取其文件列表</g1>（<g2>#92</g2>）：在 Windows 上的 {v1} 版本中，DHT（DDM 在没有追踪器的情况下查找对等点的方式）一旦其请求的计算机消失，可能会在会话的其余时间停止，因此其追踪器未提供服务的磁力链接永远无法获取其文件列表。更新后的 torrent 库会继续运行，并且一项测试会保持这种状态。<g3>添加种子</g3>现在会显示等待情况：找到的对等点（来自追踪器、DHT 或本地网络），以及有多少个响应。在 30 秒内没有响应后，它会说明可能存在的问题。

e1cb5a9a23d26236.source: The video window listing a playlist's videos, each with its length and a box to tick, and one quality for all
e1cb5a9a23d26236.text: 视频窗口列出播放列表中的视频，每个视频都显示时长和复选框，所有视频使用相同的画质

e1cd2dd85466f5b2.source: <g1>No silent overwrite</g1>: when some of a torrent's files are already in the folder, DDM asks before writing into them (<g2>No</g2> is the default). The command line's <x3/> stops and names them, unless given <x4/>.
e1cd2dd85466f5b2.text: <g1>无静默覆盖</g1>：当洪流的某些文件已存在于文件夹中时，DDM 会在写入之前询问（默认选择<g2>否</g2>）。命令行中的<x3/>会停止并列出这些文件，除非给定<x4/>。

e1dc7e2037c9dcf4.source: <g1>Its settings</g1>: <g2>Options → General → DDM's download button over videos in browsers → Edit...</g2>: turn it off; show it <g3>Over videos</g3>, <g4>Over sound players</g4>, or both; leave it off media shorter than so many seconds (the browser knows a video's length once its player has loaded it, and shows the button until then); choose <g5>Where it shows first</g5> (top right unless you choose another corner; dragged elsewhere on a site, it stays there on that site); and see or edit the sites it never shows on. <g6>Never on</g6> in the button's menu adds to that list, and a site added there while Options is open is kept when you click OK.
e1dc7e2037c9dcf4.text: <g1>其设置</g1>：<g2>选项 → 常规 → DDM 在浏览器中视频上的下载按钮 → 编辑...</g2>：可将其关闭；可选择显示在<g3>视频上</g3>、<g4>音频播放器上</g4>，或两者；可让它不在短于若干秒的媒体上显示（视频的播放器加载后，浏览器才知道其长度，在此之前会一直显示按钮）；选择<g5>首次显示位置</g5>（默认右上角，除非您选择其他角落；在某站点上拖到别处后，它会在该站点上保持在那里）；并查看或编辑它永不显示的站点。按钮菜单中的<g6>永不在此显示</g6>会添加到该列表，而在选项打开期间添加的站点，在您单击“确定”时会被保留。

e1e7fd2c10af0107.source: "Download https://example.com/big.iso to D:\ISOs tonight, don't start it yet."
e1e7fd2c10af0107.text: “今晚把 https://example.com/big.iso 下载到 D:\ISOs，暂时不要开始下载。”

e1fdac1fe283477a.source: DDM works with screen readers such as Narrator and NVDA, which hear what each control is and its state. Everything can be done from the keyboard, with the keys most Windows programs use.
e1fdac1fe283477a.text: DDM 支持 Narrator 和 NVDA 等屏幕阅读器，它们能识别每个控件及其状态。所有操作都可通过键盘完成，使用大多数 Windows 程序通用的按键。

e223e3a95d43428a.source: <g1>Open folder no longer freezes the window</g1> (<g2>#222</g2>): Download complete's <g3>Open folder</g3> asks the desktop's file manager (over D-Bus) to show the file, and DDM waited for its answer on the window's own thread. A file manager slow to start, or one that never answered (seen on Pop!_OS), froze the window until the freeze report caught it. DDM now asks in the background and, when the file manager hasn't answered within 5 seconds, opens the folder instead. Every other program DDM starts from a window goes the same way, on every system: Test browser integration's <g4>Set it up</g4>, moving an extracted archive to the Trash (on a Mac the Finder may ask first), putting an update in place (<g5>Installing the update...</g5>, with Cancel greyed while it runs), opening pages and folders, reading the icon theme on Linux and, on a Mac, the accent colour (every 2 seconds with the Native theme) and the system's version for a bug report.
e223e3a95d43428a.text: <g1>“打开文件夹”不再冻结窗口</g1> (<g2>#222</g2>)：“下载完成”的<g3>打开文件夹</g3>会请求桌面文件管理器（通过 D-Bus）显示文件，而 DDM 会在窗口自己的线程上等待其响应。启动缓慢或从未响应的文件管理器（在 Pop!_OS 上出现过）会冻结窗口，直到冻结报告捕获到它。DDM 现在会在后台请求，如果文件管理器在 5 秒内没有响应，则会转而打开文件夹。DDM 从窗口启动的所有其他程序在所有系统上都以相同的方式运行：“测试浏览器集成”的<g4>设置</g4>，将提取的存档移动到垃圾箱（在 Mac 上 Finder 可能会先询问），安装更新（<g5>正在安装更新...</g5>，运行时“取消”按钮会变灰），打开页面和文件夹，在 Linux 上读取图标主题，以及在 Mac 上读取强调色（使用原生主题时每 2 秒一次）和系统版本以用于错误报告。

e22ececa331ea68b.source: In DDM, click <g1>Add URL</g1> on the toolbar (or press <g2>Ctrl+N</g2>). The address is already filled in.
e22ececa331ea68b.text: 在 DDM 中，点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 URL</g1>（或按<g2>Ctrl+N</g2>）。地址已自动填写。

e235ba57a40331e3.source: A few settings live outside this window:
e235ba57a40331e3.text: 一些设置不在本窗口中：

e2847603e155099c.source: In Safari open <g1>Settings → Extensions</g1> and tick <g2>Dannex Download Manager</g2>. Click <g3>Always Allow on Every Website</g3>: the extension needs to read the site to pass your sign-in on.
e2847603e155099c.text: 在 Safari 中打开<g1>设置 → 扩展</g1>，然后勾选<g2>Dannex Download Manager</g2>。点击<g3>始终允许在每个网站上</g3>：扩展程序需要读取网站才能传递您的登录信息。

e2b96614efaa036c.source: The drop target's edge at rest
e2b96614efaa036c.text: 放置目标在静止时的边缘

e2d3a15847aa0c81.source: Point at the button: its tooltip says which of these it is, and what a click does.
e2d3a15847aa0c81.text: 将鼠标指向该按钮：其提示会说明是上述哪种状态，以及单击的作用。

e2e30d683ce66b3d.source: <g1>Zen on Windows:</g1> Zen 1.21.15b and later have a bug of their own that keeps add-ons from reaching their helper program (<g2>zen-browser/desktop#15432</g2>), with any add-on that uses one. Until Zen fixes it, Zen 1.21.14b works.
e2e30d683ce66b3d.text: <g1>Windows 上的 Zen：</g1>Zen 1.21.15b 及更高版本存在一个自身的错误，会导致使用辅助程序的附加组件无法连接到辅助程序（<g2>zen-browser/desktop#15432</g2>）。在 Zen 修复此问题之前，可以使用 Zen 1.21.14b。

e2f5e55e73258c80.source: <g1>Connections.</g1> Passive mode is used by default. <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks → Use FTP in PASV mode</g2> switches it off for servers that only take active connections. FTP connects to the server directly, not through the HTTP proxy.
e2f5e55e73258c80.text: <g1>连接。</g1>默认使用被动模式。对于只接受主动连接的服务器，可通过<g2>选项 → 代理/Socks → 在 PASV 模式下使用 FTP</g2>关闭被动模式。FTP 会直接连接服务器，不会通过 HTTP 代理。

e34d09bf6290c953.source: By default DDM asks what to do when you add an address it already has. You can choose a fixed answer in <g1>Options → Downloads → When an address is already in the list</g1>:
e34d09bf6290c953.text: 默认情况下，当您添加 DDM 已有的地址时，DDM 会询问如何处理。您可以在<g1>选项 → 下载 → 当地址已在列表中时</g1>中选择固定的处理方式：

e37099375f584f2c.source: Choose <g1>Tasks → Show drop target</g1>. A small box with the DDM icon appears and stays on top of other windows.
e37099375f584f2c.text: 选择<g1>任务 → 显示拖放目标</g1>。一个带有 DDM 图标的小方框将出现并停留在其他窗口的顶部。

e38a24751a3a8acc.source: Safari gives an extension's button no right-click menu: the click works the same, and <g1>Safari → Settings → Extensions → DDM Integration Module → Settings</g1> opens the options page, which says when DDM can't be reached and links to the status page.
e38a24751a3a8acc.text: Safari 不给扩展的按钮提供右键菜单：单击的作用相同，而<g1>Safari → 设置 → 扩展 → DDM Integration Module → 设置</g1>会打开选项页，当无法连接 DDM 时，该页会说明并链接到状态页。

e38c452f0cd105a5.source: <g1>Downloads go to another Dannex Download Manager</g1>, and its address
e38c452f0cd105a5.text: <g1>下载将发送到另一个 Dannex Download Manager</g1>，以及其地址

e3bcd4a87942a4bb.source: <g1>A minimized DDM keeps working</g1>: with the main window minimized (not to the notification area), queues didn't start their next file, the Scheduler's starts and stops didn't fire, download limits, the network adapter's kill switch, the clipboard monitor, the update check, the taskbar's progress and saving the list all waited until the window was restored. They run in every window state now, and their windows (Download complete, a limit's notice) open at once.
e3bcd4a87942a4bb.text: <g1>最小化后的 DDM 仍可正常工作</g1>：当主窗口最小化（未最小化到通知区域）时，队列不会启动下一个文件，“计划程序”的启动和停止不会触发，下载限制、网络适配器的断路开关、剪贴板监视器、更新检查、任务栏进度和保存列表都会等待，直到窗口恢复。它们现在在所有窗口状态下运行，并且它们的窗口（下载完成、限制通知）会立即打开。

e3bd4e21e71baec4.source: When you start a download that DDM should take, it passes <g1>the download's address (and where its redirects led), the page it came from, the site's cookies for that address, your browser's User-Agent, and the file's name, size and type</g1> to DDM on your computer, through the browser's native-messaging channel. Nothing goes over the internet.
e3bd4e21e71baec4.text: 当您开始一个应由 DDM 处理的下载时，它会通过浏览器的原生消息通道，将<g1>下载地址（以及其重定向到的地址）、来源页面、该地址的网站 cookie、您的浏览器 User-Agent，以及文件名称、大小和类型</g1>传递给您计算机上的 DDM。没有任何信息会通过互联网传输。

e3bf39c2a21c6fe0.source: Linux: dark mode follows the desktop, and a slow keyring or sleep service no longer freezes the window.
e3bf39c2a21c6fe0.text: Linux：深色模式现在会跟随桌面设置，并且密钥环或休眠服务缓慢不再导致窗口冻结。

e3ce2a886e89c710.source: Restart the browser after setting it up.
e3ce2a886e89c710.text: 设置完成后重启浏览器。

e3d0039a6c109869.source: Video pages through yt-dlp and ffmpeg, image galleries through gallery-dl (run as separate programs); while a network adapter is chosen, their connections go through a proxy of DDM's on 127.0.0.1 that binds them to it (<x1/>)
e3d0039a6c109869.text: 视频页面通过 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，图片画廊通过 gallery-dl（作为独立程序运行）；当选择网络适配器时，它们的连接通过 DDM 在 127.0.0.1 上的代理，将它们绑定到该适配器 (<x1/>)

e3da3e83e9ba3cf7.source: A bar of the whole file, showing where each connection started and how far it has got (<g1>Start positions and download progress by connections</g1>).
e3da3e83e9ba3cf7.text: 显示整个文件的进度条，显示每个连接的起始位置和已完成的进度（<g1>连接的起始位置和下载进度</g1>）。

e3f369ad490fe3c9.source: DDM doesn't accept this copy of the extension
e3f369ad490fe3c9.text: DDM 不接受此扩展程序副本

e3f982054be16bb9.source: DDM has to be running for a schedule to fire. Closing the main window is fine: DDM keeps going in the notification area.
e3f982054be16bb9.text: DDM 必须运行才能触发计划。关闭主窗口没关系：DDM 会在通知区域继续运行。

e4068d69914b5fb5.source: Paste the page's address and click Look up.
e4068d69914b5fb5.text: 粘贴页面地址，然后点击“查找”。

e40af828c5451c4e.source: <g1>DDM checks for updates every time it starts</g1> (it was once a week), and once a day while it stays open; a new version's window opens in front. <g2>Check for updates at every start</g2> in that window turns it off.
e40af828c5451c4e.text: <g1>DDM 现在每次启动时都会检查更新</g1>（以前每周检查一次），启动后也会每天检查一次；发现新版本时，会在前台打开新版本窗口。您可以在该窗口中关闭<g2>每次启动时检查更新</g2>。

e421fce0972d9f45.source: DDM follows your system: when Windows (or your desktop's light/dark preference on Linux and macOS) is set to dark mode, so is DDM. To keep DDM light whatever the system does, turn off <g1>View → Follow the system's dark mode</g1>. To keep it dark whatever the system does, for example on a desktop that reports no preference, turn on <g2>View → Always dark</g2>.
e421fce0972d9f45.text: DDM 会跟随您的系统：当 Windows（或 Linux 和 macOS 上桌面的浅色/深色偏好）设置为深色模式时，DDM 也是深色。若要无论系统如何设置都让 DDM 保持浅色，请关闭<g1>视图 → 跟随系统深色模式</g1>。若要无论系统如何设置都让它保持深色，例如在不报告偏好的桌面上，请开启<g2>视图 → 始终为深色</g2>。

e43399c3cb09d9d5.source: <g1>Paused and resumed</g1> like a file, also after quitting DDM: a picture stopped half-way carries on from the bytes already saved.
e43399c3cb09d9d5.text: <g1>像文件一样暂停和恢复</g1>，退出 DDM 后也一样：下载到一半停止的图片会从已保存的字节继续。

e43b04ea6376c4d2.source: DDM is made by its contributors on GitHub, on the code of Mister Download Manager by Ahmed Nefzaoui, and is open to contributions from anyone. Bug reports, translations and code are all welcome.
e43b04ea6376c4d2.text: DDM 由其贡献者在 GitHub 上开发，基于 Ahmed Nefzaoui 的 Mister Download Manager 代码，欢迎任何人参与贡献。欢迎提交问题报告、翻译和代码。

e44930d18622541d.source: Choose the next category (<g1>Compressed</g1>, <g2>Documents</g2>, <g3>Music</g3>, <g4>Programs</g4>, <g5>Video</g5>, <g6>Torrents</g6>) and do the same, for example <x7/>.
e44930d18622541d.text: 选择下一个类别（<g1>压缩文件</g1>、<g2>文档</g2>、<g3>音乐</g3>、<g4>程序</g4>、<g5>视频</g5>、<g6>种子</g6>），并执行相同的操作，例如<x7/>。

e44dd767faa213c2.source: Browser integration has two parts: a small helper program that the browser talks to, and the extension itself.
e44dd767faa213c2.text: 浏览器集成包含两部分：一个与浏览器通信的小型辅助程序，以及扩展程序本身。

e44e9b91ddb08e75.source: A toolbar button under the pointer

e46c8baf47223d4c.source: Report a problem with this page

e4770c93a995f627.source: The right-click menu has everything you can do with a download: <g1>Open</g1>, <g2>Open with...</g2>, <g3>Open folder</g3>, <g4>Move/Rename</g4>, <g5>Redownload</g5>, <g6>Resume Download</g6>, <g7>Stop Download</g7>, <g8>Refresh download address</g8>, <g9>Verify checksum...</g9>, <g10>Remove</g10>, <g11>Add to queue</g11> and <g12>Properties</g12>.
e4770c93a995f627.text: 右键菜单包含您可以对下载执行的所有操作：<g1>打开</g1>、<g2>打开方式...</g2>、<g3>打开文件夹</g3>、<g4>移动/重命名</g4>、<g5>重新下载</g5>、<g6>恢复下载</g6>、<g7>停止下载</g7>、<g8>刷新下载地址</g8>、<g9>验证校验和...</g9>、<g10>删除</g10>、<g11>添加到队列</g11>和<g12>属性</g12>。

e48780192b31cd14.source: <g1>Listen on</g1> — every local network address (the default), this computer only, or one address.
e48780192b31cd14.text: <g1>监听</g1> — 所有本地网络地址（默认）、仅此电脑，或一个特定地址。

e49c7399c2758861.source: Pick your language. View → Language changes it later.
e49c7399c2758861.text: 选择您的语言。之后可通过“视图 → 语言”更改。

e4ada2c56399759e.text: 我在哪里可以获得帮助？

e4b0b20e9d8b83db.source: From version {v1}, only if you choose them:
e4b0b20e9d8b83db.text: 从 {v1} 版本开始，仅当您选择时：

e4cea97fb84ee033.source: The download stays in the list under <g1>Finished</g1>. To get rid of the entry later, select it and press <g2>Delete</g2>; tick <g3>Also delete the file from disk</g3> only if you want the file gone too.
e4cea97fb84ee033.text: 下载会保留在<g1>已完成</g1>列表中。要稍后删除该条目，请选择它并按<g2>删除</g2>；仅当您也想删除文件时，才勾选<g3>同时从磁盘中删除文件</g3>。

e4d3ed91ef5779c0.source: The window no longer waits for the program that owns the clipboard. A text box's right-click menu (to offer <g1>Paste</g1>) and <g2>Add URL</g2>, <g3>Add batch download</g3>, <g4>Add torrent</g4> and <g5>Download video</g5> (to fill in a copied link) read the clipboard on the window's own thread, so a program that held the clipboard without answering (on Linux, where a read waited up to 4 seconds each time, and while the right-click menu was open at every frame; on Windows, a program that had stopped responding) held up DDM's window too. They now read it beside the window, as the clipboard monitor has since {v1}; a link copied just before still fills the box as the window opens (follows <g6>#418</g6>).
e4d3ed91ef5779c0.text: 窗口不再等待占用剪贴板的程序。文本框的右键菜单（用于提供<g1>粘贴</g1>）以及<g2>添加 URL</g2>、<g3>添加批量下载</g3>、<g4>添加种子</g4>和<g5>下载视频</g5>（用于填入复制的链接）曾在窗口自己的线程上读取剪贴板，所以占着剪贴板却不回应的程序（在 Linux 上，每次读取最多等待 4 秒，而且右键菜单打开期间每一帧都在读；在 Windows 上，则是已停止响应的程序）也会拖住 DDM 的窗口。现在它们在窗口之外读取，剪贴板监视器自 {v1} 起就是这样；刚刚复制的链接在窗口打开时仍会填入输入框（接续 <g6>#418</g6>）。

e4f6fc43ebf4b378.source: <g1>The download stops with an error:</g1> see <g2>Resume a broken download</g2>.
e4f6fc43ebf4b378.text: <g1>下载因错误停止：</g1>请参阅<g2>恢复中断的下载</g2>。

e51339e06df148a6.source: DDM downloads the file itself, as it was uploaded (a video comes in its own format, not the player's copy), with its real name and size, over several connections, and it can resume. For a large file, Drive shows a page that says it <g1>can't scan this file for viruses</g1>; DDM goes past it as <g2>Download anyway</g2> does.
e51339e06df148a6.text: DDM 会下载文件本身，也就是上传时的文件（视频会以自身格式下载，而不是播放器中的副本），并使用文件的实际名称和大小。下载会通过多个连接进行，也可以恢复。对于大文件，Drive 会显示“<g1>无法扫描此文件是否含有病毒</g1>”的提示页面；DDM 会像点击<g2>仍然下载</g2>一样跳过此页面。

e519f7b9ebe9437b.source: If the site asks for a user name and password, type them under <g1>Login and cookies</g1>. A site that needs you signed in with its own page takes the <g2>Cookies</g2> your browser sends it, written as the browser sends them: <x3/>. The login and the cookies are sent to the start address's site only, never to another site its pages link to. A login saved in <g4>Options → Sites Logins</g4> for that site is used too.
e519f7b9ebe9437b.text: 如果站点要求用户名和密码，请在<g1>登录信息和 Cookie</g1>下输入。需要您通过其自己的页面登录的站点，会使用您的浏览器发送给它的 <g2>Cookie</g2>，其写法与浏览器发送时相同：<x3/>。登录信息和 Cookie 仅发送到起始地址所在的站点，绝不会发送到其页面链接指向的其他站点。在<g4>选项 → 站点登录</g4>中为该站点保存的登录信息也会被使用。

e52b31d58add8742.source: The list's order is the order accounts are asked: a link goes through the first account whose service supports its host. <g1>Up</g1> and <g2>Down</g2> change it.
e52b31d58add8742.text: 列表顺序决定尝试帐户的顺序：链接会使用第一个支持该文件托管网站的帐户。点击<g1>上移</g1>和<g2>下移</g2>可更改顺序。

e5436ff88071ec64.source: Your phone opens a small page that DDM itself serves on your home network. Paste a link, a magnet link or a torrent file, and watch it download on the computer. Nothing to install on the phone, and no outside service.
e5436ff88071ec64.text: 您的手机会打开一个由 DDM 在您的家庭网络上提供的小页面。粘贴链接、磁力链接或种子文件，然后观看它在电脑上下载。手机上无需安装任何东西，也无需外部服务。

e54db90504acbb23.source: It comes <g1>without any warranty</g1>: use it at your own risk.
e54db90504acbb23.text: 本软件<g1>不提供任何担保</g1>：使用风险自负。

e55767cab9916a15.source: On Windows, DDM draws its windows with Direct3D 12; on Linux and macOS, with OpenGL, or with Vulkan (Linux) or Metal (macOS) when you choose them. A graphics driver can still misbehave: a window that holds still for seconds, flickers, or shows wrong colours or blocks. Try the other one: choose <g1>View → Draw with → OpenGL</g1> (or <g2>Direct3D</g2>, <g3>Vulkan</g3>, <g4>Metal</g4>), then quit DDM (<g5>Tasks → Exit</g5>) and start it again. Choosing the first one goes back the same way.
e55767cab9916a15.text: 在 Windows 上，DDM 使用 Direct3D 12 绘制窗口；在 Linux 和 macOS 上使用 OpenGL，也可选择 Vulkan（Linux）或 Metal（macOS）。图形驱动程序仍可能出现问题：窗口卡住几秒、闪烁，或显示错误的颜色或方块。可以尝试另一种绘制方式：选择<g1>视图 → 绘制方式 → OpenGL</g1>（或<g2>Direct3D</g2>、<g3>Vulkan</g3>、<g4>Metal</g4>），然后退出 DDM（<g5>任务 → 退出</g5>）并重新启动。要切回原来的绘制方式，也按相同步骤操作。

e55e44a52db6eeb2.source: It can't change DDM's options, see your browser, or turn on DDM's automation API by itself. DDM has to be running: the server can't start it for you.
e55e44a52db6eeb2.text: 它无法更改 DDM 的选项，无法查看您的浏览器，也无法自行开启 DDM 的自动化 API。DDM 必须正在运行：服务器无法为您启动它。

e571a12e9be69853.text: 在已打开的菜单中移动

e58201c9e004a361.source: By default DDM asks what to do when you add an address it already has. You can choose a fixed answer in <g1>Options → Downloads → If a duplicate download link is added</g1>:
e58201c9e004a361.text: 默认情况下，当您添加一个已有的地址时，DDM 会询问如何处理。您可以在<g1>选项 → 下载 → 如果添加了重复的下载链接</g1>中选择一个固定答案：

e58722e22694ceea.source: Browser extension that sends downloads to a download manager
e58722e22694ceea.text: 将下载发送到下载管理器的浏览器扩展

e59887ade52d6298.source: <g1><g2>Find a download in a long list</g2></g1> — Find, Find Next and column filters.
e59887ade52d6298.text: <g1><g2>在长列表中查找下载</g2></g1> — 查找、查找下一个和列筛选器。

e59a5f7de780b5ae.source: Install DDM with the setup and keep <g1>Set up browser integration</g1> ticked. In Firefox, then open <g2>the add-on's page on addons.mozilla.org</g2> and click <g3>Add to Firefox</g3>. In Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi, open <g4>its page in the Chrome Web Store</g4> and click <g5>Add to Chrome</g5> (Edge shows <g6>Get</g6>, and first asks to allow extensions from other stores). Can't use a store? Open the browser's extensions page, turn on Developer mode, choose <g7>Load unpacked</g7> and pick the <x8/> folder in DDM's folder. The <g9>tutorial</g9> walks through it.
e59a5f7de780b5ae.text: 使用安装程序安装 DDM，并勾选<g1>设置浏览器集成</g1>。在 Firefox 中，打开<g2>addons.mozilla.org 上的附加组件页面</g2>，然后点击<g3>添加到 Firefox</g3>。在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 中，打开<g4>Chrome 网上应用店中的页面</g4>，然后点击<g5>添加到 Chrome</g5>（Edge 显示<g6>获取</g6>，并首先要求允许来自其他商店的扩展）。无法使用商店？打开浏览器的扩展程序页面，开启开发者模式，选择<g7>加载已解压的扩展程序</g7>，然后选择 DDM 文件夹中的<x8/>文件夹。<g9>教程</g9>会详细介绍。

e59c26fc4c032009.source: The same DDM, without a window
e59c26fc4c032009.text: 相同的 DDM，无窗口运行

e5a7240e9ee9a3e8.source: <g1>7z and RAR archives need 7-Zip</g1>, a free program (<g2>7-zip.org</g2>). DDM runs it when it is installed, for split and encrypted archives too. RAR's own extraction code can't be part of a free program like DDM, and 7-Zip extracts 7z best.
e5a7240e9ee9a3e8.text: <g1>7z 和 RAR 存档需要 7-Zip</g1>，这是一款免费程序（<g2>7-zip.org</g2>）。安装 7-Zip 后，DDM 会调用它，也支持提取分卷和加密存档。RAR 自带的提取代码不能纳入 DDM 这类免费程序，而提取 7z 存档时，7-Zip 的效果最好。

e5a8ea4bac40a639.source: General: how DDM starts, and what it takes from the clipboard and the browsers.
e5a8ea4bac40a639.text: 常规：DDM 如何启动，以及它从剪贴板和浏览器中获取什么。

e5b3b7f0c4199fec.source: The Scheduler: the queues on the left, the Main download queue's Schedule tab on the right with Start at, Repeat on, Stop at and When done, turn off the computer
e5b3b7f0c4199fec.text: 计划程序：左侧是队列，右侧是主下载队列的“计划”选项卡，其中有开始于、每周重复于、停止于和完成后关闭计算机

e5bd466999411a6a.source: <g1>Linux: torrents work on a system without CA certificates too</g1> (part of <g2>#264</g2>): the torrent engine built its own connection for the trackers, which can't be made without them, so no torrent or magnet link started there. It now uses DDM's: peers, the DHT and <x3/> trackers work, and an <x4/> tracker fails saying there are no certificates to check it with.
e5bd466999411a6a.text: <g1>Linux：在没有 CA 证书的系统上，种子下载也能工作</g1>（<g2>#264</g2> 的一部分）：种子引擎为跟踪器构建了自己的连接，没有证书就无法建立，因此无法启动任何种子或磁力链接。现在它使用 DDM 的连接：对等点、DHT 和 <x3/> 跟踪器可以工作，而 <x4/> 跟踪器会因没有证书可供检查而失败。

e5c18c89ba8f7efe.source: <g1>Move it</g1>: drag it anywhere along the video's edge; it snaps to the nearest edge and stays there on that site.
e5c18c89ba8f7efe.text: <g1>移动它</g1>：沿视频边缘将其拖动到任何位置；它会吸附到最近的边缘，并停留在该网站上。

e5d6948eb4c4409c.source: The same list is in DDM under Help → Keyboard shortcuts, and the menus show each command's keys beside it. On a Mac, ⌘ (Command) takes the place of Ctrl: ⌘N…
e5d6948eb4c4409c.text: DDM 的“帮助”→“键盘快捷方式”下也有相同的列表，菜单中每个命令旁边都显示其快捷键。在 Mac 上，⌘ (Command) 键取代 Ctrl 键：⌘N...

e5d979d50ed29223.source: <g1>Image galleries come through DDM's own downloader:</g1> gallery-dl now only lists a gallery's files, and DDM downloads them, several at once over its own connections, as it does videos. One speed limit holds for the whole gallery and changes at once without a restart; <g2>Stop</g2> keeps half-downloaded pictures and <g3>Resume</g3> carries on from them, also after DDM restarts; the progress window counts the files ("12 of 40 files"). What only gallery-dl can fetch (videos it hands to yt-dlp, text files, a file that needs its login session) it still downloads itself afterwards, and so does a gallery-dl older than 1.27.7. Checked with gallery-dl 1.32.21 on Wikimedia Commons, also stopped hard part-way and resumed: every picture identical to one downloaded in one go. <x4/> on the command line takes <x5/> for the files at once (<g6>#769</g6>).
e5d979d50ed29223.text: <g1>图片库改由 DDM 自己的下载器下载：</g1>gallery-dl 现在只列出图片库中的文件，由 DDM 通过自己的连接同时下载多个文件，与下载视频的方式相同。整个图片库共用一个速度限制，修改后立即生效，无需重启；<g2>停止</g2>会保留下载到一半的图片，<g3>恢复</g3>可从这些图片继续，DDM 重启后也可以；进度窗口会统计文件数（“已完成 12 个，共 40 个文件”）。只有 gallery-dl 才能获取的内容（它交给 yt-dlp 的视频、文本文件、需要其登录会话的文件）仍由它在之后自行下载，低于 1.27.7 的 gallery-dl 也是如此。已用 gallery-dl 1.32.21 在 Wikimedia Commons 上检查，并在中途强制停止后恢复：每张图片都与一次性下载的完全一致。命令行中的 <x4/> 可用 <x5/> 指定同时下载的文件数（<g6>#769</g6>）。

e5ed5b1460c13fe3.source: The main window in the Native theme

e60c7523a81bb80a.source: <g1>One link directly, and the command line</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>): <g3>Download File Info</g3> says which account a link goes through (<g4>Download through Real-Debrid (your account)</g4>); untick it to download that link directly. <g5>File Properties</g5> has the same choice for a download in the list, and DDM keeps it after a restart. The command line's <x6/> and <x7/> go through the accounts of <g8>Options → Accounts</g8> too, and <x9/> skips them. A download the browser had already started stays direct after a restart, and when one service doesn't answer, the other accounts still work.
e60c7523a81bb80a.text: <g1>直接下载一个链接，以及命令行</g1> (<g2>#44</g2>)：<g3>下载文件信息</g3>会显示链接通过哪个账户下载（<g4>通过 Real-Debrid 下载（您的账户）</g4>）；取消勾选即可直接下载该链接。<g5>文件属性</g5>对列表中的下载任务也有相同的选择，DDM 会在重启后保留此设置。命令行的 <x6/> 和 <x7/> 也会通过<g8>选项 → 账户</g8>中的账户下载，<x9/> 则跳过它们。浏览器已开始的下载在重启后仍保持直接下载，并且当一个服务没有响应时，其他账户仍然可以工作。

e6628d3e0c7c32ea.source: <g1>Start when Dannex Download Manager starts</g1> — start the queue whenever DDM starts.
e6628d3e0c7c32ea.text: <g1>Dannex Download Manager 启动时开始</g1> — 每当 DDM 启动时就启动该队列。

e67bd34b79057e7a.source: <g1>source</g1> is the English text; leave it as it is. Change only <g2>translation</g2>.
e67bd34b79057e7a.text: <g1>source</g1>是英文文本；请保持不变。只更改<g2>translation</g2>。

e680897e60d1dca2.source: To bring the built-in categories back as they came, with their names, file types and folders, use <g1>Options → Save to → Restore the built-in categories</g1>. Your own categories, General and Torrents stay as they are.
e680897e60d1dca2.text: 要将内置类别恢复为初始状态，包括名称、文件类型和文件夹，请使用<g1>选项 → 保存到 → 恢复内置类别</g1>。自定义类别、常规和种子类别保持不变。

e6ca662933d9e242.source: DDM opens the web page the link came from (when it knows it), and the download's <g1>File Properties</g1>.
e6ca662933d9e242.text: DDM 会打开链接来源的网页（如果它知道），以及下载的<g1>文件属性</g1>。

e6cd6b0d42e3c7e1.source: When an address is already in the list, DDM asks what to do, or follows the answer you chose in <g1>Options → Downloads → If a duplicate download link is added</g1>.
e6cd6b0d42e3c7e1.text: 当地址已在列表中时，DDM 会询问如何处理，或者遵循您在<g1>选项 → 下载 → 如果添加了重复的下载链接</g1>中选择的答案。

e6cee4e27613942f.source: DDM contains no adware, spyware, bundled offers or tracking. Its whole source code is public, so anyone can check what it does, and every release is built from that code by GitHub's servers, where the build can be inspected. The helper programs it can fetch for videos are verified before they run: yt-dlp against its developers' signing key, ffmpeg against its published checksums. Download DDM only from this site or the project's GitHub releases.
e6cee4e27613942f.text: DDM 不含广告软件、间谍软件、捆绑软件或跟踪功能。它的全部源代码都是公开的，任何人都可以检查其功能；每个版本都由 GitHub 的服务器根据这份代码构建，构建过程也可以检查。它为下载视频而获取的辅助程序在运行前都会经过验证：yt-dlp 会与其开发者的签名密钥进行验证，ffmpeg 会与其发布的校验和进行核对。请仅从本网站或项目的 GitHub 发布页面下载 DDM。

e700a2586cf81bca.source: <g1>Downloads through one network adapter, with a kill switch</g1> (<g2>#35</g2>): <g3>Options → Proxy / Socks → Network adapter</g3>. Pick one, usually your VPN's, and every connection DDM opens goes out through it or not at all: downloads, FTP, the DNS you chose, DDM's own downloads and the update check. When the adapter disconnects, nothing goes out through your normal connection. Running downloads stop and start again when it's back. The command line's <x4/> takes <x5/>. PAC scripts' <x6/> no longer opens a network socket on Windows.
e700a2586cf81bca.text: <g1>通过一个网络适配器下载，带断网开关</g1>（<g2>#35</g2>）：<g3>选项 → 代理/SOCKS → 网络适配器</g3>。选择一个，通常是您的 VPN，DDM 打开的每个连接都将通过它发出，否则不发出：下载、FTP、您选择的 DNS、DDM 自己的下载和更新检查。当适配器断开连接时，不会有任何内容通过您的正常连接发出。正在运行的下载会停止，并在适配器恢复时重新开始。<x4/> 命令行接受 <x5/>。PAC 脚本的 <x6/> 不再在 Windows 上打开网络套接字。

e700b8b592a5b4c0.source: Free forever: no trial, no ads, no key
e700b8b592a5b4c0.text: 永久免费：无试用、无广告、无密钥

e707093847217661.source: <g1>Theme files.</g1> <x2/> reads TOML or JSON from the data folder's <x3/> (one file, or <x4/> with icons beside it). A file names only what it changes; the rest comes from the theme it <x5/> (a built-in's id or another file, the classic look by default), down a chain in which a cycle is refused. Unknown keys are warnings, not errors. The built-in style themes are such files too, carried in the program (<x6/>).
e707093847217661.text: <g1>主题文件。</g1> <x2/> 从数据文件夹的 <x3/> 读取 TOML 或 JSON（一个文件，或 <x4/> 旁边带有图标）。一个文件只命名它所更改的内容；其余部分来自它 <x5/> 的主题（内置主题的 ID 或另一个文件，默认是经典外观），沿着一个拒绝循环的链。未知键是警告，而不是错误。内置样式主题也是此类文件，包含在程序中（<x6/>）。

e70e4147e80f61f5.source: DDM never writes the token to its event log, crash reports, the automation API or the command line's output.
e70e4147e80f61f5.text: DDM 绝不会将令牌写入其事件日志、崩溃报告、自动化 API 或命令行输出。

e70f4ddad4e54ab0.source: Press <g1>F3</g1> to jump to the next match. The search wraps round to the top.
e70f4ddad4e54ab0.text: 按 <g1>F3</g1> 跳转到下一个匹配项。搜索会从列表顶部重新开始。

e727ceb9bd1817c8.source: <g1>Help</g1> — help pages and tutorials (on the website, in your language when it has it), <g2>Keyboard shortcuts</g2>, <g3>Report a problem</g3>, <g4>Check for updates</g4>, <g5>About</g5>, <g6>Tell a friend</g6> and <g7>Original project</g7> (the page of Mister Download Manager, which DDM is built on).
e727ceb9bd1817c8.text: <g1>帮助</g1> — 帮助页面和教程（在网站上，有您的语言时即用您的语言）、<g2>键盘快捷方式</g2>、<g3>报告问题</g3>、<g4>检查更新</g4>、<g5>关于</g5>、<g6>告诉朋友</g6>和<g7>原始项目</g7>（Mister Download Manager 的页面，DDM 以它为基础）。

e76084a6e032309b.source: In <g1>Helium</g1>, load the extension by hand as above (<x2/> works in Helium too). Once Dannex is in the Chrome Web Store, Helium installs it from there: click <g3>Add to Chrome</g3>. Helium fetches extensions through its own services, so this works only while they're allowed. If Helium says <g4>Extension downloads are disabled</g4>, open <x5/> (<g6>Settings → Privacy and security → Helium services</g6>), turn on <g7>Allow connecting to Helium services</g7> and <g8>Proxy extension downloads and updates</g8>, and click <g9>Add to Chrome</g9> again. With those off, load the extension by hand, as above.

e98b65ae69ff53d2.source: Look at <g1>Can resume</g1> in the progress window. <g2>No</g2> means the server can't send a file in parts. DDM then uses one connection, and a download that stops has to start over. For such servers, avoid stopping the download, and avoid a very low speed limit, which can make the server drop the connection.
e98b65ae69ff53d2.text: 查看进度窗口中的<g1>支持断点续传</g1>。<g2>否</g2>表示服务器无法分块发送文件。DDM 随后会使用一个连接，停止的下载必须从头开始。对于这类服务器，请避免停止下载，也避免设置过低的速度限制，否则可能导致服务器断开连接。

ea73253f79a248d9.source: DDM's Proxy / Socks settings are for web and FTP downloads. Torrents can use a SOCKS5 one too: set a <x1/> proxy in <g2>Options → Proxy / Socks</g2> and turn on <g3>Use the proxy</g3> in Torrent settings. The proxy covers connections to peers and web trackers only, so with it DDM turns off the DHT, local peer discovery, incoming connections and UDP trackers; it opens no UDP socket toward the network at all. If the proxy is gone from Proxy / Socks while that switch is on, torrents don't start rather than go around it.
ea73253f79a248d9.text: DDM 的代理/Socks 设置适用于网页和 FTP 下载。种子也可以使用 SOCKS5 代理：在<g2>选项 → 代理/Socks</g2>中设置<x1/>代理，并在种子设置中开启<g3>使用代理</g3>。代理只用于连接对等方和网页跟踪器，因此启用后，DDM 会关闭 DHT、本地对等方发现、传入连接和 UDP 跟踪器；DDM 完全不会向网络打开 UDP 套接字。如果开启该选项时，代理/Socks 中没有配置代理，种子就不会启动，而不会绕过代理连接。

ea8323a6a76950ae.source: Yes. In IDM, export your list as an .ef2 file (its Tasks → Export menu). In DDM, choose Tasks → Import → From an IDM list (.ef2) and pick that file: every download comes over with its address, referrer and cookies. A plain text file of links works too. See Adding downloads.

eba4a18243d01a89.source: A queue's downloads start with their windows hidden, so a queue never fills the screen: open one the same way. <g1>Options → Downloads → How the progress window opens → Edit...</g1> chooses how the window opens when you start a download yourself: <g2>Normally</g2>, <g3>Minimized</g3>, or <g4>Hidden in the notification area</g4>.
eba4a18243d01a89.text: 队列中的下载启动时会隐藏其窗口，因此队列永远不会占满屏幕：用同样的方法打开某一个。<g1>选项 → 下载 → 进度窗口的打开方式 → 编辑...</g1>用于选择在您自己开始下载时窗口的打开方式：<g2>正常</g2>、<g3>最小化</g3>或<g4>已隐藏在通知区域</g4>。

ebb00adeab17b68e.source: <g1>Links that work only once</g1> (or hosts that allow one download at a time) failed with "403 Forbidden" after Download File Info had looked them up (<g2>#28</g2>): the window's look and the download each asked the server. The download now continues from the answer the window got, and asks again only if that connection has closed meanwhile.
ebb00adeab17b68e.text: <g1>一次性链接</g1>（或一次只允许一个下载的主机）在“下载文件信息”查询后失败，显示“403 Forbidden”（<g2>#28</g2>）：窗口查询和下载操作都向服务器发出了请求。现在，下载会从窗口获得的响应继续，并且仅当该连接在此期间关闭时才再次请求。

ec30751899ba93ca.source: <g1>Folders</g1> aren't downloaded yet: a folder's link gets <g2>this is a Google Drive folder, not a file</g2>. Open the folder in the browser and download its files from there.

ec54b48fd7c3fa44.source: Dannex Download Manager starts with your computer in the notification area, hides progress windows there in one click, and uses little memory there.
ec54b48fd7c3fa44.text: Dannex Download Manager 随电脑在通知区域启动，一键隐藏进度窗口，并且在此状态下占用内存极少。

ec5948db00d533b3.source: The address the browser was given is kept along with where its redirects led, so an expired signed link (a GitHub release, a cloud drive) is renewed when resumed, and a site excluded in Options is left alone even when it redirects to another.
ec5948db00d533b3.text: 浏览器提供的地址会与重定向后的地址一起保存，因此过期的签名链接（GitHub 发布、云盘）在恢复时会续期，并且在选项中排除的网站即使重定向到其他网站也会被忽略。

ec83076f0311f20e.source: A theme is one small text file in <g1>TOML</g1> (or JSON, <x2/>; or a <g3>colour scheme</g3>, <x4/>). It names only what it changes; everything else comes from the theme it <x5/>:
ec83076f0311f20e.text: 主题是一个小的 <g1>TOML</g1> 文本文件（或 JSON，<x2/>；或<g3>配色方案</g3>，<x4/>）。它只命名它所更改的内容；所有其他内容都来自它所 <x5/> 的主题：
