ece9fd24c79f10c2.source: The windows are the ones described in this help, with the desktop's fonts, file icons and title bars:
ece9fd24c79f10c2.text: 窗口是本帮助中描述的那些，带有桌面字体、文件图标和标题栏：

ecf44891dbd76d3a.source: <g1>General</g1> — the info hash, pieces, peers, how much was sent, the share ratio, how long it has been shared and the folder. What was sent and the time shared add up over all of the torrent's runs: they don't start again at 0 after a pause or a restart of DDM.
ecf44891dbd76d3a.text: <g1>常规</g1> — 信息哈希、分块、对等点、已发送量、分享率、已分享时长以及文件夹。已发送量和已分享时长是该 torrent 所有运行的总和：在暂停或重启 DDM 后，它们不会从 0 重新开始计算。

ecfc119517fbaa5f.source: Where a download's server is (#140): an IP-to-country range table built from DB-IP's Lite data (<x1/>), looked up on this computer only, and the countries' flags
ecfc119517fbaa5f.text: 下载服务器位置 (#140)：根据 DB-IP Lite 数据 (<x1/>) 构建的 IP 到国家/地区范围表，仅在此计算机上查找，并显示国家/地区旗帜

ed005796026ee853.source: <g1>What you download, on your local network.</g1> DDM tells other computers on your network which torrents it has, so they can share faster. On public Wi-Fi, turn off <g2>Find peers on the local network</g2>.
ed005796026ee853.text: <g1>您在本地网络上下载的内容。</g1>DDM 会告知网络上的其他计算机自己有哪些种子，以便它们更快地共享内容。在公共 Wi-Fi 上，请关闭<g2>在本地网络上查找对等点</g2>。

ed015fb2e04742ce.source: <g1>Encrypted</g1>: HTTPS, with a certificate made on your computer and kept; its fingerprint is in Options, to compare with the one the phone's browser shows.
ed015fb2e04742ce.text: <g1>加密</g1>：使用 HTTPS，证书在您的计算机上生成并保存；其指纹在“选项”中，可与手机浏览器显示的指纹进行比较。

ed0419b45b0e746b.source: Pick a feed on the left to see its articles. An article with a torrent shows a torrent icon and its size when the feed gives it. Double-click one, or select it and click <g1>Download...</g1>, to open <g2>Add torrent</g2> with it, as for any magnet link or <x3/> address.
ed0419b45b0e746b.text: 选择左侧的源以查看其中的文章。如果文章包含种子，且源提供了种子大小，文章旁会显示种子图标和大小。双击文章，或选中后点击<g1>下载...</g1>，即可用该种子打开<g2>添加种子</g2>窗口，操作方式与磁力链接或<x3/>地址相同。

ed3471c3836c3741.source: <g1>Help opens the website's help pages, in your language</g1> (<g2>#227</g2>): <g3>Help contents</g3>, <g4>Tutorials</g4>, <g5>Scheduler and queues</g5>, <g6>Video downloads</g6>, the <g7>Help</g7> buttons of Options and the Scheduler, and the browser extension window's tutorial and help links opened the docs on GitHub (the Options and Scheduler buttons a page that wasn't there). They open dannex.kavangi.co.ke now, at the same section, in the interface language when the website has it (else English), and <g8>Home Page</g8> opens the website too. The command line's and the MCP server's help name the website's guide. Problem reports, releases and the source stay on GitHub.
ed3471c3836c3741.text: <g1>帮助功能现在会打开网站的帮助页面，并显示您的语言</g1> (<g2>#227</g2>)：<g3>帮助内容</g3>、<g4>教程</g4>、<g5>计划程序和队列</g5>、<g6>视频下载</g6>、“选项”和“计划程序”中的<g7>帮助</g7>按钮，以及浏览器扩展窗口的教程和帮助链接，之前都打开 GitHub 上的文档（“选项”和“计划程序”按钮打开的页面不存在）。现在它们会打开 dannex.kavangi.co.ke 网站上对应的部分，如果网站支持界面语言，则显示该语言（否则显示英文），<g8>主页</g8>也会打开网站。命令行和 MCP 服务器的帮助会指明网站上的指南。问题报告、发布和源代码仍保留在 GitHub 上。

ed5b7e8737429bd7.source: The server's certificate is checked against Windows' (or the system's) trusted certificates, as for <x1/>. A Linux system without them (a minimal install without the <x2/> package) still downloads over plain HTTP and FTP; each secure download then fails at once, saying to install that package.
ed5b7e8737429bd7.text: 服务器证书会根据 Windows（或系统）的受信任证书进行检查，与 <x1/> 的方式相同。没有这些证书的 Linux 系统（未安装 <x2/> 软件包的最小化安装）仍会通过纯 HTTP 和 FTP 下载；每个安全下载都会立即失败，并提示安装该软件包。

ed7e98ef180222ef.source: <g1>Must contain</g1>: words the title must contain, all of them, in any order. <x2/> separates alternatives (<x3/>), and <x4/> and <x5/> are wildcards. Case doesn't matter.
ed7e98ef180222ef.text: <g1>必须包含</g1>：标题必须包含的词语，且所有词语都要出现，顺序不限。<x2/>用于分隔备选项（<x3/>），<x4/>和<x5/>是通配符。不区分大小写。

ed910aded9955f8e.source: A download from the browser keeps the browser's name, size and type: Download File Info no longer asks the server again, so a link's own name (<x1/>), a Unicode name and a download behind a sign-in show right away, and correctly. When it must ask (an address typed in), it asks with the cookies, referrer and User-Agent the download will use.
ed910aded9955f8e.text: 从浏览器下载的文件会保留浏览器的名称、大小和类型：下载文件信息不再向服务器再次请求，因此链接本身的名称（<x1/>）、Unicode 名称和需要登录才能下载的文件会立即正确显示。当必须请求时（例如手动输入的地址），它会使用下载将使用的 cookie、referrer 和 User-Agent 进行请求。

The API is off until you turn it on. See Command line and automation.
ed9f8164de938ae9.text: 是。DDM 接受 IDM 熟悉的命令行开关，附带 dannexdownloadmanager-cli 用于从终端下载，并具有一个本地的、受令牌保护的自动化 API，可以列出、暂停、开始和删除下载。此 API 默认关闭，直到您将其打开。请参阅命令行和自动化。

ee2d1549d99def1d.source: What Dannex Download Manager is made for: a general-purpose download manager, like a web browser, for files you have the right to download.
ee2d1549d99def1d.text: Dannex Download Manager 的用途：一款通用下载管理器，像网页浏览器一样，用于下载您有权下载的文件。

ee37e54eb8ede1fa.source: The window's close box (<g1>×</g1>) does the same as <g2>Cancel</g2> while the download runs, as in IDM; for a finished or stopped download it just closes the window.
ee37e54eb8ede1fa.text: 窗口的关闭框（<g1>×</g1>）在下载运行时与<g2>取消</g2>作用相同，与 IDM 一样；对于已完成或已停止的下载，它只是关闭窗口。

ee38c21b58df59db.source: Dannex Download Manager — free download manager and IDM alternative
ee38c21b58df59db.text: Dannex Download Manager — 免费下载管理器和 IDM 替代品

ee58968be5c1a229.source: To check DDM's side, open <g1>Options → General</g1> in DDM and click <g2>Test browser integration...</g2>. It checks that browser integration is on, that this is the installed copy, that the browsers can find DDM, and which browsers' extension has connected; <g3>How to fix it</g3> opens the section for the first that fails.
ee58968be5c1a229.text: 要检查 DDM 端的情况，请在 DDM 中打开<g1>选项 → 常规</g1>，然后点击<g2>测试浏览器集成...</g2>。它会检查浏览器集成是否已启用、当前是否为已安装的副本、浏览器能否找到 DDM，以及哪些浏览器的扩展程序已连接；点击<g3>如何修复</g3>可打开第一个未通过检查的项目对应的部分。

ee658e61097dcf6b.source: A computer that is asleep doesn't run anything until it wakes, unless the queue has <g1>Wake the computer to run this queue</g1> ticked (on Windows it needs <g2>Allow wake timers</g2> in the power plan; the Scheduler says when it's off). See <g3>Wake the computer to run a queue</g3>.
ee658e61097dcf6b.text: 电脑在休眠状态下不会运行任何程序，除非队列勾选了<g1>唤醒电脑以运行此队列</g1>（在 Windows 上，电源计划中需要<g2>允许唤醒定时器</g2>；计划程序会显示其何时关闭）。请参阅<g3>唤醒电脑以运行队列</g3>。

ee6f7b9e469f83a7.source: <g1>Download limits</g1> keeps a capped internet plan in check: no more than a set number of megabytes every few hours. When the limit is reached, downloads wait, and they carry on by themselves when the period is over.
ee6f7b9e469f83a7.text: <g1>下载限制</g1>可以控制有流量限制的互联网套餐：每隔几小时下载的兆字节数不超过设定值。达到限制后，下载会暂停，并在期限结束后自行继续。

ee9034f4bfe810cf.source: <g1>Recheck files</g1> — reads every piece of the torrent's files and checks it, for example after you moved files in or a disk had errors. A running torrent goes on afterwards and fetches what is missing. A stopped one stays stopped. Its event log says how much was found: a finished torrent with a damaged piece becomes stopped, and resuming it fetches the piece again.
ee9034f4bfe810cf.text: <g1>重新检查文件</g1> — 读取种子文件的每个部分并进行检查，例如在您移动文件或磁盘出现错误之后。运行中的种子会继续运行并获取缺失的部分。已停止的种子保持停止状态。其事件日志会显示找到多少内容：已完成的种子如果损坏了一个部分，则会变为停止状态，恢复它会再次获取该部分。

ee9d070891f55b05.source: DDM is built for 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, as an installer, a portable copy or a plain zip. Builds for Linux and macOS come with every release.
ee9d070891f55b05.text: DDM 专为 64 位 Windows 10 和 11 构建，提供安装程序、便携版或普通 zip 压缩包。每个版本都包含 Linux 和 macOS 构建。

eea0683af36fb9e8.source: Something not working? We'd like to know.

eeaab56a62c7895b.source: As links arrive, DDM asks each server about its file, as IDM's <g1>Download all links</g1> does. A few links are checked at a time, and only a few from any one site. Each link then shows its real name and size, and a status:
eeaab56a62c7895b.text: 收到链接后，DDM 会像 IDM 的<g1>下载所有链接</g1>功能一样，向各个服务器查询文件信息。每次只检查少量链接，而且来自同一站点的链接也不会太多。随后，每个链接都会显示真实名称、大小和状态：

eec34c7f0b32518b.source: IDM vs DDM, timed to the millisecond.
eec34c7f0b32518b.text: IDM 对比 DDM，精确到毫秒。

eee3ddf8a1920fce.source: The crash report window after DDM stopped responding
eee3ddf8a1920fce.text: DDM 停止响应后的崩溃报告窗口

ef16708f12b7106e.source: <g1>Maximum download speed for one file</g1> holds each download to the same speed. Set it first, since it starts at a very slow 10 KBytes/sec, then choose <g2>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Turn on</g2>. <g3>Turn off</g3> gives full speed back, and <g4>Always turn on Speed Limiter on Dannex Download Manager startup</g4> keeps it on from the start.
ef16708f12b7106e.text: <g1>单个文件的最大下载速度</g1>将每个下载任务限制在相同的速度。请先设置此项，因为它默认从非常慢的 10 千字节/秒开始，然后选择<g2>下载 → 速度限制器 → 开启</g2>。<g3>关闭</g3>将恢复全速，而<g4>始终在 Dannex Download Manager 启动时开启速度限制器</g4>则会使其从一开始就保持开启状态。

ef4299bbbca5d797.source: A freeze report will say whether DDM's window ran all along (a loop), waited (on a lock, the disk or the network), or hardly ran at all. That last kind usually means a computer too busy to run DDM, most likely not a bug in DDM, and those reports share one signature so they find one issue instead of many. macOS doesn't measure this yet. The window's title will be in DDM's language too, and the report will keep its own lines in every language, left to right in Arabic and Persian.
ef4299bbbca5d797.text: 冻结报告会说明 DDM 窗口是始终运行（循环）、等待（锁定、磁盘或网络）还是几乎没有运行。最后一种情况通常意味着计算机过于繁忙而无法运行 DDM，很可能不是 DDM 中的错误，这些报告共享一个签名，因此它们会找到一个问题而不是多个问题。macOS 尚未测量此项。窗口标题也将采用 DDM 的语言，报告将保留其在每种语言中的行，在阿拉伯语和波斯语中从左到右显示。

ef4a27773ff3aeb9.source: The download progress window: a file over eight connections, each one's share drawn as it fills.
ef4a27773ff3aeb9.text: 下载进度窗口：一个文件通过 8 个连接下载，图中显示每个连接已完成的部分。

ef4a8ff4d9fbf4e8.source: The <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox:
ef4a8ff4d9fbf4e8.text: 适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 和 Firefox 的 <g1>Dannex Download Manager</g1> 扩展：

ef4eeb5f4c8387dd.source: A magnet link or a .torrent handed to DDM while <g1>Add torrent</g1> is already open is no longer dropped without a word: it waits, and Add torrent opens again for it when you close the first (<g2>#507</g2>).
ef4eeb5f4c8387dd.text: 在<g1>添加种子</g1>已打开时交给 DDM 的磁力链接或 .torrent，不再被悄悄丢弃：它会等待，并在您关闭第一个时，再为它打开添加种子（<g2>#507</g2>）。

ef66ff61d7cc24b4.source: <g1>Give files the server's date</g1> — give finished files the date the server reports, not the date you downloaded them.
ef66ff61d7cc24b4.text: <g1>为文件设置服务器上的日期</g1> — 让已完成的文件采用服务器报告的日期，而不是您下载它们的日期。

ef6e5d90b67f8e4e.source: <g1>"Hide tab" was cut in longer languages</g1> (German "Registerkarte au..."): the button grows to fit its label where there is room, through a shared helper other buttons can use.
ef6e5d90b67f8e4e.text: <g1>“隐藏选项卡”在较长的语言中被截断</g1>（德语“Registerkarte au...”）：按钮会根据标签的长度自动扩展，只要有空间，通过一个共享的辅助功能，其他按钮也可以使用此功能。

ef8cedcbdccdaf85.source: The code is filled in when you scanned the QR code; otherwise type it. Give the phone a name, and tap <g1>Pair</g1>. The window on the computer says so, and closes with <g2>Done</g2>.
ef8cedcbdccdaf85.text: 扫描二维码后，代码会自动填写；否则请手动输入。为手机命名，然后点击<g1>配对</g1>。电脑上的窗口会显示配对成功，并以<g2>完成</g2>关闭。

efaf00494efe309f.source: The other downloads keep their speed.

efd0b6fdff1ee45c.source: <g1>No freeze on a slow drive, everywhere else:</g1> <g2>Delete</g2> with its files, adding a playlist or a gallery, a <x3/> file given on the command line or dropped on the window, starting a video, a gallery or a playlist's list (DDM's helpers are found beside the window, and the browser's cookies written for them there), Tasks → <g4>Export</g4> and <g5>Import</g5>, the themes folder, File <g6>Properties</g6>, <g7>Move to folder</g7> and an RSS rule's check for files already downloaded no longer wait for the drive on the main window. With <g8>Delete</g8>, the row leaves at once and its files go a moment later; a download that would write among them waits until they are gone. In the first moments after DDM starts, the browser's quality menu opens the <g9>Download video</g9> window instead while DDM looks for its helpers (finishes <g10>#743</g10>).
efd0b6fdff1ee45c.text: <g1>慢速磁盘不再造成卡顿，其余各处：</g1>带文件的<g2>删除</g2>、添加播放列表或图片库、通过命令行给出或拖到窗口上的 <x3/> 文件、启动视频、图片库或播放列表的列表（在窗口之外查找 DDM 的辅助程序，并在那里写入浏览器的 Cookie）、任务 → <g4>导出</g4>和<g5>导入</g5>、主题文件夹、文件<g6>属性</g6>、<g7>移动到文件夹</g7>，以及 RSS 规则对已下载文件的检查，都不再让主窗口等待磁盘。使用<g8>删除</g8>时，行立即消失，其文件稍后删除；要写入这些文件所在位置的下载会等到它们删除后再开始。DDM 刚启动的头几刻，在 DDM 查找辅助程序期间，浏览器的画质菜单会改为打开<g9>下载视频</g9>窗口（完成 <g10>#743</g10>）。

efd87b0f999ae1f3.source: In colour; the tooltip names it

efeefb4eb3f42f1d.source: <g1>Video downloads' progress</g1> went back and forth (a stream in fragments re-estimates its size, and picture and sound arrive one after the other); it only moves forward now, from the size the video window showed.
efeefb4eb3f42f1d.text: <g1>视频下载的进度</g1>曾来回跳动（分段流会重新估算其大小，并且图像和声音会先后到达）；现在它只会向前移动，从视频窗口显示的大小开始。

eff6c00ab7dd9c1d.source: The thumb or an arrow under the pointer

f019d7a91e057d16.source: A download saved under a numbered name because another file already had its name (<x1/>) now shows that name in the list and opens its own file, instead of keeping the old name and opening the other file (<g2>#442</g2>). Two downloads waiting under one name no longer collide when they start: the later one takes the next free name, instead of failing with "already being downloaded" or continuing the other one's data.
f019d7a91e057d16.text: 由于其他文件已占用其名称而以编号名称保存的下载文件（<x1/>）现在会在列表中显示该名称并打开其自身文件，而不是保留旧名称并打开其他文件（<g2>#442</g2>）。两个以同一名称等待的下载任务在开始时不再冲突：后一个任务会占用下一个可用名称，而不是因“已在下载”而失败或继续另一个任务的数据。

f037bd6ae0bfb52b.source: <g1>Keyboard everywhere</g1>: arrow keys in radio groups and tab strips, Ctrl+Tab between tabs, type a name to jump to it in any list or drop-down, Up/Down through Add URL's and Save As' history, Home/End in menus, Tab between the Categories tree and the list (the tree answers the arrows), F2 to rename, held arrows repeat, the date picker's calendar works from the keyboard and has Today.
f037bd6ae0bfb52b.text: <g1>随处都可使用键盘操作</g1>：在单选组和选项卡栏中使用箭头键，在选项卡之间使用 Ctrl+Tab，在任何列表或下拉菜单中键入名称即可跳转到对应项，在“添加 URL”和“另存为”的历史记录中使用向上/向下键，在菜单中使用 Home/End，在“类别”树和列表之间使用 Tab（树会响应箭头键），使用 F2 重命名，按住箭头键可连续操作；日期选择器的日历可用键盘操作，并有“今天”按钮。

f03aff69718cb1f3.source: <g1>The AppImage updates through AppImage tools too</g1> (<g2>#24</g2>): it carries the address of its updates, and each release has its <x3/>, so AppImageLauncher, Gear Lever and AppImageUpdate download only the parts that changed. <g4>Update now</g4> works as before.
f03aff69718cb1f3.text: <g1>AppImage 也能通过 AppImage 工具更新</g1>（<g2>#24</g2>）：它带有更新地址，每个版本都有其 <x3/>，因此 AppImageLauncher、Gear Lever 和 AppImageUpdate 只下载更改的部分。<g4>立即更新</g4>功能与之前一样。

f03c509d0238da7b.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: a folder for the rule's torrents, and <g2>Add them without starting them</g2> if you'd rather start them yourself.
f03c509d0238da7b.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：规则种子的文件夹，如果您更愿意自己启动它们，则选择<g2>添加但不启动</g2>。

f047e40e7188535a.source: Narrow it down with categories and sorting
f047e40e7188535a.text: 使用类别和排序缩小范围

f07a76627a9be696.source: When you click a download, the extension checks DDM's Options:
f07a76627a9be696.text: 点击下载时，扩展会检查 DDM 的选项：

f084734a04183482.source: <g1>Videos from web pages</g1> through yt-dlp (installed and kept current from DDM, with ffmpeg for the qualities that need merging), and <g2>BitTorrent and magnet links</g2> through librqbit: choose the files, see peers, trackers and pieces, keep sharing if you like.
f084734a04183482.text: 通过 yt-dlp（从 DDM 安装并保持最新，并使用 ffmpeg 处理需要合并的质量）从网页<g1>下载视频</g1>，以及通过 librqbit <g2>下载 BitTorrent 和磁力链接</g2>：选择文件，查看对等点、跟踪器和分片，如果愿意可以继续分享。

f090836b00eb7c29.source: <g1>Dates and times in your language:</g1> the Scheduler's times and date, Statistics' dates and its chart's days, and the list's <g2>Last Try Date</g2> and <g3>Added</g3> columns are written as the interface language writes them (German <x4/>, <x5/>, <x6/>), or as Windows' region does when it is in that same language; English is as before, and <g7>Options → Regional → My own way</g7> still wins. Short lists take the language's comma (Arabic <x8/>).
f090836b00eb7c29.text: <g1>日期和时间使用您的语言：</g1>计划程序的时间和日期、统计信息的日期及其图表中的日子，以及列表中的<g2>上次尝试日期</g2>和<g3>已添加</g3>列，按界面语言的写法书写（德语 <x4/>、<x5/>、<x6/>），或在 Windows 区域使用同一种语言时按其区域设置；英语与以前相同，<g7>选项 → 区域 → 我自己的方式</g7>仍然优先。较短的列表采用该语言的逗号（阿拉伯语 <x8/>）。

f09732e47af740c7.source: <g1>Less memory in the notification area</g1> (<g2>#72</g2>): closed to the tray, or minimized there (on by default), DDM gives the memory it isn't using back to Windows. Task Manager's <g3>Memory</g3> drops from about 50 MB to under 10 MB (with 500 downloads in the list, from 58 to about 14 MB). It gives it back again 2 minutes after hiding, when the clock's ticks and a one-time allocation have brought some back, then every 10 minutes while DDM stays there. After the language list (which needs a font for every script) closes, those fonts are let go: about 70 MB less than before. On Linux the heap's free memory goes back to the system the same way. <g4>DDM uses a lot of memory</g4> explains Task Manager's figures.
f09732e47af740c7.text: <g1>通知区域内存占用更少</g1>（<g2>#72</g2>）：关闭到托盘或最小化到托盘（默认开启）时，DDM 会将未使用的内存返还给 Windows。任务管理器的<g3>内存</g3>从约 50 MB 降至 10 MB 以下（列表中有 500 个下载时，从 58 MB 降至约 14 MB）。在隐藏 2 分钟后，当计时器滴答声和一次性分配带回一些内存后，它会再次返还内存，然后 DDM 保持在那里时每 10 分钟返还一次。语言列表（需要每种脚本的字体）关闭后，这些字体会被释放：比以前减少约 70 MB。在 Linux 上，堆的空闲内存以相同的方式返还给系统。<g4>DDM 使用大量内存</g4>解释了任务管理器的数字。

f0c30b6e44860efc.source: <g1>Customize DDM Download panels in browsers → Edit...</g1> — the download button over videos on web pages: turn it off; show it over videos, over sound players, or both; leave it off media shorter than so many seconds; choose the corner it shows in first; and list the sites it never shows on (separate them by spaces; a name covers its subdomains, <x2/> too). See <g3>Browser integration</g3>.
f0c30b6e44860efc.text: <g1>自定义浏览器中的 DDM 下载面板 → 编辑...</g1> — 网页视频上的下载按钮：可将其关闭；显示在视频上、音频播放器上，或两者；不在短于若干秒的媒体上显示；选择它首次显示的角落；并列出它永不显示的站点（用空格分隔；一个名称会涵盖其子域，<x2/> 也一样）。参见<g3>浏览器集成</g3>。

f0d4a5d0bdcbe6d3.source: macOS: file names in Persian, Arabic, Urdu, Hebrew or Armenian show their letters in the download list and windows instead of boxes, whatever the interface language: these scripts now get the font for them that comes with macOS (Arial Unicode), the first time one is needed (<g1>#533</g1>).
f0d4a5d0bdcbe6d3.text: macOS：波斯语、阿拉伯语、乌尔都语、希伯来语或亚美尼亚语的文件名，在下载列表和窗口中会显示其字母而不是方框，不论界面语言是什么：这些文字现在会在第一次需要时获得 macOS 自带的相应字体（Arial Unicode）（<g1>#533</g1>）。

f0e933d37db8b9a1.source: <g1>Cursor</g1>: the same <x2/> entry as Claude Desktop's, in <x3/> (or add it in Cursor's MCP settings).
f0e933d37db8b9a1.text: <g1>Cursor</g1>：与 Claude Desktop 相同的<x2/>条目，在<x3/>中（或在 Cursor 的 MCP 设置中添加）。

f10113695e758efd.source: A playlist's or channel's videos, one line each as they're listed: its place, length, title and address.
f10113695e758efd.text: 列出播放列表或频道中的视频，每行一个，按列表顺序显示其位置、时长、标题和网址。

f10af3be82d5c760.source: <g1>Through a proxy</g1>, DDM only sees the proxy, so it says <g2>through a proxy</g2> (with the proxy's country when it knows it) instead of guessing the server's. A VPN that works at the system level can't be seen: the country is then the server's, but the time includes the VPN's detour.
f10af3be82d5c760.text: <g1>通过代理</g1>，DDM 只能看到代理，因此会显示<g2>通过代理</g2>（如果知道代理的国家，则会显示代理的国家），而不是猜测服务器的位置。系统级别的 VPN 无法被看到：此时国家是服务器的国家，但时间包括了 VPN 的绕行。

f10c89a15a8e65ac.source: When the Chrome Web Store's copy and the copy from DDM's folder are both in one Chromium browser, they ask each other (by their IDs, inside the browser) whether the other is there, so only one takes downloads. Nothing leaves the browser for that.
f10c89a15a8e65ac.text: 当 Chrome 应用商店的副本和来自 DDM 文件夹的副本同时存在于一个 Chromium 浏览器中时，它们会（通过其 ID，在浏览器内部）互相询问对方是否存在，以便只有一个接管下载。为此，没有任何内容离开浏览器。

f1198b0bddc112e0.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: the folder its files go to. When a package holds several kinds of files, the box says <g2>Each file's category folder</g2>: each file goes to its category's folder (<g3>Options → Save to</g3>), as Import always did.
f1198b0bddc112e0.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：文件的保存文件夹。如果一个分组包含多种文件，设置框会显示<g2>每个文件的类别文件夹</g2>：每个文件都会保存到对应类别的文件夹（<g3>选项 → 保存到</g3>），与导入时的处理方式相同。

f1277bd229063e91.source: More than 80 fixes. The main ones:
f1277bd229063e91.text: 超过 80 项修复。主要包括：

f135b1b9671dc439.source: Make everything larger / smaller, in every window (<g1>View → Interface size</g1>, 100 % to 200 %)
f135b1b9671dc439.text: 放大 / 缩小所有窗口中的界面元素（<g1>视图 → 界面大小</g1>，100% 到 200%）

f13dc0eff896fff6.source: Help: what to do when an antivirus or VirusTotal flags DDM, and how to check your copy is the real one.
f13dc0eff896fff6.text: 帮助：当杀毒软件或 VirusTotal 标记 DDM 时该怎么做，以及如何检查您的副本是否为正版。

f1452f6e417cd255.source: <g1>Playlists and channels</g1> (<g2>#69</g2>): Download video from a page lists a playlist's or a channel's videos, with their lengths, all ticked, with Select all and Select none. One quality applies to all of them (the best, up to a height, the original sound, MP3, Opus or FLAC). Each video gets its own download, in a folder named after the list, and Download Now starts the main queue, which runs as many at once as its settings say. A playlist is listed as its videos come in; the listing can be stopped and taken up again (List the rest), and one the site breaks off says after how many videos and why. A channel is listed 50 videos at a time, with Load more. Lists of thousands stay quick, and adding more than 500 downloads asks first. On the command line: <x3/> and <x4/>.
f1452f6e417cd255.text: <g1>播放列表和频道</g1>（<g2>#69</g2>）：“从页面下载视频”功能现在会列出播放列表或频道中的所有视频，显示其时长，并默认全部选中，提供“全选”和“不选”选项。所有视频应用相同的质量设置（最佳、最高高度、原始音轨、MP3、Opus 或 FLAC）。每个视频都会在以列表命名的文件夹中单独下载，“立即下载”会启动主队列，根据设置同时运行多个下载任务。播放列表会随着视频的加载而列出；列表过程可以暂停和恢复（“列出其余部分”），如果网站中断列表，会显示中断的视频数量和原因。频道视频每次列出 50 个，并提供“加载更多”选项。数千个视频的列表也能保持快速响应，添加超过 500 个下载任务时会先进行确认。命令行选项：<x3/> 和 <x4/>。

f15210a203cd6290.source: <g1>DDM can't be reached</g1>: the button is grey with a red <g2>!</g2>. A click opens the extension's status page instead of switching anything: in a sentence or two it says what is wrong and the one thing to do, offers DDM's download for your system when DDM isn't installed, and turns into <g3>Dannex Download Manager is installed</g3> by itself once DDM answers. See <g4>The browser and DDM aren't connected</g4> for every case.
f15210a203cd6290.text: <g1>无法连接 DDM</g1>：按钮为灰色，带红色<g2>!</g2>。单击会打开扩展的状态页，而不是切换任何内容：页面用一两句话说明出了什么问题以及该做的一件事，在 DDM 未安装时提供适合您系统的 DDM 下载，并在 DDM 响应后自动变为<g3>Dannex Download Manager 已安装</g3>。所有情况请参阅<g4>浏览器与 DDM 未连接</g4>。

f168ba524a2dbb62.source: DDM installs an update only when the release's list of checksums is signed by DDM's release key and the file matches it; anything else is refused, and <g1>Download</g1> opens the <g2>Releases</g2> page instead.
f168ba524a2dbb62.text: 仅当版本发布的校验和列表经 DDM 的发布密钥签名且文件与之匹配时，DDM 才会安装更新；其他情况一律拒绝，此时<g1>下载</g1>会改为打开<g2>发布</g2>页面。

f16b959263e848e7.source: You need your own paid account with one of these services: DDM doesn't sell or include one. Sharing an account or its links breaks the services' terms and can get the account suspended.
f16b959263e848e7.text: 您需要拥有这些服务之一的付费账户：DDM 不出售或包含任何账户。共享账户或其链接会违反服务条款，并可能导致账户被暂停。

f18d478bc7bd8af9.source: If some of the torrent's files are already in the folder, DDM asks before using them. <g1>Yes</g1> keeps them for the torrent: DDM checks them, keeps what matches the torrent and downloads the rest, which is how you continue a download started elsewhere or share files you already have. <g2>No</g2> (the default) goes back, so you can choose another folder and nothing of yours is overwritten.
f18d478bc7bd8af9.text: 如果 torrent 的某些文件已在文件夹中，DDM 会在使用前询问。选择<g1>是</g1>会将它们用于 torrent：DDM 会检查它们，保留与 torrent 匹配的部分并下载其余部分，这样您就可以继续在其他地方开始的下载或共享您已有的文件。选择<g2>否</g2>（默认）会返回，以便您可以选择另一个文件夹，并且您的任何内容都不会被覆盖。

f19501f1bfac80fc.source: Yes: every release has an AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz for Linux and a .dmg for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Today's are marked experimental; from version {v1}, Linux isn't, after checks on four desktops, and macOS stays experimental. <g1>More</g1>
f19501f1bfac80fc.text: 是：每个版本都提供适用于 Linux 的 AppImage、.deb、.rpm 和 .tar.gz 包，以及适用于 Apple Silicon 和 Intel Mac 的 .dmg 包。目前这些版本标记为实验性；从 {v1} 版本开始，Linux 版本在经过四个桌面环境的测试后将不再是实验性，而 macOS 版本仍将保持实验性。<g1>更多</g1>

f1b62536ab1c1174.source: Some servers allow only a few connections. DDM notices this and stops asking that server for more. What it has learned shows in <g1>Options → Connection</g1> under <g2>Exceptions</g2>, marked <g3>(auto)</g3>.
f1b62536ab1c1174.text: 有些服务器只允许少量连接。DDM 会检测到这一点，并停止向该服务器请求更多连接。DDM 记录的信息会显示在<g1>选项 → 连接</g1>下的<g2>例外</g2>中，并标记为<g3>(auto)</g3>。

f1b78c765ed86557.source: FTP downloads work like web downloads: several connections at once, pause and resume, and the same progress window.
f1b78c765ed86557.text: FTP 下载与网页下载类似：可以同时建立多个连接、暂停和恢复下载，并使用相同的进度窗口。

f1c33561e456cd2e.source: <g1>DDM's programs and downloads are much smaller</g1> (<g2>#25</g2>): on Windows, the programs went from 93 MB to 41 MB (<x3/> from 61 MB to 38 MB, the command line from 28 MB to a 0.2 MB launcher), and setup.exe from 23 MB to 16 MB. On Linux the AppImage went from 36 MB to 20 MB, the .deb from 27 MB to 17 MB.
f1c33561e456cd2e.text: <g1>DDM 的程序和下载文件大幅缩小</g1>（<g2>#25</g2>）：在 Windows 上，程序从 93 MB 变为 41 MB（<x3/> 从 61 MB 变为 38 MB，命令行从 28 MB 变为 0.2 MB 的启动器），setup.exe 从 23 MB 变为 16 MB。在 Linux 上，AppImage 从 36 MB 变为 20 MB，.deb 从 27 MB 变为 17 MB。

f1c98a8ae18a1b66.source: <g1>The browser extension in your language:</g1> 30 of its texts (the toolbar popup's list of downloads with <g2>Pause</g2>, <g3>Resume</g3> and <g4>Open folder</g4>, its box to add an address, the right-click menu's <g5>Download all images with DDM</g5> and <g6>Download all videos and audio with DDM</g6>, the keys' names) showed in English in every language, though they had been translated: the translations now reach the extension.
f1c98a8ae18a1b66.text: <g1>浏览器扩展支持您的语言：</g1>扩展的 30 条文字（工具栏弹出窗口中带<g2>暂停</g2>、<g3>恢复</g3>和<g4>打开文件夹</g4>的下载列表、添加地址的输入框、右键菜单中的<g5>使用 DDM 下载所有图像</g5>和<g6>使用 DDM 下载所有视频和音频</g6>、按键名称）虽已翻译，却在所有语言中都显示为英文：现在翻译已能传到扩展中。

f1ca1210ebccd0f8.source: Dark mode no longer draws a bright white line under the menu bar, across the whole window, in the Classic and Native themes (<g1>#379</g1>).
f1ca1210ebccd0f8.text: 在经典和原生主题中，深色模式不再在菜单栏下方、横跨整个窗口画出一条明亮的白线（<g1>#379</g1>）。

f1e66f2939b3a2e0.source: <g1>Smoother panes:</g1> the Categories tree and the progress window's Connections and torrent tables glide with the mouse wheel, as the download list does, instead of jumping a row at a time; a row chosen in the tree scrolls fully into view.
f1e66f2939b3a2e0.text: <g1>更流畅的窗格：</g1>类别树以及进度窗口的连接和种子表格，现在像下载列表一样随鼠标滚轮平滑滚动，而不是一次跳一行；在树中选中的行会完整滚动到可见位置。

f1ee92efff9ac821.source: <g1>Menus on macOS and Linux</g1>: clicking a menu item did nothing (the click moved the focus to the menu's own window, which closed it first). The list's right-click menu and the toolbar's drop-downs had the same fault.
f1ee92efff9ac821.text: <g1>macOS 和 Linux 上的菜单</g1>：单击菜单项没有反应（单击会将焦点移到菜单自己的窗口，而该窗口会先关闭）。列表的右键菜单和工具栏的下拉菜单也有同样的问题。

f1ffe13bf5cbb2c3.source: View → Interface size (<x1/>, #262) is egui's zoom factor over the display's own scale: every window is laid out in points, so it opens that much larger; one larger than the screen scrolls.
f1ffe13bf5cbb2c3.text: “视图”→“界面大小”(<x1/>, #262) 是 egui 在显示器自身缩放比例之上的缩放因子：每个窗口都以点为单位布局，因此它会按比例放大；如果大于屏幕，则会滚动。

f2039bc45d79ae2e.source: Every list's and table's column headers
f2039bc45d79ae2e.text: 所有列表和表格的列标题

f2100af9e04accde.source: Yes, completely. Dannex Download Manager (DDM) is free and open-source software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. There is no trial period, no paid edition, no registration key, no nag screen and no ads, and there never will be. You may use it at home or at work, copy it and give it to others.
f2100af9e04accde.text: 是的，完全免费。Dannex Download Manager (DDM) 是基于 GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版的免费开源软件。没有试用期、没有付费版本、没有注册密钥、没有烦人的提示屏幕，也没有广告，而且永远不会有。您可以在家里或工作中免费使用它，也可以复制并分享给他人。

f232ea1acad0ee9e.source: If the video won't download, see <g1>Video downloads</g1>.
f232ea1acad0ee9e.text: 如果视频无法下载，请参阅<g1>视频下载</g1>。

f233c05c3850ef51.source: Release signatures are checked by DDM's own small verifier instead of a full OpenPGP library.
f233c05c3850ef51.text: 发布签名由 DDM 自己的小型验证器检查，而不是完整的 OpenPGP 库。

f258c0caca2dcac9.source: Paste a video's page. Pick the quality.
f258c0caca2dcac9.text: 粘贴视频页面链接，选择画质。

f26764c71f561cf8.source: In <g1>Address</g1>, write the address with one asterisk where the number or letter changes: <x2/>.
f26764c71f561cf8.text: 在<g1>地址</g1>中，在数字或字母变化的位置写入一个星号：<x2/>。

f28372a54bdb034d.source: Options → Remote: the address, the certificate's fingerprint and the paired devices.
f28372a54bdb034d.text: 选项 → 远程：地址、证书指纹和已配对设备。

f298b52b62482795.source: Options on its Downloads page: Download File Info, Download complete and addresses already in the list
f298b52b62482795.text: 选项的“下载”页面：下载文件信息、下载完成，以及列表中已有的地址

f2ae255e0c41c631.source: When the connection drops, DDM retries on its own. In the progress window, the connection table shows <g1>Retrying</g1> and the reason. Usually the download goes on by itself once the connection is back.
f2ae255e0c41c631.text: 当连接中断时，DDM 会自行重试。在进度窗口中，连接表会显示<g1>正在重试</g1>和原因。通常，一旦连接恢复，下载就会自行继续。

f2b45bae019642ac.source: Use the path from step 2 (in JSON, every <x1/> is written <x2/>). Other assistants take the same thing: a command to start, no arguments.
f2b45bae019642ac.text: 使用第 2 步中的路径（在 JSON 中，每个<x1/>都写成<x2/>）。其他助手也使用相同的方式：一个启动命令，没有参数。

f2d4f3ae1b5602bb.source: From GitHub's public record, <x1/>: people with pull requests first, then those who opened issues, then those who commented, each once. The maintainer and automated accounts aren't counted.
f2d4f3ae1b5602bb.text: 根据 GitHub 的公开记录，<x1/>：首先是提交拉取请求的人，其次是提出问题的人，然后是发表评论的人，每人只计算一次。维护者和自动化账户不计入在内。

f2fd829426a9d905.source: Click <g1>Add URL</g1> on the toolbar, choose <g2>Tasks → Add new download</g2>, or press <g3>Ctrl+N</g3>.
f2fd829426a9d905.text: 点击工具栏上的<g1>添加 URL</g1>，选择<g2>任务 → 添加新下载</g2>，或按<g3>Ctrl+N</g3>。

f30bf87e61f773d3.source: <g1>Download counts</g1> in the Categories tree, <g2>an empty list that says why</g2> (with Clear filters or Add new download), <g3>a right-click menu on the list's blank space</g3>, a double-click on a column border to fit it, and <g4>Reset columns</g4>.
f30bf87e61f773d3.text: “类别”树中的<g1>下载计数</g1>，<g2>一个说明原因的空列表</g2>（带有“清除筛选器”或“添加新下载”），<g3>列表空白处的右键菜单</g3>，双击列边框以适应内容，以及<g4>重置列</g4>。

f313ce0fb2d7fe17.source: <g1>Peers</g1> — the computers you are downloading from, with how much you received from and sent to each.
f313ce0fb2d7fe17.text: <g1>对等方</g1> — 您正在从中下载的计算机，以及您从每个计算机接收和发送的数据量。

f32a5aaf811375cb.source: <g1>System file dialogs no longer freeze DDM's other windows</g1> while they are open.
f32a5aaf811375cb.text: <g1>系统文件对话框打开时，不再冻结 DDM 的其他窗口</g1>。

f336c7975f1585a7.source: macOS: YouTube videos that need yt-dlp's JavaScript runtime load when DDM is opened from Finder or the Dock. DDM found Homebrew's yt-dlp, but the helpers it started didn't get Homebrew's folders on their PATH, so yt-dlp found neither Deno nor ffmpeg ("Requested format is not available"); they now look there too, after the folders of their own PATH (<g1>#659</g1>).
f336c7975f1585a7.text: macOS：需要 yt-dlp 的 JavaScript 运行时的 YouTube 视频，在从访达或程序坞打开 DDM 时可以加载。DDM 找到了 Homebrew 的 yt-dlp，但它启动的帮助程序没有在其 PATH 中得到 Homebrew 的文件夹，所以 yt-dlp 既找不到 Deno 也找不到 ffmpeg（“Requested format is not available”）；现在它们在自己 PATH 的文件夹之后也会去那里查找（<g1>#659</g1>）。

f35efcc64dbdeb9b.source: <g1>Confirm before deleting downloads</g1> — ask before taking downloads off the list. On by default; <g2>Don't show this again</g2> in that question turns it off, and ticking it here turns it back on.
f35efcc64dbdeb9b.text: <g1>删除下载前确认</g1> — 在从列表中移除下载之前询问。默认开启；该提问中的<g2>不再显示此消息</g2>会将其关闭，在此处勾选则会重新开启。

f37bb491e7425f66.source: <g1>A queue starts</g1> — a queue started by hand, at its time in the Scheduler, or as DDM starts (its <g2>Start when Dannex Download Manager starts</g2>).
f37bb491e7425f66.text: <g1>队列启动时</g1> — 手动启动的队列、在计划程序中到时间启动的队列，或在 DDM 启动时启动的队列（其<g2>Dannex Download Manager 启动时开始</g2>）。

f37caeaafc491b26.source: How Dannex Download Manager speeds up downloads: up to 32 connections per file, dynamic re-splitting, per-server limits it learns, and crash-safe resume.
f37caeaafc491b26.text: Dannex Download Manager 如何加速下载：每个文件最多 32 个连接，动态重新分段，学习并限制每个服务器的连接数，以及防崩溃续传。

f39ce0c1bd08bf1c.source: The separate 28 MB command-line program: now a 0.2 MB launcher, every command works as before.
f39ce0c1bd08bf1c.text: 独立的 28 MB 命令行程序：现在是一个 0.2 MB 的启动器，所有命令功能不变。

f3a0324b1e23c534.source: <g1>Which file types:</g1> <g2>Options → File types → Automatically start downloading the following file types</g2>. Add or remove types, separated by spaces.
f3a0324b1e23c534.text: <g1>选择文件类型：</g1><g2>选项 → 文件类型 → 自动开始下载以下文件类型</g2>。添加或删除文件类型，各类型之间用空格分隔。

f3a16665a583e72f.source: The list shows the order they will run in. Use the arrow buttons under it to move a download up or down.
f3a16665a583e72f.text: 列表显示了它们将运行的顺序。使用下面的箭头按钮可以向上或向下移动下载。

f3d90a3cd84b7d3f.source: Crash and freeze reports: the monitor process, out-of-process minidumps, symbolicated stacks, the report's text and the release logs (<g1>crash-reports.md</g1>)
f3d90a3cd84b7d3f.text: 崩溃和冻结报告：监视进程、进程外 minidumps、符号化堆栈、报告文本和发布日志（<g1>crash-reports.md</g1>）

f3db0a80eb6e5aa4.source: <g1>Apply</g1> saves your changes. <g2>Close</g2> closes the window.
f3db0a80eb6e5aa4.text: <g1>应用</g1>保存您的更改。<g2>关闭</g2>关闭窗口。

f3e21327d9c7e8e0.source: <g1>Show Download File Info first</g1> — show <g2>Download File Info</g2> for each new download. With it off, downloads start at once, or only join the queue if you tick <g3>Otherwise, add them to the queue without starting</g3>.
f3e21327d9c7e8e0.text: <g1>先显示“下载文件信息”</g1> — 为每个新下载显示<g2>下载文件信息</g2>。关闭后，下载会立即开始，或者在勾选<g3>否则，将其加入队列但不启动</g3>时仅加入队列。

f40239cbbf9c12fc.source: <g1>Launch Dannex Download Manager on startup</g1> in <g2>Options → General</g2> is greyed: starting with Windows needs the registry.
f40239cbbf9c12fc.text: <g1>启动时运行 Dannex Download Manager</g1>在<g2>选项 → 常规</g2>中显示为灰色：随 Windows 启动需要使用注册表。

f4146f23b743282f.source: No. DDM needs Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The Rust toolchain it is built with no longer supports Windows 7 and 8, and neither does Microsoft.
f4146f23b743282f.text: 不可以。DDM 需要 Windows 10 或 11（64 位）。用于构建 DDM 的 Rust 工具链不再支持 Windows 7 和 8，Microsoft 也不再支持这两个系统。

f4299041ab5c5278.source: Tick <g1>Only while I'm using the computer</g1> to apply it only while you use the mouse or keyboard. After a minute without input, DDM goes back to full speed. Windows only for now: on Linux and macOS the box is greyed and the limit applies all the time.
f4299041ab5c5278.text: 勾选<g1>仅在我使用计算机时</g1>，则仅在您使用鼠标或键盘时才应用限制。一分钟没有输入后，DDM 会恢复全速。目前仅限 Windows：在 Linux 和 macOS 上，该框为灰色，限制始终生效。

f481370a8fc74096.source: <g1>The Linux files are named without <x2/></g1>: the AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz are <x3/>, and the .deb's and .rpm's descriptions no longer call them an experimental build. Update now, the AppImage tools and the website find them by either name. The macOS .dmg files keep <x4/>.
f481370a8fc74096.text: <g1>Linux 文件命名不带 <x2/></g1>：AppImage、.deb、.rpm 和 .tar.gz 文件名为 <x3/>，.deb 和 .rpm 的描述不再称其为实验性版本。立即更新、AppImage 工具和网站可以通过任一名称找到它们。macOS 的 .dmg 文件保留 <x4/>。

f48b5ed2799054fd.source: Download DDM only from <g1>GitHub Releases</g1>, where every release is built from the public source by GitHub Actions, or from <g2>Dannex's website</g2>, whose download buttons lead there. A download from any other site isn't Dannex's.
f48b5ed2799054fd.text: 请只从 <g1>GitHub Releases</g1>（每个版本都由 GitHub Actions 根据公开源代码构建）或 <g2>Dannex 网站</g2>（其下载按钮会跳转到那里）下载 DDM。从其他任何网站下载的文件都不是 Dannex 提供的。

f4b1c4f7dd31ead7.source: Build the image from DDM's source (a published image comes later):
f4b1c4f7dd31ead7.text: 从 DDM 源代码构建镜像（发布的镜像稍后推出）：

f4d9b0f06339e6af.source: The free IDM alternative: Dannex Download Manager
f4d9b0f06339e6af.text: 免费的 IDM 替代品：Dannex Download Manager

f51fdd2885de8243.source: Why is DDM faster than a browser?

f523361a18ecb218.source: <g1>Sites to leave alone:</g1> <g2>Options → File types → Leave downloads from these sites to the browser</g2>. Add the site's name, for example <x3/> or <x4/>.
f523361a18ecb218.text: <g1>要忽略的站点：</g1><g2>选项 → 文件类型 → 将这些站点的下载留给浏览器</g2>。添加站点的名称，例如 <x3/> 或 <x4/>。

f523b03f18ef6ae9.source: Both apps on the same PC, downloading from the same test server, in alternating runs. The server's own log says when each request arrived and when the last byte left, so nothing relies on either app's word.
f523b03f18ef6ae9.text: 两款应用在同一台电脑上，交替运行，从同一测试服务器下载。服务器日志记录了每个请求的到达时间以及最后一个字节的离开时间，因此结果不依赖于任何一款应用的数据。

f53d77843cbf7a47.source: The app icon, Comet, is drawn from geometry as SVG (<x1/>, rendered by resvg; <x2/> writes every size, placed for whole pixels from 16 to 32 px). Every place that shows it takes the drawing for its size on screen (<x3/>): on Windows each window's title bar and taskbar icons at its display's scale (<x4/>, which also keeps them through a move to another display), the tray's at the taskbar's. View → DDM tray icon shows it in full colour (3D style) or the mark alone in the taskbar's ink (Flat style: white on a dark taskbar, dark on a light one; a template image on macOS), with a slim bar along its foot while downloads run.
f53d77843cbf7a47.text: 应用图标 Comet 由几何图形绘制为 SVG（<x1/>，由 resvg 渲染；<x2/> 会写出每种尺寸，并针对 16 到 32 px 的整像素位置做了调整）。凡是显示它的地方，都会按其屏幕尺寸采用相应的图形（<x3/>）：在 Windows 上，每个窗口的标题栏和任务栏图标按其显示器的缩放比例（<x4/>，它还能在窗口移到另一台显示器时保持图标）绘制，托盘图标则按任务栏的缩放比例。视图 → DDM 托盘图标可以以全彩色显示它（3D 样式），也可以仅以任务栏墨色显示标志（扁平样式：深色任务栏上为白色，浅色任务栏上为深色；在 macOS 上为模板图像），下载运行时其底部会有一条细条。

f54ce429a109d5fe.source: <g1>Metro</g1>, after Windows 8's flat look: square corners, flat buttons, boxes that take an accent border when focused, check boxes with a tick, a bordered progress bar, scroll bars with their arrows always shown, one-colour icons (Microsoft's Fluent UI System Icons, MIT) and a title bar in the theme's colour with the title centred.
f54ce429a109d5fe.text: <g1>现代</g1>，仿照 Windows 8 的扁平化外观：方角、扁平按钮、获得焦点时带有强调色边框的方框、带勾选标记的复选框、带边框的进度条、始终显示箭头的滚动条、单色图标（Microsoft 的 Fluent UI System Icons，MIT 许可）以及主题色标题栏，标题居中显示。

f54d62d6026fbe4e.source: YouTube's "Requested format is not available" no longer stops a download: DDM takes the nearest quality below.
f54d62d6026fbe4e.text: YouTube 的“请求的格式不可用”不再中断下载：DDM 会选择次一级的可用画质。

f554a7b471d1c8c4.source: To check that your copy is the real one:
f554a7b471d1c8c4.text: 要检查您的副本是否为正版：

f55e431df0898bf7.source: Corner radius of a popup in a window (a calendar, a filter box)
f55e431df0898bf7.text: 窗口中弹出框的圆角半径（日历、筛选框）

f55f43905143b2ec.text: 任务 → 添加批量下载

f566a29ba545e840.source: A page whose video the window can't find: play the video in your browser, then use the extension's <g1>Media on this page</g1> to send the stream the page loaded.
f566a29ba545e840.text: 如果窗口找不到页面中的视频：在浏览器中播放视频，然后使用扩展程序的<g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>发送页面加载的视频流。

f56e4e7d42ad5f01.source: a video it hands to yt-dlp;

f575c52354f70221.source: Free forever, no ads, no trial
f575c52354f70221.text: 永久免费，无广告，无试用

f599b55f9382804e.source: Such a part pressed or open
f599b55f9382804e.text: 此类部分被按下或打开时

f5a3030081bf32d1.source: <g1>View → Toolbar:</g1> large or small buttons, with or without their names (each button then says its name when you point at it), and <g2>Customize...</g2> to choose which buttons show and in what order. <g3>View → Tray icon</g3> turns the notification-area icon off (closing the window then minimizes it), the download speed in its tooltip, and on Windows the progress on the taskbar button.
f5a3030081bf32d1.text: <g1>视图 → 工具栏：</g1>大按钮或小按钮，带或不带名称（不带名称时，指向按钮会显示它的名称），以及<g2>自定义...</g2>，用于选择显示哪些按钮及其顺序。<g3>视图 → 托盘图标</g3>可关闭通知区域图标（此时关闭窗口会将其最小化）、在其提示中显示下载速度，在 Windows 上还可在任务栏按钮上显示进度。

f5ccbc8600909247.source: Only your devices, only at home
f5ccbc8600909247.text: 仅限您的设备，仅限家中

f5d0db4c9a23ece3.source: <g1><g2>Adding downloads</g2></g1> — Add URL, the clipboard, the drop target, batch downloads and lists of links, and Start Download versus Download Later.

f5de564aaf2112b5.source: <g1>Use the browser's proxy for the downloads it hands over…</g1> — on by default. A download DDM takes from the browser goes through the proxy the browser used for it. That's the one a VPN or proxy extension set, the browser's own manual proxy, or its proxy auto-config script. Without it, the download would leave from your own address, and content limited to the VPN's country, or to its address, would fail. The browser extension reads that proxy and hands it to DDM with each download, once you switch on <g2>Download through this browser's VPN or proxy</g2> in the extension's options page, under <g3>More</g3> (right-click its toolbar button → <g4>Options</g4>; Firefox asks you once; Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi ask nothing more: see <g5>A VPN or proxy extension</g5>).
f5de564aaf2112b5.text: <g1>对浏览器交给 DDM 的下载使用浏览器的代理…</g1> — 默认开启。DDM 从浏览器接管的下载会经过浏览器当时使用的代理。即 VPN 或代理扩展设置的代理、浏览器自己的手动代理，或其代理自动配置脚本。如果不勾选，下载会从您自己的地址发出，限于 VPN 所在国家或其地址的内容将会失败。当您在扩展的选项页的<g3>更多</g3>下开启<g2>通过此浏览器的 VPN 或代理下载</g2>后（右键单击其工具栏按钮 → <g4>选项</g4>；Firefox 会询问您一次；Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 和 Vivaldi 无需再询问：见<g5>VPN 或代理扩展</g5>），浏览器扩展会读取该代理，并随每个下载一起交给 DDM。

f5fe003f854c8f13.source: <g1>Choose the DNS</g1> (<g2>#36</g2>): <g3>Options → Connection → DNS</g3> picks who turns names into addresses for downloads, FTP, DDM's own downloads and the update check. The system's (the default), Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, NextDNS (with your configuration ID) or your own, asked over HTTPS (the default), TLS, or plain over TCP. <g4>Test</g4> shows how long it takes to answer. When it can't be reached, the download stops with a message naming it, unless you allow falling back to the system's DNS; your hosts file and local names stay with the system's. The command line's <x5/> takes <x6/>. Torrent trackers still use the system's DNS, and so do video pages and galleries unless a network adapter is chosen.
f5fe003f854c8f13.text: <g1>选择 DNS</g1>（<g2>#36</g2>）：<g3>选项 → 连接 → DNS</g3> 选择谁将名称转换为下载、FTP、DDM 自己的下载和更新检查的地址。系统默认、Cloudflare、Google、Quad9、AdGuard、NextDNS（带您的配置 ID）或您自己的，通过 HTTPS（默认）、TLS 或纯 TCP 查询。<g4>测试</g4> 显示响应所需的时间。当无法访问时，下载会停止并显示命名它的消息，除非您允许回退到系统的 DNS；您的 hosts 文件和本地名称仍使用系统的 DNS。<x5/> 命令行接受 <x6/>。种子跟踪器仍使用系统的 DNS，视频页面和图库也是如此，除非选择了网络适配器。

f6036d014e6073ae.source: <g1>Media on this page</g1> lists the video streams and the video and sound files a page has loaded, so a video with no link can still be saved. Copy-protected streams are listed as <g2>Protected</g2> and never sent.
f6036d014e6073ae.text: <g1>此页面上的媒体</g1>会列出页面已加载的视频流以及视频和音频文件，因此没有链接的视频仍然可以保存。受版权保护的流会显示为<g2>受保护</g2>，并且永远不会发送。

f6139c8865fba608.source: It notes the addresses of video streams (HLS and DASH playlists) a page's player loads, in memory for that tab, so the <g1>Download video</g1> button can pass the stream on. Its button reads the page only to find video and sound players and place itself. Clicking it passes the page's address, the video's address, the page's title, the site's cookies, the page that embeds the player and your browser's User-Agent to DDM.
f6139c8865fba608.text: 它会在该标签页的内存中记录页面播放器加载的视频流（HLS 和 DASH 播放列表）地址，以便<g1>下载视频</g1>按钮可以传递该流。其按钮只读取页面以查找视频和音频播放器并放置自身。点击它会将页面地址、视频地址、页面标题、网站 cookie、嵌入播放器的页面和您的浏览器 User-Agent 传递给 DDM。

f617526761a05ad4.source: <g1>Show start download dialog</g1> — show <g2>Download File Info</g2> for each new download. With it off, downloads start at once, or only join the queue if you tick <g3>Do not start downloading, only add files to the queue</g3>.

f63dae15529c38a7.source: <g1>Faster where it counts.</g1> In our benchmark against IDM 6.42 on the same computer and server, DDM downloaded 1 GiB in 1.0 s against 5.5 s, and a small file in 0.03 s against 3.1 s. <g2>See every run.</g2>
f63dae15529c38a7.text: <g1>在关键之处更快。</g1> 在我们对 IDM 6.42 进行的基准测试中，在同一台计算机和服务器上，DDM 下载 1 GiB 用时 1.0 秒，而 IDM 用时 5.5 秒；下载一个小文件 DDM 用时 0.03 秒，而 IDM 用时 3.1 秒。<g2>查看每次运行。</g2>

f6cb473a1175577a.source: <g1>Luna</g1>: Windows XP's look: buttons shaded from white with an orange glow under the pointer, green ticks, square text boxes, progress in green blocks, a deep blue title bar with the title in bold (on Windows, where DDM draws it), and colourful icons drawn for DDM in that manner.

f76622e7ae43484d.text: 使用 Dannex Download Manager 和 dannex.kavangi.co.ke 的条款：GNU GPL 3.0 许可下的免费软件，使用风险自负，仅用于您有权下载的内容。

f77cbac3441da259.source: A name that would lead outside the folder is left out, and so is a link to somewhere else on the disk. An archive that would write far more than its size, or more than the disk has room for, stops before it fills it. Extracted files are marked as coming from the internet, as the archive is, so Windows still warns before running a program from them. The archive itself goes to the Recycle Bin (the Trash on macOS and Linux) only if you ask.
f77cbac3441da259.text: 如果文件名会导致文件解压到指定文件夹之外，或者链接到磁盘上的其他位置，则会跳过该文件。如果压缩包解压后文件大小远超其自身大小，或超出磁盘可用空间，解压会在填满磁盘前停止。解压后的文件会被标记为来自互联网，就像压缩包本身一样，因此 Windows 在运行其中的程序前仍会发出警告。压缩包本身只有在您要求时才会移至回收站（macOS 和 Linux 上是废纸篓）。

f780a1e13d261137.source: Everything can be done from the keyboard, and DDM works with screen readers (such as Narrator and NVDA on Windows): its windows, dialogs and menus tell them what each control is and its state, and the download list reads each download's name, status and size. The <g1>Categories</g1> pane reads as a tree (each category with its count, open or shut, selected or not), and the menu bar and every right-click menu as menus whose items can be run from there. On Linux, screen readers (Orca) don't read DDM's windows yet; the keyboard works there as everywhere.
f780a1e13d261137.text: DDM 支持屏幕阅读器（如 Windows 上的“讲述人”和 NVDA），所有操作均可通过键盘完成：其窗口、对话框和菜单会告知屏幕阅读器每个控件的名称和状态，下载列表会朗读每个下载任务的名称、状态和大小。<g1>类别</g1>窗格会以树状结构朗读（每个类别及其数量、展开或折叠、选中或未选中），菜单栏和所有右键菜单也会作为菜单朗读，其项目可直接运行。在 Linux 上，屏幕阅读器（Orca）尚无法朗读 DDM 的窗口；但键盘操作与其他地方一样有效。

f79d1bba86369d73.source: Your debrid service accounts (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox; experimental): <g1>Add...</g1> signs in by code in the browser or with your API token or key; a link from a host the service supports is then downloaded through it. The list's order is the order accounts are asked. See <g2>Debrid service accounts</g2>.
f79d1bba86369d73.text: 您的网盘服务帐户（Real-Debrid、AllDebrid、Premiumize、TorBox；实验性功能）：点击“<g1>添加...</g1>”可通过浏览器中的代码或您的 API 令牌或密钥登录；然后，该服务支持的主机链接将通过它下载。列表中的顺序是帐户被请求的顺序。请参阅“<g2>网盘服务帐户</g2>”。

f7c87eb79d2909ee.text: 如果您希望在离开时获得全速，请勾选<g1>仅在我使用计算机时</g1>。DDM 在一分钟内没有鼠标或键盘输入后会恢复全速。

f7f197a18bb95f86.source: Each download is then held to that speed. <g1>Downloads → Speed Limiter → Turn off</g1> gives full speed again. Tick <g2>Turn the limiter on whenever Dannex Download Manager starts</g2> to have it on every time.
f7f197a18bb95f86.text: 随后每个下载都被限制在该速度。<g1>下载 → 速度限制器 → 关闭</g1>会恢复全速。勾选<g2>每次 Dannex Download Manager 启动时开启限制器</g2>可让它每次都开启。

f7f2e0ba07d3545b.text: 一个带请求日志和故障注入的 HTTP Range 服务器，以及一个带自身故障的 FTP/FTPS 服务器，用于测试和基准测试

f8092cd791a22a18.source: <g1>Stop sharing after sharing for … minutes</g1> — or once it has been shared that long, over all its runs. Off by default.

DDM unlocks it through your account, then downloads it with all its connections, pause and resume. When the direct link expires, DDM asks the service for a new one.
f85f6808b908ce48.text: 在<g1>添加 URL</g1>中、从浏览器的<g2>使用 DDM 下载</g2>中，或在批量下载中，粘贴您的服务支持的文件主机链接。DDM 会通过您的账户解锁该链接，然后用所有连接、暂停和恢复功能下载它。当直链过期时，DDM 会向服务请求一个新的链接。

fcd7e3ff9fcf7900.source: Torrents: with the <g1>Port</g1> box empty in Torrent settings, DDM keeps the port it picked and listens on it again at the next start (another one if a program has taken it), so peers that learned it, and a router's or firewall's rule for it, still reach DDM; it was a new port at each start. DDM's log says where it listens: one socket for IPv4 and IPv6, which Windows' <x2/> (IPv4 only) doesn't list (<g3>#650</g3>).
fcd7e3ff9fcf7900.text: 种子：当种子设置中的<g1>端口</g1>框为空时，DDM 会保留它选定的端口，并在下次启动时再次监听它（若被某个程序占用则换一个），因此知道该端口的对等节点，以及路由器或防火墙针对它的规则，仍能连上 DDM；此前每次启动都是新端口。DDM 的日志会说明它在哪里监听：一个同时用于 IPv4 和 IPv6 的套接字，而 Windows 的 <x2/>（仅 IPv4）不会列出它（<g3>#650</g3>）。

fcd7edd5083864fc.source: The main window in the Luna theme

fcdbb056bd6a9d74.source: <g1>Video pages and image galleries</g1> go through it too, on Windows, Linux and macOS: video downloads (yt-dlp and the ffmpeg it starts) and galleries (gallery-dl) go through a proxy DDM runs on this computer, which opens their connections through the adapter as DDM opens its own, with the DNS you chose, IPv4 and IPv6. The same kill switch: when the adapter disconnects, their connections close at once and the downloads stop, then start again when it is back. Formats over RTMP, RTSP, MMS or FTP, which can't go through it, are refused. The command line's <x2/> and <x3/> take <x4/>.
fcdbb056bd6a9d74.text: <g1>视频页面和图片图库</g1>在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上也通过它进行：视频下载（yt-dlp 及其启动的 ffmpeg）和图库（gallery-dl）通过 DDM 在此计算机上运行的代理进行，该代理通过适配器打开其连接，就像 DDM 打开自己的连接一样，使用您选择的 DNS、IPv4 和 IPv6。相同的断网开关：当适配器断开连接时，它们的连接会立即关闭，下载停止，然后在适配器恢复时重新开始。无法通过它进行的 RTMP、RTSP、MMS 或 FTP 格式将被拒绝。<x2/> 和 <x3/> 命令行接受 <x4/>。

fd276668ae232ac7.source: <g1>Windows: a slow start no longer turns Direct3D off</g1> (part of <g2>#280</g2>): DDM gives Direct3D 10 seconds to show its first frame, and goes back to OpenGL when it doesn't. Those 10 seconds counted DDM's own loading too (the list, the fonts, the icons), which can take that long by itself on a busy computer just after it starts, so Direct3D was taken for failing and OpenGL drew from then on. Only Direct3D's own time counts now. Crash and freeze reports say what drew, on which graphics card and driver (OpenGL's too), and why, near their top, where a report cut to fit still has it.
fd276668ae232ac7.text: <g1>Windows：慢速启动不再关闭 Direct3D</g1>（<g2>#280</g2> 的一部分）：DDM 会给 Direct3D 10 秒时间来显示其第一帧，如果未显示则返回 OpenGL。这 10 秒也计算了 DDM 自身的加载时间（列表、字体、图标），这在刚启动的繁忙计算机上可能需要很长时间，因此 Direct3D 被认为是失败的，此后便使用 OpenGL 绘制。现在只计算 Direct3D 自身的时间。崩溃和冻结报告会在顶部附近说明绘制方式、使用的显卡和驱动程序（也包括 OpenGL 的），以及原因，即使报告被截断以适应空间，这些信息也仍然存在。

fd29b8ed66645d3f.source: For the best qualities and MP3, DDM needs <g1>ffmpeg</g1>, which joins the picture and the sound, and makes the MP3. On Windows DDM offers to install it (about 80 MB): click <g2>Install ffmpeg</g2> if you want them. On Linux and macOS DDM uses the system's ffmpeg. Without it, you get the qualities that come with their sound.
fd29b8ed66645d3f.text: 为了获得最佳质量和 MP3，DDM 需要 <g1>ffmpeg</g1>，它负责将图像和声音合并，并制作 MP3。在 Windows 上，DDM 会提供安装它（约 80 MB）：如果您需要，请点击<g2>安装 ffmpeg</g2>。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 使用系统的 ffmpeg。如果没有它，您将只能获得自带声音的质量。

fd40efe02c1179f3.source: The examples use Windows' paths; on macOS and Linux the programs have the same names without <x1/>.
fd40efe02c1179f3.text: 示例使用 Windows 路径；在 macOS 和 Linux 上，程序名称相同，不带 <x1/>。

fd48ccb610778e29.source: <g1>Fit columns to content</g1> in the same menu makes every column as wide as its title and cells need; <g2>Reset columns</g2> puts them back as they first were.
fd48ccb610778e29.text: 同一菜单中的<g1>使列适应内容</g1>会让每一列的宽度刚好满足其标题和单元格所需；<g2>重置列</g2>会将它们恢复为最初的样子。

fd557623911e01e1.source: Adds an http, https, ftp or ftps address and starts it, or only queues it. It can say which folder and file name to use. A magnet link opens <g1>Add torrent</g1> in DDM, for you to choose the files.
fd557623911e01e1.text: 添加 http、https、ftp 或 ftps 地址并开始下载，或者只将其排队。它可以指定要使用的文件夹和文件名。磁力链接会在 DDM 中打开<g1>添加种子</g1>，供您选择文件。

fd63eb3e402437d2.source: <g1>First and last pieces first</g1> — with <g2>Download in order</g2>, each file's first and last pieces come before the rest. It's on by default.
fd63eb3e402437d2.text: <g1>先下载首尾分块</g1> — 启用<g2>按顺序下载</g2>时，每个文件的首尾分块会优先于其他分块下载。此功能默认开启。

fd7c2bd567899d89.source: Buttons fit their text in every language.
fd7c2bd567899d89.text: 按钮文本在所有语言中都能正确显示。

fd876f9ac58a00f5.source: You can also paste a magnet link into <g1>Add URL</g1>, or drop a magnet link or a <x2/> file on the drop target (<g3>Tasks → Show drop target</g3>). With <g4>Options → General → Offer to download links copied to the clipboard</g4> on, copying a magnet link opens <g5>Add torrent</g5> with it, as copying a <x6/> file's address does, while <x7/> is in <g8>Options → File types</g8>. In the browser, right-click a magnet link and choose <g9>Download with DDM</g9>: <g10>Add torrent</g10> opens with it (the extension hands over only the magnet links you choose this way). If a torrent is already in the list, DDM says so instead of adding it twice.
fd876f9ac58a00f5.text: 您也可以将磁力链接粘贴到<g1>添加 URL</g1>中，或将磁力链接或 <x2/> 文件拖放到拖放目标上（<g3>任务 → 显示拖放目标</g3>）。在<g4>选项 → 常规 → 提供下载复制到剪贴板的链接</g4>开启时，复制磁力链接会用它打开<g5>添加种子</g5>，就像复制 <x6/> 文件的地址一样，前提是 <x7/> 在<g8>选项 → 文件类型</g8>中。在浏览器中，右键单击磁力链接并选择<g9>使用 DDM 下载</g9>：<g10>添加种子</g10>会随之打开（扩展只会交出您以这种方式选择的磁力链接）。如果种子已在列表中，DDM 会提示，而不会重复添加。

fd8d00a1a895c664.source: RSS feeds: the boxes on the <g1>Download rules</g1> tab (<g2>Episodes</g2>, <g3>Must contain</g3> and the others) keep the keyboard while you type, instead of losing it after each key (<g4>#353</g4>).
fd8d00a1a895c664.text: RSS 源：在<g1>下载规则</g1>选项卡上的文本框（<g2>剧集</g2>、<g3>必须包含</g3>及其他）中输入时，键盘焦点会保持不变，而不是在每次按键后丢失（<g4>#353</g4>）。

fd9436eee4e48316.source: To set a time, click a part of it (hours, minutes, seconds) and use the arrows, the mouse wheel, <g1>Up</g1> / <g2>Down</g2> or the number keys. <g3>Left</g3> and <g4>Right</g4> move between the parts.
fd9436eee4e48316.text: 要设置时间，请点击时间的一部分（小时、分钟、秒），然后使用箭头、鼠标滚轮、<g1>向上</g1>/<g2>向下</g2>键或数字键。<g3>向左</g3>和<g4>向右</g4>键可在各部分之间移动。

fda2cfaa8ff38501.source: Changed your mind? <g1>Options → Save to → Restore the built-in categories</g1> brings them back as they came, and leaves your own categories alone. <g2>General</g2> and <g3>Torrents</g3> still change only their folder.
fda2cfaa8ff38501.text: 改变主意了？<g1>选项 → 保存到 → 恢复内置类别</g1>可将它们恢复到初始状态，同时保留您自己的类别。<g2>常规</g2>和<g3>种子</g3>仍然只能更改其文件夹。

fda43ee86c59eb8d.source: Some servers drop the connection when the speed is very low. Avoid a tight limit for servers that can't resume (<g1>Resume capability: No</g1>).
fda43ee86c59eb8d.text: 速度过低时，某些服务器会断开连接。对于无法恢复下载的服务器（<g1>恢复功能：否</g1>），请避免设置过低的限速。

fda48c1e8bc723f7.source: <g1><g2>Keep some speed for everything else</g2></g1> — cap DDM so browsing and calls stay smooth.
fda48c1e8bc723f7.text: <g1><g2>为其他任务留出带宽</g2></g1> — 限制 DDM 的下载速度，让网页浏览和通话保持流畅。

fdac126a9d867074.source: <g1>Nothing to relearn.</g1> The toolbar, categories, download list, progress window, queues, Scheduler and Options sit where you expect them. Even the command-line switches are the same: <x2/>.
fdac126a9d867074.text: <g1>无需重新学习。</g1> 工具栏、类别、下载列表、进度窗口、队列、计划程序和选项都在您期望的位置。甚至命令行开关也相同：<x2/>。

fdcffa742865c035.text: <g1>其他所有链接</g1>都会归入<g2>各种文件</g2>。

fdd3b365476f4122.source: You can always save a video without the button: in DDM, open <g1>Tasks → Download video from a page</g1> and paste the video's address.
fdd3b365476f4122.text: 您始终可以在没有按钮的情况下保存视频：在 DDM 中，打开<g1>任务 → 从页面下载视频</g1>并粘贴视频地址即可。

fde4e6f4f17a1676.source: When a browser can't use its store (a computer managed by an organization, or a build of your own), add the extension by hand:
fde4e6f4f17a1676.text: 如果浏览器无法使用其应用商店（例如计算机由组织管理，或您使用的是自行构建的版本），请手动添加扩展：

fde94fba7214be17.source: Add a download with the copied address filled in
fde94fba7214be17.text: 添加下载，已填入复制的地址

fe04554eccb8bb00.source: In the <g1>Categories</g1> tree, <g2>Up</g2> / <g3>Down</g3> choose a node, <g4>Left</g4> / <g5>Right</g5> close and open a branch, and <g6>Home</g6> / <g7>End</g7> go to the first / last node. <g8>Left</g8> on a category inside a branch goes to the branch, <g9>Right</g9> on an open branch to its first category. The selection of whichever of the two has the keys is in the selection colour, the other one's in grey.
fe04554eccb8bb00.text: 在<g1>类别</g1>树中，<g2>上</g2> / <g3>下</g3>选择节点，<g4>左</g4> / <g5>右</g5>收起和展开分支，<g6>Home</g6> / <g7>End</g7>跳到第一个 / 最后一个节点。分支内某个类别上按<g8>左</g8>回到该分支，展开的分支上按<g9>右</g9>进入其第一个类别。两者中拥有按键控制权的那一个，其选中项用选择色显示，另一个用灰色。

fe1a7df75494930a.source: Video downloads (and image galleries) keep to the speed limits you set: a video's own limit (its progress window's <g1>Speed Limiter</g1> tab) and the limit for all downloads together, not only the limit for one file, and turning the limiter on or off, changing its settings or a video's own limit applies to the videos under way (at once for a video DDM's own downloader brings in; one yt-dlp still downloads by itself, and a gallery, take a limit only as they start, so they stop and start again with the new one, from where they were). Several such videos under the limit for all downloads share it evenly: when another starts, the ones running with more than their share start again with it. A video or a gallery started while the Scheduler's download limit is reached now waits, as other downloads do (<g2>#708</g2>).
fe1a7df75494930a.text: 视频下载（以及图库）遵守您设置的速度限制：视频自己的限制（其进度窗口的<g1>速度限制器</g1>选项卡）和所有下载合计的限制，而不只是单个文件的限制；开启或关闭限速、更改其设置或视频自己的限制，都会作用于正在进行的视频（对 DDM 自己的下载器取回的视频立即生效；仍由 yt-dlp 自己下载的视频和图库只在开始时采用限制，所以会停止，再以新限制从原来的位置重新开始）。在所有下载合计的限制之下，几个这样的视频平均分享它：另一个开始时，占用超过其份额的会用新份额重新启动。在计划程序的下载限制已达到时开始的视频或图库，现在会像其他下载一样等待（<g2>#708</g2>）。

fe1e9bfa950043a0.source: File Properties: change the address or the folder of a download.
fe1e9bfa950043a0.text: 文件属性：更改下载的地址或文件夹。

fe3606d7fc5eae65.source: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>Every connection, live</g3> <g4>Each connection drawn as it fills, with the speed and the time left. Crash-safe resume picks up where it stopped.</g4>
fe3606d7fc5eae65.text: <g1><g2></g2></g1> <g3>实时显示每个连接</g3> <g4>实时显示每个连接的进度、速度和剩余时间。崩溃后可从中断处继续下载。</g4>

The entire risk as to its quality and performance is with you. See sections 15 and 16 of the GPL. Keep backups of anything important.
fe3ad5eb0f0ce650.text: 本软件<g1>“按原样”提供，不附带任何明示或暗示的担保</g1>，包括适销性和特定用途适用性的暗示担保。其质量和性能的全部风险由您承担。请参阅 GPL 的第 15 和 16 条。请备份任何重要内容。

fe61a646d618ccfe.source: <g1>Take downloads from these browsers</g1> — untick a browser to leave its downloads alone.
fe61a646d618ccfe.text: <g1>接管这些浏览器的下载</g1> — 取消勾选某个浏览器即可忽略它的下载。

fe63bdf14208dc05.source: Queues and the Scheduler — Dannex Download Manager help
fe63bdf14208dc05.text: 队列和计划程序 — Dannex Download Manager 帮助

fe6ff4555319cc19.source: <g1>DDM follows every kind of redirect a browser does</g1> (<g2>#28</g2>): any HTTP redirect (301, 302, 303, 307, 308), up to 20 in a row instead of 10, and the pages download sites put in between ("your download starts in a moment"), which lead on with a <x3/> header or a <x4/>: their wait is kept (up to 10 seconds), and the cookies they set go along while the download runs (not into a resume later). A page that leads on only through its own script still stops there.
fe6ff4555319cc19.text: <g1>DDM 遵循浏览器处理的各种重定向</g1>（<g2>#28</g2>）：任何 HTTP 重定向（301、302、303、307、308），最多连续 20 次而不是 10 次，以及下载网站在中间插入的页面（“您的下载即将开始”），这些页面通过 <x3/> 标头或 <x4/> 继续：它们的等待时间会保留（最多 10 秒），并且它们设置的 cookie 会在下载运行时一起发送（不会在稍后恢复时发送）。仅通过自身脚本继续的页面仍然会停止在那里。

fe7544246e6d98cc.source: <g1><g2>The download list</g2></g1> — columns, filters, the categories tree, selecting many downloads, finding one, and deleting downloads with or without their files.
fe7544246e6d98cc.text: <g1><g2>下载列表</g2></g1> — 列、筛选器、类别树、选择多个下载、查找下载，以及删除下载时是否同时删除文件。

fe7ec4edd3453985.source: On the computer: <g1>Options → Remote → Pair a device...</g1> It shows a QR code, the address and an 8-digit code.
fe7ec4edd3453985.text: 在电脑上：<g1>选项 → 远程 → 配对设备...</g1> 它会显示一个二维码、地址和一个 8 位代码。

fe7f08844863e24a.source: <g1>Download with the browser:</g1> a site whose bot check lets only browsers through (a Cloudflare challenge, Akamai's edge page) can refuse DDM even when it asks the way a browser connects. Such a download now offers <g2>Download with the browser</g2> in its progress window and its right-click menu: it opens in the browser it came from (or your default browser), where you answer the check, and the browser keeps the download that follows instead of handing it back to DDM; the extension's popup says why. A queue doesn't retry the row meanwhile; <g3>Resume</g3> tries DDM again (<g4>#376</g4>).
fe7f08844863e24a.text: <g1>使用浏览器下载：</g1>有些网站的机器人检查只放行浏览器（如 Cloudflare 验证、Akamai 的边缘页面），即使 DDM 以浏览器的连接方式请求，也可能被拒绝。这类下载现在会在进度窗口和右键菜单中提供<g2>使用浏览器下载</g2>：它会在下载来源的浏览器（或您的默认浏览器）中打开，您在其中完成验证，随后的下载由浏览器保留，不再交还给 DDM；扩展的弹出窗口会说明原因。队列在此期间不会重试该行；<g3>恢复</g3>会让 DDM 重新尝试（<g4>#376</g4>）。

fe80ed54707e2242.source: Untick the addresses you don't want (<g1>Check all</g1> and <g2>Uncheck all</g2> help), then click <g3>Add to queue</g3>.
fe80ed54707e2242.text: 取消勾选不需要的地址（可使用<g1>全选</g1>和<g2>取消全选</g2>），然后点击<g3>添加到队列</g3>。

fe84619fc60f4f4a.source: Windows: a freeze report whose window thread hardly ran and stopped in the C runtime's memory routines (<x1/>, comparing the first bytes of an icon) now says the computer was too busy to run DDM or slow to load it from disk, with the page faults counted meanwhile, instead of a deadlock; those routines never wait (<g2>#663</g2>).
fe84619fc60f4f4a.text: Windows：窗口线程几乎没有运行、停在 C 运行库内存例程中的冻结报告（<x1/>，比较图标的前几个字节），现在会说明电脑太忙无法运行 DDM，或从磁盘加载它太慢，并统计其间的缺页次数，而不是说成死锁；这些例程从不等待（<g2>#663</g2>）。

fea610c52c0ff664.source: <g1>Save to</g1>: a folder of your choice. Left empty, each file goes to its category's folder (<g2>Options → Save to</g2>), as other downloads do.
fea610c52c0ff664.text: <g1>保存到</g1>：您选择的文件夹。留空时，每个文件会像其他下载一样，保存到其类别的文件夹（<g2>选项 → 保存到</g2>）。

feaa1885a7fdd962.source: Connection: how many connections, through which network adapter.
feaa1885a7fdd962.text: 连接：通过哪个网络适配器进行多少个连接。

fec76950a77c380f.source: IDM's layout and your IDM list, with torrents, video and 86 languages built in
fec76950a77c380f.text: 采用 IDM 的界面，可导入 IDM 下载列表，并内置种子下载、视频下载和 86 种语言

fedf99eaec2561b9.source: <g1>Download selected</g1> adds the ticked files to the download list; <g2>Download all</g2> adds every file found. Each download carries the page it was found on as its referrer, as the browser would.
fedf99eaec2561b9.text: <g1>下载所选项</g1>会把勾选的文件添加到下载列表；<g2>全部下载</g2>会添加找到的每个文件。每个下载都带有其所在页面作为来源页面，就像浏览器那样。

fedfa647604c147d.source: <g1>Stop at</g1> — a time to stop the queue if it is still running.
fedfa647604c147d.text: <g1>停止于</g1> — 如果队列仍在运行，则在该时间将其停止。

ff1ea73ff4171a03.text: <g1>交付选项</g1><g2>版本 {v1} · 所有人免费</g2>

ff26f3ab22a86c09.source: installs or updates gallery-dl, verified in the same way.
ff26f3ab22a86c09.text: 安装或更新 gallery-dl，并以相同方式进行验证。

ff4727ccf5f9acd0.source: The Scheduler's Schedule tab: Start at, Once on or Repeat on, and Stop at
ff4727ccf5f9acd0.text: 计划程序的“计划”选项卡：开始于、单次于或每周重复于，以及停止于

ff47a0a00c99d894.source: When it ends, the window lists the files: their name, type and size. They are all ticked, except those already in your download list.
ff47a0a00c99d894.text: 结束时，窗口会列出这些文件：名称、类型和大小。除了已在下载列表中的文件，其余全部已勾选。

ff67942829d53198.source: <g1>Linux builds and window shots in minutes, on WSL2</g1> (part of <g2>#164</g2>): <x3/> sets up <x4/>, an Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 distribution of its own, which builds any branch or pull request for Linux at the computer's full speed (<x5/>: about 5 minutes from scratch, under a minute after a change, against 15 to 60 in the VirtualBox machine), shoots DDM's windows in any language and mode on a virtual screen that never shows on Windows (<x6/>: about a second a window, against 40), compares OpenGL and Vulkan pixel by pixel (<x7/>), and hands a build to a VirtualBox machine for what needs a real desktop (<x8/>).
ff67942829d53198.text: <g1>在 WSL2 上，Linux 构建和窗口截图只需几分钟</g1>（<g2>#164</g2> 的一部分）：<x3/> 设置了 <x4/>，一个独立的 Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 发行版，它以计算机的全部速度构建适用于 Linux 的任何分支或拉取请求（<x5/>：从头开始约 5 分钟，更改后不到一分钟，而 VirtualBox 机器需要 15 到 60 分钟），在 Windows 上从不显示的虚拟屏幕上以任何语言和模式拍摄 DDM 的窗口（<x6/>：每个窗口约一秒，而之前需要 40 秒），逐像素比较 OpenGL 和 Vulkan（<x7/>），并将构建文件交给 VirtualBox 机器以处理需要真实桌面的任务（<x8/>）。

ff7459be5ff75e63.source: <g1>Chrome, Edge and Brave on Windows</g1> lock their cookies to themselves (Chrome 127 and later, "app-bound encryption"), and yt-dlp can't read them while the browser is open either. The window says so; choose Firefox, or use the button over the video, which works with any browser.
ff7459be5ff75e63.text: <g1>Windows 上的 Chrome、Edge 和 Brave</g1>将其 Cookie 锁定给自己（Chrome 127 及更高版本，“应用绑定加密”），并且在浏览器打开时 yt-dlp 也无法读取它们。窗口会显示此信息；请选择 Firefox，或使用视频上方的按钮，该按钮适用于任何浏览器。

ffeedec50b9a371f.source: For a download already in the list, <g1>File Properties</g1> has the same choice beside the login: <g2>Through Real-Debrid</g2>. It can be changed while the download isn't running. The next start goes the new way, and continues from what is already downloaded when the file is the same.
ffeedec50b9a371f.text: 对于列表中已有的下载，<g1>文件属性</g1> 中登录信息旁边也有相同的选项：<g2>通过 Real-Debrid</g2>。下载未运行时可以更改此选项。下次启动时将改用新方式，并在文件相同时从已下载的部分继续。

fffdcf4abbfd0c44.source: Menus: going from an item with a submenu to another item closes the submenu at once, and only the item under the pointer is lit. The submenu stayed open, its item lit as well, until the pointer rested on one item, so as long as it kept moving; going diagonally into the submenu still keeps it open (<g1>#579</g1>).
fffdcf4abbfd0c44.text: 菜单：从带子菜单的项移到另一项时，子菜单会立即关闭，只有指针下的项会高亮。此前子菜单一直开着，其项也同时高亮，直到指针停在某一项上，也就是在指针不断移动期间；斜向移入子菜单时，仍然保持它打开（<g1>#579</g1>）。

ffffe7806eaeae3d.source: The option is off until you tick it. On Linux and macOS DDM starts with your session the same way. A <g1>portable copy</g1> can't start with Windows, since that needs the registry, so the option is greyed there.
ffffe7806eaeae3d.text: 此选项默认关闭，勾选后启用。在 Linux 和 macOS 上，DDM 也会以同样的方式随会话启动。<g1>便携版</g1>无法随 Windows 启动，因为它需要注册表，所以该选项会显示为灰色。
